Overall, this place is good to maybe spot in and see but I wouldn't spend too much time here especially when there are much better options on Broadway.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: We tried this place twice during our stay.  We got there too early the first time.  We went for drinks....... $6 beers and hit all three floors for music and it was awful!  We went on a Friday and expected more.  The second time we showed up and it was very crowded, service was slow and still $6 beers We had to go to the bar because the waitress could not keep up.  Of three floors only the 3rd floor had ok music.  If you want music go to Tootsies or Robert's Western. I am not a college kid but That is the crowd they cater to.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text:
Seriously so poorly run that I am 35 th in line to go to the bathroom!!!
Food sucks.  Drinks are expensive but the music is awesome!

name: Famous Nashville
text:
The beauty of Nashville is that you can wander into just about anywhere (coffee shop, hotel bar, or bar/restaurant) and find talented entertainment. We loved the 2 guys who were singing there on Sunday night and stayed for 2 drinks (we just had one if the entertainment was ordinary).
The Famous is a cut above most of the places on Broadway. The decor is modern, clean, and musical. They have heard of wine and have some decent ones by the glass. The service was warm and efficient. 
We'll go back the next time we're in town.

name: Nashville Underground
text: Went around 4:00 on a Saturday. Horribly understaffed. After 40 minutes of waiting on our order, our food was COLD. A chicken breast and fries cold enough that I didn't want to eat it anymore. Asked the server for silverware and he didn't even respond. Had to go across the room to find silverware. The food is overrated. The burgers are mediocre at best. Then, it took another 20 minutes of standing at the counter just to close the tab. I do NOT recommend.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: PHYSICALLY ABUSIVE DOORMEN!! ASSAULTED MY BOYFRIEND AND BROKE HIS WRIST. PRESSED CHARGES!! This was the most terrifying night of my entire life. I was celebrating my birthday in Nashville. I asked my boyfriend to take a photo of me so he placed his beer down on the ground. A waitress opened a door which caused the beer to knock over and break. She started cursing under her breath and then screaming for us to be removed from the establishment. I asked her name and she then provided me with a FAKE NAME. We were escorted into a stairwell at which point we requested to speak with a manager. My boyfriend was of course incredibly upset that this disgruntled employee was ruining my boyfriend and admittedly was being a little aggressive in his tone when speaking with the manager. He never once raised a hand, displayed any physical movements, raised his voice, or use derogatory language. The manager then said he did not want to allow us back in due to my boyfriend's anger. My boyfriend then asked the doorman for the managers name. The manager refused to give it to him and my boyfriend continued to press him for it. At this point my boyfriend's back was facing the bouncer. THE BOUNCER THEN GRABBED MY BOYFRIEND'S FACE FROM BEHIND AND SLAMMED IT INTO THE GROUND. AT NO POINT IN TIME DID MY BOYFRIEND RAISE A HAND. HE KEPT HIS HANDS BY HIS SIDE THE ENTIRE TIME AND THE BOUNCER CONTINUED TO PRESS HIS FACE AND ARM INTO THE PAVEMENT BREAKING HIS WRIST AND CAUSING BLEEDING AND LACERATIONS TO HIS FACE!!! At this point, I tried to grab my boyfriend and pull him away (I am a little girl and not very strong). I was truly terrified this large bouncer was going to kill him. People started videotaping the assault as no one could believe that an innocent man was being tackled and assaulted when he never raised a hand. After I tried to pull my boyfriend away, a second employee started screaming "SHES SWINGING AT ME!!". Crazy! I wouldn't know how to throw a punch if I TRIED. AT THIS POINT- THE SECURITY GUARDS HANDCUFFED ME!!!!! I did nothing but attempt to save my boyfriend from being beaten to death by these crazed security guards. Neither of us every swang or raised a hand to anybody. They kept us handcuffed on the side of street for a hour. MANY people kept coming over trying to help us as EVERYONE saw the security guard completely randomly physically attacked my boyfriend. This was the most terrifying and humiliating night of my life. When the police finally showed up they of course let us go immediately as we had done nothing wrong. We were detained for no reason and my boyfriend was brutally beaten by a Honky Tonk Central bouncer. We are pressing assault charges and hopefully justice will be served and this maniac will be taken off the streets and no longer be able to break anymore bones or injure innocent patrons.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: We stopped in here on a Sunday for lunch and had a wonderful time. We ordered the nachos and a side of fries. They were both delicious. The live music was awesome. We only hung out on the first floor, but it was such a great time. We will be back!

name: Ascend Amphitheater
text: I've only had the privilege of seeing one show here so far (Smashing Pumpkins w/ Marilyn Manson) but I loved every part of the experience! We used Lyft and got dropped off right at the entrance. We breezed through  friendly security and had our tickets scanned on my phone with no problems at all. We found a great spot on the grass and set up camp. It didn't seem like there was a bad seat in the house. Sound quality was great, bathrooms were clean and easily assessable, and drink/food lines were short and moved quickly. You're allowed to bring in bottled water and small snacks, but nothing that requires utensils or has bones. Despite the heat of a mid-August night we really had an amazing time. Nothing like cuddling on a blanket w/ your lovie looking at the bright lights of the city while listening to the romantic sounds of Marilyn Manson. ;)

name: The Station Inn
text:
One of the best music venues in the USA. Not just Nashville, but America. I say this as someone who lives on the Sunset Strip in LA and frequently travels to NYC, Chicago, and has spent plenty of time in New Orleans and Austin, too. 

Whether you are a local or a tourist, this is a must-stop. I repeat: MUST. If you have chance to go here and don't...you suck. Hang your head in shame. You really need to trust me on this.

They host bands that are 100% pure Bluegrass / Americana, not country music. You will find the very best musicians in the entire genre play here. Pretty much every soon-to-be great band plays here on their way up.

We caught a young (early 20's) foursome called The Barefoot Movement. Un-freaking-believable. Go listen to them on Spotify or Pandora. Some of the best bluegrass I've ever heard. They will be famous one day. I guarantee you. And that's the point: this wasn't a unique experience. Great bands come through all the time. All. The.Time. Whomever is playing tonight, or tomorrow, or next week, will probably blow you away.

All in an absolutely priceless mega dive-bar atmosphere. The kind of vibe that enhances the experience. Who the hell wants to listen to the music of the Appalachia's in the Ritz-Carlton?

Make sure to arrive AT LEAST 30 minutes prior to showtime if you want a seat, maybe more.

You haven't been to Nashville if you haven't been to The Station Inn. Even if you lived there all your life. It's that simple. Now get.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: A fun time for a while, but security is the most shady group I have ever seen.  After throwing a guy out of the bar, they proceeded to throw all of his friends out for nothing to cover up their bad decisions.   Arrogant, should be shut down

name: Alley Taps
text: Went there last night to listen to music and drinks. My friend and I bought 2 WELL vodka and soda waters and were charged about $3 extra for a "mixer"??? The soda was flat too. If you want to bring people back to your bar, don't charge outrageous up-charges for mediocre drinks. I have never had this happen at a bar before, usually there is a set price for your well liquor and if you get a splash of water they don't charge $3. I'll never go back

name: Nashville Underground
text: Wouldn't go back or waste my time. Service was terrible. If you do decide to go here, I would suggest you pay in CASH since our server (Server #216, Courtney) decided to change the tip and charge the bottom line total of our overall bill. Several phone calls have been placed to the establishment and an in person visit was made to get this issue resolved. To date (2 weeks later) no contact from management or accounting. Good luck!

name: Nashville Underground
text: Like many others, I'll go into just about any place on Broadway, and the Underground might be a pretty good secret? If you need a break from the wall to wall country, the upper floors were actually playing 2000s hip-hop with a light up dance floor. The rooftop patio was very spacious, and the view of Broadway from up there was the best I saw all weekend.

name: Nashville Underground
text: Food and service were below average. I suspect that doesn't matter much as one would go there for the drinks and entertainment.

name: Benchmark Bar & Grill
text: Service was good but the food terrible. Got the cheesy BLT and it was so greasy from the butter they used to grill the bread. Then it was two American slices not even melted with lettuce, tomato and bacon. Over priced. The bacon was delicious. Then after we finish eating a cockroach crawls up the wall by our table. We left shortly after

name: 3rd And Lindsley
text: This is one of my favorite places in Nashville for music!  Love their music offerings, love the intimate setting so that every seat is a good one!  Acoustics are really good. Service is great!

name: 3rd And Lindsley
text:
I really do love it here, and unfortunately it's getting SO BUSY.
If you come during the week, you really need to make plans to be arriving around 5pm even if the show isn't until 8pm. Plan to bring your big pocketbook and just eat and drink until it's time. But it's a must if you want a good seat.  A couple years ago, you could arrive around 6pm without a ticket and get a decent seat. Long ago are those days.  I even recommend if you want to see a specific show you buy tickets ahead of time. Don't assume you can just get tickets at the door. Sometimes shows are sold out weeks in advance. We came around 6pm and ended up sitting in the back by the door.  1. It's cold back there with the wintry door swinging open letting people in and out. 2. You can hear things really well in this venue ie there's not a bad seat in the house in that way, however... 3. Sitting in the back is horrible if you want to SEE anything. People are standing in front of you (including servers) to get the drinks from the bar, and it's just not fun.  For food, it's bar food. We ended up getting the party platter which was great variety. As our meals, the husband got a burger which was "fine" and I think I got tater skins. I mean how can you butcher those up? I'm still waiting to find my go-to dinner option sometime and when I do, I'll definitely let you know!!

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: I came to this bar for my 21st birthday and I will NEVER go back! Not long after we got there and order many drinks (there was 10 of us) and sat down to enjoy the night, one of my friends who was there for my birthday asked for a water and got a shocking response. The bartender told her it was $2.50!! According to the LAW, if an establishment serves alcohol they are required to provide FREE drinking water. When my friend kindly questioned the bartender about this absurd topic, she was given absolute bs. She was persistent in finding out why their policy was above the law and kicked out for this reason. So after spending atleast $100 and only being there for 5 minutes, we had to leave. Also to make matters worse, my friend has a medical condition where she needs to have water accessible at all times and when she told the bouncers and police officers that, they said "I don't care, go find water down the street". The staff we dealt with were rude and beyond disrespectful. I would take my money elsewhere if I were you.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: Came here during the CMA festival because we thought we could get good views from the top floors. There were 3 stories and had a different band playing on each. It was a younger, more mainstream crowd than some of the other places we went on Broadway. The service was okay, and the food was mediocre bar food. The views were the coolest part.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: Was in the bar on a Tuesday night, it was not busy at all the bartender was talking to a friend I had to walk down to where she was to get her attention, walked back to where I was standing and there had been a gentleman next to me I ordered my drinks she gave me attitude as she did when we first bought our drinks. Walked away and I calledher back for the guy next to me she got cocky and said she had it and I didn't need to tell her how to do her job. She then threatened to kick me out. We were here the night before and had no issues and the staff was courteous friendly and served us with no problems. The staff needs to learn how to treat men and women alike since men and not just cater to men since women will tip better if you give them respect.

name: Ascend Amphitheater
text: Came here to see Anderson East. The venue is very nice with a lot of variety between seating areas. The sound & acoustics were great for an outdoor venue. The only potential drawback for some may be the seating. We upgraded when renting lawn chairs so figured why not. I'm a larger athletic build & the seats were a little cramped for me, but luckily no one sat beside me.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: Just not good. Band on the top was lame, no elevator which discourages some and the food was not worth it. And the drinks were tiny tiny. Sorry not a representative of Nashville

name: War Memorial Auditorium
text: Came here for the Louis York & The Shindellas concert and it was fabulous! The speakers are loud and clear. I don't believe there were any "bad" seats. The staff was very accommodating. Nathan and Jeremy helped me exchange my tickets and ensure I still had a great view. It wasn't until I visited the balcony that I realized they're all good. There isn't much leg room unfortunately, but that's due to the age of the building.

name: Ascend Amphitheater
text: I saw Old Dominion here and they said it was a sold out show but I was pleasantly surprised at how easy it was to find parking. I had lawn seats which you can rent, 2 for $15, and had a good view of the stage despite being all the way in the back. There were tons of food vendors and it looked like all seats had good visibility, no obstructed views

name: 3rd And Lindsley
text:
What a cool place for a concert! It has that perfect "Nashville" feel too! There is upper/balcony seating, room by the bar, and a lower pit area that puts you very close to the band performing. 

My friend and I went for an Echosmith concert and we had a great time! I really enjoyed the venue itself and parking nearby was only $5 (on a Thursday). I will definitely be looking for more shows at this location.

name: Famous Nashville
text: The food here was good but for a large party of 16 there was poor service. It wasn't busy and we waited for over 2 hours for our food. They did make up for it with fries for everyone!

name: The Station Inn
text: This is definitely a stop worth making while in Nashville, but it requires planning accordingly if you expect to enjoy yourself. After reading multiple reviews, we decided to arrive at 6:30 pm on a Sunday and the doors open at 7 pm. It was a great decision because we were the first in line and by the time the doors opened, the line was easily 60 people deep. Once inside, it's a free for all with seating. Grab a seat before going to the bar! The seating is gone within minutes and there is little to no standing room. The music is great and the bluegrass seems really authentic. My only criticism is that they allow too many people in. They continue to usher people in so everyone is packed together and trying not to block others' view, so it becomes really awkward sometimes as you're trying to watch the show, but someone is standing in your way "unintentionally". When we left at 8:45 pm, there were probably 80 people in line. It's a shame that they probably didn't know that they wouldn't get a seat and would be sandwiched against a partial wall somewhere with a handful of other people.

name: Nashville Underground
text:
Ended up here the other night for dinner, drinks, and a little of the Titan game. It was a last resort kind of thing because everywhere else was filled up, but it ended up working out. 
I had the hot chicken sandwich which was delicious! My boyfriend had the same thing and loved it. The fries were also super tasty. My favorite part about this spot was all of the rooftops. One of the managers took a liking to us and showed us around, very cool (didn't catch his name but he was so nice and made us feel welcome as out-of-towners). Our waitress was also really sweet and attentive- which I know can be difficult when you're also tending to the bar crowd, so I appreciate it even more! I would definitely check this place out again, even just for drinks and hanging on the rooftop.

name: Nashville Underground
text: Neat space with a upstairs and downstairs bar. It is annoying how the bathroom is only upstairs. The bartenders have poor customer service. They don't serve the bar I had to walk over to them. Even then when I came back and made eye contact with a quick bar the bartender walked away from me. Love music is great here!

name: Famous Nashville
text:
I came here for lunch with my mom, aunts, and family friends while in Nashville for the weekend. Shelley was AWESOME! Very attentive and patient with us (we were a decent-sized, somewhat indecisive group). Super friendly and very sweet. Would definitely recommend this place just for her!

The live music was amazing. Definitely one of the highlights of our trip so far!

name: Bobby's Idle Hour Tavern
text: Walked 35 mins from downtown to here and the beer was oh so worth it! Ice cold beers, friendly service with real southern hospitality. This is a no frills place. Got to try a few local TN beers and some of my usual favorites too. Will def come back next time im in town.

name: Bobby's Idle Hour Tavern
text: Nice place to catch a live performance from some local and not-so-local singer/songwriters. If you can't get to The Bluebird or The Listening Room, go to Bobby's.

name: Nashville Underground
text:
This place is terrible. The drinks are over priced and gross. 
The music awful. 
Bar service subpar. Didn't drink because it was gross bartender didn't even ask why.
Too many other good choices around.

name: Famous Nashville
text: Waitress brought the wrong drink TWICE, I'd forgive it cuz it's loud but she had attitude the whole time. The band playing (which was quite good by the way) came around with a tip bucket pestering for tips, yes, pestering, then COMPLAINED the tip we gave was too small! Then called us out on stage about it, who does that? Would have gladly tipped at the end of our meal rather than her hassling our table while eating after only 1 song! There are many great places in Nashville, this isn't one of them. Other than that the food is good but its not worth the price.

name: Alley Taps
text: I hate to leave this review because I don't want it to turn into a cluster like the bars on Broadway!  BUT....this was our favorite night in Nashville. Such a fun vibe with the greatest band. If you get the chance to see Caldwell Jack & the Six Pack....run don't walk!!!

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: I actually thought this was one of the worst bars I visited while on my trip to Nashville. It was dirty, smelled, and the drinks weren't that great.

name: Ascend Amphitheater
text: Fantastic open-air venue on the river just south of downtown Nashville. Super easy entry/exit setup and great visibility from all seats.

name: Benchmark Bar & Grill
text: Touch and go to say the least, but the music is SO worth the stop. My husband and I stumbled upon this place after hopping around downtown and we are so glad we did. A guys named Isaac Mathews was playing and he's absolutely incredible. We made it a point to find out his schedule and come back for round 2 the next day. Service is touch and go- our first day we had incredible service and the 2nd not so much. Again, didn't make us want to leave because this guy kicks ass. Suck it up and get a frozen bushwaker for $5 and listen to some good jams.

name: Famous Nashville
text:
I had a very bad brunch experience here. The food was not good, and overpriced. The waitress was being overworked/stressed and ran my card for mine as well as someone else's order :( 

2 stars because it's a cool bar and i have hopes that they can serve a beer better than they can make eggs and function on brunch days!

name: Honky Tonk Central
text:
0l
Great music. Poor Service. 
Stopped in wednesday night on the reccomendation of a friend. The music was great so we decided to hangout on the second floor. I ordered a beer and the fritos pie from our bartender, Samantha. The beer was good but my food seemed to take forever. 
After I'd long since finished my beer I finally got the attention of the other bartender who grabbed her for me and said I wanted to cancel my food because we were leaving. She said I couldn't cancel because my food was likely already done and waiting but that she hadn't gone to get it yet.

I could understand if the bar was slammed but it had actually been pretty empty for the last 15min and she was joking around at the register with the other bartender, so to know my food was done and just getting cold was ridiculous. 
She of course went to the back and came out with a fresh attitude and luke warm food.
I choked it down and we left. Overall horrible experience. With so many venues to choose from in the area I would never recommend this place based solely on service.

name: The Station Inn
text: If you like music you'll love this place. The grass in here is blue and the atmosphere friendly. We even witnessed a proposal from one of the musicians from on stage one of the nights we went. Get off Broadway and see the real Nashville.

name: The Station Inn
text:
Really fun experience on a Sunday night and actually FREE! You can read all about it from other reviews but a tip that there is ONLY beer, no wine or hard liquor. And they only serve pizza and popcorn so eat beforehand if that's not what you're looking for. 

Also, def come before 7:30. That's when we arrived and there was already a line. We were the very last to get in while others had to wait til someone left to take their seat. It's seating room only, no standing so they can't just pack them in. At 8pm, I overheard the hostess say there were about 90 ppl outside waiting in line!

name: 3rd And Lindsley
text: What an excellent venue! The sound system was terrific.  The music was great. Our waitress did a tremendous job with a full house. The food was typical bar food. Prices were just fine. No complaints about the food or prices. The bathroom was uniquely situated.  There are two locations for the bathrooms. Parking is a bit tight for free parking. Open seating everywhere.  I'd try the upper level next time.

name: Music City Male Revue
text:
Very entertaining and tons of fun!!

VIP tickets are a must to fully enjoy. I don't think I'd want to go if you were general admission standing in the back. 

One complaint is that I bought a round of drinks for $40 dollars. Then the next round, the same drinks were $33 dollars. Confused why it was a different cost, I went to different bartenders both times. 

I'd love more choreographed dancing and less guitar singing. The milkman performance was the best and most entertaining, I wish more dances like that were incorporated rather than a guy air humping a bench or singing in underwear.

name: Ascend Amphitheater
text:
I had a great opportunity to volunteer for a non profit here during several concerts in 2016 including Twenty one Pilots, Weezer with Panic at The Disco, BORNS, John Williams with the Nashville Symphony Star Wars and E.T, Jimmy Buffett and so many more. It was a great experience for a good cause.

 I wanted to chime in here on the fact that the volunteers work the concessions a lot of the time and we did nor do get paid for it. It went to whatever organization we chose. So appreciate the workers behind the counters volunteers or not the line gets long and they work as fast as they can. The staff treated us great only complaint was parking. We could park and walk across the bridge however we would get there at 2pm and leave at 3am and tired so sometimes we would pay to park closer. I think Ascend is a great asset to Nashville and that was 2016 much has changed they have improved a lot on the venue as I am a patron now not a volunteer. 

Unfortunately concessions are overpriced like all events are. One artist (I will not say who) requested us not to serve anything with a bottle (that could be thrown) water for example so we had to open water bottles and other drinks pour them into plastic cups. It was strange pouring 5.00 water but could not let the customers take the bottles.  For the most part people where great about it as we explained that it was at the artists request not Ascend and its for everyone's safety. 

As a volunteer and a paying customer I enjoy the venue, lots of space for seating. But parking super close ehhh but that is Nashville so you get used to the little lots that charge a fortune with the kind stranger who will watch your car all night for an extra 10.00 :) Thank you Ascend for the memories and your employees being extremely kind when volunteering and when being a customer to the shows.I love to see familiar faces when we attend events there. 

A MUST there is something for everyone !

name: Music City Bar and Grill
text: Awesome! Great folks! Great food! Stumbled on this joint and had a fantabulous time! Blake is a great bartender!

name: 360 Burger
text: Groovy place. Good beer. Better food. Great service. Kinda busy, ya know, with this bomb ass burger and all.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: Museum has a great amount of memorabilia to see and the videos were awesome. However, it was crowded when we went, certain sections were really warm and we found it hard to move around.

name: 360 Burger
text: Antioch's little secret!!! One of my favorite craft burger places in the Nashville area. I'm so in love with the PB&J burger, and I ask them to add some jalapenos (watch it, they're HOT) to kick it up. SO. GOOD. Beer is cold, wings are hot and they're always trying new things to keep customers interested in coming back. They have live music from time to time, but it's not necessary for such a small space. They also have the games on, so it's a favorite spot during football season!

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: Went last night and we had an awesome time! Entertainment highlight of our trip. The 3 guys were great....funny and so talented. Our request for Stairway to Heaven was done so fabulously!!! The guest vocalists were a hoot! Was a real party!!

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: Had a great time. Some people on here are complaining that their should be more seating, but the owners know what theyre doing. If anything it should maybe be more high top tables, but take away chairs. The only complaint I have is that the audience on this particular night was lame. The performers are amazingly talented and they do a good job entertaining, but its hard to entertain people who come there to sit on their phones.

name: Madame Tussauds Nashville
text:
We had so much fun going thru this. Was well worth the money and time.

You can buy tickets online before you go too.

name: Madame Tussauds Nashville
text: So life like. Was nice to see a variety of singers and listen to their music. Went by myself so it was fun trying to take selfies with everyone!  Make sure to read each plaque for each musician great information. Most were very recognizable. A couple I wasn't sure of but was great fun trying to figure out!

name: 360 Burger
text: It's a cool spot, great beer selection, live music. I ordered my burger on Texas toast, it might as well been plain white bread it was soggy after the first bite. Fries were pretty bomb tho sum it up- just a burger joint.

name: Music City Bar and Grill
text: Good music and good beers. Didn't see anyone eating. Smelled a little funny but it was fun

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: I was here on a Monday night and it was pretty lit. The musicians were really upbeat and cool (my favorite part was when the fiddler did a really fun feature piece) and I got some fried pickles and a slider that I enjoyed. There was a wide variety in the crowd from middle-aged people there to enjoy the music to twenty-somethings out to party. The place was packed the whole time I was there and I had a lot of fun.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Excellent music and live music experience!  We made reservations and went to the 6 pm show. The three musicians were all talented and great singers. One guy had written many hits and we recognized the songs!!
We shared an app--bbq sliders that was very delicious. Had some beers--we like the local selection of Little Harpeth beers! I have yet to get tickets to the blue bird cafe but I will definitely return to listening room for the awesome music!!
The parking lot looked small but we used uber so it was easy.

name: 360 Burger
text: The cooks could pay more attention to the order before their plate it up. The wait staff rocks!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Came here whilst visiting Nashville with a buddy. Loved the music. The service was very friendly, if a little sluggish. The waiters were moving as quickly as they could! I think they just need a few more people. It was slightly irritating that a lot of people there just chattered away even tho there was a sign saying to keep conversations down. It probably wouldn't hurt for them to enforce it.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: Enjoyed the Cash Museum. Nothing is as impressive as just hearing him sing but the memorabilia is extensive. Worth the visit

name: 360 Burger
text:
Worst service I've ever had.  Waiter lied about prices and didn't correct his mistakes.  Also wasn't visiting table and id have to go to the back kitche ln to get help twice.  (After waiting about 30 min to take our order and an hour for the check) 

The burger was good... Too bad the service was so bad

name: 360 Burger
text:
My brother, boyfriend, and I decided to check out 360 on Saturday in our continuing quest to find the best burger in Nashville. We got there around 1:30 and it was pretty empty, maybe about 3 or 4 other parties there besides us. It has a pretty relaxed vibe, and the AC was cranked in there, I was freezing my buns off. Parking is good because it's in a strip mall, so no worries there.

For checking in on Yelp, I got a free appetizer. Yay! So we opted for the fried pickles, which were pretty dang tasty. I had the Cilantro Avocado Burger with sweet potato fries. The men had some other stuff that I can't remember off the top of my head. But we all were in universal agreement that the fries (regular and sweet) were not that good. It's not that they didn't have flavor, but it's almost like they weren't cooked enough, or had been sitting around for a while before we got them. They were just kinda soggy and greasy, which was disappointing.

The burger was actually pretty legit. I thought it had some good flavor and a reasonable amount of heat. I'm not tolerant of hardly any spice, and I thought it was just the right amount. I got the burger on the pretzel bun, which I would definitely advise of anyone doing because it was delicious. We didn't have a problem with the order taking that other people seemed to have, so I was happy about that.

The service was good. Our waiter (I can never remember their names) was really friendly and even gave me some suggestions when I was trying to pick out a beer, of which they have an extensive variety. But he did check back in like 10 times throughout the meal, so we concluded that he must have been pretty bored. There weren't a lot of tables, though, so it's understandable. Overall, this place definitely could be better but it's still pretty good. I don't know if maybe they were having an off day with the sides, but I would be willing to give them another shot!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
This is the worst place in town. Had gift card for $50. Used $30 worth for food, drinks were not included  on gift card. Manager/Owner wouldn't even come over to talk to us about it. Food was just mediocre at best and over priced. Sangria was horrible, my advice stay home or go to lower Broadway for some good food and customer
 service.

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: The buffet starts right when you board the boat, so if you come in a little later than 6:30 your food will be cold. Also the show starts at the last 30 minutes, so you are sitting on a boat for two hours with no entertainment except looking out at the river. I came in with the expectation that I would be eating while a show was taking place. The only great thing about this place is that the waiter was extremely kind and helpful. Since most of our table was freezing, our waiter brought us all table cloths to warm up with. He was excellent!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
This place was amazing.  I heard they are closing down or something, so I highly recommended hitting this up before they do!  I was a little turned off by the $20 cover, but I think it was worth it during our Nashville trip bc it was one of our favorite spots.  Of course, with this sort of this, its always kind of the luck of the draw on what bands/songwriters you will get and if it's your style of music, but we really enjoyed who we had.  

We went on a Saturday night and were able to get a great spot right in the center (but there were only 2 of us).  Bluebird Cafe is fun for the experience, but the cover is worth skipping the hassle, and we liked the bands here better!  Food was good and decent beer selection.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Really cool environment. Very prompt service but also a little chaotic. Honestly we could have walked in without tickets because they didnt even check. Service was enthusiastic but scattered. We ordered the cheeseplate and potroast to split but they came out at the same time. An appetizer should come first. Now we had to choose, to eat in reverse or let our potroast get cold.
In summary the music environment was very cool and intimate but the food service is secondary at best. Everything will get slipped in front of you at once so just order what you want to have immediately dont expect a dining experience.

name: 360 Burger
text: Great food and even better service. The prices are very reasonable and they have live music most nights. Plenty of drink specials for those looking for a quiet place to get a drink after work, but also great for families with kids. As an added bonus, they use grass fed beef and locally sourced ingredients and they are locally owned.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: If you're looking for a great show look no further. The bar staff are AH-Fucking-AMAZING. Great service. Super friendly. The band can vary from Wrecking Ball to Queen with ease. Great time!

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: Always packed but for good reason. If you've been in Nashville for a while, you are probably sick of Broadway but this place stands the test of time. Average drinks and service but the musical talent here is always extremely high quality, these guys can play. Go here and hit up the second floor cocktail and cigar bar right next door for a top notch night out on Broadway.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
If you weren't a big fan of Johnny Cash before this museum, you'll quickly become one. This is a terrific small museum that is full of surprises. It's far from a fawning fan museum -- really honest and straightforward like the Man in Black himself. Photos, recordings, work and music if his contemporaries, instruments, clothing and tons of stories. A great find. 

I learned so much about Cash that was worthwhile, including his work for the disadvantaged, his speech in Congress advocating real solutions to fixing the prison system (too bad they didn't listen), his personal life and wonderful candid photos. And together videos! Awesome. Do not miss this if you have any interest in music from the 50s and later.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Rude service and poor selection of beer which was served Luke warm. The rooftop was not worth the four story climb.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: We stopped in Monday night and got to listen to the Song Suffragettes - what a great show! I love that The Listening Room makes it a priority for women to have their music and voices heard, especially given how talented they are! We also got dinner here and we all agreed the food was awesome. We had a very sweet server as well and really enjoyed our night!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
I visited The LIstening Room Cafe last week and it was really nice.  I got there pretty early in the evening and enjoyed chatting with the bartender.  It was also two for one drafts so that was nice.  They only offered valet parking which is kind of a bummer, but the guys were nice and when I tipped them seemed surprised.  

The writer's circle was good and they had some very talented people playing.  I have been to the BlueBird Cafe and have to say I enjoyed Listening Room more.  They just have a lot more space and that made the night more enjoyable.  

I will be back.

name: The Basement East
text:
I loved the pub area, good music, decent beer and a killer quesadilla.
Two for one drinks is always good.
Friendly staff.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: Payed PLENTY for a song and they didn't even play it. The song was for a bachelorette party and they called the bachelorettes in the entire place on stage to do the hokey pokey!!! I paid for everyone to go on stage instead of my party. Not only that, it was extremely impersonal. I asked for my money back they said I could not have it. For these reasons they absolutely  deserve one star.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: This is a must for any Johnny Cash fan, or even if you're not a big fan, you should go anyway.  The museum tells the great story of Cash's life, but it also focuses on the lives of the musicians that he touched as well as the immense impact he had on American culture.  The museum is small enough to do in less than an hour, but you won't want to go through it that fast.  There's just so much to see; lots of memorabilia, interactive videos and displays.  We spent about an hour and a half in the museum.  They also have quite an extensive gift shop...you'll be hard-pressed to leave with just one thing.  Oh, also check out the cafe.  They have a couple of coffee brews in there with some clever names.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Great evening until Brennin done a cover. Might as well been at a no cover no $10 dollar food, drink minimum Honky Tonk. 
Mark Irwin is def the man. Played all his hits plus a few new ones.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Stole a bite from my son's plate of the fried catfish...and I'll be back for my own order soon! 

We came for the music and honestly I just expected "pub grub". We ordered a plate of fried green tomatoes to share and they were perfectly cooked as well. 

In a sea of over priced over rated and sometimes under performing restaurants in downtown Nashville, this place surprises and over performs in my opinion. 

The catfish entree priced at $20, is actually reasonable by Nashville standards. My son's dish was served on an oval platter filled with two large perfectly cooked catfish filets, a mound of steamed green beans and a heaping amount of Mac and cheese then topped off with a side dish of Cole slaw. Easily, it was enough food for two to share, which puts the value per person high up on the competition. A nice lagniappe was the validation for free valet parking in their lot.  Oh yea, there was awesome music too!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Music and ambiance was incredible, but disappointed in the food. Shrimp and grits: grits were lumpy. Very spicy so be prepared! Chicken and dumplings: came out lukewarm, but otherwise good.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: My husband and I came her last year as our first trip to Nashville from Nebraska. We are huge John cash fans. This museum is amazing it has so many different memorabilia from his life. One thing I remembered for some odd reason was the briefcase and johnnys credit card and thought how cool that must have been back then to be able to have something like that. This place is truly a work of art and shows of much of an artist Johnny was. However I am not sure if it was the museums intentions or not but they do play Johnny cover of Hurt right at the end!! All most had me in tears!! Rest in peace Johnny and June!

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: This was pretty bad. Everything was burnt. Chicken fingers should not be black. The menu even said "fried to perfection".... what? Service was pretty bad for being the only ones in there. Music was great.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Authentic Nashville singer-songwriter vibe with great hospitality and very good food. The venue is roomy & comfortable w/ a huge stage, but still seems intimate for quaint songwriter-in-the-round sessions. The menu is small, but everything our party of four had was very good, especially the Yazoo Chili. Food quality was better and fresher then expected. Nice beer list. Excellent fresh coffee and we shared a desert of mini-cupcakes that were perfect. The crowd was a bit too into their own table talk, not as respectful of the artists as I would like. Nice that you can talk a bit. We arrived at 5:30 on Saturday and were disappointed that the music did not start until 7 on weekends, so we had time to kill. Overall, A new favorite venue for us.

name: Rack Room Blue Bar
text:
On our first night in Nashville last week, my friends and I had enjoyed a great dinner and as we were walking around enjoying the sights and sounds of the city, we decided to stop in to the Rack Room/Blue Bar. Friendly people, really nice guy working the door, great music, "let's go here."  We had a few beers, laughed and enjoyed ourselves. 

It was time to move on and so I asked for the check.

The first item on the check was "name, old." Now I could very well be misinterpreting something here but none of us had bourbon and it certainly wasn't free if we did. 

Apparently singing along with the Beastie Boys gives me gray hair because drinking fireball just makes us girls. 

Now, I'm thinking something such as "girls with curls", "two reds and brunette",  "girls in black" etc.. could have been used if needed or Mr. Cole W could have gotten really crazy and..... asked for a name or a card but no, instead he named us as "old."

Wow. Nice buzzkill son. Didn't you get the memo that "old" ladies tip? Or that "old" ladies can read?  

So much for everyone in Nashville being super friendly.  Don't worry, we won't be back, it's probably past our bedtime when the bar opens anyway.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Nothing to write home about. There are no swinging doors (at least in the winter). Decent priced food and it seems as though locals come here. The tunes were pretty good. Fresh chicken fingers and non-frozen burgers. It doesn't stand out too much, but in comparison to everything else around, it's better than most others.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Love the bar and Dierks but what the hell are the bouncers upstairs doing? Running a strip club? Bouncers were running outside the safety fence of the roof. Bouncers groping the patrons hoping to get them to come home at the end of the night made for an extremely uncomfortable and short stay.  Terrible music on the roof top bar only adding to the atmosphere that was less than enjoyable.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: The rooftop bar was a great time. Huge mix of people there. The service was great by the bartenders Jake and Nicole. Definitely recommend going if your in the area. Good DJ also he played all kinds of music from old school hip hop to some EDM and country.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Isaac Mathews made my evening ! He played my song :-) no one else on Broadway knew this song but Isaac winged it and totally made my day. We also had this delicious chocolate rum smoothie thing... It was delicious!! This place is so intimate and cozy. Definitely coming back here next time I'm in Nashville

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: It was a fast trip to Nashville, on business, but I genuinely enjoyed my trip to the JCM. A bit pricey on the admission, at $17, but, I felt like it was worth it after the tour.  Nice bonus to see the Sun Record's display, with a great photo of Elvis and Johnny.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: I went there with a group on the grand opening night and was very impressed with the amount of space. Very comfortable as opposed to the downtown scene. However, they were understaffed for opening night! I don't know how this was possible. There was also a very small selection of beers and didn't have the typical brews. The check in offer says one free bud light, something they didn't even have. Even though we didn't order food it was funny to see the reactions of people around us when their food came out as they busted into cheers. One couple just got up and left before their food came out. If they get the staff thing under control and have a elaborate selection of drinks this place would of got my 5 star review but i just don't understand how you can be so ill prepared for a Saturday. The best part of the whole experience was obviously the music. This is by far (with only one visit) my favorite music spot in Nashville. Here you will find the songwriters for some of the best songs in country music. The night that we were there we heard the song writers for rascal flats. This is a place I would love to try again and give a better review.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Very disappointed!!! I was on a pedal car tour and supposed to get a deal on shots, I mentioned we were with the pedal tour they charged me 36$ for 4 shots which should have been 20$ and when I said something all the bar tender said was sorry instead of making it right.

name: Music City Bar and Grill
text: Had a ton of fun here- went and shopped at the mall then we grabbed drinks and wings here- music was great and service was too.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Awesome night, the singer songwriters were excellent and it was an eye opening peek into their world of songwriters for the stars!

The food was also very good.  We had the brisket and the specialty apple turkey club.  Both made with in-house smoked meats.  Sides were also good.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
This is no way any reflection on Dierks himself.  Good service, good venue, great music!  I'm still a huge fan but I will not be going back to this place.  

I ordered two drinks last week.  Jack on the rocks and four roses on the rocks.  $26!!  Let me break it down for you.  $10 each for the drink, which is somewhat standard in Nashville nowadays but on the higher end. But they charged $3 each for ice....yes ICE!  $13 for a JD.  Are you kidding me?  Go back to Scottsdale with that bullshit!

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: This  is a relaxed bar with a lot of locals enjoying a friend on the the stage. He is great and the service is very good, even with the amount of  people. Had the special for dinner, very good.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: The live music, ambience, service and drinks were great! I'd have dinner before coming here though it was the only thing not worth the money at all.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: This place is so much fun!! Great music and awesome musicians. They play a good variety of music and $20 gets you whatever song you want to hear. No cover on Friday, but a $6 charge on Saturday.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Really loved this place. We were visiting from NY and couldn't get into the bluebird so we tried the listening room. We loved this place so much we came back on our last night in town. The talent showcased here is unreal. I wish I could remember some of the performers names because I would love to follow their careers. The food was pretty good too. Definitely worth a visit.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: Big Bang brings the energy! Our bachelorette had never experienced a dueling piano bar, so we couldn't miss catching this place while in Nashville. Their song choices are on point! They bring such an eclectic collection from OutKast and MJ to Elton John, Bruno Mars, and classic rockers. Service was fast and spiffy, and there was a $6 or $7 cover, which is well worth the live entertainment. Floors were littered with napkins that they throw on big songs but bathrooms were well maintained, which is always appreciated. The beers are HUGE, though they do offer smaller sizes (which wasn't clarified at purchasing), so keep that in mind if you fill up quickly on beer.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: I had such a wonderful time here. Bluebird, being as difficult as it is to get tickets, was not an option. But man I am glad we came here. The songwriters were incredibly talented and the show was inexpensive. As a plus, the Mac and cheese is also delicious.

name: 360 Burger
text: As an artist, I have to weigh in here! I've played 360 Burger a few times, including hosting a writer's night and also with my band. The staff is super-friendly and accommodating. The boys in the band love the burgers and I've opted for the salads and salmon - all were excellent and the french fries are a must! All beers come in a frothy frozen mug...such a nice detail! I would definitely recommend this place - great burgers, great music, and such a fantastic staff!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: I have been to the Listening Room twice, both on Sunday afternoons, and had a very enjoyable time.  The music and ambiance is amazing, and the unlimited mimosas are top notch!  The service can be a little slow at times, and the food does take a while to reach your table.  However, the food is always delicious. Overall, it's a place I like to take my out-of-town guests to really experience the essence of Nashville.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
Stopped in for a drink on a Thursday, live bands on every floor was cool. Went on the roof top to have a beer (2 bud lights $13.00), don't know if that's  the going rate. Service was excellent! Food looked real good and seemed reasonably price. Nashville police officers present in bar is a good site.
Good job Bob!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
If you're in Nashville, the Listening Room should be at the top of your list of things to do. It's a cafe by day, venue by night with 2 showings: 6pm and 8:30pm. Even if you're not a country fan (I'm not, really), the performers play a wide variety of songs and most of them are acoustic.

The host of the place I stayed at recommended checking out the Listening Room during my stay. She told me about how songwriters came to the stage and played their original songs before being bought and played by singers. It was an interesting premise, so decided to check it out. I tried buying tickets on the day of for the 8:30pm show, and they were sold out, so let that be a lesson to you guys, buy your tix early! 

I showed up and they told me that they create a waitlist, and after 8:45pm, they'll check the no-show lists and begin seating. I was able to snag a bar seat for $14. I had the pleasure of seeing Kelly Archer, Darby, Justin Ebach, Jordan Minton, who all played and sang lovely acoustic versions of their songs. 

There is is $15  minimum to  spend per person  I got the sangria while I was there because I was warned about their food by my host. Sangria was okay; nothing to write home about. 

Overall a wonderful experience!

name: 360 Burger
text: Paid a visit for burger week. Nice to have a local beef/sorta hip spot in Antioch. They have 2 for 1 beers til 10 everyday which is kind of misleading cause the beers are smaller than most places. Ordered wings which were very good and the burger tasted fresh and good. The music was a bit loud and pretty average but I'd go back due to the good burger and wings.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
We checked out The Listening Room Cafe during our trip in November. Hopefully, the google listing has been updated since then; we ended up ubering to the old location, without realizing they had moved. We ended up taking another uber to the new location. 

The venue was super cute. They were quick in seating you (despite the long line). We enjoyed the songwriter's performances, with their back stories to each song. I would definitely go again if I'm ever in the area again!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Had brunch here on a recommendation from a friend when visiting Nashville- a modern-rustic atmosphere with live singer-songwriter performances. The food was very good (I had the biscuits and gravy), the service and the atmosphere were excellent. Rumor was that the mimosas were bottomless-they weren't but they were 2-for-1, so we couldn't complain. Our sever was friendly and helpful, and the hostess, Daisy, spent way more time than I would ever expect to help us find other music-related things to do away from the endless loop of overplayed covers on the Broadway strip. A welcome dose of quiet coolness a short walk from the main drag.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Our family had such a great time at the Listening Room.  We were visiting Nashville over spring break and wanted to listen to live music.  Made reservations (you may want to book a few weeks in advance) and were lucky to catch the Song Suffragettes playing one evening.  The food was very good, service even better, and the live music was fantastic.  Valet parking in the city is also a nice touch.  Can't wait to go back.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: We didn't eat here, only had drinks. The drinks were strong and reasonably priced. It's very neat and clean inside which we liked. The band playing was good too.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: My favorite place in nashville.....tons of awesome memorabilia and the staff is very friendly and helpful....i go there nearly everytime im in nashville

name: General Jackson Showboat
text:
Yuck. The entire boat was covered in spiders. Railings, posts, walls, and windows should be inspected before getting close. The ceiling lights were festooned with them. An arachnophobe would have been petrified. 

The dining room was better - the spiders were on the outside of the windows. Our waiter was charming at first, but things changed when it became clear that no one at the table was drinking, a big focus of the cruise. The drinking tables did seem to be having a great time.

The food was fine. Dinner was served and cleared before the entertainment stage show began.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Really fun atmosphere. We had a large group of 14 girls and service was slow, but understandable. I really wanted to like this place, but unfortunately, had a really awful bartender who asked me what I needed and when I asked for four waters, he rolled his eyes and told me "it would be a while." After watching him serve six other customers I asked if it was my turn for the water yet. He was horrible. We spent a lot of money here and we will never come back. Don't waste your time.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Overall, I had an exceptional time with my girlfriend at the Listening Room Cafe. We went on a Saturday night with singer and songwriter Vanessa Bransan, AJ Engstrom, and Phil Barton performing. They were amazing and made the night enjoyable for us and everyone else. We both really enjoy the opportunity after the show to meet and chat with the artist, and also get pictures and autographs from them. Vanessa was so sweet and nice to my girlfriend and me, and Phil was very personable when we chatted with him. We didn't get to talk to AJ, but he was very comedic onstage and had a great personality. 

We both really enjoyed the ambience provided at the Listening Room Cafe. Our waitress was very courteous and nice. She did a tremendous job trying to wait on her tables while allowing everyone to hear and enjoy the show too without being interrupted. However, I did have to take a star away for the food. Our waitress was kind and updated us on our food and apologized for the wait, which was very nice of her. The food was mediocre. I'm sure the kitchen was well busy with the amount of orders, but I expected better execution with the atmosphere they provided. The french onion soup was solid and tasty; the veggies skewers had an interesting taste; the portobello mushrooms were a bit heavy on the greasy side and they forgot the ranch sauce, but they had good flavors; and the sweet fries were seasoned very well, but very soggy as if the deep fryer temperature wasn't hot enough and the fries just soaked up the oil. 

We will be back for the show and I hope they improve on their cuisine. When they do, I will gladly give them 5 stars. :)

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
Okay - I really wanted to love this place, but just couldn't. We went on our first night of a bachelorette party last night and it was SO disappointing, I was compelled to share. 
1 - first and foremost, it was SO dirty. Specifically the bathroom downstairs. Women's room literally had poop on the ground and coffee grounds around to try and cover up the awful smell. 

2 - the well liquor was the cheapest of cheap, the drinks were awful. 

Considering how dirty everything was, you couldn't pay me to order food from here. Sad!

name: Music City Bar and Grill
text:
Bad service by the blond bartender who kept on ignoring us. She had the worst attitude and definitely made our experience terrible. 
The cook seemed to be scared of her and behaved strangely too.
Band was awesome and they should be playing in a better location!

name: Madame Tussauds Nashville
text: So fun.  It's a good Nashville spot.  Expensive but I think it's worth it. Some interactive exhibits and lots of photo opportunities.  I think for f wax museum they do as good a job as you can hope for!

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: This was a different experience for us but we really enjoyed it.  Once we arrived, the staff welcomed us aboard and were we surprised.  They had a lunch buffet that was great and a musical show that was awesome.  It was "Country" and anyone could enjoy the music and we enjoyed the musician talent and music while on the showboat.  One significant part of the trip while riding up and down the Cumberland River was you can go outside and see it while riding.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Lovely place with great music . The food wasn't all that but the entertainment was great  . Service takes a little too long to come around but the atmosphere was good .

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Didn't have any food here but the drinks were cold and the staff was friendly. The music was awesome and the energy was contagious. Will definitely come back here again.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: We walked onto broadway street and were immediately met with the masses of people and music. We chose Kid Rock's because it had the most outside seating. The inside had a band playing on the stairs which kept everyone pumped up. We ordered drinks and listened for a bit then went upstairs to check the rooftop out. Do not miss out on this! There was a separate band playing upstairs and it was mostly rock, so perfect if you want a break from the country. Will be back the music was great the food options just weren't that great.

name: Madame Tussauds Nashville
text:
We had free tickets to the wax museum so took advantage of the opportunity. If it wasn't for the tickets this place is actually pretty expensive for the size of it. Barely takes 45 minutes to an hour to go through.
That's sad, we did have a very good time. All of the displays are interactive and you can get right beside them clothes for photo opportunities. Everything from Albert, to Carrie underwood, and a Blue's room. 
Here is a tip. We got a ticket from old town trolley. They were running a promotion that included the last museum. Might be worth checking it out.

name: The Basement East
text: My favorite venue in Nashville. They have a huge variety of music, and consistently feature up-and-coming artists you'll be seeing in an arena in a few years. They truly have something for everyone, and are one of the few indie venues not afraid to venture from the generic hipster crowd and feature country music.

name: 360 Burger
text:
I went here for lunch today and I unfortunately had a bad food experience. The salad was wilted with signs of frost damage and the American Burger came out undercooked (the meat was of the consistency of raw beef - you could mold it like play dough). My friend's salmon burger was meh. The sweet potato fries were very salty and did not taste fresh. However, the company redeemed themselves when the manager/owner took my meal off of the bill and was very apologetic. He also offered to bring me a different meal in place of the one I ordered. Very good customer service!

Since I live in Jersey I won't get the chance to give this place another shot anytime soon but I can only hope that this was just a fluke thing and that the food is normally a lot better.

name: Music City Bar and Grill
text: The onion rings and chicken nachos were excellent.  This bar isn't for the up tight, needy or picky. This bar is your true American dive bar.  There is one or two bartender's at a time and you have to order at the bar.  It's old and nostalgic!  This is where you should go before you head downtown, pre-gamer, you won't spend a fortune but you will downtown.  It is what you make of it! I loved it

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Nick Deckard will treat you right. Even on a busy Saturday night he took care of us like we were priority #1 and makes eye contact in between tables to make sure we were taken care of. Nick has set the standard high for customer service, give this guy a raise!!!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
We went on a night when there was four songwriters on the stage, each with a guitar, sitting on a stool. It was interesting to hear their songs and the stories they told about the song writing process.
The food though was sub par. We had the "brisket" which was more like shredded pot roast and the chicken wings which were rubbery and almost inedible.
The ticket price is seven (7) USD at the door, but then there is a fifteen (15) USD per person minimum for food and drink.  I suppose it is difficult to get that much food out that fast and still have quality ie: the place is empty, then fills up for a show, empties and repeats for the next show.
Skip the food, have a few drinks and enjoy the show. I think beer started at six (6) USD, and a glass of wine was about eight (8) USD.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Greeted by Andrea who was our server   Music was excellent  Food Outstanding! No wait! Early Brunch Time on Sunday! We will be back & will bring friends! Location Broadway & 4th Downtown- Just Opened!  Check it out!!!!

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
I found this museum to be impersonal, limited, expensive, and to have a confusing layout.

$17 - wow! I was out of the museum in an hour.

On the plus, there were some cool outfits, a guitar of Cash's, and a reel of his acting career.

I would go somewhere else first- not quite sure why everyone else loved it.

name: Rack Room Blue Bar
text: Came in because the surrounding bars were overcrowded. It was dead and my group and I wanted to grab a quick drink and have some room to breathe. We were standing at the bar and a guy who came in and went to the bathroom came back out and ran right into a girl in our group and knocked into her, both of them hitting the ground. The bar owner checked on the guy who caused the commotion. Did not say one word to our friend. After another girl in the group confronted the bar owner, he got upset and copped an attitude and sarcastically asked if she was ok. Needless to say, I now know why the bar had no inhabitants and we will not be returning or spending money on this establishment.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text:
The worst place in Nashville. Boyfriend and I went here for New Years 2015. We put our drinks on a table and Nick (the boss) told us to take them off. Which we did but Nick (very short manager) looked at my boyfriend and like he was going to hit him and we asked the manager what is wrong we moved the drinks and the manager Nick said your boyfriend is giving me an attitude. My boyfriend didn't say a word to this man but ok we will move our drinks. The boss kicked us out. The boss wouldn't even listen to me. If you are a manager of customer service industry wouldn't it be smart to treat your customers well? I would never treat a couple this poorly. Nick is the worst manager I have ever seen. I told everyone on the bus back to the hotel. I told them to never go there and spend your money across the street at Honky Tonk where they treat there customers with respect and understanding.
I even thanked the manager for all his time and help with understanding.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Loved this place! The bands on all 3 (open) floors were awesome! Would definitely recommend coming here

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
While food quality needs some improvement, I was overall pleased with the venue and seating. It's been a while since may husband and I have been to Listening Room Cafe, but we usually recommend to our of town friends and acquaintances. We'll be back soon!
Jacqueline

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Great place to go to close out the night! Bartenders were super nice. Love music was amazing. Had a great time dancing and goofing off with my friends!

name: Madame Tussauds Nashville
text: Our experience at Madame Tussauds was hilarious! We had the entire museum to ourselves on a Sunday afternoon so we got to be as loud and goofy and obnoxious as we wanted! The admission was $20 since we bought them ahead of time online and to be honest, I don't think I would have paid much more than that. There were several figures with lots of different rooms and themes but I felt like it was on the smaller side compared to other MT locations. Some of the figures were also hard to recognize without looking at their name tag. Overall a fun experience if you're in the Opryland area of Nashville!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: The only thing I can rate my experience with Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row is the lack of an experience that I had. We stopped in last Friday and shuffled around making our way upstairs to find quite a few open tables that were all still dirty. Thinking a rush just cleared we took a seat at a dirty table where a waitress promptly dropped off four waters and never returned to take our drink order or wipe down the table. I could understand if they were busy but there were plenty of employees standing around. After waiting around for about 15 minutes we finally just walked out. At least we were able to rehydrate and catch a few minutes of a live set before moving on.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Great music bar. Had a really good time. Is named after my best friends brother. Hahaha

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
5 stars for a honkey Tonkin' good time! Thank you WR for having a big stage where the musicians can really let loose.... And lots of TVs to follow the Preds and college football. 
This is one of the new players on the Broadway scene, but they are here to stay! 
As a local, I would personally advise skipping the smaller/older stops on Broadway and opt for a more updated experience like this one at Whiskey Row!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Great spot for a nice appetizer & drinks with a nice view overlooking Nashville. Service was good & their food was even better. Nice to see a big name take pride in their food operations as this seems less common in downtown Nashville. I don't even know who the fuck Dierks Bentley is but I'd recommend this rooftop spot. Top 5 rooftops & would rate higher if you're hungry...God Bless

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Lovely place to listen to very talented folks in a quiet setting. Service is great. We made a bad choice in the deviled eggs - but the drinks were good.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: I am beyond excited to be spending my NYE here! The outside looks absolutely amazing and I can already tell the inside is going to look even better! This will be the second Whiskey Row location I've been to and if it's anything like my last experience then I am definitely in for a fun time!! Bring on the whiskey!!!!!!

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
Amazing collection, very well displayed!
Even if you are not a big fan, you will find this museum interesting and well worth a visit.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Awesome venue, great music!!! Smoked Tennessee brisket for $32.00!!! Severed like pulled pork, no smoke, completely overpriced!!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Absolutely fantastic.  You don't get this kind of vibe many places.  Live music, southern food, full bar, lively crowd.

Took my daughter on a Saturday.  Reservations are important; a full restaurant, every table with a great view of the stage.  Four acoustic singer/songwriters sharing the stage, taking turns playing their songs and backing each other up.  Selling CDs from their instrument cases.

Food was very good.  4 stars for the food.  Fancy burgers, deep fried pickles, smoked pork chops.  They had lots of other southern food and BBQ on the menu.  Lots of beer choices.

I'd give the overall experience 6 stars if I could, so the whole thing gets 5 stars.  We will be back!

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: such a beautiful experience, this is a must if you visit Nashville.. you can feel the history here, the museum is laid out well and the staff is super friendly.. if you are a music fan you will love this place! you can even mix a few tracks while you see the exhibits.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: Who doesn't love Johnny Cash? There was a ton of cool artifacts and memorabilia squeezed into a short self guided tour. Check online for ticket deals and take time to watch the videos,

name: Live Oak
text:
Thank you for amazing food and hospitality!!!
Music was perfect and hamburgers brought us back a second time!!! Oh those slightly sweet buns .... a plain cheeseburger the first night and the black and blue burgers.... out of this world !!!

Chips and fries were great as well

Wonderful first and third nights in Nashville 

We will be back !!!

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: Extremely cheesy and not the best thing to do in Nashville unless you are 65+. They had good voices but it just didn't feel like Nashville however had great views from the boat.  Just feel as if there are much better things to do with your time and money.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
Only came for the music but omg this place is huge! Great place to party all day every day. This place was always rocking every time I passed by with the greatest artists. I wish they displayed the artists names and helped them promote a little more. Walked in on a busy Friday night and got a drink within 5min. It was great! The bartender girls had great black light neon clothing. 

The only place that opened the windows and didn't suffocate you with heaters on full blast. It was a good time on a chilly night. Can't wait to come back and try the food.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: Went here on a groupon which was a great deal! Two for one admission! This is a must see for anyone who is a Johnny Cash fan or a fan of real country music (none of that Florida Georgia mumbo jumbo). I definitely want to go back because I'm sure you pick up on different things each time. The only thing that was a little weird for me was the whole 'take your picture with Johnny Cash on a green screen thing.' That's weird. And I'm in favor of that going away. But everything else is wonderful.

name: The Basement East
text: Best waffles this side of Belgium! Seriously, they are amazing. They come with a dark chocolate whipped cream and chile syrup. And the waffles have the perfect density: kind of light. Hard to describe. Just go there and try one. Their take on biscuits and gravy is also brilliant! Small menu, but so creative. I love this place.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: This is my second visit to the Listening Room. I have to say it is a hidden gem in our city! I like to come and have a drink and small plates with buddies and now I will make a return visit for Brunch! Our server is awesome and wehave had a great start to our Sunday here.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
Friday night I experienced something I have NEVER had to deal with as a customer- and as such, I didn't tip the person that serviced me- something I've never done. I bartend at a country club in Nashville, so trust me- I get that the service industry is HARD. However, I ordered a "grapefruit vodka with club" (notice the lack of comma) from a platinum blonde bar-tender at the downstairs bar in front of the band. I saw her start to pour well vodka and get out the grapefruit juice to add to my drink, to which I kindly corrected her that I didn't want a "vodka grapefruit" but instead a grapefruit flavored vodka with club. No big deal- people make mistakes- it's loud- maybe she didn't hear me. Her response? An EVIL stare as she said "well...?!" I responded, "I'd like to get what I asked for." She then THREW the plastic cup into the trash can behind her with the attitude of a spoiled 5-year old that gets stripped of their iPad mid car ride. Eventually, she made the drink I ordered and handed me my receipt. Then another guest at the bar standing next to me looked at me and said: "Isn't she just evil?." I simply walked away- shocked at what had happened. 
However, what REALLY got to me was the next night I met up with friends and they happened to be having their after wedding party on the rooftop of this place. Before meeting up with them on the rooftop, I tried to get a drink at the same bar- the downstairs one directly in front of the band. I saw the same blonde bartender as Friday night and chose to just attempt to get a drink from a different bartender instead. However, after several attempts, I was completely ignored by the male bartender also behind that same bar. It was a busy Saturday night on Memorial Day weekend, so maybe he simply just didn't see me. But, of course, you can assume the bad taste this experience left in my mouth especially given what happened Friday night. 
People make mistakes and it's a pain to get your manager to comp drinks at the end of the night when you're tired and just want to go home. Also, the customer isn't always right- maybe I said my drink order too quietly for her to hear. Nonetheless, what's unacceptable to me is a bad attitude and making me feel like an idiot for simply asking for what I ordered. Overall, just really disappointed.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
Day drinking at its finest... walked in and it was already getting full... got a great seat in the back and people watched like a mug! The band is awesome and so is our server. I'm cooking my jets with some water right now but the fried pickles are yummy! 

I would sit here all day if I could... I wonder how long I can until they kick me out... LOL

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Bottomless mimosa on Sunday! With one to go to boot!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Multiple levels in which to quench your thirst.  It's a lively environment for sure, in the heart of the district.  Count on a ton of people being in here at all times; the space is so big however that you won't have to wait too long for a beverage to cool you down in the Nashville heat.  If you can, skip the longer lines downstairs and head up to the roof for a bird's eye view of the swarms of people in the streets and on neighboring rooftops.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: We didn't eat there but walked around and had couple of beers. You can read all the other reviews and website for more details but pretty neat spot. 4 floors of live music. We had a good time!! I recommend!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Don't go to this bar unless you want your phone stolen. 3 out of 8 of us got our phones stolen in 15 minutes while at this bar. The workers did not care enough to help us either. Very sketchy. Again do not go to this bar.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Elevator for friends of bouncers only to get to rooftop.  Can be great bands but bouncers are immediately rude with folks even if you haven't had a drink

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: All I can say is WOW!! The bartender was so sweet and helpful with finding food and drinks. The food was amazing, which surprised me a little because it was busy and it was a bar, but it was such an amazing breakfast! I would go there if you can for brunch, we stood for awhile and waited, but it was worth it!

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: I wasn't very impressed with the museum, but that might be because I'm not a huge Johnny Cash fan. I'm sure big fans will love it.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text:
Don't  go there. I could  not get my license  out of my wallet.  Would  not let me in because  he could not see expectation  date. Oh did I mention  I am old enough to be his mother  or more. Been going to Nashville  for the last 5 years
 They lost our business. Should  have stayed swingn door. Wish I could give it less than  1 star

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
So with an hr to kill in downtown Nashville, I first went to the obvious choice... The Country Music Hall Of Fame.  After gagging in disbelief at the $25 admission fee (I'll admit that corporate perks have largely shielded me from knowing what admission costs in any of NYC's museums), and quickly consulting Yelp, I was led to the Johnny Cash museum.

You don't have too be country to get Cash.  You don't have to be religious to get Cash.  Cash is eternal.  Cash transcends. Cash rules everything around me... dolla dolla bills y'all (I'm convinced that Wu Tang worked with Johnny Cash in 36 Chambers).

Johnny Cash made music across multiple eras and this place showcased it all.  This is a great little museum... definitely worth a look if you're in Nashville.  The items in the store seemed pretty pricey so I took a pass on that.

name: 360 Burger
text:
Great burger! Big and thick... They don't skimp on the meat, great pretzel bun, very affordable. The aoli is great!!
My only complaint is... The fries are soft and limp.
