The food is horrid, bordering inedible, but if you are desperate I'd stick to popcorn. I've somehow made the mistake of eating here twice with the same results. Gross. 

Parking is pretty nuts unless you want to walk a ways, and most of the garages fill up for big events so be mindful of that... traffic is the same deal. 

Overall, great for sports not for music! :)

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Great service, good food and beer. I really liked the 1927 IPA and the Basil Ryeman...Sweet Potato Stout was OK (4 stars there). Had the hot chicken...it did not disappoint. Great start to our trip to Nashville...definitely worth a trip to the Gulch (great part of Nashville!!!)

name: Ole Red
text: Ole Red's is great. Great music. Lot's os food selections. Lot's of drink selections. I had the smoked wings. Awesome!!! Wife had the biscuits and jam and fries pickles. Large food portions.

name: Ole Red
text: We have to give some allowance for this being a new establishment. However, the service was pretty bad. We waited awhile to find a seat-no problem. We finally got a seat at the bar. The bar tender was less than quick to help. After about 45 more minutes, our food came and it was wrong. They tried to correct it and it was wrong again. We ate anyway at that point because we couldn't wait any longer. The food was ok, nothing you can't get in any other restaurant. They've got some work to do to get their processes and service on track. The music was by far the best part.

name: Marathon Music Works
text: I've been to this venue several times for different events and it was okay. The parking is very close, however for big events, the spaces definitely fill up quick and you have to walk a far way down the block. The employees are not the nicest.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: Not a bad seat in the house! Easy parking. GO PREDS!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: I was impressed by the Tennessee Brew Works.  They had ample space both inside and out, plus a second story.  There were a wide variety of beers.  All of them were good, but nothing to me really stood out as exemplary.  Our friends with us ordered the meat tray.  I thoroughly enjoyed the food and watching the brewing team in action from the tables on the second story.  This place gets's a solid thumbs up.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: We had a great time at Layla's. It was so fun and the music was amazing. The band we heard was the best one we heard all night.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Great meal with the family! Our first stop on vacation. The Black and Bleu burger was phenomenal as well as the "It's 5 o'clock Somewhere" margarita. Live music was an added bonus.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: BJ was a great server!!!   I had the nachos and they were absolutely delicious and I topped it off with a "perfect margarita" I will definatly be back great food but the service was the cherry on top!!!

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: Layla's was hopping last night with The Eskimo Brothers on stage. They were super fantastic, talented musicians and really got the crowd involved. High energy, great music, and the most animated performers we saw during our trip. Super, super time!

name: Marathon Music Works
text:
Went there in May 2015 to see Nightwish, and I came back very impressed!

The venue is housed in a cool, industrial looking part of town. There are nearby shops. Very convenient is a coffee house down the street (Garage Coffee Company). You can chill there till 6pm when the coffee house closes-- WiFi, air conditioning, being away from overly zealous fans with no social skills. 

The inside of the venue is pretty clean. There are two bar sections on the side wall and back wall. Average music venue prices: $7 beer, $5 red bull. Disappointed there were no food options whatsoever, but I guess that's one way to keep it all clean. There's a good bit of natural lighting that comes in, so if your show is early in the day or in the summer time, except a brightly lit show. It doesn't have a dive bar feel. If anything it'd be closer to artsy/hipster. The stage is easy to see no matter where you are inside. The floor is flat, no gradient or raised levels. Sounds system was great. I could hear the vocals and insturments clearly, and I didn't have a ringing in my ear afterwards. 

Staff was never rude. I was surprised by the presence of a bathroom attendant. In fact, it may have been the best bathroom experience I've had at a concert venue. Definitely tip the guy. 

Outside, you can see the area where the bands load up pretty easily. Unfortunately, there's a metal gate, so it would be hard to meet the bands if you're into that kind of thing (I know I am).

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text:
This was the first stop for our group's one night in downtown Nashville. First impressions: three young bro-types immediately hit on one of our group's older women, two girls were dancing like no one was watching to the mediocre band, and it took several minutes for our large group to get the attention of one of the 3 chit chatting bartenders.

The band sucked, the energy was bad, so we ditched this place after one drink. MEH.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
We had a great time - we went on the tour and also had a few beers. We tried the flight and then saw an employee drinking a half and half containing the Bucha and Walk the Lime. Beers on the flight were fine but nothing special. The mix was awesome though! 

We would suggest going here to hear some good music, play board games, have a cheese plate and hang out with friends.

name: Marathon Music Works
text: I've seen several shows here and really enjoy the venue.  The layout and sound are good.  It's clean and has a good atmosphere.  There's parking nearby and I feel safe walking from my car to the door.

name: Ole Red
text: I highly recommend this place. Fun environment with openness.  We had some excellent smoked wings for appetizer, which had a very interesting ranch/blue cheese dip.  The Champagne of Chicken - Nashville Hot was some of the best chicken I've ever had.  It came with homemade biscuits and white gravy that was great!  Not blow you away hot like most Nashville Hot chicken places and a sweet and tangy flavor.  Tried their burger, catfish corn dogs, and desserts, all very good.  Service was a bit slow but it is everywhere at 2pm on Saturday downtown.  It was good food, good times and we will DEFINITELY be back soon!

name: National Underground
text: I have eaten here at least 3 times in past year or so. I always get the same thing, their signature underground burger. Last night was no different. It was just ok. Not good. Not great like it was almost a year ago. Nickel and dimed for fries, cheese, water and get this, the table too! Beer wasn't good and is overpriced. To top it all off, they didn't let us go back inside to use the rest room after spending almost $100 bucks on dinner. Adios. Not more trips to this joint.

name: National Underground
text: The only reason this place gets one star is because our waitress was great. The food, however, is terrible. My sister ordered their veggie burger, and after waiting well over 45 minutes, it came out cold. She sent it back, and 10 minutes later it came out rock heard. Literally, you would chip a tooth if you bit into it. Sent it back for a second time, meanwhile, the rest of the party still hadn't received their food! We waited an additional 15-20 minutes , and my "grilled" chicken was overly blackened and dry. They messed up 3 of the 4 side dishes (chips instead of fries). When you order ice water, you get bottled water that they charge $2 for without telling you. After all of the hassle, they did comp our bill $18, but it's not worth the long wait, terrible food, or expensive water. I will never come back and I wouldn't record this place to anyone looking for good food on Nashville.

name: Ole Red
text:
We stumbled in here because the menu looked so good. Later we found out that Blake Shelton owns it!! There was live music and the place was nice! The band was so good & got the crowd into it. The place was very spacious and had an entire upstairs for more dining/standing. The staff were all SO nice! Everyone was so friendly. Our waitress was so friendly, accommodating, always checked in on us, and provided excellent customer service! She was fabulous! There were so many things we wanted to order on the menu! Everything sounded so good. We decided to go with the redneck nachos without meat and the pimento Mac 'n' beer cheese. The redneck nachos were so good!! I wish they had more cheese on them, but it was piled on with so many different toppings! The barbecue sauce was SO good and everything about the nachos were delicious!! We ordered ours vegetarian and I somehow got ONE bite out of the entire nachos that accidentally had meat in it... so that was very unfortunate. The nachos were massive and definitely shareable. We saw someone else order it and thought they didn't even eat it... oh, they did, there was just no dent in it because it was so much food!! The pimento Mac 'n' cheese was not good... it was very bland. We even added sriracha to it and it still didn't taste good. I don't recommend getting that. 

Overall, the service was phenomenal, the music was amazing, & the redneck nachos were delicious!! I highly recommend coming here!!

name: 12th & Porter
text: We paid good money for this venue and the bartenders decided to cut me off after 2 drinks. The rent a cop wannabe bouncers assumed people's ID's were fake even if the were obviously well over 21. We were told we had an open bar from 7-11 but half the drinks we had to pay for and they were over priced. The treated our formal like it was the senior women's Baptist convention or something. The wanna be hardass bouncer would only let people use the bathroom one at a time like we were children. Honestly an event at a DMV would possibly be more fun then this ignorant ass shit hole. The candied bacon though was hella dope.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Love the ambience with live music and great selection of beers. The 1927 and Sinsear are highly recommended and delicious. I had their five beer burger and fries and can't complain. Nice hidden gem in Nashville. Must try!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Stopped in for a Sunday Funday today. The upstairs had a private party so unfortunately we didn't get a chance to check out the whole place. Luckily we arrived early enough to claim two high top tables though so it worked out. The beer was pretty good, sampled several varieties around the table. The cheese board was absolutely beautiful, very impressive. A few people at the table had burgers and said they were also really tasty. The jazz music started at two and made it really loud downstairs. I'd love to come back when it's warmer because the patio looked spacious.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: If you're a beer drinker, this is a must-visit when in Nashville. It's a beautiful space with a large, modern, well-designed tap room. This isn't Nash-Vegas! Take a tour, and be sure to try everything to experience the full range of what this brewer can do. The bonuses are that the owners are super friendly and helpful, and they're focused on brewing efficiently and conscious of their environmental impact.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: I've never had a bad experience here, but I normally go for lunch when it's not crowded. If you're a tourist, I would go somewhere more authentic. I like this place because I love the beach and I love the vibes and I like live music. I've always liked the food, too.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: Nothing stands out here, but was a decent arena for a concert, typical arena to most I've been to, the prices on the alcohol and food was a little much, but that's usually any arena you go to. Clean facility, and good sound, saw Metallica and I wasn't disappointed.

name: Ole Red
text:
Great looking place, great server we had and great music but things went south from there.  Shocking in such a large building that the 2nd floor is where the restrooms are with only 4 stalls for ladies and with no toilet paper and hand towels and when you mention it to staff they didn't care or change it when we used them again.

I ordered the onion burger without a bun, had about 4 bites with using a knife and fork when was cutting into meat notice some foreign object inside burger.....thought it was a bug but my husband dissected this object and his conclusion was that it was part of the cows skin and hide!!! 
Showed our waitress and she took it to the manager to show him and he came back with the same answer my husband thought it was. And also my friend found same thing in her burger 3 others at our table had burgers but with buns so who knows if the skin and hide were in there burgers. I guess they get the meat locally and ground and packed right in nashville but that was disgusting to have to encounter that!!
 So disappointed as was so excited to get to Ole Red, place has lots of potential and hope Blake and his team fix all the kinks

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: I just had to have a drink at Margaritaville in Nashville, it was just a must. Not a very smart choice. The restaurant was extremely busy, super packed with people that you cannot enjoy it. The bartenders were not friendly whatsoever, this could be due to how busy they were..? Maybe? Hopefully... and their drinks are overpriced and lacked alcohol. There is better bars not as popular with better drinks and lower prices for you to try.

name: National Underground
text:
Tasty. 

The National Underground did not disappoint. My BF has been raving about their burgers for over a year now, so I stopped in over the weekend to test his taste buds. He did not lead me astray! 

We snagged a table outside and watched as our waitress frantically ran from table to table for a few minutes. After we got our drinks we had to ask about ordering food, but she dashed back over to grab our order after we flagged her down. They do not have printed menus; only food items printed on the wall with chalk. It's a pretty simple menu thankfully, so we didn't have any issue looking it over.  I had the grilled chicken sandwich and my friend had the cheeseburger, and both were excellent! The hamburger tasted homemade and had a regular sized patty; not the thick hunk of meat that often is the star of burger joints. I like that they keep it simple and delicious! My chicken sandwich was filled with flavor which is sometimes rare for chicken at a burger place. 

Apparently the grilled potatoes are amazing, but sadly they were out when we came so we had to stick with kettle chips. Also, no substitutions for other side items. I saw a deviled egg small plate that I must try on my next visit. I'm a sucker for those guys.

My overall first trip was awesome and I understand the hype now. They had a live band playing inside, so I'm not sure how conducive it is for a dinner where you want to talk to your companions, but I will definitely be back!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Food was ok but service was terrible. We were a party of 5. The server completely missed the 5th order. When the other 4 meals were served, there were no utensils and the server was nowhere to be found. Had to flag down three other servers before getting utensils. Got the manager involved 4 times in total. He comp'd the missed meal (which was still late and we got most of it to go) and offered free desserts. Told the server that we would order the desserts after we ate. Instead she just brought us the check (with no pen). Also $15 was added to the bill. The manager ended up bringing us the pen, to-go boxes for the late meal and two desserts (which is all we ordered) and corrected the bill. Wouldn't recommend this restaurant

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: You must eat here. I know this is a brewery, but the Chicken Wings and the Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwich...wow!!! In town for the Bowl Game but will be back EVERY time I make it to Nashville.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: The beer is awesome and so is the food! We had the falafel and the fish tacos, both were great. Between my husband and I, we tried all the beer they had available. All were very good.

name: Marathon Music Works
text: I've been here 3 or 4 times, and I've had a blast every time. It's a bigger room but it still has a small feel. You can't really have a bad view of the stage unless you are behind one of the two support beams on either side. You have two bars on both sides of the stage, and an actual, standalone bar called William Colliers that is connected to the venue, which people can come and go from.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Great time. We stopped in several times during our trip and it was awesome. Great drinks, great service. Katie and Barry at the bar were great! Ask for the Barry special!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Stopped in with my kids and wife. Greeted by a beautiful smile, sat down, and were introduced to a character of a waiter. Looked like a pirate(Chris M.)! The corn and calm chowder was amazing. Fish tacos and jumbalaya was perfect. I would come back anytime. Margaritaville rocks!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: I came here for the Predators Games, but this place is huge! It's well decorated for the Holiday Seasons. They are well staffed, which is great because they are all helpful and know where the good nachos are at. They have regular trash can and then recycling trash cans, that is awesome!! They have neat automatic sinks that are just a counter and that's it and automatic paper towel dispenser. Overall it's a great venue and clean!!! there's predators' merchandise is available everywhere, the shop is setup for easy shopping experience. They offer a variety of foods like tacos , burgers and etc. the only down side they only have on funnel cake stand. Last time I was there, the funnel cake stand took cash only. They is currently construction by the main entrance, so it gets congested by traffic. We usually park about a block away and walk. The arena is to downtown Nashville nightlife, so if you want to go celebrate the Predators winning just walk across and pick one of the many options. I definitely will consider coming here for a concert or 2! I just have a good time and a great experience everytime!

name: Ole Red
text: This is a bar has a very good atmosphere and the singer, Cort Carpenter has a very good voice. The staff was pleasant and friendly. The fried pickles are as good as my homemade ones. Enjoyed myself.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: I'm not giving a review on the arena itself I'm giving a review on the concert last night everyone did well but the prize goes to baby face he did his thing it was a wonderful Valentine's concert I had a ball enjoying the performances of everyone.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Good out door, double decker patio and porch area with live music with plenty of seats.  Good selection of local beers and wide arrange of options on the menu for food($9-$15). The hot chicken sandwich was not too spicy and came with fries (has a sweet & spicy flavor- which I really enjoyed!) and the Baha fish tacos were perfectly fried and flavorful.  Their craft beer selection is on point- with flavors for all pallets. I'm not much of a hoppy beer person, so I really like their Southern Whit and their new seasonal, the Saison- tennesake and the seasonal pale ale, Wildwood Flower. If u are looking for a local brewery with a large/fun patio and unique/tasty beer options make sure this in on your list of places to go in Nashville!!

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: Seriously, stopped in for the Eskimo brothers late on an afternoon.  top Notch rockabilly entertainment, as good as it gets.  small bar, nothing outstanding or different, just intimate with peeps having a good time.  The best this night for sure.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: A stellar place in an odd, industrial road. It's a bit in the weeds, but worth the drive. Really great find. The staff is too notch, and eager to get you one of there awesome brews. They had 11 on tap when we were there, excellent variety and we tasted  them all ( 2 flights and a couple pints between us!). The favorites: 1927 IPA, Extra Easy and the Mild Davis. Each had great hops, and layers of subtle notes. Really great beers, and almost all 16oz pours at $6!. Now the food, we had the grilled Brie and the 5 beer Burger. The Brie was lovely, perfectly cooked and such good flavors. Pro tip: add the Bacon. The burger was unfortunately a miss for me. The bread was okay, the patty was large and perfectly cooked, and the cheese was awesome. But the onions and pickles were awful. Way too much salt, in the brine and the grilled onions. Tough to have such a good looking burger tasty so salty. But still a great bar and worth a visit!

name: Ole Red
text:
Had ran out of 3/4 of the starters on the menu at 530 on a Thursday.  Had to literally track down a waitress to order.  Don't waste your time...

Annndddd still waiting for waters...guess I shouldn't have held my breath...

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: This is where the visitors center and gift shop is located. It is centrally located and most of the workers inside and very helpful and great faces of the city. Just look for the spiral part of the building and you'll find the visitors center. There is also a brochure rack inside if you are looking for tips on what to do. I recommend the Nashville total access pass that they sell in here - $50 to 4 attractions plus free entrance to the Parthenon, 10% off in the gift shop and 25% off the Trolley Tour.

name: Ole Red
text: "Blake, I'm here!" I wouldn't miss this place for anything.   Great drinks and service on the lookout bar! Dig your pretzels too.   Omg.  So glad I stoped in.  Thanks for a great time !!

name: Ole Red
text:
We went inside for the nice clean room and live music. We had no idea that this is Blake Shelton's restaurant. 
Deborah was our waitress she was perfect! She is a great reason to come back. The food was to die for. Simple, healthy and priced perfect. Sweet tea was real!  I will go back when it's night time. The Cobb salad dressing was bbq sauce? I thought I will try it! It was perfect

name: Ole Red
text: Got to check this place out! Great food at really reasonable prices. The bands were great every time we went in.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
What an arena! What a fan base! Every seat in the entire arena provides a good view of the ice for Nashville Predators NHL games. I have been going to games here for 20 years and have enjoyed seeing it recently get a bit more attention as the Preds make a playoff run. There are lots of restaurant options, tons of bathrooms, and the team shopped opened not too long ago has every piece of merchandise imaginable with a Preds logo slapped on it. Outside of the playoffs, tickets to games are very affordable and the games are quite the spectacle. The fans are extremely passionate and at times the noise is intense from fans losing their minds cheering after a goal. Bring ear plugs if you are sensitive to loud noises. After the game, the arena empties out into the streets for a good time listening to live music in downtown Music City 

Can't wait to get back here. 

GO PREDS!!!!!!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Kiersten was a great waitress - knowledgable about all drinks and great personality! Give her a pin!

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: A group of us stumbled onto this place right before a crazy thunderstorm. We were looking for not only shelter, but food, drinks and A/C. We found it. For a bar.. the food was good. Granted, its normal bar food, but it wasnt bad (like some places can be). Our group had buckets of beer and buckets of cider, salads, fried pickle chips, cheesey tater tots, cheese sticks, and a few burgers.  The prices were AWESOME and the food was tasty. Were were in on a Saturday and they had karaoke. It wasnt like the "professional" sounding karaoke that you would find on Broadway... it was real.. just plane ol' bad singers having a good time. It was more relaxed.  Id go again.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: This restaurant is overpriced, crowed, and full of staff that don't seem like they care about your dining experience. I had some really good coconut shrimp, but both of my friends didn't like their food. My friend got a margarita but it was much smaller that it looks in the picture and the waitress did not ask if she wanted it frozen or on the rocks. Our waitress never brought ketchup, (I had to walk around and find some) asked about our food, refilled our drinks, or brought us the check. I had to go find her and ask for the check. I wouldn't recommend going here.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
The goods: fun atmosphere, half the staff we interacted with were wonderful, and they have games like Jenga and Connect Four at the tables... lots of space too!

The bads: the other half of the staff.... They don't do flights apparently, but the bartender offered to give us some small samples so we could decide appropriately which pint to try -- no big deal.  Until his reaction to us when we took him up on the offer was one of "really, you're going to make me actually do my job and pour you some beers.  ugh, i would rather be anywhere right now" (y'all know the attitude I'm talking about from one experience or another).  So that happened....

And as far as the beer goes -- if you love pale ales I'm sure this is the place for you!  Unfortunately, if you prefer dark beers like stouts, porters, browns, ambers, etc ... this is not the place for you as they do not serve any.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: We visited Nashville in July and this was our first stop when we arrived in the evening.  It was our first brewery and the best one we visited throughout the entire trip.  We walked into live music and a great outdoor & indoor scene.  The beer was, without doubt, the best we had during our time in Nashville and I highly recommend for any craft beer geek who heads to Nashville!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: My first time to Nashville has been an absolute waste of time and let down. Tell the server no sour cream or guacamole and she repeats it back 25 minutes later for nachos it's loaded in sour cream.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Great Beer. Excellent staff.  Would definitely go back.   Live in Atl but this is now my Nashville place

name: Ole Red
text: 10 bucks for a Tito's and water in a little plastic cup. Food was average at best. Music is great just don't eat there.

name: Nashville Symphony
text: The Schermerhorn Symphony Center is gorgeous. And in a city known for music, it's wonderful to have such a great symphony that hosts wonderful conductors, soloists, and pop acts and concerts. I've been for a classic symphony and a pop concert (a tribute to Ella Fitzgerald and Louis Armstrong), that were both wonderful evenings! I'll definitely be buying some tickets for the upcoming season once tickets go on sale later on in the summer! Support your local symphony!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: This was the most mediocre meal we experienced during our 4 day trip to Nashville. Two of us ordered beers which were lukewarm. One friend had to send his Bloody Mary back because it had big chunks of something in it. The food was very ordinary without much flavor. Huge disappointment.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Stopped in here for a late lunch and it was wonderful! Our waitress was so great and friendly! Awesome atmosphere and everyone I was with loved what they had to eat and drink! We will be returning!

name: Ole Red
text: You may not come to Nashville for burgers but I've had 4 this weekend and this was by far the best one in town. Also heard so much about Nashville hot chicken and have been repeatedly disappointed until Ole Red, a nice smokey spicy bite here. Friendly staff, decent Margaritas and great music. Will definitely be back.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: OMG where do I start if you are a burger person gotta have the 5 beer burger best I have ever had honestly the best staff friendly & knowledgeable about beer tried all the beer they make all are great I will say if you come here one time you will be a regular.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Came for  musical happy hour- which is the only reason to come to Margaritaville when there so many other cool honkey tonks.  Decided to battle the crowd- which was fine and the bar staff was nice but all of the RENTED "cops"were rude and egotistical!! I get the security issues, but I don't get the power trip mentality! They can ruin a good experience and buzzkill any fun to be had. Reevaluate your choices!  The only place during CMAs were the security was like this!

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: The manager Jacob was amazing! He helped us find the shirt we wanted and overall made our experience at Winners and Losers a great one! So glad we stopped in.

name: Ole Red
text: Omg such a fun place.  Didn't try the food but menu was awesome especially if you have allergy issues like me.  I wish Inez's hungry lots of vegan options.  The live music was AMAZING.  Went back one night and heard Mitchell tenpenny.  WOW even then service was great.  Waiters made sure to keep everyone happy.   Security was awesome.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: We were looking for something to do that's indoors on a COLD day and decided to visit TN Brew Works.  Looks like tasting tray is the way to go here, 5 5oz tasters lets you try what you want before ordering. Bartender was nice and accommodating while working the place alone (granted, it was a weekday).  We also had the chocolate tasting and it's good!  Makes a good combo.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: I would give this place a 5, but as soon as the girl with pigtails and a Layla's tag showed up our recent Saturday with out of town friends was ruined. Brian and Haley were amazing and super friendly. But this one didn't smile and acted like she'd rather be elsewhere and witnessed her being rude to several people. (was told she is a manager-Wow). She doesn't belong in customer service at all.  I give it that downtown can get out of hands with rowdy crowds, but this wasn't happening.  I love this place, and sure we will be back-but will likely exit if she is working.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: This was my first time done in Nashville. Worst bar I experienced down on Broadway. The definition of a bouncer is to keep fights from starting, but the bouncer there with neck tattoos was there to start fights, not stop them.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: We were in Nashville for 4 days and we made sure to stop in every day for at least 1 beer. We found that this bar had by far the best bands on Broadway. It is very lowkey but in the best way possible, with a very friendly staff and awesome customers from all over. The best spot on Broadway in my opinion, especially if you aren't into being surrounded by a ton of crazy, loud, drunk people.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: Bar setting was nice, band sounded good. However lack of service! Security let us in we sat down approximately 10-15 mins go by no one came to take our drink order. Finally went to the inside bar to ask and was told there's a bartender out there. Then asked if they served food because my group was hungry. Was laughed at by someone sitting at the bar and then told there kitchen is out of service.  There was no signs telling anyone this and there were condiments on the tables.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: My favorite brewery in town. Every beer on tap is amazing. They have live music most nights. You can sit upstairs if you want to be able to talk without the music blasting in your ears. Can't go wrong.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: My husband and I made the mistake of trying this bar.  Horrible service and unfriendly bartenders :(.  Odd that the manager allows this to happen.  Won't be back.

name: National Underground
text: We came here for lunch around 11:15AM on a Saturday. Upon entering the bar was barely filled with maybe 2 other couples and a large party of 8. After sitting and ordering just water, the waitress informed us that it could take a long while to get our food because the large party was being served, a couple was being served, and there was only one cook. She said we could order an appetizer and maybe get it quickly. So my boyfriend and I decided to leave, but not before we were still charged $4 for 2 waters. Awful customer service.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
We planned our trip to Nashville around a Foo Fighters concert we attended at Bridgestone Arena. 

At first look, the arena is impressive. It's location is great, right in the heart of downtown and there are a lot of vendors inside and outside. I was actually really impressed by the number and variety of food options. It also looks pretty modern inside and out. 

However, once we got to our seats--yikes. It's obvious they tried to pack in as many as possible, with no regards to their customers. The seats are small and cramped. I am an average size person and I felt like a sardine. My boyfriend's friend, who is a larger person, could not comfortably sit at all. He's not 500lbs. He's just a larger person. To make matters worse, the hand rests do not move, so even if you wanted to accommodate a larger friend by letting them share part of your seat space, you can't. 

We actually went to Guest Services to see if they could do anything to help us out. While the woman there did provide us with handicap seating (folding chairs), she was also kind of passive aggressive about it ("Not everyone can be a size '4' like me.") Okay, thanks.

Once we sat down to enjoy the concert, I looked around and saw that most people looked uncomfortable or wedged in their seat. This is ridiculous considering the price we all paid for our tickets. I would've been upset if that were my experience. 

Other than that, sound and view of the stage were good.

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
One of my favorite venues in all of Nashville. I have been to countless shows here... from the classical symphony to the pop series and everything in between. i've seen Bela Fleck, Amos Lee, The Music of Prince with the Nashville Symphony, Wizard of Oz in Concert, and Cirque de la Symphonie. Everything about the symphony is exquisite. Our symphony performs are the highest caliber. The staff are awesome and will get you to your seat with a program as fast as they can. The seats are comfortable whether you're sitting in a box or the balcony.

I have also attended conference here as well as my friend's wedding reception. Every time I come, it's transformed to the event but the beautiful building provides the best backdrop.

If you haven't been to a symphony performance, do yourself a favor and TREAT YO SELF! Check their website because sometimes they have packages or deals. We purchased a 5 show package which was super fun to mix and match shows throughout the season. You can also check out their free day of music! It will give you the opportunity to check out the building and a variety of musical performances. In 2017, they had it in October but I hope that you'll go before then. The symphony has performances perfect for families, dates, friend outings, and for just you! Treat your mind, soul, and ears to quality music this year!

name: Ole Red
text: We love Blake Shelton and had to try his restaurant. Website said to make a reservation but a waitress on the second floor was able to get us a table. Service was prompt despite the crowd. We were impressed with the food, came out fast and was delicious!!! Cost was a bit more than we prefer to spend but was worth the experience. We checked out the roof top bar and were presently surprised. We would definitely come back next time in town.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
Dear Nashville, 

You can try, but you will never keep the Blackhawks fans out. We will find the nooks and crannies and work our way around your little system of trying to keep us from coming. Oh, we will be there alright and that we were.

Last game of the Blackhawks season and what better way than to make a road trip out of it. Nashville fans were courtesy to us (probably because most of them brought their kids along) and we were the same to them. We cheer and jeered at each other and it was all in a light heart fun. However, the best part about Bridgestone Arena was that our tickets were affordable and it came along with all you can drink (beer) and all you can eat (hot dogs, popcorn, nachos, etc)! I love the United Center, but we would never be able to indulge in an all you can eat and drink deal for what we paid in Nashville, the cons of having a Championship team, but I wouldn't trade it for the world.

The employees at Bridgestone were friendly and served us as much as we wanted, I had 4 beers with me at one time. The arena is small, comparable to our All State (Rosemont, IL) so there is no bad seat. However, you guys sing America the Beautiful during Preds vs Hawks games because of all the thousands of Hawks fans that cheer during the National Anthem. I guess you can't embrace the fact that we are hooting and tooting for our team and country. It's okay we were still there and loud as ever.

Nashville you were fun and we'll be back.

name: Ole Red
text:
BEST ROOFTOP ON BROADWAY!!!  Nice bar all in all too.  Didn't eat, but came back a few times for beers on the rooftop​.  You can see down both ways on broadway.  One of the places we came too that the bartender acted like they were doing us a favor by ordering drinks.  Not every bartender, just one (two different​ times on the roof).   I spend a lot of time in tourist areas​ and lived in one (Charleston, SC) for several years.  Tourism is a necessary evil for towns like Nashville.  Southern hospitality is expected.  

PS: Not a Blake fan at all, and still really enjoyed this place.

name: National Underground
text:
We stopped into National Underground as an option on the Nashville Pedal Tour.  As I was ordering a beer - I was told by one of my girl friends that we needed to go because the manager came over to them and said in an extremely rude tone "come on girls, get out of line for the bathroom and get a beer."  

Being that my family has been in the hospitality industry for over 25 years, I kindly went up to the man, asked him his role and let him know that he now lost 8 patrons of the restaurant who were going to be spending a lot of money.  He backed up what he said by saying "we were at a tourist spot on a Friday night" (mind you, the place was empty and it was 8:30 p.m. 

We left and went to Bootleggers next door, which was awesome! We later walked past, the bouncer said "best live music in Nashville" I looked inside, there were about 10 people inside - and I notion to the manager and said - "Worst GM in Nashville right there."

needless to say, I would NEVER recommend going there to anyone I know.  Best part is, this is owned by Gavin Degraw.... who really should take a look at the people who are representing him.

name: Ole Red
text:
Came here with 7 friends in order to grab something to eat before we went out. I guess it was a little late for Nashville since most of the downstairs was too packed and they sent us up to the 3rd floor. It's where the rooftop bar is so they only serve light bar food there no meals. Honestly, they should just skip the food all together and just stick to drinks and the view cause the food was the worst food we had in Nashville. 

We arrived around 9:45pm and the kitchen closes at 10pm so the waitress wanted us to order ASAP which I get. So we decided to order a bunch of random things and share them. We also ordered drinks and she never brought mine out so I walked up to the bar and just ordered one myself since she didn't really come back to check on it. Also she never took it off the bill which we had to get corrected at the end.

For food we ordered: The giant pretzel (edible and a pretty safe bet for bar food), French fries (another safe bet and also okay), fried broccoli (which we all were unfortunately tasting for the rest of the night), the trio which comes with a bologna sandwich?, the calamari ( not in rings and very gross, do yourself a favor and just don't order this) and finally the burrata which has pimento cheese in the middle of it. Not one of us have ever seen that in our lives and we were very confused by it, no one ended up touching it either. 

Overall the experience was overrated and I wouldn't waste my time or money going back there again.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
Let me start by saying I am a native to this area and I am a huge parrothead.  I have visited Margaritaville at both the New Orleans and Panama City locations.  So, needless to say, I had been looking forward to the one in Nashville.  I love my hometown and was hoping Margaritaville would be a great addition to our downtown strip.

The prices (at all of the locations) is really too high.  They are sooo busy all of the time that they should be able to offer the same food for a bit less than what they currently charge.  The drinks are expensive, too.  I didn't have a drink in Nashville, but had plenty in NOLA and at least for the price, they were made to be worth it.

I loved the food at NOLA and Panama City.  I would re-visit either of these. Good selections and very tasty (especially in NOLA, where most all the food anywhere you go is awesome).  The one in Nashville, however, leaves a lot to be desired.  Why did such a place as this open up and serve the same 'ole same 'ole that you can get all over town.  Interesting food is one thing that is hard to find in Nashville, but I promise, there is better just a couple of blocks away.  As far as Margaritaville goes, eat somewhere else.  Big River and even Hard Rock have far superior food to this place, including hamburgers.  It is at least a little better than Planet Hollywood.

Just go here for drinks and music.  At least they got this right.  Yes, I said the drinks are high, but all you need is a couple and you will be too.  ;)

Disappointing for a place in a city where Jimmy Buffett fans are so plentiful.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
I was skeptical to try this place because I figured it would be a tourist trap, but I ended up really enjoying it! It's definitely pricey, but so are most of the bars and restaurants on Broadway. The drinks are great and worth splurging for! The waitress was super helpful and gave awesome drink recommendations. It was nice to have someone help us navigate the menu! 
We also ordered the spinach and artichoke dip and the chicken quesadillas. They were fine but way overpriced. Oh well! I think I'll stick to just ordering drinks next time I visit.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
Is there anything better than relaxing with a beer outside?! The guys who work here are passionate and so friendly, plus they have some darn good beer! Tennessee Brew Works is one of my favorite places to go in Nashville - so chill and relaxing. It's a bit off the beaten path, but once you've found it you'll realize it was worth the search.

If you know me, you know I love a beer sampler/flight. TBW has a sampler of 5 beers for $10. If you take their Saturday tour (offered a few times during the day), it will run you $12 but that includes the $10 flight. 6 beers is all they have on tap but that's plenty enough for me. If smaller portions aren't your thing and and you want a cold, refreshing pint, it can be done for just $5. All of their beers were 4.5-6.25% so nothing overly potent, but that's a good thing when you want to sit for hours having beer after beer on their patio.

Ahhhh, their patio. When I think of their patio, I get visions of unicorns jumping over rainbows with tiny kittens on their backs holding trays of brownies with no edges. It's that good. Since it's away from all the hustle and bustle of more busy areas in Nashville you don't have the congestion you may be used to at other spots. Sometimes people watching can be fun but when you need to just get away from it all, the TBW patio is where it's at. They have live acoustic music! I liked the playlist but once the live music started in the evening --- well that's where it's at.

And if you're lucky, you'll go on a night there's a food truck hanging outside. Other than a random food truck, they offer popcorn for $5 but no other food options. I'd think it's a bring your own food type of establishment.

Service was beyond top notch while we were there. Everyone there was so friendly and when we were seated outside, one of the guys actually sat down with us for a bit and chatted Chicago beers. I really enjoyed talking to him - he educated us on the brewery a bit and gave us some Tennessee Brew Works stickers.

Beer!!!!
They have a sweet potato stout! So cool! It was my least favorite of the bunch but still thought it was a solid 3 stars. The extra easy ale, basil ryeman, southern wit and cutaway IPA were all a strong 4 stars. I love a good witbier so Southern Wit was probably my favorite of the night.

This was the best craft beer I had in Nashville. This was the best atmosphere during my days in Nashville. This goes down as being top 3 places I went to in Nashville. It's only open Thursday to Sunday & usually closes at 8pm, except 6pm on Sundays - early closing so plan accordingly.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Great experience. Server was personable and helpful. I had a burger and mashed potatoes. Both very good. Nice live music. A little bit of a wait to get seated (even though there was no wait, no one helped us right away) and a little longer wait for the food than typically as well. Overall though, good & recommend to others!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Great beer, AMAZING food! Tried a flight of their stouts, all of which were tasty. Me and a friend shared their grilled cheese (with smoked apple butter) and hot chicken sandwich for dinner and it was seriously some of the best food I've ever eaten. All the employees were so friendly and welcoming, too. Next time I'm in Nashville I'm definitely coming back!

name: Ole Red
text:
I had lunch here during their opening week. 
So far, I was pretty impressed. The food was good, the flow of the building is great, and it's one of the only places on Lower Broadway that doesn't blast the live band so loud that you can't hear the conversations of the people sitting next to you at the table. 

The view from the rooftop bar is wonderful of downtown, and I can't wait to experience it more on a happening night. I think this place is getting it right straight out of the gate, and it can only get better.

I'm ready to give it a few more chances and a few more goes as it keeps progressing! Great job on the place here.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Had a great time there last night! Our server Sydney gave the best service i've had in a while! She made the night enjoyable for everyone!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
This review is for the Lexus Lounge. Who knew?!!? 
Who knew this place existed?!?!? Another reason to Yelp!!
Any event the Bridgestone Arena has, will have a benefit to purchase admission to the Lexus Lounge. Totally worth the price. Call the office. Price will be between 40 - 150 dollars per event. Also season tickets to Predators get access to this area. Who knew!!!

Amazing price for what you get. If you experience it once, you will realize it is worth it. I don't go to as many concerts as I used to before baby, so this is so worth it.  Dont' need to go to dinner before, and then pay for drinks when you get there. 
All there at once. 

Lexus Lounge. Nice, Wood and glossy and seats everywhere to co mingle. We ate before we went to concert. 

Tons of selections, Honestly, I was so excited I forgot to take pics.
Let's see, Pizza, Pastas, a few different kinds, desserts, pulled pork sandwiches, hot dogs, fruits and veges. There were 5 tables in all. I don't think I ate from all, I was too excited. Sorry. What I ate was GREAT! Really all the food was good. Would definitely pay for the extra to come back for ANY event. 

Drinks were free and readily available. I drink white wine. ONLY. Tip your server and they give you the LARGE CUP. What a kick

It was a concert and when I went back and forth to the lounge and the concert. 
It was easy and fun and seem less. 

Every single person I met at the Arena was nice and helpful. EVERYONE. 
Class act Lexus and Arena employees

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
The bartender we had made the whole trip worth it. My fiancé and I split the jambalaya, and it was the perfect! 

Service was slow, but again, our bartender kept us entertained even though we only ordered water and food!

name: Marathon Music Works
text:
I've been listening/dancing my way across all of Nashville's music venues and Marathon Music Works is a fun one. There are a lot of indie artists who play here so don't expect to see T-Swift playing at Marathon. MMW is part of the Marathon Village which is a collection of businesses all housed under the same former Motor Works warehouses which built cars at the turn of the 20th century. 

The venue itself is quite large. There is a big bar area when you first walk in with tables and restrooms. It's a good lobby/waiting area if you want to hang before/after/during a concert. They setup merch tables off to the right of the stage. If you get claustrophobic due to large crowds it's okay there's plenty of space. There is no seating area though which is the only downside to this venue.I saw Taking Back Sunday here, fulfilling a long ago wish of a teenage self. They were lively and the atmosphere was perfect for them. As far as parking, there are a few pay lots but then some street parking if you are willing to walk a few blocks. 

I would definitely see another show here. Security was efficient, the bartenders were nice and most importantly the band was great and the stage was easy to see them.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Food is horrible. Burger was soaked in dales! Smells bad and table top was about to fall off. Over priced and poor quality. Stop at mcdonalds you will be glad you did.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: This was hands-down the worst customer service I have received. The wait staff was extremely rude and slow. They did not come to take a drink order for more than 30 minutes. We did not have the opportunity to order food for 60 minutes. And this was a Tuesday night.  When trying to get the attention of a different server we were blown off. We asked to speak with the manager regarding our poor experience, who obliged and was helpful. The band and atmosphere were fun. The food was good. Maybe go somewhere else if you want better service.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: The BBQ was good. We stopped by before a concert at Bridgestone Arena.  The service was fast to meet the limited time that we had.  We did love the live music and drinks.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Wish I had gone somewhere else instead.   My table was dirty and still had bits of spilled food from the last customers.   I was served my food but was never given any silverware.   The people at the table next to me gave me one of theirs.   The meat was tough, dried out, burnt and fatty.  The coleslaw was bland and tasteless.  I should have checked reviews before deciding where to eat.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: I didn't come here for the food, just the entertainment but this place was so fun! I really enjoyed it. The line dancing was fun. The entertainment was great and had a great singer. This place was super busy but you always had tons of room to move. I highly recommend this place.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Ribs melt in your mouth, don't even need to add sauce, music was great, service was good and would come back

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
The only prompt service I got was the bro bouncer and his metal detector. Way to make me feel welcome.

Beer selection was moderately overpriced, band was subpar.

Environment all suggests "here's a honky tonk run by people who don't know how to run a honky tonk."

Absolute disappointing mediocrity, masquerading as sobro authentic.

There's a bloody good reason the other bars on this block as elbow-to-elbow crowded, and this had ample open seating on a Saturday night.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Amazing Experience through and through. 
Friend of mine took her family there while they were in town visiting and they can't. stop. talking. about. it. 
Her uncle made sure to talk everyone he met that they went there and I'm so happy I was able to pass along the great reco! 
Definitely a great place to be with the locals on historic broadway. #RippysOrBust

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
One of our favorite bars, but they close at 1am! 

I believe we had the Sunset on 2nd drink in the souvenir glass ($16 / refills $11).  

The bands were great. We watched Broseph on Friday and Tom Yankton on Saturday. We paid a $6 cover charge on Friday and no cover on Saturday. 

We didn't realize they served food. 

Overall a great time!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Good ribs. Good music depending on the band. Band members can be a little pushy for tips. Wait staff fast and efficient.  Upstairs seems to be louder than downstairs. A fun atmosphere!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
Great pizza. Live music. A good place to hang out. Casual and cool. Good beer on draught. Only been on week nights or Sunday night and never had to wait for a table and service is good.

Try the cream of crawfish soup. It's delicious and I get a cup every time I go!

The menu is diverse. They have some good specialty pizzas, and I always have trouble deciding what to order. You can build your own, or get it in calzone. They have at least four base sauces (red, alfredo, pesto, and garlic ranch) which is great. Crust is fairly thin and good as well.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: We were in Nashville for  4 days and had the best service ever on Sunday, July 20th thanks to Jonathan on the upper floor!! He was working the whole floor and getting great comments from all the tables around us!!! We spent lots of money on drinks and food while listening to some great music all week but by far he was "stellar" in service!! Great to have him on your team!!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: A dead ringer of an establishment located right on the strip of honky tonkys in downtown Nashville. Rippy's has live music everyday, sometimes with two floors of bands, a beer bible of a brew menu, dancing and good energy all around, and all bourbon and drinks one would expect in Nashville. Stop in here while making the rounds on the strip and you're in for a good time!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
This southern BBQ did not disappoint! The place is pretty packed but what place isn't in downtown Nashville? There's an awesome live band to listen to while you enjoy your food. Not gonna lie - it's pretty loud and hard but the atmosphere is great! 

The ribs are a great choice to go with - top it off with their delicious BBQ sauce too! Very smokey too. 

It's also in the heart of downtown so all the other bars are right by it. 

Definitely a fun place to be and glad I stopped by!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: A two toned cafe and bar, Rippy's is a double open mic bistro on the end of Broadway. If the constant music from both stages on opposite sides of the business doesn't' annoy you then the sub-par waiting will. What saves this place is the historical pictures and clippings on the walls, the talented acoustic and or 4-piece-band and the food: Possible the best cheeseburger I've ever had. The actual dining area is big, spacious and music inspired, but then again, what can you expect from a restaurant located on music street in music city.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: I am rating this 5 stars because they have the best pulled pork I have ever had. It tastes exactly how it smells which is a smoky BBQ taste to it. Highly recommend if you are looking for pulled pork or brisket on Broadway. Also want to add that we went during the week at night and it had a weekend vibe to it with the live music and amount of people there. Can't imagine how it gets on the weekends but I would definitely check it out if passing it.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: This was our first stop on our trip here. Maybe a little too tourist-y for me, but the food and drinks were really good anyway. Our server kind of freaked me out--he was obviously that professional type who is good at his job, but was overly phony. I love that they do line dancing--not that I participated, but it was fun to watch. We also got to see Craig Wayne Boyd perform, not that I'd heard of him before, but I'm definitely a fan now.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: In town for a conference, read the reviews and stopped in. Love the atmosphere, live music. The drinks are very reasonable and the food is the delicious. The people really showed a Philly girl southern hospitality while enjoying watching my Eagles play. Definitely will be back .

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
Came here with family, so there was 6 of us and a baby. Got sat right away, but it took a while for our waiter to come take our drink orders. We ordered cheesy garlic bread, but it was nothing spectacular. It actually tasted a little funny when you bit into the end with the burnt cheese on it. Definitely not worth $8. We all ordered pizza. I got the 5 cheese. I could've probably gotten a better cheese pizza at the grocery store in the frozen pizza aisle. I also sat there for 20 minutes with my water glass empty.

All in all, the pizza wasn't good and the service was even worse. Skip this place and go anywhere else for pizza! Even Pizza Hut would be better.

name: Twin Kegs
text:
What can I say about the Twin Kegs.... It's much more than just "two" kegs on tap. I used to be a regular at this spot about 5 years ago, and after relocating back to Nashville (albeit) a little rearranging of the setup; this place hasn't changed a bit. While  it is still what people would consider a dive bar, the same friendly faces are still there. It still has one of the best burgers in town, and cheap cold beer to boot. A little off the beaten path from your typical tourist spots, it still should not be overlooked as as a great hang out in NashVegas. Great Karaoke without a long wait, and $2.50 domestic pints.... What more could you ask for. So if you find yourself seeming lost (or not) near this little spot on Thompson Lane come on by your home away from home and say hey to Todd, Molly, Max, and the rest of the staff at the Kegs, they will definitely treat you like family.

Pros:
Great food
Cold beer
Cheap beer
Staff
Regulars
Friendly

Cons:
No liquor sales (this is only a con if you are not a beer drinker)

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Rippy's is right, as in they rip you off. The bartender charged me $18 for a whiskey ginger. Wtf??? (Later they brought another beer bucket when no one asked for one)

Otherwise, the live music is good but the place is incredibly crowded.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Good pizza and great music but horribly slow service. Lots of kids at the bar on a Saturday night so just a different vibe.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: While this isn't the worst BBQ I've ever had, it certainly wasn't the best either. I would highly recommend going elsewhere to eat if you're going downtown. One member in my group stated the burger was the worst they'd ever had. I personally thought the BBQ sauces were delicious. My salad + pulled pork was fine, too. The platter had a nice variety of items, although I thought the cheese sticks was a bit unnecessary (I can buy that at the store!). I was also not a huge fan of my drink, but it wasn't terrible. I would go here for some live music and move along.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
In the shadow of the Bridgestone Arena, we went to Rippy's a couple of times during our Nashville vacation. The atmosphere was what I was looking for in my ideal "Nashville experience". 

Our first time to Broadway, we stopped at Rippy's for lunch because the music drew us in from the street. We sat in the upstairs outside. There were 3 guitar player/singers on stage and they were really good musicians taking requests, playing country covers and interacting well with the crowd.

I had the pulled pork sandwich with a beer, which was very good. I would say it was above average. 

I did think that the service was a bit snotty. Almost as if we weren't welcome. I later found out that this sort of behavior is normal at Rippy's.

We did go back at night, just for drinks and music. This time we sat downstairs in the back and stayed for an hour enjoying the band before moving on for our bar hopping adventure.

Great atmosphere, great entertainment....would be better with less attitude.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Really good food, great atmosphere. The serving system was odd in the restaurant... had someone serve us drinks, but when we tried to order an appetizer at the same time, were told that she doesn't serve food. I could see that in the bar area, but not in the restaurant. Again, just odd. Reducing a star due to errors in the order.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: So we are Las Vegas locals, and we usually go to Stoney's and whatnot down there to line dance and two-step. We've come to this saloon 3/4 nights and we love it! This is the only place on Broadway with a big dance floor where you can really let loose or sit down and relax. Great performers and nice staff.

name: Tennessee Performing Arts Center
text:
It's been years since I've been to an event at TPAC,  but my husband and I went two weeks ago and it was a great experience.  We saw Michael Carbonaro at the James K.  Polk theater and found the venue very clean and comfortable.  The staff was pleasant and helpful in pointing us in the right direction, as there were several performances that Sunday evening and the crowds were correspondingly large and hectic. 

The seats in the theater are very comfortable and spaced so I didn't feel like I was sitting on top of anyone, and we had great views of the stage, with an appropriate sized screen also displaying the show.  

We opted not to utilize the valet parking at $20 (pre-tip) but in retrospect, wish we had.  We found a small lot just a few blocks away but paid $26 for three hours to make sure we were covered for whole show.  Next time, we'll pay for the valet and have the same cost, but curbside service.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
My boyfriend and I came here recently when vacationing in Nashville from New Jersey. In general I had just an OKAY experience here. Definitely a tourist trap but worth going to at least once. 

The decor is pretty awsome! Tons of different funny horses are spread throughout the entire place. Great for taking tons of funny pictures. 

I wanted to order the Comfortly Jack to drink and wanted it without the souiveniere glass. However, to my dissappntment the waitress told me I cold not purchase just the drink without getting the glass as well, refills are less money if you do decide to get it. I caved because I really wanted the drink itself. It cost me $13.75 for it. Grantit the glass was nice but I didn't want it and the "signature drink" was to very good. There is a problem when the drink is huge and you barley have a buzz by the time it's done. 
My boyfriend just ordered a beer and that too was its a purchase of a souiveniere glass. I get the whole up selling customer thing but to make a costumer get one of those glasses is just stupid if they don't want it. 

We split two different things, one was the sampler. It came with quesadillas, chicken fingers, fried green tomatoes and fried pickles. My bf hates is allergic to pickles and told the waitress so she added extra chicken fingers with o extra price that was very nice of her. The green tomatoes were soooooooo good! Absolutely loved ! And the chicken fingers were prob the best chicken fingers I have ever had! The quesadilla was just okayyy. 

We then decided to split the Tennessee BBQ duo . The waitress tried to change our mind and up sell us to the priciest item on their menu the "Stampede Platter" ($23.00)  after we already made up our mind and kept asking if we were sure. Yes lady we are sure! Especially due to the fact that both menu items were the exact same thing but the Platter was slightly bigger. The Duo (17.00)  came with hickory smoked pork chops and shaved beef brisket. Baked beans co slaw and Texas toast. The baked beans were amazing but the rest of the meal was pretty bland. They had containers of BBQ on the table to add to the meal. I must say while being in Tennesee I had better dinners during my stay here. 

After dinner we decided to go upstairs and check out the pool tales and air hockey tales. The pool tales were very cheap and not good if your a pool player. The hockey tables were also cheap but fun. Both were free which was great and they had a lot of them. 

Overall my experience here was just okay like I said. Go there for the appetizers and beer and to take cool pictures.

name: Nashville Palace
text: DO NOT come here while conferences or other events are going on in the area. After a day at a conference at the Gaylord Opryland hotel across the street, we decided to stop here for dinner. Our group of 7 waited for over half an hour to get offered water and to get our menus. We waited another 20 minutes or so to order. The live entertainment was great, but the extremely poor service could not be excused. We were barely checked on and were not given updates about our order. After another 40 minutes or so, three of the seven dishes came out. Two of the orders were wrong and one of the entrees were cold. We waited for the remaining four meals because many other nearby eateries were already closed at this time. We noticed tables who ordered after us getting their meals first. We asked the waitress where the remaining four meals were and she said the kitchen didn't even start on them yet!!! It was unreal. Two hours later and most of us left starving and extremely pissed off. Poor service. Poor quality food. Save your time and money and dine somewhere else.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Excellent food! Came in twice, in the same day. Laura Marie kicks butt! The daytime bartender Megan, was also amazing! Great atmosphere, music, and this place has it going on! Don't miss out on the opportunity for the full experience. A special thanks to the owner, for making this happen. Y'all made my trip! Rock on, from the Harley-Davidson family.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Our concierge recommended this place when I inquired about good ribs.  I took his advice and headed down the hill from our hotel.  I enjoyed the music and the atmosphere, but the ribs were pretty lame.  No distinct flavor and rubbery.  I wouldn't go here to eat.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
This place has a great atmosphere. The pizza is great! The nachos aren't like nacho chips, they are pita chips, so they are a little chewy, but still good. 
My friend had the calzone with crawfish. He said there weren't enough crawfish, but it was still good. 
Overall, it was good. I'll go back!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: What a great time! This was a private party that I attended. The bands were fantastic! The food was OK and the  service was excellent.  A Fun place even for those who do not dance.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Terrible customer service. Line dancing super fun especially with the woman who goes over how to do it.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: It goes without saying the music was great. Slower tempo than the other bands down the strip. We ordered the ribs and came out great. Save your cash and avoid the mix drinks. Water down for my taste.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: So I'm in a group of 14 people coming into (a very empty) Rippy's at 4pm and we wanted drinks and a little bite to eat. We sat around a bar area and they asked us to move because ONE table for two people wouldn't be able to accommodate guests. Reminder: it was empty. When we said - no thanks, we like it here- they stopped serving us. Oh wait- they barely took our orders. Then they had half of the staff surround us and basically intimidate us out of there. THEN for the two people who got an order in before they wanted us out - they wanted to be paid for their beers... that they never delivered. I'm sober enough to write this coherent review so clearly we are not a group of drunks. For a town that has a bar every two feet, I'm shocked they would turn away what would have probably amounted to several hundred dollars of business. Happily sitting at Nudies!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: If you like really loud ambiance then you will like this place, due to the incredible business they do, it is a bit messy/dirty with many over flowing waste bins too close in proximity to the tables of dining patrons overloaded with old food , plates and refuse, so that when the bus boys dump the garbage in them it sometimes spaltters around the can, plus you're forced to look at and smell old food. The waitress we had was friendly and nice but the ribs and pulled pork were not what we thought it would be. The first time they came out cold, after waiting until we could find her because she was so busy, our waitress brought a new batch back that was hot and she was very accomodating,  but there are better places to have Bar-B-Que in Nashville and the surrounding area. Maybe if it wasn't so busy we would have had a different experience. We will have to try it when it is not so super busy.If it were not for the over loaded waste bins so close to the dining tables and the fact that our food was served cold on the first attempt I would have given a better star rating.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Food was cold when it got to me. Didnt get utensils until 5 minutes after got our food and it plain just didnt tasts that good. Poor service AND food...

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: The only nice person encountered was one of the hostesses. Every other person that worked there was clearly unhappy and did not want to be there. Way to make an uncomfortable dining experience. The food was ok. The servers, bartenders, and other employees could put a smile on their face and at least pretend like they want to be at work.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
I would give this dump zero stars if I could. The food and service was a total waste of my time. The food was horrible, cold and delivered at a snails pace. The loaded nachos, were a pile of stale chips covered in wilted lettuce and warm sour cream. The fries were soggy and a mess, the wings were a 3 out of 10, but would have been higher if they weren't ice cold. The side salad looks like they took crap from the hamburger mixins bar and threw it is a paper dish.

McDonalds would have been a major upgrade to this mess of a restaurant

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: This was a very fun honky tonk vibes venue that is  more updates than the others in the area.   The food here was incredible.   We had the wings, popcorn and ribs and I highly recommend them all.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: It's a tourist trap and we fell in.  The ribs were barely edible with sauce. The music was great, beer selection was ok, just don't eat anything and you'll be safe.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: What we enjoyed most about this place was the free entertainment and outdoor patio. It was a fun place to go for drinks and music. We are lunch there and then realized that evening there was free entertainment. The lunch was good but the service wasn't very prompt. That carried in to the evening when we had to ask a waiter three times for service and he kept saying he would be back to get our order. My husband finally went up to the bar on his own to grab drinks. We were there in August for vacation so my review is a tad outdated. But I wanted to commend them on their entertainment.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
A solid 3 seems about right...although I really really love the live music.

Location is wonderful...right across from the Bridgestone arena and basically at the start of your stroll down Broadway.  If you are staying at one of the local hotels it is a perfect place to stop in..grab a few beers and listen to a set or two.

Like other Yelpers have pointed out the food is forgettable.  I got the rack of ribs and it wasn't bad.  It did the trick...I wanted some BBQ and listen to some cool live music.  If I want serious BBQ I would have headed down to Martins, but for this trip Rippy's was just fine.

Go in here knowing what to expect.  You are going to hear some great live music...have a pretty solid selection of beers served by real bartenders.  However, the food is going to be like most other places on Broadway...it will fill the belly, but be forgettable....

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Big dance floor, line dancing lessons, live music, good drinks, and a good time overall. There is a reasonable cover charge and a bathroom attendant who is sweet as pie so take some dollars with you to the potty.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Huge location! Nice, lit up bar! Huge dance flor area, lots of seating around. Huge stage for live music. We came here when it wasn't too crowded! They were even doing line dancing lessons every 30 minutes which was really fun! Very different than in the Bay Area! So many people join in and have fun! Bar had decent priced drinks.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: This place was totally dead on a saturday- weird. The first time we walked up they asked for a cover charge- i was like nahhhh then he was like ok ok no covercharge, which was SUPER fishy. Regardless we had a BLAST. the band that was here was BA like AWESOME and i loved the fact it was line dancing- which oddly I had a hard time finding in nashville? Overall great time!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Had a fantastic time there!  Listened to a gentleman, Larry Williams, great country singer.  We actually went there twice just to hear him sing.  They have yummy fried pickles and mushrooms!  The waitresses are super friendly!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Touristy place on the corner of Broadway across from the Bridgestone arena so with concerts and sports events I'm sure they are always busy. Has 2 floors very loud there is a  live band playing on each floor . food is expensive for what you get and just ok-- seriously its bar food folks , I've had better BBQ at small out of the way places .. I rate this place Been there done that

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
The barbecue here was really good and comes out very quickly (we had pulled pork, chili, and smoked chicken, all were great. mozzarella sticks were cold). Our server was really friendly and offered great suggestions. The atmosphere is fun too with great live music.

The issue with this place is that the tables are first come first serve, so if you have a bigger group there is no way you're getting a table unless you wait a long time (so do not go there starving like we did! big mistake). We had the 6 people in our party scouring both floors for about an hour before we were able to sit down. We couldn't put our name in for a reservation and sit at a bar waiting to be called and enjoying our time which we had done at other restaurants, so that was a little frustrating. I don't know if the good food is worth the hassle of your whole party working to get a table.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
Service was 8 of 10
Food was 6 of 10 (had tomato basil and bob Marley pizzas.)
Portions versus price was not very good. The atmosphere is the saving grace. Good place to drink if you want to spin the money.

name: Twin Kegs
text: We love this place! We usually get the burgers and onion rings. However, chicken wings are awful. Oh, and there's no liquor. Yet, there is a full size shuffle board and decent beer prices. The thing I love most, NO country music.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
We went there on a Thursday night because we love country dancing. Let me say this. I you love couples dancing like we do then this is NOT the place for you. We were the only ones dancing. There were NO dance lessons like the website says just someone on the floor for people to try and follow. There is NO dance floor educate,we saw people with drinks on the floor. The "line dancers"did not leave any room for couples. 
 The first band was good but the second one put people to sleep.
 The night we went there were private parties going on so no food was served.
The drinks were on the high side also.

So if you can dance you will be upset specially since it is the only place that has dancing.

We did try to go on Sunday to see if it was just an off night but it was closed.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Their pizza is to die for!!!  The cheese is melted to perfection and the crust is just the right thickness.  Service is always great and the servers are very attentive and friendly.  2 for 1 Mimosas and Bloody Mary's on Sunday.  One of the few places in Nashville that actually plays the sound during games.  We come here almost every Sunday to watch football.  My favorite pizza place in Nashville for sure!!!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: We paid a six dollar cover to find out we had no reservation and to be treated rudely.  Went across the street to  a more accommodating restaurant.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: My very first and last time at this place. My server was the rudest most unprofessional person I've ever had to wait on me. After talking to the manager about his disgusting attitude I was given excuses for his behavior. I am so disappointed because I've heard nothing but good things about this place. As said before, I will not be back into this establishment....this guy...my server Brian ruined it for me.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
Really disappointed. Came here specifically for the line dancing. Sat in the back bar area because tables were on a 45 min wait this Thursday evening July 11. 
When dance lesson time came, the instructor took the stage. Could hear him and he seemed awkward teaching the dance moves. Did see his photo on the web site for instructors. 
It was so loud with people talking just added to the bad feel of the place. 
The singer/ guitar player was not very good compared to other venues in town. We left and found much more appealing music.

name: Nashville Palace
text: You walk by this place near Opryland. Very loud but the locals love it. Music was so loud couldnt even talk to each other. I opted for smoked chicken. Did not care for it at all. VERY expensive for a small piece of meat and a handful of fries. Also their drink prices are ridiculous!  It was like 12.00 or something like that for one mixed drink. I would expect that at a very luxe resort not a country western bar. Would rather just buy a bottle and some soda and kick back in my room.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: Food was good. Zack was great. He knew the menu well and was very accommodating to our wishes. He made our time at Nash House super. We came in with a group of 10 and were easily accommodated. We ordered yummy appetizers.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
Food 3.5. 
Line dancing lessons 4.5. Fun

Wife and I had the brisket sammy. Son had chicken strips. Four different types of fries- very good.

Line dancing lessons are about 20 min long starting every 45 min or so during day. Enormous place. We went mid afternoon so quiter. Its WILD at night  and weekends. 

Music more in evenings 

Go have fun

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
