name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Ok so I know these signature places are usually cheesy but this place seemed to fit the blues bar bill. Stage placed perfectly, real blues and bar tender that was super attentive. Like most of Nashville the music was great but really impressed with the whole place. Great fan of the blues scene in Chicago but some of those places should learn something from this place.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Our visit to the Grand Ole Opry was one of the best part of our trip.. Can't wait to go back.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
The beer selection was outstanding....like the bartender said..."if you can't find something you like then you don't like beer".  And I completely agree!  You can taste test what you like until you find something.  The food was fantastic....I ordered the pretzels,which were chewy on the outside and soft on the insid and  the green chili pork stew was a perfect blend of spicy and smoky all with soft corn tortilla paired with it. 

My only beef was the parking....I paid $12 for hours.  Surely I'm missing the secret code.  I would hate to think that a restaurant allows their patrons to get royally screwed by the Public Transit system.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Best selection of beer in Music City. Always something new to try. Food is really good, and the service is great even when the place is packed. The atmosphere is amazing. Makes you feel like you are in a large pub or beer garden. Great place to watch The Preds play.

name: Third Man Records
text: A must see for any Jack White fan.  It is a small record store, but the nostalgic atmosphere is great and it is fun to just thumb through the records and merchandise.  They also have a cute photo booth in the back.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
I almost walked out. Not familiar with Nashville, I had no idea parking was a bear. They do offer valet but I prefer to park my own humble ride. So I go in and into the main room where the bar is. Instant headache. Sounds like everyone is yelling even though they re not. I've been to many a saucer and I don't recall any this damn loud any night of the week.  I almost turned around when I spotted a cold beer. Had to come in. Had to shout my order to the waitress. Meh.

Beer selection is decent with a lot of local beers I don't know about so didn't partake. I did find a sierra nevada i hadnt tried so good enough for me. It was super busy but the waitress was nice. Turkey melt came lukewarm with cold fries. Time I caught the waitress again I had ate half my turkey sandwich.  My least fav saucer thus far. Should have stayed at the hotel and bought a six pack n a sandwich.

name: Ms. Kelli's Karaoke Bar
text: I had a blast! My country music loving friend not so much! Drinks way overpriced! You'd think they could afford AC with what they make on drinks. It was so hot and drinks weren't cold enough to balance.

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text: I'm going to keep this one short and simple. This is a blast of a place with fun live music and cheap beer, what more could you ask for? Definitely a touristy spot, but sometimes it's nice to get up and out and see what all the hustle and bustle is about. We will definitely be back to check out this place more and listen to some good, fun music.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: We took a backstage tour, the tour guide was awesome! We would definitely go again. It is worth the price. Everyone there was very nice and friendly.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Well, you can tie me up in a hickory barrel and pickle me in moonshine. I can't believe I've done 3,000 of these missives to the troops (...umm, that would be you). And then I was faced with the dilemma of what to review for my self-important 3,000 milestone. But the obvious choice was staring me in the puss. It's a place I never dreamed of going to and yet I found myself enraptured by the experience. I'm not even a country music fan, and the NRA was having their annual convention that weekend. I only recognized one name on the bill that night and only barely. All the warning signs would have indicated I would have had an awful time at the Grand Ole Opry.

But no, it was a great venue for very talented musicians, and if you have any doubt that Nashville is a music town, just come here. It's really an experience you don't want to miss. I made the reservation for tickets well in advance of a trip that Jamie W. and I were making to that part of the country. We had no idea who would be playing since they don't announce the artists until a week or two before the actual date. We had our fingers crossed that it would be a group with a coolness factor like Lady Antebellum or a true legend like Dolly Parton. But alas, the only name we sort of recognized in the program was John Conlee, a Nashville stalwart who has since moved securely into Christian music. Oh dear.

Jamie and I made it to the current venue which is in a suburban area east of downtown. It was built in 1974 because the weekly attendance was outgrowing the capacity of the Ryman Auditorium, the Mother Church of Country Music, which is still operating downtown and hosts the Grand Ole Opry during the winter months. Once you enter, the theater looks the same cavernous size as the Metropolitan Opera House, both of which seat 4,000. The stage looks like a very modern version of the traditional barn front where Minnie Pearl would yell out her "How-deee!" And yet the seats were nothing more than pews with the thinnest of cushion padding. We did have good seats though, about nine rows back in the center section.

Because the show is also a radio broadcast, in fact the longest-running one in history, it is the most efficiently run concert I've ever attended. It starts promptly at 7PM and ends at exactly 9:15PM. No curtain calls, no costume changes, no exceptions. There were four half-hour segments separated by commercials for longtime sponsors like Cracker Barrel and Dollar General. They even held contests for audience members to win gift certificates. Each segment was hosted by what appeared to be a veteran of the Opry whether it was Conlee or Jeannie Sealy (photo: http://bit.ly/1dH2YVg). The program offered more traditional fare like mountain bluegrass from Jesse McReynolds and the Virginia Boys, smooth harmonizing from the Whites, a longtime sister act, and pure traditional country from 81-year-old Jim Ed Brown.

There were several more contemporary performers like Chris Janson and Jackie Lee (photo: http://bit.ly/1zrhYA9). Our favorite of the evening was Mark Wills, who has been surprisingly around for nearly twenty years and had quite a strong following in the audience. He sang two solo numbers plus a duet with Joe Diffie, and we kept wondering why he didn't have more name recognition than he does (photo: http://bit.ly/1zGTPWO). But maybe he does in Nashville. What do I know about country music anyway? Next to nothing actually, but you don't need to have any knowledge to enjoy the shows they present here. I ain't no Bible-thumping, shotgun-carrying, Jessie Helms-worshiping conservative, but I had a grand enough time at the Grand Ole Opry to make this my 3,000th review.

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
Traveling for my profession, I like to find off the wall, non-chain restaurants. Don't let it's location turn you off of this unique, somewhat hidden diner. We tried it on a Saturday at peak lunch hours and was able to find a table without waiting. This place seems more like it was made for the late night bar goers. Food was surprisingly good and service was fast and friendly. Looking at the bar, they have many daily specials and there was a small area that looked like they might have live music on the weekends. 

Overall, this was a good place to visit and I hope to go back on a weekend night to see this place really liven up.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
The staff was aloof and inattentive, as well as service being slow. I was taken back by this right away because there was hardly anyone else in there when we ate. Right there -2 stars. My drink (which was mere water) was empty well into my hot sandwich with no one to be found for a refill. 
The hot pretzels with 4 dipping sauces is to-die-for! Fluffy and delish! The buffalo chicken wrap(it is HOT) is a winner also! 
Will go back soon for those 2 items and hope service is better.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
This was a great tour and I highly recommend. 
Easiest per-purchase tickets on their website for this backstage and behind the scenes tour. 

Entering back stage you see where the tv shows Hee Haw and Nashville are filmed. 

The music artist mailroom was a very interesting stop and the description of all the dressing rooms. 

Enjoy the tours.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Cover Charge Ok if one does not drink or eat otherwise not cool for a restaurant. Service slow go for a busy Sunday night. Food was fantastic and the portions were worth its price. Beer Yuenling was as usual the best domestic one. Live Music was awesome Jimmy and the guys were a hell of a good show. Overall I was satisfied and my teen had a great time.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: It is a must see in Nashville, I am not a country music fan and I was planning to spend only one hour and then go to downtown, but once the show started, I got hooked up and I couldn't leave my chair. Do yourself a favor and make a booking!

name: Ms. Kelli's Karaoke Bar
text: Walked in and straight out. Really wasn't my scene - which is weird to say because I'm addicted to karaoke. It felt like I was interrupting someone's 21st birthday party, plus it was way too smokey. Sorry guys. Everyone else appeared to be having a great time though!

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text: First place we went when we got to town. It was exactly what I thought it would be. Multi levels from multi different scenes. Will definitely go back.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
We popped over here on a quick road trip from Huntsville, AL, and we had no regrets. They had an amazing singer, and she had one of the most powerful voices I've ever heard. Apparently, she stepped in for Stevie for a few years with Fleetwood Mac. The house was packed when we arrived, but it must have been our lucky day because they had a 2 top that just opened up. 

We both ordered the half rack of ribs, with mac and cheese, beans, and coleslaw as our sides. The major disappointment here was the tiny side portions. There was no more than 1-2oz or 1-2 bites per side. Nonetheless the meat fell off the ribs, and despite the tiny portion of mac and cheese, it was still mouthwatering.

If I'm ever in the South again, I'll be sure to stop at BB Kings!

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
Let me start by saying I went to FS two years ago with two coworkers and we loved it! It's a cool place and the food was very good so I recommend it for an good dinner with friends.

HOWEVER, this week I went for a corporate dinner and it was a hot mess. We arrived and the room for our event was HOT when we entered so you can imagine how it felt once we added 40 bodies! We were also give ONE waitress. The poor girl did a very good job but she was not set up for success at all. It took a loooong time for any food at all to come out and when it did come out it was not enough so there was about a 30 min delay before more food came out. As soon as dinner was done our whole party escaped the steam room to go into the bar area where the A/C actually worked. Moving areas was unfortunate bc we were there to hang out with our team but we were forced to split up to get to A/C. 

I would go again for dinner with friends but I would not have a private event there.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
Literally the best food I've ever had 
It was bomb pls go there if you're visiting Nashville WOW

name: Third Man Records
text: I'm from Michigan so I definitely love everything Jack white does. The vintage recording booth that Neil young recorded a song in among many other cool things just to see. There are plenty of things to purchase Third man Records, White stripes, the raconteurs along with his solo career. There are a host of very talented artists that you can find on vinyl.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
I think I'd consider moving to Nashville just to be able to eat these amazing lick your fingers, plate and any sauce off my sig others face on a regular basis. Amazing ribs is only one feature, but a major one. Just love this spot.

Travel to Nashville area for business every few months and this has become a go-to for belly bliss ribs. The three times I've had them, consistently tender, juicy, and flavorful. The sauce has a bit of a vinegar base adding to the twangy yumminess and can order plate with as few as 4 ribs or as much as a full rack. And these aren't tiny ribs, expect meaty and perfectly made.

Along with many other southern plates of goodness, another fave is the mac & cheese and their thinly sliced fried pickles. The mac & cheese is creamy with a mix of cheeses sprinkled on top and can be subbed in place of the standard pork beans or cole slaw for $2. Well worth it if love your m&c with bbq.

Add to the great food, atmosphere! It's located just off the main Nashville strip near several other colorful venues of good eats and live music.The decor is colorful and fun. And if you happen to be there in the evening, the live entertainment doesn't fail to add to an enjoyable dinner.

name: Belcourt Taps
text: Don't like leaving negative reviews, but... Here was our first impression of Belcourt Taps. This is on a Saturday at 3:00pm. We sat down, and after 10 minutes we asked the girl working where we could get some menus. We got the menus ourselves and went back to our table. 10 minutes later, she still hadn't come to even take our drink order (what, that would've taken a total of 30 seconds?)... So being that we had come to a restaurant because we were hungry and expected to be served, we left.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: We were staying at the hotel next door and headed over on a Friday night to satisfy our sweet tooth. Unfortunately we found this place is better for a night out but the dessert was pretty bland. We had the goat cheese crepes and they were definitely missing some flavor- could have used a good fruit to sweeten them up a bit. Service was fine but this is definitely geared more towards a bar crowd with a hipster vibe. Come for drinks but go somewhere different if you are just looking for something sweet. Be sure to being your ID- they'll turn you away at the door if you don't have it!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Pros: N/A

Cons: Probably best to enjoy a performance and skip the pricey tour. Tourist trap so tours are rushed. Don't get time to see the dressing rooms or enjoy being backstage. The most time allotted is taking of a photo onstage, which the option to purchase the photo.

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Love this bar!!...the staff is always friendly and they give locals a discount on drinks!!  They have Golden Tee and Darts and a huge screen TV upstairs for watching football.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Arrived and hostess appeared bothered by us to where I had to even ask if she worked there or was there someone who did that could help us. Waitress immediately gave off the vibe that she was completely annoyed to be at work and waiting on a bigger table. Did not write one thing down, so of course our order was messed up. Had to ask for rest of our food, napkins, silverware and drink refills. Food was not good, chicken was really dry and bland. For the price we paid I expected much better tasting food at least. BBQ sauce was delicious and we had to coat the food in it. She did take off drinks and extras we ordered from our final check, which was nice but not the point. We were able to pay for what we ordered and expected decent service and good food, none of which we received. After all this the catfish dinner ended up making me sick so the ending to a horrible visit. Nice place to take pictures and the live music was really good but that's it.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: The food was great, the music sounded fantastic and Amber was awesome!  We had shooters to start the night and had the catfish Creole / catfish poboy.  Amber made sure our souvenirs were wrapped up and secure and we never had to ask for refills or to remove plates.  The food came out fast and tasted great.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: The food was incredible. We have the chicken fried chicken and the ribs. We also started with the cat fish bites and some jambalaya. Everything was great. Emily our server was so helpful and welcoming. The music was great too. Highly recommend!!!

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text: If I could give this bar 0 stars I would. The bartenders were awesome but when the bouncers are completely rude and disrespectful than I have a problem so please do something about the bouncers or no one should go there. It seemed great at first but if they hire people like that than absolutely not. Do not go here. Nashville has so many more bars that will actually look after you.  Thank you, next.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
We just did the backstage tour with Lara.
Fantastic. hilarious. Full of life and energy. And that was just Lara. 
The tour is wonderful and you really feel like one of the family.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Bar servicw was horrible. The bartender was nice, he didnt notging wrong... but it was only him at the full bar trying to take everyone's order. I understand it was on a Wednesday but wait was uncomfortable. This will not stop me from visiting in the future. Just a suggestion

name: Third Man Records
text:
As a lover of small record stores and many artists on the Third Man label, Third Man is the tops. I wouldn't want the store to be any bigger or change a bit! I had fun playing with the mini guitars, monkey band and browsing the records. I purchased some stickers (huge sticker fan, here) and a tee shirt. 
I geeked out completely at Third Man and recommend it to anyone traveling near Nashville. Can't wait for Third Man's Detroit location!

name: Belcourt Taps
text:
It's possible this could be the shortest review I've ever written. It goes a little something like this...

Waited 30 minutes (no exaggeration) for 2 burgers with fries. 
Said burgers were -- in a word -- terrible. Ordered mine rare - ate it well done. Over seasoned, small, thrown together. I've made better meals in my Easy Bake Oven. 
Service: lackluster (and that's being nice). 

With amazing restaurants like Burger Up, Pharmacy and Lockeland Table in town...why why WHY would anyone eat here voluntarily?

name: Belcourt Taps
text: Good beer, good music, decent food, crappy service. Too bad; the music is impressive, but the food and the service just don't make it worth it. Save your money and your time.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
We were taken to BB King's for a night on the town during a corporate training meeting. Our group of 15 had a separate dining area to accommodate our party. 

We were all excited to let our hair down & hear some live music - even if we were at a tourist trap!! 

The night got off to a slow start. With only 1 waiter, it took quite a while just to get drinks ordered. And a few people never had orders taken! So when our waiter came back, we ordered apps & entrees all at once. We were on the company dime, so we ordered a smorgasbord of apps! Fried pickles ($5), catfish bites ($9), spinach dip ($9), crawfish poppers ($12), fried green tomatoes ($10), Gumbo Ya-Ya ($6-cup). The food arrived surprisingly fast - & there were several servers on hand to get the food on the tables! Now we're talkin'!! Everything was tasty - I think my #1 favorite was the catfish bites with remoulade sauce, followed by the Gumbo Ya-Ya - as a Mobilian who knows her gumbo, I didn't expect much - but this Gumbo Ya-Ya delivered y'all!!! It's so good!! Everyone loved it! It has the perfect consistency & perhaps more importantly, it has the heat factor we love!! 

For our meals, we again had a wide range, depending on how much or how little we gave a shit about trying to adhere to our diets pre-training....our choices run the gamut from Chicken/Ribs combo ($21), Bourbon Glazed Ribeye ($34), to Carolina BBQ Salmon ($26), Shrimp & Grits ($20), Chicken Fried Dinner ($15), BB's Pork Chop Dinner ($21), BB's Fork Tender Brisket ($21), Catfish poboy ($11), Hickory Burger ($13), Chopped BBQ pork platter ($15), Roasted Chicken Dinner ($16). 

I heard repeatedly the ribs were good, so if you're undecided, take it from the few meatzillas who were with us & get you some!! I didn't try the shrimp & grits which was disappointing because I wanted to try it! I heard it was good! 

I mainly focused on my dish - the Carolina BBQ salmon with creamed corn, andouille sausage, plump shrimp, & crispy onions. This dish proved to be a party in my mouth!! The fish was light, yet flavorful - the creamed corn was ok - missing something - but I loved the shrimp & sausage!! Awesome!!! Many people enjoyed mine :) 

And best of all, we couldn't get enough of the music!! The sang covers on songs like 'Proud Mary', Talking Heads, Chris Issacs, and many more! If we didn't have a Hummer limo outside waiting on us, we could've stayed for hours!

Thanks for the hospitality - even if it is in a kitschy tourist trap kinda way. We still embrace you. But we want a locals place next time. Thanks BBs for great food, fun & memories! :)

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
We just went to the Rat Pack show, yesterday, and this was our first visit to the Schermerhorn Sympony Center.  The outside of the venue was very nice, with a courtyard for sitting and a small cafe / bar, just inside the venue.  In addition, it looks like each level has the ability to have bar service, although they were not open, yesterday, likely due either to it being Sunday or the fact that it was a 3p show.  

There were a number of volunteers eager to assist us along the way, and even to suggest things to tour and see prior to the show, since we were there a few minutes early.  We had seats in the balcony, which were pretty comfortable seats / leg room, and we were able to see the stage and experience the show quite nicely.  It was a wonderful experience!  We also ate lunch at the Farm House, and used their valet parking to simplify our trip to the symphony as well as to enhance our overall experience!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Came in for a tropical drink to beat the heat. The service was solid. Live music playing downstairs when I was there was good. Stairwell to the second floor is painted like a piano and responds to you touching it. That was a cool touch

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: We love this brewery. Not only are all of their beers fabulous the food is amazing. Best burger in Nashville. It is a must!!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Typical Margaritaville. Slightly overpriced but dependable food and beverages. Good wait staff and the best guacamole ever!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
It's my own fault for coming in.  I mean, what was I expecting?  "Margaritaville".  Who the heck goes here when you're on music row in Nashville?  This idiot.  Revel in my tragedy.

Looking for a good beer?  Forget it.  Standard bud-lite garbage (you can salvage a Blue Moon out of the ordeal).  Good music?  Nope.  The guy (Dusty) was certainly personable and nice, but the selection (and I ended up seeing him play the next night and he was AWESOME) was super vanilla crap that you'd expect from a chain restaurant.  And, of course, they had to play "Margaritaville" while a guy on stilts danced around shaking a cardboard cutout of a salt shaker.  

The beers took so long to come out that we almost dipped out the large picture window (so as to avoid our dancing stilted friend), but I didn't feel like getting into trouble.  

Perhaps it wouldn't have been so bad had the entire experience not come with the opportunity cost of exploring another awesome bar in one of the nation's music capitals, but what can you do.  Well, you CAN just avoid this place, which I recommend.  If you're a tourist looking for a safe, generic, experience, here's your new haunt.

name: National Underground
text:
Bad customer service will always ruin a restaurant experience. My sister and I stopped in to The Underground for a morning snack during the CMA Fest going on in downtown Nashville. We wanted a mimosa or two and a bite to eat before the next concerts started, so at first we ordered waters, the unlimited mimosas for $20 per person, and an egg sandwich to split. 

We were given bottled waters - which we didn't realize we would get charged for, because who pays for water at a restaurant? We thought the bottles were just a friendly touch for festival attendees to be able to carry out with them, but our check let us know they were an unspoken up-charge. 

About halfway in to our first mimosa, we decided we actually just wanted the one drink each and asked our waitress to change our order in the system from bottomless to just one. She checked with her manager and told us that it wasn't possible to change the order. Having worked at restaurants, I know it is definitely possible to make a change like that to an order. 

The egg sandwich tasted good and was the only saving grace from the experience - until I went to the restroom and along the way saw the chef in the kitchen flipping fried eggs with his bare hands. 

When we were about to leave, it started pouring outside, and the manager was standing on the covered patio barking at pedestrians who wanted shelter from the 10-minute storm that they couldn't come in if they weren't paying customers. Amid that, my sister and I stood there waiting out the rain and I took out our water bottles that had been in my purse. The manager saw me and immediately started yelling at me that outside beverages were strictly not allowed in the restaurant because we might be carrying vodka or gin in the bottles. Thumbs up, guy; it's always a good idea to yell at your customers who just overpaid for watered down mimosas and had a below mediocre experience accusing them of sneaking in booze. 

Overall, worst restaurant I've been to in a very long time.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: Bridgestone Arena has crammed the adjustable seats so close it's painful.

name: Marathon Music Works
text: Overall the show was great and I liked the minimalism of the venue, but the security were pretty rude and overly aggressive.

name: Nashville Symphony
text: The Nashville symphony is well worth the money and is a Nashville institution that never receives the credit it is due. A fabulous way to spend the evening.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
It's five o'clock somewhere! Stopped by here just to shop but the bar looked so good we decided to take Jimmy Buffet's motto to heart. The shop is nice and has a lot of good stuff for parrot heads alike. 

The restaurant has really good food. Just about everything on the menu is eatable. The bar is what we came for. Lots of tropical drinks and beers for all to enjoy. Stop in to shop and drink if you are on Broadway!

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: I liked this pub a lot!! Fun bands, seating, good crowd, decent drinks.  Pop in while you're on the strip, take a listen to some bands and enjoy!  Great place for day drinking!

name: Ole Red
text:
We stopped in late on a Saturday night to check it out and the line wasn't too long to get in, so we headed in. It gets super packed downstairs and the bar line was really long so we scooted past that and headed upstairs which we found to be pretty empty on the second level. I would definitely bypass the downstairs bar and head upstairs and you can look over the balcony and watch the band. We headed up to the rooftop as well... it's a lot of stairs! The rooftop was beautiful and not super busy. You can see all of Broadway and across the river, and look at all the other bars that are jam packed with people and be happy you have some breathing room.

My only issue was the inconsistent pricing at this place. I ordered two shots at the second floor bar, two lemon drops, and the total was $22. When I went up to the 3rd floor, I ordered two more lemon drops and two Bud Lights and my total was $28. I was paying cash, so I feel like the guy pocketed a bit of that money, and they obviously don't give you a receipt. So I don't know if I would go back with the fear of being ripped off each time I went to the bar.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
Like the name suggests, there are wonderful margaritas available here! Also, I love Jimmy Buffett's song so it was awesome to be inside one of the locations. 

As soon as we sat at the bar, we were greeted by the Bartender and he promptly checked on us during our entire time at Margaritaville. 

We had the Margarita flight for $15.75, all the samples were delicious. I ended up drinking their frozen mango margarita with an extra shot, yum! They had live music the entire time we were there drinking. The ladies performing did a fabulous job, very talented! 

I purchased a margaritaville shirt that says "take life with a lime, salt and tequila" - love it! It was a little over priced $25 but I still got it haha. 

The bathrooms were clean which is always a plus. All in all, I had a wonderful time!

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: Not too crowded, great food, great decorations, tremendous live band, and fantastic food selections for people! I had the veggie burger - and then to watch a band play some "real" sounding country music was cool! Wait staff works pretty quick and also ID is checked at the door. Great time, I recommend it!

name: Ole Red
text: Bologna sandwich on trio is gross! Looks more like a prison sandwich (as I would imagine). Come on- get a little more creative!!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
Great staff. Solid beer selection. Croque Madame was outstanding. 

Out of the way but worth the trip.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: True country honky tonk dive bar. Cold beer and good music all day and night. Really liked all the license plates.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: The music was great, family friendly environment, good location.  Bowie was our wonderful server,  gave us advice on things to do with our 16yr old daughter.  We ordered the volcano nachos that can feed about 6 people. The only thing I would say could be better are the bathrooms.  Writings all over the walls, and the faucet falling apart. The whole place really could use some serious renovating. I guess what you may expect from more of a bar scene.  Nashville is growing at a rapid pace, construction is everywhere.  But businesses must be booming, We will definitely be back!

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: Wow! I never write reviews, good or bad, so imagine my frustration with this place to actually take time off my busy schedule to write a review.  The blond and brunette female bartenders were the rudest and most racist people I have ever met in my life. I am so disappointed at the way they treated our group.  We were a very diverse group with people of all backgrounds and based on how we were treated, one can deduce that if you're any other race than white, stay away from this place!!! It's awful being discriminated against even though you speak the same language as they do and were born and raised in this country, just like they were.  They lost our business and we will NEVER go back there because they don't deserve our business.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Just another Margaritaville.  A happy atmosphere and a selection of burgers and fish dishes. Only difference is that this is Nashville so expect music most of the day. Tonight I am listening to a duo called Triple Run. Drinks are good and the service is always very good. Not gourmet but good Americano food. Prices are on the high side, but, in line with all of the other establishments on Broadway strip. Of the many venues in this 2 block area, this location is a classy stop compared to the other bars. Not a bad stop for a drink and some laughs.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: I live in Nashville and for the "downtown scene" I think the Beer is cold, the music is great but the bartender with pigtails is always a turd. The prices are also never the same for the same 2 beers.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Skip this place. Nachos were NOT good. Prices are somewhat ridiculous for a tourist place when you compare the food and service. Get off this street and visit a local place with real food and better hospitality. Jimmy Buffett would be disappointed.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
I've been here several times for Predators games and have a blast every time! There's honestly not a bad seat in the house. There's $10 parking close by or if you're persistent or arrive early, you can usually find street parking depending on how popular the game is. And I just read there's free parking at the Nissan stadium?! Awesome!

On Thursdays, they have half-priced beers until the 1st intermission I believe. And if you're a pass holder, it's half-price for the whole game!

If you're seated in the Fan Zone area, there's a station that serves FREE popcorn, nachos, hot dogs, a rotating hot entree and soda. Unheard of bargain for a sports arena!

Seats can be small and the walk areas are NARROW. So plan accordingly if you're a klutz like me. (Hint: No high heels!)

Now, my one pet peeve is if you order your tickets online not directly through ticketmaster but through a third-party, they MUST be printed. You cannot use the online ticket to scan in. I've been turned away from a game before and had to run down Broadway to the nearest Kinko's just to print out my ticket. Lesson learned!

Overall, great venue and a great time!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: While visiting Nashville, my boyfriend and I got some tickets to a Predators game! Decent beer, great looking food (we ate before), and a fun, fun game! Great way to spend an evening in Nashville!

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: You have to stop by have some drinks and unwind to a good evening you have to stop by here good food good people good friends stop on my

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Awesome atmosphere and if you get a chance to se what's going on you will not be disappointed. They are doing something special here and worth a trip to whiteness history in the making!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
Very nice venue. Very clean. Nice staff. Here for a Predator's game. Lots of good food choices. Lots of alcohol choices. I wish they had not passed out those STUPID clapping sticks. Extremely annoying and rude. A pin would be really nice about now. The game is great and having fun despite the sticks. 
Scott Hamilton is here tonight. Fun to see a celebrity in the crowd. 
Definitely needed to dress warmer. Lol

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: This brewery is top notch. They have games upstairs (jenga, connect four, etc.) and a dart board room, which I imagine could get potentially dangerous in the hands of an aggressive person. Pints are $5 served up in a tulip glass. Brews are pretty good; IPA is my favorite. Definitely located in a somewhat shady area, but if you could get past that you're in for a real treat.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: 5 stars just for the courteous service by Adam who was running the front register. TBW is well worth the visit!

name: National Underground
text: If there was an option to leave 0 stars, I would select it. Absolutely terrible service. It took them 50 minutes to get my burger ready. I complained to the manager and he was very unapologetic. My friends ordered a quesadilla and fish and they were out of both. The food was good, but because of the awful service and the attitude of the manager the experience was my worst ever. I feel like they discriminated against us as well because of our young age (21). They treated the older people behind us a lot more kindly. I would not recommend this to anyone.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: Got drunk here and picked up a 10 ( two 5's).  The downside of this place is they got one pisser. My type of spot.

name: Ole Red
text: Great experience! Redneck Nachos are the bomb!  Great service, Destine was awesome.  I'm sure this place gets a little crazy in the evening, but we loved our experience on a Weds afternoon for an early dinner before heading to Memphis!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
If I had a nickel for every time I'd been to Bridgestone.. well, I'd probably only have like a dollar & a quarter, but you get what I'm saying. Bridgestone is a pretty nice arena. We used to come a lot for hockey games, not so much this year. Hockey is an entertaining sport to me because there's always something going on. Also, a drink will keep you warm in the arena, & who doesn't love a drink. More on their drinks later. 

We park in the "R" lot which is located across the river, next to the Titans stadium. They open the lot for events at Bridgestone. They've got a website with the dates it's open. A simple google search of "R lot Bridgestone" & you should find it. They run a shuttle that is 3 bucks a person (cash) but if you're cheap like me, you'll make the short walk across the pedestrian bridge to Bridgestone. 

We stopped in a few weeks ago for Amy Schumer. We had floor seats, which were located towards the back from the stage. Luckily, they had plenty of large screens & cameras on her. Speaking of cameras, if they say "no cell phones, no cameras" they mean it. I bet I counted like 25 people getting removed for trying to take pictures. Security is no joke. I had no issues with security except for when Amy was taking to a heckler they were trying to remove. One of the security officers came up quickly to my boyfriend who was on an aisle seat. We both thought he was getting onto us for something, but he was asking what was going on up front by the stage. Ummm, we don't know & we won't know now because he was talking to us about it. Don't they have walkie-talkies to figure that stuff out? 

Anyway, drinks are pricy. I wouldn't dare by more than one because I'd like to keep some money in my 401k. If you're smart like me, you'll have a couple drinks beforehand, or warm boots that allow for collapsible flasks. Oh I kid, I kid.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Love the vibe of this place - well decorated brewery with good beers and amazing food. Their 5 beer burger is one of the very best in town. However, I give this place 4 stars because of their food prices. $15 for a burger and fries at a brewery is very steep. The veggie burger is $18. Taking a few dollars off each food item would be perfect. I still go, but I have to "splurge" and plan on it. If it was a little more affordable, I would come much more often.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: A quality music venue to see some real honky tonk. I visited here several times on my trip after realizing some other places in the neighborhood aren't what they say they are. Layla's holds true.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
My fiancé and I like to travel to different hockey stadiums and this one impressed us because it was nicer, newer, and more spacious than a few others we've been to. I'm giving 5 starts just for the fact it was a memorable experience and a great overall weekend in Nashville. I got to see my buddy play against the predators and I loved the fact we could walk to the stadium since its in the heart of DT, no uber necessary. 

Great atmosphere as well but not better than the untied center.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Nice bar with live music and a cool gift shop right in the heart of Nashville.

name: Ole Red
text:
Atmosphere - ok
Food - not worth it.

Ordered fried chicken and pulled pork.

Everything was ok, looked like it sat under a salamander for too long.  Coleslaw smelled like the dumpsters you walk past when not walking Broadway.   Just not the best...

Would love to meet the executive chef and see him eat this coleslaw...  Disgusting...

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Decent experience, nice gift shop.  A definite tourist trap, very pricey weak drinks.  Didn't have a margarita, but probably should have, they did look good.  Service, average.  Female bartender borderline rude.  Not likely to stop back w/an option every two doors.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Nice place in the middle of abandoned buildings.  Interesting selection of beers.   Extra easy was the fav.  No food but gourmet popcorn for purchase.   Lots of seating and clean large restrooms.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: The best beer ever!!! Not just in nashville... The best beer I've ever had. I really fun location really close to Broadway there taproom is great you can get growlers from them. I recommend it to anyone visiting Nashville. I can't wait until I can buy in stores.

name: Nashville Symphony
text: I attended the Journey tribute.  I had an awesome time.  The singer was exceptional.  The symphony played well.  It was sad to see this wasn't a sell out event.  Come on Nashville!! Support your symphony!!! You be got a great asset here.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Best Brewery in Nashville. Haven't had a beer from here that I didn't like. My favorites are the Cutaway IPA and Southern Wit. Haven't tried out there food yet, but I heard it's awesome too. 2-1's on Wednesday's doesn't hurt either.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: So many places to choose this looked nice. Plus comfy air conditioning inside to escape unusual warmth for October. Good band playing at lunchtime. Nice menu, lots of options.. burgers, salad, famous fir their huge nachos platter. Sit near the front and hear the band or way in the back ( as we did) where it's cool and relaxing.  Ordered the taco salad and my husband had a chicken sandwich.  Taco salad is excellent! Chicken sandwich good too! Glad we stopped in

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: My wife and I went here on Thursday 6/26 while exploring downtown on our honeymoon. We were seated very quickly despite the place being extremely busy. Our server was excellent and very prompt. The atmosphere was very nice and the musician was very talented. Here's our problem. We ordered the Valcano nachos and the pretzels which alone came up to $23.00. I can understand that being a touristy restaurant and in a downtown area that the prices are going to be inflated but the real issue was that not long after we left and were heading back to our hotel we both became sick. We have to assume it was the nachos because I didn't have but 1 bite of the pretzels. Not only did we have to spend the whole evening/night in our room but it ruined plans that we had. Our total bill with the 2 appetizers and 2 teas came to $36.00. I'm not sure where the other charges came from but it definitely was too much money to spend to end up sick and miserable.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: I went there on a Saturday night and it was a seat yourself setup. I sat in the upstairs part of the restaurant. I ordered the wings and their menu sangria. BOTH WERE DELICIOUS! Hands down the best sangria I've ever had. They also had a live band playing and they were great! Our server was great too!

name: Ole Red
text:
Nice place to visit and staff was professional and friendly. Got seated quickly and place was clean. Drinks were cold and well made. However, food was sub par at best. 
No flavor to the coleslaw and the "Hot" chicken sandwich on biscuit was very disappointing. Not spicy in the least and the biscuit was dry and just fell apart. 
The only reason why I am giving it 2 stars and not one is the band they had playing last night was outstanding. Very difficult to carry on a conversation while they played but that was ok. We were even upstairs. 
Will go back, but not for the food.

name: Ole Red
text: I love Blake Shelton but, this bar is not typical Broadway.  We were disappointed because there's no where to listen to the band.  You have to sit at a table. Even upstairs you can't see the band.  So, people are just sitting there.  No one is getting into the music.  Boring. Then we walked past a messy ally full of garbage cans both times we visited it.  Disappointed.

name: Ole Red
text: Cool bar/restaurant, def a must. Destinie was a gem, wonderful server and made sure the busy day went as smoothly as possible. Long wait for food, under staffed but overall glad to have been abele to check it out!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: This is the worst arena i've ever been, come to la to see how to make an organisation, people are waiting standing for almost 3 hours now, and the show is in an hour, this place sucks,,,

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Excellent spot for beer! Been here a few times and it did not disappoint! Just wish they had more seasonal Christmasy beers

name: Ole Red
text: We spent opening day of Ole Red at the rooftop bar to kick off CMA Fest weekend. This was the perfect respite from the scorcher down below. We sat at the far corner of the bar where Sasha took fabulous care of us. We drank a variety of craft cocktails and draft beers. The oversized pretzel with cheese sauce and roasted carrots were delicious. We tried 3 of the Pickers drinks: Blood Orange was my favorite. The Blueberry & Lemon was way too tart and had to water it down with some soda water and ice. The Mule has a nice ginger flavor. One of the Pickers Reps even gave me a nice coozy to hold my drink. We really enjoyed our time at Ole Red.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Neat little brew pub, Natchez is a great beer. Not exactly a hardcore beer spot, more mainstream. I bet it's sweet in the summer.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Although I'm not a beer drinker, I really love this new hangout spot and the great atmosphere. I anticipate that summer will be hopping here. My husband really enjoyed the brews and our group enjoyed the board games at each table even more. Will definitely visit again!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: It all depends what you're looking for. If you're looking for a meal, don't recommend. The reviews we read were amazing, but not our experience. The service was terrible, and the food menu was limited and not appealing. The beer list is 'meh.' What is it with these pretentious places that charge $15 for a burger and have to have their own special "Basil Ryeman ketchup". We're going someplace else.

name: Ole Red
text: This atmosphere was so fun! We went for dinner and there was live music and the guy was wonderful. Pulled pork was not so good but cheeseburger was SO GOOD. Drinks were very tasty. I recommend this place is you're in town.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: I don't think I have ever had a more atrocious experience at a bar in Nashville than I have at Winners. Stevie, our female bartender, was an utter bitch. When we tried to ask her for food she was immediately irritated and refused to serve us. She continued to pass us by as we sat at the bar trying to get service. Her attitude was absolutely awful. I have never seen a more emotional, more inept bartender than this girl. Rather than serve customers, she would choose to greet her fiends instead, who were not here to stay. I would suggest that anybody considering this bar stay as far away as possible due to the level of incompetence held by the bartenders.

name: National Underground
text: Rude and slow service. Stay away! We went there on Thanksgiving day. It took about 20 minutes to catch the waitress to give our order. She simply ignored us as long as she could. After giving our order, we waited about 45 minutes to have our food. She didn't even bother to come and say sorry. She doesn't care if customers are happy. The place is on Broadway. It's convenient for people to stop by and grab some foods. That's why this place is still in business. I don't think people like to go there twice. Worst restaurant experience ever

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: This place was great for the alcoholic drinks, live music and service. Great location in the middle of broadway too. I should have gotten the cheeseburger in paradise - all three of my friends did and they loved them. I got the shrimp and grits and they were way too dry and tasteless. I prefer for the shrimp tails to be cut off and these were not.

name: Ole Red
text:
PERFECT!!   Perfect ambiance, perfect level of music, perfect service, food cooked perfect (we had a burger and Cobb salad, strongly recommend Cobb). 

We went there a second time in 4 days and nothing but perfect. COLD BEER, great staff attitude even at the opening bell of 11 am.

name: Ole Red
text: Enjoyed getting stuffed here last night! I ate way too much! The Redneck Nachos were great and the pork steak and potatoes were delicious. The wait staff were courteous and on the ball. Live band played great music. Seating on the main level is by reservation and was about an hour wait. Seating on the second level was first come first served. We were able to snag a table pretty quickly but as the night progressed it did seem to be a little more difficult.

name: Nashville Symphony
text: What a pleasant surprise. Nashville has a beautiful symphony hall. We saw the Music of Led Zeppelin with the symphony. What a fabulous experience! A must do in Nashville.

name: Ole Red
text: Terrible service and disorganization. wanted to visit this new Blake Shelton place while in Nashville. At 4pm we signed up for a table. Was told it would be a 45 minute wait even though there were many empty tables. After an hour of waiting and still not getting a table was told they had to wait for ok from kitchen.  Since we couldn't get answers from employees and we had been waiting for 90 minutes, We left. Disappointed

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Came in on a Wednesday for Bluegrass and beer.  Enjoyed a flight and a delicious and well planned cheese board.  Stayed for their BOGO specials and tasted almost everything they offered on tap.  Great atmosphere, fun vibe.  Excellent music.

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
We simply love going there for various presentations, but this past week we just had to go see The Music of Journey with the Symphony.  
Very cool and a great night!

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: Five stars for the band! The bar was super average with weak drinks. Music was rhe best part.

name: Ole Red
text: Interesting menu. Great fried Colliflower and Nachos were awesome. Drink selection was very good

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: Great Honkey Tonk on Broadway. Live music was great on a Tuesday night, the beer was cold the atmosphere was a room full of fun. So many options in the area... pop in and grab a drink!

name: Ole Red
text: He had a great sound system in the bar. I thought it was a bit to fancy/new meaning so clean. Did not eat there so not sure how food was

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: Purchased Jimmy Buffet tickets, then managed to break my femur in a skiing accident.  Tried to get some assistance re getting in and out of the venue and seating.  Told nothing could be done, but come the day of the show and they would accommodate.  Went as instructed. Told would have wheelchair available to transport from pickup spot to seats.  Arrived at the venue and was then told nothing available, sorry.  Looking for an ADA attorney in Nashville if anyone can make a recommendation.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: My husband and I had the best time yesterday afternoon, we had the quesadilla and a couple of beers and listened to some fantastic music!!! Thank you JJ for making our outing once a year downtown special!!!!

name: Marathon Music Works
text: This establishment assumed that five people that bought tickets for the concert of the night made people leave for being "intoxicated" when they had zero proof and didn't let the accused defend themselves when they paid good money to attend the concert that was proved at their venue. My group and I paid over 50 dollars to attend this concert and we were kicked out before we could even see the band. Marathon music works is rude and senseless to say the least. They don't care about the wellbeing of their attendees. I give zeros stars. They also called us stupid Jews which is very derogatory. I would not recommend.

name: Ole Red
text: Fancy place ... nice stage set up. Didn't get to hear the band though.... a very long break. Finally left but checked out all the floors that were more unique than any other bar we saw on Broadway.

name: Ole Red
text: First time here and had hair on 2 of our orders. One was on our order of chicken wings(pictured) and on the vegan quesadillas

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
Waited too long for our food. Not alot of vegetarian options. Server was nice though. 
Salad was smothered in too much cheese-like way too much. Couldn't eat very much of it. Waste of $$.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: The best thing about this place is all the outdoor seating. There's literally 3 levels of outdoor patio seating and the place is huge! There was live music right inside at the bar which was also cool. There's darts upstairs on the top level inside. The beer was meh - of the 5 we tasted there was only 2 I would actually order, 1 was okay, and 2 were undrinkable in my opinion. 4 stars because of the atmosphere and outdoor seating, otherwise it would be lower.

name: Marathon Music Works
text: My ID was laughed at by security for being "fake" and I don't really understand why. It's a valid Kentucky ID.

name: Ole Red
text: Food and service was excellent. Highly recommend after visiting multiple other places on Broadway where good service is not a thing they care about. But at Ole Red they do you right. And the biscuits - they are to die for!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: My friend and I had a horrible experience here. The chips and salsa were taken back twice because they were stale and tasted like thick stale uncooked taco shells. The 2nd time the waitress assured us the manager dolled out the next batch and they were the same yucky chips only these weren't warm. The margaritas are watered down and extremely pricey. I felt so giped that I couldn't wait to get out of there and find some place to get real food. We left starving and broke! The one star is for the location only. If I had Jimmy Buffets email I would tell him he needs to to get in there and sample some of that he would flip.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: "Always start a winner before ending up a loser"...aka start your night here before stumbling in next door to losers...always a good time! :)

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: One of the original Nashville Honky Tonks and still fabulous local, live musicians! I highly recommend you stop in and see a piece of Nashville history!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Visited Nashville for the weekend and heard some really good things about Brew Works so we stopped by - and I'm happy we did. Flights were $11 and each beer we sampled was great. Also got the wings which were amazing I would definitely recommend getting those as an appetizer. The inside is nice and theres a spacious seating area out front if the weather is nice.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Tammy Cook, our waitress, made this entire experience that much better.  Food was great, and can't beat the atmosphere!

name: 12th & Porter
text: Came here with a large group from out of town and rented out the entire place, paid for a DJ to perform, and an open bar all night. Staff was extremely rude to our group as a whole. Underage were allowed to enter the bar but were consistently followed around all night by staff members asking to see what they were drinking and checking for IDs even when only drinking soda. 21 and over were also harassed about their IDs repeatedly throughout the night and questioned even after they were checked at the door by a bouncer. Overall a terrible experience here and wouldn't recommend to anyone. If you cannot treat guests that paid thousands of dollars to rent out the entire place with respect, I'd hate to see how they treat normal guests.

name: Ole Red
text: The food was great and the music was wonderful! Only thing keeping it from 5 stars was that it took am hour to get our food. We chalk it up to the size of the crowd, being CMA Awards week.

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
Walking down to will call at the Schermerhorn, I felt like I was on the Titanic. Equally, wandering around the ornate hallways and even restrooms on our way to the orchestra level, I couldn't help but imagine that's exactly what it would have looked like when it flooded back in 2010.

It took me too long to get here but the symphony was really as beautiful as everyone said it was. Just gorgeous. The sound is also excellent. We saw Smokey Robinson which was a great experience. I love how they have pop acts in addition to traditional symphony performances such as Handel's Messiah. 

The balconies were stunning and I can't imagine there's a bad seat in the house. This is something anyone who lives in Nashville must do once (but you'll want to do it more) and is also great for tourists. Since the venue is in the heart of downtown, you could easily make a big night of it by going to the honky tonks in your dress clothes afterwards!

name: Ole Red
text:
This place has the best trash taco! The presentation is beautiful and ingredients are top
Notch ! 
Everywhere life music is present and all musicians are soooo talented. Needless to say great live music here. AJ is awesome musician and great vocals!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Well... what a disappointment. The drinks were very pleasing and did a good job buttt the problem ended up being the price of the salad I got. I have gone to Kroger and got lettuce and chicken for $5 and this establishment decided to charge me $16 for this nonsense. But other than that great place!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
Yo listen up, here's the story
About a little guy that lives in a blue world

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
From Florida  and looking for a mid-day snack and a drink on a busy day of sightseeing and shopping in Nashville.  We stopped at Margaritaville because it was a familiar name, and honestly some of the nearby places were so crowded and didn't look like they would pass their next health inspection!   This place had live music in the bar area and plenty of open seating so we came in to check it out.

There were five ladies in our group and we decided to order a few appetizers to share. We got the appetizer trio, an order of buffalo chicken wings, and a southwest salad with chicken and split them all up.  We asked our server for 5 sharing plates.  The salad was good & easy to split up.  The wings were meaty but they had  a little too much watery buffalo sauce on them.  As for the trio; the southwest egg rolls were a little over cooked, and the spinach dip, chips, and chicken tenders were just ok. 

We did enjoy our nice cold beers at a good price and our service was really good.   We weren't hungry or thirsty anymore and we left recharged for more shopping.

name: Ole Red
text:
In town for a Volleyball tournament with my daughter. Didn't check any reviews so we did not have any type of expectations. Started with the skillet cornbread. Delicious! 

The pulled pork bbq sandwich was our main dish. Really tasty...the sauce had a slight kick and nothing too overpowering. Good flavor and ample portions as me and my daughter split the sandwich and cornbread. We didn't finish everything and had plenty to eat.

The artist signing was pleasant and easy listening. Good voice and good start to the day. (Sophia Bollman)

name: Ole Red
text: This place is great. Great service, good food and love the live music. Drinks were very good and made well. Not overpowered by the alcohol, which I dislike so I appreciated that a lot. Check them out!!!

name: National Underground
text: I'd give this place no stars if possible. They sat us, said there's no tap water here (what???) and food has taken 30+ minutes to arrive (still not here). When we were ordering drinks they said they had no menu. When asked what beers they have, they said only "everything domestic" and we basically played a game with guessing which beers they actually had. Garbage service, garbage place. Probably only exists because it's next to Acme which is popular with a line.

name: Ole Red
text: Table right by the stage! Nice! The bands here are a step up from some smaller bars. The food, not so much. It was a lot, but just okay tasting. I had the smoked chicken quesadillas. They didn't taste smoked. There was a lot of food, but it was dark meat and I bit into cartilage- yuck. I also ordered the tater tots- mushy. But overall an okay experience. Nice roof top bar & view.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
Augh, gosh. I WANTED to like this place so bad.

My friend and I came here for a couple of beers and to enjoy some music. Lo and behold, the band playing was from Austin, TX! Nice to see some Texans, what with the states' common ground with their love of country music and all. They did a great job.

I had two beers, none of which were impressive to me, and split the burger with my friend. Unfortunately, both the burger and fries were just way too salty for us to enjoy. We were even brushing salt off the bun! I'm sure that was some sort of culinary decision, just not one I necessarily agree with.

Walk the Lime: Good, but I've definitely had better. 
1927: You know, even though IPAs aren't my cuppa, I thought I had developed an appreciation for them. I feel like this undid all of that. :( Sorry, TN. TX takes my Craft Beer Award.

On the other hand, the staff was remarkably wonderful and friendly, and even though I didn't like the beer they suggested, I appreciated their input/opinions anyway.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
I recently visited Nashville to see Counting Crows and Matchbox Twenty at Bridgestone. The concert was great, but the seats were AWFUL! I was section 328, row A, my view was fine. The seat itself was the issue. 

For reference, I am a size 14 pant and am 5'7" tall. Pretty average really. I did not fit in the seat. I literally sat sideways in my seat just to fit. It was an issue for almost everyone around me. I left with very sore hips and thighs, from them being pinched under the cup holders that are attached to the arms.  Woke up the next morning with fairly bruised hips and legs. Seats were right around a foot, I measured.

Seems like normal people should fit into their seats when they pay to go to a concert, but what do I know?

name: Ole Red
text: This is a cool place. Aaron was very helpful. Looking forward to coming back. The live music was cool!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
Leila is a great server. She suggested a few items to try and each was delightful. Leila was pleasant, effective,efficient  and a true hospitality artisan.

The restaurant was not perfect. Very loud and the non-stop begging by the band for tips was off putting and offensive;Play a 3 minute song, 4 minutes of begging, play another song, repeat. The non-stop begging is reson alone not to go back. If you offer entertainment they should just entertain. Beggars should be on street corners not on restaurant stages.

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
I feel blessed to be able to live in a city that hosts such amazing talent and outstanding venues to enjoy that talent in! The Schermerhorn Symphony Center while aesthetically beautiful, also has the best acoustics I've ever experienced. No detail was left out of the design of this space and you can definitely tell. I've been privileged to enjoy several concerts here and each one was breathtaking. It's sometimes hard not to want to fall asleep when the music is lulling you that way! 

There honestly isn't a bad seat in the house as far as being able to hear the music. There are a couple places I wouldn't want to sit just for being able to see. I haven't had the opportunity to partake in any of the other amenities of the Center. I will say that I've had friends show up about a half hour before a show to get tickets that are being sold at a discount. If it isn't sold out, they want to sell the remaining tickets! Just a little tidbit for ya.

name: Ole Red
text: The entertainment and ambiance was the only good memory of this place. We thought with the long lines that this place had to be a good place to eat. Sadly, we were wrong. The best part of the meal was the fried pickles we had for an appetizer. My husband ordered "The Champagne of Fried Chicken, which was fried chicken and biscuits and gravy. I sampled his and agreed with him that the only good part was the gravy. The chicken was very spicy and soaked in grease. We are southern people and love our fried foods, but just a few bites made our stomachs start hurting. I ordered the "Nashville Hot Chicken Biscuit" after the waitress said that was her favorite thing on the menu. It is fried chicken on a large biscuit with cole slaw and bread and butter pickles with your choice of tater tots or french fries. The tater tots were terrible, and my chicken was just as greasy as my husband's chicken. I ended up eating the biscuit off my sandwich dipped in my husband's gravy and the bread and butter pickles. Needless to say, the food left a lot to be desired, and we left hungry.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
Both times I have been to Nashville, I have wound up at this bar.  Once cause it wasn't busy and the other so my aunt could see a Sirius XM show.  Honestly I cannot get a handle on this place. The service is either attentive or sluggish.  Drinks can be good or bland.  I'm guessing everything just depends on the day and time you go.  

Good luck

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
This place is awesome, the service is excellent, the food is great and... oh, the beer, yeah that's pretty fantastic as well! The staff went above and beyond to ensure my out of town guests and I were well taken care of and had the opportunity to try every beer available. 

From light Pilsner style beers to big heavy porters, this place has a beer for every type of beer lover and had some great food to satisfy your appetite.

The staff made sure to treat us right and also let us go home with a few growlers of things we loved that weren't even on the board, I highly recommend this place to beer novices, and connoisseurs alike! Happy beer tasting! :)

name: Marathon Music Works
text: My husband and I drove 2.5 hours to see Miike Snow at this venue. We were excited to hear their dance music live, and anticipated a great night. However, the sound mixing made for a disappointing show. The bass overwhelmed the rest of the music, and this was the case for all 3 bands that night. We thought they'd fix it by the time MS came on, but no such luck. Despite the good lineups the place gets, we will not be spending the money on a hotel, dinner and a show at MMW unless we learn that the sound quality has improved. The staff were nice, the bathrooms clean, good drinks, yada yada yada- but people come for the music, first and foremost. If that's compromised, the whole venture falls flat.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Drinks are always great. The live music was good too. I personally think their food isn't that great. It doesn't have much flavor to it. For the same price you can go somewhere in Nashville that isn't everywhere else in the country. Our server was a sweetie though!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
The Bridgestone Arena is the home to the Nashville Predators and the CMA Awards. 

All year long they have many musical and theatrical events all of which are top notch.

I attend The Nashville Predator hockey games more than anything else at this venue and they do a top notch job as the home of the Predators.

If you get the chance, attend an event at The Bridgestone Arena, you will not be sorry.

name: Ole Red
text: We stopped into this place after being recommended and we went upstairs because the downstairs was too packed and we literally went up to the hostess and she didn't even acknowledge us she just stood there talking to her coworker so we walked away and went to the bar and after not being acknowledged by the bartender either I went up to the girl and asked her if there was a table for two and she goes no it's a two hour wait and walked away. How rude! There were literally so many open tables I couldn't believe it. Really wanted to eat here. Oh well lost our business

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: The service in the restaurant was great and the food was really good. It's a little on the pricey side, but the atmosphere was great. Went to music row happy hour after we ate.

name: Ole Red
text: Great place, it's in downtown so it's a stop for everyone. At least drop in and have a drink if you don't eat here.

name: Ole Red
text: I loved the upstairs, great drinks and food. The main floor food was mediocre at best, beer was warm and in plastic cups. Great for walking through but not for a meal

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
We had the best time tonight . We were there for music row happy hour and decided to go early so we could taste the food . We got Paradise  burgers single and double meat . The burgers were delicious and tasty.
We waited for a few mins to get our drinks but we understood they were a bit busy but Katlyn one of the supervisors made sure we were taken care of as well as our server Justin. We had a great experience!

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
My husband and I went to a performance of the Harry Potter music, live with the movie playing on a screen.  It was outstanding!

I was incredibly impressed by how well the orchestra played - there were times I even forgot the music was live; that's how seamless the performance was!  Excellent musicians, beautiful venue, and very interesting performances.  Perfect option for date night, to share with friends and family, or even as an introduction to music for kids!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: The food is great !! The drinks are fabulous but most of all...Our server Andrew Davis rocks !! He made our visit great !!

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: The second worst experience I have had at a restaurant- the first was at this same place - signs indicating its Ok  to park if you are going to either losers or winners - I was going to winners (where I have been going for years and about 3x a week) but not anymore- I park where the signs indicate it is OK to park and let the front door man know if there is an issue please let me know he replies not a problem at all and I am halfway through my lunch when some jack ass comes over and asked if that was my truck which I replied yes and he says you parked in the wrooooooooooong spot - incredibly sarcastically and aggressive I would caution anyone attending to be aware of the shady security people!!

name: Ole Red
text: Five stars for fun! Definitely coming back soon for dinner! Our friends go on and on about the food here but unfortunately they were too busy. We'll be back! The band was great! Visiting Nashville? Must add this one to your places to go! Highly recommend!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
We were enjoying the Music City Brewers Festival and visited the Tennessee Brew Works tent. As a craft beer lover I had tried Basil Ryman before and wanted to meet the people involved in its birth. The place was a buzz of activity, pun intended, and we met McKenzie. A great kid from Texas who works for the brewery and really believes in the place and it's owners. She spoke to us about the brewery, it's beer and the people who work there being the best of the best. We were impressed. I asked her about the swag and how I could acquire a shirt. I made a deal with her that I would put a very truthful review on Yelp if she could get me a shirt. She agreed but we would have to go to the brewery to get it. 
      After the festival we walked the .9 miles to the brewery. It's a great place with an industrial feel. I ordered the flight and we sat outside on the upper deck. The beer here is the real deal and the atmosphere was friendly and family like. 
     Mckenzie took some time to sit and talk with us, hooked us up with shirts and in the end got us a ride by using the Lyft app. All and all a great day that ended with some great beer and a meeting with some of the nicest people you could ever ask for. This place is a definite "have too" spot when we go to Nashville.

name: Ole Red
text: Sat on the rooftop here, Friday around 5:30 pm.  Managed to snag a high top table within viewing of the music stage.  Beautiful rooftop, loved the atmosphere and the decor.  We ordered nachos and wings, excellent food, service a little slow, but hey it was ok, we were on vacation.  Total time from ordering to serving was an hour, we enjoyed the music while waiting. would definitely come back!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: One star just so that I can write a review . 30 min wait to be seated which was totally acceptable ... we were sat at our table with only 2 menus to share for our party of 7 ok I'll share no big deal. Ordered our food and 45 mins later no server no update and no food .. server dropped off silverware and 3 napkins for all of our place settings ok maybe she's busy no refill on drinks or water . A member of our party actually got up to get a pitcher of water to refill for our party . Our sever finally stopped the table to let us know the food would be out shortly didn't communicate didn't apologize . 30 mins later one hour and fifteen minutes after we placed our order and we were told the kitchen printer was down and had no idea when our food would be out . Communication is key and if she had kept us informed we would have been more understanding . We got up and left , no food and still hungry . The manager was no help at all as she seemed to be unaware of what was going on . The worst experience ever !!!!!

name: Ole Red
text:
We have been to Ole Red several times. All during CMA Fest, so you can only imagine how busy it is. Our first trip into Ole Red was for a meal. The food was okay...which was disappointing because it was expensive. We ate on the rooftop, which was the high point of that visit. It has an amazing view of all of Broadway. There is plenty of seating and two bars on the rooftop.

Our other visits have been to trying to get into free events at Ole Red. There will be a long line of get in. Sometimes it wraps around the building. Don't let this defeat you. It will be worth the wait. We waited for two and half hours (with the line starting at the Lookout wrapping all the way around to Whiskey Bent) to see Chris Young. Once we got in we moved to the side of the bar with the gift shop stuff. We were three people back from the stage. It is a very up close and personal venue. We have waited for three shows like this. Each one was worth it. 

Insider tip: if you are there for a show and they are making people go in the Lookout entrance. Once you get inside the downstairs area make your way over to the gift shop area. It's less congested and you can get really close to the stage. People don't move over there for some reason.

name: Ole Red
text: This is probably the worse bar I have ever been to, which is bad since I frequently travel. The bar was severely overcrowded. They blocked the exits & only allowed you to exit through the entrance door. This was not only inconvenient, but also extremely unsafe. My friends & I had to push through a crowd full of intoxicated people, which was almost impossible & very unpleasant. To top that off, the bartender was rude & threatened to throw out my drink because I turned by back on my drink while someone asked me something. I understand her concern, but maybe letting me know to be more cautious instead of telling me you are gonna throw out my drink would have come across a little better. I will not be returning here nor would I recommend it.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: I don't do reviews very often and when I do it is for a reason. This place is great from the beer, food and entertainment. The food is amazing. My daughter had the fish tacos and they were great. Then me and my wife split and shared the pulled pork sandwich and the grilled cheese. The pulled pork sandwich was excellent. The grilled cheese blew my mind and is probably my favorite meal on this trip so far.

name: Ole Red
text: My boyfriend and I were celebrating my birthday in Nashville and came across Blake Sheltons bar on Broadway. We love Blake!! Hate his bar... the bartenders were very rude. We had been drinking all day down Broadway (responsibly of course) and we did get drinks at Ole Red, but we like to drink some water between drinks. Not only did we get declined by a female bartender first, but when we asked a male bartender also working that night  thinking she may have just forgotten... he too ignored our request!! Absolutely ridiculous. If we are spending money there, there should be no reason we cannot order water especially when they are not busy at all!! We will not be going back, but we will continue to listen to Blake's music, that's it. (FYI, we did tip on our drinks we ordered too)

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
I have been to many Margaritaville restaurants.  My husband is obsessed.  But this location needs to have major improvement.  We stopped by and a portion of the ceiling near the bar had leaked pretty bad.  It was closed off.  The sign in the dinning area had letters that were out.  

Had the fish tacos.  It was terrible.  Overcooked to the point it felt like I was eating cardboard.  The rice and beans had absolutely no flavor.  The food was pretty bad.  

The bartenders were good.  They kept with the crowd and were very efficient.  The entertainment was good too.  Loving the talented, unknown artists. 

I would stop by for a drink and to listen to the music, but I won't order food at this establishment.

name: The Night Owl
text: Our band was invited to play at The Night Owl and I have to say I was surprised. It's a well designed space (on the small side but well laid out with plenty of seating and entertainment), regular live music, and friendly and attentive staff. Look, I'm no expert on this area of Nolensville Road-area Antioch, but there's no other watering hole I would send friends in the area.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
If you haven't been to Bridgestone Arena and you live in Nashville, then what is stopping you? This arena is the hub for concerts, Preds games, and other miscellaneous events (my friend is a fan of the monster truck show they do there...bless her heart). This stadium is located in downtown Nashville on Broadway, making it highly accessible and an easy place to plan other things after a night there. The arena is clean, has friendly staff, good food/drink options and decent prices. They have plenty of restrooms and they are well-kept. 

My favorite occasion to visit Bridgestone is definitely for hockey to see the Predators. Since the Preds made it to the Stanley Cup final last season tickets have gone up but there are still some chances to get reasonable prices occasionally to games. Other than for hockey I've been to see a Randy Travis tribute concert which featured Garth Brooks, Allison Kraus, Wynonna, Josh Turner, etc. This event was fabulous, one of the best concerts I've ever been to. 

As far as venues go, Bridgestone is one of my favorite I've been to and I will continue to keep coming back! Whether you are a tourist visiting Nashville or a local, Bridgestone is a must.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
