text: Reasonably priced drinks in a lively casual atmosphere. Constant great live music. You may difficulty finding a chair.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: The slowest food ever.........  and then the food showed up...... fucking awful. Avoid at all cost. Shitshow!

name: Ole Red
text: Took my 13 year old daughter who is a avid guitar player. The atmosphere, live music and food is great. The service on a Wednesday night was awesome for a touristy place in the touristy part of Nashville. It was all great until we walked 2 steps out the door. My daughter forgot to get a couple of Ole Red stickers for her guitar case so we turned around and proceeded back inside and the guy working the door was a complete A-hole.. he told us she (my daughter) was not allowed inside. I told him we walked out less then 30 seconds prior. I wasn't total douche but I did express my displeasure in his warped logic. In a total dick move he told me that "after 9, NO ONE was getting inside without getting past him first." I was like, Really? I pulled out my Texas ID which turned out to be my license to Carry which looks identical to a Texas drivers license. Either way it is a valid a form of ID which Tennessee recognizes. He became an even bigger Dick and told me that he wasn't accepting my license to carry(mind you, the age to own one is 21). I said my mistake, and pulled out my actual ID. After 5 minutes of this douche stroking his own ego didn't impress me. I finally got back inside and bought all of $5 worth of stickers located 5 feet inside the front door. Tool 3 minutes to complete. We had a good time but because of a sawed off little egotistical douche with a bad attitude who happens to be as wide as he is tall, kind of out a damper on it the fun. All in all, we had fun but they need to remind their security that they are not guarding a lowlife establishment and to use common sense when needed.

name: Ole Red
text: Came in early afternoon on cold day. Hoping for Irish coffee... they were out of coffee. Otherwise service was prompt and friendly. Food looked really good with generous portions. Less hipster vibe and menu than Luke's place across the street. The sound system was better here too and the band was good. Overall, a good experience.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text:
First time coming! 

First walking in felt like a winner, especially getting two adult caprison drinks! 

After trying to give with the band I couldn't handle one more second in this bar, definitely did not feel like winner.

name: Ole Red
text:
Alright, first just take a moment to look up and listen to the song this place is named after. It is every country song rolled into one; love, love gone bad, prison, and a hunting dog. At least then the wall of bottle caps that make a face of a dog will make more sense when you visit. This place is country, but it is a upscale side of country. You find that out immediately when you walk in the front door. The stage has a massive screen behind it with the artist's name on the bottom half and a live feed on the top half. LED lights are in full effect and the sound is crystal clear. There's a dance floor in front of it and a full bar behind the tables. It is top shelf. If you look up, you will see there's a balcony on the second floor so they can listen in as well. 
     The elevator will get you to the rooftop bar and seating area. Now realize that you are atop a four story building. The view of the city and a glimpse of the bridges await you. They have it setup where dining is inside, the bar is outside and there are stools facing out along the edges. When I looked at the bar list, I was impressed. Every category (but especially whiskey and bourbon) had great offerings. Of course you have cocktails as well. I will mention that quality comes with a price, which is reflected on the cost. So just be aware.
     The place has a gift shop as well as private rooms for dining and large groups. Although there is no Blake Shelton sighting (it's his restaurant), the artist on stage was working the crowd and singing "I got friends in low places". My night was made right then and there. I will be back.


*Insider's Tip
-Just head to the roof. Unless the band playing is one you really want to see, get your food and drinks up top. Same selections and far better view. Also, you can do reservations via their website.

name: Ole Red
text:
The Spotify House at Ole Red during CMA Fest this weekend has been INSANE! Being a Nashville local, I'm so excited to check this bar out on a "regular" weekend. 

Obviously they won't have headline names playing during a regular weekend, but the stage area is such a great concept for live music. Intimate and close with the band, maybe 200 or 300 people packed in for people like Old Dominion, Cassadee Pope and Brantley Gilbert.

Can't review the food cause I didn't eat here, but the beer was a good deal (16 oz PBR for $5) and the place was very clean especially given the amount of traffic they had coming in and out during CMA Fest!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: We were there for a birthday party and Soulshine leaves a lot to be desired. The drink prices are not wonderful, there is no way to carry on any fluid conversation because its way too loud even before the life music starts, the servers are not great (we even saw one eating chips on the floor), the bathrooms were dirty in a way that is not just busy restaurant dirty but neglected deep cleaning dirty... The worst part by far is the food. Our pretty large group ordered several pizzas none of which my wife or I partook in. We had pizza at an office event earlier in the day so we decided to share nachos and a small cup of Red Beans and Rice- huge mistake! The chips were just flour tortillas that had been thrown in the deep fat fryer so they were super greasy. The chicken was dry and tasteless and the whole thing had been sat under the broiler for way too long. It should be a crime for them to serve "red beans and rice"! They we terrible!!! Nothing like NOLA, hell Nothing like Popeyes! Adding insult to injury we have both had miserable stomach aches ever since we ate! We grabbed an Uber and headed home instead of continuing on with the rest of the group!!!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: If you're looking for a place to wear your boots and learn some line dances, this is the place to go! They do lessons very frequently where you could learn 3-4 dances in a night. Music was ok, nothing special.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Nothing special bbq. Sauces are pre-made and purchased. One for sure is "sweet baby rays" , the jug was sitting out. I expect a bbq place to make their own sauces. Onion rings were poor. Ribs were ok but my wifes are better. Service was average to below average.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Came to this place looking for some good BBQ and found it! Had the pulled chicken and it was so juicy! The server was very helpful and friendly. Will definitely come back when I'm back in Nashville.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: We visited on a Tuesday around 4:30pm. The place was empty except for us and another couple (at the bar). Our waiter greeted us and didn't return for a while. He was busy chatting up the other staff members. It was cold inside so we decided to move outside. Our new waitress was wonderful. She was really stationed inside but couldn't have been more attentive to us. The pizza was ok. Probably wouldn't return here.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Not the best BBQ or southern flavor, but this is a definitely a taste of Nashville vibes with country moods and charm. We got the stack of ribs and some local beer. It was open seating for the Saturday night we went, but we managed to get a chair on the band side, close to the bar. The back was loud, crowded, and chock full of semi-drunk men playing with the boxing game. It was difficult to enjoy the music, or even a conversation with my boyfriend nonetheless. Overall, touristy spot, nothing more, nothing less.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: We had a great waiter! He allowed us to have a nice long dinner without rushing us. We ordered the hot fried chicken, sweet tea pork sandwich, baked beans, mac & cheese and chocolate mousse cake. The music was good. It's a fun place for sure.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
Came here on a Sunday night to experience a live band, line dancing, and ate some snacks. We went to one of the booths on the side, since my mom was worried it'll get too loud in front. Since no servers were serving our tables, we had to go to the bar to order food/drinks. No big deal, we knew ahead of time. We ordered a couple drinks, elephant ear ($7) and fries ($7). When the food came, the portions of the food were a bit smaller than I thought it'll be, but since we were there for entertainment (live band), we stuck around and listen for about an hour. Great for large groups and for big events. Can host big parties if needed. 

TIPS: They have lessons on line dancing at 5pm and 6pm, and a live band plays at 6:30pm. Free cover if you come before 6pm, and if it doesn't get busy they'll keep it free for the rest of the night.

name: Nashville Palace
text: Great energy here. Good service, food was good (fried catfish, Swiss mushroom burger & onion rings) & good live country music. Friendly patrons & staff.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Was told to sit wherever, which is fine by me, but then had no one come serve us for 15 minutes. Disappointed, went to talk with someone at the front counter, and was rudely told the issue "was not our problem" by staffing.

name: Nashville Palace
text:
I took my out of town relatives to this place because of the positive reviews, what a big mistake.  The food was fair at the best, the hamburger buns were cold, like they had just come out of the refrigerator.  The chicken wings were very tough and tasted like they had been over cooked in old grease.  There was only one women tending the bar and waiting the tables, I saw two groups leave because they could not get service.  Worst of all was the live entertainment, a solo guitar player/singer that could not carry a tune.  I was embarrassed I took company to this dive.  I would give it a zero star if I could.

Update. I just realized I had received a reply from the manager five months ago apologizing and inviting me to give them another chance. That was a welcome response from someone that seems to care about making things better. I have not been back since my low rating but due to the response I received, I will go back. Maybe this was just a bad day of circumstances

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: What a fun place! We stopped in here just to check it out while we were walking around Nashville. The atmosphere is great, and the decor is very unique. We didn't order anything, so we will definitely need to do that next time we are here. It is a fun place to dance and hang out, but is a fun stop for families too. When saw several people with there children eating and dancing while we were there. I'm glad we stopped in to check out this very popular Nashville destination, and I can't wait to go back and experience some of the food the next time we are in town!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: We stopped in after hockey game and at first was happy with environment the front staff was great and restroom employee was super nice. I noticed the staircase and was curious. I asked the female employee who was sitting by the stairs what was up there. I had no idea what she said she mumbled so fast and went back to her texting or game whatever she was doing. I told my husband i had no idea what she said and she immediatly stood up and screemed at me that i called her a bit*ch!!! She said something else to me but i was so shocked i was still processing what was happening then she put both hands on me like she was going to shove me! I yelled at her that she assaulted me and where do i find manager but she immediatly shouted at doorman to get me out of there! Two big big men walked me out. This was unbelievable! So i suggest you skip this place and go down the strip where bars are more friendly i ended up having a blast in nashville other than this one woman everyone else was very welcoming to this hoosier!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
On the corner of 5th and broadway. Nice location with several floors.  This location tells you exactly what you should expect, a party.  

The drinks come in plastic cups and food in a basket.  Don't get me wrong food in a basket is food and it is useful to indicate expectations in a restaurant.  This is more of a bar that serves food as opposed to a restaurant.  

It's a fun atmosphere and the food is pretty good.  It has flavor and much potential.  Just hard to get past the food is made and prepared in bulk and thus not served hot.  

Had the ribs, whole rack, brisket, chicken dinner, and all the sides.  The baked beans were nice.  The Mac and cheese tolerable.  

Overall, good location for drinking beers with a large crowd and eating at tables is the back while
Listening to music with poor acoustics.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Such a fun time. Good BBQ and healthy pours at the bar. Fall off of the bone ribs. Beans were excellent. Cole slaw could use some taste. Music was great and line dancing lessons were fun. Have someone try the whipped cream shot at the bar.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Good music. Seemed best band was on the main floor. Tons of seating. Drafts 6$. Didn't order food.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Top notch!

Ribs were awesome, waiter was great and the music was perfect!!!!

Highly recommended

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
Hey again yelpers!

Wildhorse Saloon. A place to eat, drink, play games, and be merry and it certainly can achieve all those things so long as you've got the patience to put up with the service. Brace yourselves, it's a bit of a long-winded (but always honest!) review. tl;dr at bottom.

When I think of Wildhorse Saloon, images of line-dancing and loud, live music come to mind and it lives up to that image it tries to achieve but honestly, I would not go here to eat a sit-down meal and there is where my brief and slightly frustrating tale begins...

While I was waiting for my friends to meet me a while later I decided to grab an Angry Orchard hard cider and relax on the second floor to watch people play a few games of pool. Much to my distaste, the game room was overtaken by a group of immature, rowdy children. I understand that kids will be kids but their parents really should've controlled them more as they were being aggressive with Wildhorse property such as banging pool cues together as if they were swords or climbing on top of the pool tables to make a shot or spilling their Shirley Temples over the furniture without regard to where they were. I mostly blame the parents but the wait staff did nothing to minimise their exuberance and how they might be preventing other patrons from enjoying their visit.

Once my friends arrived we were able to move to a proper table (now that they weren't still taken). We had to actually get up and walk over to the bar to ask someone to service us. I get it though, I understand that this is hardly a place one would normally go to have a sit-down meal but really now.. Once we finally got our menus, it was about 30 to 45 mins to actually get our food and drinks and when it came time to pay, the server actually lost my debit card! I get that accidents happen but for things like that, servers should really take extra care when handling them.

All in all the best part about my stay was the Angry Orchard, the billiards, and the company of my friends.

Happy yelping!

tl;dr --} The food wasn't that great for the price you'd pay, the time it takes for anyone to visit your table to take orders is ridiculous, and the staff have little regard for proper healthy practises for a food and beverage environment. Only go here to drink, dance, and listen to music (really really loud music) and little else.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: I've never been a huge fan of bbq but then I went to Rippy's with some friends. The service was okay, but the food was phenomenal. The portions were HUGE but you wanted to keep eating. I went two separate times and got the pulled pork plate and the chicken tenders. Each time I got potato salad and baked beans as a side. The live music is phenomenal and there are great views over looking broadway. You will not be disappointed if you go to Rippys. You will leave full and ready to come back again!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Food is good. Great selection of non pizza appetizers and meals. Staff is friendly and helpful. Parking can be hard to find.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Went here with my entire family for spring break. We arrived during lunch hours and got to our seats fairly fast. The service was excellent as well as the good. Our server was fantastic and kept our drinks full. We will be back!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
Didn't eat here but the small pizzas walking by looked tasty. We went upstairs to check out some live music on a Saturday night. The place wasn't packed so you could actually sit down and hang out enjoying the band. The bands everywhere we went were pretty good but band last Sat was a cut above.

What we all really loved was our bartender Tiffany. She kept the drinks coming, was very nice to talk to, and even offered us a free pizza that came out as a mistake. We had just had an amazing and very large dinner just before arriving so we passed but it's the thought that counts. Thanks Tiffany!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: When on vacation I don't like to go to the same place twice. But we got an appetizer one day and ate dinner another night. It amazes me how you can cram so many people into one place and still have good service. Food was good and they had entertainment on all 3 floors.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
Let me start with the bathroom lady Barbara, she was so sweet and attending. I didn't have singles to tip her, so I had to back to the bar to get change. She was an absolute sweetheart! 
The place was pretty empty for a Saturday night. They had a really good band playing called the Broseph E Lee, who had a pretty good crowd dancing. 
The beers were $6 which is not so bad. Everyone seemed so friendly and fun. It was a good time. Plus, they had these horses around the place that look pretty cool.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Went to wild horse for a bachelorette party with 14 girls. The doormen were so rude we should have left. All we wanted was to eat dinner, so the $6 cover seemed a little rediculous just to pay to eat. Food was good, but our server took the bill and divided it by 3 without our consent and made it very difficult to split up the check. Line dancing was ok, but the band was on break the bulk of the time we were there and the concert announcements on the big screens were severely outdated. The line dance teachers also pushed the gift shop real hard, making wild horse saloon feel like even more of a tourist trap. We won't be back.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Great place on 2nd Avenue.  Very large wide open place with a large dance floor.  Service and food was good.  This place had a wide variety of folks from younger families to young groups and older folks as well. The band the night we were there was more rock than country so we didn't stay very long.  This is a great alternative to all the places on Broadway that cater to a young crowd looking to simply get very drunk.  I'd go again.

name: Tennessee Performing Arts Center
text: One of the nicest venue's in Nashville.  Very comfortable seating.  Excellent sound.  Would go as much as we could.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: (6/23/2014)  Did the honky tonk crawl while visiting town for a conference (yes, we were tourists).  Stopped into Rippy's, were enticed by the open patio on the top level.  Did not eat here, but did get some drinks and hang out a bit.  Top level had a decent set of two guys with two guitars, singer/songwriter stuff.  Ventured downstairs to the street level bar to listen to an ear-splitting, very bad cover of "Free Bird."  Drinks were a little pricey, mostly offered rail/well or cheap brands.  Did enjoy the patio, since it's on a corner, probably one of the better views of Lower Broad.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Stopped by here with a huge group of folks attending the same conference. We weren't able to sit with our group because they said too many people in that section. So had to sit separate. Kind of lame. Sat at the bar. Bar tender was very friendly. Pork chop was tasty but so small. Pablano grits were very good.  The fried pickles were good as well. Portions could have been a bit bigger. Men's restroom attendant was kind of a pain. He was more in the way than helpful. Very loud place as well but makes sense since there is a big stage and live music.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: This is one of the places we kept going back to. The bartenders were prompt with service and with the exception of one all seemed to be happy. The bands/singers were great at getting the crowds involved and played everything that was requested. One of the downsides was having to order dinner to sit at a table. I understand if the place is packed but when you have 10 open tables and paying customers for drinks seems like you're turning away business. Other than that great times!

name: Nashville Palace
text:
Seriously, how do you get pulled pork from a can!!
 The service was the worst ever and the food was pathetic!! That is as nice as I can say about it!  Don't waste your time!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
Bigger venue than most other places near Broadway. There were families, couples from the resort, and a few people in their twenties to thirties. 
The band put on a performance with lights and dance moves. There was space for line dancing, with people dancing to every song.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Food was pretty good, service was mediocre. Disclaimer we had a party of about 13-16 people & 3-4 of our orders were wrong when we received them. One of them was still wrong when they brought it out the second time. They should've had 2 servers taking care of us.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Meandered in here last Saturday around 3 pm-ish as the more popular bbq joint across the street had a line out the door and down the street. (That one served smoked beef brisket, this place didn't.) Rippys is self-seating so I found an open stool at a long shared island bar. The bartender, "Tee" (a petite, super cutie-patootie) came out promptly and got my drink order going. Since there was no beef brisket available, I went with a pulled chicken sandwich and potato salad. It came out warm but with no sauce of any kind as you are supposed to add it from the bottles at your table. After liberally dousing it in Mild, it was fine. Tee was slammed and took a few tries to get me my check at the end of the meal, but I didn't hold it against her as the place was busy. As far as bbq goes, it was pretty average so I can understand why this place didn't have a line out the door. I think 3 stars just about nails it.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: This is neat little music/restaurant venue, right on the main Broadway drag in downtown Nashville. The place has two levels (the upstairs being open-air, and the downstairs being indoors but well-lit by the numerous windows) and live music constantly performing on both levels. We sat upstairs and nearly sweated our butts off in the humidity (no fans were running), but the musical entertainment was good enough to distract us from the ever-growing pool of sweat running off of our bodies and onto our chairs. The iced tea was brewed fresh and the pulled pork sandwich was tasty; nothing special, but the BBQ sauces on the table let you customize the sandwich to your preferred flavor. Our server was also very good about checking in with everyone and getting stuff to tables quickly, even though they were busy. This place is a dive and a little sticky from numerous nights of partying tourists, but I would recommend it on the basis of a no-frills meal with great live music!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
Abysmal. Service was terrible. I waited at one of the back bars for 20+ minutes. The bartender (Melissa) was picking and choosing which customers to serve- was not even going down the line just switching back and totally ignoring my half of the bar. Oh, and did I mention she had her 2 sons (underage- the one kid had to be 11) back behind the bar? To put away glasses... insanely irresponsible not to mention ILLEGAL. I ordered 2 double drinks - watched her make them- she measured out 1 shot per drink. So I paid 2x and didn't even get what I ordered. 

We were told there was a 2.5 hour wait for a table - and behind the seats we got along the bar there were 3 massive empty booths that sat vacant and covered in glasses & such for over FORTY FIVE MINUTES. How are you that understaffed? Every surface was covered in old glasses and napkins. It was disgusting. 

I will never come back - nor would I recommend. FIND ANYWHERE ELSE.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
This place was ok, we went for dinner and the music act had not started yet and the DJ was playing music and taking requests. They taught some people a line dance, which seemed like fun.

The food was ok, but it must be the atmosphere more than the food that attracts the people.  

I would like to go back & watch the live acts next time.

name: Nashville Palace
text: I just love this place. Every time I come to Nashville, this is the go to place for me. To me, food is good. I love their hot wings and the sweet potato fries. Food is reasonable to. I just like the atmosphere, people whether the waitresses or the crowd in general and of course the music.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Keeping it basic:
1. Self seating
2. Hot as hell. Up stairs. No a/c giant ceiling fans.
3. Service was bad. As hot as it is they need to make sure they refill drinks.  Never got the refill we asked for.
4.  BBQ pull pork sandwich was amazing!! 
5. Music was great. 
Will come back when the weather is cooler and maybe the service will be better since they were so busy.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Excellent experience during CMA Fest.  One of the artists performing was Maggie Baugh, she was an excellent new up and coming star.  She rocked out on The Devil Went Down to Georgia which is amazing for an 18 YO to play on the fiddle.  The whiskey drinks were amazing, I got the one with blackberry moonshine or whiskey, the brisket was great, got the platter.  Service was awesome too.  Great atmosphere and we stayed about 2 hours.  Bathrooms super clean and they have a bathroom attendant.  Only place I saw that for our whole 4 day trip to Nashville.  Definitely a must do...I liked that they streamlined the menu for the crowds....

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Great wings and fried chicken!  Awesome live music and Jenna was the most amazing server!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Absolutely DELISH! I had the pulled pork sandwich and onion rings and it just doesn't get any better! We dined upstairs for dinner and it was a group of 3 guys playing guitars on 5/13/13. I wish I would've caught their names because they really did a great job! The service was super fast and friendly! If you are in Nashville don't miss Rippy's!!!!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: had the pulled chicken platter which was huge and delicious! the baked beans were a great side dish as well!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Zoë was courteous and on fleek. She knows how to pour a drink. And picks your jacket off the ground. Marinara vats to dip your cheesy sorrows in. And beer to pick up your spirits. Soulshine, you get the coolinary cheers for service and food!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Casual, laid back atmosphere. Good food. Avoid the fries they were kind of mealy but the pulled pork, pork loin melt and beans were excellent. Upstairs outdoor eating area with live music was the perfect place to spend a muggy Thursday afternoon.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Oops, don't get a burger here! OK so, tonight we decided to cruise the strip for a 3 course meal and drinks. We decided to have a burger. We've had some good burgers in this city... We decided to stop here because, quite frankly, we were walking by. There was live music and the atmosphere isn't anything to write home about but not awful.
We ordered a cheese burger and the tomato might have been fresh but I'm pretty sure I just ate a frozen patty with a Kraft single. Maybe I've become a food snob but it was awful. I don't mind bar food or dive bars but frozen patty, ouch! The onion rings were worth the upgrade, golden, crispy and thick. If I come back I'll stick to live music and bottle beer, nothing on tap.... Actually, I probably won't be back...

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: It was our first time dining at soulshine and we will be back sooner than later! Fast service, EXCELLENT pizza (had the five cheese) drinks were awesome too! The Moscow mule  love the love music playing upstairs too. Awesome pizza joint!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Service was a bit spotty to begin. Had to ask for a menu. The waiter (Adam) was good. I order the rainbow warrior and it was good. Wife order the Mediterranean and the shrimp on the pizza were not all peeled. Overall, nothing spectacular either way.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: A Nashville local took us out-of-towners here last night. We like to dance and this bar was awesome - way worth the $6 cover. It takes some bravery to get on the dance floor, but everyone is quick to teach and not judge! The band was Brother Trouble - great for dancing!  It was also a nice break from the sloppy drunk crowds that sometimes take over the other bars.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Had this place on our list of places to try. I thought the prices were a little high, but the food was generally good. We ordered the fried pickles and I have to say that was my favorite part. I got a burger and my husband got the brisket sandwich. We both had the recommended beer they only sell which was good. They offer line dancing lessons every hour which was fun. They also had live music too. It seemed less authentic than the other places on the main drag, but this place I would bring my kids to as it seemed very family friendly.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
Destiny and Bernie are the best bartenders we've EVER had! Destiny made out first trip to Nashville feel like it was home. Apparently she was just training but you never would've known it by the amazing quality of her drinks and personality. 

The line dancing lessons were a blast and we really enjoyed learning and dancing! It was a fun mix of hanging out listening to phenomenal country music and dancing. 

If you go, go to the bar on the left side of the stage when you walk in and see Destiny and Bernie. Order yourself a Weekend at Bernie's shot or drink, an amazing shot that will knock you out! 

Bottom line is just go to the Wildhorse Saloon. Awesome experience and a breath of fresh air after Broadway!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: The drinks are good, the patio is fantastic, but the pizza is mediocre.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
A large group of us were staying at Loews Vanderbilt for a wedding.   Since we arrived the night before, we wanted a nice but yet convenient place within walking distance to eat.   A young man at the bar recommended a couple option, but pizza sounded wonderful.   So we took the 15 minute walk over.  

We were early diners, so we had the pick of the place.  Landing upstairs.   Great choice for Trivia Night.   

The menu had many Italian favorites, so with 10 diners we ran the gamut.   Everything was great.   I would recommend the meatballs for an appetizer if you are gingery and ready for a starter.    It is more for two.  A friend pick spaghetti, and it looked wonderful.  My husband and I did a "build your own" pizza.  Doubled the pepperonis....fabulous!   

Around 7:00, Trivia night switches over to live music.   I would highly recommend this place.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Us tourists stopped by here on a tip from a local friend, since our desired spot was packed.  We were really just in the mood for good BBQ, and this happened to be nearby.  

I'll just start off by saying this isn't really a dinner restaurant.  It's more of a bar that serves food.  This isn't necessarily a bad thing, but it's not quite what we had in mind.  

The drinks were fine, but we weren't super thrilled with the quality of the BBQ food.  Between us, we had pulled pork and pulled chicken sandwiches w/ french fries and slaw sides.  The food was really nothing to write home about, even though they provided BBQ Sauce to coat it with.  The service was a tad off; we had to wait quite a while for our bill (couldn't find our waiter).  I didn't know places still served RC Cola!

I'm not really gonna write much about the live band or the local beers, you can find these in almost every building on the street.  Not sure I would come back, given some of the other options in the area.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text:
This is the worst experience I have had at a Nashville restaurant. My family and I waited for over an hour for appetizers and even complained to a manager and little was done to accommodate us except for a "I'm sorry - it's been a busy day". 
Save your time and go to another establishment.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
This place is a bit of a shit hole to be honest. The live music was terrible. We sat through 3 hours of a early 20 somethings duo doing bad country covers, they had little guitar playing skills and their voices were even worse. Out of all the bars we visited in Nashville this was the only one I can remember having blatantly awful music.

The saving grace is the upstairs open floor patio. 

Food look gross.

name: Tennessee Performing Arts Center
text: The staff is rude, unhelpful, harassing, hateful, mean....won't let you enjoy a show without being bugged by the staff constantly.  They pick and choose who to harass, and will step on your feet to get across 40 people to tell one person not to video with a freaking cell phone.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
Went for dinner and were promptly seated outside as the inside with the loud music was not conducive to my friend and I talking. We mentioned our scoutmob deal and were told "we aren't using scoutmob anymore and we're actually suing them because they won't take our deal down"

I get that there can be trouble between companies and what not. But if your deal is online and live, you should honor it. This left us with a sour taste in our mouth but we decided to stay. 

We ordered the southwest pizza and it was delicious! Ate about half of it and took the rest home. Tasted even better as leftovers!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Our flight back to Baltimore was canceled and our next available flight was 10 hours from the current flight time (noon became 10pm.) We decided on Wildhorse for some lunch. We explained to the waiter our situation, and he waited on us for 5.5 hours! We left him a nice tip, which didn't compare to the generosity he gave to us. Plus, the food was slammin as always!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Great location located right on Broadway.  Service was actually pretty good for as busy as it is inside.  Music (of course) was awesome.

The food is good, and plentiful.  Brisket was above average but the pulled pork required copious amounts of bbq sauce.  I would give it 3.5 stars if I could.  Good, not great but certainly plentiful.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Came here for a conference. We had the whole place to ourselves. It was awesome. Good food, music, and beer. What is better than that!!!

name: Tennessee Performing Arts Center
text:
For anyone thinking of attending Shen Yun at TPAC. I went and left angry.
This show is advertised as a cultural performance of traditional Chinese music, dance and song. What it turned out to be, about $180 bucks for 2 tickets later, was a heavy handed propaganda piece for the Falun Gong a religious sect in China. That would be fine if I knew that going in, but there is no mention of it's real agenda on any flyers, anywhere in their ad campaign.
Hope this might save someone the $ and the "I've been had" feeling that my date and myself left with last year.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: We came for the line dancing classes. The instructor was awesome and so much fun with our group. I would recommend for a girls party group.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Great music, beer and food! This place is always a ton of fun! It's not as packed as others. It's also more open, being on the corner, so you don't feel like your in a dark hole, which is great. The music is fun and pretty good and interactive. They have 2 floors and each one was great. The food is bbq, of course, and it's good with a ton of it. Overall our favorite place on Broadway in Nashville.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Awful. I had a chicken flavored salt sandwich. Baked beans were okay, maybe 2 stars. My wife wasn't really hungry so she ordered a pb&j. It was actually a smuckers uncrustable slathered in butter and warmed on the griddle. Beer selection is pretty poor. Tourist hell.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: Came into the restaurant the other day had a great time Amy served me and was awesome sauce will return as soon as possible and hope she's working

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
Anytime I have to hunt down staff to resolve a problem, I know it's going to be a bad experience. 

My boyfriend and I got tickets to see Free Beer and Hot Wings Live at Night. I paid $25 each for two tickets (total $75.90 with fees) that were listed as "tickets are reserved seating on main floor rows 5 and back along with elevated booth areas" on the Wildhorse Saloon website. 
When we arrived at the venue we were quickly ushered upstairs and told that we had access to the second and third floor. We could go anywhere on the 2nd floor except the railing (which was assigned seating). Once we reached the second floor, we saw that there were no tables open so we moved to the 3rd floor which was standing room only. Initially, I thought that I had purchased the wrong tickets, so we found a spot to stand and my boyfriend went to go get us drinks at the "bar" which was a single file line leading up to two bartenders (unsure why it was set up like this. Maybe just for special events?) it was odd and made the process of ordering a drink a total pain. It took over 30 mins for him to get us two diet cokes. He placed an order for fried pickles at this time as well and we were given an order number. Meanwhile, I've been standing near the balcony eyeing the other levels and looking at our tickets, and still believe that we had reserved seating, so I hiked back down the stairs to talk to the women who ushered us up stairs. She was nice and told me that I had purchased a general admission ticket, and told me again that I had access to the second floor, except the railing. I walk back up stairs to the second floor and make three or four laps around to try to find anywhere to sit. No available seats at all. So I walked back up to the third floor and find my boyfriend who is still waiting on fried pickles (at this point it had been 20mins). While we were waiting, we pulled up the tickets and were still convinced that we should have seats, as the tickets have seat numbers on them, so I go back downstairs to talk to the seating lady once again. This time I show her my ticket and where it has a seat number listed. She begins explaining the seating on the second floor and told me that the seats where labeled with the seat number and then begins looking for a 2nd Floor Map. At this time, a manager (I assume, because he was in a suite and tie) comes by and says it's general admission ticket. So, I show them on their website where it says "tickets are reserved seating on main floor rows 5 and back along with elevated booth areas." I also pointed out that there were $10 tickets listed on their website as "general admission" and I should be a tier up from that. If I wanted to stand I would have paid for the $10 tickets and saved myself a ton of money. At this point, I can tell that the seating lady has gotten frustrated with me. They begin explaining that Tickmaster makes them assign seating numbers and that's why there's a seat listed on the ticket. I feel stupid and embarrassed that I've had to talk to her THREE times and still don't understand how their seating works. This conversation ended with me walking back up the stairs to the third floor, only to find out that we still don't have our pickles (45 mins at this point and the people sitting next to us had ordered and gotten their food within 10 mins). I thought I was going to come in, be seated, eat dinner and watch the show and up to this point, my feet were hurting, I was angry and I had no food. After about another ten minutes without food, I decided to go ask the staff about our order. The food runner was very nice and apologetic, and told me that I would have the order in a few minutes. He comes back over to us to tell us that he can't find out order, asks us for a receipt (who keeps those?!) he gets the order confirmation number and comes back a third time only to have me write the order down on a piece of paper because they have no record of the order. Another ten minutes later and we finally get our pickles. They were gross. Soggy. The ranch that accompanied them was like flavorless watered down sour cream. I am starving, and hangry, so I eat them, begrudgingly. The show begins and a few more awful things happen (drunk girl spills entire drink on our coats and cellphones, but I'm not going to blame WH Saloon for this. It certainly didn't help the evening get any better). We ended up leaving early and left feeling ripped off.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Not sure why this place doesn't have better reviews. We honestly didn't even look before we went. We went on suggestion from family. Glad we did. We went twice. Once for drinks and music and went back the next day for lunch. 

The night for music and drinks. We stopped in for drinks and and there was a great band playing. Stood in the front bar area. The drinks are strong there! My only complaint was that my drink was way smaller than my cousins and they were the same price. 

The day for lunch. Still another great band. Sat at a high top in the back area. The waiter was great. Super attentive. The bushwhacker was really good. Basically an adult frosty. We got the pulled pork nachos to start. Wow were they yummy. The bbq was really good too. We got some kind of pork loin melt. It was really good too. The band that day was awesome as well. Even brought a little girl on stage so she could sing the song she requested. 

We would definitely stop on here again on our next trip to Nashville.

name: CMA Fest
text:
This is the Super Bowl of country music. If you're a fan of this genre, the CMA Fest is one those things you must add to the bucket list. 

4 days of concerts all day and all night with lots of giveaways, autograph signings, and pure Nashville fun.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Fuck this place. Tried to wait for a dumb outside seating and the dumbfuck fucked us and skipped us on the list for 45 MINUTES!!!!!!!!' When they said it was an only 20 minute wait. Got a parking ticket because of the dumbass who LIED ABOUT CALLING US!!!! Fuck this place. And the people who run this shitty place.

name: Nashville Palace
text: Love the classic ambiance here. Live music seems to be great everywhere in Nashville but I like that this place is less touristy and more local authentic Nashville. The audience is less juvenile and not pretentious at all. We enjoyed ourselves so much!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Music was great, server was friendly enough but barely attentive talking to other staff. We had to keep flagging him down and it was not busy. Overall though he was fine and very quick when we got his attention. The bartender was abysmal and ruined the dinner. Drinks tasted terrible on the second round and she refused to fix it. She was rude and refused to break a twenty so we could tip the waiter. She was dismissive and a downright bitch. I've bartenders for years and I have no idea how she makes a living with her bad attitude. I guess that's why she's working on a Tuesday.

name: Big Machine Brewery & Distillery
text: I was recommended this place by a friend of mine who mentioned their moonshine. We were offered a sample and how to drink it. The best moonshine I've ever tasted that will definitely clear your system out. The Moscow mike was made to perfection and very tasty. Check out this gem.

name: Tennessee Performing Arts Center
text: This is my first Yelp for TPAC. I didn't think about doing a review until now. Of course every time is a different experience but always a good one. People who work here are very friendly and helpful. Parking isn't bad. We park and walk over from near the State Capital area. I've seen many shows here and most are really good. The only reason I say most is because I'm a G or PG kind of person. It's always a fun date with my best friend, my husband. Sorry they don't allow pictures during the show.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
Great live music venue.  During the Titans night game at end of Dec 6 of us walked in and easily found a table. Dance floor was full. Line dancing to Tom Petty's Mary Jane cover was uniquely good. 
Drinks were reasonable inexpensive. Parking is a challenge especially during a game day. But found a spot one block back towards the river and two blocks down. $20 for three hours.  

Shelby Lee sang his heart out and even made Garth Brooks and AC/DC sound as if they could be sang next to each other.  People watching is the best thing to do here.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Mediocre at best. Go there for drinks. I had pulled chicken sandwich & fries. The pulled chicken was barely warm. Th bun seemed like the kind you buy in bulk at SAMs or Costco. The sauce tastes like anything I can get at the store.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Awesome bar. One star for one reason.  My wife was going to the bathroom and the woman working in the bathroom was passed out on the ground. My wife is a muse and went into nurse mode. I was there talking to the manager and everything was good besides people were trying to go into the bathroom and they couldn't. So he called a bouncer over to help point people to the other bathroom. As I'm standing there with my wife and my mom (who are both helping) the bouncer comes up to tell me to "get the fuck out of here before I beat your ass". As I'm helping someone who is in need of medical attention. Everyone was cool besides that one guy but that put a spur taste in my mouth. It was 5/18 at 0600PM and he was working the front but not the front door. Standing right by the gift shop.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Service was really good considering there wasn't empty table.  Food was great and more impressive was the fact it was hot.  Music was to bad either.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: Grumpy service and TWENTY FIVE % tax on liquor!!! Rip off!! Not worth it unless you don't drink liquids.

name: Twin Kegs
text:
Was this place fun, sure? If you're into the whole hipster/hippy/unbathed atmosphere. 

I'm not at all a fan of how they run their karaoke, instead of writing your name and a song down you're entered into a rotation which takes far too long to get through. 

The crowd was incredibly friendly as was the chick running the karaoke, but this places takes the term "dive bar" to a whole new level. You can literally only get beer, water, or soda. The worst part for me was the poor ventilation and the smoking. I needed a nebulizer treatment after leaving this place. I recommend it if you're looking for a fun drama free bar. And if you enjoy wearing black framed glasses with no lenses, you'll fit right in.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Service was great. However, I Got food poisoning from the pulled pork sandwich on 1.25. Not cool.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
More 2.5 stars, but definitely not a 3. It's definitely not what it was many years ago. Although they are still doing some dances I did in the line dance craze from 20 years ago. Used to be a great place for dancing, but with their variations to the dances, it's hard to just jump back in at all these years and look like you know what you're doing. And there was not much 2-stepping. 

Came here with a reunion and we reserved a space on the second floor for over 100 people to include BBQ buffet. It was a Saturday night and the place was not packed. With the quality of food served on the buffet (1/2 star), I'd rather have not paid what we paid and just walked in downstairs and gotten tables to order from the menu or just get drinks from the bar, since drinks (outside tea and water) were not included in our price. 

The salad dressings had no flavor, the roasted herbed potatoes were way undercooked, and the "brisket" (depending on the batch that came out) was soggy and pink in the middle or a grey overcooked blob. It was more like a roast sliced like brisket, than it was true brisket. The baked beans and rolls were the only decent food on the buffet. I didn't bother to try the peach or apple cobblers. So definitely not worth the $70 per person to basically have special access to a bar and a couple pool tables. 

Didn't bother to go down for dancing. Lots of little kids running around on the floor and somebody's toddler throwing temper tantrums and laying in the floor. Dance floor is about half the size it used to be.

The live music acts were pretty good though. 

It's really just a tourist place these days, known for its past. I think big country stars taking over old bars on Broadway and putting their names on it are taking the toll on stuff off the strip. People choose here because it's not crowded.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
I can't complain about this place. There were multiple bands, the place was full, and we didn't have to wait long to be seated.

The wait staff was good, understanding we were in a rush.

The food was tasty. Nobody was unhappy in our party with a wide variety of food. The prices were reasonable as well.

I would recommend.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Stopped in for the CMA Fest. Bar tenders were on point. They open beer bottles like champs. Crazy to watch them. I got fried pickles and nachos. I am picky about my fried pickles and they were awesome. Spears not chips and well fried. Worth it. The nachos had chili which was an awesome surprise. Band on the top floor was rocking but they did a lot of repeats. First time seeing a female singing in a bar since being in Nashville. Overall, nice bar to be at during CMA Fest

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text:
Dropped on for a quick drink as the place had A/C and some fine live music (@Britney_Monroe). 

Service was good. Extensive TN brew list and cocktails.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: My coworker and I loved our meals there. So fresh and tasty. Definitely recommend. Service was great too. We went for lunch

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Went here before concert at bridgetone. Amazing grilled chicken salad with blue cheese dressing. The mozarzarella sticks and queso dip was good as well.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Maybe I'm partial to Texas bbq or maybe this place is just truly mediocre. I had seen Instagram pics of their salad and it looked pretty good. I got the house salad and asked the waitress chicken or pork, and she said pork all the way. The pork was okay and the salad was okay. Nothing special or amazing. I think I might have even liked the chicken better. I guess I'll never know bc I prob wouldn't get it again. 

The live band and their music were all very good and entertaining. This place has a fun atmosphere and lots of space upstairs and down. If I came back, I would prob just stick with getting drinks and listening to music!

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: I overall enjoyed my experience here, despite the odd impression I got from the hostess when we entered the restaurant the rest of our dining experience was very pleasant. Our server was VERY pleasant and attentive. I will absolutely return.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Phenomenal food and awesome music performances and line dance classes. The Mac grilled cheese sandwich is INCREDIBLE. Come hungry!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Comfort foods with a twist.  The short rib grilled cheese is great.  Some of the better food in the Lower Broadway area.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
Awesome pizza with a light, bubbly, crispy crust, and perfect cheese/sauce/topping ratio.   If you saw me you would know, this guy loves a carnivorous lifestyle. During this visit to Soulshine I opted for the magic mushroom pizza, which was a magically delicious vegetarian option. 

We sat upstairs where the stage was occupied by a local musician. The owner even came and sang the song that inspired him to become an entrepreneur. It made for an authentically local feeling atmosphere. 

If you find yourself in music row, mosey on over to Soulshine and eat a slice!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Stopped in here for lunch. So many choices downtown. We were happy with our choice. Of course there is live music in all the downtown eateries. We shared a sampler plate of ribs and pulled pork. Both were yummy. Our server was very friendly and helpful when we asked for directions.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: These crab cakes are for real! Chef Adam from Baltimore really rocked the kitchen and I can see why the wings won so many awards! Jessica was the best server we have had this entire trip and we will definitely be back! Great hospitality, fabulous food, fun environment. Can't wait to come back

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: Our waiter was lethargic, queso was cold. Entrees were decent but wasn't impressed.  Also, didn't expect to pay broadway beer prices thus far off of broadway.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: We did a group event here so did not order off menu. Our buffet had pulled pork and beef brisket - both good. Overall good food and decent venue.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: I stopped by in the evening for lunch and drinks. I went upstairs where there was a live band and good view of broadway. I sat next to the open window so I had good seat. I ordered some BBQ ribs and the Tennessee lager, which is good. The food, beer and music were all fantastic.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: My friends and I went in to be involved in the "line dance class." I wouldn't go just for that because they only taught one dance and it was too short, but we had a great time. If you are a fast learner you can stay on the dance floor and learn other line dances from other people. It is a huge space and very clean.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Great service!! Good ribs and best homemade pecan pie!!Worth a stop when in Nashville

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Went here to show my dad Nashville and experienced the rudest bartender ever. I politely said "whenever you get a chance" and Adam replied "if you keep bugging me I'm not gonna answer you"..... this was the first time I had spoken to him.  Had to go to the other end of the bar to finally get a drink. Awesome atmosphere but definitely ruined the night because of poor service and a rude bartender. Manager was awesome and bought us a round.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: we have people in our group who are not able to eat spicy food. We asked them if the barbecue was spicy and got the sampler platter when they told us that it was not. Everything in the platter was spicy and covered in the hot sauce from the week. When we spoke to the waiters they didn't seem to care.

name: Big Machine Brewery & Distillery
text:
We were told this was the place to be. And it was a lot of fun! Love music, great vodka, slushie drinks, and friendly bartenders. 

I was here on a weekday, so it was a bit quiet, but nevertheless it was a great time & we bought some vodka to bring home with us.

name: Tennessee Performing Arts Center
text:
This is a great venue.  I can park close by and there are restaurants within walking distance, so TPAC makes for a great, easy date night destination.

Inside, it's easy to find my seat, and the very well staffed with helpful ushers everywhere.  The size feels perfect - big enough to feel like something big, but small enough to see well from pretty much every seat.  I've not had a bad seat acoustically, either, so it's a real treat to hear good music here.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: We waited 40 minutes while looking at empty tables. The fried pickles made me sick. Our waitress, Octavia was the best part of this experience.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
BARBARA (women's bathroom attendant) is the STAR of this show. sure they have good drinks and fun music, a nice dance floor. but guess what? it wouldn't be ANYTHING without barbara. she is the queen of this shit palace. i will never love another more that i love barbara. queen. she made my time in nashville
worth it. we love her. goodnight

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
I declare Soulshine as having the best bread pudding in Nashville. This after I have dedicated myself to finding all contenders.

The optional vanilla ice cream is unnecessary since the bread pudding is so wonderful and the vanilla flavor is underwhelming. It is cold, bland, sweet stuff.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
This pains me because of the wonderful pictures of Duane Allman and Warren Haynes they have displayed on their walls,  but this was some of the worst service I have had in a long long time. 
Me and my family were the only ones on the bottom floor. We sit there almost 20 minutes before anyone came to take our order. All the time we were looking back towards the kitchen area seeing about five employees huddled and talking. 
I kept telling my wife we ought to leave but we kept on waiting.  Then finally a wait person comes to take our order for drinks and we had to holler for her to stop as she was leaving so we could give her the rest of our order. I shudder to think  how long it would of been if we had let her go. 
Now I'm not saying the waitress has to smile (which she did not) or even be friendly (which she was not) but  at least don't look like we have pulled you away from something important.  
Sadly to say I can't go back as it would be enabling this shoddy service. 
On the good side, they did play excellent music to go with the excellent pics on the wall. 
Also the guy that greeted us ( manager probably)  was very nice and the food was pretty good. 
So I guess the server and company are probably much more congenial when it's later, and the drinks are flowing, and they are around people that  they can personally relate to better then just a couple  over 40 with a child....I understand... but I also understand that is the difference in 5 stars and two. If you talk the talk, you have to walk the walk.

name: CMA Fest
text:
Definetly put your walking shoes on. This place is nuts!! Tons of people. There are Pedi cabs that you can pay a fortune for to take you and drop you off to different locations or just call Uber on your phone and get around much cheaper like we did.
The shows at the Nissan Stadium are awesome!! Great line ups. The free shows at the riverfront stadium were ok. No shade. Very hot.
ALOT of vendors on Broadway handing out free items to try, alot prof free samples were given out.
They have a walking bridge that goes directly to the Nissan Stadium with an elevator or stairs leading up to it on 2nd Avenue between demonbreun and Broadway street.

They wash the streets down after 3am

Plenty of police around. They are on every corner, on bikes, standing.

Great experience if you haven't been.

ALOT of free concerts. Seen Bucky Covington, Luke Bryan did a special surprise concert, and Lo Cash.
We didn't partake in all the free concerts as it was very hot and couldn't walk cause of my ankles. Took alot of Uber rides.

Fireworks at midnight every night from the Nissan Stadium.

Highly recommend getting to the stadium very early.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
We had the whole place reserved for a private event and I was impressed. It's much larger inside then it looks, they must fit a shit ton of people in here on a weekend. The stage is large and they're AV system is top notch, you can tell they put on a good show. We watched Burning Las Vegas and the music and sound was great.  There must be 8 bars in the whole place, everywhere you turn on any of the 3 floors there is a place to grab a drink. I don't know about a typical night but for our event the service was great and the bar tenders and bouncers were professional. 

We had a BBQ buffet with Brisket and pulled pork. They had the wet and dry brisket separated and it was perfect. The pork was fantastic too especially with all the spicy sauces available. Salad, beans, biscuits and cobbler were good. Perfect accompaniments to the meat. 

If for sure eat here if I was looking for dinner, not sure on price and quantity for a menu item but for our event everything was great!

name: Nashville Palace
text: Probably one of the coolest most authentic places in Nashville. The crowd is a mix of older and younger people making it a great place for any age.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: We waited for over 45 min, and there was an open table nearby for the entire extent of our wait. I asked the waitress if it was alright if we sat there (considering we had been on the waitlist and weren't trying to circumvent the process), and she told us we could "walk our ass upstairs". Very rude.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
The saloon is 3 stories high. There were a few people on the dance floor learning to dance. The food was average. I had a double cheeseburger nothing to write home about.
The decor was Western and interesting. Nashville Tennessee.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: The que system is a joke. The video they have posted a link to that shows you how to get a ticket is false. I reloaded the page at exactly 0800 and had the full page of possible reservations to choose from. I immediately clicked for a two person table and it says it's unavailable and then it's only has a few pew options so I click it and everything is sold out. Hey.... as long as they sold tickets I guess it doesn't matter to them.

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text: We had a great time and the food was delicious! The sweet potato pancakes are ridiculously good and the service was outstanding! The historical building makes the experience that much better! You definitely want to go for any meal that you can!

name: The Well Coffeehouse
text: amazing new find.  great coffee, happy staff, & charming atmosphere.  will be back - again & again!

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: The Sutler was the perfect place to host a high school reunion.  We had it in the Cellar in a sectioned off area which was perfect for about 100 of us.  Everyone had an amazing time! From the venue, the food and the staff who went out of their way to make sure our event was special, it truly was an ideal place for a reunion. We even had an impromptu dance party upstairs at the end of the night which was hilarious. We all look forward to coming back!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Came here Last Thursday from Dallas for a family Wedding and this place was (A Okay). If only they can remove people who smoke. But the rooftop was good and they could use an Upgrade!  I rate this place a 5/10.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Everyone has to visit Tootsies. The memorabilia and old records on the walls is worth the visit itself. The bands are always fantastic. My only complaint is the nasty bathroom with a strip club attendant and the airport bar prices. If you are coming to stay a few hours it's going to cost you a few hundred bucks.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
Tootsie's is the go-to music venue on Broadway! Carrying years of distinguished historical provenance, you can feel it as you wander in past the tight first floor bar. With the walls covered floor to ceiling in photos and memories from years gone by, there'll be jaw dropping moments when you realize just how significant to this place is to Nashville.

It is old, it is dirty. Some of the employees don't seem very thrilled to be there... You chose the Service Industry.. cheer up a little.

Live music on the first floor. Make your way up the stairs to the second. Yep, you guessed it, live music there too! And one more set of stairs to the third. What's that? Yep - that's more live music! Three levels of live music and an ass-kickin roof top patio? Now that's a go-to music venue. What's awesome is you definitely can't hear the music on any of the other levels.

I guess we were lucky. I never had to wait in any of the long lines that several people talk about, and that I saw as we were walking around.. We just bar-hopped around and made our way back to TOL.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Digging this place. My one complaint is the  bleach blonde "bartender" working the third floor. I've never seen someone so lazy and avoid work like this girl has. Thrust me sweetheart, you're cute but not enough to get away with all the other bartenders carrying you.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: I've eaten here once and will definitely be back. I liked the atmosphere and loved the food. Great location in 8 South. Everything we tried was great. Highly recommend.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: Just spent over an hour there for lunch. The restaurant was maybe half full. You seat yourself, so I grabbed a booth. My wife was right behind me. As I was sitting down a server came by and said she would bring another menu. There was only one menu on the table. More than 10 minutes later another server came by and asked if we had been helped. We never got the other menu, but we ordered. I ordered unsweet iced tea with lemon. She brought the tea, no lemon, no artificial sweetener. My wife ordered tacos, so prior to getting our food I asked for some extra napkins, and a refill on the iced tea. We never got the napkins. Long after we had our food another server came by and refilled my tea. My steak sandwich was terrible. Tough as nails, and the bread was dried out with no taste. I never got a chance to tell our server that it was subpar because it was a long time before we ever saw her again. She brought our check, and another 10 minutes goes by, we are needing to leave, so I took the check and money to an inept bartender. She had not had a single customer since we'd gotten there, but she acted like I was bothering her. She asked the name of our server. I told her I wouldn't know that, because she never introduced herself. She leaves, finds our server towards the back. Our server proceeds to glare at me and is talking to the bartender. The bartender comes back, has a hard time figuring out that on a $31 check she owes me $9 change. Finally, she entered it on a calculator, and gave me back 9 one dollar bills. It was a tossup to go to this place, or back to ML Rose. Wish to gosh we had done the latter. Wow! What an awful experience.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Always a fun atmosphere.  Just wish the bartenders would smile and say thank you when they take your money for the over priced 8 dollar drink.

name: Paradise Park Trailer Resort
text: This is my FAVORITE bar in Nashville!!!! It is so fun! The rooftop bar is the best, they have pitchers of beer for cheap, live music, greasy food and good people!!!!! The astroturf, lawn chairs, string lights and other funny decor items add so much character! I recommend it to everyone! It is a must!!

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text:
This place was an absolute blast. Now I'm not a big music person (blasphemous, I know), but listening to the performers on Song Writer's Night was very, very cool. I loved the impromptu songs and that family members were in the audience. It was great to talk to the songwriters after the show. What fantastic people! The wait staff was awesome. At times, the banter between performances was about awkward, but mostly it was humorous. 

The food is okay. I wouldn't come hungry. And beware, if you come to the later show they will sell out of popular food items. 

Also, be prepared to wait two hours plus in the scorching, humid heat before the show. It's definitely worth it, but definitely adds a particular smell to the experience. 

Overall, go here! Come really early. Eat a big meal before/after.

name: Tin Roof
text: Really enjoyed the live music, good old country with a mix of current. Small menu but great taste!

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text:
The Bluebird cafe is truly magical. My boyfriend and I attended the Sunday night 6pm show. 

I didn't find getting tickets to be hard. I live in Philly, so the morning the tickets went on sale, I logged on at 8am and just kept my browser open. I was put in a line and once the tickets went on sale at 9 (eastern time) I was immediately entered. One thing that caught me off guard was picking your seats. I panicked and picked the first table I saw with 2 seats. I don't think there is any bad seat in the building though.

Day off: I read a lot of reviews about bad traffic so my boyfriend and I headed over early and went to a bar near by until the doors opened. There is a line for reservations and a line for non. We probably waited about 5 min until we were seated. This was around 5:30. 

The show was amazing and everything we thought it would be. After, we went to the bar across the street and talked with the band even more. I highly recommend the Bluebird to everyone

name: The Sutler Saloon
text:
Nice atmosphere but very poor food value. I ordered the chicken horseshoe which was maybe 4 oz of chicken concealed by shoestring fries and an excessive quantity of gravy on a piece of toast for $16.

 I had such high hopes for the white chocolate bread pudding, but what arrived was a brownie like dessert that was do dry it was suitable to be used as a building material! 

The live local act was the only saving grace for the evening.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: We're visiting from Petaluma, California and didn't want to miss an evening at the Bluebird Cafe!  We thoroughly enjoyed it.  Great atmosphere.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Dirty  nasty urine and vomit stained sinkhole.   I understand  the place is historic but  the band was not even good.    Seems like they are falling back on their reputation  and coasting at this point.  Granted we were expecting  a rowdy honky-tonk  and not the Taj Majal. . . But everything was sticky in this joint.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: The staff is absolutely wretched. Going to this bar was by far the worst experience I had during my entire trip to Nashville. If I could rate it zero stars I would. Came here with a bachelorette party which understandably can be annoying. They confiscated our flask (I get it..being a bartender myself I understand it is against policy to bring outside liquor) but the bartenders continued to take shots from my flask right in front of us. After calling out the bartender with the fake boobs , fake tan, and fake blonde hair she had security kick us out. Extremely rudely. For what? For simply asking her why she took my flask and drank my liquor right in front of me. She was so smug about it and the security guard was a dick who could not provide us with a reason for kicking us out. DO NOT GO HERE THE STAFF IS BEYOND TERRIBLE.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: We hit up Tootsie's again and again during our stay in Nashville.  Great bands and three floors of music!  The first floor is always packed so move upstairs to the second floor.  If that's packed you always have the third floor!  It's a noisy place but then again we went back again and again

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: Waited 1.5 hours for the show which was completely worth it. However when they got to me and my husband there was only one seat left. He insisted I went in while he waited in the car. Only stayed an hour because of this but was grateful to at least have that time. Wish we would've went earlier. Truly an amazing experi

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: Just horrible. Menu leaves a lot to be desired. Food is average and tries way too hard to be hip southern with few choices. I ordered the trout which sounded really good only to find out that they were out of it. Would have been nice to tell us when we sat down. So I ordered the grilled cheese with bacon and was served the brisket. Never going back.

name: Paradise Park Trailer Resort
text:
Unbelievable. The green carpeting was great. The natty light was cold. $6 pitchers. Need I say more? I mean, the place is exactly what you would expect. I thought it was a nice change during my stay in Nashville.

While waiting in line at the bar there were also hilarious stickers to read & kill time. Fun arcade games in the back in case you want to take a break from all the chatting. There was a live band when I went too, they were great and so fun!

name: Paradise Park Trailer Resort
text: Words cannot express our gratitude to Brandon, Fantaicia and Danny. They went so above and beyond for my son my heart is bursting. He couldn't eat the meal due to his food allergies. We ran out to try to get a safe meal to bring back in and join the rest of our family. We struck out and when we came back in, just to sit and have a drink, the staff offered to drive to a safe restaurant to get him something! In 11 years of being an allergy momma, never have I experienced such compassion and action in a restaurant. Truly amazing people, will never forget. Thank you soooooo very much!!!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Pretty loud on any of the floors, staff was ok not the best attitudes. Bands were ok more geared for young crowds, stayed for a drink.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Location in the Nashville Airport. Worst food I've had in Nashville and worst BBQ iv ever had! Very disappointed.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Awesome bar with great music - great bartenders but beware of the woman in the woman's bathroom peddling compliments and hairspray for tips this woman strong arms you to tip her - she is clearly making more money then the talent! I would go to the bar but avoid using the restroom!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
This place has the best music! The upstairs patio area is usually pretty packed, but who cares? The music is better inside anyway:). I'm only giving this place 4 stars because I could have gone without the whole being carded multiple times crap. I was literally carded THREE times within 15 minutes of being there. Seriously? I'm 25 years old and there were PLENTY of other girls walking around who looked much younger than me--yet none of them were approached. It was just weird. Do you guys not trust the two gentlemen you assigned to card people at the door? Or do you just card any female under 40 that isn't wearing cowboy boots and a dress? I guess I should have worn my boots that night and joined the rest of the herd. (To be honest, I sort of regretted going straight here after my workout and not changing first... I was itching to dance!!)

All in all, it's a great place and I highly recommend it for the music.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Had an awesome time with my love and the bar maids Natilie and Nicole, then went to the roof top to hear some great music, then ran in to thi very rude b****.....the first and only rude person i met.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: Just a heads up if you are wanting to watch a performance your chances are very low on getting in or getting tickets.  I tried to get tickets for a Friday show.  They went on sale that Monday prior to the show and they were sold out within 1 min of starting sales.  The reason I give this place 4 stars is because I did get to go into the Bluebird on a tour.  The Manager gave us a history of the place and let us walk around and take pictures.  The tour that I went on was the ABC Nashville TV Show tour.  If I would have been able to get tickets to a show I would have gave this 5 stars.

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text:
Woolworth was an interesting experience. I ordered the gumbo and deviled eggs for my appetizer. The eggs were great but my the rice in my gumbo was not fully cooked. The waiter replaced it in a timely manner. I enjoyed the short rib for my entree but it was a little salty. 
    Although the food left more to be desired, the service was spectacular.   I also enjoyed the facilities.  Don't forget to tour the mezzanine for some superb photographers of Nashville's history.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: I'll start by saying I definitely need to come back here to try more of the menu items and check out the live music. I stopped in waiting for a friend so I only grabbed a quick bite, the Root Salad. This wound up not necessarily being a "quick" bite since the portion was huge - definitely shareable. Basically, it's just thinly sliced root veggies with goat cheese and a light oil dressing. it was a refreshing change to a typical salad order. If I had my choice, I actually think I'd prefer this as a side salad (in a smaller portion) to the standard side salads filled with lettuce. I only stayed for two shakes of a lamb's tail so I missed a lot of the buzz surounding that nights performance. I showed up a little after 5 and was seated with no problem but by 5:30ish they were putting out reserved signs on the majority of the tables and people started showing up for the 6:30 show. The decor was attempting to be saloon like and used BALL® Spring Green mason jars from the Heritage Collection which I loved in contrast to the wood.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: First time visitor to Nashville and fan of the tv show so The Bluebird Cafe was a must see. The band that played was a blues band comprising of older guys who have clearly been playing a long time as they were fabulous. I wish the guy who worked on the door at the end of the night was as well, but sadly not. Clearly he must hate that some people (you know, the paying and tipping customers) are fans of the show because he did not seem happy that he had to help and sell merchandise to any fan whatsoever. His attitude was a real disappointment, but I'm not letting it affect the fact that I'd travelled all the way from Australia and made a stop here purely as a fan of country music, the show, and wanted the experience. I'm so glad I could visit! It's just a shame there is no heating of any kind outside when you have to line up for over 2 hours to get in :(

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Fun atmosphere!!! Great entertainment!!!!!  Cold beer was very refreshing on a hot summer day!!!!

name: The Stone Fox
text: I've been there twice and today was definitely the last time I'll be coming here. I live in this neighborhood and was so happy to find somewhere that could rival east Nashville brunch spots. Boy was I wrong. Today they were OUT of juice for mimosas. WHAT ?! How are you a brunch destination that runs out of juice? The service there is also horrible. The staff is not friendly and act like they don't care. I work in customer service and I couldn't imagine having that attitude at my place of work We got the breakfast tacos and chicken n waffles. Both were mediocre. We left quickly and had breakfast at another restaurant. 40 bucks wasted. 100% won't go there again.
