text: I want to start out by applauding the guys on stage who played that night, they were awesome. Not only are they great at playing but they were pretty hilarious too. The crowd was really fun and bartenders were great. Overall we had an amazing experience here and it's a must-go if you're in downtown Nashville.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Tried another popular open mic and fell short so decided to research all others. Found we weren't near those either so went with The Listening Room. Everything happens for a reason! What a great night! Let's start with the food: great! The turkey apple crisp sandwich: amazing! Drinks are good and Von is a great server! The singer-songwriters are gracious and humble.  This is a great venue! You can't go wrong here. Close to downtown, great food, great servers and amazing singer-songwriters!

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: I enjoyed the museum! as a big Johnny Cash fan, I'm the type who would have liked to have read the descriptions of all the items in the exhibit and go through it at my own pace. it was too crowded (not much space to begin with!) to do that when I went but I was still able to spend time looking at my favorite items such as his yearbook, military items, lyrics, etc. the store is great too, the merchandise is quality!

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: We went on the lunch ride despite the poor reviews, because this is the only paddle boat ride available,  and had a fantastic time. The price was affordable, the staff was very friendly and courteous, the boat and bathrooms are very clean, the food was delicious, the show was entertaining and the scenery was beautiful. Very relaxing thoroughly enjoyed it. Highly recommended.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: We went to this restaurant for a goodbye brunch for 50+ people. The manager was so confused and the wait staff had no clue how many of us were coming in. They do not have any decanters for coffee. One of our organizers even asked if she could help get the coffee to the group she was told they do not have decanters and can only do one cup at a time. Half the group did not get their drinks. When we first walked in I asked the waitress if they have a gluten free option on the buffet the waitress couldn't even tell me what was on it. Once the buffet was empty they did a terrible job refilling it. They provided menus to our group but then told us that we could not order from the menu. So we paid $18 for an empty buffet. On top of that we had to pay a gratuity of 20%.  Also I saw into the kitchen there was only 1 cook working. I asked the manager if she could run my card and she told me she could not that only a server could.  I find this terrible. I hope that the management reaches out to our group to make it right. Also we had people from all over the world and country there this was their last meal in Nashville and all it did was leave a bad taste in our mouths!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: We came into this place on this past Saturday night. It was a hot one in Nashville, upwards of 90 degrees & humid as all get-out. One step into this place & a HEAT WAVE hit you. It was easily over 100 degrees in there. Which I guess makes the attitude of the bartender appropriate? She was cold & ignoring patrons. I even saw her throw cards back into peoples faces. No thanks Dierks.. nothing compared to the Jason Aldean bar.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
WAY COOL and I loved the mini theater where you could watch Johnny cash as an actor. In one scene he grabs a young Ron Howard as a shield and he (Ron) gets shot an dies......bad dad.
Lots of goodies, videos, music stations, records and displays with his guitars, song sheets and outfits he once wore. Make sure you visit the "Hurt" video display before you leave and watch a master of his craft at the end of his days.
My only gripe is that we didn't have enough time to tour the Patsy Cline exhibit there too.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: It was a busy evening and we were directed to the top floor, rooftop and were told there was plenty of room for our table of 6...we headed up three flights of stairs and ended up not being able to sit at a table until another group left. Once we were actually seated, we ended up ordering beer and appetizers initially. The waitress actually surprised us...she didn't write anything down, the drinks came out right but the appetizers came out at all different times. We waited over an hour for our burgers and they never came. The waitress finally went to ask the manager and they had no explanation as to why we didn't have our food. For the appetizers, we ordered a pretzel, hummus and fried pretzel. They were decent. The waitress was sweet and accommodating. The view was awesome!

name: The Basement East
text:
I am a huge fan of this venue. It's in that sweet spot of being the perfect size; not too big and not too small. I came here for the first time on Friday night for a sold out show, but never felt annoyed with the audience. It was very crowded but not so bad that I couldn't go to the bathroom or wait a long time for a drink. I appreciate that! You can always find a good spot along the sides, and we were even able to get close to the front later on in the show without issue. I love that! Drink prices are reasonable and the bathrooms are very clean and new, which is a nice change from some other venues in Nashville. 
I really enjoy the Basement East and can't wait to check out another show here!

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: The atmosphere of this place makes up for the lack of good food.  It's not even good bar food.  To their credit, there was one waitress and one cook there the night we went.  The entertainment was what made us stay.  The guys playing were super.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Stopped in last night for a couple of drinks. I went in first & was served pretty quickly. My wife came in about 3 mins after me. We sat at the bar for almost 5 more mins waiting for the bartender to ask what she would like to drink, but she was too busy talking to another co worker about what she did the night before. So, I told my wife that I was going to the restroom & that I would be right back.

I walked into the men's room & they only had lights working near the urinals....I turned my flashlight to be able to see the toilet & there was mold all over it! NASTY!!!!! 

After I left the restroom I thought it couldn't get any worse, but I was wrong. My wife was still sitting at the bar without a drink! I paid for my beer & we left. Save yourself time & go where the service is great, like Robert's Western Bar down the road. They took great care of us!

name: 360 Burger
text: This place is amazing! Decent prices for some amazing food! Only been here twice but walked out satisfied. Great atmosphere. Awesome staff. Never had any problems with service ever!

name: 360 Burger
text: Absolutely delicious! I had the Spicy Rooster with aioli & a side of sweet potato fries. It wasn't as spicy as I was expecting which was fine but the flavor from the jalapeño infused oil that the chicken was cooked in have it that extra pop of flavor. Will defiantly be back!

name: The Basement East
text: Good venue with plenty of space. We went to the Dixie chicks tribute concert and it was a good time.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: We had a large group event - 50+ people a few weeks ago that went horribly!  Reservations were made, but the manager never informed his staff of the large group coming in so they were completely unprepared.  They ran our of food on the buffet before even half of our group went through the line and only refilled it ONCE maybe twice and we were there for at least an hour and a half. The brunch buffet was more expensive that was advertised on their website and I wouldn't really classify it as brunch at all.  Bland sausage gravy and biscuits, eggs (if you could get them since they never refilled them), bacon, chicken wings, fruit cup and yogurt. And french toast that was only meh. Unbelievably this southern establishment didn't even have grits anywhere on the buffet - or even on the menu.  It was almost 30 minutes before I received my drink order as well - a half decent sweet tea.  The wait staff was wonderful - doing the best that they could.  But they were understaffed because the manager never told anyone that a large group was coming in.  I left there still hungry and almost $30 lighter in my wallet.  Nashville was a wonderful city, but this restaurant was just the pits.  Save yourself the grief and go to Pucketts's Grocery.  The food was much better and the live music fantastic.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: I love this place, such a fun environment for a bite or a few drinks and some live music! Also, I enjoy the variety of options available from honky tonk, to club, to rooftop bar which are all done well! It's pretty busy on weekend nights (like much of Broadway) but seems to deal with the crowds better than most of the big bars downtown. It's like it was better designed to handle the large crowds without feeling too cramped or claustrophobic. I've gone after weekday Preds games as well and had good times then as well. Our crew has had Jasmine as our bartender a few times and she's a rock star who kind of typifies the vibe here. Fun, friendly, no pretense and just happy to suggest drinks and joke around with the guests. She's awesome, and service from other staff has been great as well! Whiskey Row is the real deal!

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
As a Johnny Cash fan, I greatly enjoyed my trip to the Johnny Cash Museum. I was on a a tight schedule so I was there for about an hour and a half. That being said, I wouldn't have spent that much more time there because it was about the size of an extensive exhibit at a bigger museum. 

Between the cool artifacts and movie compilations, I thought that this museum was well worth my time and money. There were iPads that made the information a bit more interactive. There were also handwritten letters and many artifacts that gave a lot of insight into the personal life of Johnny Cash which you really won't find elsewhere. 

I thought I was semi-knowledgeable about Johnny Cash, but I definitely learned a lot. This place is perfect for people who are interested in music history or are at least moderate fans of Johnny Cash. However, it's scope is limited so I wouldn't recommend it for others due to the price of entrance.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Good music scene.  Stay away for brunch, nothing special at all.  Food was mediocre, the scramble came out moderately hot, the buffet look like something out of a cheap hotel.  Orange juice was concentrated out of a bag.  Coffee was burnt.  Come for the music and a cocktail, that's about it.

name: 360 Burger
text: Fantastic burger. I have no clue how this restaurant isn't rated 5 stars. Other than super busy days/nights service is flawless, and the burgers have never not been amazing. Also, where else can you get freaking awesome waffle fries!?

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Pretty much is what it's name says it is. Nothing fancy, just a big room with a bar and small stage.  It's a perfect size venue for showcases of artist and songwriters.  The room is just big enough to accommodate a small crowd and keep an intimate vibe musically.  I didn't eat there but they have foods.  I think it's a nice stop if you visiting and staying downtown Nashville.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
I'm a huge Johnny Cash fan, and the Johnny Cash Museum was my first stop on my first trip to Nashville. It didn't disappoint. From Yelp to Trip Advisor, the reviews of this place rock. It ranks #1 on the Forbes and National Geographic Travel Lists and is one of only six Nashville attractions that has received the 'AAA Gem Rating',  and is authorized by the estate of Johnny Cash. What does all this mean to a visitor? It simply means, whether or not you are a Johnny Cash fan, you will be WOWED. This is a must see Nashville attraction.

For a complete review and TONS of photos--please visit my site at: www.TNBTA.com

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: The music was amazing at this spot. We are from out of town and came to catch a songwriters round. Everyone was listening attentively, and the food was very good. I would say the prices are a bit high, but I am glad they are supporting the musicians. The wait staff were a bit slow, but given the atmosphere I don't blame them.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Great music, horrible service. It took 45 minutes to get someone to take our order and another 45+ for him to bring out our waters. I would have gone to the bar but I didn't want to miss the performances. 
I still haven't received them, I'm just hoping our appetizers and waters show up at some point. 
Musicians are amazing and the food sounds great, I just haven't received it to let anyone know how it tastes.  
Edit - I just walked to the bar to get my own water. No idea where the food is and no sight of the guy who took our order. 
I created a yelp account just to leave a negative review for this place. I feel bad doing so, but I've never had worse service at a restaurant or bar. I wish I'd known how non-existent the service was because i'd have eaten at one of the many amazing (reviewed) restaurants nearby instead of wasting my time here.

name: 360 Burger
text: Far from impressed.  My husband and I ate here this past Tuesday around 5:30.  The waitress who sat us had her booty hanging out of the bottom of her shorts.  NOT a fan of using sex to sell stuff :/  I'm not sure which was more fake, her tan or her attitude.  There was only one other table of guests when we got there.  Obviously, I don't know how long they waited for their food.  But it came to them about 10 minutes after we were seated.  Then our food took another 10 minutes to get to our table.  I was really disappointed that it was just warm.  The cheese on our burgers had already started to solidify and our fries/onion rings were cold...no to mention, frozen items, not fresh.  We were on our way to a concert and were already behind schedule because of the wait on our food.  So I didn't complain and I wasn't about to send it back.  If you've seen the movie, Waiting, you know exactly why.  Needless to say, we won't be back.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: Lots of memorabilia, info, clips and such. Excellent complement tour to the Country Music Hall of Fame Museum - both are included on the Nashville city pass.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Was there on June 13, music was absolutely fabulous! HOWEVER, we waited a very long time for a very disappointing COLD meal! And 4 of the 6 of us had some intestinal issues afterward. This has so much potential..... Fix this food problem!!!!

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Best food I had in Nashville . I love the chicken sandwich. Everything we have tried is soo good. And of course Dana Marie is the best. Always great music.

name: 360 Burger
text: The burger was good the fries were cold and the waitress got mad at us for tellin her to wash her hands after sweeping the floor. Gross!!! My first and last time here!

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: Big Bang is a must-go while on Broadway!  Although I haven't been in a dueling piano bar before, I'd have to say that it was definitely an entertaining way to spend a Saturday night.  The talent here, like that of every other bar on the row, is amazing, but add a bit of comedy, crowd interaction and music from all different genres is what makes this place stand out!  One of the musicians, Justin, played the piano, guitar, drums and was a crazy good singer.  Where else can you find that kind of talent?  I've been to a few bars on Broadway and although they all were fun, the Big Bang stands out among the rest and let's just say I'll be back!

name: 360 Burger
text: Terrible service. So bad that we left before being served. They were disrespectful and left us sitting there for 30 minutes. I'll never know if the food is good as we'll never go back

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: This place gets the 5 star review based on ambiance and original live artists' performances alone! Shocked that the yelp reviews are not better.  We saw "Jordan Minton and Friends "... This is the sort of music that You want to come to nashville to hear. Loved every second of it. Didn't order entrees but got some ridiculously good mixed drinks! Loved it!

name: 360 Burger
text: My family met friends at 360 Burger last night and receive 4 stars from all. Food was great and they even serve a black bean burger for the vegans in our group. The only negative comment was from my 13 year old who is into all things ice cream. Apparently they no longer serve shakes. Not a deal breaker for the rest of us. We were seated immediately (party of 8) and the server was very attentive with beverage refills and check-ins during the meal. Southeast Nashville has experienced some positive growth recently and this is a terrific addition. I love to find good places to eat in our community and we will absolutely be back!

name: Rack Room Blue Bar
text: I would give it a zero if I could. On Oct 31, 2014, I was refused entry even though I paid $25 for the block party entrance fee. The front door bouncer declined to let myself and every African American male who paid for block party entrance into the establishment.  When I asked him what his reasoning was for letting the white friend I was with in and not me, he replied, "because I said so." I will be reporting this experience and these observations to the regional human rights office.

name: Music City Bar and Grill
text:
Blake did an awesome job organizing a private party for 90 women educators.
The food was good and the drinks were reasonable!
We all had a great time!

name: 360 Burger
text: Visited the Best Burger place in town again last nite and wasn't disappointed in the burger nor the service but they changed their onion rings. They are not worth ordering.  Talked with several people that ordered them as well and everyone was disappointed in the change. Burger is still tops but onions I would rate is an zero.

name: Music City Bar and Grill
text: Music was cool (live band). The steak and cheese was delicious! Fries were gigantic and the onion rings were on point!

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: This museum was well worth our time and money! While it was not very big in size, there were lots of artifacts that allowed us to spend a lot of time there. It was amazing to see  all of the pieces Johnny Cash owned and to see his handwritten lyrics and notes. The layout of the museum was very organized, starting with a brief overview of Cash's life by each decade and then showing artifacts from the beginning to the end of his life. I did not purchase anything from the gift shop for fear it was overpriced.  However, after walking into more places downtown I quickly realized the merchandise was the same price as other places and better quality. I would highly recommend stopping in this museum for a visit.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text:
I'm about two weeks late writing this. I hope I remember their names correctly, Kenny and Angel. They were super cool and friendly all night. Thank you both!

We spent the night going from the patio to inside and back out. Never really had to wait for a drink. Can't wait to come back and live it up on a Tuesday. 

The band was also great!

name: General Jackson Showboat
text:
My friends and I took a trip on the General Jackson and it was a lot of fun. The show and food were great, as was the ride itself. The musicians are all extremely talented.

The best part was the two man show upstairs after the main show.

The staff, especially Lolita, was extremely helpful. I was running late and I should have missed the boat. However, the staff held the boat at the dock so I could make it.

I would recommend the General Jackson to anyone in Nashville.

name: 360 Burger
text: I gave eaten here 3 times.in the last 2 weeks, I just love the wings (gotta get by from 3 to 6p.for 50 cent wings)I love the Burgers as well.the staff are always nice and The Owner always stops by to make sure everything is ok. Will definitely Return.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: Everything you ever wanted to know about the Man in Black. Extensive collection of his letters, photographs, guitars, costumes, memorabilia. Great video archive. Really fleshed out his biography along with his music. Enjoyable way to spend an afternoon in Nashville.

name: 360 Burger
text: I have eaten at 360 Burgers many times since it opened.  I have tried many things on the menu too.  The Sliders (wonderful), NOLA Shrimp (not on the Menu anymore but fantastic), Fried Shrimp (yummy) and last week order the Fried Mushrooms (best I've ever had).  While I think everything I have eaten is great - I generally slide (sorry for the pun) to the Sliders with Onion Rings.  I haven't had one of their big burgers yet, but that's only because I'm a small person and the Sliders fit my appetite much better.  All my friends get excited if I ask them to come with me to 360 Burgers.  The food is great, the service is great and I love the atmosphere they have.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: The drinks was fabulous. As for the food, I just got the hummus plate- but it was good. Entertainment- great. I much prefer lesser known artist singing originals, than crowded downtown average singers.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Visitors and guests be warned , I just spent the last 45 minutes standing outside for no reason waiting to get into be show tonight. I have been to the listening room three times now and never had to deal with this. Their ticket policy is such that if you do not buy tickets ahead of the show you want, then they make you stand outside for the first 15 minutes, while the show is going on , before slowly letting people trickle in. Also known as wasting my time. There are literally hundreds of other live music venues within ..5 miles and I would tell people to go anywhere else before trying to get into this place without pre-purchase. Thanks for nothing Listening room.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
Super cool! 

I'm not particularly into Johnny Cash, but this definitely won me over. It's a nice size, though small, well-laid out considering the space constraints. 

After purchasing your tickets, your first stop is a nice person who explains the layout and a few top things to see. That was helpful because though it is well laid out, there is one weird thing where you need to walk a direction and then backtrack. 

I really liked the curation of materials. We skipped the listening stations and focused on the history, costumes, records, and other archives. The last bit of space is the best, the introduction to his cover of Nine Inch Nails "Hurt." I've seen the video many times, it's my favourite JC song, and I saw it in a whole new light after going through the museum. 

I'd recommend visiting this museum if you are in town.

name: Music City Bar and Grill
text: The food is okay but nothing special. I had a horrible experience. I ordered 3 beers all together. The waiter forgot to bring the third beer so I asked another waiter who made sure I had one. No big deal. When the ticket came, I had been charged for 4 beers. When I told the server, he stated I had four beers and I was wrong and basically insinuated I was drunk and didn't know what I was talking about. I ate a lot and was inebriated in no way, just pissed of the accusations. I've never had this sort of treatment. I spoke with the manager after asking for him. He took the one beer off and gratuity. The server did not apologize. Needless to say I won't ever go back or support such rudeness. Never in my life had I been treated this way.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text:
This is a great option downtown. We got there right before they started charging cover which we were happy about. This isn't a huge space and all the seats full up quickly. Even though we didn't get a seat, there was plenty of room in the bar area. The bartenders do a great job getting the drinks out fast. Did I mention they are soooo reasonably priced? 2 glasses of wine and 2 beers for only 20 bucks.

The dueling piano players are extremely talented. They knew tons of songs and do a great job keeping the energy up with the crowd. They play a mix of old and new and everyone is singing a long. 

If you're looking for something different to do downtown, then definitely check this place out!

name: 360 Burger
text: Finally made it up to this place. Moved to Antioch and was looking for a much needed neighborhood bar, thirsty turtle sucks, so I walk in and instantly seated and recommended drinks food. Ordered a drink and app. And before I could have 4 chips my entree was out hot and fresh! Good music and a lot of bright natural light which is rare for a bar. I'll definitely be coming back again . Excellent!

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Off Broadway, but what a heck of a great bar to fall into and listen to some great music while being served by some of the sharpest and most attentive bartenders in Music City.  Nothing special...except for the authentic flavor of a great southern bar.  Just killer!

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: Must visit location in Nashville. This man was a saint, a sinner, and spoke his truth.

name: Rack Room Blue Bar
text:
This place was nuts! 

By this point in the night one of my buddies had gone to the hotel, and another was visiting some friends in town. That left me with one guy, and we had a blast at this place. We pretty much stayed in the pool hall side, and met some interesting characters. 

One guy looked like Johnny Depp from Pirates of the Caribbean, the bartender was from Iowa which lead to some pretty interesting conversations, and we ended up partying with this guy who runs some underground gambling activities. Crazy night! Left this place to head downtown, but we certainly enjoyed our time here!

*****

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: I love me some Johnny Cash.  Seriously, I find it hard to believe anyone doesn't love the iconic Man in Black.  This well-done museum is a great homage to his life and legacy.  Located in downtown Nashville, the museum is definitely a little small for the amount of traffic it gets due to its location and attraction for tourists, but its worth a jaunt through.  There's so many interesting items to view as well as a listening tour of Cash' music over the years.  An interesting man with an interesting life, this museum does a great job of showcasing Cash with respect, making it at least feel more like a genuine spot of reverence than just a blatant cash grab.  This is something I recommend for locals and tourists alike, though off days are better to avoid the crowds and the crush within the confined space.  There are usually living social or groupon deals for admission as well, and parking near the building entrance, which is close to the pedestrian bridge.  Definitely worth a visit.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Tammie, the curly haired bartender, really just made our day.... We needed a place to go in this big city and she made is feel so much at home. Thank you, Nashville.

name: Silver Dollar Saloon
text: Maybe I'm not that big on the country music scene, but this place just wasn't for me. I came here during the CMAs and it wasn't very busy. It was like being at home watching it on TV. I had to sit all the way in the back in a separate room. It was incredibly awkward. My friend and I were 2 out of 4 people sitting in this room they had set up for overflow from the main bar area. The room ended up being the VIP room. No one told us to leave even when one of the artists performing that night had showed up and was talking to all of his friends that came as well. My friend and I just decided to mosey on over to the main area because they were going to start the live music. (Mostly because we felt extremely awkward in that room.) It got way too crowded around the stage which is positioned right next to the entrance. I had to push people out of my way to get out because they were so engrossed with whatever terrible country song this guy was singing. Maybe it was just this certain night, but I don't think I'd reccommend this place when there are better less awkward and less claustrophic places to experience good country music.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: This is the place to go if you're not in the mood for country music. They were playing indie music when I went here, the guys did a great job performing. I heard from the waitress that the first show is free, and second show charge a cover on weekdays, the cover is cheap anyways. The food is decent, it was a good experience overall.

name: Madame Tussauds Nashville
text: What a fun interactive tour!  This was our first time at a wax museum. The figures were so life-like. It was really amazing!  We have teenage and college aged kids with us and they really enjoyed it. So many photo opportunities throughout. It took us about 40 minutes to go through. If you have AAA you get $6 off per ticket so we saved $30 for our group of five.

name: 360 Burger
text:
I've eaten here many times since the place has opened and the food has gotten worse and worse. It seems that the food costs are eating at the place because the burgers gets smaller, the condiments get smaller and smaller. Hell, the last few burgers I've eaten had lettuce that was store bought from a bag rather than the way it used to be (fresh peeled, you can tell the difference.) and the tomato pieces are the ends of the tomatos, like silver dollar sized. The meat is always either dried well done or red on the inside. The fries get smaller and come in lesser quantities. Almost every time I've ever eaten there the food makes me sick and I regret it shortly afterward but it's close to me and convenience sometimes talks my body into doing dumb things.

Not to mention, the service here is garbage. There are new faces there each time I go in, except for a few regulars that have been there awhile. The only awesome server there is a shorter man named "Oli" I believe (oh god, hopefully I didn't spell it wrong) and he ALWAYS takes care of me and my friends. I tip him 35%-40% each trip just because he works his butt off to take care of me.

The worst trip I had was when I went to the bar and the bartender flat out ignored me. She was too busy chatting with a fellow male employee and texting on her phone to notice I was waving my hand and saying MISS after I had spent about 2 minutes trying to get her attention to tell her I wanted another drink. Why would you do this to your customers, just be helpful and take my money, I have lots and I want to spend it there.

I really wanted to give this place a chance. I really did, I don't think I'll be going back. For the $10 they want for a overdone burger and cold tasteless fries you could go buy 10 double cheeseburgers and have the exact same experience.

I HIGHLY discourage anybody from visiting this place, and hope that eventually they will read some of these reviews and go "huh, I guess we have room for improvement" (probably not).

I can't believe I am going to have to resort to fast food again.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Best Saloon in Nashville. Great service, friendly, personal and outstanding live music. Food looked great.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
The songwriters were amazing, but service was below subpar and the food was terrible. 

Food: we ordered apps and entrees - fried pickles, hummus plate, pork entree, steak entree. Everything came out at the same time, and everything was cold when it hit our table.  Most of it was inedible. 

Service: very sweet trainee assigned to our table, who unfortunately never checked in. Took our order, reordered is drinks, gave us our check. That was it. No checking on the food, no asking why we didn't eat anything.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
Quick museum, we enjoyed the exhibits and the lay out. They housed some pretty cool things with a few random items that you wouldn't have thought to keep. For example some of June's dresses, a letter he wrote the day of her funeral and his old American Express.
  There is a cafe before you enter and the gift shop had some neat things for all ages.
  If you are a fan of Johnny I would stop in for sure!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Great atmosphere. Food was below average! Service was slow. Location is perfect. Nice restrooms.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: This place suck if you want food or drinks. Waiting over 30 min for drinks and over an hour for food is bullshit. This place has potential but they need to hire better waitresses cause ours was terrible. Music was ok.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text:
Arrived at 6pm with 4 girlfriends so we could get a good table. The place started to fill up at 9:30 and by then we decided to move to the upper floor so we could move around and dance. The music was good, spent a fortune on mixed drinks only to realize that shots would guarantee us some alcohol. They deliver the shot glasses with blinking lights - not our thing but that's ok we just switched it off. Server was ok, not warm and friendly but there when we needed something. It's probably my 5th time going to a dueling piano bar spanning from Louisville, KY, Miami,
FL, San Diego, CA, Atlanta, GA and then Nashville. Always enjoyable but I must say Nashville was my least favorite.  Hope they change the layout and add a dance floor in the near future.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Loved listening to the Song Suffragettes.  Arrived early. Had affordable drinks before the show. Bartender was helpful and attentive.  Food during the show was average but show was terrific.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: The songwriters were great! Found a sharp object in my chicken though...might consider eating before you to and just do drinks!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Whiskey Row is always a blast. Had been to one before while visiting Arizona so it was a pleasant surprise to find one in Nashville. Had an amazing time. Drinks were great. Staff seemed friendly. Had an especially nice encounter with Thomas Lawson. He saw that all our needs were met. Would definitely recommend this place to anyone who wants a little up beat country fun in an almost club-like atmosphere. 5 stars.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: I absolutely love the Listening Room Cafe - my first visit was at the Cummins Station Location in 2009 - been hooked ever since :)

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
A fitting tribute to a country legend.  

The museum is a bit cramped but it places the emphasis first and foremost on his music, and you can listen to various versions of each of his songs (versions by him on different audio formats, and also covers from many artists).  It also has some neat memorabilia.  Most importantly, it shows you the humanitarian side of Cash.  

If you're a country music fan, it's not quite a pilgrimage site but it's one of the better music museums I've come across.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Wonderful experience here. The bands were better then any other bars on broadway (we tried them all), the food was good and atmosphere was really great!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: The Listening Room is one of our favorite places to go when in Nashville. Great music, good food, and a nice sized room. Highly recommend this place if you want to hear some great Nashville songwriters.

name: 360 Burger
text: I have never been so disappointed in 360 Burger at my visit today. This restaurant started out when it was owned by Swett's with Hot Chicken (delicious) and then Salmon Burgers (delicious) and we frequented it often. They decided to do away with the Hot Chicken but kept the Salmon Burger so we added the Cheesy Goodness Burger on their menu to replace the Hot Chicken. That kept us coming back. Then it was purchased by Freeland Chevrolet Superstore and it quickly went down hill on ambiance and food quality. Today after work I went back to order food to go and they have now done away with the Salmon Burger and the Cheesy Goodness Burger. So I ordered a burger adding cheeses in hope of recreating it and then order just a burger for myself. The cooks were not happy and fussed because they said Cheesy Goodness Burger is off menu and didn't like the fact they had to add all the cheeses. Then I requested the homemade chips and was told we only cook those for patrons eating in, but were gracious enough to do it for me, after all, I was the only one in the store. It looked like a ghost town. I will give a gold star to 360 Burger's server Connor B. He was so gracious and so kind in working with me to recreate the meal hopefully to be as memorable as in times past. Took the food home and we sat down to eat, the hamburgers were horrible. There was absolutely no texture to the meat. Every bite taken was like putting a big blob of slime in our mouths. We finally had to throw it out. The ONLY thing good was the homemade chips and fruit bowl! $30 wasted! We will probably not be going back!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Excellent bar! Great atmosphere, love the live music and open windows! Shana was an excellent server - very attentive and quick! Thank you!!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Came here two days after opening and only second day getting foood and food was great! Service was better! Our new favorite spot in Nashville!!!! Happy New Year to Us!!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: We had a blast at Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row! It was refreshing to find a more modern (and cleaner!) bar on Broadway, and one that also serves great food! There are 3 levels, make sure not to miss to rooftop! Easily the nicest on broadway. The staff was very attentive and friendly. Great vibe overall, stands out from the other honky-tonks. Would absolutely return again.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: By far my favorite out of all of the celebrity establishments around the city. The service was on point and the live music was amazing. Multiple levels to check out different bands. Another huge plus was the super clean bathrooms which is hard to come by in Nashville

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Really nice venue and some interesting music, but every other part of the experience was tortuous, from the moment we arrived until the time we left.  We had no tickets, so we went inside to purchase some for the late show while the early show was just ending.  We were rudely dismissed and told to wait outside, where it was hot. Despite there being tables and chairs and a bar right inside the door, there no refreshments. Huge missed opportunity. 

They told us they'd open the doors at 8:00, but didn't open them until 8:20. No explanation.  Instead, the same, "You're lucky we're dealing with you at all" attitude. No explanations about how the two lines (unticketed and ticketed) would work, so we had to improvise, which led to our waiting in the line for a good 15 minutes, only to have a couple of people just walk up and get in to pubs tickets before us.

Our server was OK, Althea we had to pull him aside to get him to take our food order.  Food was pretty good, and it's delivery was pretty fast.  No complaints there.

But when the music ever started, people wouldn't shut up.  We'd ad the warning about no talking during performances, but it wasn't enforced at all.  There was a large group of what seemed to family members and friends of one of the performers from New York who occupied a back corner of the venue and were engage in loud conversations during all the performances except hers. She even went back to join them.  I asked the server to ask them to shut up, and he did nothing.  Given the he sound was pretty poor to begin with, the noise ruined the night.

This could b a great place to listen to performers, but it needs new management because the current managers clearly have no idea what they are doing.  I won't go back until I see signs here that they have changed their ways.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: I think this was my favorite bar on broadway! The stage is soo cool. It's two floors open space so two floors of the restaurant can actually see the one stage. And on my second night in a row there, Kid Rock was there and sang for a solid hour!! Great time, great music!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: I'd rather get circumcised again than go Downtown but if you find yourself looking to get a couple in you before a Preds game this is a really cool place to get a drink.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
We really enjoyed this place! We went earlier in the day and listened to a country rock cover band. The place seems newer and clean. Very large, open and bright with high ceilings. There are multi levels. We were on the entry ground level. Great view of the band, and our server was very good. Our adult children went back later that evening for the night scene, and sent us a video of them singing and dancing to Elton Johns, Crocodile Rock. We did not order food. Will definitely go back. 
Update: Actually, we went back several times during our weekend stay. So much fun. We did eventually order bar food and it was super good. Chicken tenders, French fries and nachos. It's on a corner lot and the breeze zipping through made for a comfortable stay.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk is the best bar on Broadway! First Time in Nashville and first bar we walked into. The singers were great and entertaining. Both performers we saw played great music and had the crowd going. All the songs they played were hits, country and rock. We left for a bit to check out the other bars on broadway but came back to the place. If you're looking for a good time Kid Rocks bar is the place to be.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: The memorabilia is great, but the space could be set up better.  There are tons of things to see, but no clear flow of traffic through the tiny rooms they are housed in making it really difficult to weave through shoulder-to-shoulder people in order to see everything.  Also, there was an entire section dedicated to other performers that Cash was close with like Elvis and Carl Perkins that I didn't really need to see memorabilia for

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: My family went here for dinner and the music.  One of our favorite experiences in Nashville.  So neat to see and hear the work that goes into songs and to see it from the perspective of the songwriter. We will be back. Oh and the food was great too!!!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Great music! Enjoyed time there last night, First band was amazing and loved that he brought the bartender up on stage..\ she had an amazing voice

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
Was enjoying an awesome pop band tonight on the first floor and they were told to stop playing after like four songs. The band was awesome and everyone was really enjoying it, so I'm not sure why they got cut. Someone said that they needed to play country,  but why would you hire a pop band if you wanted country music? Now this bar is the only one on broadway without live music. I went to cash out and my tab had a bunch of drinks that I didn't order. Couldn't get it sorted out with the bartender so I just sucked it up, but I'm pretty unhappy.  

This bar is gorgeous and I know they just opened so maybe they're still getting it together, but my first visit was a bust. I'll come back in a few months and update my review if things get better.

name: Rack Room Blue Bar
text: Place has changed a lot. Awesome Monday and Wednesday night local music showcases. Wednesday is songwriters and Monday are bands. Clientele has changed and everyone is respectful. Owner Is changing image and it's working. Give it a shot.

name: 360 Burger
text:
My food was very good.  The quality of the beef and the size of the patty was great.  The fries were good, seasoned with just enough sea salt.  The bun was very fresh.  The produce was a good quality.

The service was good.  You seat yourself, and there should be a sign saying so.  I saw several people standing in uncertainty at the door.  The live music was great and not so loud, we were easily able to carry on a conversation.  

Lots of good choices on the menu.  Several healthy options.  For my first visit, I wanted to try a classic burger.  I had the All American Burger and regular fries.  Next I'll try the Cilantro Avocado Burger with jalapenos and habanero cheese.  I can't wait to go back!

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: Said it was open till 2am, closed at 1am. Waited for 30mins before waiter came over. Piano players could play different genres of music that's why I gave two stars, but it wasn't exactly a dueling piano bar (going back and forth with each other) it was more just one singing and then the other singing a song. Floors were super dirty, littered with napkins and trash.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Stopped in for a quick bite and drink before nephew's wedding.  Live music at 6 and 8:30 pm. But we wont be here for that.

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: July 12, 2019 we did the VIP lunch and it was amazing....... From the time we were escorted to the boat we were treated with the best southern hospitality you could want. Food was fresh, tasty and plentiful, the special VIP desert was fantastic. Ash was our waiter and he did a superior job in making us feel welcome and took great care of us! The show was fun and entertaining. The captain gave a fun and informative tour of the pilot house and all of the VIP extras made our experiences fantastic! Bob & Dave on the upper deck were a surprise and they did an amazing job entertaining us. Loved our day on the Cumberland River!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Your review helps others learn about great local businesses.

Please don't review this business if you received a freebie for writing this review, or if you're connected in any way to the owner or employees.

name: 360 Burger
text: Great burger place. Excellent burgers, fries, and onion rings. They are very friendly, and helpful. Good selection of beer both draft and bottled. There burgers are cooked to your requested doneness and very juicy, napkins are a must. They host live bands several nights of the week.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Visiting from Arizona and stumbled upon this place. Bartenders and servers were awesome. Shoutout to Maddie and Jackie for the awesome service!!!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Great spot for great music from singer song writers.  Heard familiar country music from big stars...but these guys were the writers!! Pretty impressive and entertaining.  Every seat is good.  A great time!

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Good food and consistently decent music playing. Not a huge space and a single stall bathroom is a drag. But the drinks are cold, food is quality, and music is good.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Loved it! Beautiful inside and the rooftop was awesome. Loved the music! We ordered the grilled chicken salad and chicken Cesar salad which both were very good and light on a hot summer afternoon.

name: The Basement East
text: I LOVE live music. Living in Nashville is tough because there are almost too many great concerts. My mind is telling me yes but my bank account is telling me no. This is why I appreciate places like The Basement East. The tickets are affordable and they bring in some maybe less-know talent that I love. Not saying that the artists aren't famous, they just aren't on the ridiculous level of say JT. I went to my first show here on a Sunday night to see Marian Hill. Tickets were a little over $30 after taxes and fees. The Basement East is in East Nashville (duh) so parking isn't a nightmare. There is a paid parking lot next to the building but we found free parking on a nearby street. Doors opened at 7:00 so we got there around 7:30. There was no line to get in and the check in process was super easy. I printed off my tickets but there was no need for that. If you bought tickets online they have all of the information on their tablet. Showed them our IDs, got a wristband, and we were in! The Basement East is a smaller dive venue. One bar in the back with reasonably priced drinks. They had a decent draft list and we were able to get an IPA for $6. There is a patio and some high top tables with chairs. The stage is at the front and is nothing fancy. Standing room only except there was one section with couches that was up a little higher. I'm guessing this is the VIP section or first come first serve. It wasn't too busy when we got there so we were able to get great spots at the front of the stage. Of course we got pushed back a bit once the music started by those concert goers that don't seem to care about personal space or basic human manners, but that's just the concert life. The concert itself was AMAZING. The sound was loud and I really don't think there is a bad spot to watch the show. We were so close to the stage so I felt like I was right there with the band. There were lights and fog so the stage was transformed into something really cool. I mean I don't think Marian Hill can do any wrong so that definitely helped. My one complaint is when I bought 2 beers at the bar, they kept my card open without telling me. I tipped in cash so I didn't even think about the fact that I didn't sign anything. I knew I was only going to be buying one drink because I was driving. So then 2 days later I got charged the extra fee for not closing out. Hard to close your tab when you don't know it's open. Oh well. Life goes on. Lesson learned. The concert was great and I will for sure be back to see more!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: A nice low key place to listen to some good music. Service was much faster than I had expected considering some of the previous reviews that I've read. A wide range of mixed drinks and beer were available, which was a plus. As the the food, I would say it was not bad but not great either. We had the wings, chips, and chicken tenders.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: The service was friendly, the food was all right. Few vegetarian options-- the portobello burger was okay. The portobello itself was a little too sweet. The fried pickles are good though- definitely get some of those. My mom said her turkey apple sandwich was mediocre... the toast was a little too charred, the sliced apples were a "jarring note". Everything was warm except the turkey, which was cold, which made the cheese cold again. The fries were good. All in all, not bad.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Come for the music .. and beers do not eat!!! Food is inedible.. I can't believe it a caption audience and service is terrible.. (not the most friendly servers) just the process.. and food is terrible!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: This was probably my favorite thing we did during our trip to Nashville. A local recommended it. We didn't decide in time to buy tickets, so we tried our luck with showing up early for the wait list. The food wasn't great, but the music was awesome!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: 5 stars for the entertainment but I'm sorry only 3 for the food, HOWEVER, come for the music because you'll be blown away. That was truly wonderful. The food needs improvement but the drinks were fine. If they stepped up the food, they'd be 5 stars in total. Bravo for the great music Listening Room. Thank you

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: I went for the lunch cruise. The food was good, and there was plenty of it. The entertainment was decent. It's hard to compare after being in downtown Nashville and hearing all the amazing artists out there. The view is very limited, as most of the ride is along a dirt/grassy bank. The only time you really see anything is when you get to downtown Nashville and you can take some pictures with the skyline in the back. The cruise mostly consisted of an older crowd. Overall it was pretty chill, and gave us something to do.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: The best experience with Craig the Kitchen Mgr and chef extraordinaire!!!  Best ribs, wing, Brussels sprouts, mashed potatoes ever!! And oh my gosh the Bloody Mary's

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: I'm not from Nashville but this feels like a true country music Nashville experience. Went on a Saturday for the 6PM show and there were 3 musicians who took turns singing songs and telling stories. The musicians were skilled, told great stories, and there was funny banter between them.  Highly recommended. Show was $5 with chicken wings, two vodka sodas, and a bowl of chili adding an additional $40 to our tab so it's easy to hit the $15 min food/drink per person.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: We tried a few artist's bars up and down Broadway and Dierk's had the best menu by far. The food was really good and the band that was playing was fun. I'd say the only downside is that the space is a bit small for the crowd.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Worst experience I've ever had at an establishment. Got a pineapple drink and the juice was rancid. I'm not one that likes to complain cause I know it's a pain as a server/bartender. Told the bartender, bleach blonde with short hair and a fake tan and she said "I don't know what the f*** you want me to do." Uhhh, remake me something else cause you gave me rancid juice...? Easy solution. Instead I was met with a girl who was clearly miserable with her life and made sure I was aware. She proceeded to ask me what I wanted and I said a vodka soda. She then slammed in the on the counter and slid it towards me. I grabbed it and threw it away. Maybe whiskey row should reconsider who they hire and who actually wants to be there, cause this chick hated her life and made sure her customer knew that. Never been treated that bad by customer service, ever. There's much better options on broadway in terms of music and especially service. Don't waste your time here

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text:
Went to Nashville for a long weekend -- good times full of good music and great eats!  Believe it or not the Swinging Door has some great grub!  Granted it's your typical bar food but it's very good (and we were even sober) I bet it's even better if you're not!  Ha! 

The Cuban was fantastic among the best I've had     and my friends loved their burgers.  We got cheesy tots as a starter--YUM!  Crispy tater tots--HELLOOO!  We also had the bloody mary which as others have said,  is a meal in itself.  It would definitely hit the spot when you need 'a hair of the dog that bit ya' on the morning after. 

This will be a regular stop on our visits to Nashville.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: Very cool museum. Had several items that had never been on display anywhere else. Great insight into Johnny's life. If you like this place, and you will, check out storytellers in Bon Aqua for a look at Johnny's getaway in the country. I'm a huge Cash fan, and maybe a little biased here, but this is a do not miss while in Nashville.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: The burger was good the friend pickles were great. The Old fashioned was amazing!!!!!!

name: General Jackson Showboat
text:
Food is ok. Nothing great.  Entertainment is also ok. Nothing great. They do try hard though. 

If I had a choice between General Jackson and taking a nap, I'd take the nap.  

The cruise is not good at all. If you like seeing a cement plant it's fine. Otherwise, there is nothing to see.  A complete waste of time.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: I have loved every visit I have made to the Listening Room.  Excited to be going back to Nashville in March and hear some great music at the Listening Room!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Disappointing experience.  The place is run like a low class dive bar.  "Security" are all over in marked T shirts and all of them have a "get out of my way" attitude. A real turn off.  The capstone was when the security bouncers came through at around 11pm and forcibly took all the bar chairs from any patron who was sitting on them.  It was a total intimidation move with "get up I'm taking the chairs".  I watched one of these goons bully a 60 year old guy and his wife who were too slow to get up for them.  Shameful.  This bar is a low class place.  Lots of better stops in the area.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
The food was ok, but the Song Suffragettes were AWESOME.  We got the brisket, slaw, mac n cheese, and potato salad. The mac n cheese was pretty dry and lukewarm. The slaw definitely needed some more kick. The brisket was pretty decent, but it definitely needed more bbq sauce. The food was definitely meh compared to some of the other places we ate in Nashville.

However, it's totally worth it to see the Song Suffragettes.  Out of all the musical performances we saw in Nashville, these were the most memorable- we swear some of them will be really famous some day. They're basically a way for young female aspiring country musicians to showcase their talent and play their songs. I'm not the biggest fan of country, but these girls basically changed my mind. Go Song Suffragettes!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Incredibly rude serving staff. On 8/4/18 a specific server told me I had to move from where I was sitting 3 different times only to let others sit where she originally told me to move. When I asked why others could sit in those places but not me she went on to tell me that they weren't preventing her from doing her job like I was. Everyone else in the bar was sitting around sipping on their drinks listening to the band playing as was I. I waited until the third time she told me to move to tell her that she was being rude and giving me an attitude and that she should at least make the others move too like she did me. She then threatened to kick me out for me telling her she was rude. I never got a "sorry" from her but I did get a few too many eye rolls before I confronted her poor behavior. In my opinion, in no circumstance should a staff member of any establishment be rude to a customer. She represented Dierks Bentley poorly and I have no doubt her employment would be questioned if her management knew how she spoke to a paying customer. On a positive note, bartenders were prompt and nice. However, wait staff was not worth the experience of this place. I will not recommend this bar to anyone.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
OMG... if you want to pay money for frozen water (that's science talk for ice), then come on down to Whiskey Row! I once went to a restaurant and had to pay for ice... just kidding, I never have. But it was such a nice experience having to pay for ice! And they loaded my tab up with a bunch of other stuff which was really neat! Like a tech fee...what the heck is that?! And the meals of the table to our left!They didn't take too long or give us any dirty looks for asking them to take it off... jk lol. Music was kewl though. 

Next time you want to pay for water, come on down to Whiskey Row!

Also, I felt like Helen Keller with the lights on my face.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
Tried to stop in along the way while visiting Nashville from NJ. Bouncer told me I couldn't go in because I was wearing athletic shorts, although they were not athletic shorts at all. After explaining that to him he moved me out of the line and yelled at me to go "back to 2nd Avenue where I belong". Clearly discriminating against black people in a disgusting way. After I called him racist This POS door staff stood there smiling and laughing at me in front of the rest of the line. Ridiculous experience and this place didn't even look worth half of the BS surrounding it just to get in. Go to anywhere else other than this crap establishment

Hi Kevin- thanks for reaching out. pretty self explanatory from above and we can air it out right here in public. From previous reviews i saw this isn't the first time you've had problems with your door staff. Let me know how i can elaborate for you.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: We were visiting from chicago and decided to walk down broadway since it's a staple! Stumbled in here randomly. The band was good! I'm not a huge country music fan but I really liked them. We sat ourselves per the sign but weren't greeted for a good 10 mins. We ordered drinks and i saw her actually bring it to the table next to us instead. The table next to us didn't even order drinks. Our drinks finally came after another 10 mins. We decided after the drink we were gonna leave, which by the way was another 10 mins for the check. Now i understand since it did get busy, but she never checked on us until we tracked her down to get the check. Nothing crazy special about this place. The drinks were ok. Probably won't come back here.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text:
Our group was asked to leave from the balcony area. The bouncer accused us of "smelling like weed" which is decidedly untrue, as I have asthma and cannot smoke anything at all. He also claimed "his boss was watching the cameras" which was untrue because there were no cameras and again, none of us were smoking anything. No vapes, no cigarettes, and definitely not weed.

A terrible experience. Our group was nothing but quiet and respectful, and we were kicked out for no discernible reason. Which leaves me to go with the only logical alternative, which is that we were unwelcome for being a group including a gay couple and a black person. That is literally the only reason we could have been asked to leave, and it is extremely disappointing behavior from a business in 2019. As the name suggests, definitely not a place that winners would enjoy.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Such an awesome place. Kid Rock did it right. All of the staff we encountered were awesome. We ate on the second story and I can't remember her name but the tiny blonde girl who served us was so nice and helpful! I had the wedge salad and it was great. My sister had a chicken sandwich and it was good too. Drinks were GREAT! I had a cocktail with moonshine in it and it was so good!!! Sorry I can't remember more, I clearly had fun! The rooftop bar is pretty cool too. All floors had live music (at least on Friday night when we went) and wonderfully hilarious photos of Kid Rock throughout the place. Also, all of the bathrooms were super clean!! Cannot wait to take my boyfriend here next time!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Noise, noise, noise. Turn the volume down management. Can't believe the city puts up with this dump having their windows open and music blaring from the first to fifth floor wide open all day. I'd never go back.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
Updating my review to inform all patrons of our latest experience. After our initial experience, Kevin tried to reach out to "right the wrong." He put my friend, who used her card, in touch with Chase, a manager. Chase promised to refund my friend in writing and even took her card information. Two weeks later, still NO refund. My friend has reached out to this establishment over via email and phone calls, consistently. This place is absolutely unprofessional. You do not offer to refund a group and the ghost them entirely. 

Do yourself a favor and stay as FAR away as possible! There is no worse experience in all of Nashville.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: Really nice museum. Very reasonable price. Lots of memorabilia. Give lots of information on the man and legend.

name: Live Oak
text: Love this place! Food is great. Service is fantastic. With the exception of it being polluted with New England Patriots memorabilia, I would be there every night if I could.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: I'm there at least twice a week and Jasmine is always rocking it keeping my friend's and my drink full. She's really nice and will chat it up if it's not busy.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: I still don't understand the need for this "Tech Fee" that they are hiding in the bill. I could understand it if you came in and ordered a cup of water, but to eat and drink, that should be waived. They also have pretty poor management as their opening time is posted as 10am on the weekends but they don't open on time and there were people waiting outside with the doors locked at 10:30 this past Sunday.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
We recently took a mini vacation to Nashville and at first we were afraid we would not have time to visit the Cash Museum. We were excited to learn it was open until 7 and that gave us plenty of time to add it to our day! 

The museum is really laid out nicely and it has memorabilia  in it from all phases of Cash's life. I grew up on country music and being able to see some of this iconic music history was a very memorable moment. 

I have visited many museums and toured lots of places but this has to be one of my all time favorites.  I loved the hands on section where you could listen to the same track on different recordings like for example the raw track, the 45 rpm, the 33 rpm and then the CD quality.  It was awesome!  The museum was also extremely educational and I learned things about this music icon that I had never known.  I think learning about his days in the military was my favorite part.

Try and budget enough time in when you visit to sit and watch the movie reels that are running in parts of the museum,  We saw footage of The Man in Black we had never seen!

While young children might not enjoy the museum, my 13 year old is a Cash fan and she was enthralled from the time the door opened.  I think she would have stayed all night. She knew more about him than even I did and taught me a thing or two as we toured. So glad we got to see this!  Look forward to our next trip!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
Location, Location, Location..

This bar is my favorite I've been to downtown thus far due to its location, multilevel differences, rooftop view, and cleanliness. I would not recommend it for cheap drinks with high alcohol content or a crowded mess of people dancing funky in a dark room. Pretty much any other bar on the strip will give you that past 10:30 pm.

We hung out on the rooftop, at first, to sip $11 frosé and watch the sunset with the awesome reflection of the Batman building insight. It did not get crowded or rowdy at all and I really enjoyed my time there. When the sun went down we danced to live country for a hot minute on the second level then made our way to some amazing live music varieties on the bottom floor. This band was multi-cultural, incredibly talented, funny, and gave the crowd what they wanted. 

The bathrooms at Whiskey Row were pretty stinkin' nice for a downtown bar and I didn't have to wait more than 30 seconds for a stall which is vey impressive. Though there are like 100 flights of stairs to get through all the levels of this place, so maybe people just hold it until the next bar to avoid the trek. The security guys were nice and things seemed to be run pretty orderly. No complaints at all other than the prices of the drinks and lack of selection variety. I will definitely be back!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: This place sucks. We've been sitting for over 40 minutes. Just wanna order some food. Have money to spend. We've asked 3 people to take our order.  Nothing. The band sucks. We are out. Won't be back here, ever...... again, this place sucks total ass......

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: We came here for lunch on a Thursday. Holllee was our server and she was pretty engaging. She helped us pick a few pretty great drinks. The food was pretty great, but there is a decent chance that the alcohol may have helped that opinion. Nevertheless, we had a great time and I would recommend it to anyone in the area!

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text:
We went on a Friday night around 11PM, and it was pretty empty. I was super surprised, it being a Fri night. The cover was $5 and the drinks are $5+. The musicians are amazingly talented!
They will play the songs that give $20 tips, and the may play dogs that give $10; $5 tips no way. We have a $10 tip for a song and they pushed it aside and clearly didn't want to play it, a Meatloaf song, yet they played a Tenacious D song. I really liked the Asian man, with long hair, he was good and personable. I think he was one of the late night replacements, for the two main guys. The main two guys were alright, a little too...vulgar-ish, for my taste. 
I probably won't go back again, it really is just a tourist trap, just like most of downtown.

name: 360 Burger
text:
We've been looking for a local place to call our hangout. We were greeted with enthusiasm. They recently changed ownership and management so they're running massive specials on bottled craft beers. The menu is no frills but EVERY burger is totally enticing. I ordered the avocado burger and the little jalapeño kick delighted me. My date ordered the BBQ bacon burger. Decadent. The onion rings were perfect and the crisp fries knocked me out.  

And... To address the reviewers who have commented that the fried pickle slices are too salty... Pickles are preserved in brine. DUH. 

I LOVE THIS PLACE. I SHALL RETURN.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Kid rocks!  Where the music is amazing!  Beyond amazing !  This bands play their a$$ off!   But..... the bartenders are rude and obnoxious and the drinks are watered down!  So sad bc this is such a great place to hang and drink in the heart of Nashville.   But classless bartenders who don't care about what they serve and make fun of patrons from across the bar, thinking no one notices, sad, pathetic and rude!   Thx Nashville!  A dime a dozen.

name: Madame Tussauds Nashville
text: All the staff are incredible but a special heartfelt shoutout to Claire (from Australia). She made our day so special and we could not be more thankful for her understanding and going above and beyond to accommodate us. Thank you, more than you know, thank you.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
When the man comes around you will probably find him here.  This tour is great for any fan of Cash.  I took my 18 y.o. daughter who knew very little of him and his music and she really liked the interaction with the cover songs and the mixing boards.  

You get to see his entire timeline from birth to his military service to his recordings and tv shows to his death.  It was somber the way they finished the tour with his cover of "hurt."

Be sure to stop here, it's worth the price of admission.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Literally awful. It's my first time in Nashville and this place was recommended by my hotel. The music was great but the food took forever to come out and it was ice cold with absolutely no flavor. They charged way too much for food that was mediocre at best. Terrible terrible experience. I would NEVER come back or suggest this place to a friend. I'd rather have Taco Bell.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Love the Arizona locations. I can't wait to get the pretzel! The cheese sauce is so good!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Had brunch today during Picks & Pints. This is an awesome, relaxed venue featuring talented singer/songwriters. We enjoyed their original songs and the stories behind them. Our server (from Ohio, can't remember his name) was excellent - he was attentive and friendly. The food was reasonably priced but was not great. The brunch menu was limited and the food was lackluster. Coffee was served in small paper cups which was surprising from an eco perspective and required more frequent refills. This was a great music city experience and we would definitely go again next time we are in Nashville. No cover, and artists work for tips.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
Kid Rock built his own brand new four story night club, which has mannequin of himself on the roof dressed in a Santa suit. (It is the holiday season ya know).

This was our last stop Friday night on our Broadway bar crawl. The sound system on each floor was LOUD, The bands on each floor ranged from good to meh, and the drinks were poured fairly strong.

That's all I got to say, or remember.......

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
Wish I didn't even have to give a star at all . We came here after the football game on Sunday . Place was very busy on first and second floors . The 3rd floor was pretty much empty so we all settled in up there .i had  a chicken sandwich and we ordered steak . The cheese was not even melted on the chicken patty and  the bun soggy and the steak was to make you sick , both plates were cold and not even edible . The barmaid Julie waited  on us and Very very rude young lady who seemed more interested in leaning over the bar to show her cleavage  to the men at the bar then waiting on her customers . 
She was very rude , we can see why they put her on the 3rd floor because she is the worst sever I have ever encountered and  she should know that woman are very good tippers and we don't care about your bleach  blonde ponytailed hair or cleavage we just wanted our food cooked and hot and a drink   . No I would never recommend this place

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
Went in, ordered drinks and we did not get what we ordered. Now I'm no bartender, but I don't think a lemon drop can be hard to make? What we got was definitely not a lemon drop and for the price of the shot, it was a disappointment. Went upstairs to dance, but not much was happening and there was no band upstairs.
Downstairs the band rocked. I think this place is more for the name than anything else.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text:
Reminded me of a dive bar, but with better-dressed patrons. And more patrons. The staff was friendly, but the crowds arrived in waves and overwhelmed the bartenders. 

Very good selection of beers, with full bar, and food available. We watched the guy in the back prepping hamburgers from fresh ground meat, so the burgers probably rock...but we had already ordered fried cheese curds. Those were okay, but greasy. 

As crowded as the place was, the joints directly on Broadway were mass chaos. It was pleasant to find a place that wasn't ear-splitting loud, away from the throngs. I'll go back, if I ever find myself in the area again.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: I have seen several complaints about the food I just had a fresh hot cheeseburger and fries and a awsome bartender  named Ashley  ...i dont live here but I'll be back I'll promise you that .. I'm SW Detroit born and will support a fellow  michigander  all day every day

name: Music City Bar and Grill
text: This place doesnt have enough love on Yelp. This place is awesome. One of the last and best of the classic honkey tonks left in Nashville. Also, in my opinion, the best buffalo wings in Nashville, and the best old style country country that isn't at Robert's. 5$ pints of good beer, and no tourists. Little Jimmy Dickens used to frequent this Tonk, and has a plaque at his seat on the bar. RIP!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
Fun place. There are 4 floors of live music which is amazing. We ate some wings which were okay, a couple beers and some well vodka drinks and we had a great time. Everyone there was just enjoying themselves so that was cool and the service was attentive and prompt. 
We would definitely return.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Dierks Whiskey Row in Nashville is lit! This multi level honkey tonk is the best bar in Broadway. I highly recommend the second story which is more of a club. The first story has country music. The DJ on the second story was legit. By far my favorite bar on the strip. Guess I know where I'm going again tonight.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: We had the best time tonight! Angel is one of the best servers I have ever had. She is a gem! Way to go Big Bang and thanks again Angel!!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
OK so this place is new and it is obviously working through a few growing pains.  That being said, I'll explain my reason for giving it two stars.  First, as mentioned before in previous reviews, they only have one bathroom on the first floor.  For everyone. Men, women, customers, employees.  Just one bathroom.  I visited on a Monday night and still had to wait in line every time I went.  Just not acceptable for what could and should be a flagship destination bar in the heart of Broadway.  There might (and hopefully are) more bathrooms upstairs but when I was there only the first floor was open.  So that's what I'm basing my judgment on.  

Second, there weren't enough bartenders and waits on drinks were long.  This has also been mentioned in previous reviews but needs to be reiterated.  What I thought was odd was that there was a TON of security there but not nearly enough staff to get the drinks to the customers in a reasonable amount of time.  And I'm all for feeling secure and being safe.  But for a tame, nondescript Monday night it felt like overkill and I feel that the manpower could have been better allocated.  

There are positives.  The location is fantastic and they have a nice interior with plenty of TVs.  It might be a nice place to watch a game (if you can get drinks without waiting forever).  I feel, and hope, these issues will be addressed as I think this place has great potential.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Mixed review.   We have spent time on the 2nd floor on two different occasions.  Both times the band was great and the table/drink service was fast.   However, the 3% tech fee is a load of crap.  Drinks are pricey ($11 for captain and coke) and even paying cash, you're subjected to a 3% tech fee.   WHAT?    What is that?   Plenty of other places to get drinks, hear music and not pay some bogus fee.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Nashville was so fun and friendly EXCEPT for this place.  Unfortunately there was a rude red headed server who decided to ignore us except when she felt like we closed the window.  She told us if we closed the window "management would be up her a$$".   We did not close the window.  It bothered he so much she kept saying something to us about the window but couldn't get our order.  She then sent security over to tell us not to close the window..... he proceeded to slam it open..... and scolded us too.  Rude!  We got up and walked out.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: We were just passing through Nashville and decided to try this place for dinner. It was a Wednesday evening and they had a live band (they were awesome, as well). We tried their 8 oz steak and it was melt-in-your-mouth delicious. Their garlicky sauce was an unexpected, delicious addition to the steak, too. I would recommend it to everyone.

name: Music City Bar and Grill
text: I was in charge of hosting a party for a group of women educators who were attending a conference in Nashville. Living in California I worked with Blake to organize this party over several months.  First I called restaurants all over town and the price here was more than reasonable.
