They were $7.50 and $9.25 roughly each. Well worth it especially since they had a country guitar player there playing older songs. Fun time!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
Went here for dinner and ordered a hamburger. It took almost an hour (or at least it felt like it) to get our food. And it was a Tuesday night.

I ordered the Cheeseburger in Paradise." So for $12.99 you get a cheeseburger with lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, sliced (not the little circles) pickles, their secret sauce with a side of fries. The hamburger was pretty bland - I don't know how to describe it, but I felt like I was just eating a piece of meat with bread and some toppings. The fries weren't any better - they were about the thickness you'd get at a fast food joint, but they were too crunchy.

Would I go there again? Probably not. It wasn't bad by any means, but for the time it took to cook the food, the underwhelming nature of the food, and the prices I will try something else next time I'm in Nashville.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Server was super friendly and nice but after putting in our order, we never saw him for over 30 mins. He came to tell us our food would be out shortly,  that meant another 30 mins, yes it took over an hour for our food to show up. Even then we had to get someone else to bring us forks and napkins, no one even found us knives. Dry chicken in a southwest salad, bland quesadilla,  very average burger but all at higher prices than normal. Asked for hot sauce and server came to table 3 times and made excuses each time of why he did not have with him. He was a trainer and taking care of other servers was more important than taking care of his own customers. Terrible service, bad food,  high prices, i think Jimmy himself would be embarrassed with this place, will never be visiting this chain again just because of this experience.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
When in a city where there's a Margaritaville, one must stop and soak in the atmosphere.

You can hear the live entertainment wherever you might be in the establishment.  The staff is super nice, and really ready to make your visit memorable.  I had picked up a shirt and one of the associates told me a story that involved one of the best country singers (Toby Keith) and how he related to the saying on the shirt.  It was awesome to the connection.

It never surprises me that each location has its own unique merchandise items to call their own.  Who doesn't want a sign that says, "I'm the woman to blame" ?

The food is good, but the margaritas are better.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: Karaoke is wonderful!!!!! They need more women's restrooms. One stall is not enough to have the traffic they have. It's quite ridiculous!!! Have respect for the customers you serve!! Close your doors if you can't renovate!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Did a tour here! Pretty regular tour. Guy was super nice and funny in a weird quirky way. One beer is included! Great spot and has great food! Tried the wings and the butternut squash hummus which is incredible! Definitely check this place out! But low key kinda hard to find.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: Great place, friendly staff had a great time and the Rische family band was super, and this from a hard rock, heavy metal guy.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
This is now my 2nd venue I've visited to see the Blues play and I was very impressed with everything.

We arrived early so we could get a feel for the place and see all the pregame activities.  They had a lot of tents set up outside for the various Nashville companies and they did their security checks outside as well.  Once on the grounds, the Preds Entertainment Team had a "Gold Rush" set up where if you were dressed in your team gear, you got to go through while they cheered you on.  Very neat, but they did not welcome the other team's fans through.

Inside the arena, we were in awe at how neat it was set up and how clean it was.  The prices of the items did not shock me as it is the same price as our hometown arena.  They had a lot of family activities, photobooth included, set up for the night.

The game itself was great, they have a lot of great umph that makes the game.  I mean who doesn't like to hear Tim McGraw's voice when the Preds score...however since the Blues won, you didn't hear it very much!

Tickets are not bad priced, check Stubhub for the best ones.

I recommend parking in the Library garage, its up 2 blocks from the arena, easy in and out and won't break the bank.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: I would give the the atmosphere 4.5 stars - excellent serving. The live music was fun and very good. We were there on a Saturday night. The food however left something to be desired, nothing to get excited about, especially Because it wasn't cheap.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Great live music, friendly staff, good food (love the taco salad) best sweet tea around!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: The Bridgestone Arena was clean and all of the staff I encountered were friendly. Nice space for our conference.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: This pub joint is simply awesome. I love the decorations of this place with an array of License Plates hanging all over the place. The band did an outstanding job. Great entertainment and Great Vibe, you simply cannot go wrong. It was a nice place too to get away from the crowds. It was simply a ton of fun!

name: Marathon Music Works
text:
I was at the Descendents show recently, and the guy running the lighting for the night was hands down the worst I've ever encountered (I've been going to shows for more than 22 years on a very routine basis, in a variety of cities / venues). 

I'm really surprised that the lights in the venue weren't all blue, so that this autistic moron could "Light It Up Blue" for Autistic Awareness all night. Idiot kept playing with the house lights WHILE the band was playing the entire time; you couldn't see the band b/c of it. There's a reason why all the lights face the stage once the show is underway.  

If this place wants to charge top dollar for its shows compared to other venues in the South, they need to step up their game. 

See the autism, hear the autism, feel the autism, BE the autism.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Not very good at all, the drinks were alright, but the food was super disappointing. I got a salad with crispy chicken on it, the lettuce looked like it was just soaked in water and put on the salad, very soggy. The chicken on top looked really delicious, but every single bite I took had a tendon in it and I couldn't eat it. My boyfriend ordered a bison burger, and while cooked very nicely, there was literally an ounce of sauce on it. Very disappointing. Came a while back and was really good. Music was AMAZING though, Tawnya Reynolds was fabulous.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: This was the worst brewery I have ever been to. The beer was not very good and all of the flavors were very bitter. I am disappointed after having a flight and not finishing any of the samples. All of the beers taste similiar and there really is no variation. I came here because it was rainy and it was not a good decision.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: The ambiance of this place is awesome. They have several high top tables set up that look out into their brewing area. I shared a sample platter with my sister. All of their beers were great. If you want food, they have a food truck set up outside. On your way out, grab a couple of growlers of your favorite beer!

name: Ole Red
text: I wanted to love it here, truly. I will preface by saying the staff is amazing and the only reason for three stars. We ate on the 5th floor, and other than the hot chicken sandwich, the food was mediocre at best. The pulled pork was somehow dry and greasy at the same time, with no sauce and a few shreds of slaw. It had to be sent back. The fries were the only saving grace for the under-sized burgers. The calamari was extremely greasy, but not in a yummy, fried way, but in a heavily over- sauced way. Quality control needs to be enforced, I doubt the famous owners would be okay with lack of care and finess coming from the kitchen.

name: Ole Red
text: Ole Red has amazing food, drinks, and live music!

name: Ole Red
text: Josh the bartender is very inconsiderate and unprofessional.  The bar is overrated and overpriced. Rude service. Won't come back.

name: Ole Red
text: Service was excellent we sat at the upstairs bar. Had a spicy and sweet cocktail it was delicious. Had the hot chicken sandwich it wasn't very spicy but when you added pickled jalapeños it was great. Pretty location. Live music all day was very good.

name: National Underground
text:
Slow service!!! 
My whole table ordered waters and were given (and charged for)  bottled water instead of ice water in a glass.  It was only 90 degrees out so we were are all fine w being limited to 16oz of water.  Got the burger every one on here was talking about.  Idk if the waitress asked us for a burger temp as a joke bc everyone at the table received a full cooked, well done burger (I ordered mine medium rare). 
Wasn't impressed w the whole experience.   Will not return.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Our party of 4 went to Jimmy Buffets Margaritaville tonite. 2 of us ordered the Bourbon Salmon. The meal was horrible. The salad was iceberg lettuce & the salmon was not edible.. it was extremely fishy and spoiled.. when I mentioned it to our waiter he sent over the manager. She said we had eaten it all except a bite or two. Which was not true!! She went ahead & said she would give us a 40% discount! When we received the bill it was more like $4 discount .. at that point it was useless to try to resolve this . I paid the bill and left . Would not recommend this restaurant if you want a good meal. It was overpriced and the food was spoiled..

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Worst jambalaya I have ever had! Took us forever to get a sever to come to the table and it wasn't even busy.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
TLDR: Great place for beer and food under one roof in The Gulch.

While there are a good number of food options in The Gulch, it's always a plus when you can have good beer and good food under one roof. In case craft beer and brewery crawls are your thing, Tennessee Brew Works is one of four breweries that you can walk to in the Gulch, in addition to New Heights, Yazoo, and Jackalope.

Tennessee Brew Works has an impressive space to work with - it's got two floors, outdoor seating, a space for live music, and TV's to watch the game. There are bars both upstairs and downstairs and they'll bring food to you no matter where you order and where you sit.

As far as the beer goes, there were 12 different beers on tap, as well as two ciders and two wine selections. In case you want to check out the tap list ahead of time prior to coming in, see here: https://www.tnbrew.com/on-tap. Pints are priced well, $5.50-7.00 per, and flights are available here for $11, which gives you 5 sample sized pours. The tap list does have your standard year round selections, seasonal beers, and small batch/one off/variants, etc. I went with the flight and got to try:

- Southern Wit (Belgian style white ale)
- Wildwood Flower (Belgian style honey blonde)
- King Chestnut (brown ale)
- Basil Ryeman
- TENN No. 12 - Imperial Porter

The Wildwood Flower and King Chestnut were okay, while they other three were pretty good. I particularly liked the TENN No. 12 - I think it's a great porter and if you like dark beers, you'll certainly like this one.

As you might already have read from other reviews, the food is pretty good here. I definitely recommend the frog legs and the poutine. The frog legs are nice and crispy and come with toast made with Southern Wit and pickles. The poutine was pretty unique - it was made with sweet potato fries and an egg. I thought it was a nice variation on a classic dish.

While there are no shortage of good places to eat in the area, I think Tennessee Brew Works is a solid option for both good food and good beer. Can't go wrong with that.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
Awesome brewery to stop through in Nashville! It's a great space with several bars, lots of tables, and a nice outdoor spot. The guys behind the bar and back in the brewery are so friendly.

The beer was great! I particularly enjoyed the "Country Hicks" sweet potato stout. The food was great too! Generous portions, with great flavors. The fries are outstanding, thinly cut and spiced perfectly!

name: 12th & Porter
text:
New ownership, new sound, new lights, and new bathrooms over the Fall 2013. It's new, improved, and renovated. The pizza place next door is brand new as well. Check it out on Facebook or Google. Old reviews are before the changes.

Please visit and post your comments.

Investor

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: We entered this bar at 8pm and a woman in our party was refused service because she was "too drunk" when we were not drunk at all. That wasn't the real problem because we realize misunderstandings happen like this. BUT she had a water bottle violently thrown at her by a bartender while he yelled "get tf out of here" when we were not violent nor protested at all. It was their loss, because we had an excellent time at other bars this evening. I wish we knew the name of the bartender so I could make a specific complaint about him. He was an older gentleman.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: The burger is incredible and the porter beer was my favorite. Nice place to hang with friends and watch a game. Only downside is the live band is way too loud.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
Stopped in for a drink here on a Sunday afternoon. I ordered the "5 o'clock Somewhere" margarita that came with rum, passion fruit tequila, Bacardi 151, orange and pineapple juice and splash of grenadine...unfortunately I did not enjoy my drink! It was way too sweet, I should have gone with the classic instead! We also ordered the Volcano Nachos to split between four people. They were huuuuge and delicious, they came with chili, cheese, pico de gallo, guac and sour cream. I would say, they could have used more of everything, once you eat the top layer you're really left with a bunch of empty chips. 

On a Sunday they had a great guitar player soothing our ears with live music. It's a really fun atmosphere. At night this place was always packed so I'd recommend getting here early if you want a seat!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Good drinks. Willing to make a cocktail off the menu. Relaxed atmosphere with acoustic guitar on a Sunday afternoon.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: Excellent venue. Nashville is one of those towns you arrive early. Getting in and out for people staying downtown was made easy by the local police closing part of Broadway. Most definitely a return trip is in order.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: Great venue for concerts. Attended a sat night concert of Counting Crows & Matchbox 20.  It is in the heart of downtown Nashville so you can hit the bars before or after. Not sure about parking because we took Uber.  I liked the food choices and bathrooms were clean and easily accessible .

name: Ole Red
text: We had a great time and actually went twice. We had dinner on the first floor and it wasn't special, but it was good. The bands we heard were great. We went back a couple days later to the rooftop Lookout and had a great time up there. It's got a lounge feel and good view. Less crowded and wild than the other rooftops on Broadway with good acoustic music.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
I have been coming to shows and events here for years. Why have I never reviewed it? Probably because I assumed that I did years ago! 
Well, making up for it now. 
I've always enjoyed attending a wide variety of offerings here.... from the Predators, to A-List concerts, to Monster Truck Jams, the CMA awards, Ice skating performances, beer tastings.. too many to name. But the point is they do them all well. Parking is relatively easy. If you can upgrade to buy a pass to park in the attached garage, I highly recommend you do. It is super convenient. 
The staff members in the suites are delightful and helpful. 
You won't get any deals on food/beverage but I'm sure you already knew that. 
We are lucky to have this gem anchor our Downtown scene.

name: Marathon Music Works
text: The security staff at this place are on a serious power trip. I volunteered that I had a couple vitamins in my pocket and the security staff was all "oh yeah you can't take those in here" after asking to see them. Like I'd volunteer that I have drugs on me and show them to the security guard if they were. I threw them away because I can tell that the security staff has a collective power trip complex, but I should have just popped them all in my mouth and be done. Love this venue but the people they hire are the worst.

name: Ole Red
text: Great venue on the Nashville strip; go through the crowded first floor and head to the top bar, The Lookout, it has all the views you are looking for. Plenty of outdoor seating and an in crowded bar. There is a limited menu but we split a classic ole red burger. Perfectly seasoned and cooked, lots of flavor. A couple of drinks and off to the EJ concert.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
I truly would not waste my time or money here. Go somewhere local and more authentic. This is a tourist trap. 

We visited Matgaritaville after seeing a concert in Nashville. My husband really wanted a margarita and this seemed perfect. 

We came in late in the night (but several hours before closing) and the wait staff was very apathetic. No one really seemed to care about what they were doing or who they were serving. The menu is also kind all over the place food-wise. And the prices for the food offerings are exorbitant - I'm guessing because of location and the brand. NOT worth it. 

Our drinks were fine and our food were fine but certainly *certainly* not worth what we paid. You can get the same thing PROBABLY MUCH BETTER from Chili's for a fraction of the cost.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text:
This was on May 25, 2019: 
It's a long read but STICK WITH ME... 

We were in Nashville, TN celebrating my Best Friend's Bachelorette Party. We had signed up to do the Party Barge (the pick up location is behind Losers Bar and Grill-- next door). So we thought we would grab dinner at Winner's Bar and Grill because it was recommended and their website had a good menu. Upon arrival, we all sat down and waited for a server to greet us. After about 5 minutes she came over and passed out a little piece of paper with about 5 menu items on it and didn't say anything else. She came back and asked us for our drink orders, we gave them to her and she took our credit cards? Which I thought was strange because we weren't intending on keeping an open tab. We also asked for water and she rudely said: "It's over there" and pointed to a water dispenser on the bar. After we get our drinks she explains their kitchen is "under construction" so that list is all they had. It was BBQ pulled pork, hamburgers, hot dogs, and chips... We just decided to get something anyways and would have a nicer dinner afterwards (because we were about to drink and needed food...) Next, the server told us we had to order all our food at the bar because she wasn't a "waitress". Ok. So we had to wait in line and finally all ordered our food at 5:30pm and we needed to be next door for the Party Barge at 6:30pm. We then proceeded to go ahead and close out our tabs while we waited. First, the same server charged me double. I ordered a hamburger and ONE beer. She charged me $20 when it should have been $10. She also messed up my friend's payment as well. After that, I was already annoyed. But hold on, it gets worse. We are STILL waiting for our food 30 minutes later. Food that shouldn't take longer than 15 minutes to cook. We then told them again we're on a time constraint, the other bartender was rude and said it would be out in 5-8 minutes. Finally, two girls got their pulled pork sandwiches WITHOUT BBQ because they "didn't have any" although that's what their terrible little menu said it came with. Who eats a pulled pork sandwich with NO SAUCE? Also it was ICE COLD. It's now 6:15pm at this point and then two orders of hot dogs come out. They looked DISGUSTING and guess what? COLD. At that point we went up and complained and nicely asked for our money back because 1. The food was coming out terrible and cold 2. We had to be next door in the next 15 minutes. A guy comes out who I thought was the manager? But I'm not sure... We tell him all the issues and we want our money back. He leaves for like 5 minutes and comes back opens the cash register and then THROWS the $45 in 5's at me. Then he grabs the boxes of hot dogs and aggressively threw them in the trash. I said "Have a good night" and walked out. As we met the other girls outside they show me a video of the "server" and "manager" cooking our food out back in a MICROWAVE and they said once we cancelled our orders they unplugged the microwave and took it back inside. ARE YOU KIDDING ME? *PICTURE IS ATTACHED* They should have just said they aren't serving food at this time and ALL OF THIS could have been avoided but they were trying to make a quick buck by serving low quality food. The service and food was BY FAR the worst experience I have had in the city of Nashville. I will tell everyone to NEVER attend this establishment. They should be shut down for their TERRIBLE service. We have all been in the restaurant industry and could not believe this Bar and Grill is still open after we experienced their RUDE staff and TERRIBLE food.

NEVER GO HERE.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: Huge venue! Clean and the temperature was cold! A lot to choose from for food and drinks.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
While I admit a lack the personal experience for a truly good review of Bridgestone, not being much of a sportsball person or concert goer there is a lot to like. 

The place is very big and has stalls for food and merchandise everywhere.  The Stadiums I went to in my youth (The old Tiger Stadium, Cobo Arena, The Palace) Bridgestone is a wonderland of stuff.

Having said that of course, it's all about the mighty dollar for places like this. 12 dollars for Beer in a can. 9 dollars for a glass of Wine, etc.

While capitalism certainly supports this, I didn't find myself very excited to when I'm already spending 200 dollars for two Foo Fighters tickets.

But there are certainly worse places to spend two hours, and the Stadium IS well maintained and clean.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: I came here 3 times this year (Disturbed concert, Korn/Alice in chains concert and Preds vs panthers game) and i loved all 3 events. But one thing that i don't like about this whole arena is the price range for tickets to any event, especially for one person. ($60/person for a seat in the nosebleeds and $1000+/person for a front row seat depending on it being a predators rivalry game or if it's a final tour for a good band we know and love)

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: Arrived about 30 minutes early to see Keith Urban, a sold out event. The crowd moved through security easily and seemingly effectively....  The venue is pleasing to the eye -- big bright colorful busy -- easy to navigate. Friendly staff. Plenty of friendly vendors. Beer and wine was offered. All went well --- after the show, we were able to get out and onto the streets with no thought. We arrived by cab and walked back to our hotel so no parking info from me

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
Great brewery -- probably my favorite in Nashville.  They have very good beer (3 different IPAs on tap on my last visit) and surprisingly good food (particularly burgers).

The setup of the building is unique and (mostly) functional.  There are two floors with a separate area upstairs, which can be rented out for private events.  My only qualm with the setup is that it can get loud upstairs since it's open.  For better or worse, they have songwriters performing downstairs about every night, I believe, and the noise travels up to the second floor.  Depending on your mood and preferences, hearing the music up there could be a pro or a con.

There isn't really a parking lot, but there is ample space to park along the street nearby.  The area can feel a bit seedy, but I've never had any issues after several visits.  Definitely worth a visit!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: The food was excellent as always! The service was just okay this time. We waited about 45 minutes to get our food tonight. Yes, it is a Saturday, but we came in at about 7:00, were seated immediately, and there were many open tables while we ate. Then, someone at the table spilled their water and were not offered another one. Many other people in our party were left without refills as well.

name: Marathon Music Works
text: I went to see Greta Van Fleet last night (5/14/18). Amazing band!!!! Such energy and talent! I have read many reviews of the staff being rude but my bartender was friendly and pleasant! This place reminds of the old defunct venue City Hall that was on 12th Ave. in the Gulch and is now an Urban Outfitters Store. Now the bad...they should change the name of this venue and call it THE FURNACE!!! If hell can be any hotter than this venue, then count me out the next time a band I want to see is playing there! The mercury levels and heat index had to be in the triple digits. I stood in an area where I could still see, but not elbow to elbow with everyone. My shirt was soaked by the night's end, I could feel sweat running down my back the entire evening, and went through many paper towels wiping my face. It might have been cooler having the show outside in the parking lot. The venue had many huge ceiling fans, but must have been for decorative purposes because you could see the blades of the fan as it spun...created no air current whatsoever!!! If you attend a show here, I guess hope that your favorite bands come between November through March, then it would be more tolerable to attend.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: this place keeps getting better!!!! last time i came they were not serving food yet. so, we got the cheese board and charcuterie board. damn they were good! and the presentation was beautiful too. great live music, delicious craft beer, dart boards, tvs to watch games on, a well thought out space and patio all make for a stellar experience. staff was stressed, but were killing it and working so hard. taking the busy day in stride. love that they have a bar upstairs and downstairs. just love this place!!! really love when places improve upon themselves. smashing it!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
While attending the CMT Awards show in town this arena is HUGE!!! Very clean and helpful staff...this is a great venue for big concerts. The acoustics are awesome...

Will Definetly go to a concert here and I highly recommend it. 
I would tell everyone that goes to this arena to take an Uber ride and get dropped off as parking is not-so-good in this tight touristy area.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: Layla's was the first bar we ventured into on Broadway, and it was a great choice. The band was rocking, the beers were ice cold, and the bartender was easy on the eyes. We hung out for several rounds then decided to head elsewhere, though we ended our night back at Layla's. The bar is a little divey, but only in the best way possible. The bathrooms were clean enough even for this high-maintenance gal. I loved that the TVs were showing hockey playoffs; not something I expected in Nashville, despite the nearby Predators stadium. Definitely recommended for some good times!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Usually this chain is very nice.  This one however was a bit below expectations.  Food was not well prepared, service was indifferent, and the music was not anywhere as good as in the other places along Broadway in Nashville.  Perhaps it simply paled a bit by comparison to the Nashville scene.

name: Ole Red
text: Stopped in here after the Southern. First listened to music on the first floor and hubby had a beer. Great band. Then moseyed  up to the fourth floor which has a rooftop  bar. Best views on broadway!!!!!i really appreciated being able to get a good glass of Vino. Hard to find on "beer guzzling" Broadway! This will be a "go-to"  from here on in. Next time will try some snacks

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Great place with great food, drinks, and music but needs some serious cleaning of the bar.  We scraped some off easily but it's gross we eat here

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Great food and the ABSOLUTE BEST service in Nashville! Ask for BRANDON, he is the best ever!!!! They play awesome music and the food is amazing!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: This place was exactly what we were looking for! We enjoyed both bands that played and the line dancing that was spontaneously happening during the whole first band and part of the second band. Many of the dances people were choosing were easy-only several moves repeated over and over-as someone that doesn't have a lot of line dance experience it was great-easy to catch on and everyone seemed friendly. The line dance lessons from the instructor were fun too. They had fair drink prices and we got souvenir mugs that you could get refills on. The place is huge-3 levels-not overly crowded though, and they have pool tables, shuffle board, and foosball on the upper levels. You can watch the band/dancing from the upper floors too. If you're looking for a fun place in the heart of downtown Nashville to do some country line dancing and hear some good music this place is highly recommended.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Came here for a work party and concert. I was so impressed!! Way larger inside than I expected. Had the fried chicken, Mac n cheese, pulled pork... so yummy! Generous pour on the drinks too yeeehaw!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: The lack of draft beer and the fact that they pour wine out of tiny little single service bottles was a bit of a surprise for a place like this right on Broadway in Nashville.  The music was good.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
Holy crap... This is a place with New York City prices but substandard food. Yes its a in fun and trendy midtown. 

My Pizza (Jacksonian) was ridiculously oversalted... It wasn't just me! My neighbor ordered Nachos and holy crap... also insanely oversalted. 

Yes the place feels trendy and the music is of the perfect volume - loud enough to be fun, yet quiet enough to chat... 

Oh and you better take an uber here because parking is INSANE!!! (as in 15 dollars for parking or you'll be parking illegally). 

Oh and... $5.50 for a blue moon-crazy...

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: A nice spot outside of the crowds of Broadway to catch some live music. Lots of space both indoor and out.

name: Nashville Palace
text: Always a great band and great bartenders. I have lived in Nashville for 6 years and don't often frequent bars near Opryland but if I catch a movie or do some shopping at Opry Mills I usually grab a drink here afterwards.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: We stayed nearby at JW Marriott and saw this place so decided to try it one of the nights we were in town. We liked it a lot!! HUGE tv, good food and service and a somewhat fun atmosphere. We had the loaded spoon fries thing, meatloaf and chicken friend chicken. Everything was really good. I'm not a southern food expert so don't know how it compares but we enjoyed it. The meatloaf was mushy - is that a southern thing? Good comfort food regardless. Our appy came out same time as meal so the Manager proactively offered to comp it we never said a word. Nice touch and good meal. There were times I server was hard to track down though.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Great music, family friendly,  good pulled pork and overall great place.

Band was great and honored all our requests except Taylor Swift which was understandable. 

Pulled pork was melt in your mouth good.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
I've always ended up at Wildhorse with out of town guest and in the past 15 years always had a great time and great service.  So knowing my sister likes line dancing, Wildhorse was a must for her Bachelorette party.  I was suprised how much customer service has gone downhill.  Band was great and plenty of space on the dance floor, but the bar tenders were unbelievably rude.  
After waiting 10 minutes he helped one of the 6 of us standing there and went on to someone whom just stepped up to the bar.  One in our group rolled her eyes and he immediately told us that wasn't gonna get us served any faster.  Two of us went to one of the other bars there standing another 10 minutes patiently waiting and the bar tender left the bar went to our group and accused them of not paying him for 2 drinks.  I understand we were 1 of 4 or 5 other bachelorette parties there in black dresses so easily can be confused, but then he came back to the bar purposely ignoring the 2 of us keeping his back to us.  
As a former Gaylord Employee I can not believe how customer service has gone down so much.  We won't be back.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: My husband and I went here for a late night snack and while we were eating we saw a mouse come out of the walls. My husband pointed it out to our waitress and she said nothing. Then my husband went to the bathroom and saw another mouse traveling along the baseboard of the floor. Needless to say we left as quickly as we could. We at least expected some kind of accommodation from our waitress, Monica.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
Overall--This place is average. The atmosphere is fun and loved the music and music inspired art. Service was friendly.

We went on a Saturday afternoon to watch football with some food and beers. There are about 4-5 large TVs however wouldn't recommend this as a great place to watch a game. Beer list was decent however not up to date with what they had. Our nachos were average--the sandwiches average--and the pizza average. It was nice that you could customize a small 8'' pizza. 

Overall--average.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Well, first off, this place is huge! When we were there it seemed practically empty, even though there were plenty of people there. The food is good, not awesome. The drinks are wayyy too expensive for what you get, and especially compared to what other bars charge. Some of them come in souvenir glasses, which are cute, but you can't just refill that glass. So if you order more than one, you end up with a bunch of glasses you have to cart around for the rest of the night. And you have to pay another $13 each time you want another drink. They do give free line dancing lessons, which is fun! And when we were there, this local band called Brother Trouble was playing and they were great. We had a lot of fun, but mostly because of the band and each other's company...the bar itself isn't anything special.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Had a great time at a company event, live country, fried pickles, line dancing instruction, what more could you want?

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: The pizza is mediocre, the "fun and funky" atmosphere feels forced, and the service is meh.  I wanted to like Soulshine, and I wanted to give it another chance, but it's not even worth it with number of much better pizza places I. Nashville.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Great for groups and if you're afraid you're going to be terrible at line dancing, don't worry because there are a dozen other people who look just as ridiculous trying. Jokes aside, they've got really talented live singers who take you through all the steps and someone on the floor to lead they way!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: This was our first meal in Nashville and it was nothing short of delicious!! Fried pickles? Pulled chicken? Pulled pork? burgers?All of the sides?  I would defiantly recommend this place to all of the Nashville tourists!!! Bucket of domestics was $6!! A couple floors of great music and great food!!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
There are plenty of pizza joints in Nashville, but the newest is Soulshine Pizza Factory on Division Street. This place started down in Mississippi and you can tell what the influences are by looking on the menu .Since they have opened, I have dined in twice and had take-out once. Each time I have been there, it has not been busy. The food and service has always been good. The building is brick inside and out with smooth concrete flooring. The atmosphere is very nice upstairs and downstairs with a bar downstairs which sits under the stairs. The downstairs bar is not that big but it is cute and it works. A few tables are sprinkled in the middle of the floor while booths surround the area. There is also a big ceiling fan in the room which fits the décor. Upstairs is a larger bar, tables, a stage  and an unfinished roof patio that will be great when the summer gets here. The music is bluesy, and there is great colorful artwork on the walls including a picture of Redd Foxx aka Fred G Sanford.

Soulshine has weekday lunch specials, and the pizza at this place is really good. They have various types of pizza, and you can also create your own. The 28 pizzas to choose from have very gimmicky names like the Mississippian which has pulled and grilled chicken, pepper jack cheese and sun dried tomatoes. Sleeps with the fishes has Alfredo sauce, mozzarella, spinach, bell peppers, shrimp, crab meat, and goat cheese (does not sound appetizing to me). All pizza can be made into a calzone or you can have white or wheat dough. Appetizers range from wings to cream of crawfish soup, and hummus for you vegetarians. They have several Po-boy sandwiches such as the Mama Mia which I have had. It's a meatball sandwich with marina, mozzarella, and delicious bread (Very tasty). They also have a very delicious sounding muffaletta. My friends that I have dined with had the Greek salad which they both loved. The Greek had romaine lettuce, black olives, peppers, onions, and feta cheese. Entrees include red beans and rice, Nathan Hotdogs, and Spaghetti with meatballs. They have only a few desserts but that "slap yo momma bread puddin" is soooo magnificent the sauce is sweet with a taste of bourbon. An employee told me that it had apples in it but I did not taste the apples; however, I devoured it.

This is a wonderful place with ok staff and a lot of options. It is a great spot for groups and a late night weekend bite. We were informed that the people rent out the upstairs area for parties. They also have a psychedelic van that advertises catering. Mid-Town in Nashville is getting better with each additional restaurant. I recommend this pizza joint to anyone especially to the college "kids" (the po-boys are better than the pizza). The space next door is owned by some of the same people, and rumor is, they are going to open a sliders restaurant.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
This is a medium to partly cloudy review. We came to see a friend's band (THE TRAILS!). Got there around 8pm and made our way upstairs to the heated covered patio. We've been to Mafiaosa's heated covered patio before and froze our balls off, so I came dressed to ski. Didn't need it - the temp was perfect. Go teach Mafiaoza's how to heat a patio, please.

Anyway, the downstairs looks very nice, and the atmosphere upstairs is very casual and laid back - so laid back that the upstairs is first come first served. Not a freakin fan of stalking people while they eat, along with 20 other stalkers. That was a 30 minute ordeal, along with semi-confrontations of the "Hey! I stalked this table before you stalked this table!" and "Are you REALLY using those two chairs?" variety. 

The pizza is average. Anyone who says anything like "this is the best pizza I ever had!" is either drunk, 18 years old, or friends of the owners. We also had hummus that was...pinker than expected, but tasted fine, and cheese/garlic bread that was good. Local beers on tap, prices above average for pizza joints but average for the Midtown area. 

There is valet thank goodness, but they charge $5 if you have the restaurant validate ($15 if you abuse them and go elsewhere). I'm not meaning to complain about this, just to let you know. 

To sum it up: Come for the atmosphere, the drinks and the music! Don't get too excited about the food though. Nothing overly creative or delicious going on here.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Eat, drink, and dance. I was there 2 nights and had a great time. Ordered pulled pork sandwich with slaw and fried pickled chips. Was very good. Live band performance was awesome. When band takes a break a mini line dance lesson is given. At 10pm guest under 21 are asked to leave. Will definitely return.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: The service was not very good. But the food was pretty decent BBQ. The pulled pork sandwich was very good. The fries were plain (they needed seasoning). The beans and the potato salad were both very good. Friend had the BBQ sampler for an appetizer and it was very good. The hot links were great.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: this place looks small from the outside but it is the perfect venue for music inside! we saw benton blount there this past week & they were amazing! made our entire time there! the prices of food & drinks were a little crazy but the souvenir add ins were just too cute to pass up! definitely a must see if you're in nashville! plenty of line dancing & quick lessons for beginners so you can dance to the bands or music playing. i don't know if i'd eat there agin (besides the fried pickles they were phenomenal) but the venue for music was astonishing

name: Big Machine Brewery & Distillery
text: Great service. Delicious lemonade slushies with vodka or whiskey floaters distilled on the premises. Just a bit pricey with a floater

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Great Spot to listen to live music & grab a drink, but don't waste your money on the extremely overpriced food! It's terrible!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: $15 for a good pulled pork, beer, and live music. Lackluster menu. The band was great, but had very limited song choices.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
what a big big let down.horrible horrible service and nasty drinks! the server had a "so what attitude" i saw him telling the manager what i said about the bloody mary mix,  he too gestured "what ever"

of all the places i visited while on vacation in nashville, this was -is my regret. 
it's a numbers game is why they are still open. nothing to do with customer service, good drinks or good food.

i get ticked just thinking of the nasty attitude projected on us.

never again--- skip this place!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
Sorry Soulshine, I wasn't impressed with you.

Coming in on a Friday night, I was surprised to get a table immediately and had high hopes after a good start. They were busy inside, but not packed and I really liked the big open restaurant and nice patio. Our waitress started off friendly but when it took a while to get our drinks and order, I should have known we were in trouble. She was very frazzled early on; not sure if she was just new or had too many tables or what, but she came over in a panic saying she couldn't take our order because she set down her book somewhere. Um, OK?  

Once we were able to order food, we ordered the tamales and hummus to snack on, then the mushroom pizza as an entree. The tamales were ground beef and spicy, and the best thing we ate. The hummus was decent but had an olive tapenade that overpowered the hummus. I didn't love it. The pizza was middle of the line, OK, but not amazing either. 

I would probably have given them an OK rating, but trying to get the bill and get it correctly was a CHORE. We were still enjoying our drinks and our bill was brought to the table. Um... we hadn't asked for the check and were going to use a ScoutMob coupon for half off. Plus our waitress added on a drink that wasn't ours. When we asked to use the coupon, our waitress gave us an attitude and said "it's going to take me a minute to redo it." Um, we get that but we would have told you about the coupon if you had asked if we were ready for the check. Sigh. The "minute" turned into 20. We waited and waited for our check, and when we FINALLY got it, (and it was still incorrect) we just paid and bolted for the door. It wasn't worth trying to fix.

I'm not sure I'll be back to Soulshine. If the food was better I might be tempted, but with middle of the line food I think I'll pick somewhere else next time.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Stopped in here twice this weekend during my cousins bachelorette party. It was our last stop on our bar hop Saturday night. Good crowd and had a decent band playing.

Then we stopped by for mid-afternoon drinks on Sunday. It was gorgeous out so we hit the second floor which is completely open but still has a roof which was AWESOME! The open layout allowed for a warm breeze and let us be outside without baking in the sun. The acoustic trio was really good. I have a feeling this bar gets a lot of the better gigs due to it's size.

Being from the Tri-state area, we were impressed at the drink prices being much more reasonable than NYC.

Also the male wait staff wear a great t-shirt. Gotta love dirty puns!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Easily one of the best nights we spent in Nashville! The band was fantastic and it was great for people of all ages... Adults had the bar and drinks and kids and teens still had many ways to enjoy themselves. The band -Southbound Honey- was wonderful and played sets that were both modern and classic country and people of all ages were enjoying the dance floor. The line dancing lessons, although somewhat basic were a lot of fun and people continued to do them into the band's sets. Overall a wonderful night and I would most definitely return!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: This place is the bomb to go to on broadway for a quick meal. The waitress we had was amazing and the pulled pork and Mac n cheese were awesome. The bands that play there are some of the best to listen to on the block. Have gone there multiple times and will continue to.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: The pulled chicken was very dry, as was the burger. The burger had no flavor. No draught beers and they definitely charge the tourist tax.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Cover charge to eat mediocre food and $5 bottles. Loud, can't hardly hear the person next to you. My short rib grilled cheese was awful. Meat was bland, dry, jerky like, bread tasted like they cooked it in a whole stick of butter. Had to drown it in bbq sauce to make it edible. Save your money and go to honkey tonk row!

name: Nashville Palace
text: Fun bar. We went for a private party with a band. The area was HUGE. It was clean. The food (buffet style catering) was good, and the drinks were good too. I wasn't drinking alcohol but my colleagues were. They had several holiday signature drinks which looked great. Bartenders were efficient and friendly. Staff cleared things quickly too. I enjoyed the experience, especially since it was free!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
The Wildhorse Saloon is a top notch venue to experience Nashville in a truly fun way. The layout is ideal to accommodate a lot of people. Great sound system, and plenty of really good views of the stage when bands are playing. 

The food was good- typical local fare. The bars are nice and spacious, so it's easy to get service when you need it. 

Tonight I saw two bands: Brother Trouble and The Band Perry. Both sounded great I this place. 

If you want to experience Nashville's music scene check out this place!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Delicious !!! Laid back eclectic hip pizza place ! Patio seating , live music , beer , wine , and awesome art work of musicians !

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: The staff was very friendly and it was interesting to be somewhere I've seen on TV, but the food was terrible.  No one finished what they ordered, nothing was very tasty.  Go to hangout and drink I guess, but the food isn't worth it.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Food is so-so and a little overpriced for the quality, but you really go there for the atmosphere anyway.  Very family friendly, good service. Enjoyed live music and learning to line dance. Great space.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: VERY small pizza portions. Good pizza but tempted not to come back because I'm still starving after getting a small/what's normally a personal size pizza. Step your game up.

name: Twin Kegs
text: Great local dive bar! Burgers and bites are on point and the beer is always flowing!!

name: CMA Fest
text:
The CMA Music Festival has a lot of good points, but it is seriously failing the attendees in lots of ways:

-The Concert Saturday night had  a SCHEDULE.  The schedule was a joke as they inserted some rock act (at a Country Music Festival?) that no one really cared about.  

A pathetic attempt to pander put the entire program off schedule.

ADMIT IT! THIS IS A COUNTRY WESTERN MUSIC FESTIVAL?  ALL KINDS OF COUNTY ARTISTS WOULD LOVE TO GET ON THE "BIG STAGE" AND YOU WASTE OUR TIME WITH THIS CRAP?  PLUS NOT GIVE THE CHANCE TO SOMEONE WHO WILL APPRECIATE IT?

We realize we may not always like the "new Country", and that is fine.  Change is necessary and younger fans will have different tastes.  BUT WASTING AN HOUR WITH SOME JOKE THAT IS JUST NOISE????? THIS IS A COUNTRY MUSIC FESTIVAL--WHY NOT ADMIT IT AND PLAY COUNTRY MUSIC.  LET THE OTHER MUSIC HAVE IT'S OWN FESTIVAL!!!!!

The Music Hall (Fan Hall) IS NOT "Disability friendly", in fact I don't believe it complies with ADA standards.  

The CMA Festival staff was rude, uncaring and the worst experience I have ever had at a music festival or even an event.  We were  ignored, laughed at and given wrong information just to get rid of us.

My wife is not disabled, just can't walk stairs.  There is NO WAY into the BRAND NEW MUSIC HALL.  What a joke. 

WHY SHOULD I WASTE MY MONEY ON THIS AGAIN?

name: Nashville Palace
text: Great older western music acts.  Very friendly staff and a great variety of performers.

name: Big Machine Brewery & Distillery
text: Marissa grabbed us off the sidewalk and gave us free drinks, how can you ask for a better day?  She was friendly and knowledgeable. We will be back. Thanks Marissa!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Total tourist trap.... loved it. Especially since there are places upstairs where you can smoke. How awesome is that? 

Place was rockin pretty hard when we got there on a Saturday night. Saw a kid jump up on the bar and start dancing.... couple guys popped out of the shadows and whisked him out the back before you could blink. Place didn't skip a beat. 

Pulled pork in the nachos... awesome. Chx wings "had some stank on em" according to my counterpart from Kentucky. (That means spicy in a good way apparently) Spicy BBQ sauce had nice heat to it as well. So much food I was able to share with the table, still didn't finish everything. 

Pretty good place to hang out.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: The ribs and pulled pork are great, and the baked beans are very tasty too. I tried the Yazoo pale ale but I wouldn't try it again. The live band was good, not too loud either so we could still hold a conversation.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
A fun atmosphere with live music (multiple floors), and good food. Sat on the 2nd floor with a breeze blowing through the big open room which made it very comfortable. 

We had the pulled chicken platter with potato salad and baked beans and the half rack of ribs with baked beans and onion rings. Both were flavorful and worth ordering again. Would go again!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Nachos and pizza are great! Nice place to hang out in Midtown, often have life music.  A little expensive but not too bad, mushroom pizza is fantastic.!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
The service here sucked. I'm generally very lenient with my Yelp stars but I have never been so  disgusted with treatment. So I'm in Nashville for a week long conference with my research group. We don't have the cowboy look down so clearly we're from out of town- isn't southern hospitality a thing? Not here. We first took a table downstairs because it was open and close to the band that was playing but when no one came around the able for 10 minutes we decided to go upstairs (plus it was warmer).

The band upstair was great as well. Very loud, but that's to be expected. Again, we sat at the table for 10 minutes with not a glance in our direction. We caught a bus boy who said he would send a server over. Nothing. I went up and asked a server who was cashing out what we needed to do and he told me the table we sat at was the bartenders territory. No problem, we talked to the bartender. It's unfortunate that I don't have a penis because that was clearly what she was paying attention to. 

Eventually we placed our order and it came out in a decent amount of time. We had the sampler plus an order of the catfish. Both were decent and together it fed four people pretty well. Obviously check out was a disaster and when I handed her four credit cards (before she even printed bills) I got a dirty look and an eye roll. Sorry, do you have conference traffic through here? It's the tourist district of Nashville, is it not? Ugh. The busboy was super nice and friendly to talk to, he had great advice for what we should check out in Nashville, the two stars are for him and him alone. I hope he got most of our tips... Would not recommend.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Food is pretty solid and the music is usually pretty solid, too.  Their fries are great!  One of the better food to music ratios on Broadway, in my opinion.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Too bad great big nice bar crappy band. Are we in Nashville? I'm sure they have much better talent in this city. Came here from California hoping to see good music venues. Hope it gets better as this is my first day. They use soundtracks!! Geez

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: I went here with a large group.  Reservations were planned in advance.  WOW...Great live music.  Great food and drinks.  Great service and friendly staff.  Reasonable prices for a great experience.  The country dance lessons are fun.  This place is a MUST DO in Nashville.  I could come back here every night.

name: Nashville Palace
text: Great place to listen to local talent, grab lunch and take in Nashville in an authentic honky tonk after visiting the Opryland hotel. Service was great!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Check out the smoked pulled chicken. The food is good but the service leaves allot to be desired. This place is busy but they don't staff accordingly. You will get a seat and service if you get there after the crowd has left. Otherwise, you will have to sit in a strangers lap. Some of the wait staff is friendly but dont expect them all to be.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: We were there over 4th of July weekend and it was crazy busy! Not sure if this is typical or not. There was no reserved seating so you have to walk around and hope for the best. We managed to find a small high top table and then located two bar stools in a different area. There were two live bands playing. We really enjoyed the band in our area. I am not even much of a country fan but both the male and female lead singers did a great job.  The BBQ was decent. I had the pulled pork and my husband had ribs. I think both would have been better with some different sauce options. The sides were quite good. I had potato salad and beans and my husband had fries and cole slaw.  We shared an order of the corn cakes and they were very good!  Overall, solid bbq but not anywhere near the best we've ever had.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Band was really good. Food was decent at best. I'm from the northeast and I've had better ribs up there. Chilis has better ribs. Unless your having a beer and going to watch live music, skip this place. Go across the street to Jacks..

name: Nashville Palace
text: Looking for a quick bite before heading home. This place was very good, my burger was cooked just the way I ordered it. And the onion rings were very good. They had local entertainment going on while we was there and he did a good job. Will visit again in the evening hours to listen to more music.

name: Nashville Palace
text: A classic Nashville hang... If you want to hear real authentic American country music, look no further. The food is pretty good for bar fate, too! The Fried pickles, sammies and burgers are all wonderful. If you're in the Opryland area... You can't beat it.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: We went to a bunch of bars on Broadway and this was probably my least favorite one. They had TV's on with all the games, which was nice, but the band was not very good and no one seemed into them. We ended up leaving after just one drink.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
Bottom line: you may like this place for drinks and music, but be sure to eat at home before coming.
We stopped by for lunch, having stayed at a hotel around the corner. What a mistake. We had pizza & spaghetti with meatballs. Very basic. What we got was terrible. I suspect that someone had a plan here - how to serve a menu, all just assembled from items off a food service truck, and done so consistently that it doesn't matter who works in the kitchen. 
Any delivery to our hotel room (Domino's, Papa John's, etc.) would have likely been better.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: If you want a lively place to eat, you have picked it. This place has good food and is a great place to catch some live music and drinks. I have been here numerous times and have enjoyed my experience every time.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
Firstly, I really don't like giving bad reviews because i figure if its open someone must like it. Bad reviews are simply a matter of opinion and good reviews speak louder. However, i just couldn't stop thinking about how horrible this place was and after 3 weeks of stewing on it i just had to write this one.

Unless you happen to be from Oxford and feeling nastalgic, this place is a total joke. The fact that they advertise their "Live Music all the time" before their pizza should clue you in. The pizza is the worst Ive ever had(seriously) and we ordered multiple pies as well as sandwiches. All were dry, flavorless and über expensive. $24 on average with close comparison to Little Caesars....which is totally worth $5. Beer was on the high side as well at $5/pt. and to top it all off, they have the audacity to put a tip line for the band on your tab! 

Up side: Excellent patio.
Will not be going back.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
'Ribs' is in their name - but don't be fooled. Just go to Jack's across the street. These ribs were dry. They were bland. They weren't very meaty. And the overly sweet sauce tasted like something off the shelf from Kroger. Ditto for the side dishes.
On this Monday night, the cover bands were OK.  The service was OK. The whole place was generally disheveled.
I won't be back.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
Do not recommend going here

This is totally not an authentic Nashville place, it's too touristy. Many of their drinks come with a souvenir cup and are over priced. I had a misunderstanding with our waitress about which wine I ordered. As a waitress myself, I would apologize for not confirming which one I wanted and charge the price of the wine they meant to order. She instead argued with me, she called out her manager, and he argued with me TOO. I was in complete shock as my family owns a restaurant plus I am a waitress myself. So I just paid the full bill and wanted exit as quickly as possible.

Also, we came here for line dancing. everyone recommended it as a main event. It was instead just a small group on teens being instructed very basically the steps for about 10 minutes at most. It was definitely not as fun and exciting as I would expect such a big venue to produce for something they are known for.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Very casual eating , plastic utensils and plates. 
Attentive wait staff. Quick service
The chicken was moist and prob best chicken ive had in a while. My daughter got the ribs and loved it also.  I would recommend.  Live music and the kids were allowed after 8 was hard to find a place for them.  
There are 2 floors and you seat your self.

name: Nashville Palace
text: Great music- I loved the bologna sandwich. Most of the rest of our party did not like there food. Good ambience

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Wildhorse was a solid honky-tonk to visit on our first trip to Nashville. It had a good atmosphere for line dancing, even though the performer for the night was sub-par. It was a very spacious location, with three floors(the bottom floor for eating, dancing, and a small bar, and the upper floors with bars overlooking the dance floor as well as pool tables). The food was overpriced, but not bad. Overall, it was a memorable experience, but not a memorable meal.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Our company reserved the entire place  on a Sunday night. About 400 of us filled the two floors. Live band was playing and buffet style food at both floors. Bars are plenty abound, friendly staffs!! Few of Their staffs were on the dance floor encouraging everybody to dance and even  dance lesson on line dancing.

name: Nashville Palace
text: Go for the music and/or cocktails.  The food is pretty lousy and the service is not good either.  I had the chicken "fajita" tacos, and there wasn't anything fajita about them.  The chicken was pulled chicken that was extremely dry.  Hubby had the chicken Caesar Salad.  LOTS of the lettuce was very debatable AND the chicken was the same dry pulled chicken mentioned above.  Our waitress walked past our table 5 times, with 2 of us standing and waving our arms at her, to no avail.  Hubby had to get up and go tell her we needed something.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Service was excellent. Bouncer high fived me despite having a cast on his arm-the dedication! 

Bartender was fun and upbeat and made great mixed drinks-she gave us free Jell-O shots!!

Tina wasn't there (again)....

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: This place was great the pulled pork was amazing! Keep in mind that the barbecue sauce is at your table the place was also very nice the 2nd and 3rd floors were the nicest on those floors there were some pool tables a douse ball table and a shuffle board table and if you are into live music the first and second floors are where u will get the best view  definitely recommend this place

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: This place was absolutely awful and a complete disappointment. The food was cold, like from the fridge. Ordered pulled pork and boyfriend got the ribs. All the food was cold. Mac and cheese had no flavor at all. The service wasn't good. One drink for each of us the whole time we were there. Don't choose this place for a good bbq place.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
We decided on this place for dinner as Honky Tonk was a zoo. We weren't greeted as we came in by the staff who were more interested in their own conversation. Eventually we found a table upstairs and a friendly server took our order which came out in less than 5 minutes - I'd rather wait and have something freshly made to be honest.

My fiancée had the pulled pork sandwich and I had the ribs which the server told us is what they're famous for. Maybe its my inexperience of the South/BBQ but I was expecting both the ribs and pulled port to be smothered in a delicious sauce, but neither were. There were 2 sauces on the table and the thicker of the two was delicious, the highlight of the meal, but why weren't the meats cooked in it so they could absorb the flavor more? The ribs were fall of the bone but they didn't have the nice crunchy skin I like that again would probably have come if they'd been cooked in a sauce. All in all I was disappointed in them given ribs are what this place is supposedly known for. 

The music in the background was a real mix of genres and not all that good, particularly for Nashville. On our way out we wished we'd sat downstairs where there was a better band playing. 

All in all we'll definitely be back to Nashville but not to this spot I'm afraid.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Kiddos to you guys! Sunday afternoon and we were a party of 30 people who walked in with no reservation. They were so great! Got our entire order done without a single mistake! Never mind how AMAZING the bbq was!!! Outstanding and HIGHLY recommended!!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Beer was cold, food was good.  Loved the fried pickle spears!  Band was great.  Staff was friendly and took care of our group.  Would definitely go back!

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text:
Usually my expectations for a soft opening are pretty low. Sure a mixture of trepidations and hope that result in a mixed bag as a new restaurant finds its footing and works out the bugs. 

What a joy!  

The atmosphere is great - set up with a stage for a live band on one end, a bar at the other. 

Restaurant opens at 7 am for breakfast, transitions to a brunch menu and then lunch before dinner. 

Food was great (tried their Hot Chicken) and served hot and fresh. Ice Tea was tasty too - fresh and quenching.  Fries were hot, crispy and lightly salted - perfection in my book. 

Service was great - once it gets more folks, will be interesting to see if they can keep up the high standards they've set for themselves. 

Overall, very positive and I look forward to trying one of their burgers next (if I don't hit them for breakfast first!)

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Very disappointed. We came to Nashville for my dad's 65th Birthday. He only wanted to go to the Wildhorse Saloon for his birthday. That didn't happen!  When we arrived a little before 5pm we reached the guy that was stamping hands and he told us very rudely (while looking at my dad in a wheelchair) that dinner wait time was an hour and a half. I said ok sounds good we will wait and he pointed us too the hostess desk (after making a comment when my dad asked if he could have his hand stamped and he said oh you are going to drink?). When we got to the desk the hostess said it would be a 1.5 hour to 2 hours wait. We said ok sounds good we will wait because this is where he wanted to go for his birthday. After an hour and and a half we went up there to see where we were on the list and was told that it would be another 2 hours!!!!!  We told them we were waiting for an hour and a half already and she rudely said well there are 2 huge parties in front of you. She never mentioned that before. Sadly we left and my dad didn't get to go to the one place he wanted to go to for his birthday dinner. I wish I could give it 0 stars for the way we were treated. I honestly think it was because we had someone in a wheelchair.

name: Twin Kegs
text: They say best burger in town, I just thought it was your standard burger and fries/tots. Very smokey, but if you like a good dive bar, this will be your place.

name: Nashville Palace
text: Great time!!! Good music, great bar food  Been all over Nashville and we will return to this place.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
If you're looking for a place to truly emerge yourself into the country scene, this place should be at the top of your list. The DJ is great and the instructor was easy to follow and encouraging! It does get packed so prepare to be stumbling with others trying to follow along with the moves. 
The only reason I'm rating it 3 vs. 5 is because of my experience in the ladies room with the attendant, Barbara McGowen . She was rude from the start and kept trying to obviously assist me with simple things to make a point of deserving a tip. Although that was annoying, it wasn't the issue. When I reached for the perfume she told me it wasn't free and that she worked solely on tips. I told her I understood and then I asked my friend to take a picture of the attendants Venmo so I could tip her. Then I was held back and lectured on how people do that often but never actually tip her. I replied by telling her I understood and that I was going to tip when she told me not to interrupt her. 
Overall it was a downer and ruined the mood. Getting lectured in the bathroom of a bar is hopefully not the mood they are going for but unfortunately it's the first thing I think of when I think of Wild Horse Saloon.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
I ordered the Music City Mule which is made with vodka, Reed's Ginger Beer. It was good. I didn't order any other drinks or food. I have attached pictures from the menus. I loved the music and how I felt we were in a sky bar but it was just upstairs and the window was open. 

Overall: I will give it 4 stars but I didn't really experience a lot of it and would be willing to try out other things if I go back to Nashville.

name: CMA Fest
text:
Four full days of country concerts! You couldn't ask for anything more. I went to the fest for the first time this year (2013) and after the first day was already planning my return in 2014. 

During the day, there are good, but lesser known, artists playing on stages throughout the downtown area. At night, the well-known, headliners play at LP field from 7:30 p.m. until well after midnight. Each night there are 5 or 6 artists on the line-up and then they throw in surprise guests throughout the night! 

One of the things I was most surprised about what how the fest wasn't overly crowded. With an extra 50,000+ people in town, you weren't getting pushed around. It was much more pleasant than a busy day on the Chicago Mag Mile.

You can buy a 4 day pass or single day passes. The only negative is the schedule isn't posted until 1-2 weeks prior to the event, so you have no idea who will be playing if you choose to purchase a single day pass. From this year's scheudle, I'd say nights 1,2 and 4 are your best bets!

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: We visited this morning for breakfast.  The meal arrived slightly warmer than room temperature.  We sent it back and they brought their second attempt which was also cold.  My eggs were not cooked to order and the biscuit appeared to have been purchased at Sam's.  I was really hungry, so if anything had been slightly tolerable, I would have probably eaten it, but that disgraceful biscuit was a decisive "NO."

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: Please don't waste your money. I've only has the CATFISH PLATE AND OKRA WHICH WAS HORRIBLE.  WASN'T SEASONED THE OKRA WAS tasteless.  I will never waste my money there again. You have one time to impress me. One and done.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: Great southern food, bbq, and the best biscuits! Really good live music too. Enjoyed the food and atmosphere! Perfect spot for a night out in Nashville...

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Not a great place to get brisket! According to my husband I am BBQ spoiled and after last nights brisket sandwich I would have to agree. I asked for a chopped brisket sandwich and was told "we don't do that here". So then I asked for a Brisket sandwich moist (with fat for those who don't know) and I was told they "pre trim the brisket to smoke it". So needless to say my brisket was dry and if you gotta and BBQ sauce for moistness then it's not good. BBQ sauce is for flavor! Service was good and the music was good! Not what I expected for Nashville BBQ!

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: I wouldn't recommend this place at all! The food was horrible. The fried pickles had no batter, and the ranch was so watery. I couldn't eat my mac & cheese because it was basically sitting in a bowl of oil. My server was nice, but had a hard time giving good service considering he had to ring food in at the table, on a tablet. It was awkward and time consuming for him and us. Not to mention it is overpriced! Skip it.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: The food was amazing! We had the deviled eggs as an app, I got the meatloaf which was the best I've ever had, my husband got the shrimp and grits which was amazing, and my daughter got the Mac n cheese which was on the kids menu and it was soooo good! We are going here for breakfast too and I am sure it will be equally delicious!

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: Early Valentine's dinner before a concert at the Ryman tonight. Wonderful Hot chicken and chicken fried chicken. Great music during dinner by Paige Rose. Amy D. Was a friendly and attentive server. Great experience. We will be back. Thank you.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: On the outside, Rippy's just look like a large, tourist bar, so my expectations were admittedly low coming in. However, I had the best wrap here full of smoky and tender pork ribs and tons of tangy barbecue sauce. Really good! We also had some nice cocktails, while enjoying some Johnny Cash covers.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: Came here for breakfast after staying at the hotel for the night. First off, the restaurant was nearly empty so we didn't think we have a problem getting quick service. To start, the coffee tasted burnt, almost undrinkable and I'm a coffee lover. After waiting around an hour for our food and witnessing other customers sending items back, we received our food and it was completely cold. Eggs, hash browns, bacon and biscuits. The waiter also got all four of our orders wrong. The food was not edible so we ended up having to leave and find another spot for our brunch. I highly recommend not coming here.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: I've always had the best time when I go here. My first time was 13 years ago when Taylor swift had just put out get first single. I was in town with my aunt and cousins and I was just like, you know this girl! She's going to be big one day. Look at her now! I heard her first at wildhorse! Love it!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
This venue is PHENOMENAL! Upon walking in, I felt like we walked into a very upscale concert hall. It was a slow night, which I'm not mad about because it felt like we had our own private concert!! 

It was a very late Friday night and Wildhorse Saloon is located on one of the side streets of Downtown Nashville. We stumbled upon this street by accident because we were honestly just curious and noticed the stage from across the street. BOY AM I GLAD I DID. It was, unfortunately, a slow night, and it broke my heart a little because RadioRomance was playing, and there was just so much talent on that stage, but there wasn't much people last night. I kind of found that to be true from most of the venues I visited last night, must have been an off night, but I'm slightly glad it wasn't as crowded because I got to experience, what felt like, my own private concert! The atmosphere felt very romantic, I just can't describe it in words. I mean, I am curious to see what this place is like on a busy night, but I'm kind of glad it turned out the way it did for us! 

I would definitely recommend Wildhorse Saloon to all visitors of Nashville!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Had a great time eating dinner and dancing at the Wildhorse Saloon while in Nashville!  The food was pretty good and the band, Brother Trouble was really good!  We did some two step, west coast swing, and line dancing.  FUN evening!

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text:
We went here on a Tuesday night and it wasn't hard at all to get a reservation about a week ahead of time. It is a cool little location. We went on Fat Tuesday (Mardigras) and got some free beads and saw Les Kerr play. There was a very diverse age range in the crowd. The food was quite expensive for the quantity, but it is quality! I ordered Fish & chips, which were three little fillets with maybe 25-30 fries for $13.00. It was very tasty, but not as filling as expected. My fiancee ordered some type of nacho dish, which was full of cheesy and beany goodness. 

DEFINITELY a must stop in Nashville! They have some cool merchandise there as well, we brought home a magnet for the fridge for only $3.00! I also got a hat.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Great bar ! Gets crowded as it can get ! Always has some good music  Get their early and head to the top floor snag your self up a table fast and enjoy the night away !

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: Came here for Sunday Brunch.  I got the enchiladas & they were SO SO GOOD. Cheesy deliciousness in a skillet. Perfect hangover food. My date was eyeing them. He was Super jealous. I tried his Hash which was a mixture of sausage & peppers. It was just meh.  I also loved their biscuits. Excellent to have munchies while you wait for your food. However, fair warning. They sat us RIGHT by the stage. While they were great...It was fairly loud & quite the opposite of what I expected from a chill rainy day brunch. I had a bit of a hangover & in hindsight would have chosen a place without live music. Only in Nashville is this normal  Oh also our server was outstanding.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
You must go to Tootsies in Nashville! If you go on Thursday Friday Saturday or Sunday from 10:00 to 2:00...say hello to Jake Loban ! He and the band are awesome! Country music at its best. Jake is the sweetest and awesomely entertaining. Rodney and the rest of the band are flat out good country and great human beings! Don't go here if you're looking for fancy decor but only if you want great people and good music. After listening to Jake , check out the other 
floors for Taylor or Rachael or TJ!  You might even get to sit in Willie Nelson's section! Some of the greats of country have sung here! Jake is sure to be one of them! See you there!

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: Was a really cold day, we waited on line for over an hour but got in and it was well worth it... Very intimate way to see great music

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text:
Bluebird Cafe is an interesting place.  Famous for live music, Bluebird Cafe is great under the right circumstances.  The venue is entirely context dependent on which artists you see and whether or not your have reservations.

First, if you want to visit Bluebird, get reservations.  It's a pain, I know, but it's the only way to go.  On the night we attended, about 90% of the venue was filled with reserved seats.  The remaining 10% went to the line outside, which was at least 50 people deep.  Needless to say, the vast majority were left out.

The tight seating had one great side benefit.  I watched with glee as multiple people tried to sneak inside the building before being caught and escorted out.  The woman who "wanted a quick picture" suffered the same fate as the dude who "just had to go to the bathroom" - the host politely escorted them out and dropped them at the back of the line where they belonged.  It was the most entertaining part of the night for me!

Our group had a reservation, so we were seated quickly.  We had a great view of the stage, and ordered some food and drinks.  I know that most people come to the Bluebird for the music, but the nominal per-person minimum makes food a small part of the experience.  I had a black bean burger that was excellent, but the rest of our table met with less success with the pork sandwich and other items.  The food was underwhelming, but again, that's not the big reason why you come, so it's a minor demerit.
