text: Great music, but my take away at the end of the night was just how BAD the service was. We got a couple drinks during the opener, but she disappeared during the main act. Everyone in the section was looking around wondering where she went. She forgot our beers twice, and lost my card! Do not give them your card! The few times she did come by, she purposely tried to rush passed our table. I literally had to yell "excuse me!" loud enough to be heard over the band. It really wrecked the night and distracted from the band that I paid to see.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text:
Amazing Xmas night eve with excellent live music. The other 2 floors were closed for the night but fortunately the ground floor left us satisfied.
They have a good choice of beers too(locally brewed) and other lagers -Coronas and Buss etc..
Will return for sure to enjoy the live music.

name: Famous Nashville
text: Alex is the best waiter.  Super busy on Labor Day weekend but he took care of us!!!!  Go and see him for best service in town.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: Not the friendliest place. As a local, this is one of the worst bars to visit. The staff isn't very friendly and they could care less for quality or hospitality. Good luck getting a drink.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: Horrible horrible customer service, waitstaff and music. Brittany is the worst waitress have ever encountered, along with bar management and security. If you are looking to be charged for drinks you did not order, and then be forced to pay for them or leave, you have found the spot. Do not come here, there are so many other great places to go do not waste your time. Brittany- you are better fit for McDonalds.

name: Ascend Amphitheater
text: much more beautiful in person!!! The employees are all so friendly and helpful and certainly know how to make a first concert smooth and memorable!

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: Went here on a Friday night.  It's three levels with three different bands and bars so plenty of space for you to find somewhere you like.  The bands were all good, though some of the crowd was definitely on the very young side.  A solid stop if you're just looking for some live music and drinks in a larger bar setting.

name: Benchmark Bar & Grill
text: Went here a couple times during our stay in Nashville, and it's a good little dive bar. Good music, quick service, and decent prices.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text:
Good ol' Honky Tonk. You really know how to get the party started.

This place pulls in $20 tip song requests and gets the crowd doing a sing along like no other bar on this strip. And I'm talking all the hits you probably want to hear on your trip to Nash like Wagon Wheel, Shania Twain, etc.

The space can get really crowded and and the drinks aren't as generous as elsewhere, but you're coming for the vibe of the place which is just FUN. Enjoy it!! :)

name: The Cowan
text:
4.5

I was pleasantly surprised with my experience at The Cowan. With it being a newer concert venue in Nashville, I was a little worried that they would still be working some of the kinks out. However, the whole show ran very smoothly and it was an easy check-in process.

The Cowan is a concert venue connected to Top Golf. The problem with this is parking. While Top Golf has a huge parking lot, it fills up quickly on a Friday night with both the Top Golf crowd and the concert crowd. The Cowan alone has a capacity of 600 people. I understand that they can't make a parking lot this big but I'm not sure where people should park if the lot is full. We parked on the side of the lot in some tall grass which was fine. Sometimes you just have to get creative! The doors opened at 7:00 and we got there around 7:20 so get there pretty early if you want easy parking. The line was out the door and around the corner but everything moved fairly quickly. When you get to the door, they will check your bags, your ID, and do a quick metal scan. Everyone was very friendly and efficient. If you're over 21, you get a wristband. There are 2 bars on the main level. The first is to the right pretty close to the front door. Bathrooms, separate men/women's, are on the left. There is another small bar on the left closer to the stage. The floor is open with no seating. The stage is fairly small but gets the job done. There is a second level for the VIP tickets. It looked like they had some high chairs along the balcony and then some seating behind that. However, if you don't get one of the few chairs near the front I don't think the view would be that great. I saw people gathering on the stairs to get a better view. I honestly think it's a better deal just to buy the GA tickets. We weren't super close to the stage but could see everything just fine. When I heard the venue held 600 people that made me nervous. I thought we would all be crammed in there like sardines. However, I never once felt uncomfortable or fighting for space. We were able to easily weave in and out of the crowd to grab a drink or use the bathroom. Oh and speaking of drinks, very reasonably priced! A lot of concert venues jack up the prices but I was able to get a tall boy for about $4. It's nice to be able to enjoy a drink during a concert without breaking the bank. The bar looked pretty well stacked with beer and mixed drink options. On to the concert. It was awesome! The sound was great. The lights were fun. I felt like I was pretty close to the band. They have a huge ceiling fan going so there is good air movement. It was a really fun experience!

Since The Cowan is pretty new, everything is very clean and shiny. The bathrooms were well kept, the floor was clean, and the bar was great. They keep the check-in process easy and quick. The GA ticket prices are reasonable and it seems like they have a nice mix of talent coming in. I would definitely come back for another show.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: Music was good. Food was ok. Price was too much and the entire ordeal took forever. Literally took 15 minutes to get us the check after we asked for it, and the place was not even that busy. Super lame, the rest of the strip has more to offer.

name: 3rd And Lindsley
text: If I could give this place 0stars I would DO NOT GO HERE staff is aggressively rude and will arrest you if you attempt to have fun in their bar... rly weird and embarrassing TRUST ME DO NOT GO manager has a tiny tiny pr*ck and takes it out on everyone around him

name: The Station Inn
text: It is the unpretentious (I was here first) underbelly of The Gulch, and the gulch is better  for it.  Hope you like beer (thats all they serve) and food only for those that are really hungry, this place is music city.  Forget the glam and pomp of the Ryman or Bluebird, a piece of Nashvilles musical soul resides within these walls.  Need I say more?

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: Samantha and Tyler killed it!  Ambiance is great and drinks are strong! Who doesn't like a good strong drink! Definitely a must in Nashville

name: Famous Nashville
text:
Our experience in a nutshell: good food, fun atmosphere, lousy service.
Comfortable fun seating. Very few people in the bar area and lots of staff. Not even remotely busy. Still took a while for any server to come to us. We ordered drinks, they asked if we wanted food. We said yes, we were nearly ready, just one minute to think. Fifteen minutes later she still had never returned, despite having walked up and down the main area multiple times and never even glancing over as I was trying to get her attention. Finally I had to walk up to the bar and ask her to take our order. After the food came (the nachos with pulled pork which were quite delicious and flavorful) we asked for some silverware. There were two us, just my wife and me. The server brought one set of silverware. Huh?? What kind of idiot brings one set of silverware with a napkin to a table with two people??  My wife and I just kind of stared dumbfounded at each other.  We wondered if she was just high or something. Yeeesshh. We'd still recommend this place for food, music and atmosphere. But, they need serious attention to service.

name: 3rd And Lindsley
text: Awesome venue with great music on a Monday night. Arrive early (doors open at 530) for a most pleasurable musical evening with the time jumpers (with Vince Gill) for a mere $20 they played gem after gem for 2 hours. Had a blast and the servers were amazing as well. Definitely want to come back next time I'm in the area.

name: 3rd And Lindsley
text:
When in "Music City USA" what better thing to do than hear some good music! 
This concert by Vinyl Radio was SO MUCH FUN!! 
Got there early to get seats...this place has a bar and a pretty good selection of bar food.  It's a small space so seating is at a premium! 
We ordered some beer and nachos that turned out to be acceptable, not up to what I'm used to in South Texas, but this IS Nashville after all! 
Once the band started, things got serious....seriously fun! Great cover band doing music from the 70's and 80's. 
What a crazy night....remembering those good ole days!!

name: Nashville Underground
text: Horrible.  It's not even worth my time to explain.   Nice rooftop views, but there's idiotic and incompetent management/bartenders running the place.  You have to try really hard to screw up a venue like this in one of the most prime pieces of real estate in downtown Nashville.

name: Nashville Underground
text: So if you want country music I would suggest not to go here. There music is astronomically loud and food was a disaster. My husband ordered the pulled pork and it came out cold and with hunks of fat in it. 1 thing that was a plus our server was very sweet. Doesn't help though after they tell you that they don't take reservations that you had made online and there is open seating....

name: War Memorial Auditorium
text:
Came here for Sound Tribe concert and did it rock. The house was full but the line kept moving fast outside to get in, the only bad thing here was the bar which had such long lines that the wait was forever and they ran out of water bottles.

Sound - was pretty good and balanced not as great as tpac or rymon but on part to them.
Staff - was great and courteous but that all depends on the kind of concert and crowd you are expecting.

Overall good place and parking will always be expensive around so might as well uber.

name: Nashville Underground
text: Food is trash but the rooftop is nice. Bartenders can be bitchy, but they are bartenders after all.

name: Famous Nashville
text: If you like overpaying for mediocre food, weak drinks and receiving rude, sub par service, you'll love this place.  On a more positive note, the location is good, right in downtown by river with nice view and the live music was quite enjoyable, but other than that, it was just OK.

name: The Back Corner
text:
My review is based on visiting on a few Friday nights and as you can see, I give it all the stars! Nashville the Beautiful hosts To the Maxx with DJ Chill on Friday nights and the music is so on point. I love that there is a place to dance where you're not touching cheek to cheek unless you want to. 

When you first walk up, the doors provide you a last minute mirror check before you open the door to an evening of possibilities! You'll walk straight into the bar that is often packed and you can either wiggle to the left or right and head to the dance area or head upstairs and check out the scene down below. I love that you have options here. You can bring a group and have drinks and keep to yourselves or you can head to the dance floor and be greeted with smiles from other dance lovers.

They also have some food options but I haven't been able to try those because I was too busy dancing. They have a full menu so whether you're a tequila sunrise drinker to a wine-o, they have something for you. 

Thanks TBC for providing a great space to dance to quality music and bringing a night venue to Germantown!

name: Benchmark Bar & Grill
text: I was quite surprised by this place as it is just off broadway in downtown. Went there to watch the UK game(which they couldn't get for some reason) and stayed for the music. We saw two groups while we were there and they both were great. Guess that should be expected in Nashville. The bartenders were nice and actually took time to talk to you. We compared notes on margarita recipes and how to make the best. Got one of the girls a raspberry margarita and after ideas of what to put in it, it turned out great. The food just above average for bar food. The blue cheese burger was really good. Had a mound of blue cheese. The bbq sandwhich was also good. It has slaw on top which my friend likes. The chicken tenders appeared to be premade. Not horrible, just average. Overall, I would say a pretty good sports bar to catch a game and listen to some music.

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: Great drinks, super cool venue. Music was great on all floors. The rooftop was the best part!

name: Ascend Amphitheater
text: They literally take your valuables and promise you there is no theft at entrance then throw it in the grass at the entrance. Anybody walking by can steal it. And the excuse? You could've taken it to your car. WELL MAYBE WE WOULD HAVE HAD WE KNOWN YOU THREW IT OUT TO THE PUBLIC. this venue is literally screwing people and telling you to f *** off.

name: Famous Nashville
text:
Great Nashville spot if your in town for some good tourist hopping of a local favorite.

Always great atmosphere for a drink or some yummy grub.

Super Talented guest musicians sure to please.

No, it's just not country in Nashville most of the musicians will be happy to play a request for your favorite song.

Don't forget to tip these local musicians who are very underrated and working hard to please you.

Very friendly staff!!

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: Great atmosphere! We went for some entertainment and a few drinks! Nothing special on the drink side but the band was amazing! Don't forget they play for tips!

name: Nashville Underground
text:
Poor management and customer service!! 

Will not be going back again!! By far the worst experience I have ever had on Broadway and worst NYE. The bar oversold tickets, which created a line that was over 45 mins long. The main doors were closed and even though we had already purchased $50 tickets, we were forced to wait outside in the 14 degree weather. Once we finally got in, the fire alarm was going off, very loudly over the music. None of the staff was acknowledging the alarm, letting the crowd know whether or not there was any kind of emergency. 

It took over 30 minutes to order drinks and there was no countdown or anything for the clock hitting midnight. Even though we purchased the more expensive ticket to go up to the roof we were never allowed up there and couldn't meet with our friends who were already there, missing NYE with the people we wanted to spend with. 

I've emailed the bar twice with no response and they have shown no remorse or given any kind of apology for how poorly things were handled. If my friends and I continue to be ignored, we will definitely never return and make sure our friends know to do the same.

name: 3rd And Lindsley
text:
An auditory orgasm!! The three  part fiddle harmony is indescribable the best there ever was!!!
Dr dave. Left in photo

F you like good acoustic swing and country you will find it with Time Jumpers-- They own it
captain Ron

name: 3rd And Lindsley
text:
3rd & Lindsley as a live music venue is both intimate yet also there is enough space to never be packed to the brim. This is something I appreciate from a venue that I don't feel like a sardine or don't get elbowed in the face trying to see my favorite artists. There is a parking lot outside and there is not much else around this neighborhood, however it is a few minutes in a Uber to get back to Broadway if you want to go out after a show. 3rd & Lindsley is two stories with a large bar on the first story then additional seating on a rounded balcony on the second story. The standing room by the stage is down a few steps so that the bar area is slightly elevated above the crowd which makes it great to see from no matter where you are. 

I've been here on two different occasions. The first was to see a 90's rock group, G. Love (think of Sublime meets Beastie Boys) on a Sunday night for one of the Lightning 100 radio broadcasts. If you get the chance to go to one of these events it is a lot of fun. The second time I've come was to see coffeehouse acoustic performer Joshua Radin (voice as smooth as butter). Both tickets were very reasonable and affordable. Most shows you find at this venue will be $20 or less. The bands they book are mostly rock or alt rock but I have seen some country artists play here too. 

If you want to be seated the whole time you really have to arrive pretty early and likely plan on just eating dinner here before the show. We've shown up like 20-30 minutes before the time and every single table has been taken. It's not bad to stand and watch the show but if there are openers it can make for a long night if you have old knees like mine. Any standing room by the stage is a good view and even if you stand back by the bar you can still see everything. Upstairs most tables have a good view but one time we went up and the only table that was left was an obstructed view. 

My only gripe about this place is that there are only a couple of women's bathroom stalls so a line can form if you don't time it right. Also, it can be hard to grab a beer at the bar once the music starts as people just stand in front of the bar and don't move. Otherwise a great venue!

name: Honky Tonk Central
text: Sad that the horrible customer service ruined what could have been a great bar with a great location. First time to Nashville this weekend and was given a horrible first impression by this place. The women's restroom attendant on the first floor was beyond rude and disrespectful. Used the restroom and upon saying to myself under my breath that I couldn't locate the soap, she sharply snapped "Well if you would stop moving, I'm trying to put it in your hands!" Oh, hello to you too! Later in the evening I realized that a ring that is very special to me was missing. Believing I must have removed it in the lower restroom to wash my hands, I entered to check and was immediatly snapped at by the same rude restroom attendant, who aggressivly barked that "The ring isn't here, there's no point in looking! Why are you looking by my stuff? [Her lineup of toiletries on the counter] I didnt take your ring you don't need to be checking in here!" Excuse me? I will check wherever I feel neccesary! She then later rudely attacked my friend who was helping me the same way, barking that "I shouldn't have taken off my ring then if I didnt want to lose it". Absolutely despicable customer service. I wish that the amount of money that my group of 17 spent that night was spent elsewhere. The irony that these restroom attendants are meant to be hospitable and welcoming is not lost on me!

name: Honky Tonk Central
text:
Honky Tonk Central is a great time. There are three big floors of live, local bands. I was truly blown away by the talent. Each band played four hour sets non-stop, and then when they were finished, the next band would set up. It was incredible! My favorite of the weekend was the Harold Allen Band, but there were so many other great ones. I felt spoiled. 

The layout of the venue is awesome, with big, open floor to ceiling windows that have balcony railings which provide for a really cool indoor but yet somewhat-outdoor vibe. 

Service was hit or miss. We scored with John, who took care of us on Saturday. He appeared out of nowhere every time we needed something, and he was as sweet as could be. On Sunday, our service was really spotty. We would have been better off just going to the bar and ordering there. But in all fairness, we only saw one girl working the entire second floor. 

The beer selection is limited but when I session drink I tend to go for the easy stuff anyway (pro tip!). That said, the beers got progressively warmer as our Saturday tenure wore on. I don't know if they couldn't get those domestics on ice fast enough for the busy crowd or what, but by the end of the evening I was icing down my drinks in a cup of ice water. We did order dinner during one of our visits; the buffalo chicken wrap with tots was legit!

Definitely looking forward to return visits on future trips to Nashville!

name: Live On The Green Music Festival
text:
I have been coming to LOTG since its inception! I am an OG LOTG attendee. I have loved seeing the festival grow with the city. The musicians are stellar year after year and I love seeing all the vendors, food trucks, and Nashvillians coming outside to enjoy beautiful music.

Last week, I went to go and see Passenger and when he asked everyone to be quieter, the audience responded with silence. When he asked everyone to sing, the audience sang along. How awesome! 

Band of Horses played back in 2010 and it's awesome to see them part of the 2016 lineup. I love seeing all sorts of people at LOTG. What a testament to a quality festival when you see kids, families, young adults, couples, etc. everywhere. 

Thank you for showcasing quality music, quality food/vendors, and quality people that Nashville has to offer every Thursday (and then Labor Day Weekend) in August.

I haven't experienced VIP since the first year and hoping that I will get a chance this year. Thanks LOTG for all that you do. I know it is tons of work and please know that we appreciate you all so very much!

name: Honky Tonk Central
text:
You have to be in a mood for the crowded, loud, cheap/expensive drinks. Despite these elements we enjoyed ourselves and were able to get a table to have a couple drinks on a Saturday night.

We left and went elsewhere after making our way up to the third deck.

The service was okay but with those crowds its hard to expect excellent.

I would take tourists here, but locals can find other good spots.

name: Nashville Underground
text:
What a surprise this bar was! We happened to walk by and visited just to kill some time before a Titans game and we loved it. We went on a Sunday and they had a Bloody Mary and mimosa bar (so cool). I went with the mimosa bar - they had every juice you could imagine along with fresh fruit and syrups. The grapefruit juice was tasty and refreshing. I also noticed that the Bloody Mary bar had three different kinds of salt to use for the rim which is really unique. 

It was huge inside and had ample seating on their two floors. There was also one section with some couches and a screen to watch tv. Before you leave check out the bathrooms for THE coolest sinks ever.

name: Alley Taps
text:
Super chill and a comfortable pub. Great beer selection friendly staff. I sat at the bar where the woman next to me happened to be one of their bartenders just hanging out. We had a great conversation. 

It was happy hour and $5 pints were on order. The bartender noticed I was busy chatting away, so she took charge and added another pint on my tab before happy hour ended. Pro move and much appreciated.  As you'd expect in Nashville, the guy playing guitar and singing was awesome. 

I guess it says a lot about a place when your people want to be there off the clock. Next time I'm in town  I will definitely make another pit stop at Alley Taps.

name: Nashville Underground
text:
What a FANTASTIC night we had at this establishment.  Staff was so friendly and very fun.  They took all our ribbing and jokes with a grain of salt and actually joined in with us.  Place was very busy but our party of 15 didn't seem to have any problem getting seated after a semi-short wait outside.  I was happy to get into the building though because it was cold outside.  Being a chef myself, I am very picky on how my food is prepared.  No worries here.  Expertly prepared and served at appropriate temperatures.

Staff was attentive even though very stretched with all the patrons that were there.  Entertainment was second to none.  Absolutely GREAT musicians.  Upbeat, warm and accommodating.

The only problem we have is that we actually don't live in Tennessee because I would make sure I hit this place at least a couple of times a month.  If they were able to handle all this volume on New Year's Eve then they definitely deserve my vote every other time of the year.  Can't wait to get back to Nashville so I can visit this diamond in the rough again.

name: Ascend Amphitheater
text:
Was able to go to grand opening concert. A wonderful and needed addition to Nashvegas. Ticket fees are high but expected. Drinks are about the same as the Titans games, HIGH. Food prices HIGH. Won't comment on the food as it has to get better. Right now FAIR, but then again, eat before you go, not while there. You could spend a lot when a dinner at nice place could be the same. Seriously 5 dollars for a coke?!?! Or 6 dollars for hot dog. A HOT DOG!
The Nashville skyline as the backdrop is lovely which is a plus.
Seating was fair with padded folding chair, but no numbers?!?! Hope they change that. 
Chairs on the lawn have to be a certain height I heard. Not sure what that means, may want to check this. 
Parking in Nissan Stadium lot, just over Shelby Street Bridge is 5 dollars. Excited to have this as a new place for entertainment.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: We were extremely disappointed when we came in - we heard very good things and the bar itself was very fun. Unfortunately our food was a different story - we waiting around 45 minutes for burgers, half of which were cold. Our waitress forgot to put in one of our orders, and we received nothing but curt service in return. We enjoyed the multiple other restaurants we went to in Nashville, but we would never return here.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text:
Bartender we rude.... I'm from out of town and been to at least 10 bars this weekend including restaurants.  He literally ignored me at the bar when I asked for a drink and when my food came, it seemed I was an inconvenience to ask for anything.  When I asked for a togo box, he literally threw it at me. It was the absolute service I've had in Nashville.  Now I know why they are off the beaten path and not busy...... needs a lot of customer service improvements. 

- disappointed customer

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Found this little bar just off Broadway. It has a great locals feel to it, the music was great... great performer but not so loud you can't still carry on conversation. Dennis the bartender/manager was phenomenal, and had a great personality. The menu is a "bar food" menu but the wings we amazing, the best tater tots I've ever eaten, and really great burgers and pork (we had a big group). The food came out really quickly as well. I would definitely return!!

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: It was okay but the service was rude. You're better off at someplace else on Broadway where the band and servers actually try to take care of people

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Hit the 8:30 show last night a little more music and a little less talking by the headliners would have been better. Alissa Griffith was the highlight of the night. Absolutely terrific.   Food and service was fine the venue was great. Well worth checking out on your next trip to music city.

name: The Basement East
text: The Basement East has ping pong tables and tournaments. The stage has a great sound system. The bands seem to always be pretty good, with a variety of musical choices. There's also a nice outdoor patio on the back of the building that serves food as well. All in all it's a pretty sweet place.

name: 360 Burger
text: We ordered our food and 50 minutes later the manager asked us if we ever ordered! About 20 minutes later, the manager asked us who took our order. He came back and said he would discount our order because of the long wait. Ten minutes later we had our food. My turkey burger was slightly above room temperature, but my fries were ice cold and limp! The other people in my party said their beef burgers and onion rings were on par with the other premium burger places. We walked in at 2pm on a Monday with very few people seated and expected a better overall experience. I am not sure if I will ever return, but the rest of my party was not receptive to the idea. On the positive side, their prices are lower than the other premium burger places in Nashville.

name: Rack Room Blue Bar
text:
I used to like this place somewhat solely because of the staff.  Cool bartenders that you can talk to make a place fun, but the 30-somethings in suits dancing awkwardly to modern rap seemed a bit odd next to a smoky pool hall.

Last time I went, however, the odd clientele and atmosphere took a turn for the worst.  Some dude, claiming to be an MMA fighter, tried to pick a fight with my friend.  We got my friend, who'd done nothing, out of the bar, and I went to close out my tab when the guy approaches me.

Now, I've got a secret security clearance with the army, and may need a top secret one some day.  As such, I don't fight with dudes at bars.  Its bad for my future.  This douche thought he'd let me know that he could "totally slam my head through the cigarette machine" positioned nearby.  I told him that I'm sure he could, and he reached out to shake my hand.  I was ready to leave, so, I went to shake it, at which point he gripped as tightly as he possibly could, and starting to buck up to me.

I asked him to let go of my hand, to which point he did, holding his hands above his head, palms towards me, with duck-ish lips and bug-eyed.  I think I pissed him off by snickering at this point, but watching a Jersey Shore wannabe attempt to intimidate me just got funny after a while.

So, I walk outside and by the bouncer whom I thought was a friend of mine at the bar, and with whom much of this took place in front of.  Thats when Anderson Silva wannabe comes out and attempts to put me in a head lock in front of the bouncer, who informs me that "I probably deserved it."

At this point, I shoved the douche off me, and listened to the bouncer give me some bullshit about how I can't "go around picking fights with people", before just telling them I had to get going.  It wasn't worth getting arrested over, and this bar certainly isn't worth your time or money.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: Requested a song or just anything by a popular band along with acknowledgment of 2 friends' birthdays with a tip while virtually no other requests were placed, 2 hours later and nothing, unacceptable and disappointing after having good experiences here in the past.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Was excited for this place. Disappointed. There werent many people when we got here. A table that came in way after us got their food before we did. Asked for coffee when we ordered, had to ask again for it. Sent it back, wasnt good.  Dont recommend the chicken and waffles. Breakfast sandwich was pretty good. 50min wait for food when not busy is too long.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Was here over the weekend and had the time of my life! So much fun we actually spent most of the weekend there! The bartender Kasi was such a delight, even shared her personal stash of candy with me! Amazing service, yummy food and the music was on point!! Def going back there a lot!!!

name: 360 Burger
text: This was a first time visit and it was very good. The service was top notch. Felicia was very attentive and on top of it. I had a cheeseburger on a pretzel roll and sweet potato fries. The fries come with this sauce that's out of this world. I put it on my burger as well as the fries. I asked for my burger to be medium. It was done, but juicy and flavored nicely so I ignored the doneness. If you want well done, you may get a hockey puck. Just saying. Will be back!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Best live music performance I've ever seen, period!!! We did both the 6:00 and 8:30 shows!!!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: For me, this place is as good as it gets. The price of the food was very reasonable for what you get- a live stage show. We had the turkey-apple sandwich thing which was amazing, along with their home-made fries. Service was also outstanding.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: The listening room is a great place to catch premier songwriters (e.g. Jason Duke)... Saturday brunch buffet was awesome! If you want a real taste of the Nashville music industry, check this place out!

name: 360 Burger
text:
Great burger, and atmosphere! The mural on the wall adds great character to the place and comes with a great story!
The sweet potato fries are tops!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Not a bunch I can add here to the existing reviews except that SOME of the servers there appear or act to be a little "snobby."  As if they are doing us a favor by visiting and keeping their establishment alive...?  Again, not a major deal, but on a couple of occasions I got that feeling.  Other than that, cool venue, nifty little menu for food and beverages, nicely priced, great outdoor patio, and they bring in some great musicians!  Definitely worth checking out!  The valet option is nice too.

name: 360 Burger
text:
The service was awesome! Very fast and wonderful food. We are from the St. Louis area and just
Made it from a long drive and wanted a nice hamburger. This place was great! I read reviews about an old menu vs new menu....didn't matter. If you are an out of town person and like burgers....make this part of your trip!!!

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text:
Came here for a bachelorette party and had a blast! There is a lot of space, which was definitely welcomed after being packed into some of the other Nashville bars. We were able to get drinks at the back bar without having to wait. The bartender was friendly. 
I really liked the fact that they really take dueling piano up a notch with a drum set and occasionally 3 musicians up on stage: 2 pianists + a drummer. Two complains though. First, they said that it was $20 to make a song request. However, I definitely saw one of the pianists taking requests ahead of my $20 request from others who paid $5 - $10... Second, the set up is a bit weird. There are tables everywhere, but the music was good and we wanted to dance. I wish they had a dance floor! Even a small one on the side! Other people wanted to dance too, because once we started dancing, others joined in. 
I think that this bar would be a solid 4 star place, if they only added a dance floor and didn't require $20 to get my request in (or maybe I just got duped)

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
Phenomenal collection of Johnny Cash memorabilia & portraits of the man from his music! I loved the way the museum created interactive exhibits by allowing you to view old tv clips, a short film about JC tv & movie career & a patriotic tribute of JC. These experiences plus the poetry and handwritten memorabilia make this museum a must see for country music fans! 
I love the way you can see JC's music emerging and the different decades he spans as an artist. One of my favorite items were the extra photos from the photo shoot of JC & June Carter on their first album together. Their expressions tell the story and make you feel like you're going back in time. The other interesting facet is the stations where you can hear JC's famous "Walk the Line" in all forms from old records to 8 tracks, cassettes, cds and mp3s. Very informative!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: We rushed into Whiskey Row to beat the heat on 4th of July. We loved how they had the stage set up so everyone in the bar had a good view. I got "Dierks' Lemonade" which was delicious. For $13 it was pretty on-par with the price of cocktails in Nashville. While we only stayed on the first floor, the ambiance was nice and the crowd wasn't wild. It was nice to see that the age of visitors ranged from kids with their parents to folks in their 60s-70s.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: All around great place.  Great live music, great bar food and great drinks.  Mark is a super friendly bartender!

name: 360 Burger
text:
Had a few people tell me about 360
Burger and after reading reviews, I had to try. There is nothing like a big, juicy burger! I couldn't decide between the Santa Fe, margherita or cilantro avocado burger. I chose the cilantro avocado since it is the one I kept hearing about and for good reason! I ate every. single. bite. Sweet potato fries and all. And I'm a short, petite lil thing...it was THAT good! I will be trying those other two, too!

name: 360 Burger
text: Could not have been a better burger and sweet potato fries.  And, great place to watch sports on big screen.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: I really enjoyed the music. As far as the food. The humus was amazing. The salad with goat cheese, strawberries and pecans was weak. Pretty much all lettuce. Found a few pecans and cheese sitting at the bottom.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Song Suffragettes were awesome.  Would love to review the food, but we still don't have it over an hour after ordering.....

name: Rack Room Blue Bar
text: I'll miss this place more than words. Cheers to you blue bar. You will always hold a piece of our heart

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: I'm giving this place four stars because I do like it, but not giving 5 STARS because of the bartender working at 3pm Monday at main bar.  The short haired blonde bartender is super unfriendly and too busy texting and being rude to help people! Other than that the music is fantastic and place is beautiful! Everyone else working there is amazing!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
Very disappointed with the service of this place. We came for a bachelorette party and got a table on the second floor on August 11 in the afternoon. There were eight of us at a table. We ordered some drinks and appetizers to tide us over before dinner. We received our drinks at a timely manner. We ordered three appetizers (artichoke dip, southern fries, and the pretzel platter) and waited over an hour. From what we observed, we were one of a few tables to order food. We constantly had to go out of our way to ask our waitress, a blonde woman in black, where our food was and how long it would take. She did not give us specific answers and just stated that she doesn't know and she'll check. She never got back to us. We were getting more and more upset as other tables got their orders before us even though we ordered our appetizers before them. We finally were fed up after about an hour and a half of waiting and asked her to cancel our orders. Another woman came over and stated that there was a mix up, and that our order was accidentally cancelled. We are very disappointed in this as we checked up and asked about our food throughout the one and a half hour of waiting for three appetizers. 

We got the check and while the appetizers were taken off and the drinks were discounted, they should've comped the entire check as they did not communicate and made us wait far too long before telling us our order was 'accidentally' cancelled. 

This was a huge downer on the bachelorette and would not recommend anyone to come here.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: I was very impressed with the singers/songwriters, but the food was terrible.  I ordered the hot chicken, which is supposed to be a Nashville signature dish, and it completely lacked spice. The only thing the chicken did taste like was formaldehyde with a touch of dry rub.  The only redeeming part of the dinner was the good beer selection.

name: 360 Burger
text:
First time I went it was great. Burger was DELICIOUS! Atmosphere was great. 

Next time I went and the burgers were not as great. Maybe 2/3 months since my first visit. My burger was greasy and my bun was falling apart as I ate the burger. 

Definitely recommend if you're looking for some quick food and kicking back with friends.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: What a great lineup of songwriters.  I can't believe the quality of music for the price.  Nashville is so lucky!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
If I were just basing this on the entertainment and format, I would give this a 5-star rating, but when considering the service and food, it drops to a 3-star.

We arrived around 7:30 p.m. not knowing how the showings at this place work. From what I gathered, there are a few "shows" each night. They seat for each showing, begin serving, and various musicians play for the next hour and a half to two hours. Our show was set to seat at 8:00 p.m., so the host told us we could either wait 15 minutes or so until the band wrapped up at the bar or outside on their large patio. We opted for outside, since the weather was beautiful. About 15 minutes later I walked over to the door where the host was standing. He commented that the band decided to play a little longer than scheduled. I jokingly said, "Yeah - likely story," to which he responded with attitude that they were "all just a bunch of music loving hippies around here who don't care much for time anyway." SCOFF! Just because I got dressed up that night doesn't mean he should assume that I'm not also a music-loving hippie without much care for time! I normally wouldn't be offended at that kind of remark, but it was his tone of voice when he said it that was offensive.

Anyway.

We went inside soon after this little incident and proceeded to ask him where we should sit, since it seemed there were reservations to consider. He said we could sit at any table where there were no people, so we headed for one near the stage and sat down. He didn't bring us menus, take our drink order or clear our table.

About 15 minutes later, our waiter came. He was seemingly confused as to whether we had hung around from the previous show or if we had just been seated. We told him we just sat and he quickly cleared our table. He asked if we were seated there or if we chose it ourselves. We told him the host said to sit where ever we wanted (he said the host was supposed to seat us). He asked if we got menus or a drink order taken yet. We said neither (apparently the host was supposed to do both these things, too). Luckily, he quickly made up for the service the host was lacking. He brought us our two pints and appetizers relatively quickly, was hot on the water refills, and our entrees came not long after our appies.

The show was great, too. I loved the format, having so many acts come on along with a host to tie everything together. All the performers did a great job and it was nice to see so much camaraderie among them - they all seemed to know each other and helped one another out during technical difficulties or if someone needed a fill-in percussionist, etc. It was more like a mini festival inside a super awesome music venue.

For your NYers: the venue itself reminded me a lot of The City Winery. There are lots of tables and chairs, standing room near the back, and a decent-sized bar area.

Despite the holier-than-thou host, I would still come back here for more great up-and-coming musicians and tasty food, too. Get the fried pickles, but don't get the full size - it's pretty much a pound of pickles.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: Neat and fun place to visit worth the money to check out. Very informative on his life.

name: Music City Bar and Grill
text: Came in because we got a groupon and the reviews seemed good. The place had about a dozen customers on a Saturday at 7pm. The server was nice, the musical talent was good, the margaritas were yummy. But this place is so old, rundown and smelly, just not taken care of - booths falling apart, paint peeling... Our wings were dry and we had to eat outside with the parking lot for a view and the really good music from the live band at the adjacent restaurant muffling ours because they allow smoking inside this place :( The waitress didn't know how to use our groupon because after my husband paid the bill I realized she took only half the voucher price off  the bill. Oh well, lesson learned.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: The staff was very pleasant. I had the eggplant Parmesan. I found it to be too thickly sliced, which meant that the eggplant was not cooked evenly through. I'm a vegetarian and it's clear from the sparse number of options that the place probably specializes in meat, so take my food critique with a grain of salt. The live music was not so good. The music was loud to the point of preventing comfortable conversation where my fiance and I were sitting. So, if it's so loud that it demands attention, it should be a bit more compelling. Overall, I came in with high hopes based on previous reviews and was underwhelmed.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Went here on a weekday evening. Had decent service (the place was dead) and a good burger. Then went here on a Saturday for brunch. Terrible service. Not only was I ignored half the time, but multiple people came in complaining that hey had been waiting at the front for someone to seat them or something but were never acknowledged.  They advertise bottomless bloody Mary's which were mediocre at best (I wasn't expecting amazing out if bottomless). Biscuits and gravy... Well lets just say I've had better at Denny's. Biscuits were dry and chewy and there wasn't enough gravy even if they were moist and fresh.

Music: The weekday night was good. They had a songwriters round that wasn't too bad. Saturday they had a pretty good playlist going but then let some guy walk in off the street and start playing. Not sure what that says about their music standards. The guy was decent though.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
It gets four stars because of the music, definitely not the food (two stars).
We went for brunch because of the music so it was worth it and we are going back.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: I am a big Johnny Cash fan so for me this Museum was worth it for me. It is 18.00 dollars to get into the museum and the museum itself is not that big it takes about 5 mins to walk through all the exhibits but I was there an hour taking pictures of the records and guitars and all the memorabilia.I love the House of Cash wall, that was a nice touch. They also have a gift shop with a lot of Johnny Cash shirts and everything and anything Johnny Cash that you could buy. The Museum has a great location its right off the Broadway the main drag in Nashville for the Honky Tonk bars. The have a really good pizza place next door as well. This museum is def worth for me because I got a lot of good pictures on my phone of all the memorabilia. If you are not a Cash fan thou I would not pay 18 dollars to get in but if you are a Cash fan I would recommend it. I love Nashville, great city with every friendly people who make you feel at home

name: 360 Burger
text:
I really wanted to like this place. Came here on a Sunday night around 7pm. Music was turned down kinda low so it made the atmosphere kinda humdrum. If the music was a little louder, it would've given the perception of a fun place (and would've helped drown out the conversation from the next table over). I came in and seated myself. 

I placed my order moments later. I ordered a cheeseburger, sweet potato fries and water. Took around 15 min for my food to arrive. My cheeseburger with pretzel bun was juicy and flavorful but overly salty. My sweet potato fries were clearly not made fresh. They were dry and barely warm - had to bite into one to be certain they were sweet potato fries since they weren't orange toned at all...completely brown from being dry. Water refills came - but only when there was zero in my glass. I had a moment when I had to stop eating while waiting for someone to notice I needed more water. 

Staff wasn't enthusiastic about being there - just barely friendly. 

I've satisfied my curiosity about trying this place out. Maybe this was an "off night" for them - but I'd rather drive a little farther for a better overall experience.

name: 360 Burger
text:
Stopped in for a few drinks... Friendly service. Unsweetened tea was not good at all - very strange taste, sent it back. I instead enjoyed a few Blue Moon beers on draught. They were good. Great live music and ambiance.

The restrooms (men) - Wow, this area needs some work. Filthy... Also, what's with a toilet next to a urinal (really close) and no stall? Totally weird... Why would you need both? Should I have brought a friend? A single toilet would suffice for most humans. Fix this!

name: 360 Burger
text: First off let me say the burgers here are phenomenal. Great taste full of flavors. The atmosphere was chilled and laid back. There was a band playing when we arrived then they left around 9ish. Reasonable prices came with a side of fries or upgrade to onion rings for $1 more. Big problem customer service.  We stood at the door for about 5 min until someone greeted us then sat us down and said our server would be right with us. Not the case took another 5 min before she came to the table. Got our drinks order and disappeared.  A little over cooked i ordered medium. Finally ordered my burger which took forever to come out. There Was Only 3 Other Tables In the place. If the burger wasn't so great this place would have gotten 1 star.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: Always look for piano bars when traveling. This one was fabulous! No cover, inexpensive drinks and the entertainment was fantastic. A few drunk people made it a bit annoying for awhile, but after we spoke to the waitress, a bouncer got it under control. We sang aloud for 2 hours. Incredible piano players, great mix of music (not too much country)..,eclectic crowd. Will definitely come back next time we are in Nashville!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Wonderful night of music!!! Our server was fantastic!!! I attended the dinner and a show on 7/11/2015 with my mom and two kids (4 and 9). The kids shared an order of chicken fingers and fries, washing it down with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. They were enthralled with the music and even danced! The food was good. Their menu is in a state of flux with a new chef, so some items like pork chops are no longer available. I ordered a plate of pulled pork and side of mashed potatoes. Again the menu wasn't updated, so it didn't list pepper as the main spice in the mash. My mom is allergic and this made her very unhappy. The server apologized and brought out a huge slice of cheesecake with chocolate and raspberry drizzle. The venue was very spacious and had tables that sat four people, but a few were pushed together to accommodate a larger group. Lots of couples on dates or small groups kicking off their Saturday night. Originally I was quoted a bucket of beer was ten dollars, but when the bill came it was $20! The server did correct the price without hesitation. I think it must be very confusing to not only customers but servers too if the menu is not updated. This would only be my only suggestion to Mr. Blair, if you have a new chef please print out an updated menu to showcase a short bio and a list of the new  offerings. Please discard the nasty old stained file folders and just print it on heavy card stock. It wasn't a great first impression to sit down and see old file folders on the tables; it made me think about work and I wanted to relax;) The musicians were very talented: Bill Griese and Julie Gribble. I bought both of their CDs to listen to in the car back to Georgia. Very wonderful, authentic Nashville experience!!! We will definitely go back again.
PS Valet your car and get it validated by your server. Much easier than driving in circles to find a spot.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text:
This place is awful. The food is disgusting. Nothing was fresh all frozen. I had the chicken bites and could hardly get through half my meal. Most of my friends felt the same about their choices. Would NEVER come back. Way better choices in Nashville. 

Our waitress was awful. She lost my friends debit card. Awful!!

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: I came here with a few friends to watch game three of the Stanley Cup playoffs after Swingin' Doors promoted themselves as a place to watch the game on their Facebook page. After getting a table upstairs a few hours prior to the game and waiting 30+ minutes before a waitress came to the table we thought we were settled in for the game... that is until a band started playing downstairs right before the game began. Even after all of the volume on the TVs was turned up, any sound was completely drowned out by the band. Shouldn't have been promoted as a place to watch the game and then not delivered on a good game-watching experience. We ended up leaving to watch it somewhere where a band played only on commercial breaks. Beyond that, food was just okay.

name: 360 Burger
text: This is our favorite place to grab a burger in the Antioch area. My go-to is the PB&J burger, the homemade jalapeño raspberry jelly is sooooo good. They also have great sweet potato fries, which is an item that can be very hit or miss at burger joints. Good beer list, very reasonable prices, friendly staff, and lots of options. Definitely a hidden gem in Antioch!

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
Pretty much anything and everything you'd ever want to see or know about Johnny Cash. No chance that any fan of The Man In Black is going to be disappointed in their visit. Chronicles his life from childhood through his last days and features an overwhelmingly impressive amount of memorabilia. Everything is displayed nicely with detailed information about every item. The only cons were that the place is rather small and there is no room for expansion that I could see. I don't know how they would fit anything else into here without cluttering it up. Plus I would like to see more theme rooms, like the area dedicated to his movie and TV career. And there is no specific parking for the museum. I parked in the nearby lot, which cost $10 alone. The gift shop prices were also rather steep, but that is to be expected. But these are all petty complaints. Certainly a must-see for fans!
Visited October 2013

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: The $16 admission is worth the price if you're a Cash fan, as there are lots of videos, artifacts, and fun biographical tidbits from the life of Johnny Cash. You'll see personal notes, stage costumes, instruments, gold and platinum records, and loads else. There's a row of iPads pre-loaded with clips from his concerts and music videos, although I did find myself wondering if I couldn't just find all of that on YouTube. There's a great film projected in a backroom with excerpts from Cash's acting career, and some of his doodles, sketches, and personal notes. I learned a lot, and I definitely would recommend it to someone exploring the history of country music.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
This is our FAVORITE Nashville spot.

I definitely recommend visiting and sitting for a while. We visited on a Friday night & they had a live band. I think it was the best sounding band in downtown that night. I wish I could remember their name.. but, they kept everything going and were very upbeat with tons of variety. Because of them, we stayed longer than we wanted but in a good way - we didn't want to leave.

The stage set up is awesome. I loved how it's built into one of the walls and it's at the beginning of the building when you walk in. The entertainers can use stairs on both sides to go from the upstairs to downstairs while performing. This set up keeps everyone's eyes on them. The entire place is designed so that you can see the stage NO matter where you sit or stand.

We didn't have any food on our visit. But we hung out on the second floor. Bottles of bud light were $6 each - the only downfall.. but not a deal breaker. We weren't ID'd at the door or bar.. but about 30mins & two beers later.. security came up to us and asked for our ID's. It was bothersome but we understood and showed him, he apologized and went on his merry way.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Food was OK.  Live Music not bad.  Friday lunch time horrible service.  Waitress forgot what we ordered couldn't remember to bring us water refills a it once but twice.  Never did get the beer I ordered.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: I had higher expectations of this store to have a decent amount of Johnny Cash memorabilia when he performed live concerts at two infamous California prisons, wassup with that?  The Museum looks quite big from across the street.  Here I am in the heart of Nashville at the Johnny Cash Museum and all I could find are shot glasses, pictures of him, and baby items.  Come on now, there has to be more...

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: We enjoyed the dinner cruise on July 3rd. The food was very good, but the show Hot Country Nights was amazing.  I didn't want it to end.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: SLOWEST FUCKING SERVICE IN THE WORLD! I've been here for over an hour waiting for a burger. The music isn't worth the wait to eat.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
The best spot on Broadway!  Don't miss this one.  Live music, excellent,
great atmosphere.  Our bartender JAKE was awesome couldn't have asked for better.  Super personality.  As crowded as it was  (all bar stools were taken) JAKE never missed a beat, very attentive, felt like we've known him for years. JAKE is a great guy.. a definite asset to Whiskey Row.  Thanks JAKE you're the best!  Barbara & Johnny Walker

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Such a cool place with really good food ta boot!

Had the hot chicken with a yummy pickle on a delicious biscuit bun and the bourbon cherry cider. SO good! 

This place has two performances a night where four song writers line up on stage and take turns performing the songs they've written... no covers allowed. We didn't get a chance to attend a show, but the concept seems so fun! The inside front room has tables and a bar and is industrial casual. Then the performance area has a nice stage with table seating and another bar. 

This would make for a fun night out! Tickets are on sale online in advance. There's also Sunday morning services here... I was told really good music!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
Music was great. Really enjoyed the visit in that regard. Bathroom is nice and it seems clean for a bar. 
Our waiter was great. Came by a great many times. 

Now the issue...

The alcohol was weak. Not sure if that's a thing here but I had multiple drinks and never even felt buzzed....at all. Considering the cost per I would think four would be enough to get that sensation. 
Had 4 bar drinks in about and hour and a half. Nothing. So I stopped drinking and enjoyed the band.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: I LOVE Dierks Bentley, thus this may be a biased review ;). However this bar has the "tallest" rooftop bar in Nashville and also has music on each floor. We opted for the second floor in which the band was taking requests and even played a little Folsom Prison Blues for me. Our waitress was great - always checking in and keeping our drinks full! The cocktails were also amazing... I tried a twist on the "Paloma" and loved it! My husband had a vodka strawberry lemonade and also said it was refreshing on this hot and humid day. I think I could have spent my whole afternoon here if I wanted to as it was so chill!

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: Still on the boat for the Thanksgiving cruise...the real thing I was looking forward to was the views of downtown Nashville---we've essentially been going back and forth near Opryland for 2 hours and 15 minutes now--apparently we're not going to downtown and no one seems to have mentioned it.  The servers seemed to know it, but didn't say anything until we asked.  It probably could have been salvaged if the food was good or if I was a "show" person--just here for lunch and the cruise.  The salads and desserts preset on the table looked like they were prepped 2 days ago.  Table set with tea and Ranch--no water??  Bread wasn't warm and butter was cold--tasted like it was straight out of the bag.  Lunch was essentially a processed meat plate (turkey and ham) with an ice cream scoop of mashed potatoes and undercooked green beans (no, not haricot verts).  If I had wanted cafeteria food, I would have gone to a cafeteria. Overall, a pretty disappointing trip--buyer beware and please let me off this boat!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Good atmosphere and food. Service was fine. My only gripe was the tech fee charge on our bill. This is not advertised. The manager told us the company that runs this establishment is out of Arizona and they do this out there. Helps pay for computers and keep the food prices down. Mmm.....

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: Unless you are a Cash buff that needs to check this off their bucketlist, this museum is a waste of time and money. After paying $20 per person, we were herded into a small space, where it was difficult to read or see anything and you felt rushed because of the amount of people they were letting in. There were several pieces of memorabilia to appease the fans but the rest of the displays were info that could have been googled or watched on youtube.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Waitress told us half the items on the menu weren't available, told us to "go to the bar" to get water (we were there for dinner).  Probably worst service I've ever had. Won't be coming back. Thank goodness there are other places I've been in Nashville that were great.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: This is a must for all Johnny Cash fans. Thought the exhibit were well thought out and it's fun to walk around. I never knew that he was an artist too. They had a few of his art work displayed as well. Worth a visit if you're in town and trying to get away from the bars and need something else to do.

name: Madame Tussauds Nashville
text: As all the other Madame Tussaud's wax museums, the figures are all so realistic! Of course for Nashville's wax figure themes it was aimed around country music sensations. Anyone from current to new singers including Jonny cash to Luke Bryant and Blake Shelton. The figures are pretty realistic it's scary, the details are phenomenal from the eyes to the clothing! Definitely a fun place to stop by if you're looking for something extra to do around the city!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Such a great bar! Good food and service and a great all around environment wether you enjoy live bands or a DJ. Also love seeing the Henry Martin band here!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: After ordering two drinks and onion rings for $35 we got a vodka soda when we ordered a vodka tonic and asked for ranch with our onion rings and got tarter sauce. Also by the time we got our onion rings it had been 20 min and they were cold.. other places on Broadway I would rather go than here..

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
I got into Johnny Cash because of the movie - don't judge I'm not from an area that is big into the country music genre. I knew I had to stop into the museum to get more history and listen to some great music! 
I think they did an excellent job paying tribute to his life & his music. It was smaller than I imagined it would be but I was still very happy with it since there was so much to see, read & view! I loved the live shows playing, it was like going back in time. Listening to the music was my favorite! The Man in Black sure new how to play a song that got you to the core.
I was also very glad for the photo op with Johnny himself, superimposed of course. It was worth the price to have a cute takeaway!
I wish they had more space as I could be there all day but it worth going into and it's right there in the heart of downtown!

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Just as bad as midtown! Plenty of nicer places with nicer employees to go!  If overpriced and rude people are your Jam you might enjoy!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: This was a really fun spot with great music and good service. My only issue was the oil that was leaking from the ceiling and ruined my hat and shirt. What a disappointment.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: So it's the rock n' roll bar on Broadway in the Trashville sector of Nashville.  Bands on every level.  LOTS of bars so never really a wait for a drink.  AC pumping even with the doors/windows open so it was nice.  Wife isn't a big country fan and we both hate new/bro country so even though not a huge fan of Kid Rock we enjoyed this spot.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
I came here on Sunday and didn't have to wait at all to buy a ticket or enter the museum although it was still very busy inside. It made it kind of difficult to see or read anything when there were people standing in front of you. The layout is a little disorienting even with a map but it wasn't a big deal. 

Lots of cool things to see and watch but it only took me about 45 minute - 1 hour to see everything. If you are looking to do something that will burn a couple hours this isn't the place.

The ticket prices aren't bad but I can see how it will add up if you have a family or group of people.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
Heard so many good things about this bar but was seriously let down after my experience. This was hands down the worst experience I've ever had in a bar. The atmosphere was good and it was fun at first, but after a situation with lots of people waiting in line to go up to the second floor, things quickly turned after a miscommunication between the bouncer and my friend and I. The bouncers were completely unprofessional, rude, and aggressive to my friend and I. For starters, I completely understand and respect that bouncers need to do their jobs, it's important to keep people safe, especially in crowds-- but the way my particular situation was handled was absolutely unnecessary and could have been avoided with simple communication. I was physically grabbed by my purse by a bouncer after trying to go up stairs that were blocked off. If I knew the stairs were blocked off, I would not have tried to go up like I did. This could have been avoided by the bouncer simply telling me not to go up, but instead, I was grabbed and yanked down 5 steps by my purse. I will never return to this bar or recommend it to anyone I know, simply because of the way the bouncer treated me and how poorly the situation was handled. I am deeply disappointed by this bar and it's security. My group of 18 girl friends decided to leave and go somewhere else after this happened.

Managers who are reading this: please train your security staff on how to properly handle high stress situations to avoid this in the future. In an area with such a high volume of people and so many other choices on places to spend money and time, customer service and more important SAFETY OF GUESTS should be a priority.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Out of all the "celebrity" bars down in Nashville, Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row is absolutely my favorite. Location and rooftop views are some of the best, always has the best bands, food is delicious, (get the chicken wings, you won't be disappointed!) and some of the friendliest and funnest bartenders around! Especially Jake! Even during CMA Fest when it was super crowded he made our time there so much fun! Can't wait to come back!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: I am a huge Dierks fan so of course we had to come here! First of all we came in a few days while being here for CMA FEST and we had the pleasure of having Kelly as our server. Not only was she friendly she was on it with everything! I seen a few "unmotivated" bartenders who looked not so friendly (women bartenders) but Kelly was amazing! The food was delicious especially the artichoke dip and meatball sliders. Loved the setup! As a business owner myself I would only give y'all advice on hiring more friendly motivated women bartenders. But I still give y'all a 5 star review!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Had a quick drink here with friends. The space has a great vibe and the bellinis and frozes were pretty good. It's definitely pricey though and getting a place to sit was a little difficult. We wanted to checkout the rooftop when we came here but it was closed so that was a bummer.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: So, like many things in Nashville, I think this was way overpriced​.  You do get to see some cool things.  Handwritten​ notes.  Military uniform.  Early guitars etc.   I think it should be half the price.  You can do the entire museum​ in an hour.  Cool, but expensive.  I'd almost say must-do​ for a Cash fanatic, but I am one and I wasn't sold.  Must say, I'm not a cheap person either.  I waste money all the time and wasted tons on local beer on Broadway.

name: 360 Burger
text: I have been waiting for 12 years for someone to put a cool burger joint close to the house.  We went last night and had the Veggie Burger and the Cilantro Burger.  Both are great.  The atmosphere and service was very good.  They have a nice choice of local draft beer also.  And the prices were good.  We will be back.  I can't wait for some live blues and soul music.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Was absolutely stoked to visit this bar! First time in Nashville and was looking for a memorable experience at one of my favorite country artists spot. However, bartender Ashlyn W. (#392) on the first floor working Sunday May 26th around 1pm provided very poor service (and that's putting it nicely)!!!!!!!  This GIRL would not give me or my boyfriend the time of day and made it feel we were a bother to even be present there. We ordered our drinks which was difficult to do from the beginning because she gave us attitude when asking what kind of vodka they had to order. Once ordered, made me feel unappreciated and unwelcome. There was another team member present (did not catch her name) who was watching the entire scenario and did nothing to help. We left immediately after. Totally ruined my experience at one of my favorite artists place. Please do something to resolve this because I would love to come back and visit but if I see the same bartender, my boyfriend and I will leave without question. Save yourself the trouble and do not go to Ashlyn!!!!!!

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: Nice thing to do when visiting Nashville and worth the price. Food was good, show was entertaining, and entire riverboat staff was excellent. Great for all ages. ...Nick's Brooklyn pizza in Panama City Beach FL. is a fraud.

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: We got to be boat an hour early and waited out side by the gazebo till they let us on. We payed a little extra to sit at the captains table so we got seated first and had choice seats for the cocktail hour right by the band. Then with the package got to get seated in the main room and was able to have the first course before everyone else got there. We also had first dibs at the buffet which was great as there was a lot to choose from before the masses. Tix included a tour of he pilot house and chat with the captain . Then we were taken down to eat dessert before the show. Show was very entertaining as the performers were talented in singing and dancing . They explained the history of country music through song through the years and that was nice. If your going to do this spend the extra 20 bucks I believe it was and get a few perks before everyone else.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Very upset with this place. I was here 3 times and enjoyed it at first. When i came back the bouncer accused me of having a fake ID and called a cop over. The cop told me my ID was fake and that he didn't care about my business. When i asked him to run the ID, he told me that it wasnt worth his time. I dont know how such a fun place could be so rude. I thought this was up there on my favorite places in nashville but after this incident i have no desire to come back.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: We bellied up to the bar in the early afternoon and the signature cocktails did not disappoint. I am most definitely going to try and recreate this is my kitchen.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
Currently sitting on the rooftop and this place has been a huge disappointment. Had to find a manager after 30 minutes to get a drink. Horrible service and then our waitress has gotten every drink order wrong. Not sure where the pictures come from on their website but my NY strip wasn't even a strip. People will come because it's Kid Rocks Place, don't waste time on food or expect the food to look anything like the website!!

Manager came over an comped meal and is trying to make things better!!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: I went with a group of friends and we weren't let in because our friend, who happened to be a man of color, was wearing tims, which "werent appropriate." When the bouncer was asked why why, we were called ignorant and given no further explanation. If you care about race relations in america, I would not recommend this establishment.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
I will be the first to admit that by no means am I a country music fan, however I couldn't turn down the opportunity to visit one of the oldest and most famous live radio shows in the nation. While on a trip to Nashville I had the opportunity to visit the Grand Ole Opry and watch a live radio show and I have to admit that I was quite pleased. Now with that being said I had tickets before I knew who was playing, however it ended up being Vince Gill and Ray Stevens.

Parking is the only real downside with this facility as it shares a lot with the neighboring mall, and my only advice is arrive early, very early. Otherwise you will be parking far away from the venue. Once inside there are a variety of drink stands, and yes you can take your drinks into the venue. Seating inside is good, and I doubt there is a bad seat in the house, however you will be sitting on uncomfortable benches that look like they are right out of a church.  Overall it was a great evening in this iconic venue, and I would gladly return again for another show.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Good bar. Super selection of offerings. Only down side is they are often out of stock on your first couple of selections but their is always another choice ready. Fun atmosphere and just a good place to kick back with friends.

name: Third Man Records
text:
A friend told me I needed to go to Jack White's record shop, but really, it's very underwhelming. Don't get me wrong, there's some cool stuff to look at, but it's tiny and not worth going out of your way for (unless you really like Jack White).

There's a lot of White Stripes/Jack White merch, as well as other records (just one rack of them though).

There's a cool booth that you can go into and record a song.

Woman at the counter was nice.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: My husband looked this diner/pub up online so we thought we would give it a try. We weren't greeted when we came in which is ok. We asked a server if we could sit in an open booth and he said sit anywhere you want. We sat there for a while looking at the drink menu and noticed a lady server come by and ask the people in front of us if everything was ok and then she walked right past us without even saying hello to check on the people behind us. My husband was ready to leave at that point, but I wanted to give them a little more time. The servers seemed more interested in talking to each other than saying hello to us. They were only moderately busy. We just got up and walked out and no one seemed to care. B.A.D. lives up to its name. We won't be going back!

name: Belcourt Taps
text: I was so excited to stumble across that little bar. I figured it could be a great hole-in-wall with great live music and little known great bar food. I'll never know. I walked in and got a great earthy, dingy vibe. I sat down at a two top as there only an older couple, two guys at the bar, another man doing paperwork at the bar, and what looked like a guitar player and (after misreading the woman as s waitress) a singer. Well, after 10 minutes of nobody  acknowledging me I went to the bar and waited another minute ... hmmm. Okay finally I ordered an appetizer out, another app, out again. And so was I, out the door.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
I am a sucker for a good deal, and Flying Saucer has a lot.  First, Monday night is pint night, and almost every pint is $3.  Well, every pint that is not an IPA or a super fancy craft beer.  But, the beers I like (read fruity or wheat) were all on sale, so I was all in.  They carry so many choices on draft, it's impossible to think that everyone could not find a few favorites.  The plates on the ceiling suggested they have many patrons who have tried a lot, as apparently you need to try 200 to get a plate.

The true winner though is the pizza.  We ordered the pizza with bacon, prosciutto, and pepperoni.  (Yes, we can be a bit gross, but it was vacation!).  It was SO good.  I love the fact they use mozzarella cheese, as it's my favorite melty cheese.  The meat was piled so high you could barely even see the cheese or crust.  It was so good, and one with all that meat was definitely enough to fill us both up.

Bartenders were hit or miss during our couple visits - some are super friendly, some seem like they'd rather not be bothered.  But, the beer and pizza made it all worth it.  And, to learn they are a chain!  Now, crossing my fingers Flying Saucer comes up North, and we can have a go at getting a plate on the ceiling.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Food was great, nice atmosphere as well but it was extremely busy so service was slow.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
The ONLY reason I'm giving this place any stars is because the Music and the food tasted good. But the service was atrocious!

We were in town for the CMA Music fest last weekend, so I understand it is busy. We didn't have a problem when they split up our party of 10 into 6 and 4 so we could be seated quicker. However, we waited about 10 min before anyone even came to our table to greet us. Finally our server Ashley, came over.  After we all placed drink orders, and she carded us... she came back almost 30 min later with 1 drink! ONE. She said that the bar was out of mint so they couldn't make our mojitos. What about all the other drinks we ordered? Well, she told us she completely forgot we ordered them and asked us again what we wanted. (This was the first time we spoke to the manager) She finally came back with the rest of our drinks, which tasted awful (stick to beer, don't attempt any sort of mixed drink from here) she finally took our food order. After clearly not knowing ANYTHING about the menu, didn't know what the options of sides were, what type of bread we could get, etc.... the worst was that when I told her what I wanted, she made a Disgusted face at me and said "Really?" So I clearly changed my order, I mean if the waitress thinks its bad to order it must be pretty bad, but how RUDE is that to make a gross face when someone orders their food!!??
We also ordered an appetizer for the table....

45 min later, we still had no food, no appetizer and all our drinks were empty! No one even came to check if we needed more water.
