I really wanted to sit in the lounge room, and imagine it's a prime spot for sitting and enjoying the weather and seasons. They have a decent selection of beers - of which our three-man team had no problem dividing and conquering. Service was attentive, and noise level was pleasant and cheery with the Pentatonix Christmas Album going on in the background. 

As a west-coaster, I'm a little jealous that they haven't expanded west of the Rio Grande. I could see myself frequent Flying Saucer on a regular basis with the ambitious goal of obtaining one of the hundreds of plates adorning their walls. Seriously a cool spot. I'll come again each time I visit Nashville.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
Came in with a group of 4 and sat down and waited.  After 5 minutes, I went up to the bar and ordered a drink and took back to table.  10 min go by and I'm halfway done with my beer and a waitress comes by and takes everyone elses order.  

15 min later another friend of mine shown up and she had her two older teenagers with her.  Immediately a waitress came over and said you can't be in here past 7pm, they will have to leave.

Not sure why friends rave about this place, but don't think I'll be coming back on my next trip to Nashville.  Not super busy, poor parking options.   Far better spots to go.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
We went on an October 2013 Monday with 8:30pm "reservations" booked online through Yelp/OpenTable, where the confirmation email said it was not a reservation but "priority seating." We only waited a couple minutes after we arrived to be seated, not very crowded.

We paid the $5 each cover, with the band also coming through the restaurant with a container for contributions while we waited for dinner. We gave money then too.

Both my husband and I had the ribs, which took awhile to arrive but were delicious, though they could've offered extra sauce when they brought them. We loved them, but some may have considered them dry. (We did not get Memphis style dry.) Coleslaw, baked beans, and corn bread were all small portions and nothing spectacular, but we didn't want any more because we both got big orders of ribs. I only tasted the beans, and they weren't great enough for me to eat on top of the ribs, but my husband liked and ate his but didn't want mine too. We had only sodas, which were very good, and they kept us in refills without asking. 

The band was very good. If you care about the music, it might help to call and see if you can get set times/break times. They stopped playing/took a break during our dinner and were back playing again before we left. While they're playing, talking isn't easy, nor is hearing, but the waitstaff was able to communicate with us, everybody shouting.

Casual atmosphere, didn't take itself too seriously, nice waitstaff, nice music, yummy ribs. They had a football game on in the bar area on TV.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
On a recent trip down south my family and I made a stop in Nashville. Though our timing wasn't good enough to be able to see the actual Grand Ole Opry show we did take the Backstage Tour of this iconic landmark. 

The tour is $20 per person and it was great and totally worth it! The tours go every 15 minutes so you never have to wait long for the next one. They start you off with a brief film giving you a history of the Opry. They then take you on a roughly one hour walking tour through the building. This is one of the best tours I've ever taken and my family members agreed with me. 

Our tour guide was really funny, friendly, and engaging in addition to having a plethora of interesting stories and information about the Grand Ole Opry. They take you to every interesting area of the building you would want to see! The tour includes the Opry Post Office where you can see the mailboxes of all the Opry members. They also take you to a famous filming room where Hee Haw was filmed as well as the hit show Nashville is regularly filmed there. The tour also includes the stars entrance, dressing rooms, star lounge, and the stage. When on stage be sure to stand on the famous wood circle taken from the Ryman Auditorium, the original home of the Grand Ole Opry.

After your tour be sure to walk outside and explore the plaza complete with giant guitars and the Opry Store Gift Shop. Also, Roy Acuff's home is located on site to see as well, however you can't go in the house. Unlike the Ryman Auditorium downtown, there is plenty of parking on site here making it really convenient to visit.

After taking this tour my family and I are already planning a trip down to Nashville again for next summer to see the Grand Ole Opry show here!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Wife and I visited here, because we have visited 3 of the other BB King venues.  There was a line to get it but it didn't take line to be seated, was a little surprised about the per person cover charge.  It took a little while for the wait staff to take our order, but it didn't take too long for the drinks and meals to arrive.  The music was great and the band really kept the crown up beat.  It was a fun evening and we will visit again on our next visit.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: Tues night is a great opp to hear some local color! All original music. Fantastic talent! Great local vibe. Super friendly service with good happy hr. Food is good but music is better!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
My wife and I went on an opry tour while we were staying at opry land... 

I LOVED IT!

As a long time country fan, I was delighted to go behind the scenes in country music and learn all about the opry.

I also loved standing on stage, and having a picture taken standing in the wooden circle!

If you love country, you will love this.. I would 100% recommend to all of you opry nuts like myself!

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
Beer. Beer. Beer. This place has it.

My wife and I were visiting during our honeymoon road trip. We stopped in at flying saucer to sample some local wares.

They have an impressive number of tap. Wow. Like, lots. They also had a few different flights to try. I had the Nashville flight (all local beers). It was a great mix of [what I would later find to be] some of the best beers in the area. Our server was attentive and helpful. The bar was clean and nice.

The bottom line: I will definitely stop in again if I am in search of beer in Nashville.

name: Third Man Records
text: We all love the vinyl, and Jack White has a sweet place to play the music respect! Rare recordings, recording booth, fun music novelties and T-shirts are awesome.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: I came here for country music but I got rock!   I would have thought that this famous venue would be bigger - but NOT.   It was about 1/2 or 1/3 of the Radio City Music Hall in NY.   Nevertheless, the acoustic was excellent and I was deaf by the time I got out in the evening.   um.. what did you say?

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: No where on the website could I find mention of the age restrictions that occur after 7pm. So not only did I travel downtown with my family to try out this establishment, but I paid $6 in parking to only be told I was not able to dine there as it was 6:50pm when we walked in for dinner. I understand having an age restriction after a certain hour but it should be clearly stated on the website as 7pm and not just on your door so as to not waste patrons time and money.  Very disappointed.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: It took quite a while to be acknowledged.  I get it, you're busy.  But ACKNOWLEDGE!!!  I've been in food & bev most of my live.  Try "I see you, I'm busy but will be with you soon".  None of that.  I ordered food to go.  I didn't receive utensils.  Menu said "sautéed onions". Mine were raw.  Burger is dry and overcooked.  There were no condiments for my burger.  Nor was I asked if I wanted any. One of the worst take out experiences of my life.  Skip it.

name: Third Man Records
text: As a HUGE fan of Jack White and all he does this had to be my first stop when visiting Nashville. It was like going on my journey to the mother land. It's a small shop but filled with all things awesome. Everything Jack does is high quality, including this shop. There are records, stickers, buttons, tshirts and many other lovely Third Man Items. You can just wander around and look at everything or record yourself in the record booth. Just go there and buy some vinyl.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
NYE was booming! Good crowd but not packed like sardines. The atmosphere was great!

My first time visiting at this location. I really enjoyed my experience at the one in Memphis so I figured I'd give this location a shot. It appears to be more spacious than the Memphis location. The music was great! Mostly 70s and 80s hits were sung. An occasional 90s & beyond. 

We ordered the Fried Zucchini & Bell Peppers to snack on and soak up some of the cocktails :). Sooooo yum! (Sorry no picture)

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
Arrived around 8:30pm for BBQ.
They said there was a $5 cover charge even if we were eating.
We paid it as I tip each band anyway as that is how they make money.
Question I have does the cover charge go to the band or the house?

Regarding the food, was not sure what to expect as we where eating a little late, thought maybe the food would not be very good or hot.
We had a rib dinner and a chicken/rib combo plate. IT WAS EXCELLENT.

Win/Win... Good food and the band (Mike Hayes) was excellent.

name: Third Man Records
text: Really cool venue. Really fun artists. Love that some shows live record the show for later purchase on vinyl. Only issue is you're standing there for a few hours and there in no water available. NONE. Only liquor and beer. For anyone with diet restrictions or underage be warned. You'll be high and dry lol

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: I had an awesome time here tonight! My server TREY was a delight...he was very attentive and professional.I will definitely be back ever time I come to Nashville!

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
Their pretzel app is fantastic - with two cheeses and two mustards.  I haven't had any of their other food, but have heard good things.  Beer selections is fantastic and quite reasonably priced; plus everyday they have a different beer on special for $3 pints.  Fun atmosphere, especially in low periods if you can sit on the couches and enjoy a pint.

Huge downside: parking is not free.  Park in the lot and get your ticket validated ($3 for less than 2 hours, $5 if greater than 2 hours).  Just a pain, but not so much to not make it worth returning.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: I have loved this place for a lonnnnnnggg time! Still one of my faves in Nashville! If you are a beer fan then this is for you! I love the atmosphere and the saucer bratzel! Yum! Pizza is good, Space Club and Dipster are good too! The only reason I didn't rate it five stars is like all the other reviewers said, "Don't go on the weekends." Sadly this is true. They get so busy I stopped going on weekends and now it's the perfect weeknight hangout.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
What's there to say that hasn't already been said? We loved it so much, we went twice on our trip to Nashville! Well, I guess it helps that Dolly Parton was there and we knew we needed to get there to see her and we made sure that happened!

There really isn't a bad seat in the house. I recommend possibly purchasing tickets from a third party for a really good deal, especially on sold out shows. It seems there are always tickets available and good prices even when it's sold out.

We did standing room only for Dolly and ended up standing against the wall on the top tier, just below the upper seating. It wasn't terrible, but I recommend getting their early enough that you get a decent spot on the wall, especially if you like to be more towards center.

name: Third Man Records
text: By far THE best stop in Nash! This shop is adorable and quirky and small and loaded with talent. First of all, the lady who was working at the shop was too cool for school with her vintage inspired yellow and black trademark colors uniform dress. But not only are the peeps in this shop rockabilly coolness, they are also SO nice! She gave us a full guide of local shows, bars, clubs and restaurants to check out while in town. So anyway, we browsed the store and all of it's music industry treasure nicknacks and records. This is Jack White's record shop and recording studio space, so it's truly a one of a kind vibe. The crowning jewel of this shop is the vintage live recording booth that will record like 3 minutes of sound. I saw students in there singing and playing guitar in the booth. So 6 of us decided to give it a whirl and time capsule or trip to Nash with a fun recording. The lady at the shop told us all about the history of the booth and just how many music legends have stood in that very same booth to record! She then gave us the recording on her, as a gift. I think the cost os around $10? Worth it! I picked up a Margo Price album and Johnny Cash single - my first records. There are also other interactive and fun booths to play in, like the dj booth to scratch records. This shop is such a special place and really represents what Nash is all about- the music. I think the space next door is venue and recording studio space for artists and shows, which would be so great to see in the future!

name: Belcourt Taps
text: Terribly slow service even though we were nearly the only people in the place. Food was mediocre at best.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Shrimp and grits!  Awesome.  Service great...entertainment great.  One band not so much.  Not typically a fan of tourist traps and big chain restaurants but wanted to stop in this old favorite.  Did not disappointed at all.  For some reason my bottle of beer was flat and they quickly replaced it....Fried pickles, never had those before, but they were a great appetizer.  We were there during CMA Fest from June 6-10, Nashville was extremely busy, but the service was good and it was not too crowded.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Loved this place!! My favorite on a recent trip to Nashville. Bar staff was great while we waited for the rest of our friends. Lynchburg lemonade-yum! Food was also good but the live music was the best!

name: Music City Tippler
text:
If there ever was proof that Nashville has changed, it's the Music City Tippler. The crowd, the concept, heck, even the neighborhood... back when I first lived in Nashville, none of this would have existed or made sense. But this is now and this is... OMG Taylor Swift! So, I get it and I embrace it. Nashville is all grown up and the world is starting to see what a rad place it is to live... and grab a drink.

There are many places now in Nashville to find cool kids. It just depends on what kind of cool kid you're looking for. Natives? Southern transplants? Los Angelinos? NYcers? Trust fund babies? 'Artists'? Artists? You get the point. Here at the Music City Tippler, the cool kid crowd (at least while I was here) skewed more east coast (to be expected) and star-gazing. The layout makes sense, the decor is inviting (more than that; it's gorgeous and sexy) and the drinks are good. I had an early morning ahead of me, so rather than sitting around and gazing at all the pretty as I went down the entire cocktail list, I opted for a sangria. Red wine, rum and fruit will always be a good idea. I was hopeful for some late night bites but, for some reason, they weren't available. We weren't there *that* late but I also wasn't heading up the negotiations with the waitress. The place wasn't *that* packed but she seemed pretty harried. Again, I was leaving after one drink and was too distracted by everything else going on there to pay much attention to any service woes. It just means I need to come back for more cocktails... and much more pretty.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: The food was really good especially the greens. The service was great. I loved the live music. I will definitely return here soon.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
This place was pretty alright. Unfortunately, there's a lot of construction going on in the area at this time, but if you pay close attention, you'll make it back there to the right spot.
Service was o-kay. When we walked in, I said "hi" to 2 different servers and got looks instead of hello's. You seat yourself, but it was a bit of time before someone acknowledged our table. Then we sat for a while before we had to ask our waitress for glasses of water. She did get the basics of our orders down though, and the food came out correct, for the most part.
I will say, the food was pretty good. I stuck with a safe selection - hot wings. Your typical buffalo wing sauce, but they fried them up nice and crispy, and that made them more delicious. My friend got their Loaded Rocket-Tots, and they were GOOD! So glad she shared. I don't even like tater tots (it's a texture issue, lol), but these were delicious (texture aside)! Yummy jalapeño potatoes, cheese, egg... my goodness! You need a bite with everything together to understand the deliciousness! 
The decor was cool and beautiful at the same time. 
I would definitely return. Nice pub atmosphere. 
Still want to try their pretzels...

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Terrible food, bad service, and music was just ok. Skip this one. There are plenty of other places to go in Nashville. Try Skulls Rainbow Room!

name: Belcourt Taps
text:
I do not dole out single stars lightly, but in this case I would give 0 if I could. 

I first tried Belcourt Taps (& tapas? Didn't they used to have tapas?) last year and had a very meh experience. I waited for another visit to review since a first time bad experience could always be a fluke. My husband bought a groupon for 2 beer flights and an appetizer this month not knowing I wasn't a huge fan based on previous experience, but we thought, hey it's pretty hard to mess up beer. I guess we jinxed ourselves. 

The inside was pretty full when we arrived on a week night, and it looked like a band was about to go on. I'm thinking this place is best as just a music venue where you happen to have a beer rather than a destination for a meal.

We opted for the patio since it was nice outside. We told our waitress up front that we were going to redeem their groupon, which she seemed super confused about and told us they didn't have a current groupon, their old one expired. Not her fault, but the staff was clearly not educated on the offer (which didn't expire for 3 more months). If you have a groupon out there, maybe tell your staff about it. 

We asked about the beer flights (not on the menu) and she told us that it was "local stuff."  We were fine with that explanation since we knew we were getting whatever their groupon deal was and couldn't be picky. However, when the "flights" arrived, it was one big service tray with 10 mini mason jars (those were cute, I'll give them that), each about a third full and nothing was labeled or in any order. They were also not cold. We asked her what they were and she said "mostly local stuff, it's good" and then walked away. Ok..... 

We ended up finding out through taste testing trial and error that we did not, in fact, have 2 flights (I incorrectly assumed we would each get the same 5 beers since it was supposed to be 2 flights...), just 10 random different beers. We also deduced that TWO of them were some kind of HARD CIDER.  I have no problem with cider if that's what I ordered, but I don't really find it acceptable to put it in a beer flight with no warning.  

I won't even address the appetizer we got except to say that I do not recommend the nachos. 

The waitress informed us that if we didn't order anything else besides just redeeming the groupon there would be 20% gratuity charged. We had initially planned to order more, but the app was so bad that we decided not to. We were planning to tip all along, so the gratuity charge was no problem. The receipt listed the 10 beers, which included Sam Adams and Angry Orchard (aka, not local and not beer).  We asked if those were our beers since they weren't labeled and she said no, I just pushed 10 random buttons to get the bill printed so I could charge gratuity. Great. I am convinced we did get the angry orchard, though. There's no mistaking that for beer. 

The excuse for a beer flight would have been disappointing anywhere, but is especially puzzling from a place with "taps" in their name who is specifically advertising beer flight deals. 

Since this is 2 bad experiences in a row a year apart, it's not a fluke. I will not be returning.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Second time at the Opry and second time for a night fully entertained. I don't see a trip to Nashville without going to the Opry. It's a great show for country lovers.

The first time we came we purchased tickets way in advance for a weekend getaway. Turned out that ended up being the weekend they scheduled All Star Weekend so we got to see several acts that are big stars.

Love that they mix in oldies and more current acts.

Some of their repeat acts like Jean Shepard and Riders in the Sky are very entertaining. The show is ever changing and lively as each act plays 2 or 3 songs and they move on to the next. They also break it up into portions and each portion has a different host so you never get too bored with one person.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Great live music venue and delicious food. Tons of drink options. Loved the garlic mashed potatoes and cornbread!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: The food, service and experience was amazing. I don't know what they put in their Mac and cheese, but it is some of the best I've ever had.

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Went there twice during the trip,one night they had a live band another night a DJ, large bar with plenty of bartenders so the drinks/food come out quickly, ordered the burger it was very good ... would visit again

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Any tourist coming to Nashville should know that the Grand Ole Opry House is a must. It is a wonderful piece of history, and has held so many performances by legendary country music artists.

  I will say that I have never seen a show myself or done the tour - so my review is based off of the Grand Ole Opry as an event space. I was invited through a friend to Southwest Airline's employee rally, which was held here and made for a great space.

   The inside and outside are beautiful - especially the stage room. It's big, but also small enough to wear almost any seat in the house could give you a great view. There are also a couple screens projecting who is on stage for those farther away.

   They also have a nice outside space out front, where there were all kinds of local food trucks/stands set up to cater. 

   As a fan of country music, I am already wanting to go back and schedule a tour/see a performance! This place is just awesome.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Wow! Wow! Wow! What a fantastic time.   While in Nashville, we couldn't miss the chance to see a concert at the Grand ole Opry.   Main person here was Vince Gill.   Plus, 12 others!  What a show.   What was a huge surprise was that this was an "on-air" live broadcast, from the the Grand Ole Opry. Anddd it includes commercials, as well. A little quirky, but this has been happing for 92 years that we've been told. Awesome! Just  gotta mark this off your bucket list; it's a must do for sure. Thanks for a great time!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: These idiots owe me $80 ($40 one way cab fair from the hotel).  Came all the way out here for the "every 15 min's tour" that was sold out until next week.  F&ck them, I will never come back here again.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Legendary venue. The staff is always so friendly and of course the music is always great! Always a treat!

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
Decided to go here because I have been to their other location (Fort Worth, Texas) and it was an amazing experience. They have the largest beer selections ever!!

Monday is their $3/pints and most of the beer I got tasted awesome! I usually get ciders. It's not too sweet and still have that "beer" taste. Unfortunately, I didn't get to try their food. 

Service was good and I never waited too long to order my next drink. If you decide to park in the garage - remember to get your ticket validated. I forgot how much it was but it wasn't pricey at all. Will be coming back and highly recommend to all beer fans!!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: First time here. Came at 5pm on Memorial day weekend Sunday and the wait was 45 min. Totally worth the wait.  We didn't have to pay any kind of cover so Um not sure about that.  Started with the soul sampler(wings, catfish bites and their famous fried pickles!) Had the brisket & ribs. Finished with their specialty shots. Worth the trip. Two of us with a total of 5 drinks and sampler appetizer was $75.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
TERRIBLE SERVICE!  Our waiter was literally grumbling to himself the entire time and said he validated our parking, but he didn't. We went in to grab a beer and get our parking validated. This was a bad decision. 

The table behind us couldn't get his attention and finally walked out on their check. Usually, I wouldn't be ok with that, but I had watched them wait 20 minutes trying to get his attention. 

We got an app and two beers. The food came out quickly, but the beers took forever. And only one beer came out. If I hadn't been paying attention to what he grumbled to himself, we would not have known he knew we were expecting another beer. He grumbled quietly that the keg needed to be changed. I understand that, but he did not communicate that well at all. Also, I was a waiter for years. If I have a delay like that, I bring the customer a water and have two back up choices that are similar for the customer to switch to.

name: Third Man Records
text:
Sometimes Jack White hangs out here and that is basically all you need to know.  His actual studio is next door making this a must see attraction in Nashville.

The space is tiny but jam packed with stuff to do and see adding to the overall thrill. The store is sensory overload in the best sort of way. Everything from the walls to the lights to the clothes the lady working was wearing is black, white or yellow with red accents. Music is blaring and customers are attempting to take it all in. They of course sell a few select records, but they also have lots of third man offerings like shirts, stickers, buttons etc.

There are plenty of activities to do in this pocket sized store as well.  You can peruse the hall of Jack White's records or jump in the phone booth to make a quick call.  For 15 tokens, you can record anything you want on a small vinyl record.  The booth is only large enough for one person to record at a time.  Two kids could potentially fit. 15 tokens is equivalent to $15. You can also shed a few tokens to watch a music video. For three tokens, you can get your pics made in the photo booth.  This is what my group was wanting to do, but the line was real long so instead I used my three tokens elsewhere.  I indeed walked out of Third Man with a wax replica of Jack White's 1964 Montgomery Ward airline guitar.  So yeah, that's pretty great.

Totally worth checking out and not too far from downtown Nashville.

name: Belcourt Taps
text:
This place was the worst.  The bar was pretty dead. There was one two top, one other couple at the bar, and someone who appeared to be the owner or manager sitting at the bar doing paperwork.  
We ordered the gourmet soft pretzel to start. A few
Minutes later the bartender said he was leaving and another lady was taking over. She came by and we reminded her that the guy put in a pretzel for us. About 20 minutes later it came out, and it was 100% one of those microwaveable pretzels. We asked for cheese and mustard but only got cheese. 
While we waited for the pretzel we put in two burgers. They took forever to come out, and when they were so well done. Like hockey pucks. Everything about this place was a disgrace. How can you claim to have the "best burger in town" and not even be able to properly cook a burger?  I would stay far away from here!!!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: My friend and I did a tour here, which has been on my bucket list since I was a little girl! The tour is awesome and the tour guides really know their information. You see the front of house and back of house. You get to see the dressing rooms (all different and unique). You also are able to tour the stage and get a picture in the "circle." There's a rather decent sized gift shop full of different things to purchase. Outside the Grand Ole Opry is beautiful so I suggest walking around. A must see when in Nashville.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: The blues will never die!  We had a great time here.  It took a little time to get seated hence four stars not five. They took care of us from the bar while we waited  The band was rockin and the place IS popular.  Great vibe. Friendly staff.  Cold beer.  Good food.  The B B King Allstars.  C'mon! What else do you need?  Go for the music and stay for the mac and cheese.  Thank you Faith and your staff there at the Club!

name: Belcourt Taps
text: One of our favorites in Nashville The bartender was everything you would want in a bartender and quite accommodating! Ohhh and did I mention the ribs?!? Phenomenal! We will definitely be back!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Whenever you can, gotta see a show in this cathedral of country music.  

all silly superlatives aside,  just about as intimate and amazing a venue I've ever been to.  even pops seemed to like it.  

Cheryl Crowe was the guest for our private little show.  she's got a lot of Grammys for a reason.  respected their wish for no pics during the performance,  which is fine.  She's a class act,  and deserves the best respect. 

list of faves included all I wanna do,  soak up the sun, my fave mistake, the 1st cut is the deepest, everyday is a winding road,  string enough,  if it makes you happy,  Steve McQueen, a change would do you good, home and closed the show with an encore performance of been a long time. 

just awesome.

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
Wonderful dinner here last night! Our waitress was wonderful- really seemed like she was happy to serve us. They were crazy busy with a party of 25 upstairs so it took a while to get drinks from the bar but so worth it. (She let us know beforehand) 

I ordered the Aloha burger with baked beans and it was delicious! 

Looked like they had a lot of great specials on different nights. Locals night, ladies night ($1 wells!), $2 PBR on Saturday, etc. 

Definitely recommend!

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text:
I really enjoy this venue for drinks and music. On the bottom level there is a band and on the top outdoor patio level there is usually a couple of people playing and the atmosphere is more chilled. There are heaters on the top level as well. 

Honoring our troops is displayed everywhere which I love and the people who work there are very friendly!

name: Music City Tippler
text: I have to say it's refreshing to go out in my mid 30's and have flashbacks of when things were happening in Nashville back in my 20's. It's a relatively mixed crowd. Of course there is your fair share of single 20 something women looking for a man. Overall, mixed bag. This place had an excellent DJ. The bar was packed, but efficient. I loved my Pink 75 and the rest of my crew loved their drinks. We moved down to the lower bar, which was a bit slower service. Only food I tried was the chicken biscuit, and it was pretty good and reasonably priced. Definitely nice to have small plates you can order at the bar to soak up all the alcohol before going home. Had a great time and music was fab. Looking forward to going back and trying the menu!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Not as good as the Ryman but, its a nice venue with caring personel while I was in a wheelchair. They were very helpful and caring.
I recommend the backstage tour, singing on the Opry stage in the magical circle, makes ya feel good. Knowing who once stood there.
This venue fills up rather fast.
Great gift shop, roomy and lots of choices of different items..
The acoustics are good.
Close parking spots are hard to find, Be prepared to walk far. They need more handicapped spaces.
Also, dont book an isle seat as people come down to take pictures and it blocks your view. The employees try to keep them limited but, it takes you away from the performances.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
I had stopped giving a 5 rating but have had to reconsider.  We were in town for our national meeting and finally we're given some free time.  Staying next door made this an obvious choice.  Ok, I have to admit, I am a great fan of country music.

Everyone that we ran into was so helpful.  That got us to our seats quickly, just before the show started.  Then the entertainment started, and all of them were awesome.  The blue grass band was so good that I decided I liked that kind of music.  The main act was Rascal Flatts, and although very good, I thought they came in last if I were rating.  Mo Pitney, who I had not heard of, was awesome.  I have already added some of his music.

We had great seats, right down on the floor by the stage.  All seats had a good view, and the sound system was good.

Will I return?  Already talking to the family about going during vacation!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
Came here on a business trip with some co-workers and was honestly blown away. The place definitely brings a low key chill vibe. We were greeted warmly and promptly seated at our table.
 There was already a live band playing which was amazing, they were really good and had wonderful personality. They even called out to people in the restaurant.
  To drink, I had the LUCILLE which was honestly super delicious. It was a well made drink, everything mixed together perfectly. Almost tasted like juice! 
 To eat, BORN ON THE BAYOU SHRIMP AND GRITS. Oh.my.gawd. It was SCRUMPTIOUS. Honestly the best I ever had. I couldn't believe how good it was. I finished it so quick, I wish they served more. The perfect amount of cheese, shrimp cooked right, all of it was wonderful!
  I know it's somewhat of a franchise but please stop by if you're in town! I definitely recommend!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Had a great time amazing service from the wonderful, large hearted, and amazing bartender Mattie. By far best service. Everyone needs to come and see her.

name: National Underground
text: We Loved this place. Nice staff, great food and dog friendly patio. Get the Mac and cheese, and the hot chicken sando, Nashville Gem!

name: National Underground
text: We had a great time at National Underground.  The music was good and not too loud.  We sat at the bar and we served right away.  We enjoyed it so much we came back the next day for brunch.  My wife had biscuits and gravy and I had the hamburger.  Both we very good.  We will go back when we are in Nashville.

name: National Underground
text:
The bartenders were nice but the guy by the restrooms and ice cooler, who i was told was the manager, began yelling at me, threatened to kick me out and called me a "prick" for standing next to their ice cooler even after i respected his request not to touch the ice cooler. 

I have never experienced such awful treatment by an establishment's "management" in my life. I was with a group of 12 people who were all respective and not causing any issues. I would not return to a place where this type of unwarranted hostility and verbal abuse was acceptable...ever. If I could give them negative stars I would.

Looking at other reviews it appears that many other patrons have had similar experiences here which is extremely sad and unfortunate.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: Went here on karaoke night. Laid back fun atmosphere with dance floor and bar in the back! Some of the people that sang were amazing! Honestly! Not as tourists and more of a local hang out which was nice to experience! They also have a patio area. Everyone was so friendly here we met so many people! A much younger crowd and age appropriate for our group compared to Broadway- but Broadway is a must and you will still have fun! This is a place you have to visit when in Nashville!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: I come here pretty often to watch the Predator games. The arena is always clean and the food vendors they have are pretty good! The staff here is amazing. Everyone is so kind and willing to go out of their way for you. Even the employees that get swarmed with people at the main doors that operate the ticket scanners and metal detectors, are just so nice and friendly. Love coming here!

name: Ole Red
text: Very new place to having good time!   Good for Drinks&Food and Music and Music and Music!

name: Ole Red
text:
We stopped in Ole Red 2 days in a row. Love Blake! 
So the 1st day we sat on 2nd floor. We waited for a server and finally after 10 minutes we asked for a server. 
Took about 20  minutes to get a drink. When my husband got a beer they didn't pop the lid. He took it off with his teeth... lol..... couldn't find the server.
Very slow service. 
Day 2, we went with a few others,  again sat up the top, waited and waited and finally asked a couple of people (not one) to be served. We had been sitting 15 minutes already.
Finally drink order was taken and still 20 minutes wait on the drink. After our drinks we asked for the bill. 20 minutes later we were asking again for the bill and our waitress comes out from the back and she has forgotten that we had asked for it. We wanted separate bills as requested and she came back with 1. It's not that they were really busy. There seemed to be a lot of waitresses walking around in a daze, not paying attention to what was needing attention.  I spoke with manager and she just said "I'm sorry". When we left I asked if there was another manager. Answer was no, and I spoke with the hostess and she said the same 'sorry'.....that's it. 
If this was a one time experience the I would not comment, but I sure would appreciate the feed back if it was my establishment. 
Sorry Blake, love you,  but there needs to be some improvements! 
Great atmosphere, great music!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Have eaten at Margaritaville's before in Myrtle Beach, Key West and Florida and this one is the worst. Burger was okay, hard to mess up a burger, wife's fish sandwich tasted bad (they comped her meal--good part), drinks and shot overpriced. Better options for food and drinks in NashVegas.

name: Nashville Symphony
text: went here for the first time last night to see Ledisi.  my two complaints are (1) valet didn't take cards and you couldn't pay the valet directly.   you had to pay inside.  (2) the air. i am cold natured so i travel with jackets and sweaters, neither helped!  the establishment was beautiful and sound system was exceptional.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
One of the coolest places in Nashville I've ever been to. The owner happened to be around and took my friends and I on a personal tour around the brewery, super cool guy. The main bartender has a doctorate in something no one has ever heard of ;) ( cellular structure stuff)  she's made an amazing concoction of kombucha. Ask for a beer bucha.. A natural antioxidant, you'll be feeling amazing in no time!
Honestly you have to go, you won't be disappointed.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
Perhaps it was a off-night, but the crowd at Jimmy Buffets was actually pretty lacking the night we stopped by. The first floor had a live band which was pretty solid but there was not much of a crowd or any dancing. Even on the second floor it was kind of quiet - most people were just eating dinner though it was fairly late into the evening. 

We ended up sitting here a while to rest our tired legs before moving on. Seemed like a fun place with a good setup for listening to live music, maybe next time I'm in the area it will be a bit more fun.

name: Ole Red
text:
Some of my older (baby boomer) colleagues chose this spot on a recent business trip to Nashville.

The service was slow, food unremarkable, and layout stank.  The place was about 50% full but the hostess sat us at a table uncomfortably close to the bar (people continuously bumping into our chairs to pass us).  Took over half an hour of our napkins on our plates being ready to go before we could even get our waitress to get us the check.

There are tons of great historic spots on Broadway, don't waste your time or money getting suckered into a subpar place like this.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
I have been to Bridgestone many, many, many times for sporting events, concerts, entertainment shows, etc. I really love this venue. They recently updated some of their food stands (I think that's what they're called) and they are DELICIOUS. I think my fav item is the mashed potato bowl at the Chicken stand - oh my YUM. Bridgestone is massive so it's easy to get lost in but wherever you sit in the venue, you've got a great view. Love the atmosphere when a crowd is packed in there. Unfortunately, parking downtown sucks. I can never find somewhere close to park for less than $15-$20 bucks. Of course there are cheaper spots to park further away from the venue but if I'm meeting friends, and walking alone at night, I prefer to be closer to Bridgestone for safety reasons. 

If you haven't been to an event here, come. It's a great way to spend any day/night, the alcohol selection is wonderful and the food is yummy!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Margaritaville's atmosphere, service and quality of food have always been good. My favorite room to dine in is the Tiki Room. Though upstairs in the Cowboy Room is fun as well, but might only be arranged for larger groups. If you are going for a drink and app, I would suggest the Lava Lava Shrimp. It is sweet with the right amount of spice. If you get the Volcano Nacho make sure you are hungry and ready to share. It is an impressive stack of covered nachos. For entrees I would recommend their Fish Tacos or Jerk Chicken. If you save room for dessert, you can't go wrong with the Key Lime Pie or Cheesecake.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
When we got our food, it was good.  

The ups:
Live entertainment, that rotates between floors, when they aren't on your floor, there are tvs that you can see it.  
Food was good
They give kids these neat wiki stix packets instead of coloring stuff

Our experience negatives:
I ordered the Al Vacado burger, without the jalepeno mayo.  They literally brought me a plain cheese burger.  

They brought me tomatoe and lettuce on a plate, when I mentioned it. 

After everyone was done with their meal, my corrected meal plain.

Someone in our group ordered a steak, med-well.  He got med-rare.

Our second round of drinks came 40 minutes later.  

What they did:

The didn't charge us for the steak meal, which was a more costly than the hamburger meal.

They gave us a round of desserts.

name: Marathon Music Works
text:
I attend Ethos Church here on Sundays. The huge, expansive venue fits a generous, large-to-medium sized crowd, with a modest stage space. For a mostly music venue, their bathrooms are always quite clean as well. If you're going for concerts, they have a decent bar, though I've never been here when it's active.

Structurally, I love how you can see just a bit of blue sky peeking out of side windows on the industrial, high ceilings every Sunday morning. The natural lighting also compliments the space well, given the overwhelmingly industrial feel. I would say a minimalist triumph in concert and venue spaces.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Terrible. Overpriced, long wait, and the food took forever. The jambalaya was as if it was cooked in a microwave. Don't go, nothing positive to say. My friends plates where garbage also.

name: Marathon Music Works
text: Marathon is a great space in a cool part of town. Intimate setting which is great for smaller bands. You can feel the energy and if you see a cool band like Moon Taxi (Nashville natives) then you really get an awesome show.

name: Ole Red
text: If you can get past the hostess and her lack of knowledge and service it is worth it! Waitress repeatedly told us she wasn't taking reservations or anymore names. But the second floor and roof are first come first serve. We found a table! It was dirty but someone eventually came to clean, and we used our phones to view menu. Waiter was great! But he seemed frazzled, he just moved to Nashville 2 weeks ago. Food was delicious and hot!!! Biscuit was one of the best we have had in Nashville! Nachos were huge for four of us to share and were great! Band was playing, loud but still could talk over, I felt he was taking more breaks then I have seen other bands take at other establishments on broadway. Would recommend and go again but either make a reservation a month or more in advance or get ready to test your patience with the terrible hostess and her disorganization.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
I'm not a big beer drinker. But...

Tennessee Brew Works is doing a great job of making stellar, craft beers right here in Nashville.  They join the ranks of Yazoo and Jackalope as some of the best local brew around.  The building is super cool. And there's a new menu of enticing small plates!! (including hot fried frog legs)

I play music now and then at the TN Brew Works too, and I always really look forward to it. There's an assortment of acoustic live music Thursday - Saturday nights.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Thank you Chris M. for making us feel so welcome as guests! You took time to give us tips and a map of where to visit. I can honestly say that the service you provided was the best I have ever encountered (even from high end restraunts)! I hope to come back and see you again soon!

name: Ole Red
text:
Great place for live music! 3 stories of music, food and drinks. 

Good food, great drinks and a really fun atmosphere! Wait staff is a little inexperienced but they've only been open 2 weeks! 

Blake Shelton and partners hit a homerun with this venue! It's a must see on Broadway when in Nashville!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: My husband and I stopped by for a drink and ended up staying for three and appetizers. Loved the food and the drinks were awesome, but what was really above and beyond was the service. Our waitress, Stephanie took really good care of us, made the visit very personal and made sure we had a great time!  Really didn't expect this level of friendliness on a busy tourist destination.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text:
$2 domestic beer in long neck bottles on Funday Sunday

May 18th, Sunday, Tony and I decided to Urban Hike today again in Nashville. So, after we made a few stops we ended up here...Winner's Bar and Grill on the West Side off Broadway near Vanderbilt University.

It is a Sunday and about 11am..so its not really crowded...A good thing!
Our Waitress was very friendly and quick to greet us, but didn't give us her name..We liked this bar right from the start. Well lit with Natural light and decor was in Football, with TV on the screens so it reminded us of a sports bar. There is a corner band area, not really large but right size...the tables are all high tops and one large booth. They are spread apart for ample room to move around. 

The waitress brought us menus and got our drink order. She immediately told Tony the drink special is Funday Sunday $2 domestic long necks...Great price...so Tony ordered his favorite...can you guess...??? Budweiser
I ordered a soda...we looked through the menu (very simple two sides only) but we opted not to eat here. We already decided on Five Points on the other side of town..

The music was casual rock and country blend..nothing major. They allow smoking inside and out on the patio...a plus in Tony's book. They have on street parking (if you can grab a spot) and a private parking lot you can access from the alleyway. The patio area is nice and large..

I really liked this spot and I would go here again..The prices were right, staff friendly and quick and menu looked adequate...next time will have to try some actual food...lol !!!
But the beer pricing was great...$6 for both drinks with taxes and tip

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
The Southern Grilled Cheese is something dreams are made of. Pecans + bacon + cheddar... its decadent in all the right ways. 

This place really hit the spot on service too. Everyone was super friendly, informative and went out of their way to make you feel welcome. Great spot for both locals and tourists who appreciate craft beer and upscale bar bites.

name: Ole Red
text: Pimento cheese appetizer is a DO NOT MISS!  Oklahoma burger was also delicious.  We expected the place to be more about the ambiance and music- but it was clear that just as much attention had been paid to the food.  Very family friendly (at least at lunch time)- everyone was very welcoming to both our 9 year old and 11 month old.  Ole Red was our absolute best meal and experience in Nashville.  Don't miss this place.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: The fish tacos and the normal margarita are good, not great but good. Just about everything else our party of 6 ordered sucked. Decor is lame, it's too loud to have any conversation, even early on a tuesday night. It was lame, I'll not go back

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Stopped in late at night.  Had the mile high nachos and margaritas.  Great service.  Tasty nachos.  Fun atmosphere and live musicians.  Would love to come back!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Stopped in to get a late lunch. Shane was our server and he was great. There was live music which we enjoyed. Would recommend you stopping in to eat or just to have a cold one.

name: Ole Red
text: We visited Ole Red for supper tonight. I really wanted to like it, but the menu didn't have a lot to choose from. The atmosphere was enjoyable, good music, and we had the sweetest server that was very attentive, that being said the food took longer than I would have expected as it was not very busy. I had the Nashville Hot Chicken and Biscuit with fries. The biscuits were nothing special and the chicken was not very hot (spicy) but it appeared to be made with dark meat and it seemed like every bite had one of those tendons in it that made it hard to eat, I couldn't even finish it. My daughter had the Redneck Nachos, they were just okay, not near enough toppings for the amount of chips they give you. Ole Red does not appear to be a traditional Honky Tonk so I would have expected more out of it as a Restaurant - more to choose from and better quality for the price. I probably will not return.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Well let's see...my wife wanted to go here. We had already had dinner so we stoped to use the potty and have a few drinks. The music was AWESOME!!!  They had several couples dancing and the band did a good job not butchering old songs (Folsom prison blues). Our server BREE seemed annoyed that all we wanted were drinks. Then when we got our check there was a "LBD Tax" on there. They claimed it was for cleaning up the street. I call BS.  Then in the restrooms there were attendants. I'm not a 2 year old, I can get my hands washed all by myself. The guy in the men's room actually asked for the tip. All in all we had a great time and will be back; for dinner next time.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: We stumbled into Tennessee brew works, thirsty after an afternoon of Nashvhille tourist activities, and they didn't disappoint. They had maybe 10ish beers on tap. I had the Rye IPA and it was very good. The food was stellar - I had fish tacos which were excellent, and my husband was happy with his burger. My aunt and cousin both raved about the grilled cheese too. My favorite thing was the cheese plate - at $15 it was a steal, included 3 different cheeses, and lots of accompaniments. We sat upstairs and watched football on one of the TVs, but there's also ample outdoor seating and live music downstairs as well.

name: Ole Red
text: One of our favorite spots downtown! The Ole Red beer is so good, we accidentally got to try Big Red which is a cream soda which was also pretty good if you like that stuff. We ordered "The Champagne of Fried Chicken half bird" and it was probably the most delicious meal we had that day! The chicken was so juicy and the biscuits were perfect. The live music was always great every time we went. More than 5 stalls in the ladies room would be a plus but other than that Ole Red is perfect!!

name: National Underground
text: Great drinks, amazing staff, and unbeatable food! The hot chicken sandwich was to die for... Plus they treated my dog like a king!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Came here for the Summit 2016 and came here every night cause they just had amazing food and live entertainment! Fun place to be, food is good, loud environment but that's Nashville for ya! My go-to place when I come to Tennessee!

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
While it's not such big, this symphony canter is a perl that needs to be properly valorized.

The sound quality is really great. Its central location is kind of a problem in terms of parking, but it's nice to walk around downtown after the concert that brought you there.

Elegant, and well maintained facility, I love it!
It's just a pity that they don't play "good stuff" so often.
Look up for discount coupons before buying the thicket on line. I randomly got the 50% off out of mine.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: About a week ago i was in Nashville for a bach party and did we have a blast!! Our server shane was awesome! Very fun and informational about the menu. He knew exactly what we would like and helped us all night! Fun guy and great server! I will be back for sure and asking for shane!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
We stopped in at this place after a good hour and a half of walking around people watching and seeing the sights on Broadway. There was a live band playing at the time we walked in, but they ended shortly after we walked in and ordered (around 3 pm).

Median demographic was on the over-50 end, including the band. The room with the band was a little small which made it nice to be not too far from the bar or from the band. Service to our table was prompt and friendly.

Margaritas were very good, maybe a little on the sweet side but definitely not weak. If you like tequila, the unflavored variants were mixed well.

Protip: try to snag a corner window seat in the room with the band to maximize people watching in and out of the restaurant as well as the band.

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
I haven't attended any concerts here, but my friend just had her wedding here and this location was beyond perfect! 

The stage was a great size, the seating was perfect for the amount of people that attended the wedding, and the staff was very helpful. 

We had a "bridal suite" to get ready in and it was the perfect size for our bridal party. The lighting in the entire venue was great. Even the outdoor corridors were perfect for the wedding pictures and bridal party pictures. 

I'm going to have to come back to see a concert here. I've already fallen in love with the place and can't imagine this venue being a bad spot for anything.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text:
Cute little bar on Nashville's Honky Tonk strip.
Seemed mostly suited for older crowds.  Live classic country and folk music.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: One of the BEST honkey tonk bars on Broadway! The staff is the pure definition of southern hospitality, Haley made it worth going back again! Great music, super reasonable prices and just a fun time!!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Beer is fantastic, tons of great options for any beer palate...  crew is knowledgeable and friendly.  Love the emphasis on utilizing local ingredients.  Can't wait to go back when I'm in Nashville again.  Keep up the great work!

name: Ole Red
text: Four of us were there for lunch on May 2nd. Since Blake Shelton is part owner we thought we'd give it a try. Steel Magnolias was on stage and they were OUTSTANDING!. My wife and I shared fried chicken and it was very good....not the best in the world but not the worst. We ordered a local blonde beer and it came out cold and was actually good for a local beer we'd never heard of. We were probably there for an hour and our waitress was attentive the whole time. I'd definitely come back.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: Absolutely amazing music in a fun atmosphere! Real country music right on Broadway! Great music and good times.

name: Ole Red
text:
Was here on Sunday night. Arrived a little after 9:30. Sat at a table waiting for service until  10:20.  We asked a couple of staff for menus and a waitress, never happened. We finally pulled another waitress over at 10:20 and she said the kitchen closed at 10 and btw, this isn't her section!
Won't be back.

name: Ole Red
text:
Great place after shopping and walking down Broadway to stop for a drink, a bite to eat and some good ole live music. They have several floors (3 or 4) and a rooftop bar. There is a great view of Nashville from the rooftop bar. I asked for an iced tea (non alcoholic), and the bartender comped it for me.
Great place.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
This is an interesting property with plenty of places to sit and things to do. They have seating options from outside on the patio to inside the big room where they actually make the beer. They have a room with a dart board and other games. They also have a stage downstairs with a live band.

The brewery is kind of hidden, so it will feel like the GPS is taking you the wrong way. It's below a bridge so you need to go around a few blocks to get down there. We went during the day and it felt safe, but it is an area with a lot of abandoned buildings so I wouldn't recommend you try walking there at night (take an Uber).

The beer was good craft beer. Plenty of varieties to choose from so you will find something you like!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
A great venue location.  Its close to the night life and restaurants.  Prior to the game, we ate at the BBQ joint located a few blocks away, and then went to the arena.

Came here to see my Ducks play the Preds, and we stayed at the Hampton Inn just across the street from the parking lot.  Excellent hotel as well.

The arena is one of the newer ones in the NHL so their sightlines in the lower bowl are excellent.  The only thing about the arena that bugged me is the crowd.  I felt I was at a minor league game.  The chants and crowd reaction reminded me of going to a Long Beach IceDogs game.  The chants are ok... but at least make them positive.  Yeah yeah, I'm the enemy.. so what?  Tell me to go back to Anaheim?? Yeah, I will.  But 60 minutes of hearing this was like nails on the chalkboard.

Anyhoo, I tried not to belittle them and say they're hillbillies, but by golly they sure act like they are.

4 stars for a nice arena and great lower bowl... but the crowds... wow, really? Minus one for that.

name: The High Watt
text:
Don't discount The High Watt as just another place on the Cannery compound to go ses smaller shows... this little gem is a great venue space to host a fun event too. 

I have been to The High Watt more than my fair share and have enjoyed a comedy show and some great music here. I never expected to attend a baby shower in the space and you know what, it was absolutely conducive to hosting one! From the nice little bar and the stage that was perfect to making announcements to the great cozy layout, this is a fantastic little venue for smaller parties or events. 

I  just love the crew that run the High Watt along with Mercy Lounge and the Cannery Ballroom too.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Atmosphere is fun. Service is excellent. Food is decent. I loved my burger and margarita. My group's enjoyment of their food was hit and miss. We had fun. I'm not sure if we will choose it again, because of the hit and miss food enjoyment. But if it opportunity came up I would try it again. After all I enjoyed my food and drink:0). Maybe we will enjoy it more as a whole next time.

name: Ole Red
text: The food and music was awesome.  It would have been 5 stars but based on the experience, we were sitting at the bar waiting for a seat and they took all the chairs away.   Then we went to a table to eat then they took all the tables away that was surrounding us. We were sitting in front of the stage eating on a island. It was uncomfortable because  we felt all eyes were on us and rusheto eat.

name: Ole Red
text: Came for lunch and drinks. Good live music and quesadillas were awesome. If you try an appetizer, definitely share a quesadilla. They're huge and have some good sides. But, the drinks were meh and overpriced. Service was horrible! We ended up getting our own drinks from the bar after waiting 25 minutes. Come hungry and with low expectations and you'll be fine.

name: Nashville Symphony
text: This is a really nice place. Everyone is very kind here and it's very organized. I love the lighting, it's really beautiful. I would go here again.

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
The Schermerhorm Symphony Center in Nashville is a beautiful new venue built in 2006 for the Nashville Symphony and is located off Broadway near the new Country Music Hall of Fame and the Nashville Predator hockey arena.

I remember when the Symphony played a TPAC and worked so hard and long to raise the money for the new venue.It was built to acoustically enhance many types of music and they have the ability to change panels for different performances.

Not only is it acoustically pleasing venue, but it is beautiful as well with all of the natural stone and woodwork.

I have seen everything from the symphony to Bill Cosby at this venue and I have never been disappointed in the seating.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Great beers! Had time to kill before heading to the airport and stopped in for a couple of brews. All were great. Atmosphere was good and the staff were all super friendly and helpful! We also had 2 kids with us and the environment was good for them in the afternoon hours.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: We went for the Friday happy hour w Sirius xm the highway. Now, I know jimmy buffet is a star and his place is a tourist trap and no matter what it draws a crowd regardless. But the drinks were 10 bucks a piece and taxes on top of that. I ordered 2 drinks from the menu and my total was 24$. That's highway robbery. No pun intended haha. But furthermore we'll go back bc it's fun and it is margaritaville.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Horrible food. Server was great but the food was horrible. It was so loud in here and music was horrible too. Not worth the money or the time. And darn tho. Supposedly jimmy was there yesterday. If he had the southwestern salad he knows how bad it is. NO TASTE. The chicken grilled in any other restaurant is way better. I'm highly disappointed. Won't go back.

name: The High Watt
text:
I love going to live music so I was pretty excited to check out a show at High Watt. My goal is to get to most, if not all, of the music venues in Nashville. It was a Friday night and the boyfriend and myself were looking for something different to do. He had the brilliant idea of checking out a show at The High Watt. There were 4 small bands playing that night for the mere entrance fee of $7. Awesome!

The High Watt is located in the Cannery Ballroom building. We had no problem finding a parking spot. A lot of the spots are reserved for surrounding businesses but are free after 7 pm. Tickets were $7 each (cash only) and we were nicely told the way to The High Watt. Go to the left then up the stairs. The High Watt is a pretty small venue but I think it actually helps the acts playing. There weren't a ton of people there but it seemed a bit more full since it was so small. There is a bar to the right and then some seating to the left. I personally like to stand during concerts but it's nice to grab a seat in between acts. The drinks are reasonably priced. The special that night was tall boys of PBR, Bud Light, or Yuengling for $4.00. Pretty good for a concert venue! As far as the music goes, the sound was great, the lights were on point, and the stage was visible from anywhere in the venue. The bands were all great and it was fun to get right up next to the stage. I never felt crowded or overwhelmed but if a more popular band played, it might get a bit cramped. 

Overall, The High Watt made for a fun Friday night of music and drinks. It's definitely something to keep in mind if you're ever in need of an affordable night out. I think it's also a great option if you have people from out of town visiting and you're looking to avoid Broadway. There is always new talent coming through here and I'll for sure be back to check out more music!

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
I've enjoyed concerts at the Schermerrhorn in past years but am excited that they have really stepped out of the box and have been offering so many diverse options for enjoying their venue. They're truly trying to draw and entertain all ages and tastes. 

I've recently attended two concerts that I purchased tickets for through Groupon; the music of Elton John by Michael Cavanaugh and big band music styles with Seth McFarlane. Both concerts were incredible. In each case the seats are limited to certain areas but there are no bad seats there. We were in the balcony last night and the acoustics are phenomenal. Purchasing tickets off Groupon is an affordable way to experience some of the best talent of Nashville's musicians. The Nashville Symphony played two very different styles of music and killed it both nights. The can rock out or romance the heart. 

If you've never been then a good thing to know is that you don't have to dress up. Pull yourself together in your shorts or jeans and just go. Of course, there are plenty who choose to dress up but don't feel you have to. 

Purchasing through Groupon has been an easy process too. We've had no issues.  Again, there are no bad seats in the place. I've sat in several different sections now and have been pleased each time.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
Centrally located close to downtown. Lots of areas to hang out and games to play in a brewery setting. Since they actively brew onsite you can see them working on their brews during the day. They have a wide array of beers and use fruits in a lot of them. While I'm not a fan of fruity beer, they do a good job to not let it be over powering. They offer flights where you can enjoy tasters of your pick of beers. They do a good job instructing you on the order it which to drink them. They usually have a seasonal and rotating collaborations that are fun to try. Outdoor seating is offered but on hot days, they have an indoor area with good AC. 

For food they offer an array or Southern Favorites with a different flair of ingredients. Definitely not boring fair. The Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwhich is very good.

name: National Underground
text: This place was disappointing all around. As a local on a Saturday night, we were looking to end the night away from the typical bars and have a couple drinks. As we walked in, we were told from the door guy that we had to buy something and couldn't just use their restroom. The line to Acme was long so I understand that that probably happens a lot. A waitress came up to us on our way to the bar to sit down to make sure that we were also buying something. It was over kill on their part and the service was poor from that point on. Being harassed to pay for something and then having to wait 10 minutes to order an over priced  $7 regular domestic draft beer is too much. Needless to say, I won't return and I'll be sure to pass this experience along.

name: Ole Red
text: How do you even justify food this bad?  And the service was okay, but our nachos ( liquid cheese, just don't do it) were cold, twice! (We sent them back but the server offered no condolences when they were cold the second time.  It wasn't even worth it at that point to send it back again).   Our burgers were rare ( we ordered medium well), but most importantly, the food was just awful and low quality.    I still feel terrible two days later.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: My sister and I came to Nashville for the CMA fest and decided to try MargaritAville for the first time ever anywhere. The atmosphere and wait staff were exceptional. The food was delicious and we liked it so much that we went back sunday before we left to go home. Our waiter was Clark and he went above n beyond to make sure we had a great experience. experience. Looking forward to next year. CMA FEST &MARGARITAVILLE= paradise. Only thing that'd make it better would b to win a trip to Nashville to the CMA FEST N AWARDS PLUS MARGARITAVILLE.

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
Last night was my first visit to the Schermerhorn/Nashville Symphony for a concert. A friend and I went to see Little River Band. A band from the 70's that I grew up listening to on the Radio.

The building itself is gorgeous. Decorated with beautiful chandeliers and box seats lining the sides of a long theater. And the view and acoustics were great no matter where you are in the auditorium.

We happened to have to test on the left side of the stage in box 25 which were excellent seats. And we really enjoyed the show. 

The Nashville Symphony/Schermerhorn Symphony was a wonderful place to see a concert. Parking was relatively close and I believe they also had valet parking. I will definitely be back soon for another show very soon.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: A GREAT place to catch a hockey game. Close reasonable parking within walking distance we parked for $10. Sat in the 3rd deck but the seats were great. The atmosphere was good.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: My boyfriend and I stayed across the street so decided to come by and check it out as we were driving through from Texas. The bar set up was pretty cool, the beer selections were decent, and the band was fantastic! The service was alright, but a drunk guy shoved through me to order before me though I was next to be served. We ordered beers and found a spot to stand by the trash away from everyone and a couple ran into me twice while drunkenly dancing, knocking some of my beer out, (the floor was wide open and we were right next to the trash) which was annoying. We went over to the Losers side and it was quiet--needed after Winners. Then a man came up and asked everyone on the patio from the sidewalk for money. Everyone was belligerently drunk. Some patrons were barefoot. Overall very underwhelming experience

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Great food and amazing service! A must go for Nashville tourist; make sure to try the Cheeseburger in Paradise.... It's exactly as imagined. The gift shop also had a variety of options for your favorite Jimmy Buffett gear!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
The only reason I'm giving 1 star is because I have to and because the police doing crowd control were more friendly and helpful than the staff.

If you are over 5'5 and about 150lbs don't waste your money. These seats weren't just cramped-they were criminal. There was ZERO leg room. I spent a couple hours with numb toes and my knees literally in strangers backs before we finally had enough and left mid concert. That was last night and today I feel like I was in a car wreck and have the bruises to show for it. For 6 of us to drop almost $1800.00 on tickets, this was a huge disappointment. I saw a few reviews mention the seat are terribly uncomfortable but if you're like me and chance it thinking some folks can be dramatic, let me assure you IT'S BAD! 

In the event you want to peel yourself out of your "seat" and climb over 20,000 other people to get a break, you'll find rude employees and $15 beer. One would think with the concession prices and ticket prices they could give you more than a toddler seat. Never again.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: This is a great place.  The staff was friendly and prompt. We had the tater tots and they were great.  Beer is solid and really clean.  Great work.

name: Ole Red
text: The bouncer was rude and condescending.  Unnecessary treatment of a 20 year Nashville native.

name: Ole Red
text:
Always great! Huge shout out to Genesis for her awesome service Sunday. We really enjoyed her humor. 
We've tried other places but always return to Ol Red for the consistency.

name: 12th & Porter
text: Can't lift a finger in the place place without their try hard bouncers harassing you but they do have some of the dankest bacon I've ever eaten

name: Ole Red
text: Awesome location and great experience.  Server Jen on rooftop bar was excellent. Blake showed up several times that week because it was CMA fest week.  We were there for my daughters college tour at Trevecca.  Couldn't believe missed Trace Adkins from the previous day.  The line looks long, but moves quickly and it was busy during CMA Fest.  Efficient staff who handled the crowds well.  We went several times during our 4 days in Nashville.  Food, drinks and service all good.  They know what they are doing...Giant pretzel is fun as an appetizer.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
The man. 
The myth.
The legend.
The sub par franchise on lower Broadway.

My friend and I came here at 5 pm on Wednesday night before a show at the Ryman. It was not super crowded like the rest of these newfangled country star bars popping up every other day so we were sat pretty quickly in the back. This was my preference as the entertainment upfront for the night was letting everyone know sometimes she says deez nuts while she's singing to see if people are even paying attention *charming*. 

The last mango in Paris is a delightful drink. The lethal kind where you don't taste the alcohol until after you drink all of it. In addition we split the Lava Lava shrimp which taste like the unfiltered joy of seeing Jimmy Buffett ride off into the sunset on the back of a dolphin. For the main entree I almost always get the Cheeseburger in Paradise which is ol' reliable in my book. I know it's not very adventurous but it's safe and always gets the job done. It's also my second favorite JB song so it has that going for it too. 

The reason I'm not crazy about this location is because the staff is very inattentive. We never got the side of ranch we both ordered and we never saw our server unless the food + check were ready. Water refills and another round of tequila were out of the question as she stayed MIA.

I think I dub this as more of a drinks/apps/atmosphere kind of mood instead of a full on dining experience. Choosing it as the latter may end up as a letdown as much as it pains me to say. 

But God bless Jimmy and those shrimp.

name: 12th & Porter
text: The new renovations have really taken this place up to the next level! Usually, at music venues, there is going to be one area that's hit and miss, generally the food. Not in this case, the food is great bar food, perfect to soak up all the draft beers and drinks that aren't way overpriced like they are two blocks away. It's nice to sit at the bar and catch a game, then walk down the steps to live music. The acoustics are also great, you don't get overwhelmed in the main room by the sound of the band and the noises aren't popping off everywhere in the space, considering the size. Great lunch spot, too! So happy this place is back again and even better!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Tammy Cook was a fantastic server for Buzz's happy hour.  Awesome time and great sense of humor!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Bar staff was super great. Great drinks, food was just average. Like other places on Broadway they had live music and the band at this time was kinda weird but we were sitting in the bar area so we just ended up tuning them out.

name: Ole Red
text:
Nice restaurant & bar. The food is great and large serving. Well staffed, wait is very short. They also follow the maximum number of people they let in. The bands are great. There is also a souvenir shop inside. The top floor is family friendly, the balcony is looking down to the stage with a huge screen, the main floor is where you get close to the music. Combination of rustic & contemporary decor. Large windows, doesn't feel claustrophobic.
Will sure come back next time I visit Nashville !!!

name: Ole Red
text:
Beautiful  Place, great first floor band, roof top singer was good too. But.....Blake if you are reading this, in Oklahoma talk( fellow Okie) you need to dirty this place up a bit! Meaning, the band doesn't need to have such bright spot lights on them and be blocked off from the crowd. It needs to be more fun and interactive. 
Make it more fun!

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: Simply said - don't go, don't waste your time.... the men who work here are the rudest people ever!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
The review won't be long because even reviewing the arena I feel like a traitor. 

If I'm honest and this was my teams arena, I would have the same issue and there is only one. I have terrible knees so walking up all of the steps to get to the nosebleed seats was kind of frustrating. There may have been an escalator and if there was it was not marked well. I wouldn't have taken the elevator up bc I would have felt bad. 

Anyway, if I was in town again I would go to the arena for a hockey game, IF the Predators were playing the MN Wild!

name: Ole Red
text: Everything was a disappointment.  Marginal food, very poor service, expensive.   In a world.... Lame.  Just because Blake Shelton own the joint does not make it good.   I wasted $90. Don't make the same mistake I did.

name: Ole Red
text: If you're looking for good music with incredible food this is the place! 4 levels including a rooftop bar with gorgeous overlooks of the city really make this a must on your visit to Nashville!

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
For me there remains a certain reverence to walking into a Symphony Hall for a performance. It was not a place as children that we wore our "play clothes" or acted out in any way. Both my mother and my Grandma were classical Concert Pianists  who would practice the greats on the Steinway Grand Piano brought back from Germany daily. (My mom still has that piano in her living room to this day and still plays it regularly.)

So, for me maybe my impression of Handel's Messiah was slightly tainted as I am not fully up to date with our current "culture." To give some idea the last time we attended a Symphony was at the Kennedy Center in DC where we held season tickets and our last show was Arthur Fiedler conducting the Boston Pops for the annual Christmas performance. Long before computers, cell phones or yelp. Also, three grown adult children later we want to repeat what we saw and experienced. 

The symphony hall is spectacular and grand from the moment you enter. The volunteer staff provide you with great direction to get to your assigned seats and to ensure you have a program and know the start times that you need to be in place to be allowed entry. Of course we shoes up in full formal wear, including my wearing a Tux so we were totally out of place as the Symphony Hall has gone more to jeans and t-shirts than the attire we were accustomed to.
