No problem here, we enjoy dressing up and the lack of dress in others does not effect us. 

What we did not expect is as the Nashville Symphony takes the stage that people would have their phones out texting, recording the performance and even talking on their phones. I guess even the rules on the program and announced at various times are not intended for those who think they are special or important. Nothing beats listening to a really great solo and hearing somebody's phone with a Jay-Z ringtone go off on full volume. Oh, not once but on multiple occasions. 

We also had two young ladies in the row behind us who wanted to be heard and recognized so they continue to hoot, holler and yell at times. Apparently they were college students and wanted to gain the attention of the guest conductor and be discovered.  

The Schermerhorn Center did an excellent job, they were very professional, friendly and attentive. They did not make any attempt to create an environment for other to enjoy once inside the hall but I guess this would have maybe offended some of the noise makers and we couldn't have that. 

The Nashville Symphony was masterful and despite any distractions they did an amazing job in their performance. BRAVO!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Wow. This bar was extremely busy and we still felt like we were top priority. We went for music row happy hour and stayed for 4 hours! We never felt like they wanted us to GTFO and our experience was top notch. We ordered volcano nachos and chicken tenders. I would order just the chicken tenders again next time - the nachos were good, but they need to add ingredients layer by layer. All in all, we will make this a permanent stop when we go to Nashville!!!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: I can't say anything bad about this joint. Beer flowin, friendly people. And a mash system I have never seen in Milwaukee. Straight from Belgium!! You need to visit now. And fall in love.

name: Ole Red
text: Very much overrated.  Waited nearly two hours for only so so food. Small dining areas and tables turn over way too slowly.  They'd do well by having someone serving drinks to patrons waiting for a table as you couldn't get anywhere near the baR. Best part was the music for sure.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
This place is underwhelming!!!! Food was over cooked and dry and the service was sub par. 
100s of other local choices. 
AVOID AVOID AVOID !!!!!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Terrible service and didn't receive an order for over an hour. And only got comped for one dish out of 5

name: Ole Red
text:
In Nashville on a family reunion of sorts. One aunt (who will remain nameless because she may or may not have a restraining order meant to keep her away from Blake Shelton) casually insisted that we head to (stalk) Ole Red for dinner (possible Blake sightings).

Upon arrival, our party of 10 was told that we had a 1 hour and 45 minute wait to be seated together or 1 hour if we were willing to split up. We agreed to sit wherever they had seats and hit the bar. 

The live music on the main stage really helped the time pass... so much so that we were actually seated as a group on the second floor within 45 minutes. 

After my aunt returned from "scoping out the joint" we sat down to some tasty apps and entrees. Our waitress was attentive, friendly, and patient with my aunt asking her what Blake smells like. The food-runners screwed up one meal, but quickly made it right. 

All in all, a good dining experience, but shy of incredible. Incredible would have been Blake serving the food to us himself, while dressed in tight jeans and a plain, white, slightly see-through t-shirt. 

My aunt stole my phone and wrote that last bit. Sorry.

name: National Underground
text:
Wow. I'll add to the punchlines. Please don't waste your money or time here. "We only serve bottled water." I guess the sink doesn't work here. These guys are up-charge champions. The only reason to go here is if every other restaurant around it is closed (which is how we got stuck here.) Mediocre is the kindest description of this food I can come up with. 

I can't imagine this place will stay open long.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Great atmosphere, beer, games and service! It was a great way to spend my last day before the journey back home.

name: Ole Red
text: I was at Ole Red on the afternoon of 8/10. I am compelled to write this review because the bartender that was working on the second floor that day (Tim) was operating like a well oiled machine. We were seated at the bar for about two hours. He never stopped moving. He was constantly taking care of people in a timely fashion. He was also very friendly while doing so despite being so busy. If he was frazzled, there was zero sign of it. I didn't see anyone helping him aside from the occasional bar back refilling his ice for him. It was super impressive. This Yelp Elite gives Tim two enthusiastic thumbs up! As for the establishment, I really enjoyed the fried pickles and peach whiskey tea cocktail I had. If I am ever in Nashville again, I would definitely put Ole Red on my list of places to visit!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Beer was really refreshing after walking around all day in that Nashville humidity. "Walk the Lime" was my favorite brew. Cool atmosphere and the live music was great too. The staff are friendly, but special shout out to Jordan, who went above and beyond by hunting down a charger for my dead phone. Being from out of town your cellphone is an absolute life line (map, Uber, ect) so if youre reading this Jordan then special props!! I owe you a beer if you're ever in Richmond Va!!!

name: National Underground
text:
Havent had a bad experience yet. 

The Cajun Chicken wrap was superb! The best Hot Chicken I have had in Nashville, no joke.  Homemade Mac and Cheese is the epitome of comfort food - To DIE for.  The wings! I am a wing connoisseur and have tried every wing in downtown Nashville, those made my #1 spot.  Cooked on the grill and if you want them hot, just ask.

The staff and bartenders always treat me like family and the $6 shot and a beer is my fav way to go. 

Highly recommended!

PS. They open for breakfast at 9am and continue serving breakfast until 12am every day!!!!

name: Ole Red
text: Absolute worst service in Nashville, Richard was slow and condescending, heard him refuse service to someone in our group because he didn't feel that he had tipped enough. When I bought two drinks right behind him and tipped 30% on a watered down drink. What a shame, this place was way below expectations and won't be on the return list next time in town. Where I'm from if you work for tips you earn it with personality and exceptional service not with your hand out begging.

name: Ole Red
text: Good food..served hot!  Our server was trying to talk up his tip but not paying attention!  I had half of a ribeye left. Half of the potatoes  a biscuit that I asked to be wrapped and he said he misunderstood.  I guess it went in the garbage!!  Good food..not so much for the server Aaron!!

name: Ole Red
text: This was by far the best food we found at any of the Bar/Restaurants on Broadway! Their wings were some of the best I've ever had! Great nachos! Another night I had the pig & cheese(Fried bologna sandwich). Fiancé had the blue tick Burger! Again best We've ever had! Mac & cheese was delicious too! We ate there during CMA Fest and caught performances by Rascal Flats & Maddie & Tae! As well as some up and comers! Great place in general.

name: National Underground
text: Worst bar on Broadway. Asked what was in the specialty drinks on the chalkboard. Waitress didn't have any idea. Then brought us an extra drink we didn't ask for. Admitted she messed up, then put it on our bill & refused to take it off even though nobody drank it. Waitress was extremely rude about it & said it was "bar policy" that we had to pay for it. Wouldn't go back to this bar. WAY better experience next door at ACME.

name: National Underground
text:
It seems like there are a lot of very varied experiences and reviews of this place, but I thought it was solid, and as my first Nashville culinary experience, set a high bar.  We ordered the nachos, and I had their burger, which was advertised as being voted the best burger in Nashville.  It did not disappoint.  It was cooked rare, the way I asked, was well seasoned, and was just a damn good burger.  The nachos were pretty solid, albeit small.  I wish we'd have been there for some live music, but it was noon on a Friday, so it wasn't really prime time for bands with day jobs.

Prices weren't bad for drinks, service was prompt, and they have a nice beer selection.  I'll come back!

name: Ole Red
text: Top music joint on the strip. We went to numerous places and this was by far my favorite with two performers (one on each floor) which were exceptional! Great job Blake as your spot will defeneitly be my go to when I'm in town from Miami.

name: Ole Red
text: The band and music was mediocre at best and asking for id for a 63 year old , really!

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: We stopped in for drinks and to listen to some music at this fun little hole in the wall and had a great time. The band was a bluegrass group and they were really great. Definitely worth a stop in for drink and good music.

name: Marathon Music Works
text: I just saw August Burns Red here and the venue was excellent! The employees in the restrooms were really courteous and professional, it had multiple ATM locations, the venue had tons of room, and great food options to choose from. The security staff outside was friendly and it took no longer than 30 seconds to get checked and have my ticket scanned to get in. You can tell they take pride in their venue as the whole place was really clean, especially the bathrooms. And there are plenty of places to park close by, so that isn't something you have to worry about. So all in all, I had a pretty good experience and would definitely go back to another show here. Keep up the good work!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Good beer and even better food. The five beer burger was one of the best burgers I've ever had! I love the thin crispy fries they have too! Cool environment and great service also. I definitely recommend checking this place out!

name: Ole Red
text: The newest,  hottest bar/restaurant owned by the one and only Hot Blake Shelton.  We stopped by for afternoon drinks /wine and a few appetizers. Wound up on the  rooftop with the picturesque view of Nashville.  The rooftop bar is unique, modern, very inviting and comfortable.  We ordered parmesan broccoli, and cinnamon roasted carrots with goat cheese and pistachios, both were very good. The appetizers went well with our bottle of prisoner.  James/security, Sarah &  Brittany our servers were very accommodating.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: I have been to several concerts here some of them were great others the sound wasn't all that good.The drinks/food is expensive,and you have to pay extra for handicap seating and all they did was pull out a chair on the lower level.The concert was great but besides Municipal where are you gonna go to see a really big act?

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: Cool college bar, split up into Winners & Losers, I didn't get the point between the two but I guess it was a cool concept. If you want a good ol hole in the wall college type spot, this is the one. It's on a cool little strip of bars, its full of drunkies, but its a fun night out to let lose.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
I almost gave this place 5 stars....I think it has the potential for 5 stars (and really, my rating is probably a 4.5). It's a great layout--open air patios seating, even indoor is brightly lit and "fun". There's a pretty solid craft list of constants and rotations (I assume all brewed in-house). We ordered three flights of five between the four of us---so 15 5oz pours to sip over the course of a meal! Each was delicious but I think my personal favorite was the sweet potato stout. 

So good-great beer at decent prices in an awesome atmosphere--what takes it up a notch is the food. We each ordered the hot chicken sandwich which was absolutely delicious. While not the spiciest or "truest" example of Nashville hot chicken I've ever had it was simply great regardless, great breading, great sauce, excellent bun, perfect pickles...served with a heaping side of super-crispy super-thin greatly-spiced french fries and a house-made ketchup. 

So why not 5 stars? It's close, as I said. I'm sure if I'm back and give the burger and the fish tacos a go I'll be even more inclined to inch toward the 5 star. The main hold back for me is just the limited menu as it is rather small---some soups and salads, a few sandwich choices. I get the point of a limited menu--better to have a few things you do excellently than a ton of things that are mediocre---but just a few other unique, interesting options on the food menu would send this one to the top.

While we were there the Travel Channel was filming an episode of "Food Paradises" so look for that soon.

name: Marathon Music Works
text: We host our conference at Marathon every year, we love it!!! Dave and his team make sure we have everything we need. Casey is great with sound and caters to our needs. The team hangs our lights and is on call during the whole event. The space can be transformed into anything elegant and bright!

name: Ole Red
text: I have eaten there twice now and was not overly impressed either time.  Brunch had a very eclectic menu and didn't have a lot of typical brunch foods which was disappointing.  I had the hot chicken benedict but it was not hot at all (almost flavorless to be honest).  Dinner was ok but just ok. The prices were in line with all of the other new celebrity restaurants.  There was live music but they were doing a lot of originals (I am okay with it but some people just want covers). The place was clean and the server was friendly.  I guess you could say it is a typical Broadway restaurant in the "new Nashville".

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: SMALL SEATS!!!!! We went to the rodeo this past weekend. Everything was great (food, drinks, bathrooms, cleanliness) except the SEATS! My 16 daughter & her friend fit nicely. But if you are bigger than a 20 year old you will probably go home with bruised hips and thighs. I literally had to sit sideways the whole time just to fit. How embarrassing...... I did notice a few seats where you could raise the armrest but who knows which seats those are when you are buying online! WHY would they have seats that most adults can not fit into? My husband looked at me when we sat down and said "what's going on? I don't think I can fit in this seat?"  He is 5'10" around 200lbs. Average 48 year old male. Just a little FYI for those buying tickets..... and not "model weight & size". Wish we had known when we bought the tickets.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
I am shocked, *SHOCKED* that it took me so long to come to Tennessee Brew Works. I've bought cases of their "Walk the Lime" beer at Kroger before and certainly have heard about them for a long time. Since they are in kind of an odd area of town not super close to any other restaurants and bars it just hadn't been on my radar. 

A friend and I recently came for the bluegrass Wednesdays. They also had a deal which was 2 for 1 drinks (I think the higher gravity ones may be excluded from that deal). I got their wildflower which is a seasonal beer. It was really good. The fact that they have a drink deal and there is live music are two huge factors to draw me to a place. The band was also really good. While the music was not continuously playing, if you do want to have a conversation then inside is not really the place to be. Luckily they have an upstairs and downstairs patio, so when the weather is nice you can hear the music well enough to still talk with your friends. Although their layout is a little strange it is unique and it works. 

I would definitely come back and maybe try their food next time too. The music and the beer were both good and the service was good as well. TBW is definitely a cool brewery worth visiting.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
These guys have some good brew!  I don't think they are distributing yet, but I was lucky enough to taste a couple of their beers at a private holiday party.

They have a Harvest IPA that was dry hopped but was not obnoxiously hoppy...I'm no hop-head and thought it was very pleasant.

I also tried their American Pale Ale which was fantastic.  It had earthy tones and some spices that I couldn't quite pick out.

They also had a California Steam and Belgium Wit that I didn't get to try.  It's funny how tough it is to talk to someone when they are giving out free beer, HA!

Great stuff.  I'll be looking out for their release which I think he said would be some time this spring.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Went here for lunch super packed. Live music at the front. Service could be better. I ordered nachos with steak and uptown margarita. When I got my nachos I seen no know meat. When I ask the server I was told I couldn't hear you I just put ground beef (strike one). The only thing good was the margarita. Then it took  20mins to get the bill. If I do go it will be only for drinks. Also the nachos were 16.00 with one scoop of meat and a plate full of chips.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: We stopped in during a weekend trip to Nashville and loved this place. The service was great and food was delicious.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
During the Music Biz conference, we went to Rippy's twice. The location was prime and the food was good, so why not?

I got the Pulled Pork plate, which came with two sides. They also had two choices of barbecue available on the table. You get so much food! It's hard to leave here hungry.

The second time around, we ordered drinks, which were pricey, but pretty average for a Broadway bar/restaurant. I loved the live music both nights I was here! Great atmosphere and great barbecue for anyone visiting Nashville!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Had a great time Sunday night, 2/19. I was in town for a celebration with my company Tractor Supply. We watched a great performance by the band. The food was terrific. Lots of Bar-B-Que, some corn. And good times.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Needed some food while on Broadway. We had a pulled pork and a pulled chicken sandwich. The meat was very well tender and had a perfect taste! Price was very reasonable for the area! Highly recommend!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Seems to have good specials. I came at 10pm and live music had stopped. I was a little bummed about that. Had the five cheese pizza and it was good! Not chicago pizza, though . Overall, worth a stop.

name: Twin Kegs
text: Probably the divest dive I've ever been to. The bartenders here can be a little cold at first but warm up to you after you've been there a couple times. The drinks and food are dirt cheap. Recently I went here and had two beers and tots an the bill was $5.50. As others have noted, it can get pretty smokey in here.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: First Time in Nashville and am not a huge country fan. Was there for a conference and ended up staying there till closing every night. Was one of the funnest times I've ever had. Great entertainment and drinks were reasonable .

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Get you some crawfish soup on a Sunday blues jam night, in addition to a chicken Alfredo pizza with mushrooms added. Also the "Caroline" shot (ask your beautiful blonde bartender Allison) isn't a bad idea either. Thank me later. And tip the band. #soulshineyall

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: My older daughter had been telling me about SoulShine and today I had an opportunity to try it. We had "The Kitchen Sink" pizza and it was very good. The ingredients were fresh, the service was timely, and our server was wonderful!!! My younger daughter had the hot wings (mild) and the pepperoni bread and she really enjoyed it. I can definitely say I'll be going back. Oh, and we heard some great music coming from upstairs.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: I remember going here in my teenage years when the dancing show was broadcast from this bar and it was so entertaining to see everyone dancing and changing outfits during the commercial breaks.  The bar has been completely remodeled since those days and they now serve food.  It looks like it could be a fun place but when we ventured in, it was dead.  Might still be open based on nostalgia?

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: What a wonderful surprise for a late night dinner. I had the boss hog pizza- pulled BBQ pork with pineapple, onions and BBQ sauce topped with mozz and jalapeño jack!!  It was amazing!! My hubby had the kitchen sink pizza and also a huge hit. The meatball app had a wonderfully rich tomato sauce that really set off the tender meatballs. Even my unbelievably picky kids were thrilled with their pizza and calzone!!  In a very happening part of town. We happen to hit it at a night when they were trying a little karaoke. That was definitely hit and MISS. But the food was amazing.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
Brutal. My daughter goes to school in Nashville so done the Broadway's scene many times. This time I brought my son with me and I thought I should give him a touristy view of the city so I thought we'd try Wild Horse Saloon for some bbq. I HATE going to the typical tourist traps but I thought we'd give it a try. Big mistake!! Both of us have been glued to the toilet since we were there!!

We ordered the spicy fried pickles and they were so over-seasoned it was ridiculous. It wasn't that they were too spicy. It's like they skipped using any batter and just dredged the pickles in cayenne and salt. Literally like putting a tablespoon of salt directly in your mouth. I could only eat 4-5 before I was getting iodine poisoning. My son ate a few more before he quit. To their defense they did take them off the bill but by then the damage was done. 

Quite frankly, the bbq was not that great either but I wouldn't have even written a review if those damn pickles weren't still grinding away in my belly!! Lastly, the main act was pretty week for a Friday night on a famous stage. I'm not going to mention his name but he seemed angry to even be there like it was below him. The dude had no energy. 

Signed,
Still crapping

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Quite honestly i was not satisfied with this establishment. The food is way over priced for what it is really worth. The service is nothing spectacular. We were even charged $1 for some ranch dressing. Its $9 for six mozzarella sticks! That is ridiculous! And the french fries were bland and soggy. Not happy.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Great atmosphere. Bloody's blow. Stick with Bud Light if you are a professional. Good live music. Upstairs too crowded to participate. Their loss.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Rippy's is named well!!  What a Rip-Off!  Our group stopped for a drink and a little food - so far so good!  When I got the bill I Shat Myself!  One person in the group ordered 3 double 7 and 7's and Rip-Off's charged me $54 dollars!!!  What!!??  I could have bought an entire handle at that price!!  We have 2000 people here for 2 days and if it's up to me NONE OF THEM WILL ENTER THIS RIP-OFF ESTABLISHMENT!!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Good food, cool live music scene, though service was exceedingly slow in all account and drinks are a bit pricey. Would go back because of the music for sure.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Best ribs I've ever had! They make an awesome Salty Dog.   Atmosphere was so much fun!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: GREAT pizza place in Nashville with a wide range of beers on tap. We were just in town for the weekend, but would recommend it to locals and tourists alike.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
This place is a good time if you want a country experience when you are in Nashville. They always have good country performers live on stage. I only listen to country music when I'm riding in my friend's truck. And I've heard some of the songs the performers were playing. 
The beef brisket was extremely tender and the chopped pork was delicious too. The mac and cheese was great. It was shells with white cheese. 
Between country performers they have country line dancing. Someone on stage walks the crowd on the dance floor through some line dancing steps. Then the entire dance floor line dances. It's fun. 
They have drinks here, of course. But you can have some great country fun without getting buzzed. Frankly, I had water.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Whoa! Where do I start?.... First, I have been to this place several times since it's inception, and were it not for the good service of Ryan, my favorite server, I've had less than an OK experience here. Secondly, the food takes forever and the quality is  more often than not, poor! Tonight was a whole 'nuther experience!!!! In my 20+ years in this industry, I have NEVER...EVER been treated so rudely by a bartender/server! It took 30-45 minutes for an order of wings, and when they finally arrived and after a few eaten wings, my female companion noticed that they were very under-cooked(i.e, bloody). I asked the bartender if they could be taken off my tab...that's where it all went downhill!!! The night went from an "OK" experience to an absolutely "HORRIBLE" one!!!. I had to ask for a manager to voice my complaint about the rudeness of the bartender, by way the way, while talking to the manager, my MORE than gracious tip was slammed down on the bar by the bartender as he says he didn't want it. AWFUL! PLAIN AWFUL! Truely disgusted by tonight, and it ruined a perfectly great evening up until then.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
A couple of our friends who had been to Nashville suggested this place for line dancing. It seems like a moderately local spot to go to, which was definitely a plus when we were looking for things to do. When a band isn't playing, a lead dancer goes on the stage and teaches you the moves for the dance. You learn together in a group and then the music plays for you to practice, before the entire song plays. At first, my friends and I were intimidated, but in truly Southern style, a couple of the locals chatted us up and convinced us to go up there. In our group of 3, there was 1 guy and he was truly impressed with how many girls were up there dancing. It was overwhelmingly female and fun for all.

We didn't get any food, but had a few drinks which were average and nothing special. But we didn't come for the food! And I will definitely come back for the dancing if I'm in Nashville again. So fun!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: So a group of us 50 somethings go for some good music and dancing. One member of our party, a 66 year old woman did not have id. Instead of using sound judgment the bouncer said he had to mark both of her hands with a black marker so she couldn't get a drink. How humiliating. On top of that the band was mediocre. Much better music venues in Nashville.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Rippy's is a popular bar that features barbecue.  Multiple people gave it glowing recommendations so it was our first stop for food in Nashville.

When we arrived we were told to seat ourselves.  It took about 10 minutes for a server to greet us.  We had read that service can be a little slow here, so as soon as the waitress got to us we placed our orders.  I had the pulled pork with coleslaw (can you eat it without coleslaw?).  It was good, but I was not super impressed.  The bun was large and plain.  The pork could have used a bit more seasoning and the bbq sauce was ok. The coleslaw didn't really stand out either.  I felt like my meal was ok here and was reasonably priced, but I will probably not be back here.  I did have a friend's onion ring though and that was fantastic.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Good enough food to eat twice in a day. The bartender Dominique made the time though, great person highly suggest coming

name: Nashville Palace
text: Avoid this place if you are in a hurry. Service is horrible, but the live music, cheap food and beer make it a great spot to waste away an afternoon.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
We were in downtown Nashville and happened to stumble on this barbeque place. Jennifer S was our server and was very nice and attentive. Our only surprise is that we asked for pickles with our meals and were charged for them. 
I ordered baby back ribs and The meat just fell off the bone.  The coleslaw was ok but the onion rings were great.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Good ribs - especially for being on Broadway where . Had a really good band with a surprising mix of people and ages. I was there at 9pm on a thursday night and the drunks were out, but hey its a honky tonk right?

name: Twin Kegs
text: The bartender was so drugged out and hammered that she pocketed my credit card with no recollection of doing so. She game me 5 Coors Lights, told me to "get the fuck out of her bar" which I replied "no problem, just give me my credit card" to which she had no idea what I was talking about. Meanwhile, they let me look for the credit card behind the bar like I owned the place. A patron of the bar had to go through the bartenders pockets while she was too drunk to realize what he was doing and fish out my credit card. She wasn't trying to steal the card, she was just drunk. When someone hands me something when I'm drunk, guess what, I put it in my pocket. 10/10 would come back for 5 free Coors Lights.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Started with a ton of empty tables and told I had to see hostess ok fine them told 30 min wait for a said table. Waited once seated quick devices but good was terrible. And too late once the waitress came back to complain and re order something else. And they have no concept of craft beer! Do yourself a favor and pass on this tourist trap!!!!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Fun time doing line dancing with the kids. The dance floor is huge and the ceiling is so cool with the horses. The kids had a lot of fun. We didn't stay to eat.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Everything is served in plastic. 
Coleslaw was tasteless.
Had to ask for drink refills.
Moves trashcans up to tables to clean them.
The BBQ sauce was tasty and the pulled pork sandwich was good.
$25 for 2 pulled pork sandwiches with one side each and 2 drinks...

name: Nashville Palace
text:
Being in Nashville, I figured I would try the fried catfish.  Boy, was I surprised, the catfish was almost burnt, very brown and crispy...not what's you would expect from a restaurant in the south.  And for the price they charged for this (1) piece of catfish, you would think it was an award winning dish...very basic menu, no be thrills....the live band was entertaining and the waitress was friendly.

Family place up till 10 pm.

name: Twin Kegs
text: This place is the image that pops into your head when someone says dive bar. Small and smokey with cold beer, dart boards, and karaoke. What else do you expect? It's an awesome place if you want to get your karaoke on but don't want to head into down town. Huge book of music to choose from. Good times are always abound when you head in here. This place is definitely better on the inside.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Burger was excellent and the bbq sauce is to die for! The drinks are great and the service was amazing. Great place for lunch!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Def didn't spend too much time here but from the 3 hours I was there, I have no complaints. Live music, billiard and like dancing lessons...doesn't get much better than that! Gran a drink in a boot and keep the glass boot! Cheers

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: OMG!! This place was beyond AMAZING. Beautiful inside. Food to die for. Look above you in restaurant to view the horses above you (Full size)

name: Nashville Palace
text:
We stayed at a nearby hotel    Had dinner and enjoyed the Live Music atmosphere at The Palace. A local bar feel.  We had the swish cheese mushroom burger and Cat Fish dinner.  We would recommend the Catfish over the burger.  

An enjoyable dinner with live music, good service and good food.  

I could do this every night.

name: Twin Kegs
text: Took 1 step in and smelt like an ashtray and walked right back out. Was excited to try this local dive but man that smell of cigarettes was so bad. If you're a smoker you'll love it.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: So far, my favorite "bar/ saloon" in Nashville. They have a large dance floor and teach nightly Line dance lessons. My friends and I love to take advantage of it! Sometimes it can get a bit crowded and the food is way overpriced. But I sure do love the fried pickles!!! The decor and vibe is very cool as well.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Ate at this place with my brother while visiting in Nashville. I was really hungry so I got a few sides. My brother licked his plate clean from the ribs he got. I enjoyed my collard greens, curly friends and corn bread. It's was a good amount of food. Waitress was really helpful and quick with brining back my beverages. My brother said his ribs were delicious and he even ordered some more food. The IPA I had was really good too!! 

This is a great place to stop for music and a good bite to eat while I'm Nashville.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
We're just stopping through Nashville on our way home from vacation, and we're a little puzzled why this place is only receiving 3.5 stars?!? We were a group of 8, 4 adults and 4 kids, and all of us raved about it! We tried different pizzas, all of which were tasty. GREAT crust, quality toppings!

We spent a day in Charleston, SC while on vacation and thought it would be some of the best bread pudding we could find in the country, but were sadly disappointed. The Slap Yo Mama Bread Pudding here, though? Spot on! Others tried the cheesecake which was met with two thumbs up and the brownie was the lone disappointment, but not enough of one to make my rating any less.

Service was excellent, the atmosphere had a hip vibe to it, and the live music upstairs pulled everything together! A fantastic spot in the Music Row area!

name: Twin Kegs
text:
Great place to escape the tourists and truly enjoy yourself without the pretense in other "boroughs & districts" of town. It is simply a bar to be yourself. Amazing selection of beers, and the food is delicious!!!! Burgers brought me here, the bartenders & regulars kept me entertained, and the ambience is what has continued drawing me back. Do yourself a favor and explore this place when you're looking for a spot to just relax and just be you. 

****FRESH PORK RINDS**** A MUST HAVE!!!!! DON'T FORGET THE LOUISIANA HOT SAUCE

name: Nashville Palace
text: Decent place near Opryland! Live music,  cheap but decent food and low priced beer. Come here for a nice casual place to go for dinner and a beer with live music. Portions were a bit small though and my order did not come out the way I ordered it. Cheaper here than Opryland restaurants though.

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: Well if i wanted to put this kind of filth in the Sammy machine id go to Mellow Mushroom. This place is a godamned gluten bomb. Tight ass on 2 waitresses though. I'll be back.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: We went here for a bite before a Predators game as it is so close, it was very busy to be expected. Food was very good just service was slow. I have heard great things about the wings but we went with pulled pork instead, which was great. Definitely a good BBQ joint just give yourself plenty of time before the game!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: This place is great!! Country Music fabulous and the waitress very attentive. The pecan pie Wow. A fun place to be. We are at a Crimecon Convention. Free booze and food for tonight . Yes !

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Came out here yesterday, I got the pulled pork sand which and my son got the rib wrap since they don't sell a 1/2 rack. Food was great, servers were very attentive, live music and a local beer selection.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Enjoyed our first trip to this place. Had lunch and the food and service was very good. Very large portions, one BBQ plate was enough for me and my husband.  Loved the sweet and spicy BBQ sauce!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: We had pulled pork plates and they were great. I would have liked more than two choices for sauces, but the staff and vibe more than made up for it.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Stopped in for lunch on a rainy Tuesday and the bar area was pleasantly crowded. Good live music and a very attentive bartender. Had the pulled pork sandwich & curly fries. The food came out extremely fast and was delicious - exactly what I was hoping for. I definitely recommend for a quick delicious barbecue lunch!

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text: My favorite place to go to if I just want to feel better about myself and my life.  Cream of Crawfish, red beans and rice, hot tamales, and slap yo mama bread pudding is all it takes to make me feel awesome all over again. The staff are so friendly and cheerful. I love the ambience of this place

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: John H. provided excellent customer service for a party of 11! He was helpful and accommodating. He met everyone's request with a smile! The food was delicious! My whole team had an excellent dining experience and will definitely be back! Thank you John H.!

name: Houston Station
text:
I chose Houston Station for a 500 person private event for Thirty Tigers CMA Fest After Party, after looking at every single potential venue or event space in Nashville. The room is magnificent to say the least and couldn't be more perfect of a room to utilize in a multitude of scenarios. The photos really do not do it justice so if you have not seen it in person, do that before you choose anywhere else.
But what was most impressive was the staff. Everyone that worked at the venue were the kindest and most helpful staff I have worked with for any event I have produced. They worked to help find us vendors for everything from sound, stage and lighting, security, food, etc. They went above and beyond from the moment we began looking at the space until the event was over.
Houston Station is hands-down the best event space in Nashville.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Terrible service, we were asked multiple times to move and ended up at a high top even though they claim you can sit where you like. Drinks went empty multiple times. The Pulled pork looked and tasted like it was just scooped out of a can. The onion rings were fantastic though and as usual the music was top notch

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Amazing smoked half chicken and sauces are sweet and spicy with a nice touch of tang! Good prices and plenty of beer.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: The food is ok. This is not where you come for a great meal. The show is the thing. It varies nightly and its hit or miss. They have a great dance floor,rare in Nashville, and can have a fun crowd.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Imagine Chuck E. Cheese except the mechanical animal band is replaced by human beings. I have never been in a "bar" that had so many kids running around acting a fool. I can't imagine the band being enthused to see a troop of 8 year olds playing slip and slide on the dance floor. Perhaps the blame should be placed on their parents who were shotgunning Bud Lights on the sideline, but then again, what kind of "bar" allows you to roll in with a half dozen 4th graders per adult. Needless to say, I couldn't even give this place a fair shot as I was dodging out of control kids running around while I tried to walk around. I guess the decor was cool, except my focus was on the wild pack of hyenas running around...

name: Nashville Palace
text: This is just a great old school honky tonk music hall with a lot of history.  The beers are cold and the music is fantastic.  It was mostly older folks cutting a rug out on the dance floor but they have far better moves than most young folks I've seen so I enjoyed watching their skillful dancing along with the great music.  This is a nice spot to catch some great music for the price of what you pay for your drinks. Friendly folks, great bartenders, great music and just a great time along with very easy parking.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: Featured in the center of the menu is Nashville hot chicken. 6:30 Saturday night they are out. Lack of photos of this entree leads me to believe this is a common occurrence. Great service though!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: I tried to eat at the restaurant at 2:15am and the security Guard (L. Smith) was so rude and did not let me in the door. He wanted to arrest me for trying to enter the building. The google app says they close at 3am. Fake advertising !!! Don't eat Rippy's, they are so unprofessional. # is about a 2

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: The food at Nashhouse is awesome! Atmosphere is great. Good place to watch the predators and titans game

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: The food was pretty good (fried pickles were yummy) but definitely not worth the money. My boyfriend and I got two drinks and two burgers and our bill came out to be 70$! Save your money and go elsewhere.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Great place to hit downtown if u want all the flair of a southern hospitality, good live music, and delicious southern standard dishes.....without the sticky floors and over served crowd down on Broadway. 3 floors all w a stage view. Service is friendly and prompt. Clean bars,  floors, and bathrooms. This place runs like a Disney resort with some southern flavor added in. I really enjoyed myself as a guest from out of town and was made to feel welcome.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text:
We came here for a birthday celebration and it was a party of 16.  It was a Saturday night, and a little empty when we arrived at 6:00, but we were happy to see our table was ready.  We were also happy to see that they featured live music. The restaurant filled up quickly.  The venue is very Country/Nashville themed;  but more upscale than the other crowded touristy places along Broadway.

Our waiter was Trenton, and he did an outstanding job of keeping up with everybody's food and drink orders.  Plus he was able to accommodate our large party with separate checks.  I had heard that the chicken fried chicken was outstanding so that is what I ordered.  It came with a biscuit, gravy, and onion straws on top.  Delicious!  Two friends had the salmon entree and they both said it was wonderful as well.  There were 4 or 5 people who ordered the steak.  They all had the same comments; over cooked (too well-done,) but still good quality steak & flavorful.  There was another person who ordered the pulled pork.  I thought it smelled delicious, but she said it was just ok. 

They had a full bar, lots of signature cocktails and local brews as well.  I got to try a few new beers and Trenton was happy to provide me with samples  beforehand so I could find some I like. While we were there we saw 3 local performers on stage.  I liked that they had short sets so you could see 3 different musical styles during our dinner.  All were talented!

The restaurant also provided one free birthday dessert and it was enough to feed 16 people!  Brownie sundae....also delicious!  Great times at s great place!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Tons of fun. Had a blast with the band and the service was great. Live music on each floor. 3 bands in total.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: 2 stars because the service sucked! Great place but they need to train the servers. Didn't know the menu and stopped coming to the table after food was served. Great band. Food over priced for the quality.

name: Twin Kegs
text: Excellent Burgers but worst customer service. Ordered Spicy burger from the menu. Noticed Burger had bacon on it, mentioned Waiter there should be no bacon according to the menu so she removed it and brought the same burger back with an attitude. Asked for a new burger and she rudely said " I can't get you another one". Spoke to the Kitchen Cook and she was nice enough to make another burger without bacon.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Not really impressed.  Expectations weren't high to begin with and unfortunately they didn't improve. Music was decent, but ridiculously loud (and we were sitting very far from the rooftop stage). Plastic cups and plastic, pre-packaged silverware. My paper napkin smelled like the pepper that was in the plastic wrapper with it.  Not good.  We had nachos and the bbq chicken dinner. Food was ok, but sooo overpriced for the quantity and quality.  Drinks were a little on the pricey side as well.  Won't be back anytime soon.

name: CMA Fest
text: Best weekend of my life. The free stuff was amazing. The Nissan Stadium concerts were unreal. I will never miss this event ever again in my life. Everything was so fun. Loved the Riverfront Stage. I wish we had more time to do more things. Loved the surprise artists like Sam Hunt, Garth Brooks, and Thomas Rhett.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: As always great food! Brisket was excellent! A must stop every time I go to Nashville!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Went to this place for lunch during the CMA Fest and the food was fantastic! I ran back the next day and was met with major disappointment. Instead of fried cauliflower I was met with coleslaw. Instead of a pick 2 meats I was only allowed one. Had a fantastic waiter now I have someone rude. For someone who works in the vacation capitol of the world I know something about customer satisfaction and this is how you will fail. Be consistent. Yesterday's experience is nothing of today's. Today you fail.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: I Was delighted with my meal experience here. The music was good and my smoked chicken platter was amazing. Loved the bbq sauce options as well. This was exactly what I was looking to experience when visiting - good food, good people and good music. Solid service!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Many of the Broadway bars are the same.  They are overcrowded, extremely dirty, have bad service, and very overpriced drinks.  Rippy's is no exception to this.  The reason they are rated a 3 instead of a 1 is because they do have seating available to people watch and they have one good drink, the bushwhacker.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
This place will rippy-you-off ...I couldn't recommend only because the portion sizes for the money you pay. Geat quality but not worthy of us returning when there are so many other places to try in Nashville
The Yee Haw was a great drink served in a plastic cup but larger than some of the other drinks they serve. These drinks at $9 ....And I say give me a break.
For 1 meal (pulled pork with 2 small sides) and 2 beers and 2 mixed drinks was way over priced for the quality

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Good music. Pricing is what you'd expect. If you're thinking of grabbing a seat don't bother unless you plan on eating and drinking enough to provide your server a nice tip. 

My husband and I came to hang out before a game bought a bucket and we're happy to stand. A nice group had a table the gave up to us. After being asked by the waiter if we'd be buying more we said we'd do more drinks for sure but just got our bucket so not at the moment. He proceeded to tell us he wanted to save the table for someone spending money or he'd lose money. He then came back 10 minutes later and asked us to leave so someone else who was spending money could sit there. We didn't want to cause a scene and moved. Our next visit to nashville we won't be going to rippleys. If we didn't have a bucket to finish we'd have left right away.

name: Nashville Palace
text: Was excited to try this place for the live music and solid food, and good service. Well, they got the music right! Service was slow, there were 3 items ordered that were out (including all red meat options...at a bbq place?!) The check was wrong, and took forever to get sorted. For our troubles we were promised a round of drinks, which then we were told that they couldn't deliver for free. When we got the bill, not only was it wrong, but there was a $10 fee to use a Credit Card. Can't speak poorly enough about this experience...but at least the music was good!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: I visited Nashville recently and visited this place for a few drinks and some live music. The band was great and the service to get drinks was super fast. I've seen a lot of bad reviews but I did not have that issue at all. The service here was amazing and the band was amazing. If you want to listen to some good music and have a few drinks I would definitely recommend dropping into this place.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: What a fun night! Taylor, our waiter, was exceptional and very attentive. Fried pickles and deviled eggs to start were yummy with tasty cocktails. Highly recommend the pork shank, so tender and delicious with the mashed potatoes. Live music set the mood for a fun evening. What a poetic ending to our vacation. Thank you Taylor and NashHouse!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Ok, so walking around Broadway at night as someone who sometimes and go into sensory overload can be scary. I mean if you can hear the music from across the street it's too loud, right? Most of broadway would disagree with you. Rippy's did a nice job of having live music that didn't overpower. The drink prices were very reasonable. The staff was friendly. This is the only place we went in and sat awhile because the atmosphere wasn't killer over the top.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: Stopped by after a night on the town. Restaurant is connected to the Cambria hotel. Service was great as well as the food! Mike did a great job explains everything on the menu. I tried the Nashville Hot chicken and the quest. Both were delicious and my wife and I  will definitely be back. Also, they had the biggest TV I've seen so far in Nashville!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Almost everything was great! Service was excellent, food was amazing. Live music was awesome! The drinks is where everything fell apart- every single drink we ordered had barely any alcohol. This was early in the night, too. Disappointing to say the least. Especially when you spend almost $500!

name: CMA Fest
text:
For the past several years, we have made plans to attend a country music festival. In 2018, we decided on CMA Fest as nearly every artist shows up at some venue during the festival. We had a great time, but it was a bit different than what we expected. 

We had tickets to the evening performances, which are held at Nissan Stadium. So it's a 30+ min stadium concerts for each performer. However, they were also filming for the CMA special, which got a bit tiresome after awhile when they needed to record intros multiple times. 

During the day there are multiple stages and artists performing on a first come first serve basis or based on a lottery. This are free to attend which is great for fans, but I honestly thought my purchased ticket would get me some privileges, and it did not. Honestly, that was a bit annoying. I understand making it accessible to all, but standing in a huge line to 'maybe' get in is not my thing, so we just stopped going and spent the days at the Honky Tonks on Broadway instead. Still fun, but then I don't have to be in Nashville during the CMA Fest. 

The one really cool thing which we discovered was a small stage inside the Convention Center (which was a ticketed entry area) that showcased new and upcoming artists. This was great fun and got us a bit of a taste of not just the big stars, but the writers and new artists. 

We're going to choose another festival for 2019, probably Tortuga, and come to Nashville again when it's not so hot and crowded.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text: Went to NashHouse on Sunday morning before leaving Nashville and I must say I really enjoyed it. When we got there it was not too crowded at all and were able to get seated right away (there were 6 of us). The mimosas and bloody mary bar was of course great, and the Oscar Bennie was also very good. My friend had the shrimp and gritz, which I will admit was not the best I've ever had.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: We didn't eat here...just came for the music and drinks.  The bands on both floors were great.  The service was fast.  Overall, our group had a ton of fun!  It was a great crowd!

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: Worst experience ever in my life!!! I've been in the hospitality industry for 30 years and never in my life have I witnessed a bartender be so racist! Lindsey was horrible and Adam, the manager wasn't much better ! We had a party of 25 people and the service was horrible and the food made us sick!!! Racism was over the top and I'm a white person!! They treated two of our African American parents horribly !!!  I would not even rate this a one At this point !!!!  Please don't ever go to this place!!!! Not sure what has happened to this place but it is horrible and our volleyball girls were looking so forward to having a fun night !

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text:
Good brunch and amazing drinks/bar selection. Very much appreciate the friendly staff and how hard they were working with what appeared to be an understaffed situation. 

Mac and cheese is amazing but the hash brown casserole left much to be desired. If they made the hash browns with all the trimmings of the Mac and cheese it would be amazing. Pancakes were also sub par.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: BECKA was an amazing bartender. made my night. so sweet and amazing. also BARBARA are you fucking kidding? she's most amazing the bathroom attendant and person i've ever met. she deserves the world and i love her. please come here and be nice to her and give her lots of tips thank you.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Four of us went to dinner here. We ordered Rib's,, Chicken,, a wrap and I had a Hamburg. I took one bite of the Hamburg and had them take it away,,, it was terrible and I mean terrible. The other people with me loved their dinner's but I went away hungry. They  took the burger ($10.95) off my bill and did ask if I wanted something else but by then dinner was over for the other people with me and I didn't feel like eating alone. Our waiter from the start screwed up our orders,,, forgot our appetizers and we never did get them,, he never got our drink orders right and was slow,, very slow. So far in Nashville I haven't been impressed with the food

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text: They have a schedule for "line dance lessons" so while we were there we learned a dance at 5:00 and another dance at 6:09. We also got in some foozeball and pool on the third floor, which overlooks the lower two floors and has upside down horses hanging from its ceilings. Paid a dollar or two extra to get our drinks in glass boots which we are keeping as our Nashville souvenirs.

name: NashHouse Southern Spoon and Saloon
text:
Came before the last Preds game with a few friends. Luckily I saw where you could make reservations when I was looking up the menu because they were telling people it was an hour wait at 5:30. The restaurant was pretty empty and even over the course of our hour there it didn't get much busier other than a couple of large groups. Two of us arrived before the other two and we noticed our server was kind of slow at bringing us our drinks, but we thought she was just waiting for the rest of our party. 
We ordered fried pickles as our app and while they tasted good the breading just fell off because of the thin slices. We also had hot chicken and turkey plate. The hot chicken had a great honey flavor and the right amount of spice. The turkey had great flavor but not much more can be said about it. We waited forever for our second round of drinks and when they didn't all come out together we had to cancel the others in order to make it to the game in time. We didn't hate our visit but have no intentions of returning.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Paid $25 and waited about an hour to get a cold rack of ribs. Took them another half hour to get the food out to us hot. They were busy and I get that. But there is no excuse to see my waiter twice during the meal. Didn't get us refilled drinks or anything. Complete disgrace of an establishment and will never return.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Worst service ever. Our food was awful and and out server Nikki was the worst. My first trip to Nashville and no southern hospitality here that's for sure

name: Soulshine Pizza Factory
text:
Ah Soulshine. I come here randomly and always have a good time, but never suggest it myself. Not sure why, it should maybe be on my radar a bit more.

Downstairs at Soulshine are tables and more of a restaurant feel. I have never once sat in this area so I am not sure what happens down there. I always go directly upstairs where there are more tables, a bar, and then a rooftop deck with a stage. There may be live bands playing when you are there and it makes it pretty festive. Otherwise it is still a nice patio to sit on as it is also covered.

Pizza is the menu...and it is just ok. I am not really a girl that likes going out to eat pizza, but most of the pieces I have tried have been good enough to soak up the beer. They have friendly waitstaff and bartenders pour a pretty strong drink.

Overall, it is a solid choice for happy hour or maybe to see a live band...or anytime you want to have drinks on a patio!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Not a fan of this place (I do have one exception here). First of all their security guard is one rude dude. I get it, some bars are now doing metal detector full body scans but you can consciously choose if you want to be a douchebag or not. Guy is straight faced and pretty intense doing up down, sides, making me turn around, spread my legs/arms, etc. It was like the airport to literally run in to gather friends to leave at the end. We did eat, got catfish strips which my boyfriend loved my FAVORITE and one thing they are doing right are their crispy thick amazing onion rings. Our served was terrible, she had short black curly hair but was not attentive, after we ordered we really didn't see her again and I'm big on servers coming back to ask if its good, right, etc. Initially we ordered a round of drinks, my boyfriend spilled his about 4 seconds after getting it, not only did no one get us extra towels but when we asked for a new drink we were charged again. So now here we are and we've spent $20 on one small plastic cup whiskey and coke. Also i snagged her to ask to add a corndog to the order and she confirmed, great, but alas it never came. It wasn't even that busy, there was a garth brooks concert that night getting started so the place had really emptied out. would NOT return.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: Wow was it load. Did I mention is was loud. Great bartender, never had food but looked and smelled good. Sorry I can't hear you it's too loud. I guess when I was younger that would be a great place, but when you can't talk to someone than I guess it is too loud

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
Atmosphere / decor - 3
Service - 3
Food - NA
Location - 4
Value - 3

Overall 3.5

I had the brisket sandwich here which was pretty tasty. Drinks were the same price as the places around it.

name: Wildhorse Saloon
text:
We're so glad that we came here for lunch during our stay. Fun atmosphere, lively staff, yummy bbq and refreshing drinks. While we were eating there, they had some underground singers performing on stage and we saw some people dancing on the dance floor.
For appetizers. we ordered the fried pickles in mild spicy. It topped with some green scallions and it served with some creamy dressing on the side. 
For entrees, we shared the pick any 2 meats combo and it came with 2 sides. We chose the  briskets and chicken thighs. Marinated tomatoes and fried brussel sprouts for the sides. We were stuffed after we finished our entrees.
For drinks, I ordered a cocktail that served in a cowboy boot and my friend ordered a beer.
Our server was bubbly and friendly. In the end we learned that they called the check/bill a ticket lol
We also like how they they placed their menu on a wooden board...it matched the restaurant's theme. This is definitely a great place for tourists and big groups.

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text:
Stopped by here hoping to get drinks and listen to live music before the Brad Paisley concert on 2/22/14. 

I have never been treated so poorly by a server in my life. This is an open seating restaurant. I sat down as soon as a table became available. The male server with shoulder length brown hair asked if I would order food and drinks. Told him yes and my friends went to the restroom. Server left as I was waving down my friends. Server comes back and says "YOU CAN'T HOLD THIS TABLE" as my friends were walking to the table. Then he had the nerve to say to me because one of my friends obviously ordered A BEER from the bar already we could not order food or drinks at the table. An older couple proceeded to sit at the table while I was still sitting there! I don't usually complain about places but this was RUDE! I left immediately. I have no desire to continue being a patron of place that obviously did not want my business. 

I WILL NEVER STEP FOOT INTO THIS PLACE AGAIN AND I WOULD SUGGEST TO EVERYONE ELSE, THERE ARE BETTER VENUES ON BROADWAY. I WISH I COULD GIVE THIS PLACE NO STARS

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Everybody we met was friendly, great service staff.  Come here for the ambiance, the atmosphere and the music.  Noisy, crowded, wall-to-wall people populated Honky Tonk.  Come here to just say you've been.  A must stop for Nashville

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text: Amazing space honoring the history of the building, worth going based on that alone; but then there is the food. We had six people and everyone got different entrees but everyone loved their meals. The filet was unbelievable with delicious sides and the fried chicken and the short ribs were our groups favorite. Can't wait to go back and I'm excited to check out lunch and breakfast too.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: Maybe I ordered...unwisely.  The RB #2 was dry & too chewy.  I think #2 means "second day"; sent it back.  The chicken tenders were VERY greasy & WAY dry on the inside.  Kielbasa sandwich...just ok.   Not enough Kielbasa!  $40 for lunch inc tip, no alcohol.  Great service but the food is the worst bar food I've had in years.  I loathe wasting money...and wasting lunch.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: Don't go for the bottomless $15 mimosas, it's straight Tropicana and no champagne. The food and atmosphere however was AMAZING!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Most fun on a Wednesday afternoon I've ever had! Service is great, the live music is incredible and the vibe of the place is very welcoming.

name: Riverfront Park
text: Despite the NYE barricades all week, we were able to enjoy a parcel of this great park in the cold weather, complementing Cumberland Park across the water.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: We stop by Tootsie's because it's famous so we had to. It was very packed. We were were around noon on Sunday (before CMA's) so Nashville was packed to begin with. We loved the rooftop patio despite not being able to get a table for about 20 minutes.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: Their brunch is so good! They were very flexible with my friends and I as far as our allergy restrictions went, and you can't beat the bottomless mimosas. The live music was awesome! The wait was not terrible either since I had a group of 12 on a Sunday at prime brunch time, and none of us cared since we had access to the bar while we waited! Haha. Highly recommend this place and I'll be back!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
Just an FYI they just opened a third floor that has roof access, very excited about this!! Yes, it's new and  doesn't quite have that old feel to it, but more space to fit more people and hear MORE great Nashville music. I was a big fan of the new third floor. It was a total blast!

You can always go to the second and first floor to get that original Nashville Tootsie feel. There is always someone great playing (because it's a landmark). It's noisy, it's crowded, you may have a beer spilt on you but come on would you have the honkey tonks any other way? :) Plus you'll be too busy doing fireball shots and singing along to even notice. Always a must stop for my nights out on Broadway and especially if I have out of town guest in!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Beer is expensive, but the music is phenomenal! Artists bring around a tip jar, and you can request songs for them to sing/play. Very fun atmosphere!

name: The Well Coffeehouse
text:
I was pleasantly surprised at how good the coffee was at The Well. And reasonable. A 12oz pour over is only $2. 

There were 6 roasts to choose from (they source their coffee from Murfreesboro roaster Just Love Coffee Roasters). I opted for a Guatemalan pour over - nutty and toffee-ish. The execution was among the highest I've experienced in Nashville. 

I tried a slice of zucchini nut bread along with my coffee, made by Cozy Cottage Bakery in Woodbury, TN. It was moist and tasty without too much sweetness. 

I was only in and out, but for a caffeine fix to weather (or enhance) the Green Hills craziness, The Well is the best option I've found, by far.

name: Tin Roof
text: Great service,  excellent guacamole!  Very casual laid back atmosphere.   Live music and pretty good food.

name: Tin Roof
text: Great place to visit while you are in Nashville.  Great live music and sandwiches.   Bartender could be more service oriented however.

name: Paradise Park Trailer Resort
text:
At least they had root beer.   

Everything seemed promising, friendly staff, a good schtick, and a raging cover band next door (connected). But, the burgers were bland, the fries floppy, and the jalapeño cheese fritters lacked....jalapeño.  

Don't get me wrong, ingredients were fresh, and the food came out fast.... But it never reached its potential. ... At least they had root beer.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Wow what a place. Three bands on three different floors. Cold beer and great music. Roam the same place as as Jonny Cash ,George Jones, Hank, and any one else you can think of.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: My family wanted to go to Tootsies but the doorman bent my 24 year daughter's state license and then grabbed her arm after changing his mind about admitting her to the club. She'll be 25 January 30th. Devante, the doorman was very rude and noted that SC IDs are very often fake. It isn't fake.  We asked for a manager and he was rude as well. We went to Tin Roof instead. Very nice staff and fantastic music at Tin Roof.  Too bad Tootsies can't be as cordial. It would have been nice to have an apology from them and a commitment to purchase a replacement ID for my daughter.

name: The Stone Fox
text: I waited until I had brunch here twice because I really hate giving The Stone Fox a low rating because it's a great neighborhood bar and it has such a lovely atmosphere and the waitstaff is pretty top notch, however, their brunch is pretty so-so. During my first visit, I ordered their chicken and waffles. The waffle was pretty much like an over-sized eggo--bland. Their chicken was pretty flavorful but overcooked. During my second visit I had their BLT with avocado. I also found this bland. A friend ordered their granola and yogurt and there was barely any yogurt. I would go back for brunch, if it isn't my choice and I'm not paying.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: We loved Tootsie's! Fantastic music and friendly staff. Decent beer selection. Would come back again for sure.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: A great venue to hear music the way it was meant to be.  We went on a Monday, which is first come first served. It's small, so arrive early and expect it to be cramped. An experience not to be missed while in Nashville!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
Great live band tonight, and I don't even listen to country music!  Like most bars that I've been to tonight, this one had about 3 levels to it, and a different band playing on each one.  Great atmosphere good crowd.  Came here on a Monday night and it was a happening spot.  On the weekends it's toe to toe I've heard.  

The best band was on the floor level.  Lots of old school pictures on the wall, casual atmosphere, older crowd - like 30-50 year olds who just love their country music.

You gotta come here to get a taste of what Nashville bars are all about.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
It would have been better stars but when a bar pays .40 a bud light and they charge $6.00 is a bit much. 
Bands were off key but hey everyone was having a good time. 
All in all its a nice place. A bit too crowded but nice.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
Not to be confused with Footsie's, which is what I played with your girlfriend last night when we were all on a double dinner date.

One of many wonderful places to meet gorgeous people and tourists on Lower Broadway in Nashville. On such a small stretch of road there are so many different things to do and places to hang out and listen to music and get drunk. This is just one of them. It's not my absolute favorite but it's enjoyable and busy and usually very welcoming.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge is a Nashville bar with lots of fun for anyone who walks in the door. I hung out at an UYE during Spring Break and had a great time. The lowest level has a cool stage with a bar area that wraps around all sides! There was also some construction going on with the 2nd and 3rd floors. Thanks to an awesome Nashville Yelper (Mike G.), a group of visiting Yelpers got to the hang out on the top level of Tootie's even though the place was jam packed! The best parts of this place include the great bands they have playing on each floor (their was a country band on the lower level and a rock band on the top floor during my visit), great frozen drinks (the Piña colada is awesome!), and a rooftop balcony with breathtaking views of downtown Nashville and Broadway Street.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: Food was good. But I liked the service more. The overall ambience was casual and lively with the love music. And you really can't beat the bottomless mimosas, lol. I had chicken and waffles and I liked they added curry powder in the dish. It made the dish different than what I used to have. And not too much or it would have overpowered the whole dish.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: Awesome service, great food! The sweet potato hummus appetizers were amazing and the recommended Brussels sprouts with mash potatoes were a good balance. I like the fact that their shrimp is from the Gulf and they gave a good amount in the shrimp and grits.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: Definitely one of the highlights of our Nashville trip. We saw Mystery Trip, a Beatles tribute. Their in the round format was very cool . It made for a very intimate setting. It was like you were sitting with the band. We reserved our seats, which I highly recommend. The staff was very friendly. Would definitely go back next time I visit Nashville.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: First time at The Sutler. Ordered the okra and fried pickles and the smoked wings. Might have been in the top 3 best wings I've ever had. Smoked then deep fried to get  crispy crunchy. Great with their homemade ranch. Excellent 90s rock band on tuesdays made up of musicians from several prominent country artists band's.  Highly recommend!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
I've lived here in Nashville my whole life, born & raised. I can't begin to explain how saddened I am that this bar is a "staple" of Nashville. It's painful to even give it 1 star. 

My fiancé & I stopped into Tootsies only to have a drink & watch my friend sing. We aren't ones to get crazy at a bar. My fiancé was patiently waiting for me outside of the restroom before being pulled down the stairs & out of the bar... for no reason at all. The bouncer just didn't want him standing there I guess. I didn't even have time to wash my hands before I heard the commotion. Next thing I know 3 bouncers are pushing him out of the door. As I stand there & watch them then push him to the ground, I get angry. I ask them what were they thinking...and then I get pushed to the ground. Obviously my fiancé lost his cool over this, which made one of the bouncers mad... who then had to be held back by his fellow bouncer friends because he was threatening to fight my fiancé. 

I realize this is a bar, a lot of crazy things happen... But if you intend on being a "bouncer/security guard" you should be trained to keep your cool & treat people like human beings. You & your power trip are pathetic. I also realize that not every bouncer is this way... I apologize if this offends anyone. 

I've read several reviews & every single bad review is about the horrible staff. There have also been several lawsuits due to the mistreatment of customers. This place is a disgrace to Nashville.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text:
What a cool place!
they have successfully reincarnated the Nashville classic "the sutler" the food and drinks are very creative and delicious!
You can see a live band, enjoy a craft cocktail and eat yummy southern inspired chef driven food.
The lamb ribs are amazing and the jalapeño popcorn is very cool!
Fired pickles and green tomatoes wow!

name: The Stone Fox
text: Awesome joint in west Nashville. This one has a nice selection of cocktails... And the food is pretty choice. I like the veggie melt and the veggie burger. The items that have meant are great too.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
Went in January was only packed downstairs, go upstairs there is another live band! 

Diverse crowd of all ages and I got to travel back I time to my college years with the divey decor, plastic cups and bottles bus or miller beers. 

The fiddler playing on our way out made this bar stop worth it plus now I can say I went to Tootsies!

name: The Well Coffeehouse
text:
Okay, I'll be honest. I love this place. The environment is fantastic because it is cozy and inviting. The coffee is wonderful as well. There are so many great brews and you can't go wrong no matter what you decide to order. 

However, the reason I only rated this place 2/5 is because:

1) This place is ALWAYS packed. If you want to just grab a cup of coffee and sit down for a while, good luck. There is never a place to sit down. This place is always crawling with people and, I mean, that's great but there is just never a place to actually take a seat and enjoy your coffee or get work done. 

2) Maybe it's because this place is located in Green Hills, but parents seem to think it is acceptable to drop their tween children off at a coffee shop to get caffeine high. This place is not just crawling with any type of people. It's crawling with tweens who are loud and slightly obnoxious. 

3) The line to get coffee and order is insanely long and you have to wait a long time to get your coffee. 

4) If you're not a coffee aficionado, good luck with the menu. Great brews but insanely confusing menu. 

5) The coffee is EXPENSIVE. I get why, your purchase is going towards a great cause, but still. just a heads up. 

Anyway, I would've loved this place had it not been for the above mentioned reasons.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text:
I loved the (physical) atmosphere and think this would be a great place to see a show.  That being said...

The staff has perfected the toocoolforschool vibe.  From hostess to our waitress to various food servers, there was a distinct chilly vibe.  Whatever.

The beer list is subpar, though we've discovered that is par for the course in Nashville.  After suffering through a local IPA, I ordered a Bulleit and diet, only to be served a Coke and Bulleit.  I can deal with that, as I shouldn't be mixing rye whiskey with anything, but still...

The menu is interesting.  I ordered the GA White Shrimp and it was a prime example of presentation trumping taste.  It looked beautiful, but sadly, didn't taste as good as it looked.  It was significantly over salted (and I LOVE salt).  The carrots were primarily a PITA garnish and the corncake quite dense.  The shrimp were smallish and just ok.  

My husband ordered the brisket and only ate about 1/4 of his meal.  The saving grace to the experience was the brussle sprouts (I know, right?!!).  No, really.  They are served in a cast iron pan atop fluffy whipped potatoes and topped with friend onions.  Awesome.  I'd have been quite hungry after dinner if it weren't for them.

Bottom line:  if there's music you want to see, check it out.  If not, I'd skip it.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text:
At 8:00p.m., they ran out of the trout. No biggie. But then my friend's "hoe cake," was raw in the center. So, basically, uncooked Bisquick. My husband's brisket was 25% straight up fat. The rest was only semi edible. 

Service was ok, and the waitress was genuinely sweet and helpful when we told her about the two dishes that were undercooked. The manager took off 20% of the bill, which was very nice and appreciated, 


All in all, the service was good, but the food is over priced and nothing great at all. 

Best part was the fried pickles!!! That was yummy.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text:
I wanted to like this place a little better than I did. It's got a fun atmosphere, a creative drink menu, interesting foods, and a unique flare. The Sutler has a lot going for it but I think it could easily be better. 

I went here for a business dinner with a client group. First off, we ordered the fried pickles, hot chicken, and Potted Smoke Jar. All appetizers were pretty good. I personally liked the pickles best. The portions seemed off on the jar and the hot chicken's breeding was too thin. However, the chicken had a good flavor with as much back-end kick as one of the horses festooned about The Sutler's western decor. One of the guys had a backyard drink and sang it's praises. 

Finally, I had the Short Rib Dog and it was okay. I really wanted to like it since the menu description had me salivating from the moment I walked in. It was blander than I'd like and could have easily brought in more of the cumin mustard and sauerkraut flavor. A big issue I have with The Sutler was the price. I feel like most things on the menu are 20-35% overpriced, especially considering the smaller portion sizes and proletarian featured ingredients. 

Pros-Fun vibe, interesting menu, good addition to the area

Cons-Price and the food misses on the wow factor. 

Overall-Definitely worth a visit. It could be better but I thought it was a good spot!

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text:
The Bluebird Cafe didn't bowl me over.  I'm sure if we'd seen an artist we really knew and liked, it would have been an entirely different experience altogether. We were just happy to have scored reservations while in Nashville.

I do think it's important to arrive early whether you have a reservation or not. We had reserved pew seats, but requested table seats (if any were available after all the reservations were seated), and sure enough, we got to move up to a table. Much better than those uncomfortable pews!
