The venue is tiny and seating is extremely tight. We shared a table with two other couples. The kitchen burned my quesadillas twice, so I strongly advise eating somewhere else beforehand. I can't imagine anyone comes to the Bluebird for their food anyway. 

My best advice for the Bluebird is to keep your expectations in check!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Great fun..great bands. The place was packed upstairs because the singer was amazing.

name: The Stone Fox
text: My husband and I met some friends here last night for dinner and trivia. I ordered the veggie burger with a gluten free bun (#newyearsresolutions) and fries. I sadly drank water and everyone else had beer or mixed drinks. I like that the drinks were all served in mason jars. It was very fitting with the cute, vintage tables & twinkle lights. Our server was really nice and our drinks were never empty. I personally really loved the veggie burger. I've never had a veggie burger made with beets but I want more! The bun tasted great but was a little more dense than a regular bun. Still, it didn't have the weird taste of some GF breads. It was just impossible to pick up and eat without the burger squishing out onto my plate. I do wish I could have eaten this like an actual burger and not with a fork, but it was still really tasty. There were other things on the menu that were tempting and my husband's pretzels looked awesome. Trivia was really fun and we will definitely be back!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: What is there to say, an Institution in Nashville. Lots of fun, great music, great people, great, drinks.  Great for locals and for tourists. Can get very crowded at times but Love this place so Proud of Tootsies

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Had a lot of fun here, music was great, Cassandra on that fiddle was absolutely amazing. Very small place and it was a packed house but great crowd, singing along and friendly. But again great music!!

name: The Sutler Saloon
text:
We have been twice. The first time was to go have a drink at the bar downstairs. Such a cool atmosphere. The guys behind the bar definitely know what they are doing. Let's just say that because of the first visit for a drink and an appetizer, we wanted to come back. The second visit we started out downstairs. Again, the drinks rocked. Our bartender totally created a drink for my wife that she love. (He had to do this because they were waiting on fresh strawberries for the drink she had last time.) I also saw the prep work done for the bar. They actually washed the lemons before they cut them!
Upstairs for dinner was great! Our main coarse came out just a bit before the fried pickles and the beer cheese soup, so they took them off our bill. I like that. Shows that they care even if we did not. Good vibe, great staff. Wished we could have stayed for the show. (Yes, they have a stage with live music. Hard to find that these days with a dinner atmosphere.) Go. You will enjoy it.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: My family and I waited for 2 hours in the heat for a open mic at the bluebird cafe. the lines were very confusing and people were line jumping. The staff kept on changing the rules. It was a very frustrating experience overall. Then, after waiting for hours, they directed us to the gift shop. I would not recommend this to anyone unless they enjoy waiting in line.

name: Paradise Park Trailer Resort
text:
I enjoyed myself
Halloween here was so fun!
Great mix of music

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Been here many time and this time was maybe the last time. Ordered 9 beers...ALL were warm and when I approached a "manager" I'm assuming...he acted like he could care less and actually acted annoyed.  An apology would have at least been nice.   Very rude.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: Love the Bluebird! It is pretty impossible to get tickets here now since the show Nashville, but it is definitely worth the fight if you can.  It is even worth standing in line.  If you are going the standing in line route, be sure to get there a few hours before. The history of this place is just amazing.  It is very small and quaint inside and you watch about four or five songwriters perform songs that they have written and tell stories about them. The talent here is amazing and the drinks are good.  I am a huge fan of the Bluebird.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Went with my friends and went outside because the bar was crowded, but it was freezing outside. One  of the the at lamps was off and we tried turning it on but it was broken and a security guard came out and told us to stop and we'd be kicked out. We said okay and smoked a cigarette and he came out again and told us to stop again, even though no one touched it. We said okay and a few minutes later he came out with police officers and told us we had too much to drink. Out of all the bars I've been to in Nashville, I don't think I've ever experienced bouncers as rude and ridiculous as this, and I will never go back.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: I just stopped in for a quick lunch here and had some sort of pulled pork sandwich that was very tasty, and the service was good.  I was there mid-week at 1PM and was pretty shocked at how slow they were.  I guess lunch service is new here, hence the sign outside, but I'd go here again.

name: Paradise Park Trailer Resort
text: The atmosphere was great. The people that worked there were incredibly friendly! The food was fantastic. We ate there two nights back to back.

name: The Stone Fox
text:
West Nashville hot spot!

This is an adorable house that has been converted to a hip restaurant.

Great for a happy hour hangout with friends, family, or co-workers. On Mondays they have two-for-one specials.

Beyond that, they have great apps and delicious burgers.

One of my favorite things? Owned and ran by a brother and sister, who both serve and bartend. They have created a local spot with great music and a place where you could become a regular.

Definitely a must!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
Heard about the infamous Tootsies and knew we had to visit. The line was out the door every day we were there but looked quiet on a sunday night. However took us a while still to crowd in.

Discovered the upstairs, got a table and enjoyed some of their fine Apple Pie shots. The upstairs band suckes. Cared way more about their egos than e very other person in the bar. Couldnt finish songs. Also there was a valet in the men's bathroom?

After spending a few hours here it was already one of my fav Nashville bars. Then we almost got picked up by some swingers and now this infamous dive bar has a special place in my heart too.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
My 2nd favorite place on Broadway..
It has 3 levels of fun!!
All levels have live music.
It gets crowded so be ready to get cozy when you walk through this bar of fun!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Rooftop is amazing! This is a must visit bar in Nashville. The drinks are reasonably priced and the Moonshine is a must! Be prepared to be in a popular venue. It is always crowded, but almost always has live music and for being as crowded as they are the bartenders are attentive and work quickly!

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: Couldn't get tickets, but stood in line for an hour and a half on a Saturday nite and got very lucky. One of the songwriters (Brian White) that entered while we were waiting told us it was worth the wait. He was absolutely right! The variety of music was incredible.  It was music in the round with five performers's all taking turns with different styles. We particularly enjoyed Lisa Carver.  And, the food was very reasonably priced with tremendous portions and it was delicious. I had a Turkey bacon club that was thick and juicy and came with the most yummy potato chips I have ever had! Service was excellent! We talked to the performers afterwards and even purchased their CDs which we are now listening to on our drive back to Ohio.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our meal at the Sutler. The fried pickles were tasty. The gumbo was just right. And my husband loved his smoked bologna sandwich with Mac and cheese. Try the Don't Ask Rye cocktail. It was delicious. Even the sweet potato pie was on point. The service was really fast too. So, I don't have a single negative thing to say about this place. Everything was just right and we will definitely be back.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: Went here for back to back shows on Valentine's Day. Had the pork sliders which were excellent and so were both shows. I just wished they had a more extensive beer menu.  When your watching music for almost 4 hours it leaves you a lot of time to try a variety which they didn't have.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Walked in here cynical thinking tourist trap and then couldn't leave because the entertainment was so good and the vibe ruled. I don't know the name of the group (four girls who sing on top of the bar, one with a fiddle plus a band) but they were so awesome. They did covers, country hits, hip hop, Led Zeppelin, TV show theme songs, you name it. Super talented and super fun.  Place was packed. They sang and played their hearts out for at least 4 hours. Didn't have any food but the selection of beer is decent from craft beer to crappy Bud/Coors Light.

name: The Well Coffeehouse
text:
Warning , coffee fiend review! 

I had been wanting to check out this place for a while since, like others have said, there isn't a good coffee place in Green Hills. I was expecting more ....yeaaa. The place always looks packed and I finally decided to drop in one day. 

The inside was busy with kids running around Everywhere. It seems like this is more of a place for soccer moms to bring their kids after school. At least this day was like that. The line was long and most people seemed like they didn't know how or what to order. A lot of time was spent watching people get all the way to the front of the line only to not know what they wanted. There was only two people working behind the counter and they were swamped ( don't get me wrong , they were working their asses off). 

I got a french press roast and sat down waiting for it to finish. I was surrounded by kids and tweens cracked out on caffeine with parents no where in sight. The decor of the place makes me feel like I'm in a Cracker Barrel!!  There's a whole gift shop area right next to where you need to stand in line. O, and for some reason they are selling books.......religious books are sitting right next to sexual southern romance novels !?!?Lol......I dunno. 

I mean I get the whole idea of helping out countries with severe poverty, I really do. I think it's super cool and I get behind that 100%. But I don't know why a place that's a coffee shop is selling Christmas ornaments , scarfs and stuff that you'll find on Pinterest if you ever go to peruse the website.

I think this place is definitely marketed towards people that live in the area and that alone. This is a place that I would not go out of my way to find or drive to. If you're coming from across the city, there are better places to hit up. Check out my reviews on places in Nashville, Atlanta or San Fran.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: First time visiting Nashville and had heard great things about this place... They definitely didn't disappoint! It is extremely touristy, but the live music was great, the drink prices were reasonable and we had a great time. We went on a Wednesday night and it was still pretty busy, so I imagine on the weekends it must be totally packed. Would definitely go back!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Great environment, 3 floors with a band on each one. Was very crowded for a Tuesday but was a great time! Not as "Honky Tonk" music playing as so.e of the other bars on Broadway, but bartenders were friendly and music was good!

name: Paradise Park Trailer Resort
text: The burger super grease and not the world's greatest burger. If u drunk and no taste buds perfect place to eat. The taters were extra salty and the chilly was also salty and no crackers. Chilly is all meat nothing else in it. First and last 4 me.

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text: I was so excited to try this restaurant.  I'm a fan of Tom Morales restaurants and I know about the history of the building and knew he would create something special.  I think he did, but I was very disappointed in the service.  Our server and bus boy were inattentive and seemed stressed rather than hospitable.  The food was good but the presentation was sloppy.  We had dirty plates (appetizers, salad and soup) still on our table when they brought out main entrees and we actually had to ask to have the dirty dishes cleared.  I will give it another shot but they need some  improvements to service in order to live up to the hype.  Tom, I hope you are reading this.  (Also -- would recommend one more healthy, non-comfort food choice for both appetizer and main dish options)

name: Paradise Park Trailer Resort
text:
This place is everything I expected and wanted a bar in Nashville to be (and to be honest, it's what I'd love a bar to be anywhere).  First off, the place has astro-turf and lawn furnature...genius.  If society wouldn't look down on me, I'd be barefoot in this bar because I love the way turf feels on my feet.

Next, $6 Natty Light pitchers.  Nothing like reliving the old college days and drinking beer that tastes like white bread.  They also had a variety of other beers behind the bar sitting in a bathtub full of ice.  

This is also the only place where I could fall into a lawn chair, break it, get punched in the face by a chick, and still keep telling myself how awesome this place is. 

Plus the bar has "trailer resort" in its name and the link on this Yelp page has a myspace address, how could you go wrong?

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text: We went Tuesday night before a play at TPAC for a round of drinks and appetizers. The service was decent where we had 4 people check on us and gave us what we needed to dine, like small plates and silverware. The food was great, our favorites were the deviled eggs and the Brussels sprouts. Plus, the head chef Matt gave great recommendations on desert for the next time we go, as well as other places to dine in. The decor was nice and somewhat true to the history of Woolworth, and we really enjoyed the shelves with Black chef cookbooks!

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: My girlfriend and I loved this place.  We were told about The Sutler by a local and came the day before New Years Eve.  We were very impressed for a lot of reasons.  First off they offer a generous military discount and we were treated like first class by our waitress Kelly.  We enjoyed our drinks on our first visit and were again impressed with drinks on our second visit.  The musicians were professionals and added to the atmosphere.  Last I must say what really made our night was this; they were out of the chocolate jar dessert on our first visit and second visit, but went to the extra effort to go out of the way and make one of the lacking ingredients for us. It's full of people of varying ages and lifestyles that keep coming back because of their continued impeccable customer service.  For our brief time in Nashville for Bash on Broadway downtown for New Years The Sutler will be our most memorable experience in Nashville.

name: Tin Roof
text: My favorite bar in Nashville. When my friends come in to town from out of state I bring them here. Staff is GReAT, drinks are awesome and I love the bar food. I can come here to catch a game, listen to some music or use it as a jumping point to go to the rest of the strip.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: I can't comment about the venue or what the atmosphere is like but I can comment about the line you will wait in. The 3 stars is just me imagining I'd of had a good time. No previous yelper really let us know what to expect besides "you will wait in line". We decided to go on a Sunday night where no reservation is required. For the 8pm show we got there at 630pm. The line was already at least 80 people deep. Every one waiting seemed to be from out of town, no locals, so the conversations I got to listen to for an hour and a half were a little annoying. We almost made it in, only about 8 people left in front of us but no luck. As for parking forget about the front parking lot if there is already a show going on. We parked directly behind the bluebird cafe, possibly an employee lot. No signs saying not to and a lot of open spaces. So get there about 2 hours a head of time. Good luck!

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: I came here on a Friday night to meet a gal pal for a drink. The bartenders were really friendly and served me pretty quickly. I appreciated them being attentive and serving me right up. When my friend came, they let her try a few things before she decided on the cava. When I walked in, there were a great crowd dancing on the floor with a DJ. I loved the vibe and will definitely be stopping by a lot more than often.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text:
Attended a private morning showcase the day of the 2015 CMT Music Awards.

The breakfast buffet was great and the Mimosa's flowed.

But the best part was seeing and hearing the acoustic sounds of three top songwriters: Chris DeStefano, Jessi Alexander and J.T. Harding.

Hearing them perform some of the songs they wrote, which would be performed later by other "major" artists at the awards show, proved to me that most times, the original is better than the cover.

name: Tin Roof
text:
This place is rad. I usually come here once a year just because I'm from out of state. I love the down to earth, Nashville feel. I usually never remember leaving this place!  
You'll also catch some of today's biggest country music singers or musicians in there. Awesome place!

name: The Stone Fox
text: The main thing holding me back from giving The Stone Fox more stars was our extremely poor service. I came to eat on a fairly slow afternoon with two girlfriends. We ordered our food & theirs was brought out first, which is fairly normal, but when the waitress messed up my order & brought me out something completely wrong I politely let her know, and she told me I could keep the wrong dish & take it home for free. I said sure why not & then expected for my CORRECT dish to move to the front of the line in the kitchen to be rushed out.... twenty minutes later (after both my friends had finished their dishes) I asked about my dish, the waitress went back & got it for me. It was wrong again. She sent it back a THIRD time & finally got it right. I ate my food alone & ended up having to pay full price for it. Service really makes or breaks a place and I can't say I got the best impression of TSF at all after this visit :(

name: The Well Coffeehouse
text: Great atmosphere and I love that they contribute financially to the community. Even with live music playing, the environment was tranquil and the drinks were good quality.

name: The Stone Fox
text: Good beer, better bands, amazing food!!!  Me and this place get along better than Michael Jackson and Macaulay Culkin.

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text:
Went here with 2 work colleagues based on the reviews.  I will say the entrees were delicious but the 2 appetizers were terrible (lamb meatballs and pickled shrimp). The meatballs were so dry they crumbled like sand and were tasteless.  The shrimp was also tasteless - not even a hint of pickle. 

When we were starting to tell the manager he tried to say "Let me get a content card". We said we'd rather just talk to him.  He essentially said thanks for the feedback,  see ya later.  Didn't even offer to take them off the bill. 

We did try the desert and that was okay.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: Food and service was great! I didn't give it a 5 star because the kitchen was very slow. The BLT has enough bacon on it i got a to-go box for. Mac and cheese and tomato soup was on point.

name: The Stone Fox
text: Beers only tonight. Good People on draft. Forget to wear skinny jeans, Chuck Taylor's and fedora so stuck out like sore thumb.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: Waiting in line in the heat sucks but if your lucky enough to get a seat it worth the pain and suffering of the wait. Music is awesome and room is historic. Not really any good options here so if you haven't ate plan on going somewhere afterwards.

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text: I like the atmosphere and friendly service. Wonderful knowing this civil rights historic landmark has reopened, and with a nightclub downstairs. I love the black & white films being screened on the wall and the old R&B/funk background music . The brisket sandwich, served alone with bbq sauce, was very moist and tasty, though it should be served on a kaiser roll not a plain  hamburger bun. The thin sweet potato fries are deliciously crisp, the black eyed peas were okay. The price was reasonable and I'd like to go back to try their brunch.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: Getting a table here is a nightmare. You can reserve a table at 8:00AM the Monday before a show, but their website is not equipped to handle the traffic, so you just get locked out. So the people who get tables are just the ones lucky enough to get through the crappy website. They need to fix this.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: Beautiful bar and restaurant. Had great drink specials, live music, and holy moly their food. Best breakfast in Nashville. I want to eat their fried chicken as my only meal for the rest of my life. Go to here.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: One star is a bit of a stretch..... I had a terrible experience at Tootsies. I ordered a beer at the upstairs bar and was denied because my ID had an air bubble. The bartender denied me, then laughed in my face and asked where I got it from. I said it was obtained from the Department of Motor Vehicles and requested it to be checked by the manager. When the manager came upstairs with my license it had been destroyed. The small air bubble turned into the bottom portion of my hologram being ripped off, making it unusable for the rest of my trip. After this interaction I wasn't even offered anything to compensate for ruining my license, which I need to fly home. I was not even offered a cup of water while I waited for my friends to finish their drinks. I will never go back to this restaurant because of their disgusting lack of customer service.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text:
The menu and beer selection are electic. We started with appetizers, the guac trio and smoked wings. The guac was brown and the variation consisted of simply piling crab meat and mango chunks on top of very brown guac. The Costco chips were tasty though..
As for the smoked wings, they were not really smoked but instead had the soggy memory of being in a warmer..The Alabama White Sauce has the taste of mayo, vinegar, and ranch which some may love... However, these are not ingredients I find delightful.
The entrees have yet to come.. But we are hopeful..

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: Intimate venue with ive music.Songwtiters perform their work.  U need to make reservations online for all shows except Sundays and Monday's.  Parking limited.  7$ minimum but food not great so eat before or after and stick tyo drinks and sweet potato fries.  The music is fantastic so make reservations

name: Paradise Park Trailer Resort
text: GREAT FOOD/ Location/ Prices!!!  BBQ Bacon burger is the business!  Tater Tots are delicious!!! Right in the middle of Broadway!  Good people watching!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: So. Much. Fun!!! Too crowded on a Sat night but thankfully we got in on Sun about 6pm - the place was still packed. The performers were fantastic & non-stop! Bartenders were awesome!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
Yup, it's one of those places you just HAVE to visit if you are doing the touristy thing downtown. 

I loved they had the history of Tootsie herself on the actual menu. We didn't order anything besides beers here, but I loved learning a little more about the history. 

The walls of fame are covered with old, falling apart newspaper articles and pictures of some of the biggest country stars you know. Just having a seat at the bar makes you feel a little special, about being somewhere so many great things have come out of. 

It was about 2 pm on a Thursday, and we had a little more time to kill before we headed back to the airport. Yep, there was live music playing, and although it was more of a "pop" country kinda thing going on this day (not my favorite) it was still an experience. 

There is also another bar and was another band upstairs that suit our tastes a little better... so we grabbed another brew before we were unleashed back on Broadway.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: We stopped into Tootsies a few times on our long weekend in Nashville. It was always packed and had bands playing no matter what time it was. The drinks were a bit pricey but it's a touristy place so that's expected. We always found a good crowd here and the best spot is to head up to the rooftop and grab a table if you can.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: . We had the brisket tacos and the steak sandwich and they were both fantastic. Jasmine gave us great, super friendly service. Will definitely be back

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text: Food was good, solid, but not amazing. Nothing super-exciting in the menu choices--about what you'd expect from a nice place down south. The drinks were actually better than the food! The place is also a historic stop and you can wander around and see photos of sit-ins and the Civil Rights history that happened right there. The owners have done a great renovation job--honoring the history while also creating a 21st century space.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Felt like a tourist trap. I'm ok with paying $7 for a light beer to be downtown and enjoy live music but it appears that Tootsie's does not subsidize the artist. We walked up and put a $5 tip in there tip jar and asked they could play a Tom Petty song. Only for the lead singer to pull it out of the tip jar and told the whole bar this is way too low and she was only playing requests for $20. I got to see Tom Petty live in concert before he passed for $30 lol, but she needed $20 for a song requests. It was kind of embarrassing and seemed like a tourist trap. The artist will ask for money after every song, which starts to get uncomfortable.  There are a lot of better bars we found that appreciated our tips and played great music. Very strange experience overall.  Not for me...

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: If you like bouncers who look like the lead singer of good Charlotte/ fallout boy/ Green Day/ or any 130 lb emo male this is the bar for you. They throw out loyal customers for having a fun time. The bouncers call the cops when they are too small and emo to deal with the customers who aren't doing anything wrong. This is an embarrassing showing by a bar to keep fun loving people happy. The bar needs to hire better/ more capable security instead of the 90 lb "bouncers" who get offended by the comments on his eye liner.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text:
****By far, the WORST ticket purchasing experience I've ever had.*****

Me and the wife planned a trip to Nashville for our anniversary and wanted to catch a show at the Bluebird Cafe. Tickets go on sale at 8am on 07/04/19 so I planned ahead and put it in my calendar and was in their virtual line by 7:30am for tickets on  7/11/19. 

The ticket website goes down that morning and I reach out to the venue, the virtual ticket company and even the vitrual line company. (All different) 

I finally get an email an hour later that the page is back up so I IMMEDIATELY go back to the site to find that tickets for the 6:00pm and 9:00pm shows are sold out. 

The story doesn't end there.

I take the loss on that one and see that they have tickets hoing on sale at 8am on 07/08/19 for shows on 07/12/19. (Day after our anniversary)

I repeat by getting in line at 7:30am and finally get through for the 9:00pm show and its great because there are 2 tickets available at the bar and, since I know I only have one minute to pick my seats, I take the bar seats and click on the proceed to checkout link.

The link malfunctions and puts me back in line and then brings me back to the page to choose my tickets. Guess what happened next..... 

There is only 1 seat available in all sections. So now we don't get to go because their website ticking is HORRIBLY run. I'm completely disappointed and we will fine another way to enjoy our 1st anniversary. 

Thank you Bluebird Cafe for ruining our plans with your defunct ticketing service.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: This place was the best part of Nashville, which was a great experience on its own. We had literally the best waitress I have ever had (shout out to Virginia) and she is the GOAT.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text:
Worth the wait!

My mom and I waiting in line for 2.5 hours to get into the early show. It was 90+ out and really muggy. But, all that heat and sweat was worth it. Once we got inside the vibe of the venue was buzzing with excitement. Each and every person was excited to be apart of the upcoming show. 

We saw a songwriter association show. The music was better than most songs on the radio and that isn't an exaggeration. Each song was original and the singers voices were amazing. 

Next time I'm in Nashville, I'll make sure to go to another show here. If you have a few hours to spare, get down there and check out a show!

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text: Good experience overall. Service was friendly but not particularly adept. We all liked our entrees a lot - salmon, shrimp and grits, and bistro steak. But the desserts all disappointed - fruit cobbler, strawberry shortcake, and bread pudding. Three people including desserts was about $150 with tip so it's not cheap.

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text: I love this place for the history, ambiance, friendly staff and amazing food and drinks! Woolworth in fifth is a must if you're downtown.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text:
Allow a little extra time to find a parking spot. The atmosphere was casual and fun, live music doesn't start till nine. 
 The potted smoke AMAZING! Boiled peanuts were deliciously salty and tender. The greens were so very good! The Mac was lackluster.
 The cocktails were very tasty but they were out of the syrup for the one we wanted which was disappointing.
 Going on a weekend? Get a reservation or be prepared for a wait. I will be going back to sample more of the menu!

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: We weren't able to get reservations so my friend and I decided to stand in line to see if we could get in! We got there 30 minutes before the doors opened at 7:30pm for a Sunday night 8:00pm show and got into the pews in the back! It's actually small enough that you can still see well and communicate with the servers! You order food and drinks at the bar and they bring the rest to you! The music was incredible, Service was very kind and swift, and overall a wonderful place to spend an evening! Highly recommend!

name: Tin Roof
text: Alex is the shit & needs a raise$$$ asap. Bob Franklin is a genius for this bar. Respectfully from the Shane Johnson's bachelor party 7/2917. Again Alex deserves a $$$$! Savage

name: Paradise Park Trailer Resort
text:
Trailer trash.... Oh yes! 

This is the second time to the park, and I have had a blast every time! Live music and it's usually very loud! However, we stopped on a Monday afternoon and the music was fantastic and the performers were awesome. We chatted with them while we enjoyed ice cold beers. The bartender was great and attentive. Now that is a fantastic Monday in my book! 

Ok the decor is hilarious... Green astro turf, a pontoon, broken down car, beers are iced down in bath tubs, and you order your food out of the food truck. The bumper sticker that are posted are hilarious... Sorry not appropriate to write, so y'all know they are bad as I don't hold back much. There are old school box TV's with Jerry Springer or other trashy shows like that. Paradise park does not miss a thing. 

The food is good and greasy... Perfect place to soak up all the booze you have consumed on Broadway. 

Game day wear your predator's jersey and get a free beer. 

Love this dive and can't wait to go back!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: If you are looking for a tourist trap, this is your place. Seriously, if you have the urge to say "I went to Tootsie's and had a beer", visit the airport location-less crowded, less dirty, better environment, but still expensive. Just don't let on your Tootsies was on the Gate C ramp and not lower Broadway.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Went in for a few drinks before the Garth Brooks concert, was extremely crowded but we made our way to back of the bar, got lucky and 2 were leaving so we got their seats. Bartenders were extremely friendly and very good at their job. Bands were ok, begging for tips . A fun 3 hours, would have liked to walked around and looked at all the history on the walls and went upstairs to check out but didn't. Will definitely go back on our next weekend trip

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
This place is pretty famous in that it is right next to the Ryman Auditorium. It has several sections including an alleyway entrance, a main entryway, and a rooftop section. 

We found a spot in the front section and listened to some live music while drinking a couple of beers. 

Every place on the strip has terrific live music from struggling but talented musicians who play for tips. The music is mostly country with some blues mixed in.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Such a fun place. It gets extremely crowded, so be prepared to be squished. The music is very entertaining, usually a very fun and friendly crowd. Good drink prices.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Kassidy was awesome! Made our entire experience even better. Great bar tender great service. Great music.

name: The Stone Fox
text:
I'd say it's more like 3.5 stars. After reading some of the reviews about how the wait staff was unfriendly and food often came out cold, I was a bit concerned about what my experience would be like. 

My roommate & I arrived around 7PM on a Friday night for dinner, and a friend of hers joined us shortly thereafter. The place was fairly empty, maybe only about half full, which was somewhat surprising. 

Positives: 

- Our waitress (I believe her name was Mariah?) was one of the best waitresses I've had at any establishment in a long time. She was incredibly helpful with her recommendations of beers on tap and was just an awesome, friendly person. Far from the poor reviews other patrons have given the waitstaff. 

- My dinner: I ordered the chicken tenders, which were amazingly good. They were tender, juicy and perfectly fried. I ordered honey mustard to go with them (which they apparently make in-house) and it was a great combo for both the tenders and fries. I'm STILL thinking about those tenders!

Negative:

- We ordered the sundried tomato & basil flatbread as an appetizer and I wasn't particularly bowled over by it. The cheese seemed to have a bit of a rubber consistency and I couldn't really taste much of the sundried tomato element of it. It definitely came up short. 

By 9PM, the place had filled up and was packed for the live music that was about to begin. We stayed for about an hour into the set and the crowd seemed to be into it, but it wasn't music I have much knowledge of, so I'll abstain from giving my opinion on that. 

All in all, it was a much better experience than I thought I might have, given the other reviews. If you go for dinner, I HIGHLY recommend the chicken tenders, but avoid the sundried tomato & basil flatbread. I'll definitely be back (and hope to have Mariah as my waitress again)!

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: The Blue Bird Cafe is incredibly cool and what a great vibe! It was really cool to be in a place that holds so much history of music legends. We had reservations and didn't have to wait outside in line too long. Our server was wonderful. Watching "in the round" was very cool and it really does feel like you are "sitting in your living room listening to music with family". Wonderful experience.

name: Tin Roof
text: We walked in to be part of the crowd appreciating the music and atmosphere there, live band is energetic, place is set up nicely, staff super friendly and no fee to go inside, highly recommend!

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: Heard this place is one of the most desired place in Nashville as well as REALLY hard to get into. Only 18+ place in MILES. Luckily got in here. Music was great and the guys were funny. Waitress Ericka was RUDE.  Got snappy with a few of us sitting around me as well as myself when asking for water. But good thing it's about the music I suppose.

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text: The historic value of this place is enough to get you in the door of this Downtown Nashville gem but the food and flair will easily keep you there for a great meal!! We started with the deviled eggs, then moved into entrees of Pork Chops and Fried Flounder, before topping off the delicious meal with an absolutely perfect Pecan Pie variation that complimented everything beautifully! Excellent service, welcoming atmosphere, and a delight for the taste, visual, and auditory senses. If you are a local or just visiting for a trip, don't miss out on adding this place to your "must visit" list!!!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: I tried this bar twice during my stay in Nashville as everyone recommended it, but was unfortunately disappointed. Both times I walked in, checked out each floor and walked right back out because I could not move - which I guess is a testament to how good it is if so many people are always there! However, not being able to walk isn't exactly my cup of tea. I will say the second I walked in the second time the bartender made eye contact with me and asked if I wanted a drink - I definitely appreciated that. I'm sure the service is great. I only purchased one beer there unfortunately. If you want to be where everybody is (and I mean everybody) then it might be for you.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: The food was delivered ice cold - the tacos looked like they had been sitting for a very long time. The hollandaise and ham on the benedict, along with the potatoes, were cold to the touch. The wait staff quickly returned the food to the kitchen and brought us a slightly warmer meal. The food was fine, but not stellar. All that was after we waited an hour to get seated, only to find that our space had been deleted. The app apparently had a glitch. Loved the bluegrass. Just not worth the drive out of the downtown area.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text:
First word of advice: please encourage your staff to NOT ask patrons if they are pregnant. It's incredibly rude.

That was my first interaction walking into the establishment so I was immediately put off. We got a cute bubbly waitress, but she brought us glasses of water that were in fact just glasses of ice, to which later she realized her mistake. We then asked for sugar for our coffee since there was only sweet n low on the table. Our waitress said they didn't have packets of sugar but she could bring us some from the tub of sugar they use to make sweet tea. 

The food was decent so my review has nothing to do with the quality and quickness of the food, which we received soon after ordering and enjoyed. I mainly was very upset at the assumption that I was pregnant and a ditzy server who seemed very confused.

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text: This is a new stakehouse that I have never been to before but this is probably one of my favorites so far. I got the New York strip and so did one if the people I ate with. My stake what medium rare but the meat itself was surprisingly soft when you chew and the fat on the end was the melt in your mouth kind of fat.but the reason i give it a 4 star is because the other persons stake was not so soft and was not so medium rare but still good. If I ever come back to Nashville I think I would eat here again. 4/5 - 5/5

name: The Sutler Saloon
text:
Okay - this place is right next to Sinema and I had no idea it existed until I recently popped in for a business lunch...IT IS SO GOOD! 

I ordered the sweet potato hummus and avocado salad. The avocado salad was just alright - a little too much dressing. But the sweet potato hummus was fricken delicious! I loved the overall vibe of the place and the service was fast! Parking kinda sucks, it is a small lot so if you've got a group, you may wanna carpool or uber there. 

I'd love to come back here for dinner or during a weekend night to listen to live music and get drinks. I'm stoked it's only 10 minutes away from where I live, I'll be back soon Sutler!

Edit to Add: I came back recently for brunch and was so so impressed. My fiance ordered the chicken and biscuits, I had the breakfast tacos....we also had the bottomless mimosas. The food was amazing and they had a bluegrass band playing. I will DEFINITELY be coming back ASAP - I'm obsessed with this place!!

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text:
Have never once written a yelp review so this is my first. Wow!! Okay so my wife took me here this past Saturday evening for my birthday, and wow! It didn't fail to live up to the hype. The music was amazing and so much fun to see live these songs we knew. 
The food was amazing, my wife and I ordered the chicken mozzarella sandwich and the caprese both so delicious. I NEED that ranch recipe it was the best I've ever tasted. (And I own a restaurant back home so I know) The food was far better than I had been thinking it would be. The drinks were local brews and all great beers. Great selection all around. Our waitress was amazing and so sweet to each of our needs. Thank you again nashville and blue bird cafe for the best birthday I've had in years. This is a fun and great night out, so happy to have been able to have come here.

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text: Awesome experience! They do an excellent job of recreating the lunch counter/diner feel! Food was great, got the Egg Salad Sandwich with shoestring fries, wifey got French Dip with Sweet Potatoe Fries. Both were generous portions with my egg salad falling out perfectly! Wonderful staff and atmosphere with superb food. Highly recommended!!!!

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: Worth the wait! Got there at 4pm and just got in to the 6pm show! Ended up with great seats on the floor. Had the fried green tomatos. There is no cover charge but a $10 spending minimum! This is great place. The music was authentic and incredible to hear while in Nashville for a short time. Highly recommend! :)

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text: Our server kim was exceptional!  She was extremely attentive and went above and beyond to give us a great dining experience. The food was great and very reasonably priced. I loved looking at the many historical photos throughout the building and the atmosphere is very charming.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text: My chips that came with my pulled chicken tacos were stale. Service was so slow and they weren't busy. This used to be one of my favorite places. The Sutler was out of Amarillo by morning. How do you run out of margaritas??? We had to ask for silverware and napkins after our food arrived. There was something stuck to the dirty menu too. I doubt I will return.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text:
It's difficult to put into words how cool it is to go to the Bluebird Cafe if you're a country music fan. The venue is so small and intimate, and realizing just how many amazing artists got their start here is unbelievable. 

Yes, it's difficult to get tickets. We didn't get tickets so we showed up an hour and a half early and got in without a problem. The first 8 in line get seats at the bar and then next 10-12 get church style pew seats. From what I gathered, there is no cover charge for these seats during the early show, just a $7/person food & drink minimum. 

Honestly I can't speak to the food because I didn't eat it, but no one goes for the food. 

Do yourself a favor and make the extra effort to get in here. It's worth the trouble.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: I'd give tootsie's 4.9. We watched the NBA game 7 while listening to a great band...can't complain. The drinks were small and heavy on the ice for the price. Service was good. Restroom service was on point...bring a tip!  The line moved and it was clean!! Different live bands on all 3 levels. Outside seating on the roof.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: This place was crazy!!! So incredibly busy. The drink menu consists of sweet alcoholic drinks. I left with a sweet belly after trying a few of their cocktails. Super fun country bar with a party atmosphere!!!!

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: Didn't actually get to go, but wanted to say that you need to get there extremely early for the Sunday night writers nights to have even a remote chance of getting in.  I called 2 1/2 hours before show time and was told they were already at max.  I'd guess you need to be there 4 hours early.  For the reservation shows, make sure you log on and buy the second you are able to, the Saturday night show sold out in less than 1/2 hour.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Finding myself in Nashville again and wanting to visit Tootsie's . This time I climbed all the stairs to get to rooftop. It had a beautiful view and a lot of legendaries musicians have performed here. Everyone should check this place out when in town. The collection of pictures hanging and signed by artists is something to view.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
Tootsie's is one of the most famous/popular bars on Broadway. 

Came at 6 pm on a Friday and it was pretty packed and full already.

Was at the top level, the bar was small. They have a big stage for live music. Luckily we arrived right when the band was going to start. Tips for request. 

Crowd was very energetic and sang to the music. Once the music starts, you are shoulder to shoulder with people. Very hard to move and gets really cramped. We found seats at the bar so it was not as bad.

Bartenders were good. Came around pretty fast. Drink prices were ok. Higher then normal but expected for such a popular spot.

Honky Tonk Mule - $10 - Decent mix drink, crappy whiskey though.
Jameson Ginger - $10 - Good, it was not drowned in the ginger ale.
Bud Light - $7

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Great spot! We visited on a Thursday night, probably a slow night for them, but a lot of people out & about. The bartender was quick, they had a great band playing!

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text: I love the painstaking effort to restore this historic space. But the love stops there. This is a new place so maybe they just haven't worked out the kinks. I ate breakfast at the counter and experienced painfully slow service. Coffee came, no sugar no spoon and it took forever for the server to find those things. The sweet potato pancakes were really good once I was able to get them to bring the special butter promised on the menu and then she had to go find some utensils. The utensils were at the hostess station, (not behind the counter?).  Overall the place felt disorganized, chaotic, and slow, and I was there at a time that wasn't crowded.   I also ate lunch there a few weeks prior and had a similar experience with service so slow a really began to think they had forgotten about me,  very average fried chicken, and undercooked green beans by classic southern standards.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: We had heard of the Famous Tootsie's in Nashville many times and it did not dissapoint. We ordered some beers and then listened to some great country music by up and coming artists. We stayed for an hour or two and just soaked up the ambience and nostalgia that is Tootsie's and you should too.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Yeah, I expect live music to be played here. I didn't really care for it. Plus it's crowded which I can't stand. Maybe that's a good thing for the bar because it keeps the place going. But hey if you like feeling as though you are stuck on people and loud live music then this is your place. My friends and I went to the next bar.

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text:
I was hesitant about eating here because of the history that's associated with the restaurant but as soon as I walked in, I noticed that they preserved the history and are willing to discuss the history.
I ate with a group of 9 and we were accommodated with a booth that was perfect for a birthday celebration. Our waiter was very attentive to our orders; drinks, apps and food and everything was correct.
I had the burger and it was delicious. We were kidding about the description because it sounded like a Big Mac but far exceeds that fast food. 
According to the table, the shrimp and grits were delicious. The pork tenderloin was fantastic. The deviled eggs were a surprise, bacon makes everything better.

name: Woolworth on Fifth
text:
In town visiting from NYC and heard about comedy and live music happening here. I heard it was a very nice establishment and that a nice selection of food could be ordered. 

Upon arrival, it appeared very nice. The show was held downstairs and I was shocked that the downstairs area was not as nice. The furniture did not match and I'm surprised that the couple sitting on the sofa didn't tip out, as it was leaning. 

The service at the bar was great. The band and comedian were awesome! 

I was bothered by the fact that they served my salmon with plastic ware instead of silverware. . That is just unacceptable to me...especially for a 4star restaurant. They get 3 stars for mediocracy. And, the salmon tasted microwaved. We need more pacific and Alaskan wild salmon at restaurants charging $20+. Farm, Atlantic salmon is not worth it.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
There is a reason why there is a line to get in!  Tootsie's won't disappoint.  We enjoyed music on all three levels, from the rooftop to the lower level.  Of course it was crowded, but the music was fantastic and the service was very efficient.  

This is a not to miss stop on Broadway!

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text:
This one is tough to rate. Depends on what type of night out your into. 

If you love jammed packed live music bars this is certainly the spot for you. 3 very narrow floors of live music , you will not hear anything but music. The energy here was jamming. 

If you are claustrophobic pick another place.

name: Tootsie's Orchid Lounge
text: Three stories of honky tonk!  Yee haw!  Tootsies was the only one of the Broadway bars I'd ever heard of before coming to Nashville and it lived up to the hype.  It's purple.  They play good country.  And they have a great rooftop patio to look out on all of the bachelorette parties lining Broadway.  It was crowded and touristy, but it was also exactly what I had in mind for my Nashville experience.

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text:
Wonderful experience here 

We were like the other 50 people who couldn't get reservation so we waited outside for over an hour. But - it was so worth it. There is no cover charge but each person has to spend $10 on food and drinks and that was easy. 
Music was great and the performers were so wonderful. This was a great intro to country music for me and I like it!!
Green fried tomatoes: first time trying and decent taste. After awhile I didn't care too much for the breading but the tomato was food. 4 stars. Wait a little before eating or you may burn your tongue. 
Nachos with queso blanco: decent - jalapeño spiced things up and the accompaniment of salsa and. Sour cream on the side was appreciated. Chips were so thin. 
Hubby tried the pineapple cider which had a great pineapple flavor- if you like pine apple you must try. 
I got the Tennessee Wit: white ale. Smooth and delicious.

name: The Sutler Saloon
text:
What a cool place!!! The vibe when you walk in is so cool! The lights are dim and the dining room is open. You can see the kitchen from your seat and the decor is very Nashville. The bar has great happy hour specials until 6:30, which is what we went for on my birthday. I got the watermelon margarita and it was refreshing and amazing, went down a little too easy, that could get dangerous! My husband got the moonshine and root beer, which was excellent!! I would definitely go back for happy hour again, great 1/2 price specials are totally worth it!!
While we were standing at the bar we were looking around to see what people were eating, it all looked amazing. We even ended up talking to the table behind us about what they were eating. Next time we go, I'm definitely getting food!!! 
I keep hearing about the downstairs bar and how awesome it is but unfortunately it was rented out for a private party when we were there. I was a little disappointed but I'll go back and hopefully then it will be open!

name: The Bluebird Cafe
text: The Bluebird Café has the best new music in town! I love going and hearing these singer/song writers perform in the round. There is something special about hearing a songwriter perform their music live. I've been three times and each time has been wonderful. Now the food is not that great....but hey, it's a music venue. I was there to hear the music.

name: The Stage on Broadway
text: DO NOT GO!! The bouncers and manager were extremely mean and aggressive. The bouncer ripped the plastic facing off my legal, government issued license on purpose and refused to repay me to get it replaced. When asked to speak to the manager he was equally unhelpful and aggressive and the two of them started yelling at us. The bouncer then grabbed the license from me and started ripping the plastic off even more. I finally left in tears. I now have to go home, wait at the DMV, and have them replace my LEGAL ID that was destroyed by this awful establishment. Do not go unless you have multiple forms of identification or a back up ID after they destroy yours.

name: The 5 Spot
text:
I guess it's been featured in the show Nashville (I'm afraid I don't watch it), and I now know Lady Gaga recently made a stop on her dive bar tour here (how cool is that?), but we were being brought here for neither of those reasons.  We were brought here because it's a solid spot to get up close and personal with local music, and knock back some local beers.  The folks performing when we were in were fun, and clearly had a following of dedicated fans that shouted out for their favorite songs, and took to the front of the floor to spin their partners round and round a time or two.  Since I had JUST said the music made me want to dance, I was a little bummed that none of my partners took the hint and took me for a whirl, but the dancing didn't last long, so I didn't stay wistful for long.  We did not peek outside to the patio, nor partake of the food truck, but I love that both of those things exist here.  Solid.
There seemed to be several other spots nearby to easily wander to as well, if you wanted to make a night out of one location.

name: Hard Rock Cafe
text: Food is consistently delicious. The wait time on 4th of July seemed to breeze by. Bathrooms were clean. Our server was new and that explained the lack luster service- ex: soda syrup ran out so we waited for a long time for him to go to the basement to change it he said.

name: Whiskey Bent Saloon
text: Been here 6 days and checked out all the bars, even the so called famous ones. At 50 yrs old that easy keeping up with these young folks, but Whiskey Bent is the Best, good atmosphere, talent on stage and of course the hardest working bartender in Nashville "Bri" she remembered mine and wife's drinks and she shovels out thousands of drinks while I was in town. That is dedication and a perfect smile to boot

name: Hard Rock Cafe
text:
I'm spending my summer in Nashville and wanted to take my parents somewhere that they enjoy for dinner... So Hard Rock, it is!  We really enjoyed the service here.  We wanted to sit outside, but that area wasn't staffed with a server at the moment. It wouldn't have been an issue for us to be seated inside, but the host spoke with the manager to see what he could do.  We ended up being able to sit outside and had a wonderful server.  Our drinks were great, and the food was timely.  A major pet peeve of mine is when the appetizer and entree come at the same time (Ugh!)... So glad we did NOT have this issue (food was great!).

The only downside, and reason for 4 stars, is the parking issue.  While there's little the Hard Rock can do about this (they are right in the middle of the busiest part of downtown Nashville), it was a bit annoying trying to find suitable parking that didn't cost an arm and a leg.  However, I do believe the restaurant offers valet to ease the stress of finding parking on your own.

name: The Valentine
text: The setup of the place was very good and encouraged a lot of movement. The chicken fingers were pretty good. My girlfriend ate the cheesesteak and it was ok. I went in the lull of the afternoon and I thought the service would have been a little better. It is not a bad place to sit and enjoy group company.

name: The Valentine
text:
Newer and clean. Great location downtown. Nash chicken sandwich was a great spicy chicken sandwich. Slaw was good also tasty. Burgers are 100% beef. 
Menu is very simple, one page with something for everyone. Staff super cool.
We also had excellent family friendly live entertainment from Tyler Baily & band.
Bathrooms were well kept.

name: Hard Rock Cafe
text: Ate here after a Titans game. Arrived 5 mins before close and the staff was happy to seat us. Food was really good for a chain restaurant.

name: The Judge's Vinegarroon
text: Maybe the best ribs in all of Nashville! I have yet to all the ribs in Nashville but they would totally be in the running.

name: The 5 Spot
text:
apologies in advance for the low rating, and i am so disappointed that i couldn't rate it higher, but as a nashville newbie i was really looking forward to checking out the great music-listening rooms.  this place in particular was recommended by a number of folks in the neighborhood, but i couldn't handle the smoky atmosphere.

attention nashville club owners:  get with the program!  communities across the country are going smokefree!  this incl:udes not only large cities but but even small towns who understand the health risks to customers and employees of exposure to second-hand smoke!    let's enter the 21st century, ok?

name: Hard Rock Cafe
text: The food was okay nothing that was so great but it is what you expect when it come to a Hard Rock Cafe,   The service is what I am commenting on here,  it was excellent!   Our server was very responsive and out going.  The restaurant was clean and cold and that is what matters the most after you have been baking in the sun at CMA Festival.  The only negative is that the prices seemed to be exceptionally high for this category of restaurant.

name: Sheraton Music City Hotel
text: This hotel is beautiful and the staff was amazing. Not to mention the beds are more  Comfortable than mine at home.

name: The Stage on Broadway
text:
Great decor.  Love the wall with all the old rock n' rollers!  Little bit of a younger crowd than I would expect for a Sunday night but drama free!  
Great music and plenty of space.   
The air is on full blast.  Loved that!  I'm one that never sits still for good music and love that I'm not more of a hot mess than I usually am

name: The Judge's Vinegarroon
text:
Really!!! 

I order an combo PLATE!!!! I asked for Brisket and Sausage. My plate gets delivered to me, I already been told it did not come with sides for 7.99. But really no BREAD!!!!

I am sorry!!! I have never been to a BBQ place anywhere that did not server bread on a plate. A matter of fact, i never been anywhere where PLATE did not mean 2 sides!!! The person i was with ordered cole slaw for 2.25. This is the smallest dish of slaw for 2.25 i ever seen. You would think there was gold leaf in this slaw at this price. 

I got my bill and i even got charged for water!!! Had to have that taken off.... 

The brisket and sausage good..... But not for 7.99 and no sides or bread!!!!

Guys i lived 3 times in Texas.... believe me they know what bread is.....

name: Whiskey Bent Saloon
text: We stood at the door for 30 minutes Saturday night. When we watched the bouncer take cash from 8 different guys and let them in before us we left.

name: Whiskey Bent Saloon
text: Cool place. I had allot of fun here while in Nashville.

name: The Judge's Vinegarroon
text: Not great. Kind of dirty. Over smoked meat. Brisket was not delicious. Ribs were ok. Not impressed. I think there is probably better.

name: The Stage on Broadway
text: I was in Nashville for the first time this week and The Stage had everything I was hoping for. Drinks. A good crowd (all ages). Great live music. The band was awesome and it wasn't just country music. I highly recommend The Stage!

name: Hard Rock Cafe
text: Service was very good. Hot chicken sandwich and southwest rolls were good. Came with a citrus slaw that was very good.

name: The Stage on Broadway
text: I think this place is a little over-rated. Yes.. its historic.. and yes.. all these famous people have played there.. but they're not there now. Not much to offer at this place. I gave it 3 stars because the bartender was nice and I liked the beer. Really.. nothing special here.

name: The Stage on Broadway
text: This is a great venue the band was GREAT. Dancing, drinking and fun. The A/C works good and the bathrooms are clean.

name: The Stage on Broadway
text:
Without a doubt my favorite honky tonk bar on Broadway! I have always had such great experiences at The Stage. The band has always been able to get the crowd fired up! I also love the multiple levels. The drinks have been pricey (average for Broadway), but have always been made pretty strong! 

I love The Stage and will be there every time I venture down to Broadway!

name: Sheraton Music City Hotel
text:
What. A. Dump. And super scary with balconies that run the length of the hotel so that anyone can walk by on the outside. On the direct flight path by the airport. Slow and cranky service. Out of everything, including soap. Hairballs on my bathroom ceiling. Everything in the room was disgusting and covered in stains. One of the people I was with was given a room with a murphy bed only. 

Not enough money in the world to stay there again. And for all that, I got a special rate of $240 a night.

name: The Stage on Broadway
text: The bands were fun and there were two stages. It was nice to have two options to listen to. The drinks were a bit over priced but it was still a nice place to spend a little while and visit a roof.

name: Whiskey Bent Saloon
text: Broadway is a must when in Nashville. The amount of bars with live music may be too much for some to navigate, so hopefully this will help you out. WB is a winner!

name: The 5 Spot
text:
Tuesday night, Live music, $2 beers, good vibes
Great bar

name: Bootleggers Inn
text: This place is great for a crowd looking for more classic country flavor. Less Sam Hunt, more Highwaymen, Conway, George Strait.  Personally I really enjoy that and if you do too you should stop by here. If you are looking to get wasted scream and black out, maybe head on up Broadway a little. This place is based on mountain made moonshine and the atmosphere and decor reflect that.  I plan to return whenever possible.

name: Whiskey Bent Saloon
text: 満席で立ち見客で溢れてた。音楽はロック。音楽はいいし、近くで観れるし最高。ビールは買えても食べ物を買うのは至難。

name: The Stage on Broadway
text: This bar was so much fun! This bar had two really good bands that played a wide range of music from pop, to country, and rock. The drinks were good as well. My friends met these guys from Canada at this bar who were such flirts and we found out later that they have girl friends back at home. Ladies don't trust some of the guys in this bar! Just dance the night away with your girls!

name: The 5 Spot
text: Came on a Saturday night. Glad we picked a night with an awesome DJ and lots of dancing!

name: The Bridge
text: I got the quesadillas and they were great. They had very fresh ingredients. My dad got the turkey sandwich and it was great also. Definitely would recommend this place again!

name: Whiskey Bent Saloon
text: The atmosphere at Whiskey Bent is great and the bands have always been fantastic each time I have been there. I especially love going when Amber is bar tending. She's got a wonderful personality and knows her drinks! Thanks for making the night that much more fun, Amber!!

name: The 5 Spot
text: I love a good dive bar with live music. However having a unfriendly bartender is the worst. Came here after dinner to see live music, paid cover, came to bar for drinks. Bigger guy with red hat and glasses was the rudest  dud of a bartender. Asked how his night was going, his response was what do you want. Ordered 4 drinks, including  a dos amber, brought me a dog fish where I responded is that for me. His response, well not anymore....ummm wtf smile and listen. Band was boring, crowd was not entertained. Moved onto next venue....keep trying.

name: Hard Rock Cafe
text: With so many great places on broadway why end up here. First they have drinks, delicious, yummy, in a cute cup drinks. Also it's open all the time, any day, like Christmas Day. Typically I stay home on Christmas Day but being on vacation this was the spot. The food is good, Mac and cheese never disappoints. The service was great and we had an overall great experience.

name: Whiskey Bent Saloon
text: Love going to this club! It's clean, open and friendly...No food here, but you can bring in your own. Bartenders are great and attentive. Our favorite local band is The Randy Nations Band. They play here most Tuesday (classic rock) and Thursday (classic country) nights. Highly recommend!!

name: The Stage on Broadway
text: This is one of my favorite bars on broadway, but tonight made it clear that this is a terrible place to go if you want to have fun. Security attempted to keep my dad from coming back into the bar after smoking a cigarette, even though he had drank only two beers at this bar. People were falling asleep on the stage and falling off of their stools, but apparently my dad, coherent and put together, was the biggest threat. He was calm and collected throughout the entire night, and to have him be treated like that as a REGULAR is insane. I will never recommend this bar to any of my customers again; tonight was absolutely absurd.

name: The Stage on Broadway
text:
Hung out here late on a Friday night and Sunday night (Jan 15th and Jan 17th). This place gets packed, packed, packed! We got lucky both times and snagged a table and chairs in the small upstairs area near the back. Otherwise, I think it would have been really unenjoyable. The dance floor is shoulder to shoulder standing room only in the evenings. 

Both times the live music was outstanding. They played a great mixture of cover songs, both country and pop. We had a great time listening and singing along, definitely a place not to miss when visiting Nashville! 

Be aware, they do not serve any wine at this bar! Beer & liquor only!

name: The Valentine
text: Security threw me out because I've been there for two hours hanging out and they took the chairs away at the bar and I complained!  They literally grabbed me and threw me out!  Not worth it! Don't go there.  Go somewhere else!  I will also be filing a police report.

name: Whiskey Bent Saloon
text: I can't say much about this place because we only happened to stop in when we walked by and heard my BF's favorite song playing. The bar on a Sunday afternoon was pretty empty, more of an older married crowd, but the guy playing music was good. We stopped in for 5 minutes and stood by the bar listening to music and the bartender didn't ask us if we wanted any drinks.

name: The Stage on Broadway
text:
Bourbon Street?  Is that where I ended up?  For surely Broadway in Nashville has much of the same vibe as the New Orleans iconic bar street with plenty of the same drunken patrons, loud mouthed yelling and bachelorette parties galore.

The Stage had come recommended to me by people who obviously like cover bands that play great songs in a mediocre way.  But the crowd doesn't seem to mind as they cheer, dance and drink their way to oblivion!

There is no cover charge (for most places that we went to along this stretch) and there is also no smoking allowed in this bar, both of which were a plus in my book.

As for the drinks, they pour a strong one and if you have a place at the bar, know that people will be putting their empties on it all night which makes for a lot of jostling for position.  Also be prepared to have people spill on you as it is crowded and often reminded me of frat parties back in my college days.

You may have to stand a bit in the line out front, but never fear . . .it moves fast and you will find yourself inside in no time at all.  The bands vary from night to night so you may get lucky and find yourself a decent one when you visit.  But even if it doesn't start out strong- they vary about every 3 hours so just pop into another place on the strip and come back a little later.

I love live music . . . .and of all the places on Broadway, this still is my favorite.  Just know that it's a party first, and a music venue second.

name: The Stage on Broadway
text:
They book some of the best up and coming local bands for all the patrons to enjoy. It gets very crowded when the bands are playing. Lots of funny people watching from the dancing drunk people to the groups of friends on a weekend get away where, "what happens in Nashville, stays in Nashville."  Their drink prices are pretty much the same as all the other Broadway music venues. The girls/guy behind the bar looked very busy with organized chaos but they got drinks served quickly and occasionally had a second to hit the floor and pick up the empties. The security is friendly unless you do something stupid to piss them off. I would not want to be on the end of their walk out as they are very big guys who have a business and vacationers to protect. 
BTW, If the line is long at the front door, take a little walk around back as there is a quieter entrance there. Love the Stage!!!

name: The Stage on Broadway
text: This place was tons of fun! My group went bar hopping on broadway on a Friday night and we stopped at the stage just to explore and to our surprise we were very pleased! This was the only bar on broadway that wasn't packed wall to wall with people. The live band was fantastic and the drinks were very affordable -- I'd definitely recommend it!

name: Hard Rock Cafe
text: Our experience here was not good.  Honestly, it was so bad our party joked that we felt like we were being "punked".  Most of us ordered Sweet Tea ... they were brought to the table in warm glasses containing warm tea and remnants of ice.  When I made note of it to our waitress she said, "Yeah, it's fresh."  - Okay.  I asked for a side of ice.  My husband ordered Ginger Ale... when he told the waitress it was flat (seriously, not a bubble in it) she told him, "Oh, it always is; everyone returns it." We really should have left then.  While the restaurant was not busy, our meals took forever.  I ordered the California Cobb Salad...the  pomegranate seeds were mush (probably previously frozen), the diced avocado was brown and mushy, and the lettuce looked like it was going bad.  - before the waitress had left the table, I gave her the dish back.  The manager came over and offered to get me another salad on the house.  I was honest with her - I didn't trust the produce after seeing what had come out of the kitchen.  Mine was the only dish that had to be sent back, but only two in our party finished their meals... the others were just blah.  The two that did finish had burgers ...and one of them chipped a tooth on a hard, bone-like object.  We knew he had bitten into something and put it on the side of his plate, but didn't know about the chip until after leaving the restaurant.  I had never been to a Hard Rock Cafe but was really looking forward to it ...never again.

name: The 5 Spot
text:
Great place for a fun night out!

It's located in East Nashville, far away from the craziness of Broadway downtown. I recommend coming for Motown Monday (starts at 10 pm basically every Monday of the year). Cover is $5, they play all the greatest hits, and there's ample space to dance the night away.

name: The 5 Spot
text: The older bearded bartender made fun of my stutter so myself and 10 people left. It's untasteful and rude.Maybe get a attitude check!

name: The Stage on Broadway
text: DOESN'T DESERVE A STAR!!! We complained about a cranberry/vodka served that tasted like straight juice. We were told bartender didn't have ice (which would have diluted the beverage to begin with...) We are from out of town and have never been to this location before this weekend. We went to the bar on a Friday night and had a blast... then on a Saturday night we had the complete opposite service. We have a complaint about a 2nd floor female bartender: we were 'served' a Cranberry/vodka with no ice because we were told she had no ice (although I personally ordered a Long Island Iced Tea with ice and was perfectly fine) In no way did we ask for a refund or another drink... we simply were bringing attention to the staff and bartender that she made a terrible drink. We came around 1:55 am on a Saturday, and asked for a vodka cranberry and she said she didn't have any ice. We asked when the club closed and she said, "She was done by 2:15, and everyone needs to be kicked out by 2:30." (When the club closes at 3 am according to online) You can tell she wanted to go home and was in a hurry to leave and get home. Another "assistant manager" stepped in and mocked us as we complained to the bartender to tell we didn't have alcohol in the beverage we were served. Not only were we treated poorly and charged for a drink we didn't receive properly... we have a poor representation of The Stage in Nashville as tourtist. As we left the "body-guards" treated us poorly and made us feel like we were in the wrong by saying, "As if she had any reason to do that to you..." they made us, as paying customers, feel like we were incompetent and lesser than. As a server in my home town, I would never treat a "guest" like this. We never ONCE asked for a refund, nor another drink we just asked the bartender why the drink only tasted like cranberry with no vodka. Multiple people tasted the drink (with no ice) and said it was purely cranberry juice and told us to ask about it, we were treated like absolute dirt. We have never been to this city, and never this bar... and we will never recommend this bar to anyone after this. We had people who don't even drink, taste the beverage, and tasted no alcohol. As a server and person who works in customer service, I would have taken the beverage and thrown it out-- and made a new one. I would have treated the guest better than we were treated. It's about the principle and treatment we received.

name: Hard Rock Cafe
text:
I dislike leaving bad reviews but this was such that I at least needed to have it stated. 
we went last night for a memorable trip for the girls unfortunately that was not the case. The good was we had a pretty decent server, Michelle. she even got us a great table. The reason why we needed a new table though...I'm a bigger girl its obvious you can see that so when you put me in a booth that's fine if the table moves but I couldn't even sit in the booth. so ok whatever we get moved to a table. Then it was a 40 min wait on our food. that's fine. my kids were complainy but they can learn patience for good food. but it wasnt that. we watched them place our food under the headlamps and stay for about 15 or so mins one of my daughters dishes the twisted mac and cheese came out cold. I know this because I took a pic at 8:06 and at 8:14 when I took a bite it was so cold, not even room temperature. which was disappointing. my friend who was with us ordered a burger medium well. theres a wood fire grill which is fine but it was so burnt. ya know that acidic burnt taste that you get. ya that. so badly she couldnt even eat half of it. It really put a damper on a once in a lifetime experience for my kiddos.

name: Bootleggers Inn
text: Good music and great Tennessee Moonshine.  Service is pretty good too.  Placed was packed on Sunday afternoon.

name: Sheraton Music City Hotel
text: Decided to eat at the hotel and listen to some live music. Ordered the burger asked for mayo and have been sitting waiting for it for over 30 min. now. Hope this $17 burger is worth it cold.

name: The Stage on Broadway
text:
This, like all the other nearby juke joints, is quite the scene. 

There's a bouncer at the door checking ID, ensuring that you are 21. Friday & Saturday nights are the most popular and it's wall to wall inside. ....just like walking on the street. 

Seems like the music is pop rock as all the 21 year old girls in the audience know the words and sing along with the band.

The norm is no cover,  and beets are about $5. Male sure you tip the band when they pass their Buckley around!

Always a fun time, and you might actually hear some good music.

name: Sheraton Music City Hotel
text:
Came to Nashville for New Years.... Very impromptu trip so our hotel was booked very last minute. We were pleasantly surprised with the hotel considering  the price we paid per night. Hotel look clean, well maintained and had great customer service. Front desk was very friendly and informed us of all the amenities we had. Room seemed clean
Until we saw our comforter.- MOLD! We went to the front desk and they said they've gotten complaints/ concerns before regarding the comforter. They said it's the feathers in between the comforter that make it look like mold. (I still feel unsure). Although they said that the "moldy" looking substance in the comforter is actually the feathers In between, they changed all the sheets in our bed. They had the head of housekeeping contact us to explain to us that it's the feathers not mold and then they had the front desk call us in the afternoon to let us know that they've further looked into the comforter to make sure it wasn't anything bad. Regardless of what this "substance" may be, the customer service  this hotel has is impeccable and not seen often. Even thought this hotel may not be very central, I highly recommend it just because of its customer service, friendliness and attention to detail!

Also- breakfast was good at the restaurant. And the bar at the lobby is great also.

name: The Stage on Broadway
text: This is one of my all time favourite places to go when on Broadway. The atmosphere is amazing with the live entertainment outstanding. It's a real mixed crowd of young and old and the vibe is top notch. Service is fast but mixed drinks are hit and miss.

name: Sheraton Music City Hotel
text:
Awful carpet that smelled up the entire entrance. This hotel would not be on my list to stay at again when I visit Nashville. From the outside it's quite large and appealing from the sheer size.  The parking lot get's quite filled up easily so parking can be an issue.  When you walk in the main entrance it's very dated.  Old world style decor.  I did happen to see some signs saying pardon our dust why we renovate so maybe they are revamping the whole hotel.  They need to.
