It's insulting and unprofessional to ask for tips, especially at the beginning of the evening, when the service hasn't been completed. The valets are the first people we encounter at City Winery, so to start the evening with a lecture about the importance of tipping is off putting to say the least. I've always tipped, so it's just weird to start the night with such an accusatory speech.

At a show this month, I again got the terrible, off-putting tipping speech.Tips (which I have always, always given) are optional based on service - they shouldn't be requested at the beginning of the evening. 

Lastly, what is wrong with the plumbing at this place? Two out of the last three times I've been there, the women's restroom was closed because of plumbing issues. Get it together, City Winery.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Really enjoyed Loveless Cafe. I ordered smoked turkey, mashed potatoes and corn and all of it was excellent. We received our food in record time and was in and out in thirty minutes or less. The famous biscuits lived up to the hype with strawberry, blackberry and peach jam. 

This is a must restaurant if you like southern home cooking and a neat atmosphere. I would highly recommend and look forward to returning soon.

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
I can't say enough about this place. We came here for New Years Eve and saw Marty Stuart. We had a table in the VIP balcony area. Upon checking in we were immediately escorted to our table and then greeted by our waiter. We were seated at one of the bar top tables, which are not nearest the railing. Our view was slightly obstructed and when I mentioned it to our waiter, Patrick, he moved us to a closer table and our view was fantastic. 

We ordered the cheese plate appetizer, a bottle of champagne. I had the trout and my girl a steak; everything was delicious. The show was phenomenal and the crowd respectful. 

Overall, the whole experience was tops and was the highlight of our trip.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Prepare to wait a long time for southern food. This place is always crowded. Yes, the jams are tasty. The chicken tenders are huge. The mac n cheese is pretty creamy. The green beans are a bit too spicy for my taste but still flavorful. The prices are a tad steep but I expected that since it's such a popular tourist attraction. I recommend ordering takeout to avoid the crowds, but your food is probably going to be cold.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: The food wasn't that great.  Beer was good.  We had higher expectations for a flavorful meal.  It's a really nice restaurant though which should do well in this very touristy area.  Two beers, two meals, tax and tip about $72.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: So fun and delicious!! Staff is so friendly!! Highly recommend the Chicken friend steak and chicken and waffles!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Great selection of German beers. Love the atmosphere. Not many options for those who only eat fish.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Sooo good! Worth the drive if staying in Nashville! Great staff and fantastic breakfast.  Plus some fun shops right there when you are done eating.

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
I really wanted to love this place.Unfortunately, it missed the great mark for me.

Let me start with the pros...
Beautiful ambiance, happy hour specials, great event venue, solid menu
The restaurant itself is gorgeous. There is an upstairs event space, a spacious bar area and a great stage set up. A group of 6 of us ordered dinner while watching the Marc Cohn show last week. 

Dinner: Everyone enjoyed the food. The service was less than impressive though. The server seemed to be overwhelmed by the tables he had. It took forever for him to take orders for cocktails. Then an even longer forever to come back with cocktails. Then add on some more forever to take out orders.

Nothing ruins a beautiful dining experience like subpar service. You can correct an underwhelming dish, but underwhelming service can ruin an experience for me. Having been a server/bartender for a number of years I am both very critical (internally) but also forgiving (externally) when it comes to service. I am never rude, even if the service is subpar. That being said, it is an absolute pet peeve of mine when a server cannot keep up with who ordered what at a table of 6. In an establishment as nice as City Winery that just should not be the case. It is a complete moodkiller for the server to have people at the table check off what they had on a printed out receipt. It is even more annoying when the server encourages the table to split the check evenly because "it's easier that way". Unless there is a policy against separate checks that is indicated to a party at the outset, it is the server's responsibility to separate checks. It is a pain in the a** to do so, but that is what is expected. 

Ultimately we ended up splitting it evenly because after the 2nd return everyone was irritated. I will note that the show was over completely before we even got to the even split of the checks, though everyone was done eating before that. All and all, I would go back again and hope that this experience was an aberration from the norm.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: The place to go when you come to Nashville! Great country ham, biscuits, homemade preserves, and all things Nashville. Wonderful gift shop.  Friendly people and good outdoor spots to wait for a table where you can sit around a picnic table and talk with friends and family just like you would on a front porch, and they have one of those too! Wonderful!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: So glad I stopped here. Good food and excellent beer. I sat at the bar and the service was great.

name: Big Shotz
text: Two dollar beers, bartenders are friendly. If this bar was in Dallas it would be packed every day and more likely in Deep Ellum. I really liked this bar I would definitely go here againg.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Pace yourselves. Is all I have to say! I overdid it! The biscuits are so good. Ridiculous good. So good you could eat them plain, but why would you when there are the best jams ever on the plate? The peach jam is like eating the best peach cobbler on a biscuit. The blackberry still has pieces of the blackberries intact?? How do they do that?? The strawberry is good, but not as noteworthy as the other two. Oh, and they will bring more biscuits, but cut them off after two plates! 

I prefer the turnip greens at Arnold's, but hey to each is own! They were really the only thing I wasn't over the moon about! The sweet tea is perfectly sweetened. Not too sweet, not too bitter, just right! I had fried chicken and it was sublime! Would definitely order it again. The string bean casserole was a little taste of thanksgiving in may...score! 

I also had the chicken and bacon soup chowder which was delicious. Not salty at all, perfectly seasoned! My friend and I both had pie, the strawberry rhubarb and steeplechase ( derby style pie) and they were perfect slices, not too big and not too small, definitely too small to share, but perfect when you already regretted ordering it!! Delicious both of them!

Well worth the wait, and theres plenty to shop before you eat! Oh and ask for Virginia! She's the best waitress!!!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text:
Enjoyed the food, beers and atmosphere.  Felt like we were back in Munich.  Maddie was an awesome bartender!
Prost

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
My friends love this place and said its a highlight of their city. I thought it was just okay. 

The property is pretty cool. An old inn converted to a restaurant and shops (too bad the shops were closed by the time we got there). The interior is country kitchen. It was cute but nothing spectacular. 

We started with the complimentary biscuits and preserves. These were marvelous. Probably the highlight of the meal. 

I ordered the fried chicken with creamed corn and mac and cheese. The mac was okay. The chicken skin was good, but the meat itself was a little dry. I was disappointed. The creamed corn was amazing! I would eat a ton of that. 

The service was good. All in all, it was okay but I wouldn't say it was one of the best parts of my Nashville experience.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
My 1st time in Nashville & this cafe was highly recommended by my stepdaughter. It was very hot that day & the cafe had a wait of 1 hour & 15mins at 2:00 pm. Wish they had a waiting room for the overflowing tourists & locals willing to wait almost 2 hrs to dine. Thus the 4 star.
They're known for their biscuits.I agree. It was very moist & savory.Choice of their 3 exclusive brand, BlackBerry,Strawberry  & Peach. Peach was my personal choice.
My husband & I split the three meat + 2 sides. Fried chicken (1 thigh) Fried Catfish & pulled BBQ pork. Quite small portions for $17.99. Sides were cream corn pickled cucumber/onions,both were okey. 
The staff however has the Southern hospitality. Great waitstaff. 
The dining area is bright, clean,& well decorated with a local artist's paintings which are funny & beautiful.
I will go back to Loveless & try other dishes.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Ate breakfast this morning at the Loveless Cafe with my fiancee.  Thursday morning, 7:30am, so no wait for a table.  Our server, Bruce, brought us two biscuits.  Not sure what all the hype is about, they didn't taste like anything special.  Also, my fiancee was miffed because she wanted to order a Bloody Mary, but Bruce said it was before 8am, so she couldn't get one yet.

So things didn't start off well, but they soon improved once our food arrived at the table.  I had ordered the Pit-Cooked Pork Barbeque & Eggs (One to the Left and One to the Right), and my fiancee had ordered the Fried Chicken & Waffle.  Our meals were good, I had a hard time finishing the generous portion of pork on my plate.  Wasn't really crazy about the red BBQ sauce on top, but it was OK.  Hash brown casserole was tasty, I liked it.  My fiancee liked her Chicken & Waffle quite a bit, the waffle itself was very good, delicious.  

And Bruce had brought us out more hot biscuits and a Bloody Mary in a mason jar for my fiancee.  Overall, a good experience this morning at the Loveless Cafe, we would like to come back again, but it is about 85 miles away from where we live, so I imagine that won't be happening anytime soon.  I recommend giving them a go if you are in Nashville.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: if i just ate the schnitzel and drink the beer it would be a 5 for sure. the sausages are good but everything else i have tried isn't 5 star stuff.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: We stopped in while visiting Nashville and  were impressed with the Bavarian Bierhaus from the moment we walked in. The ambiance immediately makes you feel like you're in Munich. They young lady who greeted us was warm and friendly. The bartender, Shawn, was our server. He was thoroughly knowledge about the impressive German beer selection, as well as the German food that is available. We had several questions about both, and he seemed more than happy to thoroughly answer each of them. The beers were terrific and each of us LOVED our meals, which were authenticity prepared and delicious. Nashville has a lot to offer with regard to restaurants and bars, but next time we visit we'll most certainly come back to the Bavarian Bierhaus.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Thursday night at 7...no wait!  Triple choice with chicken, meatloaf and catfish was outstanding.  Cream corn and green beans were excellent sides.  Endless biscuits with various jams are always amazing.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Been here multiple times and I have loved my trip EVERY SINGLE TIME!  They have the best biscuits on the entire planet; warm, flakey, buttery, melts in your mouth and with the choice of three of their home made jams! (Peach, Blackberry, and Strawberry) The food speaks for itself and is absolutely delicious. I would suggest the Southern Sampler because you can try some of their best meals all in one in decent sized portions. They also have gift shops that you can explore while you wait, that sell some of their special ingredients to little fun knick knacks! Highly recommend trying this timeless, classic out!

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
WOW. I mean the reviews are clear...it is definitely a tourist trap..however, well worth the wait. We arrived and waited 45 minutes for a table, they have little shops and such to visit while you wait. Biscuits biscuits and more biscuits - their peach marmalade was amazing! Their sampler platter was the best - however I had hoped for more of each meat and less biscuits...but alas..5 biscuits later...darn good food! 

And of course...couldn't leave without dessert...their steeplechase pie and banana pudding...amazing! 

Great value - prices are very reasonable.

Location is so/so - not much in the area, but the Checkwood Botanical gardens are nice.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
No love for the Loveless Cafe. We waited about an hour to be seated for dinner and after eating there, I figured this had to be a tourist trappy type of place. The drive to the cafe was beautiful as we passed by large homes with acres of property. During our wait, we were given a buzzer that would work at their different gift shops. My winning find was the piggy popcorn cooked in bacon grease with bacon bits at the Hams & Jams Country Market. I will definitely order that online. 

All of the workers were super friendly. Their specialty fried chicken was bland and dry. The fried catfish and fried green tomatoes had the same batter and were both bland. Yes, even the biscuits were kinda bland. Maybe that's just the way it's supposed to be so you can smother gravy on everything. I honestly enjoyed the food at Cracker Barrel better... and that's not meant to be an insult.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
I thoroughly enjoyed the Loveless Cafe except for two small things: the distance from downtown (thank God for Uber!), and...don't kill me, but...I didn't think the biscuits lived up to the hype. Maybe it was just an off night. 

Everything else, however, was great! I had the fried chicken with a side of green beans and mashed potatoes. Even the smaller portion of the chicken was more than enough. The alcohol was a little expensive, but my cocktail was good. We went on a weeknight and were able to make a 7:45pm reservation the day of with no problem.  It's very cute inside, and the service was quick. I'd return if I go to Nashville again.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Really fun atmosphere to walk into, very loud and fun. Staff was very nice and welcoming, the waiter helped my husband pick out a delicious beer also. I only really had one complaint, it was our first time coming here and the waiter offered us some apple sauce for our baby. We thought it was just a polite gesture, but we were charged 3$ for this apple sauce. Had I known it was a "side item" I wouldn't have gotten it. Our baby is 8 months old and only ate like 5 bites off of it. Either way we told him we didn't mind paying for it but I wish I had known before hand we would be charged 3$ for something I thought was just complementary. I got the Oktoberfest chicken which was pretty tasty, I didn't like the red cabbage that came with it but that's just my opinion. My husband loved the red cabbage. He got the Rouland and he said it was delicious. We ended it with the apple strudel dessert. OMG so delicious. I will probably get that dessert everytime I go back. It was a pretty pricey place but it wasn't bad for an occasional visit. We enjoyed it overall.

name: Rocketown
text:
I attend the Taste of Nashville event here. It was a little of an annoyance to try & find a parking place. We parked in a pay lot. The event space is large area that has a stage at one end. At the Taste of Nashville, they had tables set up on the sides of the event space and also in the center. This allows for people to be able to walk around the space and partake from the different venders. 

The space is large, but I think Taste of Nashville overshot the space size, because to get through the event you had below & bump into people. The bathrooms at Rocketown are located under a catwalk that extends along a part of the building. The bathrooms were large enough to accommodate people in the large group without have to wait in line. I say that about the men's restroom, I think the woman had to form a line.

Overall I had no issues with Rocketown, other than I'd like them to have a little more parking. The space is pretty bare, allowing you to decorate how you'd like. At Taste of Nashville they had colorful paper lanterns hanging around. The event space is great if you're looking for a place with a stage. I have to say that I like City Winery & The Bell Tower better as an event space, Bell Tower being the front runner. Both are also in the same area as Rocketown.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
I love, love, love the Loveless Cafe! I highly recommend their biscuits and gravy (their the best I've ever had)! Their scrambled eggs with cheese, hashbrowns (they have cheese in them, too), and fruit preserves are great, too! 

The atmosphere is so cute and country with their checkered print table clothes and farm-y feel. I also loved the shops that are located on their grounds which is a great way to kill time (as the wait is 1-3 hours). If you're on the go and don't have time to wait, I recommend getting it to go and dining on the benches in front of the cafe. I'll be sure to go back!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Great food, super friendly service...biscuits, chicken, bbq, country fried steak were all ordered in our group.  All very happy & full!

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
Such a cool music venue! I have not had their wine or their food, but I am happy City Winery brought this unique music venue to Nashville. From what I observed, the table service was very professional and nice. 

Only concern: the venue is not in a location with a lot of street parking close by...or in an area I would feel comfortable parking in. We were pretty much required to use valet for $7.

name: City Winery Nashville
text: What great venue for eating, drinking, and listening to your favorite music groups.  Last night we saw New Riders of the Purple Saga and they blew us away.  A trip down memory lane when I hung around San Fran in the early 70s.  Jam band elite, although the founding members are dead all but one they still got it.  They were working their way toward Chicago for the Greatful Dead 50th and last show over the 4th of July weekend.  We started with a Scottish Devil egg, Cobb salad split, peach n Beacon flatbread with a very young Vinhe Vino wine.  All in all. A great evening!  We will back!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: So worth the wait (1.25 hours). Everything was GREAT!  Fried chicken, mac n cheese, creamed corn and greens. The biscuits are deserving of all the rave reviews! Everyone else in our party of 7 got something different and everyone left happy and full!

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Great music venue!  I was lucky enough to catch Lucinda Williams there and it was fantastic.  The food was great, too.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Great food. Very fun atmosphere. Great staff. If you like good, authentic German food, I would highly recommend.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Loveless is a must stop! The bbq is amazing as is the fried chicken! Normally there is a crazy long wait but it's worth it! I got a sampler this past trip with catfish also but didn't care for it as much. The mashed potatoes are yummy but skip the turnip greens. They're known for their biscuits but I'm not in love with them. I guess I'm spoiled to Cracker Barrels biscuits and turnip greens. I'd say you definitely need to get the chicken or bbq!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text:
This is my first 5 Star rating!!
The food was amazing. The server (Shalimar) was wonderful! The manager sat down and talked to us! It was a great time!
The only negative is------ I live 1600 miles away

name: Loveless Cafe
text: We live nearby and frequent this place for breakfast. My father law tried to order toast with his meal and I almost smacked him. If you go to Loveless, you get the biscuits!

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
I visited City Winery on a Saturday afternoon as part of a series of events for a bachelorette party.  We were a party of 6 ladies and I can speak for all of us when I say the overall experience was wonderful.

Once greeted we were seated at a booth in the dining room right off to the left when you walk in.  The service was top notch throughout our visit. Our server even smiled when we asked him to take a few pictures.  

Drinks - I had one of their wine flights which was a mix of white and red wines.  Their flights are $20 which includes tax.  One of the other ladies had a bloody mary.  I love bloody Mary's so of course I tasted hers.  They use Zing Zang as their mix which, in my opinion, is one of the best mixes around.  They also have a small variety of beers. 

Food - The table ordered a few appetizers to share.  Everything was delicious and very flavorful. The brussel sprouts with goat cheese are a must. 

City Winery is a great place for a nice date night or a special occasion.  If I lived in the area I would definitely be back.

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Good food, although the menu items (including both drinks and entrees) are more expensive at the restaurant than those listed on their website. Service was okay, although waiter seemed a bit sensitive.

name: City Winery Nashville
text: I was super excited to come here, after hearing great things, but it didn't wow me as much as I hoped it would. The food was good, the wine was delicious (as to be expected) but it was lacking the atmosphere I was hoping for. If you're really into wine though, this would be a great place for you to visit!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Thank you. Your servers and chefs say that their is animal product in them. What do you use to make your stock? They warned me when I ordered and also double checked with whoever prepares the food.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text:
I have since tried this place 4 other times.
Each time ordering something different.
 All in all, the food is good, with the exception of the spaetzle.

After commenting about this place, a couple of friends wanted to try it.

They have also lived in Germany, so expectations were high.
I did not let them know about previous reviews, so as to not give a possible negative bias towards anything.

Each time, the negative comment was on the spaetzle.
Usually with the same comment....... it was like paste.

We did go one day for lunch (a Tuesday?) and a band was playing.
I will say it was playing MUCH to loud for the space.
4 adults could not carry on a conversation due to the volume.
Now we may of felt different if we were there to fest, but it was a working lunch and just had to fight to be heard.

I do like going here, but that may be due to my love of German food.
Is it the best? No, but is it good? YES.

Will I continue to eat here? Yes, just not on days with the band due to the volume level.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: By far THE best bbq spot in all of Nashville! It's a bit on the outskirts of the city but let me tell you, it's worth the drive just for the biscuits alone. They said our wait was going to be 40 minutes but our buzzer rang after 15 minutes. The meat was smoked to perfection, and the sweet potatoes had just enough cinnamon and butter. They make their own jams to go with the biscuits; and did I forget to mention they serve them before your meal? The banana pudding is house made to perfection too. Food came super fast, and service was great. Everyone was super friendly; the hospitality lives here!

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
This place is fantastic, albeit a distance from downtown Nashville. Still, well worth the drive out to enjoy the scenery and the restaurant/shops. 

If there's one thing that stood out for me the most, it was their hospitality. I work in the industry and appreciated receiving the sincere friendliness and attention to our visit. 

The biscuits were ready for us as soon as we arrived and our order was received quickly. The food comes in large, hearty portions. But wow! Everything tasted amazingly. Definitely recommend the Country Fried Steak or the Chicken & Waffles. 

Make sure to take time and visit the nearby shops that were formally the rooms at the Loveless Motel. You'll find great stuff there with their logos - especially kitchen decor and items. 

I already look forward to my next visit to the Loveless Cafe.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: We went here for Easter, it was fabulous...I am not a biscuit lover, but, these I couldn't stop eating w their homemade jams...all the dishes we got were worth the wait, and they have alcohol !!

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
A lot of folks drive out for the fried chicken.  Had the Fried Chicken, Hashbrown Casserole, biscuits & jam.  But oh my country crickets! I had one bite of the home made Cream of Corn and wanted to order a gallon of it! It's called Loveless but there is nothing but love for this cafe.  When I walked in the restaurant that looks like a white country home. The walls are covered with celebrity headshots. Leann Rimes and my boy Bucky Covington and of course Elvis! Tons of celebrities.
     There's other shops surrounding the restaurant and you can order some pulled pork sandwiches to go. There's a bbq smoke house too which is cool.  The chicken was good. I didn't have a chicken that people talk about. I need to try more items which is fine. I can't wait to go back for the corn. The biscuits are smaller but they have good soft texture with the jam.  The hashbrown casserole was ok.  I'll pass next time and try another side dish.  Loveless won me over with the corn and a photo of Bucky.  All kinds of people have made the nice drive out to the country side to dine here.  It is worth it. Just becareful at night.  Some country roads don't have lights.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: One of our favorite place to eat whenever we visit Nashville. Hot biscuits, great choice of sides, and excellent variety of main courses. Something for everyone. We appreciate the full bar. Our waiter was excellent and on point for our large group.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Amazing. I wish that I lived closer to the loveless cafe- I would be trying the entire menu! I ordered the country fried steak with Mac and cheese and hash brown casserole. The steak was huge, great flavor and the sides were great.  The biscuits and jam were to die for!!  The service was top notch and I felt like I was at home.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: One of my favorite places in Nashville. Good food. Great atmosphere. Everyone wears authentic German attire. Large variety of brats and sausages.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Drove an hour to this place, than waited over an hour to eat.... And the food was sub par. My bacon was like rubber. Save yourself the time and go to a chain restaurant for the same food. Not worth it.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Nasty!!!   Food was horrible, did not taste like schnitzel.   Save lots of money and go somewhere else.   They need to emphasize on quality of food instead of the lil German outfits!!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text:
Being generous with 2 stars.  Food is OK, service is laughable.  
 I've been to Germany and the slaw and potato salad are pretty authentic to what we got over there.  Sausages are all made by a firm in Wisconsin (they're good), don't expect to get anything actually made on site.  

Now for the service....Seated at 6pm on a Sunday.  Maybe a third of tables occupied.  Probably 10 minutes for a server to come by.  Another 10 minutes for beers to be delivered.  Still very few people in the place. Had to turn away 2 different sets of food that were sent to our table rather than the proper table.  Once our food finally arrived, had no silverware.   So between the person that seated us, our waiter taking our order then delivering drinks and the person who brought our food, nobody checked the utensil stein on the table to see if we had silverware.  I went and scrapped up some knives/forks from another table.  FINALLY a member of the wait staff came over when they noticed we had 2 of the cutlery steins on our table to see if they could take one of them to use at another table.  It was comical.  

We had previously been here for their family style Christmas dinner and it was good.  Food was all tasty and service was decent.

Overall, it's pricey for what you get both food and service wise.

Won't be going back.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: This place is a must!  The biscuits are the best I have ever had!  My daughter agreed and she is picky!  I got chicken and waffles, she got pancakes...delicious!!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: It's ok if you want traditional southern cooking. It's made its way on to internet lists so I think its become a tourist thing with long waits. I don't get what the big deal about the biscuits is. Its always just be ok when I have been. Don't be fooled by the BBQ you can see outside, they don't know what they are doing with that.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: We had to wait for awhile and it was worth every bit. Food was delicious and plenty of it. Worth the trip here. Thanks for the good meal.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: After the 1 1/2 hour wait, it won't be shorter even if you are only a party of 2, I can say it was worth the wait! Our waitress was super down southern sweet and the food did not disappoint. My hubby had the southern sampler choices were fried catfish, ham ( yes, it's salty but he likes that) and the fried chicken. Yum to all. Sides we shared were creamed corn ( to die for), fried green tomatoes (liked), caramel sweet potatoes (Yumo!!) and hash brown potatoes casserole. Tastes like the one I make so nothing special but it was good. Our food came out super fast but then it slowed waaaaay down on closing out our bill. Good place for southern comfort food!

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Hands down best food in Nashville! I would rev comment this to anybody. A little higher price point, but the experience and quality food it so worth it!!!

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
I went to City Winery for the first time last night and it was a good time. Parking, as others have noted, is a mess. Uber/Lyft if you can. 

We went to a concert, and it was great. The artist (Ben Sollee) was fantastic as expected, and the venue offered an intimate feel and decent acoustics. (It is no Ryman, but I thought the sound was full and robust). Since the concert was not sold out we ended up with a table to ourselves, but you will usually be sitting directly across or next to strangers. You get to pick your seats when you book so you will know what you are walking into. 

The doors open about 2 hours before the show to allow for dinner service, but you can order food and drinks throughout the show, so don't feel like you must get there early. The staff did a great job of being incognito throughout the show. Our server was responsible for several tables, and he managed it well. I would expect they increase staffing if the tables are full. If not, service would have been terrible, this way, it was as attentive as you would hope for during a show. 

I had a glass of wine - Malbec - it was good. Nothing I can't live without. The food was ok. We got the Frites, Hummus, and Margarita Flatbread. Of the 3, the flatbread was the best. The others were non-impactful. Not bad, not particularly good. The prices are pretty high for what you get. For the above mentioned items and a coke it set us back nearly $60 (including the tip)

The chairs are not comfortable. I wished I was an old lady at a football game that brings along her seat cushion.

The concept is cool, the ambiance is great, the wine is pretty good, and the service was decent. I would attend concert here again. Next time I will eat prior to getting there and have a glass of wine at the show.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text:
Stumbled upon this place after hitting up Yelp for a new place to try... I was I M P R E S S E D!

Entering into the restaurant, it felt as if I was entering into a beer hall in Munich. The atmosphere was so open and inviting. The menu features traditional German dishes. I tried the Schweinebraten, which is a pork roast. The meat was savory and the bier gravy was heavenly. The red cabbage reminded my wife of the recipe that her Oma used to make, it was amazing!

If you are looking for a truly German experience stateside-- or just comfort food, Nashville has it here! 

Oh, and beer??? Yeah... they got that too! :)

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Maybe German food just isn't my thing, but I just didn't like any of it here. Was with a large group attending a conference nearby. Buffet had brats and kraut and pork schnitzel plus sides. It was all bland and over cooked. Ambiance and wait staff were awesome and there's fun little German market with lots of goodies near the entrance, worthy of a two vs one star despite the food.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Fried green tomatoes are excellent.  
Pork is really, really good, as are the biscuits.  Catfish is pretty good.  
Chicken was a bit dry.  
Waitress was friendly and accommodating.  
Overall positive experience.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Biscuits. You sit down and get biscuits. And once those biscuits are gone, you get more biscuits. How many biscuits consumed in one sitting could be considered obscene? I didn't care. Those biscuits were damn good. 

I kind of want to stop it there, but the rest was so good too, so I'll tell you about it. When I drove up, I just knew it would be good. There was a wait, but it went fast and when it was over, I was sitting at a table, with a plate of biscuits, strawberry, apricot, and blackberry preserves. Having eaten 2 of the biscuits before I had even started looking at the menu, I decided that an egg white omelet was in order, you know, just for balance. Of course, to throw it off again, I ordered a side of bacon. The omelet was superb and the bacon, thick and crispy. And at Loveless, an order is 5 slices. FIVE. And of course, there were more biscuits.

My waitress was awesome and friendly, as was everyone I encountered there. The atmosphere was nice and homey, with some groovy art on the walls. The memorial to the biscuit lady was my favorite. And they have a good, roomy handicapped stall in the bathroom. I like to mention this when it's true.

Go to Loveless. You will like it. I liked it. And now I'm really, really sad that I don't live anywhere near it. Although my weigh watchers points are OK with that part.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: We were really looking forward to eating at the Loveless Café after reading all of the website and history of the food and heritage of the café. We thought we were going to eat such good food. Unfortunately, we did not. The food was just average. the biscuits were under cooked and not individually cut - but cut in one large square pan. The flavor of the biscuits were just average. The fried chicken was over cooked and dull in flavor. The blackberry preserves had no flavor at all. The pancakes were very dry and hard on the exteriors. Even though we knew it would be crazy busy, we were not willing to wait the 2 hour delay for breakfast, so we ordered it to go and ate I outside on a picnic bench. About 50 percent of the customers did this. To us, it was not worth it. We will not go back. I did buy a coffee mug in the gift shop. To be honest, this is nothing more than a tourist trap. Maybe when it was owned by just a couple who put genuine effort into the food, it was great. But now that a few high powered business owners have it, it seems to be just a marketing ploy to make "them" a lot of money at the expense of the customers and employees. Sad

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Loveless Cafe is the perfect place to go for a traditional southern meal and a nice walk around the grounds. I had fried chicken with eggs. My girlfriend had the breakfast bowl. Excellent meal with super friendly service. And the biscuits are delicious. The gift shop and apparel shop are also very fun to check out. Loveless is a great spot to walk around and check out some cool trinkets after a delicious meal.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text:
Stopped in here for dinner with the family after a night of shopping. We are part-German, so we were excited to try the cuisine of our ancestors. This restaurant was all German including the long tables, and the attire the servers wore. All of the workers were friendly and helpful with the menu, which was partly in German.

Food was pretty decent. I had the schnitzel, which turned out to be huge, however, I was disappointed that it tasted like chicken parm. I love chicken parm, but I was hoping pork schnitzel would have a different taste! My brother & parents all tried different wursts's. They all had leftovers because the plates were filling especially with the yummy sides! 

This meal was a good change from some of the Southern food we had been eating the past week. I would definitely recommend it if looking for a change of taste.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: I'm not a biscuit lover. I think they're usually too dry and crumbly, and I'd prefer a croissant or dinner roll any day. But I figured I might as well try again because this place was so highly regarded, and I was blown away. I was presented with delightful biscuits, the most delicious preserves (blackberry was my favorite), perfectly soft scrambled eggs, a giant heaping of barbecue pork, and the cheesiest, creamiest hash brown casserole. It's easy to make mediocre breakfast food; it's rare to find a place that does so many things so well.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: My family enjoyed breakfast. We arrived early, 8:30am, and did not have to wait to be seated. We ordered a family breakfast. It was all you could eat, homemade biscuits, jam, scrambled eggs, gravy, sausage, bacon, and fresh fruit. The service was wonderful. The food was incredible. Totally worth the drive and would definitely return!

name: City Winery Nashville
text: This is a great venue for a concert but the food leaves a lot to be desired.   I've been there a few times, and the risotto balls are good but everything else I've tried is unimpressive and expensive.   I'll definitely come back for a concert but I will dine elsewhere beforehand.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
I understand why this place is an institution.  The ambiance screams southern cooking and in my opinion Southern Cooking is the best cooking.

I want to love this place because it has so many elements to love it, but the food in general is BLAH.  

My friend and I ordered the "legendary" fried chicken and a country fried steak to split.  We had a slew of side dishes to try and the only thing we both agreed on was the creamed corn was amazing.  

The chicken was no better than what I could buy pre made at a Publix and the white gravy for the Country fried steak had no flavor.  The mac and cheese was basic and the hash browns were OK.   Other than the creamed corn, my side salad was the best thing I had.  

The pie was average at best

Prices are great, service was phenomenal,  and the overall feel of this place is sooooo cool.  Like I said, I want to love it, but the food has to get better.

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
Edited: we got ahold of the manager and he was amazing! They made an effort to still give us the wine tour, which was the best tour that I have ever been on. Evan was so knowledgeable and fun. We learned so much. The wine was the best and most beautiful wine I've ever had and the food was delicious.  I was thoroughly impressed with the service last night along with everything else. 

They beyond redeemed themselves, and I would gladly go back to this place and recommend it to everyone I know!! 

I, for one, will definitely be going back!! Thank you so much to everyone at city winery last night. You made it a great night for us all! 



Old no longer relevant review:

If I could give this place 0 stars for service I would. 

My mother and aunt are coming into town to visit me and city winery has always been on our list of places to go in Nashville. 

A month ago we made reservations for dinner here, but they called and said they rented the whole place out and needed to cancel our reservations. Totally understandable. So we rescheduled and made a winery tour the next day. Well they just called and cancelled that for the exact same reason. 

Two cancellations was already a let down, but beyond that, the staff was incredibly rude and condescending on the phone, which makes me not even want to go to this place at all. They are not trying to accommodate us for their doings at all (and haven't reimbursed us for the cancelled tour) If you are going to cancel multiple reservations for paying customers then you need to have public and private times separate and only allow for reservations at those times. This is getting ridiculous. 


We're supposed to go to a concert there that night, but will they cancel that too?

name: City Winery Nashville
text: There are not enough words to describe how amazing this place is. Brunch was outstanding. The service was great. And the food is delicious. We had the fork and knife BLT and the roast beef. So good. The mimosa bar at your table is also great. Check this place out!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Delicious! The biscuits are amazing, but the peach preserves are really what keep you coming back. I always get a vegetable plate, and from fried green tomatoes to creamed corn to mac and cheese, Loveless does it very very well. There can be a long wait, but when I visit at nontraditional times (like Tuesday night at 7:45), I am usually seated immediately.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Great homecooked meals, especially desserts. The wait can be long, especially on weekends and the parking can be challenging, but its a must-try if visiting Nashville. In short, its a better version of Cracker Barrel, but with lots of history and memorabilia.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Delicious Southern Comfort Food!!!
Biscuits and Jam YUM!
The sampler plate was very good with three choices of meat and two sides.. Enough to take leftovers home to enjoy a second time.
The fried catfish and fried chicken are not to greasy. The meatloaf is as good as what Mamma makes and that is pretty darn good!!!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: I come to Nashville every few months and have never been here. Until now! The biscuits did not disappoint. I got the southern omelette which was good and my fiancé got the country fried steak which was great. I must say the biscuits are the big hit. It is a little bit of a drive out of downtown but if you can make it I highly recommend it! Oh and our server Diane was just the nicest woman alive.

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
Amazing service and awesome food! Mike, Sydney, Hayley, and Daryl were absolutely wonderful and accommodating. I can't say enough good things about City Winery and their amazing staff. Food was great and the drinks were great. Came here for brunch, and I'm still here! Mimosas were great!

Thank you, Cass for turning on the lights for my selfie!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: We had a good time - take it for what it is, beer beer beer and decent food, live music, just fun , if you're waiting for some kind of culinary experience that's not the point - staff was friendly and it was a fun place to relax, and did I mention have a beer! .... a little like polka

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Do not book a party at Loveless!!!  My fiancé and I decided to have our small wedding reception at the Harpeth Room at the Loveless Cafe.  We were unable to reach anyone by phone so we booked by email.  They said they'd get back to us about menus and pricing.  A couple of weeks went by and we didn't hear from the event team.  We tried calling again and left a voicemail.  They emailed us back stating that the Harpeth Room had been booked by someone else.  We called back requesting an explanation and to attempt to salvage our reception.  Instead of calling us back, they emailed us AGAIN stating that all venues on the Loveless property were now booked for the evening of our wedding.  Since we had no luck contacting anyone by phone, my fiancé went to the restaurant.  The managers apologized for the mistake and told us we could rebook for another night and that they would compensate by giving us a free dessert.  Like a free dessert would sufficiently compensate for their poor communication and incompetent event booking team.  The food is tasty, but you will wait for hours to get a table.  And clearly, don't send out invitations saying you're having a party at the Loveless Cafe because they will probably cancel your event with mere days to spare.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
This was my favorite meal during my trip to Nashville! The place is so homey and inviting and the food is to die for. 

We went on Monday for lunch and waited about 20 minutes to be seated. While you wait, you can check out their adorable country store with everything from jams to home decor. As soon as we were seated we got a generous plate of biscuits and jam, and these were the best biscuits I've ever had! Even better than a certain hyped up biscuit spot in Nashville.

I decided to order the meatloaf, and you get two sides with each entree. Its hard to make a decision since all the sides sound awesome, but I went with caramel sweet potatoes and fried green tomatoes. Everything was so fantastic. The meatloaf portion was easily enough for two people and it was moist and had a tasty sauce. The sides were excellent as well... along with my own choices, I loved my friend's cheesy hash browns.

Despite being so far out of the way in Nashville, this is a must visit spot.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: We split a breakfast plate and with the complimentary biscuits where enough to fill us up (2 people). Amazing biscuits!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: This had to be the worst jager schnitzel we have ever had. My son & I got the Jager , his with fries & mine with some type of noodles, which neither of use could eat due to them floating in gravy. I could NOT even eat my dinner, the taste literally made me sick, my son did eat 2/3 of his meat & maybe 3 fries that weren't drenched (& that was only because it was almost 4:00 & we had not eaten all day.) NEVER, EVER would I recommend this restaurant. Our waitress acted like it pissed her off, when I called her over & told her to take it back because I just could not eat it, she never once came back & checked on us for refills nor to pick up our payment. The manager did come out & took my $21 meal off & left me a card for a free meal, NO THANK YOU....I don't want your free meal & after waiting 5-10 minutes for our waitress to pick up our payment, I decided to walk to the front & pay when my daughter realized a male worker had literally followed us from our table to the front, I assume to make sure we were paying & not trying to skip out. Very insulting!!!

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
This is my first time visiting the Loveless Cafe. I ordered the sampler plate with BBQ pork, meatloaf, and fried chicken. The meatloaf was good not great, the BBQ pork was just slow cooked pork with BBQ sauce, no smoke flavor whatsoever. The fried chicken was above average. My sides were mac n cheese and the hash brown casserole. The mac n cheese was just a notch above TV dinner fare, and the hash brown casserole was pretty average. What really let me down was the biscuits and preserves. I was dreaming about them on this trip before my visit on this trip. The biscuits were way below average, I might have had a bad batch as the waitress was taking to the table next to me about them and they said they never have seen them like this before. The preserves were below average for the peach and strawberry, but the blackberry were some of the best I've had. 

Overall for the price and hype I was expecting more. I wish I would have had breakfast for dinner as that's one meal that's hard to not hit the mark with. It's cool to say I ate here, but there are much better places in town to frequent. 

The service however was very good. Everybody here was warm and friendly.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Outstanding food and great ambience!  Reminds me of when I lived in Germany, just brighter on the inside. The food is on par with about any restaurant in Deutschland and the price isn't bad at all.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Literally everything I have ever ordered from Loveless Cafe is amazing. I love everything about this place, from the quaint interior to the friendly staff. If I could eat here everyday I would probably be hundreds of pounds over weight. It's that good. If you are ever in Nashville it is worth the drive to eat at Loveless Cafe.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Best German food I have had! And being from Chicago I know good food! Kathleen our server was fantastic!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Believe the hype!! Believe the hype!! Believe the hype!! It can be a bit of a drive because of its location but there's other attractions near by such as Percy Warner Park that you can make a fulfilling day. Also, be mindful that you may have to wait in line but it's worth it. There's different areas you can visit to kill time or you can sit in the car. Treat yourself nonetheless!

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Went to City Winery for the second time, I requested Kimberly because she was our server on my first visit. She DID NOT DISAPPOINT.... Kimberly was just as amazing as the first time that I had her! I was so excited when they told me she was working & hoped to receive the same level of service and WE DID! Great job Kimberly....you are truly a sweetheart & very knowledgeable! I will have to say again....she is the best server I've ever had in Nashville!!! I will be back and I hope Kimberly is working!!?

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Hadn't been to the Loveless in 10 years or so and was glad to find the food is still great.  We arrived around 4:30 on a Saturday night and only had a 10 minute wait.  We spent the wait time browsing in the General Store gift shop and found many unique items tempting to purchase.  The wireless buzzer system allows you to roam the grounds while waiting.

My favorite meal of the day is breakfast and the Loveless is ready all day.  The biscuits deserve all the hype and with the jams and preserves and real butter are lovely together.   

Had never traveled to Nashville North on the Natchez Trace before but was tickled to find the Loveless is on Hwy 100 just off a Natchez Trace exit at its terminus or start depending on which direction you are going.

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
Our server Kimberly was outstanding!! She knew her wines and was on top of the cuisine!!
You have to try the risotto balls, out of this world!! Lamb ribs were incredible but the roasted Brussels sprouts "stole the show"...Feta cheese on sprouts?!?! WOW!!!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Plenty to do during our 1:15 hour wait so it went fast. Preserves are very good! Biscuits small which is a good thing because I probably would have eaten the same number!! We Had the country fried steak, pork chops, and country ham. Eggs over easy cooked to perfection! All were outstanding! Bloody Mary also good. Grits different from what we usually get in SC but still very good!  Only thing I didn't like was the casual way the waiter addressed us: called the men (old enough to be his dads) "bro" and the ladies "girl..." as in, "hey, girl, what would you like." Would have preferred "ma'am" and "sir." But that doesn't seem to be unusual in restaurants today. But otherwise the service was good.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Great sausage and German sides. Everything was delicious. Large beer selection. Portions are generous. Menu is full of selections and options. Fast and friendly service. Restaurant includes a small German market full of goodies. A rare find for a restaurant attached to a mall.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text:
Very very good German food and beer. Very nice gifts reasonably priced out front. Very authentic looking beer haul that makes you feel like you are in Bavaria. Entertainment never made it to the stage while we were there. It would have been a 5 star with a little music.
Moved to 5 stars from 4. Reason - obviously they care. I got a prompt response from my review and honestly the place deserves 5 stars. I'll watch their calendar and catch a time with some live music!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Ate here for breakfast. Come early or prepare for a wait. We waited almost 2 hours. Service was fast friendly. Tons of choices serve both breakfast and dinner all day long. You'll leave full.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Excellent authentic German food. Even our waiter had a heavy German accent. The pretzel is amazing as are all of the sausages. The grapefruit Hefeweizen is delicious.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: We went here on a Sunday and it was quite a long wait at 11 AM, but it was a neat area to check out  with a bunch of souvenir shops (I bought a ton of bbq sauce). The food was pretty good as well! Mine wasn't very picturesque because I just got eggs, hashbrown casserole and cheese grits.. but the person I was with got this cool biscuit sampler/sandwich thing, which he loved! If you're wanting to check out the place, the hashbrown casserole dish was suuuper yummy! Wish there was more of it! Overall, I'm glad we checked it out, and yes I loved the hashbrowns, but I'm not sure it was worth the long drive from Nashville and the wait.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: The loveless cafe was lovely! We had the chicken waffle and garden omelet with a side of hash browns and they were amazing. Waffle was delicious, fried chicken was perfectly cooked, and the biscuits are to die for. They have a bunch of cute little gift shops and a shops where you can buy there homemade preserves and biscuit mix. Such a cute little country cafe.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Absolutely worth the wait time! Went in for the famously delicious biscuits (which they were scrumptious), but fell in love with everything we ate. Most tender pulled pork (try the BBQ sandwich), crispiest fried chicken (try the chicken & waffles), and melt in your mouth side dishes (hash brown casserole and Mac & cheese are musts). We ended up so stuffed that we had tons of leftovers which tasted just as good the 2nd time (we even just heated them up at our campsite that night over the fire - so good!). The wait staff was friendly and attentive. Just good ole' fashioned southern comfort! You can also explore the gift shops while you wait.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Classic breakfast and complimentary biscuits & jam. Yummm. Super quick seating for a busy place! No complaints.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Pretty solid breakfast joint though not extraordinary given all the fanfare.   You'll wait a long time so be prepared. There isn't a place close by that sells adult beverages. Maybe bring a flask or a cooler to help pass time. Don't have a group of more than 4 to get seated faster.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Dont worry about the wait. They told us 1.5 hrs but we only waited 45 min. COMPLETELY worth the wait!!! The biscuits are to die for. We ordered the chicken fried steak with hash brown casserole. It was amazing!!!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: I'd give it a 4.33 stars if I could.  Yams we're great, enjoyed the biscuits and preserves, and the meat sampler was pretty solid across the board.  Didn't have room for dessert with all the biscuits I ate but it was pretty good overall.  Had a bit of a wait though so don't come starving.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: This was by far the best breakfast that I have ever had. On our way out of Nashville we hit this place for some fuel for the long day of driving. There was a bit of a wait, but they give you a pager and you can go look at the shops on the property while you wait. Once we were seated, our waiter came by and was really friendly. He recommended a couple of things and I went with his recommendation of BBQ pulled pork and eggs. It was delicious! It came with a choice of sides and I had the hash brown casserole which were the best hash browns that I have ever had. My husband thought the biscuits and gravy were the best he's ever had as well. My only regret was that I didn't have enough room to have a piece of pie. They looked really good in the case. You can buy a half or whole pie to go as well. The shops on the property have a lot of their products for sale - jams, sauces, bacon, syrup, honey, etc. they also have a bunch of novelty items and souvenirs. A nice way to get breakfast and shopping out of the way.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
I struggled when deciding between 3 or 4 stars but ultimately decided on 4 since it was a good meal but not mind blowing like all the reviews hyped it up to be. It is a solid 3.5 stars.

The atmosphere is homey and very welcoming. The restaurant looks like a repurposed home and I love that cozy feeling. Our waiter was also attentive and nice.

The food was underwhelming for me though. Which is really disappointing and sad for me. I ordered the Southern Sampler Supper Plate with catfish, fried chicken, and pulled pork, it came with creamed corn, mashed potatoes and hush puppies. The chicken was fried too much and just thrown on my plate that the skin was already half falling off. There was not much seasoning on it which surprised me. The cat fish was fried well but also not much flavor or seasoning. The pulled pork was also not tender or juicy like I was expecting. I did really enjoy the sides though! The gravy that accompanied the mashed potatoes was SO good. And of course the biscuits were deliciously buttery and fluffy. We also ordered the country fried steak, which was huge! It was tender but didn't have much seasoning on the breading. The white gravy that went on top was good! And again the sides were good, the hash brown casserole was good!

Overall the meal was good but I'm not sure if I would come back. The only thing from the meal I would come back for are the biscuits and homemade jams. Considering the glowing reviews my expectations were very high and the food was underwhelming for me.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Good service and good food. Nice touristy flavor to the place as well to do a bit of shopping (kitchen items, cafe branded clothes, souvenirs, etc.

name: Fat Kat Slim's
text: Horrible. Food was tasteless. Portion were small. If you want to make it in Nashville you are going to have to do something. If you just want to be a bar then don't act like a diner. Never going back. We were the only ones in the restaurant part and maybe four people at the bar.

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Food was amazing Kimberley and Ryan were great servers have the best time!! Large group of 11 took reservations! Killer bloody Mary's we would definitely come back again!!

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
I have been lucky enough to eat here twice.  Once for lunch and once for breakfast.  Some great food and atmosphere.  They have some traditional Southern eats (chicken and waffles) and some interesting new things. I add the BBQ pulled pork omelet for breakfast.  

Can't wait for the 3rd time!

name: Rocketown
text:
Rocketown is great!!! The main bldg. & the smaller white bldg across the street, are both great venues. Concerts are why I have been to both locations this far & we thoroughly enjoyed ourselves! 
Thanks Michael W. smith for your vision & opening Rocketown!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Went here for a birthday dinner and it was great! Very reminiscent of the Beer Garden at Epcot/Disney World. We went on a Saturday night and had no trouble getting seated (we reserved on Open Table but were early and they sat us right away), there was live music that was fun and interactive with the audience, service and food were great and the desserts were delicious! The little gift shop by the registers is a lot of fun too. All the staff were very nice, the restaurant was large and busy but very clean. Really enjoyed our evening here!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: We are visiting from Houston and coming here was on our list of must go places. I am so glad we went! Mark was our server and he was so funny and genuine. It was very refreshing and made our experience even better. The food was as great as we were told it would be, but Mark was really the highlight! Thank you Mark

name: Dirty Little Secret
text: So I went to the club VIP and was very disappointed. I danced with my wife one time due to the horrible mixes that were played. If you like lame club music that is not even close to good club music please go but if you want good club (hip hop) music stay away. I would never recommend this place to any of my friends.

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
Meh. Mediocre. That's how I feel about this place. My boyfriend and I have been here twice now. The first time, valet parking was mandatory and $5, then obviously you tip the valet driver. We were only coming for a pre-dinner glass of wine. Starting the price of my glass of wine at $10 before I even order seems absurd.

Fast forward. I found a Groupon and thought it was definitely worth another try. Afterall, I hadn't tried the food. So we came back for brunch after church on a Sunday. The service, also mediocre. I did really love the drink I ordered here though. It was different and pretty refreshing- pecan't even. My boyfriend had the bloody Mary which he liked as well. We ordered the blueberry corn muffin, probably my favorite thing I ate for brunch. Actually, definitely my favorite thing. For entrees I ordered the frosted flakes pain perdue. For me, it was overly sweet and pretty soggy. My boyfriend ordered a croissant eggs benedict, which was pretty good. 

So honestly, the food is okay. The service is okay. Wine is alright. Drinks are pretty good. For me, nothing was bad but nothing was good enough to make me want to come back either.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Another lovely experience at loveless cafe. I typically plan on a two hour wait when going here, and they got us in with an hour and a half. 

Their biscuits are the best I've had in the south. I typically purchase the mix to make them at home and fresh jelly from their store while waiting to eat. Cornhole helps pass the time too. 

Our server was friendly and attentive. Our food came out fresh and as ordered. My only recommendation for loveless would be that they wipe menus in between guests. Mine was pretty dirty.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Bang for your buck: 5/10
Quality: 4/10
Service: 8/10
Ambiance/Location: 10/10
Overall: 5/10

I wanted so desperately to love Loveless Cafe. Everything about it seems just so much up my alley, but alas, a glowing review is not meant to be. 

Let me at least start with the pros:
-They have Dr Pepper
-Their biscuits are very very good 
-As are the preserves. Especially a fan of the strawberry.
-There are about two dozen items on the menu that at least sound like they'll be delicious 

The Cons:
-The food: I got the fried chicken. It had so clearly been sitting in a warmer all day. It wasn't moist and juicy with a crispy crunchy coating like a good fried chicken should be. Nope. This was dry and stuck to the bone. I couldn't even finish it because it was essentially inedible. It lacked so much flavor that I doubt it would have been very good anyway. Dave got the pimento cheese burger. The pimento cheese lacked any of the flavor composition you want in a pimento cheese and the burger itself tasted like it came from GFS. We got a host of sides because I just love sides. I'd struggled the whole time we waited for a table to narrow down to sides because honestly I wanted them all. I finally talked myself into only getting the 2 that came with the chicken meal, and I'm really glad I did because it simply meant less food to be disappointed by. I ordered the hash brown casserole. It was very meh. Dave and I shared the fried okra; it was too greasy. Dave got the macaroni and cheese and it was so bland. It didn't taste cheesy and wasn't even a little creamy. We both wanted dessert, but I figured it was better not to even try.
-The service: Our waitress could have been more attentive. When we asked for something she brought it pretty quickly, but she didn't check in on us and didn't seem concerned that I didn't touch my chicken.
-The Wait: we waited for over an hour for a table. It was a Sunday afternoon and Loveless is popular, so that's a little understandable. However, waiting that long for a super disappointing meal stinks. 

Overall, Loveless is touted as a powerhouse of Southern cooking, and it was just Cracker Barrel with higher prices, way worse food, and a much longer wait.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Driving out to the Loveless Cafe was a spur of the moment decision on our trip to Nashville and it turned out to be one of the food highlights of our trip! Just driving to this quaint cafe you feel the cozy, rural sights taking your stress away. We had an hour and a half wait for a table but with the shops and beautiful weather the time passed quickly. Once seated we had an amazing meal with the best server! Owen made us feel like we were in his home and there was no feeling of being rushed so the line of people waiting to get in could get a table. We truly felt like we could enjoy our meal and have a chat. The biscuits are truly the best I have ever tasted and the Fried Green tomato & Pimento cheese biscuit was amazing! We will definitely be going back again and again now that we know about this warm and inviting place! Thank you for such a memorable and friendly experience!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: A definite must to go for breakfast. So cute and quaint. Service was friendly and you need to check out the market and smokehouse. The fried pork chops with white gravy is delicious and feeds two people. The waiter was helpful to choose something off the very long list of breakfast items. Gets busy, make sure you party is complete before you ask to be seated. They food is quick to come out and they bring biscuits immediately to your table with fresh jams, yum!!

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Heavenly biscuit is no lie!

There will be a wait, but they're pretty accurate how long it takes and you can check out their cute store just outside.  Drove 30min from Nashville while we were there for a long weekend in Oct 2016.  Definitely worth it.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
This restaurant is a far piece from downtown Nashville we were staying by the airport and it took us between 20 and 30 minutes to get there don't let the distance or the wait scare you it is well worth it

Honestly some of the best food I've ever tasted I have the fried chicken mashed potatoes and macaroni and cheese the husband had their daily special which was brisket over toast mashed potatoes and green beans

The chicken was perfect juicy inside crispy on the outside not over breaded and macaroni and cheese was amazing its obvious everything here is made from scratch my husbands brisket literally melted in your mouth and the green beans or seasoned perfectly.

We stopped in on Saturday around 1 o'clock the wait was 2 hours and we were just too hungry to stay we came back on Sunday around 4 and still have an hour wait the food was well worth it in the meantime we walked around to all the shops on the campus and you even are able to check out corn hole bags to keep you busy.  We walk through all the shops and even got a t-shirt that said praise the lard and pass the biscuits the lobby is full of autographed photos from celebrities who have stopped by and  the decor is like being in your grandma's kitchen. 

When they first sit you down they bring you their scrumptious biscuits and homemade strawberry peach and BlackBerry preserves.  If I would have known these were so good I probably would have bought them in the gift shop rather than the t-shirt they melt in your mouth

The service was as good as the food.  Kramer was our waiter we never had to ask for anything my tea glass was always at least half full and he stop by several times to see how we were doing.  If I have to find something I didn't like I would say the tea probably wasn't sweet enough but that's nothing that would stop me from coming back.

 can't wait to come back to Nashville to eat at loveless again next time I'm getting breakfast

name: Drifters
text: I've only had their BBQ sampler platter. It's big-- can easily be shared between 2 or 3 people. It comes with 1/3 of a rack of ribs, 3 oz of pulled chicken, 3 oz of brisket and 3 oz of smoked sausage. The BBQ itself was pretty good. The brisket was really good as was the  sausage. Their hush puppies are super delicious though! And often times you'll go there and there will be some kind of live music going on.

name: Belcourt Theatre
text: Love the theater but just had a horrible experience.   Confusion with one line, two cashiers,  one only doing will call.    Missed the beginning of movie so I left.    Figure it out.    That was a mess.

name: Belcourt Theatre
text: Love seeing movies here. Very decent prices, a good selection of unique and classic films. You can drink beer during a movie! They have cool midnight shows, and small independent films not showing anywhere else in the city.I haven't been to a Regal or Carmike cinema in years, but I make it to the Belcourt at least once a month.

name: Belcourt Theatre
text:
This is going to be the shortest review ever.

Mean Girls, Harry Potter and The Sound of Music on the big screen all for $9? I'm in LOVE

name: Drifters
text: Great outdoor patio! Love drifters...almost always live music and drink specials! best place in 5 points to sit outside with friends and enjoy the nice weather!

name: EXIT/IN
text:
This is one of the best venues I have ever been to. It would get five stars if not for the pudgy, power tripping doorman with zero people skills. This venue is an intimate setting where the band and the audience can feel each other's energy effortlessly. 

     My wife and I flew in from out of town to see a band that wasn't coming to our town. What an amazing show! So glad we made the trip. Definitely a wonderful time. Nashville treated us well.

name: The Country
text:
I was staying at The nearby Marriott and wanted to get something to eat hear some music. It's Nashville! I had dinner, drinks, and some live music.

Pros - new bar with an old feel. Edison bulbs. Classic musical patents for decorations.  Matte black. Good sound system. Good food. 

Cons - it was bar service but there was no way to know that. Say at a a table for quite awhile waiting for what I thought  was a waitress to stop by the table. 

While this might not be an old, classic Nashville bar, it is also not a tourist trap. It's a nice clean new bar with good music and good food. I had the Korean barbecue tacos. Fit right in with the mostly hipster crowd. The tacos were good, the coleslaw on them was very fresh, the sauce was a little sweet and a tiny bit smoky. The music was great. I would definitely recommend coming here if you want a place to eat and listen to live music

name: Drifters
text:
The service was awful. The waitresses ignored us for other tables with larger parties. When we reached out pointing out that we had been waiting longer than the people they were serving three separate members of the waitstaff obviously didn't care.

We ended up walking out after the pattern became impossible to ignore.

name: The Country
text:
Well, It's been three months, and I've been back enough times to justify a review update. The Country has impressed me over the last few visits. First off, my hope of seeing taps rotated? It's happening! They have a great selection, including some Michigan beers (but hey, I'm partial) and high-grav options. In truth, my friends and I never come here to drink cocktails, but their menu looks promising, and I am sure I'll try some eventually. I also don't usually come here to eat, but that may be changing soon as I recently has an amazing burger, with an aioli to die for.

While I did not attend their New Years Eve party, I stopped by the night after and got a glance at the photo back drop, ice luge sculpture and NYE menu, which certainly made it look like it would've been a great time. I'm excited to see what other events and musicians they have in the future. It is nice to have some live music on our side of town.

I have to give props to Lee, the bartender who is there pretty much all the time. Seriously great service. Also, my friend lost his [beloved cowboy] hat the last time we were there and Lee helped us track it down.

My friends and I will certainly continue to come to The County. Can't wait for some warm weather patio drinks here next summer!

name: Drifters
text: Loved the BBQ.  Great music.  Bar-like and a tad rowdy, which fit the place well.  Service was really quick and attentive.  Place is behind the fish joint, just up the alley.  Parking was scarce, so we went across the street and paid ($3/hr).  East Nashville section know as the five points.  Nice scene with a lot of bars around it.  Highly recommend.

name: Drifters
text:
Nice little dive joint hidden in Nashville. The area around is pretty cool. The food is great! Don't let the biker vibe stop you from going. 

I recommend the wings! They are the size of a pterodactyl.

name: Belcourt Theatre
text: This is one of Nashville's most special places and my absolute favorite spot in town. Great mix of repertory offerings, midnight movies, special events, and new foreign and independent films. Clean theatre; courteous, friendly, unpretentious staff; and great concessions including some local beers on tap.

name: Commodore Grille
text: Foods good service sucks waited 15-20 min I finally moved to the bar flag someone down. Lazy!!!

name: Drifters
text: Relaxed atmosphere. Popular spot, as I'm sitting here there's a production crew that wrapped up filming for the day just chilling and eating good food. I think their server is the same one as mine so she's killing it, I hope you get her when you stop by cuz I can't remember her name. Paid parking but like $5/2hrs so not too bad, paid much more for less time and poor service here in east nashville. Veggie options. I'd ask for what's truly vegan tho. After you're done rocking out to live music here you should stop by one of the other bars on the block, 3  Crow is excellent, Tenn Sixteen has some of the best gumbo around...just come to the 5 points area man. You won't regret it

name: Frisky Frog's
text: We didn't get greeted for awhile, our bartender was extremely slow too, we pretty much got ignored the whole time!

name: Drifters
text: Great place for outdoor eating with a simple vibe and yummy bbq. We had the pulled pork bbq sandwich and fried catfish. Great band was playing and was a fun place to chill before heading to Family Wash for a show.

name: Drifters
text: Drifters is always on the top of my to do list when visiting Nashville! My dog is my road trip buddy for the 20 hour drive to visit my brother, and she looks forward to eating here too.  The food is delicious (I always bring bottles of sauce back), the service is quick and friendly, and they always bring a bowl of water right out for the dog.

name: Mercy Lounge
text:
Well, I know this isn't necessary a completely fair judgment, but I can only judge it based on when I was there. Apparently I was there on an unusual quiet day, because it was a Saturday night and there was hardly anyone. It was the Saturday right after gay marriage became legal and all these Pride festivities were going on.

Pros: The venue is huge and can accommodate at least 2 groups playing at the same time that wouldn't bother each other since they're on the opposite end of the floor. They have free pool and darts, and I love the balcony (smoker's area) because it has a good view of the city. I didn't smoke, but that didn't mean I didn't enjoy the scenary.

Cons: Because there were hardly anyone there, the music was painfully loud, and the only way I could escape it was to go into the pool room. Considering how little people there were, the cover charge seems unnecessary and overly expensive for what we got as an experience.

So, all in all, I would have to be really in the mood for music by random bands or my favorite bands play there to go back. There are bajillions of places on Broadway with live music.

name: Mercy Lounge
text: Such a great live music venue in Nashville. I've been three times and have yet to be disappointed! Very fairly priced drinks, great atmosphere, and free nearby street parking.

name: Drifters
text:
Juicy 6 ounce burgers, infused with ground bacon, served on a toasted bun with a side of french fries. $7.50.
Bacon and cheese are $1.00 extra.

Juicy, tender, tasty, (did I say juicy?) on a toasted bun.  How many places do you know that toast the bun??

French fries, crispy, matchstick thin, salted..  Oooooh, so good.

Cold beer, full liquor bar, decent prices, non-smoking interior, familiar music coming from the speakers, TV's on silent...  every chair in the place is taken.

Where else would you go for a juicy bacon burger on a toasted bun for $7.50?
NO WHERE!

There's a ton more stuff on the menu, but I prefer the burger with bacon!
Even the fried pickles hit the spot.

Burger you, burger me, no lines out the door, no $11.00 burger, no extra price on the french fries.  

This is heaven.
*Even the waitstaff is pretty efficient.

name: Frisky Frog's
text: Went to Tin Roof. It was relatively empty. After waiting nearly 30 minutes left and went here. Fish tacos were really fresh and good

name: EXIT/IN
text:
Yes! My favorite venue! They constantly bring in great acts ranging from just about every genre and popularity. I've seen some wonderful shows here, some of the best being Mac DeMarco, Avey Tare's Slasher Flicks, and Slow Magic.

It is an intimate venue with a lot of history and chill atmosphere.They have a small balcony and even a smoking area just outside by the stage that you can use to escape a hot and heavy crowd. 

If you're in Nashville, your Music City experience is not complete until a visit to the Exit/In.

name: Drifters
text: Cool little place in a fun area. It's a basic bar but the BBQ is great and staff very friendly. Looks like it would be a lot of fun on the weekends. We very much enjoyed it.

name: Cannery Ballroom
text:
I was just assaulted by some 7 ft tall jerk who works there and am filing a police report right now. 

EDIT: My girlfriend just spoke to the owner who was very apologetic and informed us that security is outsourced through a company called Axis Security. He also ensured us that the individual involved will no longer be welcome at his venues.

name: Frisky Frog's
text: Great place to watch a game plenty of tvs and the staff is great. Will come back again.

name: Springwater
text: This is a "no frills" kind o' place...cash only, smoke inside, dog-friendly, open during snow...yep, you read that right: OPEN DURING SNOW. We drove up a day early before Erin's course viewing so we could explore a little bit. We had this planned for at least a month...then Winter Storm Jonas shows up and dumps cold misery all over Nashville. We called around to places within a few miles, hoping we could catch an Uber ride somewhere once we found a spot to take the pups. We were losing hope when Erin called her cousin Jennifer for advice, who then asked her good friend (also an Uber driver) to tell us what only a local would know. Springwater was 1 of 2 sppts he named, but we never even called the other place. I think we stayed for 3-4hrs, just biding our time until nighttime spots would open.
