Only thing I noticed when I first stepped into the place, was the smell. Honestly don't know why but it was a stinky urine smell. Or a dirty mop used to clean the floors. I've smelled this kind of place being downtown in the dive bars and don't know why it smelled like that. But you get immune to it within a few min and don't notice. But first time in, I could def. smell it.

Still great experience.
Will be back.

name: Rack Room Blue Bar
text: Nice place, we came at 8pm. Very quiet. Don't  be fooled tho, they only have one pool table- so it's by no means a rack room. Which was sad.

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: The cruise was nice, show lasted bit too long and the food was HORRENDOUS!! EAt before you go!

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text:
Do not go here for food. Not only did it take over an hour for my four friends and I to receive our burgers and fries, but the food arrived cold! How could the food be cold AND take an hour+ to prepare? Someone seriously dropped the ball here.

I do not recommend this place for anything except its Bud Lights and maybe live music.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
Smaller museum, but really well done. Shows a timeline of his life, all his albums, interactive audio and video. When they play Hurt as you leave the tour, it's hard not to get choked up.
Great showcase of one of the all-timers!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
We were told by several Nashville locals to check this place out. The hospitality was just as amazing as the music and definitely made our experience. We stopped in during the day due to issues making a reservation online, and the host, Emily, was unbelievably helpful in getting us in that night and giving some Timing tips to make sure we got a good seat. When we arrived verrrry early for the 8pm show, we were given helpful options to buy time. We ended up standing in the back for the 6pm show that had just started (the manager even found bar stools for us!) the night host (we didn't get her name) then helped us getting a great, close table for the later show! 

I don't think we were overly nice to get such great service, they were just that awesome! I also saw some comments about the food, but we had no complaints: an interesting take on fried pickles & salads with blackened shrimp were delicious. 

The music was on point for both shows! Really cool to hear the guys who wrote popular songs we'd heard at the later show; I've added some up & comers to my Spotify list from the early show. 

I will absolutely be back on any & every trip to Nashville!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: By far, the best thing my mom and I did in Nashville. Good food, service, and extremely talented performers! Whenever anyone asks what to do in Nashville, this is my first recommendation. If you watch the show "Nashville", this place is very similar to the Bluebird Cafe, the difference is that the Listening Room Cafe is located right downtown Nashville, walking distance from Honky Tonk Row. Perfect place to grab a bite and a drink (or two), and listen to some authentic country music.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: You don't go here for the food or drinks obviously. The entertainment was excellent. However, the drinks took a very long time for a half packed crowd. Also, they forgot our food order and we got it 5 minutes before the show ended.

name: 360 Burger
text: So I returned to 360 to check out the cheeseburger instead of turkey burger. While my burger was a but more well done than expected, it was still fantastic. I also had the opportunity to try the hot apple crisp and it was amazing!

name: 360 Burger
text:
I should be giving this place a 2 star for my true feelings, but its new and I really hope that they can make it, as Hickory Hollow definitely needs someone to breath new life into the area.
The service was great, she was friendly and gave us the speech, which I enjoy, love learning about "what their deal is" she told it it was all local beef, grass feed vs grain feed... cool!
I ordered the 360 burger, on sourdough (she said it was, didn't taste like the sourdough i know of) with an egg and bacon. I got grilled asparagus as a side, i know odd, but it was the best part of the meal and much healthier than fries!

I couldn't get pass the meat...something smelled off...gamey, old, mixed with some other sort of meat, i don't know, i ate 2 bites and I was done. 
Not sure what happened there, I've definitely had grass fed, local meat before and it's usually top notch! 
This place could be a hit, but you have to fix the burger...I'll be back, as its close by and i believe in second chances. fingers crossed!

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: A fantastic stop when you're in Nashville to go see the legend himself. Great opportunity to listen to his music see his albums and attire from the various stages in his life. There is also a café in the ticketing area. Don't forget to spend some time upstairs to see Patsy Cline and all the things she's done. $18 is worth a visit. Highly recommended.

name: 360 Burger
text: Definitely could've lived without. Went here based on reviews to get my husband a burger for his birthday. Menu is short with very little options. Choice of type of burger is.... Beef. Sure it's supposed to be "fancy" but, still it's beef or chicken on the menu. We had to ask about a kids menu though clearly we had a 7 yr old at the table. The sweet and courteous waitress had to tell me what kids meals they served because they weren't on the menu.. There were 5 other kids though in the tiny restaurant so clearly it wasn't for a lack of use. Kiddo and I ordered tea, musn't be popular bc it was sour. Burgers got to table and meat/cheese was with opposite toppings/condiments, so we flipped patties. It looked nice...but then we ate. Tasted like a grease infused patty burnt on a skillet. Ew. Bad smell, bad flavor, bun was BLACK around edges, not brown, black! Sweet potato fries were good. Milkshake was good. The worst part was who I believe to be the owner doing "live music" which sounded like something you'd hear in an elevator on a cruise ship...awful. I never want to hear a synthesized version of Hotel California again....ever.

name: Music City Bar and Grill
text: While there is certainly room for improvement when judging the quality of the drinks or the cleanliness of the tables and bathrooms, the scenery is unmatched.  If you enjoy seeing an exposed areola entering the mouth of a fellow patron as they bond over music that was close to decent 25 years ago and the lowest quality liquor that is allowed by the FDA then look no farther.  If you crave frozen cheese sticks, you are in luck, but if not it's proximity to Waffle House leaves you with quality options.

name: Rack Room Blue Bar
text:
The owner of this establishment is wildly inappropriate. 

Let me elaborate. Last night we left Rebar to go to this bar and it was sometime before midnight. There was a person who was talking to us, who had obviously become really drunk, and started to act a little mouthy. The owner engaged him in a verbal argument through the open patio window and was not backing down. I think it's really unprofessional to not simply recognize someone is intoxicated and ask them to leave your establishment. Done. Altercation over.

However, the owner would not stop. I leaned over and politely tapped him on the shoulder and said "He might be very drunk, you should just ask him to leave."

(He was yelling at the guy: "You, motherfu**er are a liability in my establishment!" Which is probably true, but what happened next speaks to a deeper issue.)

And he whipped to the side, and screamed at me.

"Don't you fu**ing touch me you stupid bit**!!"

Woah there, homie. First of all, you don't talk to a lady like that. Secondly, I did not do anything more than put two fingers on your shoulder in a polite manner to tell you that I agreed with you, he needed to go, and you both needed to end it- you were drawing a crowd on the sidewalk adjacent to the patio and my friends were sitting close to this. You were not dealing with myself or my friends- and we were not obnoxious in any way. I was trying to help diffuse the situation and, attempt to, also get you to get rid of this guy who had been following myself and my friends around most of the evening without drawing too much attention to myself for being the whistleblower potentially and/or my girl friends.

Clearly, the owner is more concerned with being a hot headed loose cannon than he is the safety of his female patrons. He also seems to like to degrade and berate female patrons, too, as you can see.

We seem to visit Nashville enough- and we will not ever be returning to this establishment.

I advise others not to either.

You, sir, pissed off the wrong patron.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Very cool place.   4 singer song writers play their best.   Local brews.  Food was okay but who cares.  A great night of fun.   Not so loud that you can't hear your table mates.  A little bit of an older crowd.   30-40 scene. Lots of couples on dates.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
This place is amazing. The tickets are $20, but it is well worth it. 
The museum takes you through the life and works beginning to end for Johnny Cash. 

It is a pretty extensive collection of materials and works from the Man in Black. The tour took us about 1 hour to get all the way through, which to me is well worth the money spend. 

And we learned quite a bit !

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
I'm a huge old school country fan, so when I was we where in town and blocks from the museum I told my husband we have to go. 
One thing you need to know is that it will be packed with young and old. 
Fun and full of interesting things!
I love that it is set up that when you enter its his early years and you end with his last recording "Hurt" his cover on the Nine Inch Nails song months before he died. With the showings of the movies he was in and live showing of old concerts. 
I think his son opened this museum in 2012.
If I come back to Nashville, I will return.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: We were directed here by a musician on Broadway.  They bring in songwriters to sing their originals. Chances are you will recognize several songs that have been aired but here you hear it from the person that wrote it not the big name musician.  There were 4 songwriters/singers the night we went and we recognized several songs we have heard (Martina McBride and Tim McGraw sang them) but got to hear them performed by the songwriter, Rick Ferrell.  The other guys had some amazing songs as well and there's no doubt we will hear some of the songs in the near future on the radio whether it's by them or another musician. The food was also absolutely amazing. I believe our server said pretty much everything is smoked on site. I had the hot wings and my wife had the brisket. The wings are right at the top of my list, my mouth waters thinking of them. I went with the buffalo sauce and it was perfect heat and flavor. My wife said the brisket was fantastic. Very flavorful, extremely tender and very juicy!  Can't say enough great things about Listening Room Cafe we will definitely go back on our next trip, maybe more than once. There is a cover charge for the show and a 15 dollar drink/food minimum once in for the show. Otherwise you can stop in just for food in the dining and bar area.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: This Museum is a fitting tribute to an exceptional human being.  It helps Fan's or anyone who walks through to get a full Picture of a man who's contributions to society did not stop and in the Recording Studio or When he left the stage.  It's classy and a look into a very complex and gifted man's life.  It walks you through starting at his humble childhood Right up to his last days and the legacy that Will endure in a way unaffected and unmeasured by time.  Evryone should visit this Tribute To Johnny Cash wether a music fan or not, Anyone who does will walk out with a far deeper understanding of Johnny's Contributions not only to music but to American History and Popular Culture.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: I brought 11 girlfriends to the big bang for my bachelorette party. We had an awesome time! The musicians were so talented and interactive. We had a wonderful time and definitely recommend that people come here for a bachelorette party or other celebrations or just a fun night out with friends. The drinks were a bit expensive, but they were delicious and strong and I would love to go back!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
If you've ever let children or cats loose in an empty room, it would sort of be how the organization at Listening Room Cafe was Saturday night. My sister and I arrived at 7:30 and had already purchased tickets for the 8:30 show. We walked up to the hostess who said we would not be seated until 8:15, cool, no big deal, we will go get a drink at the bar we said. We sat down at the bar, had a drink a piece and an appetizer (cheese tray, which was actually pretty good) when we notice it's about 8:10 at this point. We stand up to go see when we can go in or find some sort of "plan" in this now extremely crowded "waiting room" and there is literally NO direction. People are just standing around in a huge gaggle, asking everyone else if they know what's going on, at which point nobody knows the answers. The employee at the door was of NO help and would let some people sneak past while others who had been waiting in line (not us thankfully) for an hour were still standing in line. TOTAL disaster. At this point I was super annoyed and had I not purchased tickets we'd have left but finally, at 8:45 (yes 15 minutes after the show was supposed to start), they get all of us inside. The songwriters made several comments about starting late, as well, so it was pretty clear everyone was pretty peeved. 

I'd like to tell you the disaster ended here but sadly, it did not. We ordered two diet cokes and two waters from the waitress. About 30 minutes later, and after having been asked by 300 other waiters if we'd ordered a beer, margarita, whiskey, etc. our waitress finally came back with two diet cokes. I requested a few waters and we put in our food order. Once our food came, and thankfully that was pretty fast, we had mixed reviews. The hot chicken was no bueno  but the brussel sprouts and the fried pickles were edible. 

The entire duration of the show the artists kept ordering beverages they were not getting served so finally patrons of the show would bring them drinks. It was seriously insane. I don't live in Nashville but if I did, I'd probably go anywhere else. It's really too bad because you have all the ingredients for success just maybe too much going on.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: This place was quite simply the best place I've visited on Broadway so far. Our server, Heather, was fantastic and provided excellent service. The band was awesome, covered a lot and knew their target audience and the food was great. The artichoke dip was on point as well as the beer can chicken. I believe the rating does not reflect them, just busy and overcrowded upon opening.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Really awesome live music with the Nashville Nobody's.  Nice and quick service.  Cozy place. Would def return while in Nashville.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: We had a wonderful experience enjoying the first all female band we've seen on Broadway. Dozzie, 4 girls from Australia rocked the house with amazing harmony, singing a great mix of top 40. They play on Saturday afternoons. The food was great. We enjoyed the Shrimp fritters, Mac and cheese, loaded fries, fried pickles, wings and the banana bread pudding. The highlight of the afternoon was our server Nicole who was pleasant, fun, and knowledgeable about the menu. This is also a good bar to watch games. There are lots of tvs well placed throughout the restaurant.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Way better service and experience in this new venue. We sat at the far edge of the room but still had a good view. Music is always great!! Decent selection of beers. The mini donut dessert was just okay.

name: Rack Room Blue Bar
text: Anyone who puts below 5 stars for this bar is a douchbag. Yes, please complain more about how you couldn't gain entry because were dressed as a complete moron in a tank top; or how you were kicked out because you were rude to the bar staff or another paying customer. The owner is super nice and the bar staff are the most amazing people I have ever known!! Bob is fucking awesome and one of the most down to earth, friendly, accomodating bartenders I've ever met! Go here for amazing drinks and great music!!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Awful!  Went to the roof.  One bartender! Not a full bar. He's not very nice.  No waitstaff! Order food at bar.  Food comes. COLD!  Two rounds of drinks. Second round is one less drink BUT same price as first round?!!!  NEVER coming back.  Can't believe Dierks Bentley puts his name on this place.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Came here with 3 other people on a Friday night. First floor was packed, second and third floors were empty so we opted to sit on the roof top with around 45-50 other people. Band played good music with asking the crowd for requests multiple times. We got a round of drinks immediate and ordered the potatoes skins. Received them under 10 min later. Nothing special, basic bar food. Overall no complaints and a nice new place.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: This museum is a great tribute to the Man in Black. From his military days to his personal troubles to his time as an actor they covered it all. Mr. Cash was also great friends with the owners and curators so there's a ton of fantastic memorabilia. There's also a nice gift shop and coffee shop in the front of the museum. I bought some nice baby clothes which I will put on my dog.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Good food!  I had the cheeseburger.  Free valet parking is a great deal in this part of Nashville.  Really good music!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Five stars for the entertainment, regardless of the food!  (Although the food's pretty good, too -- I'd give it at least four stars.)

We were there on Saturday of Thanksgiving weekend, for the early show.  There were four singer-songwriters lined up across the stage, and they took turns performing -- Emily Earle Caroline Watkins, Ruthie Collins, and Tom Whall.  We hadn't heard of any of them before, but really liked them all, each with their own style of singing and songwriting.  It was also fun to hear some of them introduce family members who were visiting for the holiday weekend and were in the audience for the show.

As I'd said earlier, the food was secondary, but good and satisfying.  I'd read about their famous Sweet & Spicy Pickles, so we had to try those as an appetizer.  They were really good!  Just the right amount of spicy, and not too sweet to offset that.

I had the pulled pork sandwich, "Pulled pork, slow smoked in house, then topped with house made creamy coleslaw. Served on a brioche bun and a side of CB's BBQ sauce."  A couple things -- there was far too little coleslaw.  It literally got lost between the (flavorful, juicy) pulled pork and the bun.  And the BBQ sauce is so red in color that I thought they'd brought me a container of ketchup for my fries (which were quite good and didn't need ketchup) until I told the server she'd forgotten my BBQ sauce, and she arrived with a second container of red stuff.  Only then did I try it and realize that it was not ketchup but a very tasty, mildly spicy, BBQ sauce.  This should be more clearly marked, or mentioned by the server, so others don't make the same mistake I did.

Tickets were $10 -- a true bargain!  The food (a $15 minimum required per person, which we had no trouble achieving since we also had a couple rounds of drinks) was reasonably priced and tasty.  This is a fun way to spend an evening with some good entertainment without breaking the bank.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: I really wanted to be able to write a better review, but I just could not. First off the entertainment was 5 stars but that's where it ends. We went early to have dinner but after having the appetizer I could not bring myself to order more food. Secondly, our server could have not been more unfriendly.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Being new to Nashville, I wanted to explore Broadway and the bars/restaurants that line the street. When I came up on Whiskey Row, a manager noticed me peeking in and was so kind to invite me in and give me a special tour of the venue. The exterior looks awesome but wait until you get inside, this place is AMAZING! I'm so excited to be here on NYE for the opening! I will be at Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row all night long!

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Miller lite was flat as shit. Disrespectful butch looking bartender, terrible experience. Never going back.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Wasn't allowed in because my shirt had intentional rips in it  ...................... I watch girls wearing lingerie get in but my ripped shirt was unacceptable. Maybe if I had taken it off and worn my bra they would have allowed me in. Have never ever run into this issue at any other bar ever.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
Legend, icon, hero, idol, rebel, convict.  Johnny Cash

This is a small but dynamite museum.  Absolutely enjoyed every minute taking a tour of this American original.  The museum is filled with his artifacts, handwritten liner notes, personal artwork, outfits, and walls of his hit records-what an amazing career!

We toured the Museum of Country Music the day before we went through this tour and IMHO, this one is a 10th of the size and is twice as good.  You actually get some meat on the bones of who Johnny was, what his life was like, his successes, demons, and loves.

The museum has a great little eatery and a wonderful gift shop with reasonable priced Johnny memorabilia.  

Located right off the magnificent Broadway, the Johnny Cash museum is not to be missed if you're visiting Nashville

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: This is a great venue for listening to singer / songwriters!  Everyone was respectful of the musicians and the listeners.  The food was very good also. I will go back again and again.

name: 360 Burger
text:
I took a really long break from 360 Burger. But it seems like not much has changed. I went in today around 3 o'clock. Happy hour had just started, and since it was between lunch and dinner , it was really slow. But somehow, my waitress still managed to make me wait over 5 minutes before taking a drink order. Granted, I think she was having issues splitting checks for a 6 top table. She came back just before I was getting ready to leave.

All I wanted was fries, water, and a couple bar drinks (don't judge. It's happy hour). I sat there and watched my fries sit in the window. It was sitting so long that the bartender brought it to my table. Way to go for teamwork! The heat lamp kept my waffle fries warm and they were yummy so no complaints about the food. (P.S. Try the waffle fries with onion ring sauce) The bartender also noticed that my glass was sitting empty so he refilled my water. Not once did my waitress check on me until I was noticably waiting for the check. Nor did she ask if I wanted another drink. However she brought the check back immediately. 

I wanted to tip the bartender with the awesome mustache, but he left. I try not to give up on restaurants but..... I hardly leave here happy with my experience. They used to be SOOOO good, I just keep trying to get that old thing back. :-(

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: People moan about bad service here. Get over it. The kids who work here come and go. We had great service. Maybe next week it'll be shite. But that's not a constant. And you can be proactive if you have any problems. In any case, Mondays are great. Kids on stage singing their hearts out. You know some of them are going to make it. Food is good. Beer is cheap. Audience was respectful. If you are in the area on a Monday, come here.

name: 360 Burger
text: We Stopped by for lunch after my wife had some surgery because She wanted a burger and had I  stopped once before for a drink. We were met at the door and drinks out really fast. After ordering, it took some tine to get our food get to the us. It was really good and she said that the onion rings were the BEST she every had. I have to take her word for it because I don't eat them. Was going to rate them at an 4 until she said that. My 4 rating was because of long wait to get our food but it REALLY was worth the wait.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: How on a Saturday night, can you have the only accessible bathroom be on the third floor? Who sat down and thought this is a good idea? Did you not have enough in the budget for a few more feet of pipe?

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Had a blast here! I love the atmosphere, the band was awesome. I really enjoyed the Dierks Lemonade, i would recommend that for any first timer. An employee named Thomas Lawson was very helpful, ask for him and he will show you a good time.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: The bar is dark and I used the women's stall by accident , single restrooms they all look the same. When I came out the bounce kicked me out for using the women's restroom..

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
This place is incredible! I don't know what others are talking about with the not so great reviews. I come here all the time and the service and food is incredible. I don't know of any other place in Nashville where you can actually get fresh great food while also listening to music. And the music, let's talk about that...these are the best singer/songwriters in town. Not your honky tonk cover songs. 

Do yourself a favor if you are in Nashville and visit #thelisteningroom - you will not be let down.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: We are visiting Nashville for a long weekend and wanted to go places that are more authentic and less touristy. The Listening Room delivered- great intimate venue to hear original music performed by songwriters. They ask that people not talk loudly while the performance is happening and I wish they enforced that a bit more assertively.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
Well we had to do something cultural. You can't just drink all day... hmmm. 
I was struck by what a poor job they did with this place. They had a few cool items - documents from his military service, letters and music, but not a lot of it. 
The rest of the exhibit seemed like a couple guitars "in the style" of the ones he played, video and music you could see during pledge drive on PBS, and a black jacket. I'm not sure what I was expecting, but I was totally underwhelmed.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Guys, i'm gonna be honest. The scene was good (not great). As a Nashville native, i don't really frequent Broadway. But a friend of mine wanted to go, so i went. At the inception, everyone was extremely nice; bartenders, doorstaff, restroom attendees, everyone. Then i went to the fourth floor. The rooftop which should be the hallmark of any Broadway bar. Took tons of pictures, had a great time, the DJ was playing great music, and i thought it was gonna be a fun night. However comma...The bouncers were pretentious and actually stole something from me while i went to the restroom on the third floor. I went there with two close friends and they validated the fact that the bouncers on the fourth floor STOLE from a paying guest (no, not customer, because i work in food service). Do yourself a favor and keep your effects in your pockets if you leave your table. They'll steal your smokes and try to sell them back to you. Had high expectations for this place and, other than the high-school jock clique that is the 4th floor bouncer staff, would recommend it to any visitor. Great location, great city view, great everything...sort of. And to the GM that is reading this review right now - i moved my one star to a two star because your bathroom attendee (Andre) was nice enough to give me a smoke or two for my troubles. Word to the wise; might be time to check your guys upstairs. And footnote; when i confronted them about it when i saw them smoking my brand, they denied it to my face. I promptly left.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: They are not playing Country!!!  I don't know what else to say. No Alan, No Dirks, No George. There is some Shania but I can't hear the good girl singer because they're playing the music so damn loud. Let's hear the singer!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
This place is fun, happy, lively with good bar food, sports bar, and great bands! 
Live entertainment is good and talented and friendly. Drinks are not the.best but enjoyed listening to rock n roll and a bowl game! #rolltideroll

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: I am looking forward to going back here when we're in Nashville next time! Huge Dierks Bentley fan!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: What a fun time, packed house, good music, great burger and fries. and not over priced like so many other places around Broadway. Everyone there seem to be having so much fun and just a great atmosphere. Beautiful building. Just a lot of fun.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: I came to listen to some good music and I wasn't disappointed. This is a setting in which to hear the songwriters behind all the songs you hear on the radio. These people are incredibly talented!! I cannot rate the food or drinks as I didn't have any. This is a low key country bar cafe on 2nd Ave that is the perfect ambient setting to chill and enjoy yourself. The only lighting was that of the stage and the old timey looking filament bulbs. Hard to describe but adequate lighting. There's usually a very long line waiting to get in and for good reason. Get there early and buy tickets in advance. You can also buy shirts as various other souvenirs too. All in all, a great night's activity. I'll be back!

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: I don't know what everyone was complaining about the show was AMAZING !! The view of the city was excellent and the food was great !!! We didn't have the best of servers but the manager fixed the issue and the night went on :) my son even got a high teething fever and they had a medic on board thankfully he was fine but how can you beat a service like that :) .... Also it was worth every Penney !! Sit as close to the stage as you can

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: The vibe of the place is pretty cool and you can't beat the live music. The have a decent beer selection - lots of good local options on draft.  Our food was good (we had the nachos with chicken), not anything impressive especially for the price, and the service was just average.  Also, we checked in with the yelp app and were told on the app that we were entitled to a free light beer.  Then our server checked with his manager and we were told that they weren't doing it any more and it was an error on Yelp's part...we thought it was poor form that they didn't still honor it.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: We came on a Tuesday night and the bar was pretty full and lively. The entertainers were on point and took requests. Very fun! However, no one was serving drinks. A man was walking around and clearing tables but refused to take drink orders from tables. He said they had to go to the bar, but the bartender said the gentleman (who refused service to everyone) would be around to take orders. It was frustrating because this one guy was bringing down the mood of the whole establishment by frustrating customers. We were not the only table that was annoyed and irritated. That being said, the entertainment was excellent. The entertainers took multiple difficult requests and played them well with a lot of energy and enthusiasm!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Went to this bar twice while in Nashville Tn. It was by far the most fun. We tied one on for sure! But 4 floors and elevator and numerous bands you cant go wrong.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: This place was so unexpected.  Great drinks, food, and of course music. Would suggest Kids Rock Bar to everyone.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
Very cool place,

There is a small informational musem/memorabilia & gift shop.

Great way to learn more about the Legend Johnny Cash

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: My friends and I had an absolute blast here!! We came multiple times during our trip and it was one of the most fun places we went! Great environment with super friendly employees like the security guard, Matt. I would highly recommend coming here! It definitely gets packed at night and is a great time!

name: Rack Room Blue Bar
text: Aweful place and service. It reminds you that racism is still alive. You would think that people grow out of it but there is a little reminder that you are the color you are regardless if your spouse is fighting for this beautiful country. Managers just rude definantly would not recommend this place.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text: Mediocre at best. They didn't duel at all so don't expect that to happen. It's more bad Karaoke than anything with the same three guys singing every song. Its loud. it's bad music, and bad atmosphere. They ask you to make requests every other song and they make you pay for requests. It's frustrating.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: So comprehensive I never realized the across genre impact Johnny Cash had. My favorite moments were the old flag movie, the Bob Dylan tribute that Johnny wrote, and I was in tears at the end of the museum. I could feel the heartbreak Johnny felt after losing June at the end and was moved to tears. So powerful! Can someone snap a picture of his dedication to Bob Dylan at the Nashville Skyline exhibit and post it!

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: Its been more than 3 years since I took the boat but have been four times and once for a Christmas party as well. The shows are great and food was always fantastic, very nice.  Great view of water and nice ride on the boat while enjoying dinner and a show

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: I'll start off by saying that this place is spot on! I'm a huge Kid Rock fan so I had to check it out. Loved it.  The only thing I'll say is that the bartender that I dealt with was rude. I wanted to buy a shirt. She acted like I was bothering her. I needed a certain size and without checking all the shirts just said there aren't anymore, which was true but she was not cool. Other than that, I would go back.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: This gem of a museum is half a block from South Broadway and all the bright neon lights of Honky Tonk Row in downtown Nashville. Johnny Cash and June Carter's stories are beautifully recounted in this interactive museum with listening stations, vinyl collections, stories of collaborations with other museums and stunning displays of the show costumes the couple wore. Don't miss it!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
Visited for the first time on 12/27/18. My friend really wanted to eat here, even though it wouldn't have been my first choice. We chose the third floor, which was definitely less crowded than the first and fourth floor area. Liked having the live music on each floor - all different too. For a Thursday night I thought there could have been more servers - seemed like there was only one for the floor, but there were two bartenders. Ordered drinks and those were tasty. Food seemed pretty standard for a bar. Would have liked to have had steak but I thought the prices were pretty salty. So settled for a hamburger with fries. Seemed like it took quite a long time for dinner to arrive. My meal was good and I had one friend satisfied with her meal and another friend who was not. The server and the kitchen were gracious about the order problem and fixed it - just took awhile.
Given the number of available places to eat in Broadway in Nashville, I would try a different place if I were to visit again.

name: General Jackson Showboat
text:
You aren't going on the general Jackson boat for the delicate food you'll eat lol. My group and I, 25 of us in total got to enjoy the lunch cruise and we had a great time. The buffet consisted of butter lettuce with a lot of cubes of random cheeses, the only dressing available was sour cream based aaahhhh! There was coleslaw, it was alright. The hot food buffet was a spread of yellow and brown stuff, a soft rainbow of unattractive foods: mushy tasty carrots, velveeta Mac and cheese, mashed potatoes, pulled pork, fried chicken and white rolls with butter. See? Yellows all the way lol! My very health conscious self managed though: I had a ton of lettuce (a few cheese cubes snuck in there), I got carrots and I topped the thing with pull pork (pork was good!)!! I enjoyed that very much :) Deserts were on the table: industrial pecan pie slices, sugar bombs, wasn't bad though! I ate half of it and hid it under my napkin. Meal comes with unsweetened tea and coffee at the end! Pretty cool, but again, it's not about the food, it's really about the amazing show! 
The show takes place as we go down (or up) the river all the way to downtown Nashville where we make our turn. The music is phenomenal, we have an hour of live music in the main room with our meal, the artists keep on changing their outfit, and they are on! Really want to dance and sing along, the ambiance is awesome! When the show is over, you can leisurely walk around the many decks of the boat. I suggest you check out the upper deck where more live music happens during the second half of the cruise, and see the deck below and in the back where the red paddle thingies that power the boat are located! Awesome to see and to hear. 
I loved it, it is touristy but it's totally worth it! The music is phenomenal, if you like yellow food, you'll have a blast, and you get to be on a historical beautiful boat!! Woot woot!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: I try and five a place the benefit of a one off night, but this place has disappointed 2 times in a row. Terrible service, food is mediocre at best and cost is ridiculously high. Keep walking, there are way better places than this.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
Mr. Rock pulled this one off with precision when he decided 5 stories, 5 different bands, 5 different parties!

This venue sits in the heart of Broadway and offers rooftop, open, and high visibility seating. Each layer has been separated and noise cancelled as to not interfere with the accompanying vibe of the party above or below. 

Drink prices are fair, staff was friendly and prompt oh and wearing eye welcoming clothing. 

In Nashville, you'll need to do you rounds, but don't leave Broadway without dropping by and giving em a try!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Had a great discussion with the Owner offline so I'm bumping up a star. They really care about their guest's experience, and I appreciate the effort made to follow up with me. I'll look forward to giving this place a second shot when I'm back in Nashville.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: I had a nice time here for the most part. "Devil without a cause" I'd highly recommend if you plan on getting a cocktail or two. :) The only thing I'd say is that it took a pretty good amount of time until someone came by our table top to take our order. Other than that, it was all good energy. The band/performers stay engaged with the crowd which was pretty cool as you do not see that often.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: Came to Nashville two years ago and enjoyed this bar immensely, came back December 2018 and returned to our old haunt- was so excited. Ordered tap beer and a bottle beer- the lite beer was flat and when my nephew told the bartender (short haired blond with an attitude the size of broadway) stayed  "the tap was just changed, do we want her job to check?" Ummm no, new beer- never offered went to the end of the bar to complain with a coworker. Five minutes later, she came over and I stated she should give the couple who bought our beers their money back- she offered a bottled beer- we were leaving, again I stated we were leaving she said don't yell at her- What? Then the bouncer came up to me to ask me to leave. Absolutely, you bet I'm on my way out, but my point- I wasn't drinking- I took a sip of my nephews beer just to taste the flatness, I neither yelled nor was unruly. I just wanted her to know she should not have charged for the beer. My advice- if your in the Nashville area for fun, stay away from this bar, they are trying to take advantage of those under the influence.  So disappointed

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: We went here for the first time last night and we were super excited. But it was a let down, we had a good waitress, but the food was just ok nothing special. We tried to get a shirt but the lady who they had to go get had an attitude with us, like she was pissed she had to help us. We asked for sizes in shirts and she half ass looked and said they didn't have any. So we just left and we will not be back.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
I am down with the 'Man In Black'!  This museum was a 'must see' for my visit to Nashville!  I am was glad that this museum did such a great job of capturing some of those lesser known facts about Johnny ..such as all the movies he was in during his life!  

I enjoyed seeing Johnny's costumes, Grammy's and the personal letters that are in the museum collection. 

I enjoyed watching the YouTube videos of performances from the 60's-2000's.  There are also listening stations where you can listen to various artists who have covered Johnny Cash's songs-such a great!  

At the end of the tour-there is a section dedicated to the cover of the Nine Inch Nails song 'Hurt'!  Awesome tribute!

It is a small space, be patient with the crowds and enjoy! 

Tip:  Do yourself a favor and purchase tickets online--will save you a few bucks!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
I would give this 2.5 if I could. I know it's new and I'm sure working kinks out. 

The place looked awesome. It's a whopping 5 stories when you count the rooftop bar. The bottom two are kinda connected. The second looks over the main floor entertainment area. The stage was cool. Two tier. Very cool.

The bar on the first floor was terrible. It was huge. And that's not a good thing. The actual counter was so deep I could barely reach my drink because the bartender just barely set in on her side. Had to almost climb on top. The drinks were SUPER weak. It was $11 for my cranberry and vodka and it was basically watered down cranberry juice. 

Maybe we'll try it again sometime.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
We love going to museums, but this one is extra special. 

I find this place packed with amazing collection of Mr. Cash memorabilia, instruments, costumes, awards, handwritten lyrics and other items in the best designed museum I've seen.  Heck, it even has his original Amex card!  

Self-guided museum with numerous videos playing and iPads throughout provided details on his life and his career.  The tour shows information that most people were not aware, like Mr. Cash was in the Air Force stationed in Germany in his early twenties. Although we learn about this adventure, we don't know what influence this may have had on his career. This kind of ambiguity occurs throughout the museum, so you get an informative but superficial understanding of who he was.  Maybe it was designed that way as we all know Mr. Cash was a man of mystery.  

Plan on spending some time as there is so much to see. It can get crowded especially if weather is uncooperative.  One part of the museum that caught my eye and really enjoyed was a small area where Mr. Cash is projected on a flag while he says "Ragged Ol' Flag." 

This museum sets a standard for others to live up to. Whether you're a fan of the Man in Black, or even casually interested in this American icon, this museum is a must see. 

Cafe and gift shoppe on site.  Located just off the honky tonk of Broadway Street.

"People call me wild.  Not really though, I'm not.  I guess I've never been normal, not what you call Establishment.  I'm country."  - Johnny Cash.

name: Live Oak
text: This new place is excellent, the mushroom appetizer is super delicious, love that they make everything fresh.  The new owners are doing it right that is for sure, also a great place to hear some live music.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: I like some of his songs but not a fan of the museum. Small walk through that is a short period of time spent in there. I went in because of my group and if it wasn't included in our pass I wouldn't have gone. Small but some what informative

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: I really enjoyed my time here, but you absolutely have to pack your patience. I went on a Sunday around 2pm and the place was packed. They try to stagger the line so that not everyone can enter at once, but the signage is small, the hallways are narrow and a lot of the fun is listening to the headphones and recordings. I was shoulder to shoulder trying to read the information, constantly waiting in line to listen to the features, and frankly just a bit too annoyed for having paid $16 ($2 off for having visited the Ryman) for a museum that takes about an hour. The museum is brand-new and beautiful though. They have a ton of memorabilia and it was absolutely worth a stop, but try to go first thing in the AM.

name: Live Oak
text: This place was delicious! I got the mushroom and Swiss burger and the waffle fries. SO yummy. Our bartender was awesome-- I forget his name but he had a Mohawk and worked the lunch shift today. I would absolutely recommend this place.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
This place is new and I'm not quite sure it knows what it's doing yet, but Kid Rock stopped in the night we were there and it was pretty cool. 

3+ floors - we never went high enough to see if there was a roof top.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: What a great tribute to the Man In Black. Great museum. For the man Johnny Cash was, I thought it would be a bigger museum. It was pretty awesome though. Loved the Johnny and June related parts of the exhibit. It was also nice to see the items from his friends in the original tour. Great place to see when in Nashville.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
The Listening Room is a must if you are visiting Nashville. 

Be sure to go to their website and get tickets in advance. 

My friend who is a local got us tickets and surprised us by not telling us what we were doing.  Otherwise I would not have known about this place and I would've missed out on so much. 

The listening room is like a comedy club where are you sitting in a room at tables, ordering food and drinks before and during the show while watching a performance. The difference is, the performers are songwriters and extremely talented musicians and singers. The songwriters that I saw the night that I visited had written number one hits and were all so amazing!  Before this night I didn't understand that most songs are not written by the actual performers or famous people that we see on TV. They are written by other geniuses!

The food was pretty good too considering you go for the performance not the food.

Just go!  It will blow your mind!

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: The museum is interesting but way to expensive for such a little museum. Most of the things you could do is listening to his songs which you can do on the web as well.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: This museum is not large, but it is fun. I am a Johnny Cash fan and he is one of the only country artist that I have grown up listening to (sorry...more of a classic rock guy). My wife and I really enjoyed the museum...the history, learning about his life. It took us about an hour and a half. You could breeze through much quicker if you want because it is not very big...or if you read everything it would take you even longer

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Its like a bigger dossier version of the bluebird cafe.  Great performers.  Downtown location. Valet parking.  Great cocktails.  The food is okay.  Eat at the southern or Ichiban
instead and then come here for music and drinks.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
Johnny Cash is one of my BFs favorite artists so of course we ventured down to Broadway to come here during our time in Nashville! 


We loved it! A lot of stuff packed into the exhibit. It was so neat. Loved all the photos of his family and the personal elements like the China he and June had in their home. 

Definitely would return on another vacation to Nashville.

name: Big Bang - Dueling Piano Bar
text:
Very good music venue in Nashville. They are located up on the second floor and the entrance is very small until you walk in to go upstairs, so you could almost miss it. 

Went on a Saturday night in the summertime with my wife and some friends; only took us a few minutes to find a table even though it was busy. Also, $ 6 a person for cover-not bad at all. It is a bit narrow when you go in but there is a LOT of seating because the area goes pretty far back. 

I did not try the pizza they serve but the service for drinks was good. I didn't have to wait long at the bar and they even had servers coming around to your tables to ask if you needed anything regularly. Drinks are pricey but that is expected because it's Nashville. 

The music wasn't bad-not much country being played so that's different for Nashville. I really liked seeing those who were performing playing multiple instruments-one minute a guy is on the piano and then a few minutes later he would rotate to the drums while others rotated to the pianos. That's when you know they are good! 

They will play anything-but the more you tip them the better the chances of your song being played. At times it got a little rowdy and of course LOUD, but still a fun time. I will definitely try to come back when in Nashville.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text:
I just went in this place tonight for the first time. In fact this is my first time in Nashville. The guy at the door has a personality of a nail. He asked to see my ID. I tipped my hat to show my bald head. It was just a joke. I'm 61. He just stared at me and told me since I don't have an ID that I need to leave. How ridiculous. name: General Jackson Showboat
text:
Cheesy, overpriced, and disappointing!  
I was fooled into expecting a beautiful cruise with spectacular city views and a nice dinner, a la World Yacht in NYC.  Silly me...there are no such views in Nashville, LOL!  It doesn't even pay to go onto the deck, as all you will see is swamps and warehouse parking lots.
The dinner reminded me of my high school cafeteria.  My friend paid $15 for a 20-ounce soft drink in a cheap plastic boot-shaped container.  Many of the patrons were drinking what looked like colored sugar water, certainly overpriced diabetes bombs.
The show was only about an hour long, and did not begin until 9:00.  It is a long, boring time to wait until 8 for dinner and 9 for the show, when the boarding time is 6:15.  Be prepared for a lot of sparkly costumes and a predictable salute to America.  May God bless those awesome musicians, who would probably be playing a jazz gig!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: The bouncers verbally and physically abuse women in this establishment and they get away with it. Why are there several reviews describing abusive behavior by bouncers towards women, and yet NOTHING is done about it? Do not support this business in any way.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: We had the BEST time, with fabulous food and drinks. Jake is the best bartender in Nashville! You will not be disappointed!

name: Music City Bar and Grill
text:
So, I walk into this bar, cause my horse ain't allowed, wandered over to the bar while listening to the live cover of some ole country singer and I have to say this place was happening for a Tuesday.

So as I was waiting for service the bar tender was yapping to a whoever. I waited. I waited again and I realized I should just go over there and flag her down. Maybe slow night for her.

Music was actually very good. No, it was brilliant. Ole school country music. No twang. Cowboy shit. Make sense?

Menu is crap. It's a bar. Not surprising.

It's good country and western bar. I enjoyed the ambiance.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Music wasn't too loud unlike most bars on Broadway. First floor band was prepared and acted more professional while fun. Food came in 10mins, great service and fries were yummy. 5 floors so easy to find a spot to sit down

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Typical club environment with overpriced drinks. It'd be cool if they did like most of the clubs in Broadway and have different types of music on each level. It's all country or rock. Kid rock started out as a rapper so it's strange they wouldn't play any rap on one of the levels. I probably won't be back unless they change the music, no way one can dance to country or rock

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: This place is awesome! Walked in on a Saturday night just bar hopping and before we knew it, Kid Rock started to perform on and off. He also was giving the band that was playing a musical lesson. It was so cool. The atmosphere was awesome and drinks were reasonably priced for broadway street. The bartenders were friendly and we truly had a memorable experience. I hear kid rock is there all the time so I say pop in and check it out.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Came here specifically to watch a friend play. We just ordered beers, and no food. The venue is wonderful for live music. Sounds are amazing and most seats in the house are great with views of the stage. The beers are decently priced, good mix of local beers, good craft beers and even some mainstays if you're into that. The only complaint I would have about this place is that it smells like a college bar...like vomit. Immediately upon walking in it hits you. Our entire party thought the same. Obviously didn't deter us, we stayed and watched the entire show, but its very reminiscent of college bars.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: The workers here are extremely rude. I understand that it's a really crowded packed place, but shoving a patron out of the way without asking them to move first, isn't acceptable.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Went in with my daughter who was celebrating her 30th Birthday and 1st visit to Nashville.  The bottom level was crowded with no room to sit so a police officer or security guard helped led us to an elevator for the second level.  My daughter is in a wheelchair.  There was no place for us to sit and have a drink where she could put her drink on a table.  There was only tall chairs and tables and the bar.  We wanted to like this place so I sat at the bar and she was next to me.  We were ignored for 10 minutes with waitresses all around us as we were not in a crowded area.  Not one acknowledged us for a second.  We ended up walking out disappointed.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
Pros: good atmosphere, the band played good music, decent food
Cons: really loud, band was really pushy about tips, service isn't the best

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Was cruising around by myself on a Thursday afternoon when I could hear this band playing so stopped in. The place was full, great vibe & the band CRUSHED it.  Some serious talent!!

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
On a recent trip to Nashville, one has to pay homage to this legend.

I enjoyed walking through this treasure chest full of memorabilia. The history is amazing and the stories that went with each item really helped sum up his life.

The iPads were a pleasure to use. Embedded in a series of podiums with attached headphones, one can experience a glimpse of six generations of music.

The reading  of the dozens of letters in Cash's own hand fascinated me, I even teared up a few times. June and he truly had an amazing love story.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: This is probably the single biggest party bar on the entire Broadway strip. It screams Vegas, and not in a good way. Definitely grimy like an old college bar, lots of screaming, and the service was actually a little rude. The band was a bit pushy with tips, and we felt awkward since we had just walked in and had no cash on us whatsoever. Needless to say, after snapping a couple good pictures out of their big open windows, we winded up leaving almost immediately because the vibe was not what we were looking for. Maybe on a calmer weekday evening this place would be more enjoyable, but on a Saturday afternoon it was not my cup of tea!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Really a neat place. Had a Cobb salad. It was good, by very salty. The music was good and service decent. We would go back, but nothing super special.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: We had been to several other Honky Tonks up and down Broadway and enjoyed the energy, loud music and the crowds.  One afternoon we wanted something a little less noisy, less crowded, with a softer country theme.  We found Swinging Doors Saloon almost by accident.  As was our habit, we stood outside for a bit and listened to the music.  There was a duo playing at a softer decibel level, alternating between singing together and separately, and it appealed to us.   We went in and got a seat at the bar.   It was a bit early for us to be drinking, so I just ordered Cranberry juices.   When I went to pay the bartender said she would run a tab.  When we eventually got up to leave I summoned her over to pay.  She said since we just got juice, there was no charge.   I gave her a generous tip, tipped the ban and vowed when I come back, this would be my place.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
We came in late Friday night. The first floor was packed so we took the elevator up to the Mezzanine. There is a bar at the end, standing room on one side and 2 rows of tables on the other side. We were able to get a low table on the balcony and had a good view of the band. There is no service at the tables so you have to go to the bar for a drink.

The sound and lighting were very good. The band played AC/DC, Metallica, Guns & Roses, etc and were very good, entertaining, and interacting with the crowd. However, every hour they came around with a tip jar. I don't mind tipping, and tipping well for really good service. I didn't like that they come to each table every hour and stop with the tip jar on your table.

name: Dan McGuinness Irish Pub
text: I enjoyed my experience greatly.  The service was good and the food was fresh. I got the turkey wrap and fries. It was so yummy!  2.50$ happy hour for wine...wowzers! Next time I'm trying the shepards pie. My bf got the prime rib and he said it was excellent.  I enjoyed the atmosphere (6:00ish),  the stain glass ceiling was cool. I'll definitely be back :-)

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Pity I didn't get to see this in all its glory as they're currently renovating / extending but this is a must see if you're in Nashville!

name: Dan McGuinness Irish Pub
text: Sunday drink specials are awesome, but service is a dart throw - sometimes great, sometimes dreadful.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Did the backstage tour and fell in love!! This place has so much history and such a wonderful friendly staff! You learn so much and get to do things that you never imagined a venue like this would show you! Very wonderful place I highly recommend!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Wow, just what I was looking for. The live band rocked and played a lot of timeless music. Some really cool at work as well. All in all I was very pleased with my visit.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: First off the management at this place is ridiculous. We came from out of town and made a reservation for a Sunday night. When we called initially we were told NO COVER CHARGE. When we called to confirm our reservation the same day the girl on the phone was so confused and couldn't really help us. She told us that there might be a cover (even thought we were already told there wouldn't be one), but it wouldn't be more than $2 per person. When we arrived at the restaurant just before our reservation there was a sign that said $5 cover fee per person. Needless to say we were pissed. The amount kept changing and going up, despite being told that we wouldn't have to pay a cover. When we asked the front desk about it they basically told us that if it starts to get busy they can just increase the cover as they please, which is a major rip off, considering their food prices are relatively high. There was also a mix up with our bill and we ended up getting charged for our meal and someone else's, even though they promised they had fixed it. When we went to leave the cover had GONE UP AGAIN. Other than that the food was amazing! We had gumbo, full rack of ribs and some fried pickles. Great portion sizes and amazing flavor. The stuff is a little pricy, but most places in the big city are. The waitress was really nice and super friendly. However, despite the food and friendly service I would not go back because it seems like they just want your money because of the cover charge!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Cool vibe and great music. Come for the music and the drinks. Food is good, but not great.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: Enjoyed my visit here. It is in a dark alley, but once you walk in it is full of life. I had the black bean burger and fries and a few cocktails. I enjoyed it all and have found myself thinking about when the next time I can go back!

name: Back Alley Diner
text: This places was suuch a pleasant surprise. We were on a day trip from Louisville on a Saturday and were having trouble finding parking downtown. Once we did, this place was down an alley right behind us. Looks a little sketch from outside but don't let it fool you. It's clean, nice and spacious inside. Great music too: nirvana, white stripes, Marcy playground, etc. Server was awesome. Only thing I noted was that I wanted to black bean burger (I'm vegetarian) and they were out. But they had a veggie quesadilla and threw in some fries for free since they were out of the burger. Also was not busy at all for a Saturday night! Not dead either. Also had a full bar. Overall great experience.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Wow! By far my favorite part of the trip. We took the backstage tour of the Opry and wow was it worth every penny. You get to see where the musicians enter, dress, sound check etc. sends chills down your spine thinking famous musicians like Johnny Cash, June Carter, Keith Urban, Loretta Lynn, Carrie Underwood all walked that stage. We were able to walk into the stage and take a picture of the circle that came from the original building. Such an experience and I suggest to any first timer to come to the Opry for a backstage tour and possibly a show if they have time

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: We've been here several times over several years, and each time has been more unpleasant than the last. Service is consistently poor - last night we were overcharged after a very long wait for our beer, and then the server lost our credit card (it was found but only after s lot of stressful searching on our part). The place is always noisy and parking is problematic. It gets two stars only because they have a wide selection of beer and were open when others were closed.

name: Music City Tippler
text: Fun atmosphere and great bartenders. However, I went to the bar and not to eat, and as a fair warning I went on a Saturday night and the crowd skewed younger as the night went on (early 20-somethings)

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Everything we have gotten  is good. However the services atrocious. It took more than 20 minutes for a waitress to come five. After that it took another 20 minutes for drinks to arrive. Our lady peed twice since she's been here. Service is terrible. We wish could walk out, but supposedly our meals put on their way

name: Back Alley Diner
text: Quick lunch spot, service was decent and food came out fairly quick. I got the hot chicken sandwich which was average. The bread is dry and toasted, but the chicken had too much of a sweet flavor to it. The coleslaw was very bland, even after a ton of pepper to it.  I would go back, but I would stick to a burger.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: We decided to stop by Back Alley Bar while we were waiting for a table at a nearby restaurant. It was a good place for a quick beer. Our server was very nice, the drinks were cheap. When we went there wasn't a great vibe, probably because it was a Tuesday night.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: The tour is a lot of fun! It's very informational and it gives you a good look at what goes on behind the scenes on the opry! Our tour guide was Bridget; she was awesome!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Great music! Fun dancing... Decent food. SLOW service. Make sure you don't have a tight schedule you won't get out of here in less than 2 hours. They are super polite though.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: The Suacer is one of my favorite bars in Nashville. They have an amazing selection of beers and the taps are always rotating. Everytime I got to the Suacer I end up trying something new. They also have a club where if you drink 100 beers they put your name on a plate on a wall and give you a shirt. It's always fun looking at all the plates lining the walls. Oh, and did I mention that the food is pretty good too?

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text: Lots of fun watching some talented wannabes and doing sing alongs. Ok service. Never offered food though they supposedly had it. Drinks seemed expensive... The late afternoon and early evening crowd was fun. Around 8 the drunk college kids showed up and were rowdy and obnoxious. We left as did anyone over 30 (we had more than enough to drink). Bathrooms are in an adjoining bar... very weird. I'd go back. It only during the day to avoid the rude crowd.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
We were walking back to the hotel after dinner and craving some live music.  Yelp showed us we were very close to BB King's Blues Club.  We had a little difficulty finding the actual entrance, but once in we were golden.

We scored a two top right next to the stage, where the band was already tuning up.  Our waitress got our drinks immediately and recommended the half order of the fried pickle app for snacking.  Perfect.  Drinks were decently priced, large and boozy.

We stayed for the first couple of sets.  Live blues was the perfect end for our first day in Nashville.

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Good dogs. I had their Nashville and the BBQ with bacon. The Nashville was to big but the BBQ was great.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Beer selection is very good but not outstanding if you are accustomed to great beer joints. It is what you would expect out of a corporate chain. All in all a good experience and well worth the stop

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text:
Dawg House is one of my new favorite places to go on the weekend! I went for the first time on a Saturday night with (around 12:30am) and the place was surprisingly empty. We were unsure as to why, but figured it was a good place to have a drink and check out the place! Drinks were amazing and reasonably priced! Bartenders were friendly and knew the menus well--a few even got out on the dance floor!

The DJ was the best part for me (young guy who is there Friday and Saturday nights until 2am). He played a great variety and had no problem dancing with us on the dance floor. He created a fun atmosphere and I will definitely be back next weekend!

name: Back Alley Diner
text: This is a great place right in the heart of Nashville where you can grab a drink and have a good conversation with friends. It's rarely too loud or overcrowded, and the employees are friendly. The drink prices are also some of the best in downtown. If you're looking for a cool low-key place to have some drinks with friends and escape the insanity of broadway, this is your spot.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
If you are American, you have to visit this place, even if you don't like country music.  Every seat in the house is great, they really treat guests like guests, and the show is always good; sometimes it's a surprise.  They do a good job of keeping the tradition of country music alive.  

What I loved about this place was how easy it was to get in, and to get out again.  The GOO makes it almost effortless.  

I am not a country music fan, but I loved the tour, I loved the history, and, most of all, I loved the show.  

When in Nashville, find the time to visit the Opry, and be sure to take the tour.

name: Belcourt Taps
text: Would not recommend. For a place called "taps" beer list was only about 10 beers long. Took 40 minutes to get our food. When it did, fries and burgers were all cold. Burgers were over cooked. "Over easy" egg had completely solid yolk. Was upcharged for the cajun fries and garlic fries when they are literally the frozen fries with a sprinkle of Cajun salt and minced garlic. Food should have been $3-7 range but was $12-20.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: I traveled to Nashville recently and was excited to try the Flying Saucer. On my way to the establishment, the cab driver warned me that it's a good place to have a beer but the service wasn't very good. I went despite this and I wish I wouldn't have. Unfortunately, he was absolutely right. The waitress was very rude for starters, never once smiled and acted annoyed and as if she was doing us a favor. My friends pop was very flat and she let out a sigh, walked away before she could even order something in it's place and set it in the bar behind us and continued walking. When she finally came back to our table, my friend wanted to order something else besides water and she said that she couldn't do anything about it and all the pop would be like that. The carrots and celery we had with our meal should have never been served. They were brown and discolored. We asked for new vegetables and the second set of vegetables was the exact same. We all were very disappointed. The only reason I am not giving 1 star is due to the beer selection.

name: Ms. Kelli's Karaoke Bar
text: It's a Dive Bar! Get's crowded, Smoking is allowed. My review has nothing to do with that, but I got 3 bud lights and a water, they charged me $65 dollars on my card, and said that's what they had on my tab. I repeated and said, I only had 3 bud lights and a water, this is impossible. They said, all it takes to order on my tab is my name and someone must have ordered. My last name is foreign and very unusual. Plus, that is not how you argue charges to your tab. If that is how you operate your business, you have a lot of room for robbing people, which is what happened to me. I was robbed here by the Bar Tenders.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: The BBQ chicken sandwich was fantastic. The chicken was cooked beautifully and the sauce was delicious. Price was mid tier. Food came so quickly so it was good for a quick lunch during work. The ambience was delightful. I would definitely come back.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Definitely go here for the music! There is a cover charge but if you stay for awhile it's worth the entertainment value. We had drinks and BBQ nachos. The drinks were good but the nachos didn't sit well with us. The staff is hard working and friendly.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Had to pay to get seated in front of a speaker of the live band- that was 5 feet away from us that literally yelling at my server was having a hard time taking my order. Couldn't talk to anyone else at the table, ran into by everyone else passing by. The food, wow, the food was so bad and over priced that we literally left it and paid our tab and just grabbed pizza down the street. This is just a terrible tourist trap.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: I was visiting from Michigan with my family and I loved it! I like BB King and the live blues music here was pretty amazing! I was happy to see live sports on TV and be served by a very friendly woman! Pulled pork and hush puppies were good! The meatloaf/mashed potatoes/green beans as well! Everybody please try it

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Cover charge for band...HORRIBLE!!!!!  We went to a TON of different places in Nashville, & this was the ONLY place that charged us a cover charge for the band before entering.  When he asked for our $10, I thought, "wow...this oughta be good!!!"  Yeah right!!!  The band went on "break" as soon as we sat down.  The bartender said he only allows them a 15 min break maximum.  Yeah right...35 mins later they finally came back. We originally sat at a table, but didn't get any service, so we went & sat at the bar.  Lots of red flags so far.  We ordered the fried green tomatoes appetizer, and they were nothing grand at all.  Forgettable.  My husband ordered their cheeseburger sliders, but they were out so he chose the pulled pork sliders with a side of mac n cheese and I had the bbq chicken.  Sliders were standard, same with the bbq chicken, and the Mac was less than mediocre.  Not much flavor at all.  We walked out of this place irritated & disappointed on many levels and will not recommend this place at all to people traveling to Nashville.  They should be ashamed for charging a cover charge for the band.  How embarrassing.  Guess there not doing very good business & have to rip off the public to make ends meet.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Open Christmas night! Great beer selection. Friendly and accomodating staff-put on our football game and was extremely nice. Fun atmopshere and family friendly.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
Super good food! Gumbo is fantastic. I had the chicken and ribs combo, which was just amazing. Great drinks, too. Great atmosphere, especially if you're done with the Honky Tonks. 

The band didn't play blues...so that was a little disappointing, but the food was worth it!

They charge a cover even though we bought a ton of food... Not sure about that one. 

Another plus is that this is one of the few places with live music where kids are allowed, if you have one with you

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text: The best karaoke bar ever. The lineup wasnt too long of a wait when I came in. The crowd was extremely kind to me during my performance and a lot of people congratulated me after my song! We were able to make some great friendships. Long live "Mr. Brightside"

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Absolutely amazing! We took the tour and being able to see the rooms and each room has its own theme was amazing. Being able to be on the stage that all these amazing country artists have performed on was amazing. We even got to see the musicians mailboxes where dan mail can be sent and the artists pick them up there. They also showed us where parts of the show Nashville was filmed. They also educated us in the flood that cause a lot of damage and temporary closure of the Opry. If you love country music, this place is a great place to visit and learn about how much of a role this place takes part in its history!

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text:
This joint is the jam- literally.

Drinks were affordable, crowd was friendly, and 99% of the people on stage sounded like legit professional vocalists.

I'm used to the karaoke bars in California- drunk bachelorette parties belting out horrendous boy band songs incredibly off key.  

WannaB's was a serious talent showcase.  Next time I visit Nash I'll be back for SURE!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: The food was really good the band that was playing that night was excellent I love the atmosphere and the location I'll be back again it was just a really great time

name: Ms. Kelli's Karaoke Bar
text:
Be careful of how you treat people, especially if you are a business owner, because you never know how it could come back to haunt you.

I love when people show you who they really are, especially when their true colors are those of a bigot.  

A friend of mine was in Ms. Kelli's bar the other night and questioned the aggressive behavior of one of the bartenders towards her brother.  Discovering that the aggressive "bartender" was just hanging out behind the bar and didn't even work there, Ms. Kelli intervened and said that it was her bar and she can have anyone behind there that she wants and started hurling derogatory comments to my mild-mannered friend calling her "it" and "him/her" and asking them to be escorted out of her bar.

This is NOT okay.  But you know, now we know.  She might as well put a sign in front of her business identifying herself as a bigot and homophobe.  We are a tight knit community and we have lots and lots of expendable income and guess who WON'T be getting any more of our money??

This place is a dump in more ways than one and correct me if I'm wrong, but isn't it a violation of the TABC to have a non-employee behind the bar?  Especially if they do not have their Alcohol server permit?  Just asking...

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
Easy going atmosphere was nice after a long drive to Nashville. Service was friendly and attentive, at least at the bar where I was sitting. Burger was good but nothing special. Fries were pretty good. 

Music: It was a songwriters night and the music was less than wonderful for the most part. I know there is better talent than that in this town.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Be very careful about reading the fine print when you purchase your tickets. We spent a lot of money and flew people in from out of town to see a show and the big name artist canceled a few days before. As a customer, you have zero recourse and I'm told this happens often. Buyer beware. This is a situation where the Grand Ole Opry likes to remind it's customer "sorry, that's our policy. You are SOL."  

If this happens to you, forget the show and head down to Broadway for some live music. It's a better experience.

The show itself is a bit laughable.  Since it is a radio show they literally announce advertisements after every song. For such a historic and traditional venue, this certainly creates an odd feel. The performers themselves are a medley of country music talent. We had an 88 year old guy perform and also comedic fiddle and banjo band that was very hokey. They also threw in an actual comedian that was reminiscent of the Catskill New York resorts in the early 80's.  

I absolutely love country music but I felt like I was seeing a current day Hee Haw live.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: House band was best I've ever heard. BBQ tots are awesome. This place is a definitely must visit for out of towners. Uber or Taxi from your hotel or be prepared to pay anywhere from $10 to $40 for parking.  They are kid friendly and will allow them when band plays.
