name: Back Alley Diner
text:
I was trying to go to a restaurant down the street, I was on business and they had over a 30 minute wait.  I came to this location instead and was pleasantly surprised. I had some wings which were delicious - crispy and well seasoned.

I follow that up with a bacon cheeseburger sans bun, which was exceptional - well cooked, juicy, great flavor. Service was also excellent at the bar.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Love B B King, the place needs to be playing BB King music, and needs better pa system. Big problem is that there is a photo of Clarence Gatemouth Brown and the artist painted the name Clarence Gatemouth Moore on it. There was a artist named Gatemouth Moore but his first name was not Clarence.  The photo is a picture of Clarence Gatemouth Brown. Damn, some museum.

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Great bar!! Came here for a girls trip, great food, great drinks and great workers! Thank you Key, we'll be back!

name: Back Alley Diner
text: We got the drinks quickly but waited 50 minutes for the food. We just ended up leaving since we were late for the concert.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
I visited Nashville for a conference. A group of us had a lunch reservation for 10 but we ended up being the only people in the restaurant. This is obviously a night time place because the energy and vibe was dead.  

I loved that they have happy hour during lunch time. When in Nashville I guess.  

Although we were the only people, I assumed our food would be delivered quickly.  Most folks had salads and there were a couple bbq sandwiches but it took more than 40 minutes to get our food.  

Food was really good but had to eat it fast in order to get back to the conference on time.  Would love to come back but at night to listen to a band or 2.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
The website doesn't specify that if one has dinner there, one can also watch the band play.  Definitely make a reservation though.

NYE weekend, how is it possible they run out of fried pickles, gumbo, salmon, tuna, cornbread, and green beans???????  The waitress informed us 30 minutes after we ordered that they're out of one item, so we had to order something else.  When one entree arrived an hour later, we're informed they're out of something else we ordered.  The ribs were burnt, but I was so hungry I didn't care.  The pulled pork sandwich was cold and bland.  My husband liked their corn and jalapeno fritters.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Always a wonderful show, full of talent from young ones to older accomplished artists.  The staff is friendly, which I attribute to the Opry hiring an 'older' more seasoned generation of workers who actually DO care and know about customer service! Amen and may the Opry continue strong for years to come!

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
The good: if you're looking for a dive bar with poor to mediocre food this is your place. Potato chips were amazing though. Food came out super fast. 

Bad: overpriced (not very well made) cocktails, food is poor to mediocre. Pulled pork platter had a disappointingly small serving of meat that was dry and not very flavorful. BBQ sauce was bottled Sweet Baby Rays I think. Grilled cheese wasn't grilled, cheese wasn't even melted. Burgers were average to above average. 

Net: we will not be back.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: The service here is always horrible. It doesn't matter how cute you look in a school girl dress- you should be able to manage your tables effectively. I am always underwhelmed by the service. Thank god for the beer selection or I'd never go back.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Have I mentioned that we are not "country fans"?  But we were told that we MUST go to the Grand Ole Opry when in Nashville and we are sort of "When in Rome" people.  It was blast.  This is going to prove what non-country fans we are, but neither of us knew that the GOO (as it is known by its fans) is actually a regular radio show.  The first time the announcer came on with his cheesy radio voice to say, "This segment of the Grand Ole Opry is brought to you by Mrs. Dash's"  We had to stifle our laughter.  

That said, the whole thing was AWESOME.  I left ready to convert and buy myself a sweet-ass pair of cowboy boots.  The musicians were really talented.  The vodka/cran and beer somewhat reasonable, and a perfect length of time.  It isn't too cheap so I'm not sure that I would bring the kids but it sure was a great time.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
The wife and I made a recent weeklong trip to Tennessee, and we decided to do a nice mix of touristy visits as well as hit the local spots. Since we are both fans of country music, we decided that while in Nashville we would have to do the Grand Ole Opry tour, and I'm really glad we did.
I was glad we called ahead- they offer tours throughout the day, however some days they have big shows and events going on, so it's not every day, and we were able to swing out and join a tour during a Thursday evening. We got the backstage tour, and it was worth every penny.
You see some short videos from country music stars, television stars, and historical musical figures. You walk through the entire backstage area, including dressing rooms, sound stages, mail areas, and more. Our tour guide was very friendly, very informative, and really made the tour enjoyable. Although I'm a country music fan, I never really watched the Grand Ole Opry- I learned a lot on this tour and was amazed at the HISTORY of the building and the stars that have performed there. 
For the finale of the tour, you walk from the backstage area onto the stage itself, and I have to say I was breathless walking through the curtain. To take in the view of the audience seats, and to stop and really think about the LEGENDARY performers that had taken that same walk, I was really moved. Especially standing on the famous circle that came from the Wyman auditorium to the Opry- knowing I was standing on the same piece of wood that Johnny Cash, Garth Brooks, Minnie Pearl and others had shared.... I didn't feel worthy, but it was an amazing moment.
If you're a fan of country music or music in general, this is an absolute must-do. Make sure you call ahead, but take the trip out, especially for the backstage tour. Absolutely worth every penny, it was a lot of fun and very informative. I would definitely come back, and would love to catch a show some time. Definitely worth the trip, especially if you're staying in Nashville!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: The food here is awesome (I had the pulled pork sandwich) and Alexandria was a very nice and attentive server! Will definitely come back.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: I really liked how HUGE this place was. We went around 10pm on a Saturday night and did not have to wait for drinks. The bartenders and servers were working quickly while giving us knowledgeable suggestions on beverages. I really like the diversified selection and the menu sorted by type of beer. Great TV visibility, would be solid to watch a game here. Would visit again.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: I  visited B.B. Kings on Saturday, May 31, 2014. I had a party of 7. I was impressed that they were able to seat my party within 5 minutes without me having a reservation on a crowded Saturday. The atmosphere and decor is very nice. Our server was very attentive. I had a salad and black pea hummus which was filling. Additionally, I enjoyed our appetizer which was  Spinach Dip. My group enjoyed their food, however, it's took around 35 minutes for us to receive our order and the portion sizes were sort of small. Additionally, my guest did not enjoy their cocktails. However, the house band made up for the cons, because they were awesome. They knew how to get a party started. I will definitely be back.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: The Yazoo creole catfish was awesome. Spinach dip is good also. Adam McDonough does a great job of entertaining. Great place for food and music.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Walked into the ticket office, no other customers in line. However, no greeting from any of the three ticket agents so I had to ask for assistance. Not a warm, welcoming environment.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Just great.  You already know this is the best place in the world to see and hear country music performances so I won't bother with that.  Get your tickets early for best seating.  Tickets may or may not be available the day of the show, but if they are, the seat selection is sure to be limited.  There is a security line to get in so leave those pocket knives in the car (you'd think people would have learned that by now, but last night the guy ahead of us opted to throw his knife in the trash rather than going back to the car, or maybe he came on a tour bus and didn't even have the option of going back to the car).  The lobby is inviting.  Several concessions inside sell all kinds of drinks and a few light food items.  There were some outdoor BBQ concessions doing dogs and burgers (maybe more, we didn't really check them out) out front before the show.  Restroom lines can get long so be prepared.  There's also the gift shop to get your Opry souvenirs.  Go, enjoy and have a good time.

name: Ms. Kelli's Karaoke Bar
text: The owner of this bar, Kelli, was intentionally rude and hateful to a friend of mine last night. Referring to my female friend as "him/her" and "it" when telling her to leave. I won't support Kelli's bar ever again and you shouldn't either. It is this type of small minded bigotry that perpetuates hate.

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Very excited about watching the Alabama game with other fans but we did not even make it in the door. 2:00 in the afternoon and a 53 year old me  and her 66 year old husband were turned away because I left my ID at home! WTF? Place was pretty much empty. Ridiculous!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
We went to the Grand Ole Opry at 1 p.m. for a tour. The tour is a must if you love country music.
They take you backstage and show you the entrance only the ar totists come through.
They will show you the different dressing rooms and the large room where the country singers get together before the show.
Went back there at 7 p.m. to watch Luke Bryan. He put on a great show.
Make sure you get there a little early because the lines are very long.
If you go to Nashville and enjoy country music this is a MUST!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: So much for Southern Hospitality.  Our long anticipated holiday in Nashville was just disrupted by a winter storm, causing us to have to miss the Opry tomorrow night.  I called the box office in tears. Non refundable tickets I'm told - too bad so sad for us. .

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: It was 11 of us so it took so long for us to get seated. We were on a girls weekend getaway. The food and the customer service was just ok. The music was ok as well. We danced a little bit that was fun. I really do have to go back to Nashville to explore more.

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text: The Redneck Riviera is a patriotic joint which accommodated our Army unit reunion. The bartenders were great and the music was good.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: What happen to this place? Gross and nasty .. crap all over the chairs and floor cannt even sit and relax.  Afraid to order a beer it looks so dirty.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Beautiful intimate theatre but a word of advice, go to the early show on Saturday! I believe it's at 7. If you go to the later one...at 9? You will be waiting for the other show to finish, not be able to sit down, even more difficult to find parking with double the people there that haven't left the early show yet. I must also say, I went to see Vince Gil, he sang 2 songs, 1 which was a cover and 1 a tribute to Merle. While it was a very touching song, I was extremely disappointed and heart broken that I didn't get to hear more classic Vince Gil songs ;(

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: We were blessed to walk into BBKINGS in Nashville for lunch! We were lucky enough to have met Alexandria our waitress.  It felt so good to have someone who not only took great care of us, but she was an  amazing person. It is rare to see someone who loves what she does. BB would be proud that she represents his memory! We will definitely be back and will ask for Alexandria  ( we are not family either- just really happy customers )

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
I had so much fun at the Tuesday night, 9:30 show which featured Bill Anderson, Levi and Marcus Hummon, the Gatlin Brothers, Carrie Underwood, Henry Cho, Eric Paslay and the Oak Ridge Boys. 

We sat in Section 7, Row G, 11, 12 and 13 which was up close, but far left when facing the stage.  Wish were a little more towards the center.  

The live music was great.  I think I'll return every time I visit Nashville.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: The show was fantastic and we had great seats. It's not a cheap evening but it was well worth it! We attended a tour earlier in the day that was also great. I thought the price of the tour was a little high ($33 each) to then want $25 for the picture you took in the circle. Cool, but gimmicky. We passed on the picture.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: We've eaten at B.B. Kings in Las Vegas and loved it so we were excited to try another location. We were not disappointed!  The BB Kings All-Star band started playing while we ate. They were phenomenal. Ribs and chicken were delicious. Love their BBQ sauce.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
We went to a performance while we were in Nashville For a reunion.  We had been once before back in the1980s and all I remember is that there weren't many seats behind us.  Of course, after this much time, I have no idea who was playing back then, attending a show at the Opry was just something you have to do when you are in Nashville, sort of like seeing Elvis when you are in Las Vegas.

This time we had much better seats as part of our group and we knew that Carrie Underwood was getting top billing.  The show is broadcast live so it included the commercials as well as the performances and consisted of four distinct half hour shows with several different artists for each one as well as a different MC.  Carrie Underwood was in the last segment and sang several of her songs beautifully.

Overall we had a really great experience this time and I even recognized names and songs of some of the other performers like Ricky Skaggs, Jeannie Sealy, and the Whites.  I'm not a regular at attending concerts or live shows lately because I don't like dealing with crowds and traffic, but the Grand Ole Opry was well worth it!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
How do you give the Grand Ole Opry anything less. 

The best please for history of country music and a chance to see a big name while there. Love it.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
This review is for the Backstage Pass tour that occurs every 15minutes. Purchasing tickets that day was a snap and getting to the right location to start, very clear. I always felt like I was being directed with confidence and a bit of humor. 

Tour guide was energetic and had a few quilts to give us a chuckle. It was really cool to walk the same area that country legends walk before and after the show. Checking out the dressing rooms and getting a picture on the stage was memorable as well. The only bummer is I really don't like it when you can hear other tours going on - it takes away from the experience. We heard two separate tours for a few moments during ours. Lastly, gift shop clothing was awesome!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: We reserved priority seating for two at 5:30 on a Tuesday to assure time for a 7:30 performance at TPAC and were seated promptly. There were only 20-25 people there so the reservation definitely wasn't needed. No one came to get our drink orders for at least 20 minutes, although several waiters passed by our table and made eye contact. An attempt to flag one down was blatantly ignored. When our waitress finally arrived (we suspect she was late to her shift and nobody covered her table), the service was adequate but not spectacular. My gumbo was tasty but was served warm--definitely not hot; not a wisp of steam was to be found. My husband enjoyed his pasta. We weren't offered a second round of drinks. Checked off list; doubt we'll return.

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text: One of my favorites on Broadway! It is smaller than other bars, but the beer is not overpriced and the atmosphere is great.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: We had so much fun at the Oprey! The grounds are beautiful. Even though it was a sold out night the lines weren't bad and everything went really smooth. There was a little bit of a warm up and pre show so arrive early. The show is awesome. On the night we went there was a great line up finishing up with Little Big Town. Every act was great. The interaction with the audience and the small personal theater make it magical. If you are ever in Nashville be sure to go to a show, or 2 at the Oprey! You won't be disappointed!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: In a recent trip to Nashville, some of my friends and I decided to grab tickets to The Grand Ole Opry. I had watched it as a kid and wanted to have a taste of that old nostalgia. We were not disappointed. The Opry is in a newer building on a big property with a huge shopping mall and hotel. You could make a total day of it or ride in shortly before the show and walk around the Opry. The mall has newer stores. The hotel has restaurants and the Opry offers entertainment almost nightly. I highly recommend grabbing your tickets in advance which you can do on their website. The hook is that you buy the tickets but you dont know until the date gets closer who will be playing that night. We were totally lucky and got to see Carrie Underwood with The Oak Ridge Boys. She was amazing!!! The show house is set up in seats that resemble church pews. The show is recorded and you are part of the live studio audience. They even have the ON AIR sign! NOTE* go into the gift shop BEFORE the show. After the show you are ushered out and the only way to the gift shop is to get back in the line to get into the concert ,AGAIN! so be sure to make time for that BEFORE the show. There are drinks and food options outside the show area and you can take drinks inside the show house. The Opry is not close to downtown and requires an uber and or a ride to get to. Plan on at least 20 min or so to get out to the area. Would recommend to anyone visiting that has the time to make it out that way.

name: Ms. Kelli's Karaoke Bar
text: Rude and ignorant security. Would never go back for the way he treated my friend and husband.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: We visited B.B. King's in Nashville and overall enjoyed it.  The music was outstanding.  The service was excellent and fast.  The appetizer's were good and the drinks were good.  The entree's, however, were "ok".  I have been to most the B.B. Kings in the USA on a quest to get souvenir glasses from each location.  Memphis still has the best location - food wise.  But no matter what you can't go wrong with B.B. Kings.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
If you're in town this place is a must! The live show was very entertaining, drinks were great (they didn't skimp on the alcohol), the pew seats were actually very comfortable and I didn't feel like I was encroaching on the other person. Actually, I  think more venues could benefit by having this type of seating. The artists were very down to earth and each played a couple songs a piece. The comedians "The Indian and the White Man", hysterical and the amount of patriotism felt in the room was overwhelming!
Side note *Grand Ole Opry Hotel* leaves a lot to be desired!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: No trip to Nashville is complete without attending a performance at the Grand Ole Opry.  The lineup doesn't have to have a huge headliner to be entertaining. Every performer we saw connected with the audience. You might even get lucky and witness a performer make their Opry debut! Also, I f you attend a performance at the Opry, a backstage tour is a must. Our guide was knowledgeable, engaging, and full of interesting facts. It was clear she loves being a part of the Opry. You walk the same path as the performers, visit the dressing rooms, watch a short film in the old HeeHaw studio and stand on stage, in the sacred circle, to have your picture taken. Even if you're not a country music fan, it's a fun experience.

name: Music City Tippler
text:
Gorgeous new bar, decent spirits list, helpful staff. A little "hipster meets country chic" vibe here. 

When we were here I sort of felt like it was a bit of a tourist trap, but the food and drink selection was nice and it was swankier than other bars and restaurants I visited on my trip.

There was definitely a ton of attention paid to the decor and every detail here. Heck, I think you even have to be good looking to work here! But I suppose that's all a part of the experience. The space is cool, the employees are cool, and so you feel cool.

Plenty of room for small groups, large groups, private parties, or just a nook to snuggle up in with a date for a drink and a bite. If Portland and Beverly Hills had a baby, it'd be at Nashville at Music City Tipler. Hip, but almost to the point that it felt like they were trying just a smidge too hard.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: If you're not into country music or are looking for a change, BB King's is a great place to grab a bite to eat and enjoy live music.  You can make a reservation or just walk right in.  We were seated at a table front and center.  This was great other than we couldn't carry on a conversation until the music stopped.  Something to think about when coming with a group and if there are any people in your group that are hard of hearing.  Not the clubs fault, just advising any future patrons.  Our waiter was relatively new but he did a great job.  He was attentive and when the music was playing, he wrote down what he was saying so we knew what was being said.  Smart!!  Maybe supply your wait staff with small marker boards.  Would be a funny, and smart way to communicate with your customers while the music is playing.  Would definitely help alleviate frustration and the continual "what?" when the music is going. They food here was great with several options to choose from.  There is bound to be something for everyone in your group.  Great change from the traditional country bars.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
There are tons of drink to choose from. My brother in law is a regular so he took us here. 

The sight is very unique. A beer enthusiast should visit this place and learn about all the saucers on the wall. You'll be entertained.  

My fav is the appetizer; chicken snack with the mojo spice. Those who enjoy the heat should totally get the mojo spice. It is tender and the fries are definitely a hit at our table. 

We ordered a pizza, but i had better. They don't really have much choice or selection for my personal liking (the only reason I gave them 4 stars). 

It is family friendly place, but they clearly want anyone under the age of 21 to not be in their premises after 7pm. Which is a good thing. Just heads up for those bringing kids there.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Recent trip to the Opry was a nice outing. It is a bit pricey for the tour le gth but the tour guides were plentiful and knowledgeable and friendly.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Loved this place, we went on a Monday afternoon and even though the place was not very busy and no live music the food was excellent!  I had the chicken sandwich and it had great flavor and was very juicy and fresh!  French fries were excellent too!  Price was very reasonable.  I would be sure to go back

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: So disappointed - the experience was just plain awful. Eight of the ten performers were "has beens" that could barely sing. I really don't know how The Opry stays in business if this is the show every Saturday night! I'm sorry I spent my money and time on this event.

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
Interesting place that is definitely worth a visit. The atmosphere inside is fun and rather cozy. However I would not return as I can cook much better food really, the staff (or the waitress who helped us) was not that fantastically cheerful and friendly, and the music the night I visited B.A.D was, ehem, awkward. 
Overall, it's a pretty cool place for hanging out with your friends, grabbing a quick bite on a whimsical, random night out.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: We are havin' some fun listening to Grant Garland and eating some GREAT food! And, the service was flawless. Ask for Tre!

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Best spot ever on a Sunday! The Spazmatics were performing and football was on! The staff is very attentive and friendly. This place gets packed, and is a lot of fun! The food is good bar food and the drinks are cheap! We visited this bar twice while in Nashville for the weekend, great discovery!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Such a great experience in the Nashville area. If you've never been, I encourage it! If you're planning a trip to Nashville, schedule it in! The lineup was somewhat disappointing for the evening I attended (all classic country and a few unknowns) but it was such a neat experience to be a part of the well-known Grand Ole Opry! The balcony has awesome seats!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: My daughter and I are celebrating her 16th birthday in Nashville, we came to BB King's because we went to one in New Orleans and the food was amazing. Some things to consider at the Nashville location, we arrived Friday night around 6:30 pm there was a $5 cover per person to get in, we were only there for dinner. But there was live music so understandable. The menu was minimal compared to the New Orleans location. The food was just good! I had a Nashville hot sandwich and she had the blackened catfish.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
This place is the bomb. Good food, music, and attractive waitresses. A little loud, but hey it's a bar right? 

The food is banging especially the rocket tots and the giant pretzels (make sure to get the queso dipping sauce). The beer selection so extensive, literally a giant black board full of beer selections. Although, I can't speak to much for the beer because I am 18, but my mom is obsessed and is halfway to getting a plate on the wall (200 beers). This place is also vegetarian friendly, for a while my favorite thing on the menu was the garden burger. 

If you are a hipster like me and can't stand pop music but is bored by classic rock, this place is also for you. They have played Passion Pit, Lorde, Mumford and Sons, Florence and the Machine, and the Caesars since I've been here (it feels like I handed my iPod to the bartender). 

The waitresses can be a little slow, but if you're not in a hurry it's not a problem, more time for talking (which we could all use). Also if you have kids get in before 9 because they start to card. I'm on a cross-country road trip and it is nice to know there is a quality chain I can count on for sweet food. Check it out!

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
Do you like beer? Do you like trying many different kinds of beer (they have over 250 different beers and not always the same ones) and branching out beyond Bud Light? If so, you should go to Flying Saucer. You wouldn't know it, but it is a chain. I admittedly have never eaten anything here (that I can remember), but I do enjoy having beer here. If I lived closer I'd even try to get myself a saucer on the wall (or ceiling). You can do this by drinking so many beers. Of course, in one visit you can only have two beers go towards the saucer (no drunk driving, people!). I actually know someone that did this! He has a saucer on the ceiling!

The service here is always great. Our server last time really enjoyed Chris' Mr. Meeseeks shirt and even did an impression (Rick and Morty fans).

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text:
First time there, not impressed won't be back. 
Prices are way too high for hot dogs. The column of the tv or music was way too loud. 
Not as clean as I thought a restaurant should be..

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Unreal is the word I would use! I dropped in here by chance because I was at the museum next door and was starving looking for a good place for lunch. Thank god I did because it was one of the best places I have eaten at in the city! I got Two Pretzels to start and the Duke Burger and would 10/10 recommend! A lot of good beer on tap to boot

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text: This is absolutely the worst bar on Broadway.  I went on Monday night and the bouncer was extremely rude.  He is chubby, tall, has dark hair and a beard and watch out for this guy.  He was extremely unprofessional, sexist, and rude, he hit on my friend and also smelled horrible.  This guy was clearly proud to be a jerk bouncer, and then once we were into the bar he kept coming in and harassing us more until we left even though his job is clearly to stand at the door and check people's IDs.  There are a lot of fun bars on Broadway, but save your time and go anywhere but here (I recommend Coyote Ugly personally.)

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Good place to catch great acts. I have seen the likes of Blake Shelton, Keith Urban, Kellie Pickler, Kree Harrison and more and it is so cool seeing them in a smaller (not arena size) venue.

name: Belcourt Taps
text: Went here to listen to a friend play live. The space was small and cozy, but around the bar area to the bathrooms was a little close for comfort. I had a bacon cheese burger and was very pleased with it. The pepper jack cheese was extra spicy, and the bacon was cooked to perfection. I loved the bun that it came on. The fries were common but a bit over cooked. I will definitely be back for the live music, but I'll try the coleslaw on my next visit.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
Our family had a positive experience at BB King's. We made a reservation with open table and had no trouble. The music was good and there was a large dance floor. The menu was not what I'm used to and felt a little challenging but I had the chicken fried chicken and it was amazing on a bed of Mac and cheese. The fried pickles were amazing. My brother in law enjoyed the ribs. My mom in law liked the skillet shrimp appetizer. Over, a good meal. 
The server we had was very friendly. The restaurant seemed understaffed for a Saturday night. Service was slow. We had plastic silverware which was also strange for a place where food isn't cheap. My fork broke as I tried to eat my chicken. 
But, it's a fun vibe and we enjoyed the atmosphere.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: There so many different selection of beers. What really caught my eye was the Kombucha beer which was very tasty. I also ordered their wings tossed in mojo cajun spice with buffalo and blue cheese dip on the side. I can't wait to come try some more brews!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: A ton of fun!  Even got last minute tickets. A fun piece of history here.  Great sound!  Nice little gift shop inside too.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: The service was appalling. Dishes from the previous guests sat on our table the entire time we were there. Even when our food was brought out, we told the person that this large pile of dishes were not ours...he just said, "oh ok" and then walked away.  Our server was extremely overwhelmed, in fact our appetizer came after we had all finished our meals. There was absolutely no air and the manager refused to open the garage doors to let in fresh air. We were only there for The Office trivia night but we will never ever be back and I will encourage people to skip this restaurant. The food was overpriced for food that's only ok. Definitely not up to Nashville standards!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: One of the best places to see Live music in the country  - This is a bluegrass lovers dream venue. Old Crow Medicine show last year was incredible - What Yankee stadium is to baseball is what The Grand Ole Opry is to Live music!

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text: Unfortunately, our bachelorette party had a really bad experience the bartenders were rude and would not serve us unless we moved to the middle of the bar. A member of our group opened "the unlocked cage" to look at shirts. The bartender finalllyyy made her way to that side of the bar where she apprended the shirt and made an accusation of stealing essentially. Explained the situation and was not taken well by the staff. When speaking to the "manager" he stated "I don't care about you or your lesbian friends". Only friendly face was the DJ who apologized multiple times for the incident (he saw entire thing).

name: Belcourt Taps
text:
I love Belcourt Taps! It has a great atmosphere, the bartenders are always friendly, and they do a lot for the music community. You never know who you'll see playing there. Could be a new young song writer or someone who wrote for George Strait. 
It's always a judgement free, fun place to be.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: This was a quant performance hall, so intimate, not matter where your seat was it was a good seat. Beautiful architecture, lots of history and the sound was amazing from the performer. It WS very intimate and personal, such a great theater

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
Just FYI... The kitchen is not open until 11pm on Sat. like stated on their website!
FAIL!!

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text: We were there for a couple of hours with a party of 8. We all just wanted a cool place to finish watching the Titan game and watch the next up coming game. We Spent well over $500. Asked for the Green Bay Packers game be turned on. We were told they have to ask the manager. The manager was nowhere to be found. We were told they were too busy look. That was not only including the bartenders, but waitstaff, 'security' and whomever else was asked. We even told them what channel.  Finally we were told that Redneck Riveria doesn't get the Fox channel. Hmmm. Every other bar had it on and we could see it on at Luke Bryan's.  This bar just doesnt happen to carry one of the major networks?! I guess we know where to not spend our money next time. Sorry John Rich.  We were hoping for so much better.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Tour Review Only: 
What an outstanding place! So glad to finally get back to Nashville for the first time since I was fourteen. My girlfriend and I were out cruising around town and decided to head to the Opry. We checked on a tour... since we were also interested in touring The Ryman we were told it would be best to buy the tickets now (on a Sunday) and just return Monday at The Opry for the tour, then you have the rest of the day to make it downtown and check out The Mother Church. Great advice.

We returned early Monday morning and off we went, through the tumultuous security checkpoint (I kid - it's not that bad, just check for weapons and the like) and over to our meeting point. They start with a cool Intro video featuring that Shelton guy, followed by the tour itself. It was a small manageable group, so that was nice! You pretty much get to go almost everywhere, including the sound stage where HeeHaw was filmed for many years! So cool!

The cherry on top had to be setting foot on the very stage where music legends have played for years. The second best part, I think, was seeing all of the dressing rooms - combined with hearing all of the behind-the-scenes stories.

It was also incredible to hear about the rough time they had during that epic flood! Amazingly, how so many great people came together to resurrect The Opry in such short time frame.

On your way out don't forget to visit the Gift Shop. You know you want to...

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
I'm not into country music like my wife but I loved the experience at the Grand Ole Opry House and would recommend it to everyone visiting Nashville.
Most of the acts were amazing.  The facility is nice inside, bathrooms are clean.  The bench seating could use improvement.  Although comfortable, with today's society mostly overweight you most likely will be squished, touching shoulders and butt cheeks together with your neighbors.  
Make sure you eat before you come to the show, there are not a lot of options at the venue and the ones that exist are really disappointing.
Enjoy!

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Walked in and walked right back out. Didn't try the food, there was no band playing. It was pretty much dead. Maybe caught them on an off night? It was a Saturday night though...

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text: Yes because what Broadway needed was another redneck loud terrible music bar with overpriced drinks.... yep not great.... plus does anyone ever clean in here?

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: This place is great! Staff were very friendly and helpful with my food and beer selection.  I am a fan of trying new things and the food was amazing.  Great beer selection too! I will definitely recommend the Flying Saucer to friends and family.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Five stars for Blake Shelton being in the video they make you watch. 

Lol seriously. 

Must do while in Nashville! Cool to see where all of our favorite artists come to make history!

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: It' s a Flying Saucer. Some reviewers here to seem not to know it's a chain, so here's a heads up, people: there are Flying Saucers everywhere. And they're fine. Lots of beer. Bar food. Typically huge so you can go with a big party. That's why I was there recently. I needed a place for happy hour with a lot of my coworkers. There are places closer and walking distance to our office on the north side of downtown, but we really needed a table that could seat 20. So Flying Saucer it is. It's nice that people who want to eat can order their food (although their food is nothing special). It's also definitely a beer place (obviously), so the beer drinkers in your party are going to enjoy it more than your wine and spirits drinkers! A totally fine place to go for a drink. Nothing special. It's a Flying Saucer.

name: Third Man Records
text:
My girlfriend Julie is a huge Jack White fan so this was a must stop. The record store is intimate but very cool. There are some really cool White Stripes/Jack White memorabilia inside.  Don't forget to peruse the t-shirt selection.

They often have art exhibits and shows in the back part of the compound so I would check the web site to see what is going on.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: We were there for the half marathon and decided to check it out. Well worth the cost! It was so cool to be walking through the doors and relive what so many country artists dream about. They show you were they wait and do their best to allow you to feel how the artist may feel when they're inducted. It was awesome! They even showed you the areas that were flooded several years ago

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text:
I'm surprised I'm even writing a review in favor of someone who sang a song called "Save a Horse Ride a Cowboy". In an otherwise godless and clichè country star owned (I mean no respect Dierks Bentley) strip of downtown that's infested with tourist and bachelorette parties stands this building. What sets it apart is what I like to call the OUTSTANDING MORAL FIBER FACTOR. Amazingly, John Rich isn't out to gobble up all your money via $15 watered down "specialty" drinks and shots. Instead he's created a business which pays homage to soldiers and pairs it with quality whiskey and on theme decorations/seating (read:redneck). Fun fact! A portion of proceeds from each bottle sold goes to Folds of Honor, a non-profit organization that provides educational scholarships to children and spouses of fallen or disabled members of the military. That's really special if I don't say so myself. 

Logistically, there are three levels so you aren't crammed in like sardines. The bartenders are attentive and live music is available on each floor. The whiskey was great and I highly recommend the bushwhacker. 

All in all, this is my new favorite bar on Broadway. It doesn't get better than a proactive bar committed to its community and those who serve us. In an otherwise greedy and insipid area of town, this is a standout for quality on all fronts.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: It was thrilling to be sitting at the Opry to me. I loved the show and had good handicap seats. Each artist does a three song routine. I would recommend and will go back next time I'm in town. Highly suggest you go

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text: Had a really great time, got to sing 1 song and enjoy the rest of night with hubby. The drink prices were a little high for size of plastic cup, but still good

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Really enjoyed this brewery... Not only good draft beer, but great atmosphere to consume tasty beverages! The outside seating was great, plenty of activities, such as darts, board games, live music and sports on TV.  My favorite Brewery to visit.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
This place is a poor excuse for an arena and organization, for that matter.
The way the staff at this Arena (corporate) treat their employees, potential employees, and customers is a disgrace.
If you're considering going there for an event, take the below into consideration:  
The food is overpriced, tickets are overpriced, staff is rude, service is slow, and it's less than an exciting experience.

However, if you're even REMOTELY considering working at this venue, you most definitely should abandon that idea immediately.  
I have never in my life encountered such a biased, cruel, and demeaning corporate staff in my entire life.  I recently went to a "job fair" at this organization and was hired on the spot.  But, I was astonished by the types of people who were getting hired left and right and the illiterate and sloppy folks who were walking through those doors and the arrogant rednecks who were doing the interviewing.  I figured there would be some classy, educated, business-savvy, smart folks working in a place that is so centrally located in downtown Nashville, one that has a major impact on the city, but I was sadly mistaken.  I was hired, put through the mill to continue the next steps of the hiring process, did as I was told, and then when it came time to pick something up from them in person, I was treated as if I was some sort of lowly peasant and they had "no idea" who I was.  Was denied the final papers I needed to continue the process without any explanation, was told I'd be called back, and never received a call (and this was AFTER I was hired on the spot).  I decided to call them back and then they tried to retract statements they had made and randomly explained that they weren't hiring me and to come back next time...again, AFTER I was already given the job.  I was treated so disgustingly and with no explanation by three of their executive staff members.   I am not originally from Nashville and had moved here just a few months ago.  I had turned down another job for this one being that they made it clear this was a sure thing and after months of looking for work, was excited to begin with this company and had the job taken from me with no idea why before I could even begin.

Word of advice to all who consider working here...if you weren't born, raised, and intend on dying in this city, don't bother walking through those doors.  They treat out-of-towners like lepers who don't deserve to be in their presence.   I am sickened by this experience and this company surely does not do Nashville justice.  Do rethink going to this venue if you at all care about equality and how people are treated.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: My boyfriend and I shared the flight (5 samples) all of the beers were very good! Prices were fair as well.

name: Ole Red
text:
Wow...after coming home from the great of place of Nashville with that great Southern hospitality, tours of the Grand Ole Opry and Ryman.  It is sad to say...we experienced some of the many reviews of the Ole Red restaurant. The standard procedure in many bars and restaurants is to swipe the credit card before the customer orders and is given service, (i.e., the credit card must be swiped and returned after the swipe). After at least 45 minutes our order was not received, then one hot dish was served but cold. They took it back. 
But the manager was nice and gave us his business card, apologized and said it was OK to leave. We were not provided a charge bill upon leaving. A charge was submitted later without my signature and most importantly, without my knowledge of being charged along with a tip. 
The is very sad...Blake is class act and we loved 'seeing' him at the back-stage tour of Grand Ole Opry. Thank you, Blake and congratulations, on being a member of Grand Ole Opry. Maybe.... a new song "Waited One Long Hour." 
Peace, love, happiness and most of all staying strong for everyone!!!

name: Ole Red
text: This is a solid choice for food and drinks on Broadway. It has a great atmosphere with almost continuous live music. The cherry limeade was delicious. If you are hungry I highly suggest the tater tot poutine. They have handmade tater tots that they cover in pulled pork, rich white gravy, and a fried egg.

name: Ole Red
text: Bad service...seated 20 minutes without a server.  When a server finally came by, they asked us to wait a while longer..  this place has some work to do to get it together.. unsatsfied customer.. update... i ordered a cider beer at the bar and they said they were out.. sitting at a table (with no service for 20 min) the table next to us was served 2 while we were waiting...

name: Ole Red
text: The atmosphere and phone the best on broadway! If you get a chance to go to the roof top ask for Jade great bartender.

name: Nashville Symphony
text: Been to 2 shows here, it's great venue for live music, classical or otherwise.  They sell beer! and wine.  Ain't cheap, but hey, it's a classy joint.  Support the Schermerhorn, you'll be glad you did.

name: Ole Red
text: The place was clean (having been newly constructed). Food was a mixed bag - pickle flight idea is good but meh, no one loved it. Wings were surprisingly good - very flavorful and well done, even though it took forever for them to cook and serve. Not a ton of other options on the menu. Service was pretty good. I wouldn't make a huge effort to go back since the music kinda sucked (come on, aren't you supposed to have the best talent?).

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: Great bar. The bartenders were awesome and very friendly. The atmosphere was relaxed but fun. The music was terrific. Go sit at the bar a spell. You are sure to drink too much and solve the worlds problems.

name: The Night Owl
text: Divey & fun.  They serve drinks and food well into the night.  The beer selection is okay.  The food is a-ight.  The servers are cool people.  It can be pretty loud, so don't expect to have intimate conversations, but it is a bar that plays music, so you probably shouldn't expect that in the first place.

name: Marathon Music Works
text: Bought tickets beforehand and had to wait in line outside for ONE HOUR BECAUSE THEY HAD ONE PERSON CHECKING IDS ON NEW YEARS EVE. I understand waiting in line on NYE but not that long if we bought a ticket in advance for a concert. Ridiculous that I paid to wait in line with for an hour. Not worth it.

name: Nashville Symphony
text: Last night's concert, Nashville Symphony and the music of the Rolling Stones, was amazing in this incredible venue.  Should be lots of pics and video posted based on what was going on around us. Apparently not really enforced!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Amazing food , friendly staff. Overall great brewery to check out. I love the outside sitting area . I highly recommend it.

name: Ole Red
text: Great music, great drinks. And clean. Richard at the bar was great. Recommended some good drink choices. Went above and beyond helping my can't decide wife make a decision. Great beer options. Good mix of original music and covers.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
Nashville Predators Play here.... Do I need to say anything else?
They have good concerts and I really enjoyed the beer festival;.
GO PREDATORS!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: I am not a beer expert by any means, but I did not enjoy any of the beers I tried in my flight. However, it is a great value to get the flight and try 5 different beers. Maybe, I didn't pick the right ones. Another gripe is none of the beers were chilled enough for me. I really wish they were colder and more refreshing. That being said, I thoroughly enjoyed the food! The cheeseboard was amazing! All of the cheeses were local, with the exception of one, I think it was imported. The bread is their homemade beer bread and it is perfectly buttered, pairs perfectly with all the cheeses and the persimmon butter. My husband had the burger, and it was delicious as well, probably one of the top burgers I've had in Nashville. I would recommend it! The atmosphere is actually really cool. I really liked the second floor patio. There are also free board games you can play while hanging out with friends. Overall, I really enjoyed the food, but for a brewery, I was really disappointed with the beers I tried.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: My friend and I stopped in here while we were bar hopping along South Broadway. We sat in the bar section by the band. Our waitress was Kiersten and she made our experience a great one! She was extremely friendly and had some great recommendations on the menu. I would send friends and family there for a fruity cocktail or beer, and a burger! The live band they had playing in the bar area was great and created a nice atmosphere.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
You stumble upon an area that is in the middle of a face lift and there is this gem shining bright. The place has a modern feel, is very clean and is off the beaten path from the rest of the Nashvegas crazies.

They offer food and I had the burger for $10 and the $7 frog legs. The burger just comes as a burger on a paper plate and I wondered....where are the chips are fries to go along with the burger? The burger is a greese bomb but full of flavors and pairs perfect with beer. You get two frog legs and they are breaded with a hot canjun seasoning. Flavor is awesome and I wish there were more frog legs to dig into. 

I tried every beer with two $10 flights and met one of the owners in the process. They are two years new and don't quite distribute outside of the brewery. They had very good beers when compared to others I had. The Ryeman and whisky bourbon aged beers were my favorite.

Live music as well and it was loud so we hung out upstairs. You order everything from the bar and it gets a bit tricky when they try to find you with the food. 

All in all a great place to grab a lunch, beer and listen to good music. They reflect a solid Nashville experience.

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
Another great experience, one I will always remember.
Everyone on staff was absolutely polite and professional.
The symphony sounded amazing and had a great night of performance.
A Lifetime memory, thumbs up.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
I had their TN No. 12, described as a Belgian-style Quad, which was delicious. Also had a porter or heavy ale, which I'd name but it's not on their on-line menu. It wasn't their Imperial, and it was acceptable, but that's all I recall.
For food, I had their pickled wings, which I didn't like the taste of. We also had a cheese plate, which included gorgonzola, a cheddar and a goat (and more), along with grilled (toasted?) bread. Quite delicious

name: Marathon Music Works
text:
Recently visited Nashville to see Flogging Molly at Marathon Music Works. The venue, pretty good. I liked the atmosphere, it was warehouse meets artsy type of scene. We arrived early and stood in line waiting for the doors to open. I was pleased to see they carded and stamped hands prior to getting to the door to save time, as it was cold outside. 
I guess you are wondering why I only gave it two stars then, eh? Well I contacted the venue via twitter and facebook, requesting the prices prior to getting into town. I wanted to be sure I had enough cash to cover the cost of drinks for me and my boyfriend. They never responded, to either request. Now, I know, people are thinking, well, maybe they weren't on their site, right? Wrong, they were quick posting about other events, ticket sales, etc., so I know they were on their account, but just didn't have the decency or customer service skills to respond. I find that rude, and frankly unacceptable. Being from out of town, I don't like to leave my credit card/debit card at the bar to keep a tab open, especially at a place with that large of a crowd, and wouldn't you know there was a minimum that didn't allow me to swipe my card each time. Needless to say, I had one beer there and decided I would spend my drinking money elsewhere after the concert. 
Note to management: RESPOND TO YOUR CONSUMERS! Without your consumers, your bills wouldn't get paid.

name: Nashville Symphony
text: Amazing venue and the restaurant is nice for a pre-show meal.

name: Marathon Music Works
text: I attended Closing Night Runway Shows of Nashville Fashion Week 2014 and the After Party. The sound was great during the show but during the after party it was almost too loud to carry on a conversation. I can only guess that it may be this way during a live performance. This venue is spacious and easy to navigate with a wheelchair. The only real issue that needs improvement is a lack of accessible parking. I would definitely return

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: So much fun!  Great live music.  Service was great and our sever gave us plenty of information since we were visiting from out of town.  Recommend the cheese burger in paradise or fish tacos and washing it down with a Last Mango in Paris.  Top it off by sharing a piece of key lime pie.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Great atmosphere that anyone can love even if you are not a parrot-head. HUGE QUANTITIES (nachos) the servers are great and funny. They have a very funny balloon maker that made it much better.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text:
If you go to one place on Broadway come here.  Most of the spots are completely touristed out and have lost their original flavor.  Layla's has not.  I came here about 10 years ago (Broadway was about half what it is now, and the place was hot).  I came here recently, still hot.

Really good music, with that authentic sound.

Bartenders are on it, and very polite too.

It's still old school, 90% of everything else on Broadway is new school.

You're welcome

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Margaritaville is my favorite restaurant in downtown Nashville because it's just FUN!!!  Yes, I'm a "Parrothead".  But, even if I wasn't, this place is great for several reasons. One, it has really fun food. I had their seafood mac and cheese recently and it was really good!  Obviously, good, homemade mac and cheese is one of the great comfort foods of all time, but add shrimp and crab meat to it? Oh yeah babe! :-) And some of their drinks are as much like dessert as they are cocktails. And don't even get me started on their actual desserts! Second, after you eat, you can shop in their Margaritaville store. It's hard for me not to want one of everything.  The only downside is that the music tends to be loud.  But what most people go there for is the party, Margaritaville ambiance. And they get it in spades.  One of these days, I'm hoping they put a Margaritaville on the west coast. Right now the closest one to me is in Las Vegas.

name: The Night Owl
text:
This is walking distance from my house, and my buddy plays the Jazz jams on Sunday nights, so I've been several times. First, the ONLY reason it's not 5 stars (wish I could do 4.5. That's my actual rating): NO DRAFT BEER. So so so sad. The second that changes I'll be a much more frequent customer. For now I get a PBR tallboy because it's dirt cheap and even the bottle selection offers nothing worth spending more for :(
The plentiful good things: chill place, good variety of live music, always cool bartenders, and FOOOOOOD. The garlic Parmesan fries are a must. The wings are excellently prepared, with custom designed sauces mixed up individually for each order. (The "kitchen sink" sauce is fantastic--a bit of everything). Great selection of burgers for a full meal if you want, and happy hour drink deals 5-7 M-F.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Seems to be a trend on broadway to offer terrible service. Can not tell you about the food as we waited for about 15 minutes for a server to greet us at our table and then left.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Good great, music good.  Service, one of the worse we've ever experienced anywhere.   Our waiter came to our table first time and asked us what we wanted.  No smile, no hello, noting.  Maybe the guys was having a bad day.  There was nothing on the table, no menu, no napkins, no silverware (remember this for later).  We were a bit puzzled by the abrupt question but went we it.  We asked for some water and...ah menus.  A few minutes later the waiter came with menus...no water.  He came back a few minutes late and we ordered some drinks...and asked for the waters.  We eventually ordered the food which came fairly quickly.   We quickly remembered that we had no silverware.   It's hard if not impossible to eat the side salad without a fork.  We had to wait a bit more to get his attention again and asked for silverware...and water.  The waiter came back with literally two forks in his hands.  No knives.  The food was very good and we eventually got the water.  As we started eating we quickly realized that napkins are a must (burgers were tasty but greasy).  Mind you by now we're finding this experience ridiculously bad and sadly funny at the same time.  My wife and I are not extremely picky so my wife half-jokingly said she'll use her dress to wipe.  Yeah that didn't last long. It's gross and difficult to eat without napkins.  We we asked for napkins and the waiter came back with...wait for it...6 bar napkins.  Come on now!!!   Bar napkins are so small!  The waiter seemed puzzled with every request we had and remember, we only asked for basic stuff that should have been available.  We ate pretty quickly and the waiter picked up our plates and said he'll bring our check.  Ok, I guess our evening was done there.  And we were more that ready to go.   We thought that perhaps the waiter was very new and inexperienced but he seemed to be able be able to juggle multiple tables at once, albeit not very well.  We didn't take too personally, the guests at the table next to us ate without napkins too. Eventually they asked for napkins too and the they got some normal sized ones.  So lucky!!!  Our impression is that the waiter was just incredibly lazy and just didn't give a crap about anything.  On a positive note, the gift shop kid was super friendly and we ended up buying some gifts (my wife is a huge Jimmy buffet fan).

name: Ole Red
text:
I was looking for a place to get some hot chicken and found Ole Red on the corner.  The music sounded great, so I thought what the heck.  I wanted to sit at the bar, so I decided to go to the upstairs bar and take a seat there.  I ordered the half a chicken, hot, with greens.  The chicken came in a big tin bucket and it was excellent (gravy and a biscuit too).  I was only able to eat two pieces.  The greens had bacon in them and they were delicious.  

The band that was playing was Mark something, can't really remember the full name, but they were VERY good.  

I wish I could have given this restaurant a 5 star (5 star music & food), but service is a HUGE part of the restaurant business.  The female bartender who waited on me was not so great.  Not attentive at all.  I did want another glass of wine.  My glass was empty for awhile and she never even asked if I wanted another one.  She wasn't even busy.  Very disappointing.  Does she realize that if she gives better service her tip will actually go up????  Hello There????

Ole Red, I think your food and music is fabulous.  Your service sucks!!!!!!

name: Ole Red
text: Two words:  tourist trap.  We went on an incredibly slow night.  From the very beginning we were repeatedly reminded that the help depends on tips but we couldn't even get silverware to the table despite numerous employees standing around doing what appears to be nothing.  We had to go to the bar several times to gets drinks because our waitress could t be found and apparently no one else is allowed to serve a sitting table.  The waitress got half our order wrong.  Then, after almost forty minutes, she brought us another customers steak that was over cooked.  We know this because they were sitting right beside us and were complaining that theirs was UNDERcooked and sent it back.  The waitress tried to be cordial and voluntarily explain it all away but at this I think we were all just ready to leave.  I'm not one to be overly critical but I thought it important for potential patrons to know that if you're expecting anything short of poor service, bland food, and an outrageous bill you'll be sorely disappointed.

name: 12th & Porter
text: We held our "Till Death do Us Party!" here this weekend to celebrate the marriage of Lauren and Alex.  The staff and venue were epic!  The sound for the live band--amazing! I highly recommend this venue for your next party!

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: This was our favorite and go to while in Nashville. We went in each of the days/nights we were in town. This is a legit honky tonk bar. Much of what I hope is not going to disappear from Broadway. Each time we went in, the music was different, but all good. Drink prices one of the most reasonable.Fun place

name: Ole Red
text:
I'll give it 3 stars just because the ambiance was great. Love music all day long, but everything else was mediocre at best. They brought out my sons nachos before everyone else's food, even after specifically telling our waiter we wanted them when all the food came out. My sweet tea tasted off and my hot chicken sandwich was dry. I asked for pickles and didn't receive any. 

All in all, great atmosphere but don't plan on an exceptional meal. Should have taken my husband and my $100 elsewhere. I was really hoping to find a new local joint.

name: Ole Red
text: Came here after the craziness of CMA Fest. Finally there wasn't a line around the building. Service was excellent and the food exceeded our expectations. Drinks were awesome as well. Good job BS, great restaurant and bar!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: So the food was good but a little overpriced but it was all worth it, our server Darrell was awesome! He was super attentive and seemed dedicated to our experience! He was so fun and he had us laughing the entire time. He had suggestions on where to go afterwards and we tried to get him to meet us but he still had a few hours left on his shift. Anyway, we had a great time.

name: Ole Red
text: I recently visited this establishment and enjoyed every minute. Our server was Mandie and she was an absolute delight. Drinks were great and I will definitely be back. Mandie gave the best service possible and I will be requesting her when I go back!

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: During a bachelorette weekend we did a party barge that took us here. 10 girls at around 2pm on a Saturday, so it was a pretty empty bar. We all bought drinks, shots, and the bartenders and 'bouncers' were all having a good time with us. The bathrooms are each a big bathroom, one marked for men and one marked for women, the women's was occupied so we were told to us the men's. We left, continued our party barge but ended up at winners/losers at around 3:30. 3 of us entered to use the restroom. The bouncer waved us through, saying he remembered us. We used the men's bathroom, as the women's was occupied, as they they told us to before. Yet when we came out we had about 4-6 men bartenders/bouncers staring at us telling us to get out, we're not allowed back 'don't even think about going to losers because your kicked out'. Really!? Well the rest of us went into 'losers' side, peed and then went to red door saloon, where they were baffled by your bipolar mess. Maybe get on the same page, okay?

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
Two words. Loaded Landsharks: landshark beer and a shot of lime tequila as a floater. YOU NEED TO GET THIS. you don't even taste the liquor.... We discovered these in myrtle at that Margaritaville.

We stopped here for lunch with  our group of a bachelorette party. Everything was completely packed since it was a gorgeous day on a Saturday in downtown Nash. We slipped on in and they seated us right away. decent items on the menu, a little pricey(but it's the touristy thing to do).

name: Ole Red
text: Definitely worth a stop while in Nashville. A great venue, great atmosphere, and great music. The service was decent and the beer was cold. I'm just hoping that they expand their menu in the future, right now it's a lot like every other greasy burger joint in town.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text:
I have been to Winners Bar and Grill at least a twenty times in 2013 and 2014 since several of my friends wanted to go there and since it was very close to the University but I would say that this bar is not worth your money and that you should go to one of the better ones instead.

This bar is easy to access since it is close to Vanderbilt University and in the heart of Mid-Town, and it has an outdoor patio area. The good thing about this bar is that you get live music once in a while which is pretty nice.

Parking will be very challenging in the area so make sure to get there early. The drinks here are acceptable but be ready to have a LOT more ice than alcohol for the price you pay... Also, this bar is very often empty, so it is hard to have a good time in there, expect if you come with many friends.

Finally, I would qualify the food they serve as low-quality bar food.

Overall, my experience with Winners Bar and Grill was rather negative and I would not recommend it. There are better bars in Nashville! Feel free to message me for any additional details that you may need!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text:
I've been here for hockey and concerts. This is a GREAT concert venue! Sound is spot on. The food in the Lexus lounge is pretty good too!

They should probably pay closer mind to people's intoxication levels. (Although, since they were quick to clean up peoples vomit, and nobody puked on me.... they still get five stars.)

You'll never know how many people need rehab until you see a concert in smashville.

name: Ole Red
text: The food was amazing!!! I had my 12 year old daughter and niece so it was nice to go to a place that was kid friendly. The hamburger that I ordered was amazing. The staff was super friendly and the entertainment was great!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: The epitome of customer service. First, upon mentioning it was my husband's birthday the hostess got us a table immediately (I wasn't asking,just conversing). Then when a steak was presented well under done, the manager came out and delivered a new steak and comped it (again, not expected). Shea, Callie and Lavaysha...thank you!! We'll be back!

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: Predators foundation but on another great beer fest. Food was really great this year too!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
he third and final brewpub imbibed at during my first evening in Nashville was the nearby-but-not-necessarily-easy-to-get-to Tennessee Brew Works. Sure, it's only a half-mile away, but when you take the shortest route, the road runs over a railroad track. Not that big of a deal unless there happens to be a train stopped in the middle of the road, which there was. Luckily we were walking, so my wive and I could just climb over...

The effort was worth it. If Tennessee Brew Works has one thing down, it's definitely the location. There's outdoor seating, cozy indoor tables and even a balcony that provides even more outdoor space. The brewery felt trendy, welcoming and cozy all at the same time, which isn't necessarily an easy trio to pull off.

And the beer was pretty tasty too. Again, thanks to outdated southern beer laws, there was nothing above about 6.3 percent ABV. Thus, for anyone who has to have a bourbon-barrel-aged double something or other to be impressed, you won't be here. But for the styles they were serving, the quality was pretty decent.

The service was on-point too. The bartender (owner?) suggested saving the stout and the fruity pale for last, as the dry stout sampled before the pale would really bring out the flavors. And he was right.

I'd happily return.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
Great atmosphere for a brewery. Love all of the different seating options. Fish tacos were fantastic! Prices were reasonable. 

I did not like the 'hurry up & order' vibe at the order counter. I really didn't like that my flight came with no direction as to which beer was what. I liked 2 of the 5 beers I sampled, but no labeling means I have no idea which ones I liked. It was a Tuesday afternoon. I can't imagine how frustrating ordering would be on a weekend. 

Overall I liked it here, but not sure I would return. The vibe is better to me right down the road at Jackalope, which feels more like a brewery & the folks working there appear to love what they do. This place is more like a restaurant that happens to brew some beer.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
Sat at the bar for dinner.  I had the shrimp wedge salad which was nothing spectacular.  The dressing that comes with it is very similar to thousand island... this is one of my pet peeves.  If it is a spade call it a spade.  I can't remember what fancy name they called the dressing on the menu but I was kicking myself for not asking what it was. It is thousand island, people!!!  YUCK.  The shrimp were pretty good but too greasy for them being blackened.  This wedge salad desperately needed some bacon on it.  And ranch dressing.  The lettuce wedges (3 of them) were obnoxiously huge.  Really who is going to eat all that?  They were so big there was no room left to cut them up on the plate.  And the capers were just out of place and weird.  Anyway...my friend is a vegetarian and ordered the veggie burger which looked a lot like a beef burger from my angle.  Luckily he checked it out before biting into it...  Not cool.  Wasn't impressed. 

The atmosphere was really loud.  I know it is Nashville but it was overbearing and the band wasn't all that great.  The bartender seemed to personally know the guy sitting next to me so I had to listen to her almost constant conversation with him which was her loudly talking (almost yelling) over the band.  It was annoying.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: This is my favorite restaurant in Nashville. Yes it is a bit over priced but I enjoy the wonderful atmosphere. The decorations are awesome and there is always life music. One of the best margaritas I have ever had. Only $7 and got me more than buzzed. I enjoy the shrimp on the menu. Can't wait to come back!!! As a margarita lover, Margaritaville is my safe haven.

name: Marathon Music Works
text: The security (axis) was very pleasing but the venue not so much! They wouldn't let me re enter even with the funds to buy a new ticket! They refused any help and I am ver very displeased!

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: Quick service. 5 dollar beers. Band was awesome female lead. Only stayed a few beers. But atmosphere had a good vibe

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
Amazing time! Beers are excellent, and they are stocked with tons of games for people to play in a cool atmosphere. Picnic table-type seating upstairs, which allows for easy game play. 
Servers were courteous and very helpful. We very much enjoyed our brief stop here.

name: Marathon Music Works
text:
Woo gotta love Marathon. If it wasn't for the Exit/In's simplicity and intimacy, Marathon Music Works would be my favorite venue. I've attended some unforgettable concerts here (Cut Copy, Odesza, Interpol) and they tend to do a wonderful job with the special effects and sound.

The "big room" spacious venue style is prime for mid-high popularity bands that attract decently large crowds. While I have pushed my way to the front before, you can definitely still have a more relaxed time towards the back of the venue without sacrificing too much in sound quality. 

Overall, this is a laid-back, fun venue that constantly brings in spectacular acts.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
If I could give more stars I would. Hands down best brewery in Nashville, heck, THE WORLDDDD. So much work goes into each beer, each piece of food, everything. The staff know what they are talking about, can steer you in the right direction if you are unclear of what to order, and are just so nice and friendly. 

The food is insanely good, all local, and almost every thing on the menu incorporates one of the beers. 

I like the laid back atmosphere, and the patio is superb. Nothing else like it in Nashville!

I recommend the burger or hot chicken sandwhich, and the 1927 IPA (so refreshing).

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
We made the mistake of going on Saturday afternoon.  We thought mid-afternoon would be relatively quiet.  WRONG! The bartender was very nice, attentive, and found a beer I liked.  I didn't realize I'd caught him in a lull.  Then, a tour group came out and the bar was inundated, repeatedly.
Main negative to this place, other than being jammed and not much parking, was the upstairs restroom.  There was a single unisex bathroom.  The door wouldn't close securely, much less lock, leading to men walking in on women and vice versa.  The bathroom was FILTHY, even by guy standards for bar toilets, with water overflowing from the urinal running out under the door, and no paper supplies of any kind.
They get two stars rather than one because we went back Sunday evening and things were much more sane.  I also discovered nice, clean restrooms on the first floor, back in the touring area.  The staff was great and the beer was good, but not good enough to offset the parking problem, small bar area (upstairs bar was closed on Sunday), and general atmosphere.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: What a beautiful venue. Went to the mixtape tour and the place was packed. Thet have a variety of foods and drinks to choose from. The bathrooms could've been cleaner.

name: Ole Red
text: I'm sad to say that we are still racist in 2019 , the bartenders at the upstairs bar would not serve my African American husband and when we told management they did absolutely nothing.  This truly breaks my heart

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
I was glad we decided to stop by and try this place. Great set up on the interior and super friendly staff. The brewer was nice enough to come out and talk to me because i had some questions on his beer. 

The food is amazing! We had the chicken wings, frog legs and hot chicken sandwich. I recommend all three they really made the trip worth it.

The beers were really good. Their specialty beers really stood out to us. The beet beer was amazing, loved the cucumber beer as well as the Thai basil, they had some really unique stuff going on.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text:
First place to grab a bite to eat on my trip to Nashville with my friends. The food was sub par. Service was weird too how you had to go pay for your bill at the bar and they didn't have a lot of napkins and looked like they were understaffed. 

My quesadilla I had was spicy, so spicy to the point where I didn't even end up really eating any of it. I had to pick apart the green peppers. Not sure sure what made it so spicy, but I was not a fan

name: Ole Red
text: Fun vibe! We were there on a Friday late afternoon and they had great service and a great band. Eat the chicken. You'll thank me if you do.

name: Ole Red
text: If I could give this 0 stars it would be more appropriate!  Having Celiac is always a struggle to eat out, but I've always managed to find something to eat at every restaurant. Today I was told I could not eat anything in this restaurant!! Really???  Are you just lazy???  I should be able to eat ANYWHERE!!! Shame on you!!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Absolutely incompetent staff. Jimmy should be ashamed to have his name attached to such a train wreck. Dozens of us have been waiting for hours to get inside for the Happy Hour radio show and suddenly several dozen people were allowed to cut in line in front of us - it was reported and nothing done about - due to complete lack of organization. Repeat of New Year's Eve 2017. How hard is crowd management? Well, if you work at Margaritaville Nashville, it's impossible.

name: Ole Red
text: We got the soft pretzel and it was very good.  We did have to wait a long time for a server. They were serving the table next to us, but would walk by us. They had live music on the rooftop that was great!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
Pros: Plenty of seating. Large beer menu. Chill atmosphere. 

Cons: Beer was just okay. I wouldn't buy it after trying the flight and my 2 guests that joined agreed.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
As Broadway bars are, this one is pretty "old time" tourist popular compared to the newer bars who are using a country singers actual name. You might think that coming here you are going to hear alot of caribbean type music but that is not the case. They bring in solo/duo artists as well as bigger Broadway bands. There have a family time where younger under age performers are given a chance to break into the singing scene. 
The food and drinks are pretty much like every other place along the street. Some things have a theme and come in kitschy containers. Fun for the tourist aspect! There is an upstairs area though I have never ventured up there. The gift shop have a lot of "Jimmy" stuff and other cool surf wear.
Fun fact: they host Sirius XM shows periodically and the artist draws a big crowd so get in early.

name: The East Room
text: Went to see some friends play music last night! Pretty decent place. Nothing jumped out and grabbed me as awesome. It was grungy but didn't feel dirty. So that was nice! At first we couldn't find the entrance..... so that was kind of weird. Sounded good in there though! They had a lot of good beer choices, which is great for people who love beer!! I don't though. They did have ciders which was good. But none of my favorites. I tried a new one I'd never had it was in a can... I don't like cans and it didn't taste at all like wild cherry. So some better bottled ciders would be cool:)

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: I never complain what so ever. I say this in hopes that it helps. The margaritas are $9 (cheap for the Location) but it's was the most salty marg I've ever tasted in my life. It could be the day or the bartender working.  My  friends and I will wake up needing water. The food is perfect as well as the service. Definitely worth trying

name: Ole Red
text: This was my favorite bar downtown Nashville this visit. Staff is friendly, music is awesome! We just had drinks and they had my beer on draft mich ultra!

name: Ole Red
text: Came here for dinner the other night and I have to say the food was great! I've been here before but just for drinks . The band was really good and our waitress was very attentive.
