We sat outside and just loved the atmosphere. I'm GF so I couldn't try the biscuits but the rest of my group had 3-4 each (our waiter, the lovely Trevor, gladly kept bringing us more!) Their omelets are DELICIOUS. Just go - you won't be disappointed!

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
So this place is definitely out of the way if you're staying in the city (my friends and I were a few blocks from Broadway when we went), but if you've got wheels and a burning hunger for the kind of southern food you came down South for, then Loveless is your place. 

The meal started with a basket of biscuits with homemade jam (on the house) and my friend and I shared the Pimento Bacon burger and the BBQ sandwich, then finished the meal off with some pie. The service was super-friendly and the food was all good.Totally what we wanted out of a Nashville dining experience.

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
I went to the City Winery during my one day Nashville whirlwind. I went into town for the glaad concert for Love and Acceptance to see Meghan Linsey. 

As others have said parking is pretty impossible unless you do valet - which is $5. Don't try to park in the adjacent lot unless you want to be stopped by security in a golf cart.

Since I had a ViP ticket, I was escorted to my seat. I don't know if the tables are always that close together, but I am on the lower end of a "normal" weight range and I felt like it was a tight squeeze. Not just on each side but even scooting my chair out. The person at the table behind me could not have pulled his chair out simultaneously with me. We were that close.

The bathrooms were okay. They ran out of paper towels and they stayed out through the evening.

The wine list is not as impressive as the name would lead you to believe. No Moscato anywhere on the list if you can believe that... Not even available by the bottle. I am such a Moscato fanatic (my dog is named after it if that gives you any indication), I would have bought a whole bottle despite being a two drink max girl. But alas it was not meant to be.

I wound up getting a burger with those truffle fingerlings with some Chardonnay (sweet, but moscato you were not). 

The food was... Ok.

I hadn't eaten all day. All I had had was caffeine. Caffeine and adrenaline. And somehow I didn't even manage to eat half the burger. I don't know...

And I love truffle oil. Truly do. On fries. Tater tots. Grilled cheese. You name it. But, I found these needed salt and some (gasp!) ketchup to go with as they lacked seasoning. 

Service during the show was good. And quiet. She literally managed to get me my bill without me noticing she had placed it down.

I also love the water at the table - reminds me of Bailey's Chocolate Bar in St Louis. It also saves the waiters time.

But after the concert, the service was not so nice. A hostess came up to me to ask me where I got where I was wearing. She said another hostess absolutely loved it. I told her it wasn't a dress but a top and skirt but that only the petticoat was still available. She huffed off. Told the other hostess and not so nice commentary ensued after as if they didn't believe me when I said it was no longer available - it sold out circa 2013... Not making it up.

The same girl didn't recognize Jamie O Neal later and it wasn't until someone informed her of who it was that she let them up the stairs... Whoopsies! 

They were quick getting my car out from the valet too.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
We really enjoyed this place!  When you're headed there, you're going to swear you took a wrong turn, but just keep going - trust me, you'll get there if you follow Apple Maps or Google Maps.

So their biscuits are really almost as good as everyone says they are.  We got some to go, with some of their preserves, and it was great!  As for their food, it was also really good!  I went with the Country Fried Steak with Mac & Cheese and Mashed Potatoes, and thought that everything was generally really good.  Definitely not the absolute best I've ever had, but more than worth it.

My wife had the Fried Chicken, and it was also good, but same report from her - good, but not the best she's ever had.

We also hit up the Country Store while we were waiting (be prepared to wait, btw), and bought several things, including some preserves to take home.  That was nice, because their Strawberry Jam is really freaking good.  Like, maybe some of the best I've ever had.  So good, that I really want to have it with a PB&J, but don't want to run the risk of wasting it on a sandwich where it might be overshadowed.

We also ended up with a free pound of their peppered bacon, which we ended up giving to my sister.  She cooked it up several days later, and said it was some of the best bacon she's ever had.

So, I'd recommend coming here, if nothing else, for the biscuits, preserves, and the experience; you won't be disappointed!

name: City Winery Nashville
text: I love going to City Winery when one of my favorite alternative musicians comes to town. My husband and I recently saw Eric Hutchinson and AJ Croce. We purchased our tickets early online and got seats at one of the tables closest to the stage each time. What a treat to be so close to the artist while they're performing! I haven't tried the food. I'm grateful to live in Music City where I can enjoy incredible talent throughout the year!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Fried chicken that was done perfectly. Turnip greens and grits!  Peanut butter pie!!! Tooo good!! Absolutely deserves the longstanding reputation of great food...oh I almost forgot...butter my butt and call me a biscuit.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Biscuits and jam are awesome. My favorite part! I've been here lots of times with my boyfriend, which he loves it as well. Service is always great!!! And I leave happy and full each time!!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: YUM!! So good! I went last Saturday and had the "Blue Plate Special" , which was a half smoked Honey Fire Barbecue chicken. It was SOO yummy!! Great homemade biscuits with yummy jam! 4 stars instead of 5 due to an hour wait and soggy fried green tomatoes. All the other sides were great and the corn my niece got was the best corn any of us had ever tasted!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Food was excellent. I ordered a country fried steak and it was massive. Biscuits are fresh and fluffy. Staff is super friendly. Only negative was we had to wait over an hour to be seated but there are some shops to walk around in and cornhole to play.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Very good staff.  Food was good, well seasoned vegetables.  I would eat here again.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
We were visiting Nashville and some family who came last year said we had to check this place out. Its a 20 minute drive out of the city, but it's a beautiful drive. We waited for maybe ten minutes to sit down on a Monday morning, not a big deal at all for such a popular place.

Our waiter was a gentleman named Mark, and I hope the owner reads this, he was the most genuinely nice person we met in Nashville. He answered the few questions we had about the menu and offered his recommendations. He really did a fantastic job of making us feel welcome.

The biscuits were great, the blackberry jam was amazing!

I ordered the country fried steak and eggs with a side of the hashbrown casserole. Everything was really good, portions are huge. The casserole was AMAZING! So good!

My wife ordered the bbq pork omelet. I had to taste it, and the pork is delicious. I can only imagine how good it is on their dinner menu.

After we ate, we went through their gift shops and got some recommendations from the staff on areas to check out while we were in town. Again, very friendly and helpful employees! 

I will definitely come back when I find myself in Nashville again!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Entertainment is an A+ ...they like to get everyone standing on the benches having a good time. Rouladen was a disappointment because it was more like a cylinder shaped meatloaf instead of rolled meat as in the traditional way.  They also wouldn't substitute side items which didn't seem reasonable. Service was a little slow during this visit too.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Dont expect 'Southern Comfort' if you are a party of 8.  It took them 1 hour to seat us.  It was a Thursday at noon.

name: City Winery Nashville
text: We met friends here for dinner, wine and an Ambrosia concert. Full of song writers and who knows who. Great food and fun! We will be back!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: What a great atmosphere! The fried chicken was not the best I have ever had but it was good... The biscuits were for sure the best thing about this place! I ate five of them before our meal was served...

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Cool place, great service, but the food is just good southern style food. Its very similar to almost all small town diners. But the atmosphere makes it a must see place!

name: City Winery Nashville
text: The staff here is horrible.  We bought $75 VIP upgrades to our already $35 ticket a piece x 3.  I have two friends who drove from Michigan.  We are being treated horribly.  I'm a Vino VIP member and have never been treated this bad.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Let me tell you a little something about Loveless Cafe, y'all. A friend and I decided to ride our bikes there one day from West End. 13 miles. Bad Idea. 5 hours later when we got there, and the biscuits finally came, they literally saved my life. I owe those biscuits MY LIFE, I tell you. If you are gonna do Loveless, just forget about the calories and order the Fried Chicken with all the fixins (or you could burn it off with a bike ride). Also, try your darndest to save room for Steeplechase pie. To Die For. The wait can be long, so go at a weird time and you should be ok. Otherwise plan on waiting at least an hour. Luckily there are little shops in the same complex to keep you busy. A must visit in Nashville!

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Our time at Loveless Cafe started out with a bit of a hiccup.  I thought I had reserved us a table for a Saturday and when we arrived I was informed I'd made the reservation for Monday and the wait was going to be an hour and twenty minutes.  I take full responsibility for my screw up but I was really hungry and really upset with myself.  Fortunately, there are a few quaint shops on the premises where I was able to get a GooGoo Cluster and root beer and forget that I was starving and also managed to buy lots of cute kitchen decorations, preserves, even a pair of earrings.  Our wait ended up being around 50 minutes (thank you so much for your hustle or whoever ate their food quickly, my stomach and girlfriend are forever grateful).  Once seated we were greeted by the sweetest server who took care of us like a pro.  She got our sweet teas (a must), and a plate of the most divine, buttery biscuits and preserves you could ever dream of to nosh on while we waited for our lunch.  I had the fried chicken tenders, hashbrown casserole, and macaroni and cheese.  My girlfriend had the chicken fried steak, fried green tomatoes, and cucumbers and onions.  Everything was exceptional, well seasoned, and just downright delicious.  Plan to take home leftovers as the portions are huge.  I took home enough to make an entire second meal.  Despite being absolutely stuffed we decided it would be a sacrilege to leave without pie and we were absolutely right.  A slice of coconut cream pie and peanut butter pie was the perfect ending to a perfect meal.  

If you're staying in downtown Nashville, allow yourself about 30 minutes to get to the cafe but it is worth the drive and then some.

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Went to see Steve Earle and Elizabeth Cook last night. The show was great and the food was fine. It's expensive but that's what I expected. They advertized an after show in the upstairs lounge that sounded nice. Go up after the show, have another drink, and listen to a fine local artist. What I didn't expect is that the after show was another $12!!! I had just dropped close to $200 on the main show and dinner and I just didn't expect to get charged again for basically another ticket. Sure, the guy's upstairs deserve to be paid, but I would think the establishment could cover a guarantee for that plus put out a tip jar. It just sort of cemented in my mind that the City Winery is about taking money from its patrons any way they can. I'll go back and in fact I have tickets for another Steve Earle show in a couple of weeks. It's a nice, comfortable, upscale venue but I'll be keeping my hand on my wallet.

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
Dess styrka av att vara både en restaurang och en konsertlokal är tyvärr också dessa svaghet. Den gör båda sysslorna lite halvdant, och ingendera helt bra. Börjar med min (hittills) endaste besök här. Insläpp två timmar före musik showen börjar, ljusen i den stora lokalen är så neddimmade så att det är omöjligt att läsa menyerna, ens för de med perfekt syn. Resultatet blir att alla som vill beställa något tvingas lysa upp menyn med sina mobiltelefoner, en del genom att tända foto led belysningen. Andra tvingas ta hjälp utav serveringspersonalen som får ta fram sina mobiler och fungera som ambulerande ficklampa. Rätt komiskt! Jag kan förstå att under föreställningen vill man ha nedsläckt för att framhäva artisterna på scenen, men det här är timmar innan uppträdandet, när dessutom ingenting pågår på scen (allt är färdig riggat och sound checkat). 

När jag och andra här beställer öl så får vi varsin ölflaska men inget glas att hälla upp den i och dricka ur. Och det här är definitivt ingen billig honky-tonk sylta utan en restaurang med $20 varmrätter och $10 öl (en hygglig ansenlig summa här). Ber man om ett glas för sin öl så bär de gärna fram ett. Borde kanske vara standardutrustning?

Den förstärkta ljudanläggningen här verkar vara av fast karaktär som är permanent uppriggad och inkopplad för alla artister. Det sparar visserligen både tid, besvär och pengar men betyder också att du som ensam trubadur här får ungefär samma ljudbild som en hård rockade heavy metal band. Kompromiss är inte alltid optimalt! Kvällen då jag var här var mycket tung blues-rock gung ifrån scenen (Leon Russell). Men ljudet var, om inte direkt dåligt, så iallafall underdimensionerat för musik typen.

På plussidan så påminner man här, på flera ställen, om att man som gäst inte skall prata under föreställningen av respekt mot både artisterna på scen och sina bordsgrannar. Det budskapet applåderar jag!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Great bbq, fried chicken, and biscuits. Got a smoking education from the pit master. He suggested the smoked pork chops and they were awsome. I found I new favorite. Keep the good food coming loveless.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Went to the Loveless Cafe on a recommendation from a local friend as one of their families favorites. Of coarse I first still checked yelp for reviews prior to goin,g so I knew I was in for a wait, which was helpful. It took 45 minutes to be seated at 8 pm on a Monday night.  The drive to it was very scenic and the gift shops kept us happily occupied.  Once seated though our fabulous waiter named Owen promptly took our drink orders and brought my party of 5 an enormous plate of the famous biscuits and jellies. I thought we would never eat all of them but within a few moments time Owen said, " I did bring you a plate of biscuits didn't I?" with a warm smile on his face.  We each ordered different meals and not one was disappointed with their choice! As we sampled each other's side items....the cheese grits and Mac and cheese were big hits.  Not only was the food scrumptious but the hospitality of our awesome waiter (Owen) mixed with the cozy environment made it a night to remember! It will be a definite stop for us next time in Nashville.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
I am absolutely in love with everything about Loveless Cafe. It is one of the most popular Southern breakfast diners in the U.S, and it doesn't surprise me one bit that it made that list. 

  It is pretty out of the way from downtown and other tourist attractions in Nashville, but I think that adds even more to it's hometown - type background.So in other words, expect a 20 minute drive out, but it is totally worth it.

  The restaurant looks like the inside of your grandmother's house. You can also tell that their staff know how to treat their customers with true Southern hospitality. 

   They've got a huuuge selection on their menu, it was so tough for me to decide what to order. Everyone gets free biscuits, which were perfect and fluffy, also given a choice of four types of jelly. I went for the Southern Sampler breakfast, which seemed to be like a bit of everything. 

   With my meal including ham, eggs, sausage, bacon, AND fried potatoes, you can guess that I didn't leave there hungry. The portion size was overwhelming! But everything was delicious, especially to someone like me who normally doesn't care much for breakfast food. 

  Anybody and everybody has to experience this cafe at some point in their life.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Shawn at the bar was extremely cool. The Reuben was probably the most amazing sandwich ever created. Every bite was better than the last, it was just perfect. My wife and I would probably drive from Chicago, just for that! The atmosphere was authentic German and the place was packed, so the food quality is apparently not a secret. I'm hoping I can find a sandwich of that caliber in Chicago, though I won't get my hopes up. Thank you for being one of the best parts of our trip, we'll be back!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: The best biscuits and moon shine Mary's ever. Love this place even though they are always packed and the wait is long, but that's okay, the wait is worth it and all the shops are super cute.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Very good and great service.The food wasn't bad we had a sampler plate. Some was great some wasn't

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
So after a week in the smoky mountains getting fat, happy and not so fulfulled on southern cooking I find myself a loveless on the way home. 

One of the top 2 meals I have eaten in the last week. The deference in quality from the places in the smokies was apparent from the first bite. 

I ordered the breakfast sampler and a bowl of gravy. Three meats two eggs and a bowl of hash brown casserole. Oh don't forget the unlimited biscuits. I didn't. As I tried to single handedly eat them out of biscuits this night. Between smothering them with gravy or lathering them up with butter and jellies. Yum Yum 

All the food was great. It's hard to do great breakfast and this place does it. Most place breakfast is good and the is it. I am so glad I got a top notch breakfast before heading home from vacation. The one thing I would pass on next time is the Banana Pudding...got some to go but it was just okay. 

Oh and can I have another plate of biscuits....some of the best you will ever have.

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Horribly slow service (40 min to get appetizers, then another 20 for entrees!, it wasn't a busy night too). Ambience was nice but no live music. Waiter was friendly. Food was OK, nothing special.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Of course you have to eat at Loveless while in Nashville, it's an icon. The fried chicken is unfortunately a tad dry...but, the biscuits, jams, fried green tomatoes, and desserts more than make up for that offense. I highly recommend the fried green tomatoes (crunchy, salty, and delicious), the homemade peach pie (with spiced peaches for the win), and biscuits with sorghum.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Loveless cafe was a special stop today! The property is so cute, with a gift shop, antique store, art store, and bean bag tossing pits in addition to the actual restaurant itself. I can see why loveless is so popular! Great staff and authentic southern vibe going on. Had the chicken and biscuit side for breakfast, it was delicious but tiny (I ordered another!) Lots of southern sides and dishes! Yum.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Every time I come here always get great customer service food always good it is a must if you like good country food come hungry the portions are plentiful biscuit light & fluffy it's like no other in Nashville been here many times & will be here many many many more thanks

name: Big Shotz
text: It's a dive bar that has it all; no cover, cheap drinks and great live music.  I stopped here on Memorial day weekend with some friends and it was our favorite bar in Nashville.  We would definitely recommend if you're looking for a good time without emptying your wallet.

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
I had the chance to go to City Winery in Nashville for an event, and I absolutely fell in love with the atmosphere. The service was excellent and the servers were careful not to interrupt during the event. 

I had the Margherita flatbread and the Cabernet Sauvignon and was not disappointed. I can be picky about my wines, but this was excellent. It was a little pricey, but I kind of expected that with this nice of a venue!

I really hope to attend events here in the future and try some other items on the menu!

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Awesome wines. Great small plate. The dinners are tiny and just ok. Dessert was awful. Really expensive for what you get. Felt like NYC. Really??

name: Loveless Cafe
text: I ate decent breakfast here.  The biscuits are a signature dish, but I didn't think they were very special.  They were not flaky or interesting.  Had the texture of a dinner roll with the shape of a store bought biscuit.  Adequate, but I expected more and was told by my airbnb host that it was better years ago.  I really liked the country fried steak.  Very tasty with the sauce and very crispy.  Best part of my breakfast.  I also had eggs and potato casserole.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Recently moved to Nashville and one of my friends told me about seven times in the first week we needed to visit Loveless ASAP (no exaggeration). We showed up at 3:15pm on a Sunday afternoon and couldn't believe there was a 45 minute wait for two people. And supposedly the wait is usually two hours long so we were "lucky" (okay we can roll with it. Good thing there were a few shops on their property to waste some time so we walked over there. My bf bought two jars of preserves for his family (on recommendation from said friend) even though we hadn't actually tried anything yet. Im so sad now that we didn't get a few jars for ourselves! 

The wait seemed to be over pretty quickly and we sat down to our late lunch. We got our first plate of biscuits and they were AMAZING!! There was a sampler of preserves to try out: blackberry, peach and strawberry. My favorite was blackberry and his was strawberry. They were all so good that there really was no way to rank them higher than the other. 

I ordered the fried chicken livers with the sweet yams and corn. He ordered the pork chops, hash brown casserole and corn. Our meals came out piping hot and I actually had to wait a second to eat because it was so hot (something I really appreciate --hot food is the best!). We also got the banana pudding even though we were so full. Took the dessert home but took one bite first and it's some of the best banana pudding I've ever had. The vanilla wafer is obviously homemade and has such a nice crisp to it. The service was fantastic and we'll be bringing our family back here when they visit us for the first time in the city. 

Highly recommend. Wait is worth it. Buy some preserves for yourself and some holiday gift goodies when you're here. We know it's a down home southern cooking restaurant but you really can't go wrong when they're stellar at their job. Can't wait to come back!!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: We were lucky to walk in tonight and have no wait as this is a well loved restaurant. You get biscuits when you arrive, essentially, served with their outstanding jams. We liked the blackberry and strawberry best. The biscuits live up to their reputation that's for sure. We ordered and our meals arrived very soon thereafter and the service was professional, helpful, and pleasant. My mom ordered the watermelon ribs which is the Thursday night special. The meat was falling off the bone, juicy, satisfying flavor as they should be. My sister had the fried half chicken and thought it was good. I had the grilled catfish which was pretty flavorful if a little wet. The hush puppies that came with it were excellent with just the right sweetness and flavor. I ordered fried okra as a side, which was a mistake but what can you expect from okra I guess? My sister and I both ordered the caramel sweet potatoes which were as advertised - very sweet but good. My sister's second side was the turnip greens and they were a little more spicy then expected. My mom's two sides were definite hits with the beans - flat and green beans - my sister did get some grit twice while trying these though. The creamed corn my mom got was so tasty. We finished it off with the peach cobbler which did not disappoint. Made with peaches that were frozen when they were fresh a dumpling and good French vanilla ice cream. We were pretty impressed!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: My Loveless experience was more love than less. True to all other high regarded reviews, I do actually have nothing but love for this roadside joint. It boasts some tall orders like homemade banana pudding, biscuits, and pretty much if it's on the menu it's made from scratch. Places just don't do that anymore. Not like this and not for these prices. All my respect to places that can manage good food on a budget and more. With that said, I enjoyed everything I ate. Was it the best ever? Probably not .... But it was most definitely solid hand made fare that for Nashville, is a force to be reckoned with. There are a LOT of southern fare joints we discovered in Nashville. The Loveless Cafe is a must visit. There is no negotiating this. Oh and yes....even with that crazy long wait. All you foodies must know by now, the longer the wait .... It must be worth it.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: This is really great food. If you come here you have to try the hashbrown casserole! It is the most amazing version you will ever find in a restaurant.

name: City Winery Nashville
text: This company is taking customer service seriously, that is important to me! Please consider giving them a chance. I will be giving them another chance since they have graciously offered me the opportunity as a result of my dissatisfaction with my dinner. A real commitment to customer service is an amazing thing to find in a multi-state company but looks like City Winery is making the extra effort to get it right! I debated about three or four stars but decided the music/listening space gave this place the extra boost. Great space, fun concert and amazing (amazing) sound My waiter could have done better and the food was not above average but I am giving them a second chance! You should go - some amazing concerts are planned! Oh and $5 for valet is so reasonable in this town!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Great country breakfast.  We ate here twice while in Nashville last week.  The first morning, I had the fried eggs, ham and red gravy, which is more like aus jus where I come from.  It came with hash brown casserole that was quite tasty.  The biscuits and homemade preserves were divine.  Overall a very good breakfast.  The second visit, I had the port BBQ and eggs and my friend had the country fried pork chops and eggs.  The highlight was the country fried pork chops!  The BBQ pork was delish as well.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: The service and atmosphere are great. The prices are reasonable. The food could use more seasoning. We had the pork shank and the schnitzel, they were both bland. Not much taste....

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Hands down the best restaurant for Southern food for me! I am not actually a big fan of southern food, but I enjoyed every bit of experience at Loveless cafe. The friends that came with me that night came from different states in the country and they all enjoyed everything they ordered. But one thing stood out: their BISCUITS! The biscuits were so fluffy, buttery in a good way and melt-in-your-mouth soft! The different preserves on the table were so good but I love the blackberry the best. You could just have as many biscuits you like and I think I had more than 10 on top of my big meal (the servicing size is huge too!). I just can't stop eating their biscuits, it was that good! To add to the wonderful dining experience, the servers were very friendly and they have a store where you could buy their biscuit mix and homemade preserves/jams. A definite must-try in Nashville!

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
I mean, come on, what can I say that everyone else hasn't said?

Yes, their biscuits are pretty rad.
Yes, I have had better country cooking (hailing from Alabama, and all).
Yes, the staff is very friendly...especially for being crazy slammed all day long every day.
Yes, I only go here for special occasions (i.e. Out of town guests).

name: Loveless Cafe
text: We drove over from Nashville (30min each way) and there was a 75 min wait, which was super accurate. There are all kinds of things to do and see on the grounds, though, so it made the wait go by quickly. The food was great (worth the wait); I had the jumbo chicken fingers, the meatloaf was amazing; my favorite was the green beans, brown gravy and definitely the biscuits!

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Why LoveLESS? This place should be called loveMORE! Hands down the fluffiest biscuits I've had in life! And the waitress was very generous about  bringing out a second hot basket before we even finished our first. Though I wondered what did she do with the leftover buscuits that she took away with the first basket? o.O

The fried chicken was executed to perfection. You can tell the recipe has gone through decades of tradition and years of perfection. The chicken however  lacked a bit of seasoning. Good stuff but I've also had better. 

I was somewhat disappointed by the hash brown casserole, especially after reading raving reviews about it as I was waiting for our table. The proportion of cheese to potatoes was nearly 50/50.

The location is a little out of reach, but definitely worth a short drive if you are in town.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Can't say enough how delicious this place is!!!! If you love biscuits then this has to be a stop on your way through Nashville. We went on a Monday night and there was a small wait but it was well worth it! The best fried chicken I have ever had not to be out done by the amazing BBQ pork and fried catfish. Our waiter was extremely friendly and made the experience even better. Truly like having dinner at grandma's!!!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: This is a great place to visit. Plan on at least an hour wait. Their biscuits are made on site. Jams are delicious. I preferred the peach.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: The service was amazing! The biscuits, homemade biscuits, and the hash brown casserole were all delicious. The coffee is just so so and the omelette wasn't very good. I'd definitely come back & try some other things on their menu.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: So we finally made it to the Loveless Café! Definitely not disappointed. Everything was delicious. We had French toast, southern omelet, hash brown casserole, bacon and the famous biscuits with a side of gravy and homemade jam!! Everyone is so nice here too! Virginia our waitress was superb!! Do not pass this up! We can't wait to come back to try out their dinner menu!! If you like what you eat they have a store that you can buy biscuits, ham and jam!! Oh...and if you leave hungry something is wrong! Portion sizes are large so come with an empty belly! :-)

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
June 2017 - interesting place with Great Southern Cooking and Good Beer.  It's located near Hwy 100 and Natchez Trace Parkway, a wonderful way to drive to the restaurant.  Breakfast is served all
Day.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: After reading some of the reviews I had a few doubts that our meal here would not be as good as some places closer to the downtown area. I was very very wrong, we had a wonderful time, waited about 15 minutes to get seated but enjoyed relaxing on the front porch until our table was ready. The portions were huge and every single thing we ate was delicious. We ate too much, and after lunch went and visited the shops around the property. Overall a need to visit if you're in the Nashville area :)

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Set up is nice. Music is too loud. Waitress didn't know what kind of meat was on the burger. Enough said. The wine bottle table numbers are cool, but not cool enough. Waitress didn't check on us the entire time we ate. No courtesy stops. Food was less than average at a higher cost. Added taxes of $10 other than sales tax? Table#62 on 1/24/15 didn't meet expectations

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Food was good. Pretty place. People where friendly and helpful. Only downfall was prices way too high....20$a plate was the average.

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Joe was SO AMAZING. We arrived early off a flight before we could get into an air BnB for my friends bachelorette party he let us in 4 hours before hand and surprised us with cannolis. I have worked in the hospitality industry for years but he goes so above and beyond he truly is amazing at what he does. Thanks joe!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Some people may see this as sacrilege but I would say that the most exciting things about Loveless are the facilities and the drive there. The dining room is cute and very open, and there are cute stores in the campus. The food was solid and the biscuits very good, but the latter didn't live up to tall the hype is heard. The preserved on the other hand were pretty awesome. What I was most disappointed about was the service. In a place as iconic as this one I expected some good southern hospitality but it was all just rushed. I don't regret going, it was a good experience. That said, my visit was during the week. Had I waited the typical 2.5hrs on the weekend I may have been a little disappointed, only because of the hype.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Oh God the food here was outrageously good. Everything we tried with better than the other. Worth a half-hour Trek from downtown Nashville. They close at 9 so allow time.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Growing up in the south you know a good place to eat good food.  The biscuits were great right out of the oven with the jam.  I ordered from the breakfast menu with the country style steak and eggs.  I was a bit disappointed in the steak.  Too much breading but a very large portion.  My husband got country ham plate.  It was nice and thick.  Would go again if nearby.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: We were staying in downtown Nashville and had heard about this German Restaurant. It was about 5-6 miles from downtown and worth every mile! The Bierhaus is attached to the Opry Mills Shopping Mall. The inside is very traditionally German decorated. They have the traditional long wooden tables and benches. We ordered the onion soup as appetizer and it was delicious topped with a pretzel covered with an abundance of cheese. We ordered the King Ludwig platter to split. It was $27 and plenty for the two of us. Afterwards, we had the Black Forest Cake. OMG!!!! Delicious!!! And a huge piece. My husband and I couldn't finish it!! Our server was Kelse. She was AWESOME!!  We highly recommend this restaurant!!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Good quality food for the experience but pricey. Long wait but we toured the grounds. Delivered a plate of biscuits and jams when we sat down made me change what I ordered. Country ham is a speciality but try it with the red eye gravy. Fried green tomato and pimento cheese biscuits was weak on the tomato.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: We shared fried chicken, mashed potatoes, sweet potatoes, chicken fried steak, mac n cheese, and greens. Everything was so good!! And their biscuits were to die for!!! Best food we had in Nashville!

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
It's definitely a tourist trap but well worth a visit if you're in Nashville.  Biscuits were great and portions are very generous. Servers are very friendly.  

When you're heading to the restroom, you can see them making biscuits.  :D

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Went for their Mother's Day Brunch and this time, was very disappointed. They couldn't seem to keep the buffet full and the quality of what was put out was poor. I'm assuming that the people that ate earlier than our 1pm reservation were able to sample all the options, but we weren't. Many items were not replaced while we were there. We had to ask for salt and pepper and was told there were a few sets floating around the room.  There were a lot of empty seats so it wasn't because they were packed. They must have not planned well for this event - or it was a staffing issue.  The music was great and the one glass of wine that I was able to order was good. Not worth the $42 per person

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: I lived in Bayreuth, Bavaria, for three years, so I know German when I see it.  What a surprise and delight to find this place in Nashville!  Our server, Charles, was attentive and tireless, ensuring we had  our food delivered hot and delicious and our beers cold and flavorful.  Definitely, we're coming back!  Great place, great times, great food, great music!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: The only complaint I have is that at times they are very busy and the dining room gets rather loud. However, all those customers is a good thing.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
The reviews on the biscuits hold true! I ate a few (I'm afraid to admit how much lard I actually consumed). If you love the biscuits you should go to the gift shop and buy the magnet that says "praise the lard and pass the biscuits". 

Aside from the biscuits I shared the sampler meal ( BBQ, chicken, meatloaf) with the mashed potatoes and sweet potatoes (I apparently love lard and starches). The mashed potatoes were great (had little potatoes chunks that made me think they were homemade). The sweat potatoes were nothing I would try again ( semi sweet with a hint of Carmel).  I also tried my friends fried ocra, it tasted average. 

I loved the meatloaf.  It had great flavoring and consistency. The chicken and BBQ was good but if you've had great BBQ and fried chicken it's about average. 

I gave 4 stars because our waitress only came to our table 2 times the entire meal and pretty much rolled her eyes at us. She would just walk by and not offer refills or ask if we needed anything. We finally waved down another waiter who gladly helped and brought more biscuits, drinks, and even made sure we liked our food.  We left a tip for Kramer and he ended up running outside to thank us for the tip- so kind and sincere of him! 

Worth a shot but planning on waiting!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Had a really good lunch here. The food arrived piping hot and very tasty. We had the fish and chips and an order of the rubin sliders. Both tasted great. The Rubin slider is more like a rubin egg roll than a small sandwich but it was very good. Seating is at a long table with benches on either side. Not the most comfortable seat but it keeps with the bierhaus theme of the restaurant. This is somewhere I will go back to again.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Their bread pudding is amazing here. I was also pleasantly surprised by the chicken and waffles. Not only that, but the biscuits and gravy were pretty good. However, the country steak was meh; that is the only downside to this eatery. I also tried grits for the first time; it didn't taste good at all. Overall, it's a great place for breakfast/brunch. Be sure to get the bread pudding!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Nashville institution. Not worth the trek for those only in town for the weekend, but certainly put it on your list if you're around a bit longer. The biscuits and jam are heaven! Cozy, down-home country kitchen vibe.

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Had a wonderful, romantic dinner on our first night in Nashville - City Winery came highly recommended and fully lived up to and exceeded the hype. The atmosphere was lovely, the service was exceptional and the food and drink were fabulous. I'm not a wine guy, but my Lovely Dining Companion is, and she enjoyed both glasses she tried. Had we not been flying out she would have gotten a wine growler to go for sure. The beer list featured several local options, and I was glad to get to try a  few of them. We started with the Nashville Hot Chicken Eggrolls, which were fully delicious and not overly spicy. I followed a recommendation and had the steak frites, and the ribeye was perfect. My date had the seasonal farro risotto, which had big cherry tomatoes, asparagus, summer squash, spring peas and shaved parmesan. Really a lovely, different and not overwhelming take. While we were tempted by dessert, both of us were full and it was just the start of the night so we didn't want to overdue. Beautiful first meal in a beautiful city, very glad we got to enjoy it together!

name: Fat Kat Slim's
text:
Not perfect but I think this place has potential. The patty melt was tasty, though a bit on the small side for the price. The onion rings had too much breading and were on the border between well-seasoned and overly salty, but at least they weren't bland. The blackberry cobbler was delicious and the portion size was ample, but it was lukewarm at best. The music selection was superb and the service at the bar was excellent. And finally, while they're clearly aiming in a different direction with the focus on martinis, I think the addition of milkshakes (boozy or otherwise) and possibly even an adult take on some soda shop classics like egg creams and cherry lime rickeys would fit their theme nicely. 

In short, a mixed bag but there were enough good things to build on that I think this could end up being a decent place.

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Beth is the best EVER!! Beth helped me all throughout the night, my boss was playing, so I had to go back and forth between my seat and backstage. Beth walked me around the back to get to backstage and even brought my wallet I left on the table to me!! The food was so good too!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: 3 of our 5 kids live in Nashville and we visit often so we will definitely be back! The food was delicious, the waitress was patient and friendly with our table of 13 and the kids loved dancing to Rocky Top!!  We had a great time and can't recommend highly enough!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text:
Being married to a German, he wanted to go here since we moved to the Nashville area. He loves all the Bratwurst etc.  Me being a vegetarian always finds something on the German menus. I opted for the dumplings with mushroom gravy. The waiter suggested 1 potato & 1 bread, my husband told me to get 2 potato, but followed the waiters lead. Loved the potato one, the bread one wasn't flavorful or even warm on the inside. When the waiter came back I told him the bread one wasn't good & he just took my plate & said ok. Didn't offer to bring another potato one. This dish was $12.00!  So essentially we paid $12. for 1 potato dumpling. Definitely not worth it!

Manager has promptly contacted us, apologized & said they were planning on taking the bread dumpling off the menu anyway.  This apology went a long way with us & we will definitely visit this restaurant again.

name: Rocketown
text: just here for the skate park. brought my nephew here.  skate park is in good shape. there all about safety. staff is very friendly and helpful. they have a coffee shop serves burgers pizza dogs etc. prices aren't bad.  they also have a show venue here that is also a church on sundays.  great to have a safe place to take kids. being here makes me want to check out a show sometime.  Probably over rated the place but the safe haven for kids is worth it.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: If you are looking for an authentic German experience, this place is pretty darn close.  Good food, good servers and good entertainment.  There are items on the menu for everyone - even a few choices for vegans.   The atmosphere is very electric when they have performers on stage.  You'd swear you were in a German pub until you walk out the door into the southern humidity.  Do yourself a favor and try it at least once.  I think you'll be back again.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: What a wonderful place, went there yesterday at 12:30 and was told would have an hour and a half wait, advised to come after 4 PM. Came back today at 4:30 and got right in. Our party of four had fried chicken meatloaf country fried steak and pulled pork. Everything was excellent and our server Kramer was outstanding. If you're looking for down-home cooking that is not real greasy this is the place. Got desserts to go, all homemade, and will enjoy later.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: I've been to Loveless once, on my last trip to Nashville, from California and I was looking forward to another meal until now. I am coming out again for a visit next week and I will be skipping it and unliking their FB page and unfollowing them on pinterest due to the LACK of customer service and complete disregard of a person's holiday as displayed by the review posted yesterday. I am appalled how unkind the staff was. There are so many fabulous places to eat in Nashville that I am glad to say I can cross Loveless OFF my must do's list for future trips. Really disappointed. Disgusted is more like it. We have better Southern Hospitality in California than Loveless showed.  And don't worry, I'll share this on social media to make sure everyone knows how Loveless treats customers.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Order to go on a beautiful day! They have a lot of picnic tables. Okay so it's Good food (especially the biscuits!) but I don't know about an hour long wait. It was our third attempt at coming for breakfast and we got smart and decided to Order our on the app. It was perfect we placed our order and walked around the cute little area and we got our food in 30 mins. My favorite was the biscuits!!! And meat loaf. My husband loved the hashbrown casserole! Overall it was good but next time we wouldn't make the drive out here we would go check somewhere else instead.

name: Big Shotz
text: Like everyone else, was overcharged.  Server lady had bad attitude even though I was all smiles.  1 star for the attitude, nothing but remorse for overpaying.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
This is a giant hostile gift shop rather than a restaurant. Wait is too long. Staff is not friendly. Biscuits are not delicious as advertised. Turns out the secret ingredient is non-dairy creamer. There's a reason people prefer real cream to non-dairy creamer. Actually some of the worst biscuits I've tried! Fried chicken was horrendous. I really wanted to like this place since I actually live nearby but had a bad experience here twice! Get ready to wait at least an hour before you get seated. Their business model seems to be making you wait a long time so that you buy stuff at their gift shops. This may have been a good breakfast place at one point in history but obviously they have let the quality of the food slide as it has become more of a tourist zoo. I will not be coming here again! 

Also when we finally were seated after waiting over an hour, over half the tables were open. Not sure why they are having so much trouble seating people!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Consistently good food. All the southern favorites like fried chicken, ham, greens, fish, and amazing desserts. Very generous portions and top notch sweet tea. It's always crowded so make sure you give yourself time.

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
The Good: A hidden gem in Nashville. Music was great; atmosphere was terrific; exceptional service. 

Nice food and drink selection. Wines on tap; other spirits. Great music and events. Looking forward to going back!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Today, we had Regan as our server. We had just gotten off of our red-eye flight and she welcomed us with so much hospitality. Food was also fantastic! Must-go location!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: A bit of a tourist trap, and not inexpensive, but you gotta love those biscuits. Terrific handmade jellies and jams too. Very hard to get a bad meal here, and service is top notch. We always take people here when they visit TN. It's a guaranteed bright spot in everyone's visit to Music City.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text:
Horrible service! Server had no idea what the Restaurant Week special was (on day 4). Ordered cheese dip, he didn't bring it. Checked on us for the first time after we were 99% done. 

The only reason they got two stars is because the food was okay. And I mean... just okay. Nothing special.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
so, we drove almost an hour and had to wait about 90 minutes to be seated. 
no, pressure, loveless cafe. we only have a 13-hour ride back to nj ahead of us. nbd.

wait, actually- lots of pressure!!. the biscuits better be life-changing. 

THEY WERE. 
holy moly, these are some phenomenal eats. 

the biscuits. THE biscuits. oh em gee. i've never had a biscuit like this, and i can't stop craving them.  paired with the homemade preserves, they were AWESOME. and endless. (no, this is not a joke).

since this was our last meal in TN, i went BBQ... pulled pork over corn cakes, with sides of fried okra and cole slaw. it was SO yummy. i was pretty full from the endless biscuits (mmmmm biscuits), but the flavors of the bbq sauce and coleslaw to cut the richness were great. the fried okra was good too. it tasted good as a snack in the car a few hours later, too!

honestly, i'd go back and wait and wait and wait again. there are a few gift shops that share the parking lot, including a kitchen store that i believe sells some sandwiches (and they give out samples!). they have coffee and tea outside, which makes waiting even easier. 

5 stars for the biscuits. 4.5 stars for the rest of the food. and a definite drop to 4 stars for the service. 
our waitress was abrupt, barely made eye contact, and was almost impossible to catch. definitely not the southern hospitality i was hoping for from this place.

don't skip it. 
and if you're heading to or through the central nj area afterward, bring me some biscuits!! (pretty please?)

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Best restaurant in Nashville. Not only is the food fresh and delicious, the service is friendly, fun. Overall a perfect experience.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Skip the bbq biscuit. It's $3.50 and TINY. Complete price gouge. Should be like maybe $1.50 if that. It's just the lack of respect for the customer. It was decent. (Honestly it was cold when served). The rest of the food was diner breakfast food, nothing crazy. It gets some respect for the location. But if they keep up the downward slide like this, it'll only be tourists coming and that will shortly fall of because of the drive.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: We stopped here while in Nashville. We loved the biscuits!! But my meal was amazing smoked pork chops with a peach glaze. Delicious!

name: Big Shotz
text: This place is terrible!!! The bartender purposely overcharged us a beer because my mom left. When we received our bill and paid we told that he over charged us he didn't do anything and got super defensive. If you come here I would suggest watching what you buy and check your tab closely. I would not recommend coming here!!!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: I've eaten here once several months ago with a few friends. I wasn't especially impressed. There food was okay and I definitely think it was overpriced. The service was good and I thought the "much touted" biscuits were so-so. Bear in mind when you read this, I am by no means a connoisseur.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: If you are looking for some delicious Southern food this is the place to dine. While there is normally a wait, there is plenty of shopping and seats outside for relaxing. The meals are always started with homemade biscuits and jam, and no matter what you order for your main course you will not be disappointed. The food is delicious and I've never had bad service. Whether you live in the Nashville area or just visiting this place is a must go for all.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
This is a 3.5-3.7 star review for the food. We came at 10am on Father's Day and the wait was an hour. It was supposed to be 1:40, but we were not leaving until we experienced the food!

While we waited, we walked to the two stores. The clothing merch store was meh. However, the main shop was a tourist trap that we all were will to succumb to on this trip. I got the biscuit flour mix and snacks to bring home for the kids. 

Tons of shades for kids to hang around and grassy area for people to hang out and stay in the shade. 

The wait staff was friendly. The food was solid. I had expected more from the hype, especially the fried chicken, but it was just ok. 

Meats:  Fried chicken thigh meat--good but the breading was ok. I had expected more flavors. The grilled catfish was really salty. The fried catfish was ok.  You'll want to dip it in the pepper vinegar.c which is great. The pulled pork was the best protein there. Yum. 

Fried okre, green tomatoes--ok. Is it bad that I like the fried okre from Golden Corral in CA more?

Creamed corn--this was amazing. 

Casserole hash brown--ok. 

Fermented cheese with biscuit--meh

Buscuits--delicious with the jams.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: I'd give more stars if I could! People are not lying when they say this is a must go to spot when you're in Nashville. I know they are known for their biscuits, which are delicious but the jams is where it's at! They are beyond words amazing!!! I'm not a gravy person what so ever but my boyfriend is so we shared biscuits and gravy (I figured I'd just eat the biscuits plain) the gravy was so delicious I was dunking as much of the biscuit as I could into the gravy until I couldn't eat anymore! We also shared the chicken & waffles which I might add was more than enough food for the two of us! Everything was delicious and I love that you can walk around the property while waiting for your table, it makes the time pass way faster and the gift shop with the jams and other cute decor is a must see!

name: City Winery Nashville
text: City Winery was generic and didn't have that great of an environment.  We came for an after dinner drink, but couldn't get the attention of any of the waitstaff.  We went to the bar ourselves for service instead.  The wine was decent but nothing special.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Good southern cooking. Hashbrown casserole isnt all that good but the rest of the food we had was good. We had chicken and dumplings, sampler with fried chicken, bbq pork and country ham. Kate was very good as a server.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: What an incredible experience... and surprisingly at a mall! It literally felt like a stand alone restaurant. Great atmosphere with great food. Much of it verified by the German friends we had with us. Ate the pictures posted (forgot what they all were) and loved every bite. I would totally suggest this to friends who are in the area that don't want BBQ!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: We went off Yelp recommendation for a good breakfast place and ended up here. They give you biscuits once you order and there are delicious. I ordered fried chicken and waffles and the chicken was amazing! We enjoyed the atmosphere and the service was good even though it was busy we will return!

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
We had breakfast here on our drive from Nashville to the Natchez Trace Parkway, Franklin, and Belle Mead. I made reservations for a Monday but probably didn't need it as there were empty tables when we arrived. 

The restaurant is part of a larger complex of buildings that include lodging and a cute store that sells their preserves and biscuit mix. 

We had the following dishes:

* Chicken and Waffle - the white meat was drier than I like
* Fried Chicken and Two Eggs (dark meat) - the dark meat was nice and moist
* Pit-Cooked Pork Barbeque and Two Eggs

The meal came with biscuits, which were moist and delicious, and served with three types of yummy preserves: Strawberry, Blackberry, and Peach.  We loved the biscuits and preserves so much that we had them bring us a second helping!

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Good southern food at a good price in a good atmosphere.  There are so many good reviews so just ignore the bad ones.  Everyone else has discussed the biscuits and the rest of the food.  
  This place is trying to give you good southern food and does a dang good job of it.  Think about it this way,  I cook a better biscuit at home and they would make you swoon if you ate one....but I'm not cooking in the neighborhood of 10000 every single day!!  
  They are famous and have lasted a long time for just that reason.   Ignore the naysayers....I'm pretty sure they were simply not raised right,  and there's a rumor running around that they was raised up North somewheres.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Cute sign caught my eye to drive way out of the way to try on the road trip home.  What I found is a renovated restaurant that is quaint compared to Cracker Barrel. 

Unfortunately, the service to order is terrible!!! Takes too long to get there attention, they don't help you understand what's good here. 

After placing the order, it took MUCH too long to arrive. We should have just left after the 45 minute wait for our food but had hopes it would be good with all these reviews.. 

The Southern Omelet that Dad expected to be a Country ham omelette had a bunch of other things he did not want in it and the cheese was cold and not even melted from it's shredded state.  And this omelet made him very ill later in the day.  He was really sick after eating here. Somalia?

The biscuits are really small. The odd thing was when I ordered biscuits & gravy, the order came without biscuits.  I received a bowel of gravy with no biscuits. When I asked for some biscuits, they told me to use the 3 cold ones which sat on our table for the 35+ minute wait. I figured they were heading back to bring us some fresh warm biscuits while I ate these cold ones left on our table.  We needed biscuits for our 2 other plates of food. Unfortunately, after trying to flag down a woman for help of the 4+ women circulating next to the waitress station next to us, they finally arrived after our eggs were then cold. My daughter would then not eat her breakfast with cold eggs.

The waitresses need to brush up on hospitality and prompt service.  (Where is the Southern Hospitality?) They need to give more attention to the begining of a meal & during the meal. The best service was to get our credit card and back for payment. Which was odd after such poor service throughout the meal.

I am so sorry we stopped. This took much longer for expecting something better.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Literally only come here for the biscuits and jam. Her favorite is blackberry. My favorite is strawberry. We purchased 4 jars from the market during the visit. We also had other food, I think it was the daily special. Nice big  portions. We shared a plate with plenty of leftovers! Our waitress Susan was very animated and sweet. Excellent customer service was provided. We were greeted by everyone. What a great atmosphere. We will definitely be stopping back in for more complimentary biscuits and jam.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Think you need to be here for live music.  Big portions. Had sights on the pork shank but knew I wasn't hungry enough to do it justice. Had pork schnitzel and spaetzle.  Touch salty but good. Kids had bratwurst and loved them . Seemed to be a coarse meat grind so not like a hot dog which I prefer. Would go back.

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
Some warnings:

Located in a sketchy area

No live music in the restaurant -- must pay separate admission for the music. 

Parking is expensive - 10 dollars

Nice decor inside but the other problems make it less desirable. 

Many other better choices.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Excellent German Food.  The staff was wonderful, efficient and quick.  We enjoyed brats and corned beef as well as a fine German brew.  Definitely recommend.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: We were headed from Nashville to Memphis and wanted to grab dinner somewhere before it got too late. We chose this place since it was near I 40, and as we drove there we thought maybe we had picked a place too out of the way. I fell in love with the place before we even got inside. Loved the decor, the bright neon side outside and the country market with hams and jams. They serve delicious, melt in your mouth, warm biscuits at no charge and they come with 3 homemade jams. Food and service was great and my drink was never empty. We even got to sing happy birthday to one of the waiters. This is a memorable, must visit destination if you are ever in the area!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: This restaurant is a unique experience. The staff dresses up in traditional German clothing. There was live music. We had fair service. I think that the food is slightly overpriced for the quality. It was decent, though. The bratwurst was very good but other items were just okay, especially compared to other German restaurants that I have been to. It was fun to try but I probably won't be back.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Have eaten there a few times. Enjoy their barbecue chicken, green beans are great, and loved their cucumber salad. We also tried their breakfasts as well which was good. The only thing I wasn't a fan of was their biscuits (which is to be one of their signature foods). Texture was dense and they were greasy; other than that It was fair for my taste.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Good atmosphere but that is where the good things stopped.  Poor service.  Food was average at best. Prices was very high for the quality of food we received.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: I LOVE this place! The greens are amazing!! They're definitely my favorite so far. The fried green tomatoes are good, the catfish is good, chicken fried steak is huge, the eggs are decent, the hot warm biscuits will fill you up before the plate even comes. Hash brown casserole isn't bad, but not worth raving over. I've been here twice and have received phenomenal service each time. I've been told there's a wait usually, but I have had no such experience. Was seated immediately! Overall, I think it's worth a visit.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: What can I say great Staff make you feel right at home. Biscuits Biscuits Biscuits! So So Good I had Fried Chicken and Waffle Couldn't get through the waffle because too many biscuits lol Chick ws excellent though Others had eggs bacon etc.  Gravy was also to die for ! def try this place

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
Came for a late dinner tonight and loved the food, the wine, and the ambience. Had the Turkish White Blend by the glass but they have an extensive wine menu for all tastes! We started with the cheese platter, which was the perfect size for 3-4 people. We shared the risotto balls which were dynamite and for desert had the chocolate stoudt cake.... Very good! I also highly recommend the waiter Chocolate Thunder... You can have him with every course :) 

Oh and the steak entree was pretty banging!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: A great lunch stop on the way to the Natchez trace parkway.  Friendly service, great big salads with delicious breaded chicken.  Sweet tea and cute little gift shops.  We also took bbq & coleslaw to go for the next day. We will definitely be back.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Holy heck this place was amazing! My daughter and I both got the sampler as we couldn't decided. On mine, I got the ham, chicken and catfish. She got the meatloaf, pulled pork and chicken. We both tried a taste of everything and all of it was good. My one warning is that the ham, is very salty. We personally like it that way, but if you don't like salt, then avoid this dish. 
I can't not mention the biscuits and jams. I could make a meal off these alone. They were completely with our meal. They are served warm and to die for. 
If you are in the area, you need to try this place. It was lovely! We will be back.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Very good place for dinner - homemade biscuits and jam were super. Friendly waitress and good, prompt service. There were six of us and all of our food cans at the same time. Plus....they serve moonshine!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Amazing food, service could be better. Biscuits are delicious. I love the southern environment feel. For it being a famous landmark the prices are super reasonable!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: This famous cafe lived up to its standards. The service was amazing and the food was great. Also, if you like sweet tea and homemade biscuits this is the place to go. The prices were not too bad for the size of the portions. It was nice to walk around after dinner a explore the little shops.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Died and gone to heaven comes to mind when eating at the Loveless Cafe.  Biscuits that are fresh and home made!  Country ham and pit BBQ with eggs and grits for breakfast awesome!  Want delicious and cheesy hash browns?  Got it!  I can't say enough about this place except "Superb!!!"  Friendly staff with a southern charm.  This is worth the 25 minute drive from downtown Nashville.  Spend some time wandering around their shops, well worth it.  Crafts and food and an awesome BBQ kitchen.  Just stick me in the vat with the sausage gravy.  Happy to expire there!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Amazing food and staff ! So glad I stopped it was worth it ! I used the app and ordered since I was traveling ! The biscuits are amazing try them !!!

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text:
Brandon, you're a rock start! Quality service. Food is ok, but what I tried wasn't not a signature dish so I won't judge them by that even though I believe everything should be amazing. I had the pigs in the blanket looking things. The sausage tasted good. They don't come with dipping sauce so if you are one that needs that, then you need to ask for it on the side. 

The decor is very medieval with the chandelier and the flowers on them. The staff dresses with German outfits. They don't seem to like wearing them, but they go very well with the atmosphere they are trying to create.

They have a big bar area where they have TVs  and differ wells, beers and wines. They have high top tables in that area too. 

They have a gift shop when you enter with different merchandise; key chains, cups, shirts, etc.

Go check them out, you won't feel you are in Germany but definitely will experience some of it.

name: Big Shotz
text: Save your money for the better bars in the area. The drinks are cheap, but the poor service, warm beer, and overall bad management make the place not worth it.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
The food is really amazing. The biscuits and jam are really awesome. Service was awesome down home service you don't see anywhere else

Must try when you are around Nashville Tnn

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text:
Nice job replicating a little piece of Bavaria 

Good selection on the menu ....nice offering of beers 

Service team takes on the Bavarian hospitality role with refreshing enthusiasm....as do many of the regular patrons

Wunderbar !

Noch ein Bier, bitte?!!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Great service from very engaged manager and wait staff. Fried chicken sets standard for Nashville. Salads are good..not great..could use mixed greens and more variety. Corncake and biscuits excellent and jams outstanding. Fried okra had too much breading..lighten up! You can see why its top 10. No reservations so arrive early or late.  Year in and out a must.

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
I can't stand people that lie. We called to ask about whether the Predators would be viewable during the concert and two different callers were told YES! Absolutely!  We understand it is the finals and the Preds game will be viewable at your table. 
NOPE!!!  Not only that, they only had ONE TV in the outer dining room/bar. 
Seriously?!?!????
Even the band was huddled in the bar to watch.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Worth the wait BUT you can make RSVP online!
We heard about Loveless Cafe on a national morning show and made a point of going on our trip to the midwest, happily making a reservation for brunch. We followed the GPS out a lovely road, West End, passing elegant homes, and once there, checked in and were called rather close to the time we reserved. There are plenty of things to look at while you are waiting: cornhole boards, gift shops. Once inside, Mary was our server, and greeted us with a brilliant smile, happy eyes and welcoming us with a complimentary basket of fresh hot biscuits, several homemade jams, and drinks. Our meals were heavenly: my husband had delicious pulled pork and veggies, and I had waffle with substantial amount of melting chocolate chips and real butter, with FOUR slices of bacon. The service was great, she gave us a box and sent us out full and happy. We loved the Loveless Cafe! You will, too!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: I unfortunately found this place a bit overrated. Food was decent. Price was great and so was the service. I just found the flood a lil less than seasoned and the biscuits weren't as fluffy as I imagined. Plus there is a long wait since it's so popular

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Wow! Two hour wait but so worth it. We came at 6:00pm on a Friday. We knew anywhere we went was going to be a wait. Waitress was friendly and knowledgeable about all of the menu. The biscuits reminded me of my Granny's biscuits. Pretty emotional moment in many ways. Brought back memories but also made you want to keep grabbing them. Jellies were very good and the waitress brought several kinds for us to try. They were all very good. The fried chicken wasn't the best I've had but was very good. Okra was lacking and kept this from being a five star review. Macaroni was good. I would definitely want to come back here but I would probably come much earlier.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Love, love, love Loveless Cafe!  So Nashville!!  My biscuits are better but Loveless is a close second!!

name: City Winery Nashville
text: This review is based solely on a musical show we attended, not a dinner or food prep/service. We attended the Marc Broussard show on December 31st.  We like to sit upstairs as you can get a private table as opposed to sitting at the communal tables downstairs.  The downstairs tables/chairs are VERY close to one another and it makes me uncomfortable, especially if I don't know my dining neighbors :-).  The Somm at City Winery.  Just tell her wine type or flavor profile you like, and she picks a bottle just for you.  Prices are reasonable for tickets AND wine.  The sound quality is exceptional and it's a very intimate venue.  I highly recommend City Winery for the music alone, but I also hear the food is delicious.

name: Bavarian Bierhaus
text: Was not disappointed.. amazing food and good prices!!!! We shared a pretzel with beer cheese as an app. Split the reuban and the 2 sausage plate. Let satisfied for sure.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
While on a business trip to Nashville, we had a chance to visit the Loveless Cafe for lunch on a weekday. Great timing because we only had a 20 minute wait and spent that time shopping in the cute little gift shop. Got a package of Piggy Popcorn which went over great at the office at home. Wearing my Praise the Lard T-shirt as I type this.
The food was classic Southern goodness. Delicious biscuits and jam to start the meal, and could have stopped there and been happy happy happy. Proceeded to have the BBQ sandwich and found it to be pretty tasty though not knock your socks of great. Coworkers had the fried chicken livers and the chicken fried steak smothered in gravy. I also had the sweet tea. Yum. I thought the livers were a little overcooked and did not get to taste the other entree. The caramel sweet potatoes side dish was wonderful! 
Loved walking around the property, especially smelling the smokey BBQ pit outside on a crisp, clear day. Everyone there was very nice, in typical Southern style. We felt welcome and left well fed and happy. 
If you cannot make the trip, do go to the website and buy up some of their tasty jams and hams.

name: City Winery Nashville
text:
Disappointing. That is the first word which comes to mind about my experience at City Winery. The service was uncomfortable. The food was an overpriced mediocre attempt at a la mode cuisine. The wine was good but not enough to overcome the other elements. Once seated, we waited approximately 20 minutes before our drink order was taken due to the servers each thinking the other was in charge of our table. As it was Sunday night, the restaurant was not busy. The first two things I ordered were not available. It took the server over 30 minutes to realize my second option was not prepared, and I had to fall onto a third choice. I understand running out of things on a busy night...or even her returning right after putting in the ticket to inform me they had run out of something, but this was odd. Food was eventually delivered with all the courtesy and customer service of the social security office. Food tossed on tables. Server awkwardly hovered but did not actually ask if everything was ok, then disappeared until we were pretty much done eating. 
Food ordered: 
Head of Romaine Salad: Boring, underdressed. Salad can be simple without being boring. This was not the case.
farro risotto was nice and hearty. Best thing we ordered. 
Shrimp piri piri: warm, mild flavored shrimp served on a bed on fridge cold couscous salad. The temperature different was offputting.
Pan chicken: underwhelming.
We did receive a complimentary dessert in compensation for the lack of available menu items. The olive oil cake was the best part of the meal, but was also tossed onto the table so that the forks slid into the marmalade (covering the handles of the forks) and the gentleman delivering the food seemed surprised when we asked for a little more marmalade (since the majority ended up sticking to the fork handles)
Our server was adequate, but shied away from our table.
Go for wine. Not for food.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
Loveless Cafe is a beacon of southern comfort food for me, like it is for many others. Every time I'm back in Nashville, I make my pilgrimage to Loveless. The biscuits are always as good as they are in my memory, the preserves are so flavorful, and the hot food is delicious. The fried chicken is definitely above average, and all of the southern sides are a hit. 

I would recommend Loveless Cafe to any visitor going to Nashville. It will definitely be a hit. However, the 2+ hour wait gets old. This last time I went, my boyfriend and I played the "Guess Who" game with countless portraits of celebrities on the walls of the cafe while waiting 1.5 hours for our table. So if I'm in Nashville next time and had limited time and patience, I would take myself to Monell's for a comparably delicious and authentic southern food experience.

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Good show venue , but it took 30 minutes for basic food.  Fries that cost 7 dollars should not be worse than fries I made in my oven at home from Kroger.  On tap beer selection has areas for improvement.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
I dream about their darn biscuits. I almost need to unfollow them on IG because my heartaches when they show up in my feed. LOL Gosh they are good. I am a picky foodie and I am hard to please when it comes to biscuits. These are perfect. Lacking nothing. They are buttery, flaky, tender, moist, full of flavor, just yum. 

As far as the entrees I have mainly had breakfast. All of their breakfast meats (bacon, sausage, ham) are awesome. The eggs are eggs..lol. Pancakes, GREAT! I have also had their fried chicken..so good. 

Just go. You will not regret it. The service is friendly and prompt. The wait can be long but they have all kinds of things to walk around and look at and a little shop to browse. It is worth the drive and the wait. It is my go to every single time I am in town. 

LOVE IT!

name: City Winery Nashville
text: Unfortunately I was a victim of a security breach through there website when I purchased tickets a year and a half ago. In addition, I wasn't able to attend said show due to having to be in the ER that night. Immediately following the incident, I was sent a gift card in the mail and was told I could have tickets on the house to any show I choose, due to the security breach. Which was awesome! Well for the longest time, browsing through the upcoming shows, there wasn't anyone I wanted to see. Finally I found someone I wanted to see, Ani DiFranco. It being a year and a half later I was weary of them still giving me tickets, but I asked anyhow. There was even a new box office manager since the incident had occurred. Amazingly he, William, was well aware of the incident and still granted me the tickets (which that is very rare when there is a new manager). We had an amazing time. The food was excellent, our seats were great, and it's a great atmosphere. If you are looking for a more personal concert experience, this is the place to go. And the manager on the floor, Mike, even took the time to stop by our table, acknowledging me by name, making sure I was enjoying my visit. That was my first time at City Winery and I am beyond impressed. I have worked in the service industry for 15 years and it is very hard these days to find an establishment that truly cares about their customers. Sorry for the long post, but thank you so much! I will definitely spread the word.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: Upon our arrival to the Loveless Cafe I was mentally ready for the wait. The wait was about 45 minutes to an hour. However, the cafe has little stores you can check out on campus. The history behind the cafe is pretty cool it use to be a motel. If I had known the biscuits were going to be that delicious I would have saved myself and not ordered the pancakes. Needless to say I did not even touch the pancakes because I was so full on biscuits. The jams that were served with the biscuits were so good best jams I have ever had. There was a strawberry, blackberry, and peach. I also have to say the OJ was absolutely great! Next time for sure I will be ordering the waffle and chicken, and take home the biscuits and jam for a snack. I also, noticed throughout our meal, our server was not so great. We didn't get drink refills until the end of our meal. She really did not check if we needed anything else. Other than that this cafe is a definitely must if you are visiting Nashville.

name: Loveless Cafe
text:
A few friends and I went to loveless on our trip to Nashville because we had heard it was the place to go.

For an hour and a half wait? 
Meh.

Now, coming from Chicago-- Im used to the variety of breakfast/brunch options. So maybe I have just a different idea of what brunch should be. All and all, it was very plain. My favorite part was the Hash-brown casserole, and honestly I'd likely just recommend a bowl of that and some biscuits.

If you have the time, worth a stop to a "must go" breakfast place. Otherwise, i'd pass.

name: Loveless Cafe
text: My wife & I were in Nashville last Fall and wanted to try out one of the restaurants I had seen on the Food Network. We were directed to Loveless Cafe and we were not disappointed.
