The jukebox is alright. My brother paid money to hear some songs and I am pretty sure we left before they all came on because he chose to let them play whenever, rather than next. Nice job, brother.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: Enjoyed the concert while we waited on our dinner. The meat on the burger could have been thicker but it was tasty. Onion straws were thinner than I expected but overall a good experience.

name: Third Man Records
text:
Esta es la famosa disquería mas estudio de grabación de Jack White. Un lugar más que pintoresco que recontra vale la pena visitar si es que tienen pensado ir a Nashville.

Si son fans de la música, Third Man Records es de esos lugares que les resultará encantador, una tienda tan interesante como estéticamente bella, la cual es un placer conocer.

Para los fanáticos de White, la travesía será mejor aún ya que tiene bocha de material del mítico músico de los White Stripes y de seguro que encontrarán varias cosas que serán de su agrado.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: 5 stars for happy hours prices.  Food has been surprising for being a back alley bar (literally).  I've gone there twice.  I have yet to find another $5 Bloody Mary in this town.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Food was pretty good, but the service was very slow. We took advantage of the happy hour (2-4-1 well and beer until 6p), but ended up having issues with our bill. The fried pickles were AMAZING. Definitely a must have. Worth a visit, but hope the service improves.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Im not a fan of country music but this place was a lot of fun.

First the negatives, and here aren't many.

The concessions, is VERY weak.. There is one main place for crappy food (hot dogs etc) and then a section for alcohol, and on a busy night, the lines are long.

The stage itself is very elaborate and very nostolgic. We saw one of the Judd's here (the larger one), and she was good and reminded me of the old show "HeeHaww".

I particularly liked the 'bench' seating, which gave you a more than adequate space to sit and plenty of leg space.

Crowds were polite and orderly, and I would come here again if I had to listen to country.

name: Belcourt Taps
text: The burgers are great. The other stuff on the menu is pretty good too. Provided you can actually order and get it. I've given this place so many chances, but they keep screwing up. How someone to work the outside!! I went an hour early to see a movie five seconds across the street, ordered a beer and tacos and barely made the movie. Service is just pathetic. Good food. Terrible throughout service.

name: Music City Tippler
text: GREAT SPACE!   A refreshing change from the Nashville norm of dumpy roadhouse bars.    Loved that the place had three different rooms which three different vibes.   The cocktails were great and the staff was super friendly.   Im sure this place will hold some great events and I cant wait to go back.

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text: This place started off cool until the overachiever muscle head bounce came up to me and asked for my ID. They checked my ID at the door and we had been there for at least 20 mins when he came up to our group. Of the 3 of us, he only asked me, after looking me up and down. I thought he was joking because we had to show it to get in the door. I asked him to see a manager and when the manger finally came, he was a jerk and really didn't care. The door man was too busy tryna talk to some chick to do his job. They need people who actually gonna do their job and not these losers. If you come here be prepared to show your ID several times. The karaoke part was cool and drinks were decent but the people working here outside the bartenders are horrible.

name: Belcourt Taps
text:
By far the best burger in Nashville and I've been to about every burger joint in the city.  They recently added several smaller menu items such as shrimp/chicken tacos, smaller plates, etc...everything they make is great.  It's the best value for food and drinks I've seen in the city.

We go there all the time; its a laid back atmosphere with good beer on tap, great food, and very friendly staff.  The Sunday Brunch burger is the best burger I've ever eaten.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: I had the saucer dipster which was pretty good. The only bad thing was the service. We had an hour for lunch and that is about how long it took for us to get our food. Nice looking place, too bad I didn't get to try any of the beers.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Bad, very bad ... Music was great but don't eat there. Screwed up/ mixed up all the orders. My dog would not eat this stuff.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Had an amazing time and experience with my team at B.B. Kings. We were searing quickly and the live music was amazing! Our server Devonté was outstanding and made our experience great. Highly recommended

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
I wanted a place with good food and good beer for our first meal in Nashville. I was not disappointed!

My friend and I both ordered some local beers that are escaping me currently, but they were good, I promise. I got the Turkey Meltdown, and she ordered the Kick Ass Chicken. The food was super solid, and the desserts looked amazing - even though I did not eat any. 

The place itself is spacious and comfortable. There's a sunroom area with couches and tables when you walk in. The main bar area has a lot of low and high top tables, some of which are communal tables. The bar is large. The servers were knowledgable about the beer - they had like 12 on tap at least. 

There were specials as well on various days and happy hours. Good place, cute location. Not right on the Broadway strip, but good location.

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
If it wasn't for Yelp and similar word-of-mouth, I don't know how people would find this place. The name "Back Alley Diner" is appropriate as it's really down an otherwise dark alley with very little signage or notification. Hidden, would be appropriate. But the Yelp reviews were good and it was close to where I was walking near the Capitol (do check out the Capitol) and so here we were.

Seat yourself and I took a comfy booth and was able to get signed on to the wifi before my waitress came by for my order. A local beer (Yazoo) and a cheeseburger with cole slaw were on the way a few moments later.

Beer was nice and cold. Burger was cooked medium with a good amount of blue cheese. The cole slaw was plain and unremarkable. But the burger rescued and "A-OK" to a "Yay! I'm a fan!".

Neat little place with karaoke some nights and plenty of regulars at the bar. I can see coming back to it one day.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: So this got the 4 stars mearly because of the ambiance. When I went it took too long to get a table, but the entertainment was very talented. Their music made for a great atmosphere. My ribs were good and the coleslaw was great, but I thought it was overpriced for what it was. Considering the cover charge I wasn't loving the overall cost of the night but it was my first time in Nashville and I wanted an experience. I got it!

name: Third Man Records
text: Andy Warhol said, "Being good in business is the most fascinating kind of art. Making money is art and working is art and good business is the best art." Third Man Records celebrates art in various forms...What a cool experience. Jess was extremely helpful and knowledgeable. We will stop in again...

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Awesome beer selection. A bit on the pricey side. Food is quite good. Fee to park there. Overall a great place to have a beer but would be better with a patio.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Had apps and drinks with friends...great atmosphere with extensive draught beer choices.  Staff is friendly and efficient. Appetizers were excellent.  Wonderful place to meet up and hang out!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: A tale of two joints.  Friday night (7/15) we had a great experience.  Paid a reasonable cover, listened to fantastic music, got great service, and had a good time.  So much so, that when we were looking for someplace to finish the next night off with food, we headed back.  First surprise was the 400% increase in the cover charge.  Gladly paid it, because we were looking forward to good entertainment and food.  After 30 minutes, it was clear the the entertainment was up to snuff, but the service was absent.  I went to the hostess to let her know that we hadn't been waited on yet.  She essentially failed to respond.  I returned to my table in the hopes the lack of service W would be corrected.  No joy.  We left without being handed a menu.   Even after complaining on the way out, we were met with indifference.  To add insult to injury, the party of six that came in 15 minutes after us (for whom we helped move chairs and tables) were served before we left.  $40 lesson learned I guess.  Boo.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: Good food at an affordable price. Definitely a hole -in-the-wall type place with a chill atmosphere and great service. I was especially happy to order the fruit cup and actually find good fruit other than all melons. Highly recommend checking this out for a laid back night.

name: Dan McGuinness Irish Pub
text:
We came to Dan McGuinness this afternoon on a whim, looking for a nice place with an outdoor patio to grab some lunch.  This simple Irish pub did not disappoint!  We were here on a Sunday, so there was no live music or rowdiness from the crowd, which was just fine by us (we participated in a Pedal Tavern tour the night before and were looking for something greasy to ease our hangovers--loud music was not what we wanted at all).  

My fiance ordered the fish and chips and I chose the cobb salad.  Both of us were very happy with the freshness of our food; my salad was full and hearty, topped with lots of grilled chicken and veggies, and his fish and chips were hot, crispy and very fresh.  We shared bites of each and, of everything we ate, the french fries were my favorite part.  They were thick cut and perfectly cooked, topped with just the right amount of seasoning salt.

Our server was kind and attentive, answering our questions about the menu, refilling our drinks without us asking, and making sure we were comfortable and happy with our dining experience.  Prices for our meals were more than reasonable and the menu had lots of options for traditional Americanized Irish pub fare, healthy salads, soups and burgers.

Reading other reviews about Dan McGuinness', we probably wouldn't come here for a night out, but for a delicious lunch on a spacious outdoor patio, we'd be back in a heartbeat!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: It's history. Beautiful and nostalgic. We didn't make the tour inside, but the outside was better than nothing.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: We went on a guided tour, and had a great time.  We were able to see all the 'behind the scenes' and were impressed by our tour guide's knowledge and personability.  Would highly recommend!

name: Back Alley Diner
text: After the reviews I was excited to try the place out...not any more.   The only thing that tasted even remotely fresh were the bacon wrapped stuffed peppers.  Everything else came straight from the freezer.

name: Music City Tippler
text: The relatively subdued lower level bar is more comfortable for us than the hectic See and Be Seen bar in the front main room . The lower bar is in a smaller room down some steps anchored by a modest stage of rough old wood. Tippler offers dedicated cocktails for Nashville, different from the original Manhattan lounge. But I was impressed with their fine classic martini with two generous dashes of orange bitters stirred into some fine dry vermouth and gin. And the bartender squeezed the oil from the lemon peel into the drink carefully, in a way that was more than perfunctory; no olive. About the decor, Nashville is literally not literary in the New York City style so it was amusing to see a set of Dickens and of World Book on prominent display. But better that than the cheap glitz in certain local bars.

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text: For a Saturday I expected it to be crowded but something was up with the karaoke set up. The songs kept cutting out and there was no flow to the singers. I don't know. I've been to way better bars and could not have gotten any service from a bartender. We left real quick.

name: Third Man Records
text: Just a helluva place for vinyl geeks.  Friendly folks, bizarre/quirky items up for grabs, a dadgum instant record recording studio.  Full of weirdo Jack White vibes everywhere--which is a great thing.

name: Belcourt Taps
text: Stumbled across this place while looking for a place to get drinks near Vanderbilt hospital. Great atmosphere!! There was live music the night we went, and the performers were amazing. Perfect place to unwind after a long day.

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
Stumbled upon Back Alley Diner (aka BAD) after visiting the Nashville State Museum.  It's a nice hole-in-the-wallish looking place in an alley.  You wouldn't come across it unless you were looking for it.  Anyway, I got the pulled pork sandwich with bbq sauce with fries.  I had no complaints.  I didn't think the pulled pork was greasy or fatty or anything.  The bbq sauce came on the side, so I was able to put as much or as little as I wanted.  The fries were crispy, just how I like them!  

This is a no frills restaurant.  Not fancy, nice people, and straight to the point.  I wouldn't make a point to go back if I were in Nashville because there are a lot of other restaurants I'd like to try, but I have no complaints!

name: Third Man Records
text:
As a vinyl junkie record collector I just had to stop here on my trip to Nashville. We arrived early to get a ticket for the tour but there was a line already so we came back later and luckily they added on another tour. 

We loved the tour, our tour guide was friendly and loved her job. It was like walking through a non creepy version of "Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory." And just like the Oompa Loompas everyone behind the scenes had uniforms to wear.  And they all seemed like they enjoyed working there.  

For the record store there was a great selection of Third Man vinyl and merchandise from the white stripes days too.  

Any fan of vinyl should make a point to stop here.

name: Third Man Records
text:
Awesome place!  We've been to the Detroit location as well and love them both!  I was able to get some really nice & rare vinyl records and the staff couldn't have been more helpful and pleasant to work with. 

There's lots of cool merch to buy, artwork to see, recordings to listen to, people from all around the world to talk to and a palpable buzz and creative vibe in the air. 

Take the studio tour if you're able but it books up QUICK!  They took us through the creative process, areas, technical gear, art department, lunch lounge, performance spaces and merchandise warehouse, etc.  We even saw some pre-release materials and masters from some of the bests artists you have and haven't heard of!

My highest recommendation goes to Third Man Records for many reasons. Support the Art and the Artists and we'll all be better off!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Great service today by Alexus and the food was fantastic. We had an array of foods. Kids tenders and Mac'n Cheese, 2 burgers, brisket, and chic/ribs combo. All were an A+. They had some lunch music that we enjoyed, as well.  We would all go back again.

name: Third Man Records
text: I love Jack White and his music! This is such a wonderful, fun, all around fantastic place and his love for music shines here. I could have spent all day just looking as it was most inspirational. The only downside was the staff, all of whom were luke warm at best.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: This was my first time in Nashville. I was excited to try some southern Barbq but when I arrived and looked around at other people's plates, the food seemed generic so I went with their Barbq burger to be safe. It was good. But most of all the atmosphere was what won me over. The BB king band sounded amazing and the guest singers too. I even had to get up and dance at one point... And I was by myself (in town for work)! I only deducted a star bc the drinks weren't very tasty.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Bought last minute tickets to Paramore here. I was walking in expecting to be disappointed at the seats that we got because there weren't many options to choose from. To my surprise, we had really good seats! Seriously!!! I don't think there are any "bad" seats in this venue. I wish all of my favorite bands played at the Grand Ole Opry House.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: It's the Grand Ole Opry. I didn't even like country music when I went but country has evolved so much that some of the artists you catch here could really surprise you. I saw Sara Darling when I went and thought she was pretty great. The seats are comfy and over the two hours you're there, you get to see a bunch of different artists. I thought it was really fun, I'm warming up to country, and I'd defnitely go again.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Every time my husband and I pass through Nashville, we make it a point to stop here. I love this staple of our Nashville tradition. For our anniversary (6 years this past Wednesday!) we made our way to Nashville to enjoy each other and the beautiful sounds of this city. So of course, last night we chose BB King's to soothe our ears. This was the best time we have ever had there! The band was the greatest that we had ever heard. The girl's voice was phenomenal. I'd come back every night just to listen to her. Never get rid of this band! Absolutely amazing. Thank you, BB King's, for making our anniversary the best one to date.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
The Grand Ole Opry is absolutely beautiful. This stunning and historic building boasts top name country acts as well as seasoned county vets. Every seat in the house in a good one. It's small enough to where you can see the stage well from everywhere. It's air conditioned and very clean and comfortable. The staff is also really friendly and jumped in to offer to take our pictures and show us to our seats. 

Buy your tickets early to ensure a spot. The only downside to purchasing early is that you don't know who is performing. We went to a show where we didn't know a single person performing. But even then, it was still really fun and enjoyable. 

The show is split into two halves. Each one is an hour and has a different host. Each performance is quick. They only perform about two to three songs per person. This keeps the pace of the show moving really quickly. 

If you're lucky, you could catch a big name act here. But even if not, come and enjoy the history of the opry.

name: Dan McGuinness Irish Pub
text:
Decent food for an Irish Pub. I have come here multiple times for football and soccer games, and it is a great atmosphere for soccer. The service is attentive and friendly and provides good recommendations for beers.

It seems that the crowd at night is primarily college-aged students, and the back patio turns into a dance floor.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: I was stoked to go inside and listen to live music at BB Kings, the $5 charge was no surprise, but how often do we see a BB Kings.  Of all the drinks listed, I was craving a mojito, and the waitress advised they were able to use the last of their mint for one last mojito - phew.  I ordered the fried catfish, and it was fried perfectly with tender flakes...no fishy taste whatsoever.  My husband ordered the brisket, and it melts in your mouth.  Sound system at this place is outstanding, the female vocalist got everyone out of their seats.  The dance floor is big and spacious, everyone was having a good 'ole time!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
Not impressed at all. We had to pay a five dollar cover charge because of the entertainment. The food was mediocre at best and I had to return my potatoes because they were cold. 

I believe a restroom in an establishment tells you a lot about the cleanliness of the facility. The restrooms were horrid. I do not recommend this restaurant and I will not return.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Visited on a Friday evening. Environment and seating was great. We sat on the high rise and our view was great down onto the stage. They picked great upcoming singers, current hit artists, and comedians to perform. I can honestly say I really enjoyed every performer. Will definitely keep returning.

name: Third Man Records
text:
I wanted to like it, I really did.  It has cool stuff in it, and I liked all the vinyl.  We tried to use the photo booth, and that is where things started to go off the rails.  Photo booth took REEEALLY long, and then stopped working. They did refund my money.

  I realize it's a touristy thing, but thought many of the items were at a gouge price level.  I might take a friend from out of town, but I will manage my expectations when I return.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Stopped by BB King's for a late lunch. We ordered our drinks and waited. It was happy hour on appetizers so we ordered The nachos with pork.  The pork was good the rest not so much. Still waiting for that beer. Finally flagged down the waitress. We got an "oh I forgot".   We we ordered ribs and pulled pork sandwiches they were awesome!  That's why my review is middle of the road. There are some great foods and some great servers. We just didn't get everything. Will probably try again. The music is worth the trip if you can get a drink.

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: It won't let me give it 0 stars! Terrible customer service! I called with a beer question, not only did he refuse to answer, but hung up on me! We're from out of town and WILL NEVER GO HERE!!!! MEAN TERRIBLE SERVICE!!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: I cant say how thankful I am to the staff here, I have a sprained foot and a knee scooter and was going to walk down the stairs but the security at the front cal and got a gentlemen to take me around the top part of the bar to the elevator so that I didn't have to walk down or back up the stairs. Very very helpful. I really appreciated the extra effort they gave to make sure I was comfortable.

name: Belcourt Taps
text: I want to give this place a bad rating so I can keep this hidden gem to myself, but it absolutely deserves 5 stars! The local live music is the heart of nashville and the bartenders are so friendly and on point! Definitely my go to neighborhood bar

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Three of us went into this bar today and we sat there for twenty mins before walking out. We were never served or greeted. It was like we were invisible , the bar tender looked right us and just kept talking to a couple at the bar. We will never go back.

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
We had planned on going to Bicentennial Mall Park to see the Nashville Symphony perform on a Friday night at 8pm. We looked around for a place to eat & noticed the high rating of this place. Why not try it? We parked between here & the Mall. It wasn't much of a walk & we found B.A.D. (Back Alley Diner) from the small sign on the side walk of Church street. The diner is located in the alleyway east of the Loews Hotel. 

There's an entrance at street level & one up a few steps. The entrance up the steps directs you to use the street entrance. We arrived around 7pm (missing the daily happy hour that is from 4pm-7pm, damn!) and was greeted with a sign that told us to seat ourselves. We had our pick of the place because there were only a few people at the bar. They've got tables and chairs along with booths. 

Our sever came up immediately and greeted us and got our drink order. She was very friendly. She told us of a special they had that night, a pork burger, not to be confused with the regular pork burger on the menu because that is a burger with pulled pork on it.  This pork burger was a burger made of pork. I love a pork burger, but I decided on the Mega Titan Burger ($8.99) that comes with "Mouthwatering Burger, LOADED with Applewood Smoked Bacon, Sautéed Mushrooms and Cheddar Cheese​". My boyfriend ordered the pork burger special however for $8.99.

I'm not sure how long B.A.D. has been around, but the place shows it's age. It doesn't look dirty or anything, mind you, but you can tell the building has been around for a while, but that's what I like about it. 

It didn't take but about 10 minutes for our food to come out. We both ordered the French fries. I'm glad we did. I would guess that they fries are from a bag, they look like Rally's fries but taste a million times better. They have the right amount of breading on them, a nice spice and salt flavor. I could've ate a pound of them. 

Onto the Mega Titan burger. This thing is big. I was surprised with the size of the burger and amount of fries for the $8.99 price, especially being downtown. The cheese was all gooey and melted on top of the pile of bacon. The burger had a nice beef flavor and was juicy. A fluffy bun, what else can I say. It was delicious. Phillip also loved the pork burger special. 

I know the place is rated well and I now see why it is. The food is delicious and the prices are great. It's located off the beaten path but I'm glad I found it and will be going back again!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Great music and food. Our waiter Devonte was outstanding and made our visit even better.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Everything was awesome. Considering the traffic and their advise, we gave ourselves 1 hour to get to the show from the exit which was plenty.

It is very poorly managed. Give yourself at least three hours to get to the doors in time for the show.

I would not buy tickets again. Watch it somewhere more accessible.

Took me more time in the traffic both ways than the actual show.

The show Rockettes was awesome.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: My dad loves Blues and Jazz so when he came to visit me in Nashville, I knew I wanted to try this place out. We got there around 9 and it was pretty full but we were able to get two seats at the bar. We sat, drank whiskey, and listened to the live band for hours. The band was more Funk that Blues or Jazz and I was worried my dad wouldn't like it, but he really enjoyed it. Can't really speak to their food menu but the bar was pretty standard and the bartenders were nice. Still, it does have the "chain" feel to it and there was a cover which I always find hard to justify when there's a dozen other places right around the corner that don't have any cover charge. But if you're looking for something a bit different than the standard  honky-tonks on Broadway, might be worth a shot.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: The music was fantastic and the food was delicious. They had the best shrimp and grits that I have ever tasted before.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Just went here for lunch today on July 3rd. Not as crowded as we expected, but I'm sure that will change after 5pm.

Our waitress (my wife called her Taylor Swift lol) was excellent. We enjoyed her level of humor and her great service. I ordered the walleye sandwich with fries while the wife, Chris, ordered the regular burger. Everything was excellent for a small waterfront pub. So nice to have walleye again! Would go here again next time we are in this area.

The views from the outside deck are very nice of the riverfront. The drive back to here is a little bumpy due to the deterioration of the road, but not too bad.

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text: Find it rather annoying when you come in and pay $13 for a drink, go to request to sing a song and told they have it but don't sing "slow songs" after 9pm. Seriously? What a rip off. Not interested in recommending this place ever. It's Tuesday night. Be grateful I'm even here.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: We visited the Grand Ole Opry for the daytime tour. It was about 40 minutes long total and much of that was watching videos. It felt rushed, there was not much sense of history and it felt gimmicky. You are told you get a photo and they lead you to have it taken during the short tour, but then at the end you discover you have to pay $25 if you want it. Very underwhelming, I wish I had visited the Country music hall of fame instead.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Music was on point. Food was great! Had the shrimp n grits. Love that it had a lot of fresh okra on top. Only giving it 4 stars because the restrooms were gross.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Go here to drink, not to eat.   My Catfish dinner was OK, but ridiculously small.  Got charged a $1 up grade for a Dixie cup filled with Mac n cheese- really?  Many better places to eat in Nashville!

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text: Previous to this place I visited 10 bars on broadway  however from sitting here for an hour no one ever approached me and asked if I would like any drink or food of any kind. The karaoke seems to be a preset list and very fun with not only the crowd but the singer enjoying it  as well. Certainly wish they had servers walking around to order drinks and food.

name: Third Man Records
text: We took a road trip: Nashville, New Orleans, Clarksdale MS, and Memphis. Third Man was definitely a huge highlight of the entire trip! What a thrill to be in a cool spot owned by a musical genius and one of my top favorites, Jack White! We loved this place so much....small, cool, and interesting. What make it even better is that they carry records from little known artist which gives music lovers a chance to hear something that is not mainstream. There is a listening booth which was ultra cool to be in....the music sounded fantastic! (Lots of 48s to choose from). There are lots of well-deserved awards (Jack White's) on the walls and in cabinets. Really decorated in a way that you know love was poured into it. :)  (there is even yellow toilet paper in the black and yellow bathroom!) DEFINITELY check this place out!

name: Music City Tippler
text:
After a friend's birthday dinner, we decided to check out Tippler to top the night off with class.  It was certainly that, with well-dressed, beautiful Nashvillians talking up strangers and ordering expensive cocktails.  The drinks were reasonably priced, and they even had a few specials on a Saturday night!  $5 drafts, $8 mixed drinks, and $10 fancy cocktails, I'm a happy camper!  

It would be a great place to take someone visiting Nashville, as it's not bogged down with tourists, although it gets PACKED past 10pm.  Better to take your friends than a date, I would recommend Music City Tippler to anyone wanting a nice bar experience.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: We were in town for the night from Baltimore just looking for a low key spot to have a few beers and burgers. This feels like a locals spot and has a welcoming atmosphere. Our waitress and bartender were quick and friendly and our food was pretty good and really affordable.

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text: A little pricey, but hey, it's Nashville! Great crowd, good acoustics, and on Saturdays they use a live band for karaoke. Pretty cool! The KJ has every song known to man, and seemed like he got an even rotation. The bartender was awesome, quick with the drinks. There serve food, but we didn't eat.

name: Third Man Records
text: The place is way cool. The people are even cooler. Not sure what Jack White is paying them, but it is not enough. Very patient with the people in the store and with me. I am in Nashville for a conference and came in wearing a suit...thought I may get the cold shoulder, not at all. I gotta say I am a vault member and after my pilgrimage to third man, I will stay one for ever. Only thing...I wanted more stuff! The shop is small and I wish it were bigger.  First world problems right?

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Great environment for Bama game, but they need to do something about one of their bartenders that throws hissy-fits if you even look her direction. Yelled at me Saturday night 11/3 because I tried flagging down someone to help get the people behind me a drink. And not specifically her. Next thing I know she's standing there screaming at me. I mean she went of like a bomb, dropping F-bombs and such. Just off the handle tirade . I just held up my hands, said sorry and told the rest of my party not to engage with her. Next thing I know I've got a bunch of goon security guards tossing me out (which they clearly get off on). She clearly has a problem. Pretty sure everyone knows the one I'm talking about. Complete B. Apparently doesn't know she's in the customer service business. Cost her team $50 in tips. Hope she gets help or another job.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
Made a dinner reservation for 3 people for 8pm on a Sunday. Get there and have to pay a $3 cover charge. Understandable for people just coming in to watch and listen to the great band. Not sure why we had to pay the cover for dinner on a Sunday though. 

Get to the table and order 2 beers and a cocktail. Wait 10 minutes, order nachos, still no drinks. Another 10 minutes, order our entrees - 2 pulled pork and the catfish sandwich. Finally get the drinks, which were good.

Another 15-20 minutes goes by and we finally get our nachos which were okay. Devour those, since at this point it was 8:45. Wait 20 minutes, order another round of beers. Get the drinks, finish them, wait another 40 minutes and finally get our food at 9:40pm. The pulled pork and Cole slaw was good, the catfish sandwich was lukewarm with stale bread and standard fries - would not recommend. 

The waitress apologized profusely throughout the whole ordeal. It was definitely not her fault, she was managing a ton of tables and was taking orders, bringing food, drinks, cleaning tables... they just need to hire more staff. It should not take half an hour to get nachos and shouldn't take more than an hour for a mediocre sandwich and pulled pork. 

DO NOT COME TO EAT DINNER. The only saving grace was the live band, they were fantastic. We asked to see the manager and luckily they took off 15% from our order which was still not enough in my opinion. Would come back for music and a drink, NOT the ABYSMAL service and SUBPAR food.

name: Belcourt Taps
text:
Belcourt Taps is the perfect place if you're looking for a regular hangout place. The food is spot on with good burgers, tacos, salads, and a bunch of good appetizers. And the beers. Don't forget the beers. They have around 14 taps that are mostly dedicated to local brewers like Black Abby,  Czahns, Jackalope, and others. 

Most every night has music of some sort from the new-to-town singer to the Belmont student to the seasoned Nashville veteran every night offers something for everyone. 

Recently, they have started serving brunch on Saturdays and Sundays and like the regular menu the food on the Brunch menu is excellent. I had the Bacon, Egg, and Cheese sandwich with the potatoes and it was as good as anything I have had any place else in town. They cure the bacon in-house so the flavor is like nothing you will get anywhere else. 

All in all, if you are looking for a good hang-out that changes to from night to night Belcourt Taps is the pace to be in Hillsboro Village.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
Best place ever the food was great the drinks were really good and the music was awesome 
So glad we found it

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Attended the Opry Friday October 12th. My fifth visit over the past 10 years. I'm done with attending the Opry live and I'm through with Nashville. The town has evolved to embrace the worst elements of Las Vegas and Gatlinburg TN. Through no fault of the Opry, we got terrible seats - too close to the stage and far left of center. Two drunk, rude, obnoxious couples sat behind us and would not shut up!!!  Loud conversations disturbing everyone sitting near them continued not only through the breaks, but throughout the performances!

An employee (male) sat on a stool in the aisle nearby and said/did NOTHING! Through stares and polite requests, these huckleberries continued blabbering. We got up and left our seats midway through the performance and, after complaining to ushers about these Delberts, were led to much better seats just in time to hear Terri Clark. Somewhat saved the night for us.

If your idea of a happening time has devolved to drinking, acting like an a**hole, fighting traffic and paying outrageous prices for entertainment / lodging / food / parking etc., then Nash Vegas is for YOU!  Me, I am so over it.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Stopped by at 5:00 and left st 7:40.   Great ribs, good fries.  Lynchburg lemonades and local beer.  Yummy.  Highjivers were fun.  Great service from our waiter. Would come come back again.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: We went here based o  the things to do in Nashville recommendation. We got the tickets in advance. This is the first time my friend and I attended country music concert without much interest in it. The show was for 2 and half hours and I really enjoyed country music. But next time I would definitely want to listen to some songs before taking a leap like this. We got lucky this time.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Large selection of beers to choose from. Monday's are $3 pints so you can't go wrong with a good beer at a good price.

name: Belcourt Taps
text:
Horrible experience all around.  I've literally never written a review of any establishment or product before, but my experience at Belcourt Taps was bad enough to motivate me to bite the bullet and sign up for a Yelp account.  My girlfriend and I had a Groupon for two beer flights and an appetizer.  We visited Belcourt Taps on a Saturday night at about 8:30 and sat outside on their nearly empty patio.  When our server saw our Groupon on the table, he instantly pointed out the fine print saying we had to have a reservation, which we hadn't previously noticed.  Who makes a reservation at a bar??  He said he would check with the bartender to see if they could honor the Groupon without a reservation but told us the answer would probably be no.  Sure enough, he returned a few minutes later saying that because it was a Saturday night, the bartender was "too backed up" and didn't "have time" to make beer flights.  The bartender doesn't have time to pour beer??  Seriously??  We tried explaining to the server that we weren't in any hurry, but to no avail.  We left feeling pretty certain that if we had ordered beer flights without a Groupon the bartender would have had plenty of time to pour beer.

We returned a few days later with a reservation.  When we walked in, we were told to sit anywhere and that we didn't need a reservation unless we were using a Groupon.  Okay...

We sat at a hightop table and were greeted by our server a few minutes later; she let us know they were out of two of the beers on the beer flight menu.  We ordered our two beer flights and the fried green tomatoes appetizer; our server returned about 15 minutes later to say that they were out of fried green tomatoes.  We ordered the queso appetizer, which turned out to be disgusting.  We had originally planned to use our Groupon for the beer flights and appetizer and then also order dinner and additional drinks but were so disgusted with the place and their horrific service by the time we finished the beer flights and queso that we just wanted to get what we had already paid for and leave.  When our server brought our check, we were unpleasantly surprised to see that Belcourt Taps had applied an automatic gratuity to the tune of about 30% without our consent to our table of two.  When I questioned it, the server explained that this was because, you guessed it, we were using a Groupon.  We definitely would have tipped even though our experience left a LOT to be desired, but 30% without our consent just because we were using a Groupon??  Come on, people.

My girlfriend and I both got the distinct impression that Belcourt Taps is quite resentful of Groupon patrons and very into petty rules and nickeling and diming customers to death.  Ironic, considering that most businesses offer Groupons to increase publicity and build their client base.  Epic fail, Belcourt Taps- we will never return and strongly discourage others from making the mistake of visiting your establishment.  I predict a FOR RENT sign on Belcourt Avenue in the near future.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Decent food, good beer....horrible service!!!! The staff literally won't make eye contact so they don't have to stop if you have a question or need something.  Very disappointing.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: 5 stars for he service! The hostess Adaora was a GEM! She was so kind and made sure I had a great experience! Will definitely be back

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Wonderful show! We loved everything about our trip to the Opry. The atmosphere is great and the music is the best. We definitely want to come back again soon. The only problem was the gift shop line after the show. Was way too long. I would definitely suggest going to gift shop before the show.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
Touristy check; loud as all get out check; 
That being said, we had good service, very good music, and pretty good food. Try the chicken fried chicken...tasty comfort food.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
Much quieter than down on Broadway!  Great food.  Recommend the pretzels!  Awesome dips go with it.  Beer list overwhelmingly large, so something for everyone 
I went twice while staying in Nashville- worth it!

name: Belcourt Taps
text: My kids and I walk here sometimes for their burgers since it's in the neighborhood. This, along with Brown's (and maybe the Dog) are the best burgers in Hillsboro Village in my humble opinion. I would walk or bike another mile to eat The Hangover, Juicy Lucy, or Hell's Kitchen. It's a tight place and one with tight beer. You can bring your dog and hangout on the outside patio. Only reason I minus a star is supported smoking on one part of the patio. Enjoy a beautiful day here on Belcourt and hop over to the theater and Dragon Park.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: Great place that is just a short walk from the heart of Nashville, but far enough where it isn't too crowded. Awesome service and reasonable prices, would highly recommend. The hot chicken sandwich was delicious!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: This is a must see if you're visiting Nashville. Loved, loved, loved the tour! Our tour guide was wonderful.  He was very knowledgable and gave us time to look at everything. We enjoyed all the history and fun facts about it. Only thing was that the woman who sold us our tickets was VERY RUDE & misunderstood our question about the tour start time-that was surprising but we knew that didn't represent the entire staff. We actually went to the gift shop too & I bought several items! I defintely will return to the Grand Ole Opry House next time I'm in Nashville.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Had an amazing time at the BB King Blues Club.  Great food and entertainment.  You can't go wrong stopping here for a good time.

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Came in on a Thursday night to a rather empty bar. Could not get a drink because the bartenders were too busy chatting to each other rather than wait on customers. To top it off, when I finally get their attention after 15 minutes of being there, that I need a beer she replies "not to get fucking attitude with her, since I didn't know if the guys who had been there for 2 hours had a tab or not, and to give her the money or she'll take the fucking beer back" She then proceeded to walk over to the other workers and discuss what a rude bitch I was loudly in front of her other customers.  I have never been treated so rudely by a bartender. This was my first time to Nashville and I will never return and spend money here.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
I recently returned to America after nearly 20 years overseas and decided to move to San Diego. Since everything I have can fit in a small car with room to spare I decided to drive across country and see America again. 
Why mention all that? Well, I picked Nashville for two reasons. I always wanted to go and have never been and I wanted to go to B.B King's Blues Club for my own lone commemoration of his passing.
The staff was quite friendly. I called ahead and asked about live music and the hostess answered every question I had.
I loved the music, the atmosphere, and my service was very patient even though he was so busy. I loved my appetizer, but the entree really messed with my stomach for some reason. 
I can't say it was because of something bad on the restaurants side. I ate a few spoonfuls and my stomach went all kinds of goofy. 

I would still recommend the place. I knew nothing about Nashville and still don't, but if you are ever around Nashville go checkout B.B King's Blues Club.

name: Third Man Records
text: Our first time here and it was enjoyable.  It's a small store but has the perfect amount of vinyl and artifacts to look at.  We used a machine that made a mold of an electric guitar.   We got a few shirts but I didn't find anything I really needed or wanted to buy as far as vinyl records.  We did walk back to the venue side to see the back area but it was closed.  The restrooms are cool looking for the yellow and black decor.  If you are in Nashville this is well worth the stop.  So many big artist have recorded there and it's easy to get to.  They have street parking and a small lot to park at.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: If you enjoy blues and don't stop here!!! Some of the most talented musicians in Nashville.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: As with all Flying Saucers this has a superior selection of beer and ales. Of the three I've been to (Memphis, Houston, Nashville) this is my favorite of the three.  It does not have the crowd atmosphere as Memphis, but it is the most aesthetically pleasing of the three. The location is behing the hotel that occupies the old train station so it's a little off the main Broadway nightlife area, but that may be a plus for you if you don't prefer the tourist crowds. This is a 4.5 star place, losing the .5 due to the easily missed location off Broadway.  I will go here everytime Im in Nashville.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: There is nothing much to add to the Grand Ole Opry House experience that hadn't already been said.  The tour was excellent, the history superb, and the performers on point.

name: Anthem
text:
My wife, her friends, and I rented a table here to see Grandmaster Flash, who was admittedly awesome. The venue is gorgeous. Thats where the compliments end. Our table had a $200 minimum, which is fine by me. However, they don't seem to enforce the reserved nature of the tables, and when we came back from the VIP balcony, there were other people sitting at our table with their drinks atop it. When we finally got rid of them (incredible rude people by the way), I asked for a reserved placard. 25 minutes later the waitress shows up with a tiny sign too small to even be noticed. I found the sign on the floor with other peoples drinks in its place. The service was too horrible to believe. The waitress only came about every 45 minutes. After a drink order you'd wait about half an hour to receive that drink. It took 15 minutes for the waitress to come back to say they were out of something. They were out of most of the things I wanted to order; specialty appetizers, specialty drinks, even entrees, each time requiring another 15 minutes for the waitress to inform us that they were out of them. The VIP bathroom was filthy. When we finally ordered an entree, they completely forgot about us for over an hour. We had all run out of drinks, and no help came to us. The VIP bar that we paid extra for wouldn't charge drinks to the table, another completely pointless addition to our night. Other tables also seemed to be having this problem. How can you spend $200 when you can't get a waitress around to order anything?

Well, thats easy. You can order a $180 liter of jack daniels, or a $200 bottle of sparkling water. 

The bass was so frighteningly powerful that it vibrated the table, and even vibrated a drink right off of it and onto the floor where it broke. It took over 15 minutes for them to come over to clean up the glass fragments that littered the ground below us. I spoke to the lady up front and she apologized for the lack of service. The waitress brought us a few free shots, and took some items off of our tab. I was happy, for a moment. Then it still took over an HOUR from the time I wanted my check to the time my card was brought back. They include a hefty gratuity. Still, with the items taken off the check, the bill wasn't too bad.

Except that they DOUBLE CHARGED my card! Maybe my review might go higher if they fixed that. EDIT: they did fix this. 1 star added.

Conclusion: One of the prettier bars I've been to, but if its got horrible service, its a horrible bar. Their attempts to fix the night were more than outweighed by the continued ineptitude we experienced.

Not recommended.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Amazing atmosphere wonderful time! We saw Ricky Skaggs, the Gatlin Brothers, Swon Brothers, a few others, great show. Very pricy drinks but expected for such a attraction as this. Great seats

name: Music City Tippler
text:
A Big City (original Tippler is in Manhattan) transplant hits Nashville.  Nice, upscale place with good Scotch and Draft beer.   Upmarket Nashville crowd.   For sure the nicest lounge I have been to here.      

The bathroom has a special foot pedal door opener.   That is an original touch and worth noting.     

Well worth keeping this place in mind.  Next time I would like to chill out at one of the outside patio tables.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: This is an amazing place.  It is breathtaking really.  The only reason I didn't give 5 stars is because the staff was not very friendly.

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text: Planned to belt out "Don't Stop Believing" at WannaB's but quickly noticed that only serious singers were allowed on stage (with the exception of two guys singing a Maria Carey duet). We tried getting drinks from the bar but the service was non existent despite the bar not being busy.  Didn't stick around long with no drinks and no sings.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Ok, so I've never really been into Country Music before going to Nashville, but I can see why so many people like it!!! It's really fun, most of the time.

But apparently the Grand Ole Opry is the place to go if you are into country music.  We have no idea why the bachelor wanted to go, but we did it anyway for him.  Honestly, I didn't know what to do expect and I was tired and hungover from the night before and we just had Mission BBQ right across the damn street so I wanted to take a nap.

It's not too long of a tour but we did take it backstage which was really cool and they said they filmed some show that everyone knew about howdy do dee? No idea what it was, I was more of a Sesame Street, Transformers, He-Man kid.  But I think it was pretty boring most of it, until you get to stand on the stage, then you realize why people loved it. It was really good, our hostess was SUPER nice and so enthusiastic, so I gotta give her a shout out.

I gave it a 5 because for what it was and what it is, its pretty amazing and to see the history and the tragic events that it went through (flooding) and to see it still standing and going strong is pretty amazing.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
I went to Flying Saucer to meet some friends the night before Thanksgiving.  Apparently they do a special glass every year - Turkey of the Year?  I didn't know this but my friends were excited about it.  Since it was featuring Anthony Weiner this year, I ended up having to get a couple for myself.  hahaha fun

So this is a nice bar, typical of other Flying Saucers with tables, tall bar tables, couches, games, etc.  They serve beer of all sorts.  I am not a very big beer fan, but I do have some "fancy" beers I can drink.  So I stuck to them.  I think maybe they have liquor somewhere "if you really want it" but I am not 100% on that.  Maybe it is just wine.  The food I had was really just snacks like pretzels and cheese plate.  Bartender and wait staff were really nice and helpful, especially with securing us those glasses!

Overall this is a good place and if you dig beer then you will love it.  As for me, I'll probably stick to other places that are more used to pouring cocktails!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Came here with a whole bridal party the night before their wedding. We were seated in the balcony and had a pretty good time listening to the bands and musicians which included Billy Ray Cyrus who is the only performer I knew since I'm don't typically listen to country music. Their drink prices were pretty high though we still got one since it was a celebration. Line for bathroom wasnt too bad since it moved pretty quickly.

name: Third Man Records
text: I'm not giving five stars because it's owned by Jack White. I think this is a unique one of a kind record store.  It's a record store which only sells artists who are signed by Third Man Records. It's difficult to find parking. For music fans, this is definitely worth a stop. It is a small place and it's divided into three rooms. One room is for CD's, books and stickers. Another room is for t-shirts and records. Then another room is posters, juxebox, and an old photo booth which unfortunately was out of order along with an old booth where you can press your own records. The employees were nice and helpful. I ended up buying a Loretta Lynn CD where she duets with Jack White and a t-shirt for my friend who is a big Jack White fan.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Small venue. Only bad seats would be all the way at top, otherwise there is a great view all around. Pew seating with plenty of room. 6 performers are on stage for about 15 mins each. You can feel the history all around and it is a must see for any country music fan. Drinks and snacks available inside. I love concerts, but this was not a concert (no one stands up or dances, no drunk people crawling around)-this is a show where you sit and enjoy the performances and are just present in the moment. Had a great time. First show ran late so we had to wait outside in the rain for everyone at that show to leave before they would let us in. We walked over from the mall, so I'm not sure of their parking situation. It was hard to plan our visit in advance because the performances are not set up with much advance notice. I plan to go back again next time we are in Nashville.

name: Music City Tippler
text:
Thanks to the yelp event and the generous people at the Tippler, I had a gift card to spend.  Lo and behold, my friend arranged a happy hour there for another friend's birthday.  Opportunity to spend and check the place out?  I am in!

So I got there at around 5 pm and it was pretty dead except for our group.  The main bar area has a lot of tables to choose from, so if you get there at happy hour you are likely to have your pick.

Once I was seated it was time to pick my drink.  I already knew they had moscow mules so I chose a Tito's vodka version.  Our waiter was a doll - totally chatty, he knew his booze, and we talked quite a bit about the house made ginger beer and my favorite store bought ginger beer to make them with at home.  (It is Goya by the way...if anyone knows where I can get the Goya ginger beer around here you should holla at me since I've been ordering it on Amazon...)  I tried another drink after that with cucumber and gin and other things.  Both drinks were great.  

We also tried a sampling of food.  The hummus was deemed "spicy" by some at our table which just shows you how people's tolerable spice levels differ because I thought it was just "flavorful".  The crab cakes were nice for an appetizer.  My favorite things were the mac and cheese (um, VELVEETA, BACON, and peas - that's all A-OK with me!) and the chicken biscuit.  A few at our table didn't like the chicken biscuit because of the tomato jam, but I am always a fan of sweet plus savory so I dug it.  We also had Tippler chips which were just homemade chips perfect for munching while drinking and talking.

Overall I found the experience to be a great one.  It is a nice place, somewhat swanky in decor and ambiance.  Not my normal dirty dive that I love, but a great change of pace.  Plus I got to treat the birthday girl with part of my gift card so it must have brought out the nice girl in me.  And that so rarely happens....  Tip of the hat to you Tippler!

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: All these beers and NOT ICE COLD?!!!! WHY? What a shame!!  Not impressed!!

name: Third Man Records
text: Jack White's record label. @thirdmanrecords So wonderful!

name: Rippy's Bar & Grill
text: No A/C on a hot humid day, had to walk up to the bar to order food from a "couldn't be bothered" lady bartender. Music- acoustic rock songs not country songs, Pulled chicken BBQ sandwich was really good though. So, you decide, depending on what's important to you.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: Yes, had an absolute ball. Friday night - first act was very good, place was half full and comfortable. We sat up top and watched the action below. Second act was fabulous, and the crowds grew but not to the point of being crazy. So happy to be able to hear that level of talent in a relaxed and fun environment. Why run around the street when you can settle in, have a few drinks, and get to know the place while the music gets better and better?

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: What could be bad?? Its all good!! Especially when you make it on the jumbo tron!!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Loved this place, must try the tranquil waters drink and nachos if you're there.  The entertainment was great and a fun time was had by all.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: My friend wanted a plate of volcano nachos very badly.  Met up with him here.  Live music was very nice as was the food.   Big detractor was the speed of service.  It was a Saturday and it was busy but we were there for over 2 hours. Waited at least an hour for our check after we finished meal. Had to flag the wait staff down to pay our checks so we could leave.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: Thank  you Bridgestone Arena and Nashville Predators for the most wonderful weekend I've had in my many years.  Although I did not participate in the hockey experience because we were in Nashville to celebrate my twin daughters birthdays (yikes they were 50) and chose your city in which to celebrate we were overwhelmed and surprised by the fantastic event put on there for the NHL All Star Event.  From the music to the marshmallows the event was well organized and families all around seemed to be having a wonderful time.Whoever was responsible for the venue should be commended.  My only disappointment was that I only saw 2 Sabres fans that entire weekend (but of course I was not inside). Go Predators and as one gentleman told me Go Sabres - he explained to me they are a young and upcoming team and will soon be a force to reckon with.  Dare I hope?

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Drinks were good. Appetizers were tasty, especially the Lava Lava shrimp. Services wasn't that great.

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: Large modern facility. Games are great, parking and traffic can be a pain, as expected in Nashville

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Enjoying Broadway like the rest of Nashville, my best friend and I didn't really want to go to a chain-type establishment.  But we noticed two seats at the Margaritaville bar available and the entertainment for the evening sounded better than most.  So we were going to grab a drink and leave.  The bartenders were so awesome though.  We stayed there all night!  I highly recommend going there and sitting at the bar...let them pick a couple of shots for you.  These were our favorites!!!

name: National Underground
text: Got recommended to us by a local. Great location but didn't put much effort into making it a memorable experience for it's guests. The burger was...good, the beer was...good, the service was...just ok. Didn't hate it, didn't love it. If I was walking by, I might stop in for a quick bite but with all the great choices in downtown Nashville...I'll probably look elsewhere next time we are in town.

name: National Underground
text: Um. The doorman lets me in. I head to the restroom. He grabs me and stops me 1 step from the door to tell me I have to buy things. I don't know if he wanted a credit check, but there's literally 20 Bars I could've stopped in. Meanwhile probably 10 people underage snuck in. This inspired me to drink one beer, average busy bar service nothing more, no personality. And leave. Disappointed.... Was getting my $7 one time ever more important than no extra flushes?

name: National Underground
text: Zero stars. You get kicked out by the owner for dancing. If you're I the pedal tavern or sprocket AVOID!!!! No fun, lame entertainment, and the OWNER SUCKS!!!!!! We took 12 people in there during our sprocket rocket bar stop and the OWNER told us to stop dancing because the old people were getting upset. Acme is next door, go there.

name: National Underground
text: Should've read the reviews!! Everything others say is true. From the mediocre food to the rude service. Seriously....$2 water and up charge for fries when it's already almost $12. BTW-Not "The Best Burger" despite what they write on their chalk board. And while we were there, we watched "management" physically confront and block the way for people that wanted to use the bathroom...even questioning PAYING CUSTOMERS!! What a HORRIBLE place. There a TON of other options downtown...even on either side (Acme/Rock Bottom) and across the street (Hard Rock) of this atrocity...go with those restaurants or ANY other nearby for a better experience.

name: Ole Red
text: Food was way too expensive. Wait staff was rude and Didn't know the menu. Cool vibe, but missed opportunity.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
We were here on a tour.  They knew we were coming, they only offered us three choices on the menu, and, yet, it took them over an hour to get food on the table.  Granted, the food was pretty good, but the service was pathetically slow.  i would cut them more slack if we had just wandered in, and were ordering off the regular menu, but that was not the case.  They really dropped the ball on this one. 

The only reason they got three stars was because the veggie burger we ordered was pretty darn good.  Both the roll, and the patty itself had good flavor and texture, and you don't always find that in a veggie burger.  The fries were tasty, too.  

I like the food, but they could have done a whole lot better job with the service.

name: 12th & Porter
text:
After reading many reviews on this spot the fellaz and I decided to check it out!

Pro's: Location is very easy to find and literally located on 12th & Porter. Parking is free, located adjacent in a gravel parking lot, or you can park on the sides like a lot of people did. Not a very big lot so i recommend if you have a show to see at 8pm etc. i suggest being there at least an 30 to 45mins early to secure a spot. Upon walking in to 12th & Porter you see a bar like setup where people are ordering food & drink. To the right you will see table and chair setups. To your left there is a check in boot where a guy/girl takes your ticket for whatever event you came to see or if you. Immediately to their right is the entrance door to the club/dance floor/ where the stage is where the band will perform. On this particular night DJ Joseph(i think was his name) was on stage RIPPING IT! I've seen a lot of DJ in my time but this by far was the coldest white DJ i have ever seen!! Dude mixed up every great hit song old and new and you could tell EVERYONE in there couldn't help but to fight the urge to dance! BOI WAS BADD!!! Ok now back to setup....

Now upon walking in to the staging area to your right is a bar where bud light cost 5$...not bad. There is an upstairs sitting area that has stools and one table but i warn you ITS SMALL AND HOLDS ABOUT MAYBE 10 PEOPLE MAX! Not everyone up there gets to sit down on a stool cause there's only about 5 of them if that...recommend if you want to sit GET THERE PLENTY EARLY!!  Below is the standing room only...I repeat STANDING ROOM ONLY!!  so if the artist you are there to see are normally late for shows be prepared to stand for a while and get yourself a drink to by the time AND I RECOMMEND wearing some shoes with cushion for long periods of standing....I made the mistake of wearing some nice dress boots but by the end of the night my feet were DONE SON! Could barely walk back to my car!

The stage for the performers was a nice size and the sound as well as the lighting effects where top notch! Its defiantly a place where real musicians should perform at in my opinion. Bathrooms are small but very clean at least the guys were, and the crowd was a mixture of all races just enjoying the music.

Con's: It was very hot in there!!! I was lucky to find a spot close to the wall where air would eventually hit me from time to time but for the most part i was sweating as was everyone else in there. Like i said the best thing to do is get a drink and sip on that badd boy to keep cool because once it gets packed getting back to the bar is a adventure!  That is my only complaint...:(

Will defiantly return! :)

name: Nashville Symphony
text: As a pop series season ticket holder I had been to see the Nashville Symphony more times then I can count, but almost every concert exceeded my expectations.  The talent of these individuals and their abilities are tremendous and always a pleasure to watch and, of course, hear. The new building is so beautiful, I always enjoy that aspect of the experience. In my opinion there is little to be desired, from the doors to the floors you can tell everything has been pondered over. I look forward to more nights spent with a glass of wine in the company of such fine talent.

name: Ole Red
text: Been here two times so far.  The atmosphere​​ is fun, of course,​ it is always​ great to hear live music.  You can make reservations online, which I recommend​.  One of our visits was around 4 and it was already hopping. Both times that we have been here the service was very slow.  Not really a big deal when you are enjoying the music, you don't feel rushed, but our drinks were often empty.  The fried pickles were amazing, a very​ large portion, plenty to share with a group.  We ordered the bucket of chicken to share.  A whole​ bird came with two biscuits and a very small container of dried up gravy.  It was just OK. We will probably go back with out of town guests b/c of the novelty of being Blake's place.  I was really hoping this could be a go-to spot for us, but we will probably pick a different spot next time

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: What an amazing Father's Day experience I had at this place. First off it was my 2 children 7/9 my wife and myself, the environment was totally kid friendly and even had board games for them to play. So we get there and Zach the manager (which we didn't know at the time he was the manager) takes care of us personally, we order a cheese plate and a flight of beers, he and his coworker did a great job describing the characteristics of all the beers to us. Time to order food, the kids menu is rather small so Zach personally made my youngest chicken tenders. All in all the bill was nothing compared to the service and food we got, and they give a military discount!!! We will be bringing many people here soon!!! I highly recommend and it's close to the farmers market so so that's where we usually come from.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Kim and Brittany were great!  They got us a table for our friends!!  They really went out if their way!!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: This is the best for Bach parties!! Our server Shane was absolutely wonderful!! He got out drunk super fast, he was very attentive. There was a lot of people and we were still super pleased with our experience! Next time we come back we will be asking for Shane specifically!! Thank you!!

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: I am so glad they added a kitchen. We have several tap rooms in the area that don't serve food, or if they do, it's pretty limited. I had the fries with a hot chicken sandwich (be sure to tell them if you want it local hot). Both were great. They also have a mean burger, and I hear the frog legs are good. And all of the recipes include their beer in the recipes. The beers are always a nice selection of session styles, and with the new laws, maybe a few high gravity offerings. If you want to eat AND get well made local beer, this is a must try. There are a few other breweries nearby if you want to do a mini crawl, but check the hours.

name: Nashville Symphony
text:
We flew up from TX to see Styx play with the Nashville Symphony in concert. The weather dropped below freezing this morning and there was light freezing rain and snow most of the day. Travel conditions were lightly impacted. We learned about 2 hours before the show that the Symphony canceled their performance but Styx is still doing their part of show. The venue did offer to exchange our $150 per person tickets for another event between now and July. This is not too attractive to us because of the airfare and hotel costs.

Styx was awesome. They dropped Madam Blue from their regular set which we believe they would have done had the Symphony been there.

We are disappointed and feel like the Symphony are being fair weather friends in this event. Two stars for that.

name: Marathon Music Works
text:
I've been to two events at MMW in the past few months and I think it's a great venue.  Great acoustics and great layout for whatever your needs are (stage, multiple bars, multiple bathrooms, outdoor area in the back).  Plenty of parking nearby.  I don't love the outdoor area - I always feel like it could be so much better, but then I remember that they frequently have food trucks and the like out there, so they can't really do much with it.  (and people smoke outside, I wish they didn't, but for you, maybe that's a good thing).  Also, if you're trying to be outside, that freight train can get pretty loud (but you can't even hear it from inside).  Bathrooms are much nicer than one would expect at a venue like this.

Haven't been to a regular concert here, but when I do, I'm sure I'll update!

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text: The band last night was great. I think they have a great band all the time. Come on in and grab a seat. Lots of good drinks and music

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: We came in on a Saturday night and even though it was ridiculously crowded, the section we sat in wasn't very loud.  Mary was our server and she was very attentive and made some great recommendations.  The prices are pretty reasonable and the serving sizes were pretty large, I took half of my hamburger home!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Amazing margaritas, food, live performances, and service. Definitely a must if in Nashville.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: By far the best burger I have ever had. Five beer burger add the bacon of course! The seasoned fries paired with the basil ryeman ketchup is the pair. Not to mention the view and the beers. This place is a must!

name: National Underground
text: Awful. There's a waiter pretending to be the manager .  Needs to be more specific about what is and is not on the menu.

name: Ole Red
text: Ole Red was on our bucket list for Nashville and did not disappoint.  Got there when it opened and found wonderful entertainment with Steel Magnolias. Topped it off with poutine, something I'd never had before and found delicious - and a great cocktail.  People were super friendly and service excellent! Hope I can return tomorrow!

name: Ole Red
text: Great new place. Very attentive wait staff. Huge portions. Great smoked pork. Lots of room with an open airy feel.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: We went there before a concert. The atmosphere was wonderful. Great music, great decorating, and excellent music. The food was good as well. However, we ordered cheese curds, and a burger with a salad instead of fries. We got our curds quickly. However, the burger took over 30 mins to come out and they gave us fries instead of our salad. Had such high hopes. Just fell a bit short.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: It's basically what you would expect. Expensive and gimmicky. The band area was too crowded to see anything and the drinks were weak and not worth the cost. You can go for the picture and to say you had a margarita at margaritaville but I don't recommend hanging around.

name: Marathon Music Works
text:
I've been to most if not yet all live music venues in Nashville and though some have perks that surpass Marathon and are better suited for specific needs, Marathon may be my overall favorite venue all things considered in the Nashville area. It's basically an old converted warehouse so it's just a huge open floor area but for a rock show it's the best option as long as you stake out the spot you want to be in. However, I have found depending on the show and the audience you often can leave for drinks or a bathroom run and still navigate your way back to your approximate spot. I will say that if it's a sold out show particularly if its an energetic band it can get tight, full and sweaty!
Drink prices are fair. There's very little actual food or drink (other than coffee) within walking distance of this place though so it's not the best venue to eat or pregame prior to a show and though it probably isn't directly associated with the venue there is a huge parking area directly across the street that is directed in and out for only $5 which makes this the easiest venue to catch a show at in the area regardless of what night of the week it is. 
So, 3rd & Lindsey is better for a smaller audience if you want a meal and a relaxed experience, Exit/In and the End may get a little messier and active and the Ryman might be secular church but for just convenience and steady quality of acts Marathon gets the slight edge.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text: Nice relaxing place. Clean crisp tasting beer. Good variety. IPAs are really good. Truly a great beer joint.

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
Current (and standing for a year or so) favorite brewery in Nashville. The beers are all next level. All of the flavors are pronounced and they're mostly full bodied. I'm especially enjoying the barrel aged selection lately. 

I've enjoyed a few nibbles from the menu-- frog legs, cheese board, and the bacon wrapped dates. All great! I recommend the dates, but know that it comes with 5, which is an odd choice seeing as most people are going to split them. Even numbers people!

The staff has always been super friendly and helpful in a very genuine way. Lately I've noticed a lot of new faces that perhaps don't have the service experience as the seasoned vets. Hopefully they won't be green for long though.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Excellent Food! Best burger I've had in a long time. Live music was awesome. A duo named Brittany and Matt played, they were awesome. Staff was very friendly and attentive. Good value for the money.

name: Ole Red
text:
Ol Red - Oofdah (MN gal here) where do I start!?.  It's a clean classy place we went on a Tuesday!   

Entertainment- gorgeous (see pix - this this why there were like 8 bachelorette parties within three block radius?)

Food- fattening and full of delicious gluten (see cornbread and pickles)

Drinks- overpriced ($11 for Jack and a mixer !?) 

Overall: I'd come back, just not to drink on a night out.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Loud as fuck. If you're into loud live music and a bunch of drunks singing, this is the place to go. The food was excellent and the staff were really good.

name: Ole Red
text: We just ordered appetizers while we enjoyed some great music by Skyler Anderson. He was the highlight of our visit. What a great entertainer and humble guy. We stayed and watched his entire performance. As for the food, the cornbread was amazing!  I would definitely order this again.  We also ordered the fried pickles & green tomatoes which were fine. For our taste, probably wouldn't order again. The tomatoes were small chunks. I expected big round tomatoes slices. We also had the House Made Tots. These were ok. Little over cooked. The waitress was an absolute sweetheart. We would definitely return here to try a meal and enjoy the music.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Tammy Cook was our served made our night, and Jambalaya was awesome. party of 6 and she made sure our drinks were always full. Thanks Tammy

name: Bridgestone Arena
text: Venue for major Nashville events and of course the best live sports to watch, hockey.  Right on Broadway, so tons of things to do before and after the games.

name: Ole Red
text: My parents came to visit and we decided to go to Nashville after looking around for a family friendly restaurant we went into ole red. The service wasn't the best but we all got hamburgers and fries. All 7 of us enjoyed our meals and the entertainment. Awesome atmosphere, we will definitely go again.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text: Food was great and the atmosphere was wonderful! My only complaint is that they need a larger ladies restroom! Only 2 stalls in a popular bar/restaurant is NOT enough for women!

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
HORRIBLE SERVICE- RUDE - we were here for 
July 4 weekend and this was BY FAR the worst bar in the NashVegas row! Don't go here- service sux(we actually walked out before even ordering).

name: Tennessee Brew Works
text:
Great brewery in downtown Nashville!

2 stories, with both levels serving delicious beers.  They have ales, IPAs, porters, stouts, & more.  I love how this brewery serves food!  & not just snacks, but actual food like burgers, sandwiches, & salads.

Friendly brewtenders, servers.  They have lots of board games & television.  & as we were leaving, there was a live band about to perform.

Hummus:  This could have easily been split amongst a group of 5 & our group of 3 barely made a dent.  Served with fat pieces of buttery toast.
Fries:  Just a side of fries was plenty to serve us 3!  Flavorful & thin, & their house made sauce was delicious.

name: Winners Bar and Grill Nashville
text: Quick service for drinks. Not so great on karaoke night if you want to sing and don't know the dj. Given it two tries. Will not try again.

name: Margaritaville - Nashville
text:
I took my partner and his two children to Margaritaville tonight and waited an hour after putting our order in only for our waitress to come up to the table and tell us that that they had a computer malfunction and the kitchen was a mess. I asked if she had any kind of timeframe for our food to be ready and she didn't. At this point I would have expected a free appetizer or something but nada. She comped our drinks which was nice and I totally understand things like this happen but after an hour and a half with no food I wold have expected a gift certificate or something similar to make up for that pretty egregious experience.

Response to manager. I emailed you on 8/4 and have yet to hear back so my review stands.

name: Layla's Honky Tonk
text:
