Read the reviews and was equally surprised as the others (although I guess I shouldn't have been) that they were out of so many menu choices for Saturday brunch - like "sorry, we're out of ham" or the real kicker "we're out of our signature jam (for the biscuits)". At least the performers showed up. . .

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
Tip: There is nowhere to store luggage, but you are allowed to carry your suitcase around the museum. 

A small museum dedicated to Johnny Cash, with some mentioning of other country music artists. Walking through the museum, you will learn about Johnny Cash's life, listen to his music, and even watch a clip of his movie. We spent about 1.5 hours, enjoying the air-conditioning inside.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
HOPE THIS REVIEW GETS TO MANAGEMENT AND THEY CHANGE THEIR POLICY BEFORE A LAW SUIT SHUTS THEM DOWN!!! 
Wednesday approximately 12:00am 

My first time in this bar and wasn't impressed with security. As a former bar security I have respect for them & understand their job is hard when dealing with over served patrons but they have guidelines and more responsibilities than most people working in the bar. 
     I observed a patron sleeping (passed out) at the table I was standing at for about 20 minutes. He was next to a guy and thought they were together, after the other patron got up and left I approached the security officer (in the corner texting on his phone, he was approximately 5'6" with black hair and black beard) and asked him how they dealt with patrons passed out in the bar.  
     I told him where he was and he went up to him and tried to wake him up, he then took his flash light to get the attention of the security agent at the door. They woke the patron up and escorted him out the door. The security agent walked back over to take the patrons beer off the table. The guest sitting behind me asked him what they did with the patron. His comment back to the guest was "I don't know, we kicked him out". 


Unprofessional in every way. They should have got management involved to get him in a cab and safely home or to hotel.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: Absolutely the worst service and food, and even worse management staff.  Water seemed to be rationed as well...

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: This 3 star review is only because of how nice the place was designed and the fact that our waitress frequently checked on us. Our food came out  way after we ordered all I got was some fries and they didn't taste good. A few people next to us stood at a table waiting for it to be cleaned for at least 15 minutes and ended up doing it on their own. It's pretty disappointing for a music row bar owned by such a huge star.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Great time!  The place was packed but we were lucky & got a table in the back.  We were still able to watch the entertainment on the stage because the were on a high stage.  The energy in this place was magical!  The band & singers were excellent.  Our food was very good & the waitresses did an outstanding job!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: It was very busy.  Sat on third floor.  Kinda disorganized was surprised waiters and waitresses did not have assigned area.  Tried ordering food and asking for no cheese due to dairy allergy.  That is not possible.  Everything is pre done.  Probably will go back only for the music and beer not the food

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Insanely loud, grossly overpriced and just not any fun. Even concerts aren't this loud couldn't talk to anyone beyond 2 inches. Not doing it again. $11 for a shitty Jack & Diet. Actually, I just dropped this place to a 1 star since I'll never go back. Sorry Bob. Your bar tends should be trained to make a decent drink.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: So disappointed in Kid Rock's, one of my favorite places to listen to music now charges $2 for a cup of ice water. Really? Normally I would have given this place 5 stars. I cannot believe the boss is good with this. A guy who prides himself on making his concerts and drinks affordable. Please reconsider this one folks. If nothing else it promotes responsible drinking. With so many choices in Nashville I think we will be looking for a new place until this policy changes.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
I knew that I'd have to visit after getting a recommendation for this place the same morning. I was visiting Nashville for the first time just last Thursday and was told about the writers round concept, and I highly appreciate singer-songwriters.

I didn't know about reservations, but it wasn't an issue since there was a lot of seating. I paid a $7 cover charge to listen to the four acts. Each performer offers a backstory then plays the song, and it's really neat to hear that some of their songs made it big. I'd definitely come back for the talent that you can find here.

They also had a $7 minimum purchase policy, so I ordered a coffee and turnover with ice cream. Yum!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: It was great. Excellent atmosphere and lots of fun. The music was awesome. We didn't get a chance to eat but enjoyed everything else about the place.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Floors upon floors of fun! You can enjoy a different experience on every single level. Drinks ain't cheap and you are paying for the experience, but there is something for everyone. Including a rooftop bar with beautiful views. The best music is on the first level in my opinion, but make sure to make your way up the stairs to check out everything. A must stop in Nashville!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: This place is awesome.  I can't say enough.  Good food and reasonable drinks for Broadway St in Nashville.  The 2 story stage plus 3 other floors of live music is awesome.  This will be my go to place every time  I go to Nashville.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: They say he's cocky, but he says What? It ain't bragging when you back it up! And he brought everything here to back it up, probably the nicest place on Broadway right now. Huge building with 4 floors of goodness and different music from country to the 80's to classic rock. And the man himself might do a surprise show up and do some songs (some friends were lucky enough to see him!). Got some beers and a half fried chicken, the food was surprisingly good, I say that because bar food is usually for tipsy people so they can drink more, but this one was good-good! Try all the levels and different music styles, also the view is great from above, have fun!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
The RUDEST bartenders and staff I've ever encountered in my life. Yelling at guests trying to spend money in your establishment. Lost other guests credit cards behind the bar and said "oh well" and didn't offer apologizes when they found it. Had security remove a girl for throwing trash in a trash can. I mean this place was a joke!

I tried to buy a T-shirt and the bartenders said "no" and gave me the finger. Well then.... 

The live band that night was great, but that was the only great thing about it.

My advice to others, just avoid the place and save yourself the trouble. Plenty of live music to choose from with more attentive/friendly bartenders

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: I've been to Whiskey row a few times on a Friday or Saturday night and i always have a blast but i stopped in yesterday for lunch when i was on my way to work and i must say i was pleasantly surprised with the daytime atmosphere. The live acoustic band that was playing was awesome and the staff was so nice and welcoming. When i first looked over the food menu i was a little disheartened because i am a pescatarian and there aren't many option for non-meat-eaters but i will say that there are a lot of dishes you can modify. For an app, i had the shrimp fritters and OMG I'm obsessed, they are sooooo good and the portion size is perfect. Then, for my entree i had some fettuccine pasta dish, that originally had an assortment of meats in it but i modified it to only have shrimp, and it was really good. The sauce was creamy and seems homemade and the dish was very flavorful. I'm definitely going back there to get some food again in the near future.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Bartender was wonderful!! Food was ok, music was AMAZING!! DZZI  hope to be back!! Much love from Scranton, PA!!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Really disappointed in the hospitality. Been ordering drinks all night and asked for a water and was charged $2!! Trying to be responsible and was penalized for it. Upsetting a business would want to profit from something that is normally free especially to someone who has been paying for drinks all night. Won't be back.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: This was our favorite bar in Nashville! Every band that performed was top notched and involved the crowd. The performers were exceptional especially Officially Nothern! The bartenders were extremely polite and not a typical busy bar service of ordering and running but actually talking to you! Love this place !!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Dierks, I love your music and we were so excited to come to your bar tonight. The band was a lot of fun and the only reason I'm giving the place 2 stars. At the end of the night it was a complete down pour and I was waiting for my uber which was at the light across the street. I was standing in the awning to avoid getting soaked. Your security boys repeatedly pushed the door into my back to push me onto the sidewalk and would not let me back inside to escape the rain when I asked. They threatened to call the police which I told them to do because I had  broken no laws. My friends and I celebrated a birthday and spent a significant amount of time and money at your establishment. I never expect to be treated that way simply to get into a safe ride home. Shame on your staff. I was not belligerent nor drunk. No one should he treated that way.

name: The Basement East
text: Dang it Beast Pub! You were my favorite! I hate that I'm updating my review, I loved this place, it felt like a hidden gem that I was always so excited to tell people about. First off, in the past month and a half I've gone 3 times and walked in to private events. Yikes. There's been no signs heading us off, we have just walked in to parties...awkward! But the real kicker is their new menu. So the old menu had these amazing sandwiches and chips and queso and a basket of chips for $1 so hanging out on their fantastic patio munching on a basket of cheap chips insured that we kept buying drinks...now there's no cheap munchies. On our last visit we saw the new menu and asked the bartender if that was it because there were like 8-10 things listed. She seemed like she's getting a bit sick of answering that question and she said that there's a new chef and he's awesome. Sure, he may be awesome...but where's any of the food that we used to come here for? We decided to get the chorizo tacos for $8 and they came out pretty quickly and they were okay...flavors were good but suuuuuuuper greasy, also it was just tacos, no chips or anything with it. So from now, we will just go for happy hour because their 2 for 1's are pretty great still but we won't be getting food anymore. Bummer Beast Pub...bummer.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Pretty cool place. We did not eat. Not sure they had food, but the music and the vibe was great. Set up nicely. They handled the crowd well and it was crazy crowded at 3 on a Thursday afternoon. Good beer. Good service. Good music.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Beware !!! we were there and Tiffany the bar maid never gave our debit card back and said she did. Had to cancel the card the first day there.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text:
For $16, you can take a look at some of the coolest pieces of Johnny Cash history. You don't need to be a Johnny Cash superfan to enjoy the experience.

They have a lot of materials about when he served in the military, some of his art work/photography, and a whole section dedicated to his TV career. It really made you appreciate how widespread his influence was.

They also don't sugarcoat the times in the 80s before The Highwaymen when he didn't have much mainstream successes.

There's a whole other theater room set up that focuses on Cash's other label-mates on Sun Records (including Ray Orbison and Elvis). So that was an extra little surprise.

The entire museum is pretty small (at the end of the museum, there's a station set up to play the "Hurt" video nonstop, which you can hear from half the museum, which is a bit jarring). The staff told us it would take an hour to see everything, but that's mostly because they had music stations set up, each with 4 videos you could play. Kind of a let down there.

But everything else was super fun.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text: The new facility is really beautiful! Bought the tickets for me and my date ahead of time through the Listening Room website and it was very easy. Loved the complimentary valet parking! Food was good and show was great but I have one major complaint. Again and again, I was told there was a $15 fee beyond your show tickets. This means that you have to spend $15 on food and/or drinks. It was never once specified that it's $15 PER PERSON. We thought it was per table so we were stunned with a larger bill than we anticipated. We just came to see a friend play and weren't expecting to pay $40 beyond our tickets. This distinction needs to be made more clear! We left very annoyed. Definitely less likely to return for future shoes unless there's someone playing that we specifically want to see.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text:
I was very underwhelmed by my experience, to put it politely. I'll start with a few "positives". My group went around 1:00 on a Saturday, and we were able to get a table pretty quickly; however, we were a group of 8 and our table only had 3 stools. Had we waited for a larger table, it would have been much longer... not a big deal, though. The "light man" was able to turn the lighted spotlights down very quickly and easily at our request on his iPad and he was very friendly and happy to accommodate. Prior to running into him randomly in the middle of the bar, I had to wear my sunglasses in the room because a spotlight was directly in front of me and beaming into my eyes. The bartender was very friendly and was able to serve me my drink very quickly.... something I only had to do because our waitress, Hollee, abandoned our table and only answered questions when we sought her out elsewhere in the bar. On to the negatives.... I'll try to summarize these. 1. We ordered drinks as soon as we got a table, over the next hour and a half, our waitress never returned to our table to refill water or to ask if we would like to order more. 2. We ordered 3 appetizers that we never received, and were told the food would be "comped." Call me crazy, but you can't comp something that you never served or gave to a customer - no favor done there. 3. WE approached our waitress, Hollee, 3 or 4 times about our food and check. We were told she would check on it (but she never came with an update), another time we were told the food would be right out (not the case, our order was "lost and missing" per the manager). The WORST part about having to approach our waitress was the fact that each time we spoke to her about our order, she never felt the need to ask if our table was ok, if we needed anything, nor did she EVER apologize for the service, or lack there of, that we received or for the food that we never got. 4. They comped half of our drinks, I suppose that was nice, but when we approached the manager about getting a full comp due to the time waisted and awful service, we were told the discount given was all they were comfortable giving. 

Riddle me this Dirks Bentley's Whisky Row... if I had come in and JUST ordered drinks, and my waitress neglected to come to my table and check on me or take additional drinks orders, and I had to approach her 3 or 4 times about my check (only due to the poor service...  may I add), wouldn't you agree that ALONE would be deserving of an apology and 50% discount? Do you not put a high priority on your customer's experience? 

Readers, don't take your chances at this place. Let this be your warning.

name: Losers Bar & Grill -Downtown
text: This bar rejected my aunt because she didn't walk across the street correctly because of her neuropathy which happens sometimes with cancer survivors. We tried to explain to the door guy that she walks that way because of her neuropathy. Still denied us, so if you're a cancer survivor and have neuropathy I wouldn't recommend this bar to anyone. Guess if you can't walk they won't let you in. #fuckcancer

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Don't do it! Didn't check rating before we came in and sorry for it. 30 minutes to get part of our food. Another 10 minutes get a side salad that I told them to forget about. Burger came out undercooked. Wait staff apologetic but too many restaurants down town to provide such poor service.   Dierk needs to check in on "his" places.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: We are huge Kid Rock fans and we were looking forward to visiting this restaurant while in Nashville. After reading some of the reviews, I was on the fence... Definitely not the case. We were greeted as soon as we walked up to the third-floor and had excellent service throughout our entire visit, thank you so much Chastan!!!!  The view was amazing, especially since the NFL draft was going on. Small menu but that is a bonus, easy decision making. I would give him five stars but I CANNOT agree with the price of beer nor did they have his bad ass beer, which is odd and disappointing since it is his restaurant! Six dollars for a regular Budweiser was a bit ridiculous!! Still a cool place to hang out but not if you want to talk with anybody, it is pretty loud. Hopefully Mr. Kid Rock is getting ready for a fish fry!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
If you are really drunk and don't care if you get the right order....  Silverware... Napkins....food... This is the plac for you!!!!!   3rd floor female bartenders are NOT friendly.. 1 is friendly she is of Asian descent.  The rest are nasty attitude ESPECIALLY if you order a SODA.   I did order 3 drinks with th soda.... So im not sure why that was wrong.    
Sorry Kid Rock.... Your place will only last based on location.

I think our waittress tried... By they threw her into the firey pits of hell and didnt  care if they sent her out with the correct orders.
Sent wrong order...  The plate was sent back to kitchen.. They had the waitress try to convince us it was correct.  Poor poor poor management skills!!!!!  I do not blame the wait staff!!!!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Loved this spot. The rooftop bar was very nice. Overlooked the entire strip and nice views of downtown. The ground level bar was spot on for drinks and prices were comparable to the other clubs. The band that played was really awesome (with a fiddle player too!!). After jumping around from a few other bars, this is where we spent the majority of the evening. I will definitely be going back!!

name: 360 Burger
text: What a delicious burger Joint. Everything was delicious, whether it was the chicken wings, the fries (waffle or sweet potato), or the burgers themselves. Just melted in your mouth. If you are feeling healthy, order a side of steamed broccoli... Cooked to perfection. Definitely will be coming back. But they do need to work on server speed. I have been here twice now and BOTH times the service was so slow we considered leaving. Unfortunately, there aren't many places to go in this unsavory section of Nashville at night.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: We have been sitting at a table on the roof for 2 hours and not one person has come to take our food and drink order!!

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
Honestly the best thing we did in Nashville. If you are a fan on live music - you MUST go! The music is phenomenal and we loved that it was a spotlight on the song writers. It was incredible to hear some of our favorite country songs from the people who wrote them and the story behind them.

The music and drinks are alright. There is a $15 minimum per person which we didn't mind since we both ordered two drinks. The nachos were very average, but we had great service. 

Definitely go at least 30 minutes before the show to get the best seats possible. I really can't recommend this place enough!!!

name: 360 Burger
text:
New management, new menu, not coming back.

The food I ordered wasn't right. And when asking the waiter about it, the man said, well, that's how they do it in the kitchen.  Wouldn't try to ask how to make it right, offered nothing else, just a smart mouth.

The exact same thing happened to my wife, her sandwich was completely different than what it said on the menu, is was a complete rip off. And we got no help in correcting it. And the waiter was just completely rude. Mr. 4164 Sommers.

Thanks for screwing up one of our favorite places, we will not be back.

name: General Jackson Showboat
text: I went on this riverboat on a law-enforcement conference, it was all you can eat and all you can drink. You just can't beat that!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
ASS CLOWNS!!!
These idiots that say it's to loud (It's a Fucking Honky Tonk, that means loud music every day, all day), bars are too big, and can't reach the other side(What do you have, fucking T-Rex Arms?) Don't like the music (Go to another floor, there are 5 dumb ass) Rick Springfield, who doesn't like Rick Springfield? I have heard Bo Cefus, BB King, Elvis, Kid Rock, Motorhead, and every other artist past and present. Yes, I have two favorite places on Broadway!! Kid Rocks and Kid Rocks Steak House.

ASS CLOWNS!!!, pull your head out and enjoy life and stop bitching. Life's to short. Enjoy life or move the fuck on!!

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: Whiskey Row is a pretty cool bar, food was excellent and the bands that played there were all very good. Coming from Vegas it's a good time and they even have a little hip hop and DJ portion. My wife and I had a great time there until I was escorted out for swaying too much while I was peeing... yes I was in the bathroom and no I didn't miss the urinal. But I would still go again because even the guy who asked me to leave was very nice. Just an awkward encounter. So I went on about my night and had no hard feelings.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: What a great place! I realize how much I didn't know about Johnny Cash. The man is a legend! So many interesting things about his life. I could have spent my entire day in his museum.

name: Listening Room Cafe
text:
My husband and I were in town visiting friends and went by the Listening Room. We loved the writers performance and the food was great. We ordered the hummus plate small plate, fried pickles small plate that was sweet and spicy, and the tomato blt sando. I would order the small plates. The BLT was a little too much bacon and not enough of the other stuff. I would order a different entrée.

Cool atmosphere and great music/lax vibes.

Highly recommended for locals and tourists.

name: Johnny Cash Museum
text: Tons of Johnny Cash memorabilia and exhibits.  If you're into the man, then you should head over here.  I'm not.  Maybe because my Dad named me Sue.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Disappointed by the service at Kid Rock. Had bought multiple drinks and spent 2+ hours at this bar...when we asked for waters we were told that we could not be given waters for our table. We ended up having to drink the (hot) water from the bathroom because the bar would not serve us. We were informed that if we wanted water we needed to pay for the water. Management, please rethink your service motto because people NEED WATER if they are out and drinking/partying. Please do better.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: My husband I went here for a date night. We went to the roof at first to see the big fuss, it has a nice view and a bar up there and I got a pickers vodka drink, which is amazing . We decided to head downstairs, second floors didn't have much seating area, so we went to the bottom floor. We found two seats at the bar. We order fried pickles and their wings, both were super delicious. The cover band (I can't remember their name) were awesome and that man could sing!!!! It was a great night. Hope to go back again soon

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text:
Probably my least favorite bar I visited on broadway. We had been bar hopping all weekend so it's pretty easy to compare places. We were looking to stop in for a drink and sit down and listen to some music for a bit, before headed to the next bar. This place was extremely loud and you could not hold a conversation at all. However, I did like that they played more rock than country. 

The band was pretty good but once their set was done the leader singer literally went table to table with the tip jar, asking for tips and even interrupting conversations doing so. I don't know if that's a Nashville thing but I had not seen that at any other bars. And the immediately after a guitarist went around holding up the tip jar. It was just way too pushy for me. 

There are many floors to this place and the stairs to the rooftop bar seemed pretty steep. I don't how any drunk person would be able to safely get out of this bar!

Also I would definitely only stick to beer at his place. I ordered an $11 cocktail and the plastic cup itself was tiny. Disappointing to say the least.

name: Live Oak
text:
So I would leave zero stars if possible because this was such a ridiculous experience. But my brother and friends came here to meet up with my friends and BEFORE my brother ever ordered, was only offering to pay for my boyfriends round and was denied because his eyes weren't open enough?? Excuse me WHATT?? Please tell me how blind people or people with the condition of having lazy eyes in general or amblyopia if you want the specific term, are they denied as well? My brother was one day post op LASIK eye surgery so excuse him for his eyes looking puffy but I just felt it was completely unfair and discriminative for completely unnecessary reasoning. We were only trying to take him out due to him just coming in from California for the holidays. Hadn't even had his first drink yet. Will NEVER return. 

UPDATE: we've been to two bars since and have had no issue so obviously there was an issue with their staff, not my brother. Specifically the male bartender with big ears who liked to look at everyone with judgmental stares.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Horrible service. Bar tender was great, but security is unprofessional and disrespectful. Situations arise and the necessary means we're not put in place to ensure proper treatment of patrons. We would recommend passing this bar up if in town, and visiting Luke's bar across the street.

name: Dierks Bentley's Whiskey Row
text: My server Savannah recommended I order the Red Pepper hummus. So light and delicious! She knew exactly what I needed! Love this!

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: Ran out of steak... need I say more.  Ordered onion rings.. and they were horrible so I left.  Not going back.

name: Kid Rock's Big Honky Tonk and Rock n' Roll Steakhouse
text: This place is terrible. The venue is nice but we went for lunch and had the chicken tenders and burger and you could tell both were sourced directly from Sysco. The chicken tenders and fries were the exact ones I served at the local country club when I worked there in high school. Only difference is that Kid Rock's Big Ass Sysco tenders cost double.

name: The Basement East
text:
I will be back! Food is amazing - every item on the menu was fresh, creative, and "real". And such great flavor! I couldn't have made more perfect nachos :)

The prices are great for such quality and quantity. And the wait staff was excellent.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: Better than average food.  Really fun bartender.  And the prices weren't jacked up like at some of the other downtown joints.

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: My boyfriend and I were looking for a place to eat on a Sunday night.  I had tried to look up some "must eat" places in Nashville on Trip Advisor and tons of places were closed.  We ended up finding The Dawg House Saloon by chance as it was very convenient from our hotel.  Immediately, it looked like a popular place for a Sunday night.  Most people were only drinking, but we ordered dinner.  For an appetizer, I had the fried pickles and my boyfriend had wings.  I loved my appetizer and he said the wings were really good (he's pretty particular with his wings so that's a definite plus).  We both ordered burgers- I had a jalapeño burger and my boyfriend had the black and blue burger.  Although I was expecting more kick with my burger, the jalapeño flavor was awesome!  Would definitely recommend this place for a good burger and a place to hang out.  The only reason I gave it 4 stars is because we weren't able to see the live music.  Not sure what time it starts, but we were there until 9:30.

name: Belcourt Taps
text: I was hesitant to come back to Taps because of my previous two visits with a lackluster waitress. This time, though, our server Eleazar was so cool and helpful. He even have us 20% off! I've always though the food was delicious, especially the Macho burger, which is stuffed with buffalo chicken and blue cheese. I will definitely be back again thanks to our server today!

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Okay. So far the best bar I have found in Nashville. A lot of people my age 20-30ish, great food and the most amazing  beer menu I've seen in a while. This will definitely become a regular place for me to visit on the weekends.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Okay... So I normally don't delve out bad reviews, but this one is going to be one.  I'm giving a two stars for  for the music and atmosphere. BUT THE SERVICE sucks!!!  We were not told about the bar/seating rules when we paid at the front.  So while we waited for our table, we ordered food since they said we had an hour wait till we could be seated.  However, by the time the food came out, our table was ready.  So, then we are informed that our server would possibly be mad at us for ordering at the bar.  ?!?!?!?!?  And mad he was.  From the moment we sat, his first question to us was "Did you order your food at the bar???"  Then, he commenced to give us VERY poor service!  I have NEVER been thus treated.  And possibly will NOT be back.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: My husband and I didn't even make it in the door. We walked in and we're told it would be an hour wait and the cover charge was $10. Then the host turned his back on us and continued his conversation. The big problem I have is this was a Monday night and at least half a dozen tables were empty. Disappointing. We loved BB Kings in Memphis.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Great beer selection! This place has something for everyone. Local beers and beers from near and far! Food was tasty with a good selection of Germany fare. The wait staff was knowledgeable, kind and attentive. Seat yourself with a variety of stools, table and couches. Great Sunday funday!

name: Music City Tippler
text:
This is officially my favorite spot in Nashville.  I have been in for dinner, brunch and drinks on several occasions and continue to love it.  

Food is great.  Drinks are great.  Staff is great.   Place is great.

Great.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Stopped in for lunch on Saturday. The brunch menu was a bit limited but the bbq pork was good. They had a bluegrass  band playing and getting us to dance and that was fun. Great atmosphere!  Prices not bad at all.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: The Saucer is definitely a place to go in Nashville. I can sit at the bar, look up onto the high walls and see some old friends, friends of my father. Great memories bring old happiness to the new memory being made here. Aside from the nostalgia for one native Nashville girl, there is a plethora of beer. Draft beer, 12oz bottle beer, 22oz bottle beer, beer beer beer :) The food is mighty delicious and the atmosphere is cool and comfortable. Set in the old train station across from The Frist, with reasonable prices and good service, this place is not one to pass up.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: The backstage tour is a must if you're visiting Nashville.  We absolutely loved it! It was fast passed but not rushed. Our tour guide was fun, light hearted and knowledgeable.  We were given plenty of time to take pictures.  Standing in the place were so many legends stood was amazing. If you miss this tour you really missed out on why the Grand Ole Opry is the heart of country music.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Great music venue. The building itself is very nice and they handle the crowds very well. It is very accessible with minimal wait. There is plenty of food and drink available inside with minimal wait as well. The sound and view from our seating area were great.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: I try not to be too harsh in my reviews. But man this place was just subpar. The smell was not great when we walked in and the food was all exceptionally underwhelming. The location of the restaurant was the only thing that was appealing. It was right in the middle of downtown and an easy walk to anything. We will not return.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: We just went last night and talk about a gorgeous venue inside and out! 2 hours or great entertainment. Whip I'm a self-proclaimed concert connoisseur I have to say this has been one of my favorite venues. Beautiful areas to take photos as well!

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: New awesome bar on Demonbreun- delicious food, a ton of TVs, great live music, great prices on drinks and food- all around awesome place to go- try it out for food or drinks -  I love it!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: The food and service was outstanding trey was our waiter and totally took care of us we had a large party and he was all over it

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
Back Alley Diner is tucked into an alley in the Arcade. Upon entering, one is greeted with interesting art on the walls, live music and plenty of seating options. As this is Nashville, there was live music taking place when we came for an early dinner before 6pm. We selected it based upon its close proximity to TPAC, where we were later seeing a show.

I had the catfish po'boy, which came with two hushpuppies and a side option. Since it's summer swimsuit season, I passed on the fries and onion straws and selected fruit as my side. Wah wah. But, it was delicious and refreshing, consisting of pineapple, grapes and strawberries. The sandwich was comprised of a large filet, lettuce and remoulade. It wasn't New Orleans quality, but we're in Nashville, not New Orleans. It was good and we had very friendly, attentive service.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: This is pretty cool! I was even more impressed with how many bar areas and restrooms they have in the building. The lines were short to non-existent and the  restrooms were clean.  I noticed that they also offer an outdoor smoking area on the second floor for those who need to excuse themselves....the gift shop has some cool things to offer which is available before and after the show.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Great bar with a huge variety of drinks. The interior is nice with ample seating for larger groups or small ones. I especially like the couches which are comfy and relaxing.

name: Dan McGuinness Irish Pub
text: Between the liquor selection and the awesome food and service you can't go wrong. Justin was a very attentive server.

name: Belcourt Taps
text: My wife and I come here about once a week. The food is always good and the servers are friendly. They have a great selection of local beers on tap.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: This is one of the must see places in Nashville.  Great blues / jazz music to listen and dance to.  The ribs are one of the best in city.  Super moist and succulent.  We are definitely coming back the next time we visit Nashville

name: Belcourt Taps
text: Awesome music and food! Always a fun time at Taps! Never a better place.... Nice place to connect and hang out and have fun!

name: Belcourt Taps
text: I cannot say enough great things about this place! I purchased a groupon for 2 flights of beer and appetizer and I am so glad I did. We did not have a reservation and the grouping stated it was required, but they gladly helped us anyway. The staff was friendly and personable, and the owner was so nice! After over hearing we are new to Nashville she walked over to introduce herself and chatting about all the great things to do in Nashville! The live music was awesome and the vibe was just what we liked. I have a feeling we will become regulars here!

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: From the impressive beer selection to the even more impressive knowledge about said beers that the bartenders have, this place is a go-to for any beer lover. The bar has well over 200 different varieties of beers from around the world. The bartender who was serving us had stellar recommendations, including an apricot sour beer that was phenomenal.

name: Anthem
text:
A great place to go see a show or dance in Nashville.
Has very interesting seating setup, and plenty of different areas to lounge in!
This one of the largest and nicest clubs in Nashville!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Went here for a quick lunch on the first day of the CMA Fest. I had the catfish po boy and my boyfriend had the pork bbq sandwich. Fast service, delicious fries, and reasonable prices. The great live music was an added bonus!

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
With taps galore and even more in bottles, the Flying Saucer features between 100 to 150 beers on any given day. Although I can't attempt to try them all, I'm sure there are those who try. 

The beer menu is a newsletter four pages long, one I wouldn't mind reading more often. I decided to go with Abita Select Strawotor, love Abita beers. My guy ordered some Seasonal special on tap. 

For an early lunch snack, we ordered the 3 item plate (pick from meat and cheeses) and along with that you get olive tapanade, crackers of multiple kinds, roasted almonds and apples. We went with two different types of cheese and the peppered salami. It was a great cheese plate. 

I loved the service, the beer selection and the food. The location has a lot of charm and so much to see with all the saucers on the ceiling. I would love to stop into another location when traveling or come back for more.

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
While visiting my sister who lives in Nashville, she took me here to grab a bite to eat before we went to all the bars off Broadway. This isn't a bar that you would think exists in downtown Nashville if you didn't live here because I know when I think of downtown Nashville I think crazy packed honky-tonk bars, and this is quite the opposite!

Glad we stopped here first- it was ladies night! Their Thursday night special is ONE DOLLAR WELL DRINKS (for ladies only obviously)! You can't find a deal like that anywhere in Nashville...especially not downtown. We started our night off right, the food was delicious and the drinks were cheap! If you're looking for a chill and inexpensive stop before hitting up the honky-tonk bars this is the place to go!!

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
This is my favorite bar in town! Large area, so it never feels extremely crowded. Comfy leather couches, pool tables, darts, and seating for large parties are some of my favorite aspects of The Flying Saucer. 
It is open late and always has a really laid back atmosphere. You can also join their UFO club to keep track of the beers you drink to work towards a platter on the wall. UFO club members also receive great offers.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Amazing experience that I will never forget. We were lucky enough to have chosen a night where David Nail, Vince Gill and a Little Big Town were performing. The Opry runs so smoothly, entertaining every second. We had amazing seats in the center section. It is a must and worth every penny. I will definitely be back again. Soon I hope!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
The best thing about the Grand Ole Opry venue is that there are almost no bad seats.  Compared to many other venues it's a very small and intimate one.  Recently the better half got tickets for "Weird Al" Yankovic and it was an outstanding experience being able to see him here. Instead of having to strain my eyes looking at a Hawaiian Shirt shaped speck you could actually make him out.

Additionally, the parking is free because you are next to Opry Mills. Of course it may take you a while to FIND said Free Parking because of how busy Opry Mills always is. 

Opry Mills is also a bonus because you can easily find a place to eat before the show. 

Highly recommended for any concert.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Went in for a drink and that's all we had. The bartender wasn't very welcoming, she was too busy talking to the only other people in there. We had one drink and went a few doors down to Doc Holliday's where we were very welcomed!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
If you are a country music fan, this is a must do!!!  Book a show and take the tour.   The tour takes you through the back dressing rooms and on stage, and they let you not only see the perspective of those performing, you get to stand on the Circle of Wood taken from the Ryman when the Opry moved to the new building. 
Then do a show! You get to witness a LIVE Radio show and see multiple performers even if just of a couple of songs each. Only downside, if you book early to get decent tickets, you don't know who you will see.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: Wife and I went for dinner I had the smoked chicken Philly and hush puppies, she had the pulled pork and fries. The waitress warned me that there was lots of chicken on the Philly but to my surprise when I got it, it didn't even fill half of the 9 inch hoagie that it was made on. I believe there was about 5 onion pieces and about 4 pieces of bell pepper on the Philly, not what I would expect to see on a Philly of any sort. The hush puppies were cooked with some kind of flaky batter that was the consistency of a crushed shortbread cookie. I was not impressed and definitely will not return. We also had drinks, the sex on the beach was bitter and tasted watered down. I gave it to stars because my wife's food was tolerable.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text:
We only ordered Nachos so this review applies to the beer and beertenders only. OUTSTANDING! Our bartender really knew the beers they offered on tap (200+ of them) and pulled together an excellent IPA sampler. Prices were very reasonable also.

If you like beer, this is a must in Nashville.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: Best burgers in town, hands down. Friendly staff, lovely ambiance and an overall great experience. The fries are to die for, so make that your top priority when you come! Will be back very soon!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
Actually, probably closer to a 3.5 as food was just meh and they didn't have my drink of choice, Limon.   :(. The fried pickles and catfish bites were great.  Definitely a must.  
Crowd was a great mix of ages and the band playing was excellent.    
Our server did a great job keeping up with our group of 8.   
Dark place and very loud but I think this is expected for a blues bar.

name: Music City Tippler
text:
My boyfriend and I tried the Tippler the first week it opened and I was very impressed with the decor as well as the speakeasy vibe. We went for drinks before dinner and they weren't terrible but I am a huge Patterson house fan and the Tippler does not compare. 

After visiting again last night with a group for a friends birthday I was a little confused. We walked over from boundary and see a group of people waiting outside and a bouncer at the door. We were told we would have to wait unless we had reservations. Luckily my friend reserved a table so we were able to go right in. Once we were seated with our party it was 20 minutes before we saw a waiter and another 20 before we got our drinks. I felt like I needed to order 5 things every time I saw him because I didn't know when he would be back again. 

Towards the end of the night we gave up our table and walked around the bar a bit. We looked to our right and there was Nashville star, Sam Palladio "Gunner" posted at the bar, so that was a plus. There are three levels. The top level is cozy and has a shuffle board table but it only took change so no one was really playing. There was also a tv and couch which was nice. The middle level is somewhat of a dining room feel while the bottom level has a club vibe. 

Overall I liked the Tippler and they played great music . The drinks are a bit pricey for what they are but still good. After a certain time I think it turns into more of a club than a bar so if you're not into that go early. I didn't like the whole bouncer at the door and feeling like I was on 2nd ave but it still turned out to be a great night. I would go again before dinner but not for dinner.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
A must see/do when in Nashville! 
The Opry offers a taste of a variety of different artists playing a variety of genres. Great views and sound. 
Advice: get there early so you can have dinner and parking is plentiful. 
We combined this with a trip to Opryland which is within walking distance. Allow for a couple hours of strolling through there 4 gardens. There is no cost to stroll. We found the best cheesecake in the Cascades restaurant. Have fun.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: First time checking out this place today. Had an awesome time food was great. Only thing I wish was that beer prices were a little lower. Paying $5 or $7 bucks for a 13oz or 16oz beer is a little much.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
On a recent trip to Nashville, we were able to watch Carrie Underwood and a host of other artists perform. The show started off with Carrie narrating the history of the Opry, including the flood in 2010 and its rebuild and recovery, and the significance of the wooden circle in the middle of the stage. 

The performance was a bit over two hours, featured so many lives acts, funny moderators, and is all broadcast live on the radio. On this particular Saturday night, the Opry was packed--and one can easily see why: it's an experience to be had, and I'm not even a country music fan. It amazes me that they are able to pull off performances like these night after night. You definitely cannot miss this if you are in town!

name: Back Alley Diner
text: wonderful dinner here with a friend while attending a convention. food was terrific and staff was very attentive. best burger I've had in a long time.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: I was in Nashville for a conference and a group wanted to go to the Opry.  Always down to check out some country music.  I was surprised how amazing my night was.  I didn't check out who was singing that night and it was such a great idea!  Barry Gibb ended up performing.  Hearing him sing "Stayin Alive" with Ricky Skaggs was amazing!  I couldn't believe it.  This has to be one of the best concerts and venues I have been to.  Great experience at the Opry.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: So much fun!!  We had a wonderful time at the Grand Ole Opry!  Can't wait to come back one day.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Had a blast last night seeing the Grand Ole Opry live! We may have been in the "nose bleeds" but I still felt like close to the action. Maybe it was the performers, but they also played to us and not just the front row. 
By far the best performance was by Chris Jansen! Funny and energetic. He made a three song set feel like an entire show! Not sure how he'd keep that energy up every night, but it was a blast! Hopefully he has some staying power and gets inducted into the Grand Ole Opry. 

It was made even cooler by the fact that we took a behind the scenes tour earlier in the day and got to see some of the awesomeness first hand. We didn't get to run into anyone famous, but it was still really cool to stand in the circle.

name: Music City Tippler
text: In my opinion, unlike any place that Nashville has thus far. This has become one of my favorite places to go on the weekends with friends. Not too pretentious, not too expensive (if you order wisely), not too small, and isn't overwhelmingly dominated by any certain demographic. The DJ is great, the mezcal mule is perfect, the decor is awesome. I have not been back since they changed their menu, so I can't speak to it as a dinner spot but as a place to go with friends after dinner it is definitely a good time!

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text: Great service!! Lindsey is the best! Came in for a bachelorette party and had a great time!!

name: Belcourt Taps
text: I stumbled upon Belcourt Taps while killing an hour before heading to see my movie at Belcourt Theatre. It was packed so I waited at the bar before finding a seat and watching a few people sing & play up on stage. It is a small place, but I don't mind it. I've been back several times & I like that I can catch people singing any night. I haven't eaten the food, but my friend had the fried green tomatoes & said they were good. I tried a glass of their Belcourt tap, which barely qualifies as a beer, it's so light.  I won't get it again, but I will be back.

name: Dan McGuinness Irish Pub
text: I come here for the beer battered deep fried pickles!! Light, crispy, greasy, salty goodness!! I love the outdoor patio w live music playing...and it's not allllll country bands thank God( nothing against country music, it's just that I can only take it in moderate doses and that's all u get at some places)they have a nice mix. I've never hung out inside, seems kind of dark and stale in there but the patio atmosphere is awesome. The servers have always been friendly!

name: Belcourt Taps
text:
I went to Belcourt Taps for the burgers. The burger was pretty good. 

I wouldn't go here for flights of beer. Someone else's server came to the bar (where I was sitting) to ask the bartender how to serve a flight. She was told to "pick random beers" for the flight. I doubt she remembered all of the ones that she chose for that table's order.

Food was good; avoid the flights.

name: Ms. Kelli's Karaoke Bar
text: Great place to sing covers of the greatest hits! I especially loved the moment when Prince came on and I got to sing little Red Corvette! It is the perfect place to drink and sing out of tune. Also if you are up for playing a game of pool, they have that too.

name: Back Alley Diner
text: Finding this place was an adventure, but it is awesome! The atmosphere is homey and welcoming. The fries are very crunchy and the burgers are fantastic. My husband got the aloha burger which is marinated in terriaki sauce and has fried pineapple, I got the Titan burger, which has mushrooms and cheese. The burgers are excellently marinated and my husband recommends that you order a side a fried to take home.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: Likeable enough place but the bartender acts like she's doing you a favor by getting you a drink AT THE BAR!!! Hateful, rude and very disrespectful. We asked to switch the channel after the male bartender said "no problem" and she was argumentative and rude again. We won't be back and I hope she isn't working to pay for anything because she is an ass. Long brown, straight hair with a baseball cap and bad attitude.

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
We popped in here for a lunch based on all the rave reviews. We did have a good experience, but for all the options in Nashville I was a little underwhelmed. If I could, I would give it 3.5 stars.

First off, it's a typical pub food menu. Good quality pub food, but still pub food. We came hungry, so ordered a lot of food. The poppers were good: bacon wrapped cream cheese stuffed jalapenos, not deep fried. I had a burger, and it was definitely above average. I also sampled the fried catfish, fries, onion strings, baked beans, and hush puppies. ALL above average. There were no bland fillers here. 

The service was really friendly, really attentive.

If you're hungry for a burger and fries kind of meal this is a great spot for it. However, if you're visiting Nashville and looking for a unique dining experience, this isn't anything you can't find in your hometown.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
Being in town for business we were looking for a place we considered to be authentic yet not overwhelmingly country and we found BB Kings. 

I can say we had a great time. The food was not the best ever however had many highlights including the fried pickles and the amazing fried catfish. 

Our table got a variety of entrees ranging from fish to steak and while no one was amazed everyone definitely left happy. 

Overall the ambiance made the night and we would definitely come again when in town.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Had a blast. Saw Thomas Rhett. Wish he played more! But for what we got, it was an awesome experience! We even were able to take the behind the scenes tour, which was awesome!!! Our tour guide was a younger girl, can't remember her name, but she was super funny and informative! All around great experience and a must do when on vacation in Nashville!

name: Back Alley Diner
text: A decent burger joint in an out of the way place.  A better choice than all the tourist trap places in downtown Nashville.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: What a fun thing to do when in Nashville!  Loved all of the variety in the perfprmers, and since we took the backstage tour, we got to see most of them up close and personal.  It seems like such a prestigious pace, yet still casual and homey in that the performers seem like one big happy family.  A must-do when in Nashville!

name: Dan McGuinness Irish Pub
text: Scotch eggs, burgers, fish and chips, and the rest of the menu is cooked magnificently to order.  Tuesdays is rock and roll night and you just might see someone whose CDs you've been listening to for years.  This is hands-down the coolest spot in Nashville!

name: Third Man Records
text: Passing through Nashville during rush hour and figured that this would be a perfect way to avoid driving in some traffic. Just a short 5 minute hop off I-40 and it's off a sneaky road with the Third Man Records logo standing tall. The building looks awesome and the interior is even better! But the only downside is that the space is too small for the crowd of people in there.. The ambiance of exploring the things in the store gets lost when people are bumping you. Besides that I'm soo excited to listen to the first records of my new record collection!! Rock on Jack

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
This is just a cool place to hang out, grab a bite to eat, have a cold beer for a decent price, and watch a game or listen to live music.

Is the food great? Nope. It's good. It's flavorful. Portions are good. Prices are decent. You can order standard bar fare or something healthier. If I owned the restaurant, I'd be proud of what I was doing.

The atmosphere: it's off an alley, hence the name. I've taken my teenage daughters to BAD before hockey games, entire family on weekends, and friends. The crowd is nice and you can enjoy a meal with your kids and not worry about someone acting 'the fool.' They have live music. Are they ready for primetime? Nope. Do they sing better than me (yes and easy bar to hurdle) and are they entertaining? Definitely.

They have a good choice of beers and happy hour specials. They are closed on Sundays and are colas for private events on occasion.

I highly recommend BAD. I don't eat there often enough.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
We first went to BB Kings when it was still in Vegas so we were looking forward to this visit to Nashville so we could go again. 

However, we were let down!! The ribs were cold, refrigerated cold, not room temperature cold! The Mac n cheese tasted like they just microwaved it. Horrible stuff! It seems like they are relying on their reputation to get them business and the quality of food is going down hill. 

We hand two drinks that were decent, but if you want really good drinks head over to 417 Union or Skull's! 

The music, I gotta say, was awesome! The band was Hayes and the Hustle. I think that's the name, they were really really good!!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
We were hesitating to see this show or not. In the end we're super happy to see the show.
For 2 and half hours the show was going on pretty well organized. They were all good.
The audience and singer with bands, felt like we're all one big family.
Great show. Definitely worth to see when you are in Nashville.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Very fun night out. So many talented acts. Cassidy Pope was the main act. The opening acts out performed her. A must do when in Nashville!

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
Came on a Sunday morning for brunch.  The combination of an excellent live band and a good buffet puts this on the top of my list in Nashville.  
The buffet starts out as a regular Sunday brunch; made the way you like it omelette, bacon etc.  They add super fresh fruit, pulled pork, and BBQ ribs. Add a live band that played Blues  and Motown while we were munching away, and I'm a happy guy for the rest of the day.  
We'll be back!

name: Belcourt Taps
text: Great spot! No I'm just kidding worst experience ever. Literally don't go here. Server was a nice guy but the food took over an hour to come out. I ordered a full sized Caesar salad and it was the size of my palm. We ordered a mushroom burger, and if it wasn't for the name on the menu, I wouldn't have been able to tell you what the f*** that s*** was. My dog has taken s***s better than that. It was a vegetarian version of a White Castle slider. Thank God the music was good right? Yeah it was pretty good. For whatever reason after over an hour and a half, we decide to order Jalapeño poppers. Our server says 4-5 minutes. Yeah...f***ing RIGHT!!!!!!! After 20 minutes we look over, and to our amazement the guy doing the mixing for the live music has gotten a full grill cheese meal that he ordered two minutes earlier. OKAY. This was the last straw. I call over the nearest bar back and asked him about the Jalapeño Poppers, dreading his response. He told me with a straight face that they had been having printing problems and that our server had just told him about it. I'm sorry, I don't usually write yelp reviews, actually this is my first one. This was hands down the worst restaurant experience ever.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: You always have a great time but be aware with bench type seating it can get a bit tight and some folks can spread out with clothing and packages. I am sad to see each time we come, it is more and more expensive.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: So much fun! Love the history of the ole Opry house. The music was Great! Goodyear took us and had a great time.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: It's a must do Nashville sort of thing! Just commit and do it if visiting the area!  Get tkts ahead of time if you can.  Shows start at 7 and doors open at 6.  Arena is big and church pew style seating.  Get some popcorn and a beverage it's a long show with 1 intermission and multiple acts!  The night I was there high valley, Vince Gill, and Charlie Daniels band played as lead performers!  What an experience to see devil went down to Georgia played live!  Overall would do it again!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: The backstage tour was one of our favorite places in Nashville! We really enjoyed hearing about the history and being able to step on stage for photos. The tour guides were informative and kind. We stopped on our way back to the airport and the security team allowed us to check our luggage with them.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text: Collard greens, gumbo, Texas toast all big winners. Great music and great atmosphere are a huge plus. I could stay here for hour

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text: Cute place but the band that was performing asked for tips for about 20 minutes. And after we gave $20 the lead singer walked around and came to our table asking for more.  After 30 mins they finally played a song. Strange.  The bathrooms are great - tire and gas pump sinks and guitar toilets!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: First trip to Nashville . So excited to check out the Grande ole Opry! Did the backstage tour. Randy was our tour guide. Randy is absolutely wonderful! He was so knowledgeable. Charismatic, helpful, funny and overall just a joy !! Couldn't have been happier. Thank you Randy!!!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: This is a Nashville classic! No matter what kind of music you enjoy, you have to go to the Grand Ole Opry  to get a true taste of Nashville. Down home friendly people and Country Music Royalty! So much fun!

name: Ms. Kelli's Karaoke Bar
text: To each their own, and I'm not a germophobe. But the employee proclaiming herself as Ms Kelli, the owner, (to be fair I don't know if she was the owner or just a bartender) cut in front of everyone in line in the bathroom, then upon leaving the stall, left the bathroom without washing her hands. As I walked out of the bathroom I saw her behind the bar making drinks. I can only assume she was opening beers, garnishing drinks, etc. with her unwashed hands. Like I said, to each their own. If you don't find that offensive, you may well enjoy this bar. I just wanted to pass along what I saw.

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text: Great time and great band. Service was quick and the staff was pleasant. One of the best bars in the strip!

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text: Thee was good and bad. First of all, we live here so we don't come down to Broadway very often(too crowded) but we thought Christmas exe would be a good time to listen to some music. Normally we go to Roberts for what I would call an authentic honky Toni experience. So first the good. The place looks awesome, I love the bar area downstairs. Very intimate and comfortable on a day when there weren't 25 people in there. We didn't eat so I can't speak to that. The problem? A 3-4 ounce glass of house wine and a 12 ounce can of Goose IPA was $16.50. That is ridiculous. OK, I get it, screw the tourists, but damn. I'll go back to Roberts and drink my limited selection of Domestics for $2.50. Just my opinion.

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Watched the Titans game here. Decent beer selection and a great crowd. Unfortunately, was rubbed the wrong way when the manager asked me to move out of my seat away from my friends. This was so the "VIP" tables could watch the game without me in their way. Except there was absolutely no one behind me in the VIP section.

name: WannaB's Karaoke Bar
text: Great Place to go with a Group and show off those singing skills. The audience participation is pretty spot on here. So like I said if you want to feel like a star for a day then this is definitely your place. You will have a good time in general.

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text: You might think this is just another downtown bar, but they stand for much more than that. They have so much respect for veterans and the military. They have a house whiskey where 10% of the proceeds go to families of fallen soldiers. They also will buy your first round for free if you are a service member or veteran. I love what they represent and the entertainment here is awesome. True to country music and music city!

name: Third Man Records
text: I ordered a t-shirt from Third Man for my husband.  The design was fine, but the quality was terrible.  I tried to return for a refund, but they would only give a store credit.  I didn't want another t-shirt because of the quality and everything else was too expensive. We ended up keeping it because of the hassle.  We have also visited the actual store.  Some cool things but very small and the staff act too cool to be helpful.

name: Third Man Records
text:
Loved this little hot spot. We got there on the early side. They have a wall of there of hot local and only available to this spot shelves. Make your own 45, or go into the listening booth. Lots of great little goopies, pins, patches, shirts and record player accessories. 
Glad we stopped

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Good food and decent prices, but they charge a $10 cover on Sundays if you want to watch football upstairs (which you have to do if you don't want to watch the Browns). Go to Double Dogs or Clyde's for football Sundays instead!

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: After a short deliberation, my colleagues and I deferred to come here instead of the Titans game. A mistake, I concluded. But nevertheless, the ravens were on and not blowing a perfectly winnable game for once so I was pleased. The food here is pretty much just like every other sports bar in Nashville: kinda overpriced, heavily seasoned, easy to throw in a microwave. Overall, great place to drink and watch sports. I've ever made this a yelp comment before, but it's worth noting because it's so prominent here: the staff are kinda socially awkward. The lady that sat us cryptically asked us to relocate cause the entire bar was reserved (apparently, although as I type this there's one lady sitting there). Also, this one nice bouncer kept coming up to our table and just saying "cups," to indicate that he wanted to take our empty drink cups. Interesting place.

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text:
uggh just horrible - so
Not recommend at all.  Security is rude AF for
No reason ... could be nice if the men went to etiquette class!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Holy Nashville, the town Vegas doesn't want you to know about! Little Big Town  and Charlie Daniels Band at The Grand Ole Opry, Randy Travis making a rare appearance on stage.. this experience was  so good!!! This is such a good time, we're going again for sure.

name: Music City Psychic
text: Had reading with Gennifer while on fun weekend with friends.  She was amazing!!! I don't know how she was able to be dead on with everything she told me. Very impressed! !

name: Belcourt Taps
text:
This place is a joke!
Service would be better ran by monkeys!
The short round intoxicated woman pouring shots for her friends keep her busy enough to ignore the paying customers.  The shot glasses look like a collection in a college students dorm room. 
The smell near the bar is tainted due to never cleaning it and the fermentation odor is nauseating!

name: Ms. Kelli's Karaoke Bar
text: I took my friend here to show her a good time in Nashville (her first time in TN). She LOVES karaoke. She requested a song and it took her MULTIPLE requests (i.e., prompts) to get her song played. After they FINALLY played her song, she sang and the "host" proceeded to criticize her performance before the whole bar (please note, she's obviously not famous-- just having fun, but multiple "singers" before her were just awful and there were no criticisms). As she stepped off stage, she attempted to report her terrible experience to which the "manager" asked her if, "she'd still take him home with her." I'm appalled. That's sexual harassment.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: Here for the first time on our 6 year anniversary date. We are seeing #Move staring Derek and Julianne Hough. Awesome show! If you get the chance see it!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: this place has always been on my list of things to see in my life & it did not fail me! i'm a fan of old country music as well as newer & it was just a dream to walk the halls of where all my favorites had & see the mail area and the inductee wall! it was just a country music lover's dream! the rooms were just amazing! i cannot pick a favorite! the staff is so courteous & just down right sweet! loved the tour, hated that the prices for the tourist picture with the mic was so high & there was no way to get a picture of it aside from the set up kodak people...but overall it did not damper the absolute perfect of that place

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: A great place for a quick bite or a sit down meal. Wonderful atmosphere, extensive menu for all eaters and tons of beer choices.  It's a must try and a will love! I recommend the soft pretzels and get all of the dips. Each one is great! Enjoy!

name: John Rich's Redneck Riviera
text: We ended our night at the Redneck Riviera where the music was great and the drinks were yummy. My friend had a yummy Busch Wacker and we even got these cute shot glasses thanks to Yelp! It's not a huge place but I recommend going to this bar when in Nashville!

name: Anthem
text: I went to Anthem for a private Yelp event but I can honestly say that it is a gem. It exudes lots of style and the staff and bartenders were very welcoming to me each time I had a question or visited the bar! The handcrafted cocktail are pretty solid and bar service is great! In addition, Anthem has quite a few nooks and sitting areas where you can chat with friends or strangers. I also loved the fact that there is a lot of space to dance in the main floor level area in front of the stage. The club has a great set-up that gives patrons various vantage points of the venue. From the top balcony there is a great view of the center dance floors and stage and great views from any of the bar areas or comfy plush seating areas. Overall, I thought Anthem was a charming club that I would love to visit the next time that I make it to Nashville.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
Talk about legendary, iconic and historical. Wow. Just an incredible property and venue to visit and be a part of whether it's to explore or to see a live performance.

This is where it happens for so many country music stars over so many decades.

It's just really cool to be in the same space where so many found their voices.

Can't wait to go back.

name: Belcourt Taps
text: Simple little spot where we enjoyed some writers rounds, drinks & appetizers! Very small and packed early so sitting on the patio worked just fine!

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
Back Alley Diner is a great dive bar with solid bar food choices. Yesterday in downtown was a stress test for anyplace: tens of thousands flooding the place for free music, hockey playoffs, and beer.

The Back Alley is a bit difficult to find but look for the signs on Church Street, walk up the alley, and you can't missed it.

Beers include all of the standards and a smaller selection of local microbrew product.Saturdays are typically $2 PBRs but go for the local Yazoo brews. Mixed drinks, they got them but they are typical of southern bars: a bit sweet and often too loaded for bear. 

The fries are among the best in town; my companion judged them the best. And you get to choose how to load them up, even with pulled pork. The wings are solid not spectacular. 

The burgers are the real deal-- go for the special on Texas Toast, enough for 2 people. But I am a fan of the catfish and chicken tenders. Expertly fired up, not greasy not overwhelmed by the batter.

The service remains the weak point: friendly but maddeningly inconsistent. Perhaps the regulars should let the staff do their jobs rather than gabbing. But you have to a hate a guy serving who is also talking on his cell phone.....

Now the best news: good drink, good food and you don't have to take out a loan to pay for it. Reasonably priced restaurants have disappeared in downtown: glad that BAD is still a hold-out.

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text:
Bring your lube for getting screwed here. $5 for a 12oz draft Miller Lite?!?! WHOA! 

Service was ruff. Bar appearance looked ruff. Bathrooms were SUPER RUFF. Just pass.

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Showed up with friends and family to watch game. Managed to get corner spot at bar. We had several friends requesting that we get them drinks as it was very crowded....UA draws a hell of a crowd, Roll Tide.  Short hair blonde was great and knew we were there to spend a good amount and bought plenty of rounds for other fans as well. In swoops skinny attitude ridden bartender with the most horrendous visible grey hair extensions by the way.  We (husband and myself) drank very little and knew we needed to pace ourselves  so yes, it was very easy to see those God awful extensions.  Never pick apart someone's appearance but she 100% deserved it. No one knew why she decided to serve our corner but when my husband put up his hand (not even called or waved) to order drinks for patrons behind us, she laid into him calling him every name in the book. There were at least 20 people who came to his defense asking why she would berate him.....she didn't like that she was clearly out of line and beckoned the bouncers over to physically throw him out. Subsequently, she threw out a hefty tip that we routinely would have paid. For a big game and behalf of our friends, they were looking at a minimum 100-150 in tips. We were all asked to leave since we defended my husband. Disgusting display of management. Will NEVER set foot in that place. I may sneak in to give the nice short blond bartender the tip she deserves. If she's reading this, feel free to message me if that B of a bartender gets fired bc I would like to tip you what you deserve. I stand by my word.

name: Grand Ole Opry
text: I really enjoy coming to the Grand Ole Opry House. I've been here before on a backstage tour. That was really neat.  Tonight I saw Jason Aldean and Michael Ray, along with some other amazing talent. The Opry store has some cute things. Clothing seems to b overprices. The only thing I feel that is prices decent are the mugs. The staff is polite and we will be returning to another show (one day).

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text:
I am not a frequent visitor of Midtown, and after my night out I have no clue why. There's more space to move around, less noise to talk to your friends, and drinks are way, way cheaper. 

For a Friday night, DawgHouse was not very lively. But I really had no problem with it, we were able to sit at the bar with no problem talking, and got quick service. The music was kind of lacking, the DJ wasn't doing much to draw in too big of a crowd.

Overall I had a good time at DawgHouse but they had a lot of competition up and down the road and they were not seeming to do to well in terms of getting people in the door.

name: Third Man Records
text:
Look, I don't really know anything about music and I'm definitely not a ridiculous snob about anything Jack White-related (in reality, I really don't care all that much for him or The White Stripes... sue me).  

So, as a person who knows nothing and doesn't really get all nerdy about music stores, Third Man was a pretty fun place to be.  The vinyl records are insanely expensive (everyone post-1985 would be appalled at the prices) and barely anyone has a record player, so annoying.  However, there's a ton of really fun stuff in here that entertained me while my husband looked at the measly record and tshirt collection.  

A) There's a MOLD-A-RAMA.  A FREAKING MOLD-A-RAMA!!!  I'm not sure where these used to exist, but if you grew up in the Chicagoland area pre-1995, you likely visited Brookfield Zoo and got to use a Mold-A-Rama to make gorillas, giraffes, and more!  That smell evokes a nostalgia in me that is difficult to describe.... and you can make one at third man!  You bet I did and I still have it because it's amazing.  I'd go back here just to use that machine again.

B) There's a recording booth where you can cut your own record.  Kind of expensive but super cool if you're into that sort of thing.

C) There's old carnival-like machines with dancing monkeys and such that play music.  Super adorable!  I'd spend money on this any day of the week.

I'll likely end up back here some day because my husband loves JW, TWS, all things Detroit, and music... but I'll only come if there's a Mold-A-Rama in it for me.

name: Back Alley Diner
text:
Friday special - BAD Food, BAD Drinks, BAD Service. They play a lot on their acronym which is cool. Downtown for a meeting and decided to hang around for lunch. Three of us gravitate to The Arcade. The other too had been here I think, I had not. It's pretty hard to find if you haven't been before. I have been to The Arcade several times and never knew it was there. It is actually in the alley that bi-sects The Arcade. 

Cool vibe and lots of character. Ample bar area along with booths and tables, exposed brick and beams, peaked ceiling. This looks like a great late night place. They have open mic night on Tuesdays.

I had the hot ham sandwich on wheat and the turkey sausage and white bean soup. Soup could have been warmer and as always, a larger portion. The amount of ham was ample and had Swiss cheese lettuce and tomato - the taste was great. Co-workers got the bleu burger and pork sliders - on with chips, one with fries. They didn't ask how he wanted the burger cooked and it was overdone, but said the taste was good - cooked on a flattop. Like me, he liked it a little pink on the inside. Fries were your typical frozen fries - nothing more, nothing less. Think the chips may be made in-house. Pork was deemed OK, but needed the sauce. 

It is a comfortable, cool kind of place - lots of tattoos and piercings on the staff, but that's all good. Sandwiches and burgers are the main fare. Service was exceptional - making one aware that lots of the food was probably already cooked and then warmed up - but it is hard to mess up a ham sandwich and obviously soup cannot be made to order.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
If it was music alone it would be TEN STARS!!! The music was AWESOME!!! The band welcome members of my sorority with open arms. We danced and just had a grand ole time! 

Not my margarita? I am still trying to figure out what exactly that was and in a paper cup, like really! I expected somewhat the same such as  BB King in my home town but NEGATIVE! The bbq nachos was good and tasty as an appetizer. I ordered catfish and shrimp. The fries were to salty, the catfish was to seasoned (keep it simple) the shrimp was okay. 

Service was good and somewhat swift. The guy was really nice. The atmosphere is nice with the awesome band.

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
I came to this place with my sister and a few of her coworkers when we were in Nashville for a work conference. It was an excellent choice! The live music was really good (although one of the bands did get a bit too loud - it was hard to even enjoy conversation) and the atmosphere was nice. It's a nice big open space with tons of tables and a laid back vibe so it's easy to sit and feel comfortable and enjoy the music. 

All the food we ordered was good... ribs, burgers, fried chicken, fried pickles, wings... Nothing that really blew me totally away but it was all very very tasty. The beer selection was good too, and so was the service! I have nothing bad to say about this place except the music getting a bit too loud. If i was in Nashville, I'd be back.

name: Ms. Kelli's Karaoke Bar
text: I love this place been coming to this bar for 4 years love the djs the owners the music and other patrons very friendly place to go. Cheapest drinks in downtown Nashville and you get to be a star while your come check it out for yourself and have a good time ..so 5 stars it is for me thanks Ms.kellis for all the good times .

name: BB King's Blues Club
text:
I held the groom's dinner for my son's wedding here in October.  It was the perfect choice, and the event was a huge success.  Kelly was great to work with.   I don't live in Nashville, so I bombarded her with emails with questions and she was quick and thorough with her responses.  I wanted a casual Southern feel to the food and it was excellent! (this was told to me by many of the guests).  The pork, Jambalaya, corn bread, green beans...everything, really, received compliments.  The wait staff (especially Kameron) was completely attentive.  I didn't have to ask for a thing.  As the buffet needed something they were right there to refill.  
We had our own band and they were allowed in the day of the event to practice.  That was extremely nice.  BB Kings did not nickel and dime me on anything.  The prices were the prices.  
People who attended the party are still talking about it, and this is in no small part to the wonderful venue, food, and staff.  Thank you everyone!!!

name: Grand Ole Opry
text:
What an experience, one might even say a religious experience! I knew I had to see a show here while in Nashville. I ordered my tickets two months before my trip!
I will admit, ABC's Nashville had a big part in turning me onto country and exposing me to this historical venue. I knew I had to see the stage that has welcomed & introduced so many greats. I had to see the place artists dream of being inducted into. And I was really excited for the back stage tour!
There isn't a bad seat in the house. I was on the lower level on the left. it was amazing. There were multiple hosts with multiple musicians on the bill. Traditional country, blue grass and more modern as well. The highlight for me was seeing Montgomery Gentry - it was phenomenal!
I highly recommend the backstage tour with ticket purchase and make sure to go after the show as you are more likely to see some of the performers backstage! The video with Darius Rucker is fantastic! I loved watching the night he was invited to join the Opry by Brad Paisley. 
I loved seeing the dressing rooms, each with their own story!

name: Ms. Kelli's Karaoke Bar
text: What's with all the negativity. This place is hella cool. The DJ is hands down the best singer of anyone that came on stage. He controlled the vibe and energy and seriously one of the best karaoke DJ's I've seen and heard. Place is huge. Drinks good. Chill out people. It's karaoke. You don't have to cry if they didn't play your song.

name: DawgHouse Saloon
text: Smells like stale beer. Went to watch a ball game -- this place was perfect for that. Hopefully a college bar... prob should been sanitized with Clorox to get the smell of beer and vomit to go away.

name: Flying Saucer Draught Emporium
text: An unbelievable beer menu, including ciders, lambics, and beer cocktails for those not super into beer (the Hummingbird H2O is great!). A fun stop before or after visiting the Frist!

name: Loveless Cafe
text: A great place for comfort food. My wife and I ordered the meat loaf and fried pork chop dinners. Great homemade flavors and the portions were humongous. A definite stop if you are in town.
